      "skill": {
        "name": "Unification of Spirits",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge</color></size>\nWhen \"Lion's Spirit\" is full, use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike</color></size>\nWhen \"Lion's Spirit\" is not full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Striding Lion</color></size>\nAfter casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, enter <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state;\nAfter casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Lion Awakens</color> or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Strive: Lion's Vigor</color>, if \"Lion's Spirit\" is full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state.\nIn the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state:\n-Attacks can be launched in mid-air. If Lingyang is on the ground, use Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color> to get back in the air.\n-\"Lion's Spirit\" is continuously consumed before running out in {0}s, and when it runs out, <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> ends;\n-If Lingyang is in the Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Lion's Vigor</color> state, the consumption speed of \"Lion's Spirit\" is reduced by {1}, extending <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state by up to {2}s.\n-Lingyang's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Feral Gyrate</color>, which performs up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>;\n-Lingyang's <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Mountain Roamer</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>;\n-When \"Lion's Spirit\" is less than {3}, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>; after performing Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, the Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color> becomes available.\n-Concerto Energy is restored when \"Lion's Spirit\" is consumed.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lion's Spirit</color></size>\nLingyang can hold up to {4} \"Lion's Spirit\".\nWhen casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Furious Punches</color>, \"Lion's Spirit\" is restored.\nWhen casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Lion Awakens</color>, \"Lion's Spirit\" is restored.\nWhen casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Strive: Lion's Vigor</color>, \"Lion's Spirit\" is restored.",
        "param": [
          "5",
          "50%",
          "10",
          "10",
          "100"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge</color></size>\nWhen Lion's Spirit is full, use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike</color></size>\nWhen Lion's Spirit is not full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Striding Lion</color></size>\nAfter casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, enter the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state.\nAfter casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Lion Awakens</color> or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Strive: Lion's Vigor</color>, if Lion's Spirit is full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state.\nIn the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state:\n- Attacks can be performed in mid-air. If Lingyang is on the ground, use Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color> to get back in the air.\n- Lion's Spirit is continuously consumed, and when it runs out, the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state ends.\n- The consumption rate of Lion's Spirit in the <color=Highlight>Lion's Vigor</color> state is reduced.\n- Lingyang's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Feral Gyrate</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n- Lingyang's <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Mountain Roamer</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n- When Lion's Spirit is less than {3}, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. After performing Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, the Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color> becomes available.\n- Consuming Lion's Spirit restores Concerto Energy.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lion's Spirit</color></size>\nLingyang can hold up to {4} Lion's Spirit.\nLingyang gains Lion's Spirit through <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.",

  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_27_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_27_UI",

    "influence": "Jinzhou",
    "info": "An artist for hire trying to make a living. Reserved and timid, she is not good with words but speaks volumes through her art, where her creations come to life with impossible authenticity.",
    "talent_name": "Enchanted Brush",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1231-G]\n\nThe exact timing of Resonator Zhezhi's Awakening is unclear. Signs of \"animation\" appeared in her childhood drawings, and her Forte control improved alongside her painting skills.\n\nResonator Zhezhi's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on the back of her right hand. Post-Awakening observations have not found any significant physical changes. Testing shows Zhezhi can \"animate\" her paintings, affecting observers' visual perception and judgment (effective on both living organisms and <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>).\n \n\"Animation\" has two levels:\nModerate: Causes slight movements in two-dimensional images.\nSevere: Simulates three-dimensional volumetric forms, lasting up to 30 minutes and 28 seconds, covering up to 274.5 square meters.\n\nBoth levels produce illusions, not actual objects. No stable interval detected.\n\nNo similar Resonance Spectrum Pattern identified, and the cause of Zhezhi's Awakening remains unclear.\nAdditionally, analysis of test samples show a <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a noticeable periodic waveform. Therefore, Zhezhi is identified as a <te href=850068>Congenital Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Zhezhi's waveform graph shows a regular pattern with brief abnormal fluctuations. Long-term monitoring of her Time Domain indicates that the waveforms remain stable. Examination results are within normal parameters.\n\nResonant Criticality: Normal. However, Zhezhi's frequency displays low stability with a high risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n\nRecords indicate no history of Overclocking.\n\nRoutine examinations and psychological counseling are advised.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Miao Zi",
    "cv_name_jp": "Makino Yui",
    "cv_name_ko": "Kim Ha Ru",
    "cv_name_en": "Shin-Fei Chen"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Prized Possessions",
      "content": "The girl proudly presented her painting to her mother, eager to share her achievement. The woman, absorbed in selecting jewelry to wear, stole a fleeting glance at the artwork. \"Impressive, Zhezhi,\" she murmured with a brief smile. Delighted by the praise, the girl inched closer. \"The people in this one are—\" Her words faltered as her mother turned, absorbed in wardrobe choices, oblivious to her daughter's attempt at connection. \"Well done. Now, why don't you paint a few more before the guests arrive?\" Zhezhi blinked, at a loss for words. Her mother grew impatient, sighing as she marched Zhezhi to the door. \"Buy whatever supplies you need, dear. The price doesn't matter, we can afford it. Now, I need to dress. Be a good girl. Off you go.\" As the door closed, Zhezhi stared at it, wanting to say more but unable to find the courage to voice the sinking feeling in her chest.\n\nLater that evening, Zhezhi, dressed to impress, nervously clutched her skirt in the corner seat, silent amidst the bustling room of guests. The woman noted Zhezhi's unease, the sight of it triggering memories of their family's past struggles and humble beginnings. She strode forward, taking Zhezhi's hand and leading her into the center of attention. \"Didn't you know? Zhezhi was gifted from the day she was born. Her paintings were chosen for exhibitions even before we hired a tutor.\" With a painted smile, she mimicked the grace of the upper class. \"Would you care for a painting too? Zhezhi can finish one in a day.\" Zhezhi shrank inwardly, wishing to disappear, only to be thrust forward. \"Show everyone your skills, Zhezhi.\" All eyes turned to her, leaving Zhezhi trembling, unable to paint a single stroke.\n\nLater, as the mansion fell silent, Zhezhi gathered her courage again. Holding the day's painting, she approached her parents' bedroom door. Just before knocking, she overheard their conversation inside.\n\"Did you know? That painting sold for 400,000 Credits today. With this money, we can fulfill the paused order.\"\n\"Right. Are the paintings for the guests ready for this weekend?\"\n\"Not yet. Zhezhi mentioned wanting to go to the theater. That girl, always seeking diversions, never thinking about what's best for this family...\"\n\nZhezhi looked down at the happy family in the painting, her grip tightening until it crumpled, distorting her mother and father's faces.\n\"...I'm sorry.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "The True Meaning of Art",
      "content": "Zhezhi realized something was amiss in her painting only after heading out for a sketch. As she took in the idyllic countryside, a new idea struck her like a ray of sunlight. Glancing around to make sure she was alone, she stretched her arms, and for a moment, let go of her parents' demands.\n\nAs her bare feet met the grass, its prickly, cool softness awakened a sense of nature's healing vitality. She broke into an impulsive run, shedding worries about upholding the refined image her family demanded. A distant voice abruptly interrupted her frolic.\n\n\"Hey, who are you? What are you doing in our field?\"\n\nStartled, Zhezhi immediately looked down at her feet in embarrassment. Realizing she was trespassing on private property, she apologized as she tried to leave. \"I'm so sorry! I came here to paint. I didn't know this was someone's field...\"\n\nThe girl laughed, seeing the panic on Zhezhi's face. \"Don't worry! These veggies are tough. You don't need to run!\" She laughed as she continued gathering the vegetables with her sickle. \"A painter, huh? That's different...\" Zhezhi hesitated for a moment, seeing the girl hard at work. \"Let me help you with that...\" The girl met Zhezhi's eyes with a twinkle. \"Sure! Thanks for offerin'! Here, use this sickle, I'll go grab another one!\"\n\nZhezhi stared in confusion at the sickle promptly shoved into her hands. But she soon squatted down among the tall vegetables, mimicking the farm girl's movements. \"Wait, wait. You won't get anywhere doin' it like that. Here, lemme show ya!\"\n\nUnder the hot sun, the two girls worked together to harvest the field until they reached its end. Exhausted, they lay under a tree to rest. Zhezhi forgot about the mud on her shoes and the dirt on her expensive dress, lost in the joy of spending time with her new friend. The carefree laughter between them filled her heart with ease and brought a true smile to her lips.\n\nThe mood was suddenly cut by a sharp voice. Zhezhi turned to see her mother watching, her eyes squinted in anger. Zhezhi could see her disdain for her new friend. Sprinting to her feet, she ran to explain and apologize, transforming back into the child her parents demanded she be.\n\nA few days later, the girl received a scroll. She unrolled it carefully, gasping softly at the sight. The painting showed her and Zhezhi in the sprawling fields of her home, picking vegetables together.\n\nA letter fell from the painting.\n\n\"I'm sorry I didn't say goodbye. I had so much fun harvesting the field with you! The sickle, the sun beating down on us, my sore hands... It made me realize what my paintings were missing. This is my best work, and it's for you! I hope you like it! Maybe next week, I can sneak out to help again.\"\n\nReading the letter made the girl smile, but she couldn't help being confused by Zhezhi's last line.\n\nNext week? Did she think the vegetables would grow back that fast?"
    },
    {
      "title": "No More Hesitation",
      "content": "Zhezhi stood a short distance from the art supply store, eyeing the tall, gruff-looking clerk who was frowning and scribbling something in a notepad. She hesitated, taking a few steps back.\n\n\"Maybe I should go to another store...\" The thought had barely crossed her mind before she dismissed it. \"But... this is the only store with the latest supplies...\"\n\nZhezhi stopped her pacing and pulled out a coin, a habit she had developed for situations like this. She tossed it into the air, caught it, and thought to herself, \"The usual. Heads, I go in. Tails, I come back another time...\"\n\nShe slowly opened her palm, peeking briefly before quickly squeezing her hand shut. \"No, wait. Best two out of three.\"\n\nThe coin went up and came back down. \"Heads again,\" she sighed.\n\nClutching the coin tightly, Zhezhi took a deep breath and steeled herself. \"Oh well, I guess this is a sign. I can't keep running away.\"\n\nTaking a deep breath to gather her courage, she marched to the store and pushed the door open with all her might. The sharp ring of the bell above the door sent her nerves into overdrive. She rushed forward with a lowered gaze and blurted out the lines she'd rehearsed countless times, as if her tongue was on fire.\n\n\"H-Hello! I'd like to buy some new paint! Six cans of Malachite Green No.3, five cans of Azurite Blue No.3, five cans of Vermilion, three cans of Indigo, three cans of Ochre, three cans of Gamboge, and two cans of Golden Yellow. Thank you!\"\n\nRelieved to have finished her sentence smoothly without a single pause, Zhezhi inhaled deeply to catch her breath. When she looked up, she met the eyes of a surprised-looking clerk who was just coming out from the back room.\n\n\"Hello there. How can I help you?\" The clerk's gentle voice was a stark contrast to what Zhezhi had imagined.\n\nRealizing that her earlier words had gone unheard, she froze. \"Uhh... I...\"\n\n\"Are you looking for any specific art supplies?\"\n\n\"P-Paint... I...\"\n\n\"The new releases? They're quite popular.\"\n\n\"N-No... I think I...\"\n\n\"No rush. Feel free to look around.\"\n\nZhezhi, sweating and nervous, walked over to a shelf. \"O-Okay...\"\n\nThe clerk's detailed and professional introduction of the products gradually eased Zhezhi's nerves. She relaxed and was able to name what she wanted, even chatting about her painting.\n\n\"If you're using White Jade Paper, these new products would pair nicely.\"\n\n\"Perfect, that's just what I needed. I'll take these too.\"\n\nWalking out of the store with her new supplies, Zhezhi felt light and confident.\n\n\"I guess I can talk to people when I'm not feeling anxious. Next time... I'll try it without flipping the coin. Maybe it'll work out again...\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Shaping a World",
      "content": "Unsuspecting, Zhezhi was thrown out of her home, her belongings strewn across the courtyard like discarded memories. As she gazed at the mess, it dawned on her that she herself was just another discarded item, abandoned by her parents like the rest.\n\nDesperate for shelter, she first sought out places familiar to her. But those once kind and welcoming turned cold when they learned of her plight. Behind their polite excuses, Zhezhi saw the distaste in their eyes as they pointed her to an old hotel on a street corner.\n\nThe hotel's decaying corridors teemed with unfamiliar fights and loud arguments. Sitting on the bed, she wrapped herself tightly in the musty covers, eyes fixed on the flimsy wooden door barricaded by a table. She longed for sleep, hoping to wake from this nightmare, yet fear kept her awake, afraid the door would shatter if she closed her eyes.\n\nHer descent from luxury to hardship stretched endlessly, each day a painful reminder. The staggering figures of her parents' debt seemed to flicker across the ceiling in the dim light of her windowless room. Her hands, covered in worn bandages, trembled from painting non-stop for two days, but she dared not rest.\n\n\"It's a big order... I can't mess this up,\" she murmured, her weary eyes blurring the landscapes on her canvas.\n\nSuddenly, harsh shouts pierced the night, jarring her awake from an unintended nap at her desk. She stumbled to the door, slipping on something wet at her feet.\n\nAching from the fall, she stood nervously at the door of her leaking room, apologizing repeatedly to her neighbors. The biting cold seeped through her wet clothes, and the neighbors' complaints echoed through the thin walls. She stared at her painting, ruined by the water, and a heavy sigh escaped her lips, compressing the room's thin air, almost crushing her fragile frame.\n\nZhezhi's exhausted figure stood motionless in the cold puddle. After a long pause, a faint light glowed in the cramped room. With paint-stained fingertips, she scrolled through her Terminal, \"First, shut off the water valve... then replace the damaged parts...\"\n\nShe had made a habit of looking up solutions for life's unexpected challenges. \n\n\"I think I've got it... I'll give it a try...\"\n\nShe waded through the water, slowly making her way to the source of the problem."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Ray of Light",
      "content": "\"This painting is a reflection of me. Everyone needs to see at first glance that it's an expensive masterpiece.\"\n\n\"If this is the best you can do, I'll take it. But only at half the price.\"\n\nThe client's words echoed in Zhezhi's mind. She wandered the streets with her bundle of paintings, feeling a sense of numbness begin to creep over her as the festive preparations around her started to fade into the background. It wasn't until she tripped, her paintings scattering, that she snapped out of her daze. Without bothering to look for her glasses, at first she scrambled to pick up her work. But as the wind blew some paintings out of reach, she stopped, staring for a moment before deciding to let them go.\n\n\"Forget it, they're lousy anyway... What's the point of having them back...\"\n\nShe dropped the remaining paintings in her arms, letting them fall. Lost in her thoughts, she didn't notice someone stopping in front of her.\n\nA stranger picked up her paintings and glasses, handing them back to her.\n\n\"Did you paint these? I've never seen art like that. Remarkable.\"\n\nZhezhi, stunned by the compliment, could only accept the outstretched paintings and watch the stranger turn and leave alongside their companions, disappearing into the night.\n\nShe fumbled to put on her glasses to catch a clearer glimpse of who it was, but all she caught was a distant silhouette.\n\n\"Someone complimented me... \"\n\"They had nothing to gain from it. It was just... simple praise for my paintings.\"\n\nThe stranger's words, simple yet sincere, pierced through her paintings to reach her heart. For the first time ever, it was as if someone saw her creative intentions. It was like a sudden beam of light scattering the dark clouds that had long weighed her down, bringing a sense of warmth long overdue.\n\nZhezhi stared in the direction the stranger had vanished, clutching her paintings tightly. Until...\n\n\"Excuse me... Hello?\"\n\nDays later, a familiar voice startled her out of her thoughts as she searched for the perfect spot to paint.\n\n\"Don't worry, we're just here to chat.\"\n\nZhezhi looked up and saw a pair of golden eyes. The memory of that night rushed back—this was the person who had complimented her work, their voice free of the pretense she had grown to despise from everyone else. That voice had given her strength when she had been ready to give it all up.\n\nThe warmth from that night returned, filling a world of pale grey with color once more."
    }

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_die_01.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "The painting... isn't finished yet…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_die_02.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "I'm sorry…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_die_03.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Here comes a helper.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_bat_hxsummon.play_favor_word_zhezhi_bat_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "A new technique.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_bat_hxchange.play_favor_word_zhezhi_bat_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "W-watch out!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_engage.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "(Effort Sounds)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "(Effort Sounds)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_hook_01.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_hook_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Huh?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_scan.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "(Effort Sounds)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_dash_01.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_dash_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "This looks valuable.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Little by little.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_zhezhi_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Paintbrush Set",
      "content": "A set of paintbrushes Zhezhi purchased during her first solo shopping trip as a child, after fumbling for words in front of the shop owner. Wherever Zhezhi went, so did these paintbrushes, recording her artistic growth along the way. Though now too old and fragile to use, Zhezhi still regards them as a source of encouragement, handling them with great care.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure65_UI.T_Treasure65_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Empty Birdcage",
      "content": "A luxurious birdcage left empty for a long time.\n\nAs a reward for Zhezhi's obedience in using her Forte to paint and help save the family business, her parents bought her a pet bird as a surprise. Every day, Zhezhi watched the bird beat its wings against the cage until it was exhausted. After much hesitation, one day she boldly defied her parents and released the bird from its captivity.\n\nAfter her parents disappeared, Zhezhi sold off the family's remaining belongings, keeping only the birdcage as a memento. Whenever she looked at it, she didn't see the bars but the bird that had long since flown free.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure64_UI.T_Treasure64_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Wish List",
      "content": "New desserts, art exhibit tickets, trips to new cities... Struggling to pay off her family's debt while barely making ends meet, Zhezhi took the habit of jotting down things she wanted to buy or do on a wish list. She often checks this list, but can only fulfill one or two of these smaller wishes on rare occasions when she has a bit of extra money.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure66_UI.T_Treasure66_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Dimming Brush",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform an attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\nHeavy Attack does not reset the Basic Attack cycle.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks while in mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Ink and Wash",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Phantasmic Imprint</color></size>\nZhezhi may summon <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprints</color> at the cost of Afflatus when casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Manifestation</color> or Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Conjuration</color>.\nUp to 1 of each of <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Left</color>, <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Middle</color>, and <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Right</color> can exist at the same time, each lasting for {0}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Conjuration</color></size>\nThe 5 moves below consume STA to perform <color=Highlight>Conjuration</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n-Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Manifestation</color>.\n-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>.\n-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> while in mid-air.\n-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.\nIf Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, consume 30 Afflatus to summon a <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Middle</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius</color></size>\nWhen a <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is nearby, the Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color>, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:\n-Move to the location of the <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color>, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is in mid-air.\n-Gain 1 stack of Painter's Delight, lasting for {1}s and stacking up to 2 times.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith</color></size>\nWhen a <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint</color> is nearby and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:\n-Lose all stacks of Painter's Delight\n-Move to the location of the <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint</color>, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing greater <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG, additionally increasing the Basic Attack DMG Bonus by {2} for {3}s. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Afflatus</color></size>\nZhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.\nNormal Attacks grant Afflatus on hit.\nCasting Intro Skill grants Afflatus.",
        "param": [
          "15",
          "8",
          "18%",
          "27"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Phantasmic Imprint</color></size>\nZhezhi consumes Afflatus to summon <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprints</color> when casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Manifestation</color> or Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Conjuration</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Conjuration</color></size>\nThe 5 moves below consume STA to perform <color=Highlight>Conjuration</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n- Holding <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color>.\n- Using <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Manifestation</color>.\n- Holding <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>.\n- Holding <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> while in mid-air.\n- Holding <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.\nIf Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, 30 Afflatus is consumed to summon a <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Middle</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius</color></size>\nWhen any <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint</color> is on the field, Zhezhi's Resonance Skill becomes <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color>. When it is cast, Zhezhi deals <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and gains 1 stack of Painter's Delight.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith</color></size>\nWhen any <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint</color> is on the field and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>. When cast, Zhezhi deals greater <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, and her Basic Attack DMG Bonus is increased.\n\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Afflatus</color></size>\nZhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.\nZhezhi gains Afflatus through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "15",
          "8",
          "18%",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Street Antique Appraisal",
      "content": "On the busiest street in Jinzhou, a small appraisal stall occasionally appears, adding a touch more excitement to the bustling scene.\n \nThe stall owner is a lively girl Youhu who confidently considers herself a seasoned appraiser. She claims that with just a light touch, she can discern the history behind any antique. Her early career saw just one slip-up—misjudging an ancient Ding. She later purchased it from the client, repaired it with her cryogenic powers, and now keeps it close as a reminder to stay sharp.\n \nDespite her playful self-promotion and carefree antics, people don't mind trusting her, especially since her appraisal fees are modest—just the cost of a meal and a sprinkle of compliments.\n \n\"This folding screen predates <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, a rare treasure perfectly preserved! You can even call it a witness to Jinzhou's rise and fall!\"\n \n\"The glaze here? Smooth as jade, soft as silk. It's not ancient, but the craftsmanship is definitely worth the price!\"\n \nHer insights, whether on artistry or historical value, hit the mark every time, earning her the trust of her clients. \n \nAdding to the charm of her appraisals is a unique flair—call it a show, if you will.\n \nWhile others might inspect antiques with magnifying glasses, Youhu examines each piece with lively gestures, reciting witty poems as if she's performing some ancient, mysterious ritual. \n \nInitially, people worried she might accidentally damage their valuables, but after seeing her skills, they've come to embrace her eccentric ways. Perhaps true masters just have their... well, quirks."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Returned Treasure",
      "content": "Youhu always carries a scroll-like box filled with miniature replicas of antiques she's appraised, each crafted with her Forte. These replicas aren't just souvenirs, but handy tools to fend off <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. In the summer, they can double as coolers. Just pop some fruit in with an iced replica, and voilà—a chilled snack!\n \nInside the box is also a booklet where she writes limericks about every antique she encounters:\n \n\"A guy from the <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te> asked me to find that missing enameled porcelain from <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>. Noted!\"\n \n\"That merchant definitely got the celadon tripod incense burner through shady means! I hinted he should return it, but who knows if he'll listen. Better keep an eye on him.\"\n \n\"That carpenter at the city gate is chopping wood with a centuries-old knife! The audacity! What a disgrace! I'll... let it slide this time. Just need to tell him the knife's true worth later.\"\n \nThese interesting notes help keep her memories fresh.\n \nTake that merchant with the incense burner. After weeks of strange events and sleepless nights, he recalled the street appraiser's warning:\n \n\"Haiya, that incense burner's from a bad place! Your luck won't hold up against it—misfortune's coming your way!\"\n \nShe had said it with such flair, like a storyteller spinning a tall tale. The merchant hadn't taken her seriously at first, but his recent misfortunes made him reconsider.\n\nOne night, after the fifteenth eerie shadow flitted outside his window with its bone-chilling shriek, he rushed to return the stolen burner.\n \nHad he dared to look up, he might have seen another scene unfolding: \n\nThe Patrollers had spotted a suspicious figure on the rooftops and moved in to question them.\n\nYouhu, dressed in a makeshift disguise, saw the guards approaching and fled, stumbling a few times along the way.\n \nEven as she ran, she managed to jot down in her booklet: \"Celadon tripod incense burner, returned to its rightful place.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Where History Endures",
      "content": "Youhu was born in a bustling port town known for its antique trade, where her parents were both esteemed appraisers. \n \nOn her first birthday, her parents, following local customs, surrounded her with objects representing various trades. It was said that the first item the child touched would predict their future interests and career path.\n \nBut that day, little Youhu ignored pens, swords, and cooking utensils, crawling straight to her mother to latch onto the family's precious heirloom—a genuine antique Ruyi ring—and refused to let go.\n \nGrowing up surrounded by antiques, Youhu's love for them blossomed. She was fascinated by everything about them, soaking up the driest, most obscure appraisal facts with a twinkle in her eye. But what she loved most was listening to the stories her parents told about the antiques.\n \nThe deep chimes of the ancient bell echoed with memories of distant times when people knelt in devotion before golden statues praying for their family's wellbeing. \n \nThe stone carvings depicted bold youths drawing their bows, warding off <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> to protect the people.\n \nYouhu's lively nature shone through as she immersed herself in the world of antiques, the <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> on her arm glowing faintly to illuminate her eyes.\n \nIn every antique, she saw a little piece of history and a glimpse into the remnants of a civilization. This magic still holds her spellbound today.\n\nChenpi, Youhu's master, often praised her talent. \"To be honest, your knowledge of antiques lacks structure. But don't worry, I'll teach you everything you need to know.\"\n \n\"What's truly valuable is your respect for the history in these antiques and your keen perception. In other words, you're a natural appraiser.\"\n \nAnd Youhu would flash a cheeky grin, \"Pfft, my parents already said I was born for this.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "The Value of Antiques",
      "content": "The so-called renowned appraisers are always squabbling over the value of antiques.\n \nFirst, they downplay an antique's value, snapping it up for a pittance, only to turn around and hype it up to sell for a fortune. Craftsmanship? History? Mere afterthoughts in their pricing games.\n \nHowever, Youhu has a different approach. For her, the worth of an antique isn't measured solely in currency, but something more unique.\n \nGenuine appreciation is the first factor. Youhu enjoys facilitating deals where buyers are deeply respectful of the antiques and sellers entrust their cherished items to someone who truly appreciates them. As the antique changes hands, its frequency is mirrored in the hearts of both parties.\n \nAnother factor would be conscience. When Youhu was seven, raiders ransacked the town looking for riches. To them, antiques were just another form of loot.\n \nThe wealthy merchants and local appraisers panicked, abandoning their treasures as they escaped.\n \nThe raiders, ignorant about the true worth of these antiques, justified their plundering by saying the people here didn't deserve their treasures anyway, and such items might as well be taken somewhere they would be appreciated.\n \nBut not everyone fled. Some stood their ground, facing the raiders with steely resolve. They knew the true value of these antiques and defended them to the bitter end.\n \nAnd that brings us to the final factor. The courage to sacrifice.\n \nNow, it is Youhu's turn to make a sacrifice. Whether it is her talent, her knowledge, or the lengths she will go to recover them, she is determined to return every lost antique back to its rightful owner.\n \nIn the past, those who couldn't see the value in these relics trampled all over them. But today, Youhu's mission is to return each lost antique to where it truly belongs."

She also crafted an ice Ruyi, swinging it with such gusto that she nearly smashed the nearby ice cauldron and mask!\n \nPeople often ask about her most treasured antique. Youhu always hesitates, her eyes fixed on the Ruyi ring before her. This is her family's heirloom—once shattered, but now pieced together with ice.\n \nHer mother had told her that the Ruyi ring symbolized completeness and good fortune. Youhu was mesmerized by the clear and translucent jade. But when raiders came, she could only watch as the ring and other treasures were pillaged and shipped away.\n \nThree years later, she found those plundered items displayed as trophies in a museum. Despite an exhaustive search, the Ruyi ring was nowhere to be found.\n \nIt wasn't until she stumbled into a dusty storage room that she found the ring's shattered fragments, along with a tag that read \"Low value, not for display.\" What she valued most was dismissed by those who didn't understand its true worth.\n \nHeartbroken yet determined, Youhu clutched the fragments and trudged through knee-deep snow, her tears freezing as they fell. Driven by a sudden thought, she ignored the biting cold, crouched down, and used her Forte to piece the ring back together from the ice before losing consciousness.\n \nWhen she awoke, her hands were etched with delicate snowflake patterns. The next thing she saw was a perfect, gleaming ice Ruyi ring lying beside her, as if it had been waiting for her all along."

      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_youhu_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "Geez, you're actually giving me all of these? Good call!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_youhu_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack",
      "content": "Tryna fool me?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_atk_heavyatk02_01.play_favor_word_youhu_atk_heavyatk02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "NOICE!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Woohoo!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Useless!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill02.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Let's listen... Waah, ouch!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill03.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Wow. Exquisite!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill04.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill04"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "This is SO COOL... Ow!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill05.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "All eyes on me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill06.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_skill06"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Behold my collection! Hehe... Waaahhh!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_burst_burst_01.play_favor_word_youhu_burst_burst_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Luck is on MY side! Hehe... Waaahhh!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_burst_burst_02.play_favor_word_youhu_burst_burst_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_burst_burst_03.play_favor_word_youhu_burst_burst_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Take... that!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_qte.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Oopsies!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_youhu_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Ow! Watch where you going!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_youhu_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Is that the best you got?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_youhu_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Nu huh... Bring it on!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_youhu_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Not pulling punches, huh...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_youhu_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Hands off... my treasures...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_die_02.play_favor_word_youhu_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "It's so... cold...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_die_03.play_favor_word_youhu_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Go! Get 'em!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Watch and learn!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_youhu_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Here comes Master Youhu!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_engage.play_favor_word_youhu_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "I... I'm scared of heights!!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_youhu_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "A-Are we goin' up?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_hook_01.play_favor_word_youhu_com_hook_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Aha! Found ya!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_scan.play_favor_word_youhu_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Yay! Good stuff!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_youhu_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Worry not! Go ahead and open it! This master is here for ya!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_youhu_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Outta my way! I want a look!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_youhu_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_youhu_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Master Youhu's Poetry Collection",
      "content": "A booklet Youhu always carries to jot down her favorite poems and snippets of inspiration for her limericks. \n \nThey say to record all your ideas—you never know when they'll come in handy. That's exactly what Youhu does every day, capturing every clever thought, whether for antique appraisals or an occasion that calls for a witty poem. It's her way of keeping her mind sharp. \n \nBut of course, this is her little secret, so let's keep it between us, hm?",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure69_UI.T_Treasure69_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "An Ice Mask",
      "content": "An ice mask conjured by Youhu's Forte. The design differs from the original, but the sly grin on the mask mirrors Youhu's own when she's scheming up some mischief. \n \nYouhu often toys with this mask in her spare time, keeping it as a reminder of how she was nearly deceived when appraising the original antique early in her career. \n \nBeyond serving as a cautionary symbol, it's also the perfect prop for giving people a good scare or pulling a fast one on those who catch her interest.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure67_UI.T_Treasure67_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "The Ruyi Ring",
      "content": "A jade ring once cracked, now repaired by Youhu with her cryogenic Forte.\n \nOnce lost in the chaos of a fire, this family heirloom has finally found its way back to Youhu after an arduous search spanning miles. She still dreams of the old days—the gentle breeze from her mother's fan, the sound of her father brewing tea. When she wakes, she often finds the Ruyi ring clutched in her hand.\n \nRuyi, a symbol of peace and happiness, is believed to grant one's wishes. To Youhu, it's more than just an antique.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure68_UI.T_Treasure68_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Frosty Punches",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\n- When Frost is full, hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color>.\n- When Frost is full during the <color=Highlight>Fortune Rolling</color> state, release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color>. If Youhu cannot cast <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color> at the moment, perform <color=Highlight><te href=850045>Lucky Draw</te></color> once instead.\n<color=Highlight>Youhu can obtain Frost in the following ways:</color>\n- When Frost is not full, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to enter the <color=Highlight>Fortune Rolling</color> state and restore Frost over time.\n- When <color=Highlight>Basic Attacks</color> hit a target.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Frostfall</color></size>\nYouhu dashes forward, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, and performs <color=Highlight><te href=850045>Lucky Draw</te></color> once.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nPerform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nWhen Youhu possesses no <color=Highlight>Antique</color>, quickly press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to thrust forward, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, and perform <color=Highlight><te href=850045>Lucky Draw</te></color> once.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\n- When Frost is full, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Youhu gains Frost in the following ways:</color>\n- When Frost is not full, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter the <color=Highlight>Fortune Rolling</color> state and restore Frost over time.\n- When <color=Highlight>Basic Attacks</color> hit a target.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Frostfall</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and perform <color=Highlight>Lucky Draw</color> once.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and perform <color=Highlight>Lucky Draw</color> once.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Scroll Divination",
        "desc": "Youhu smashes her scroll down at the enemy, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, restoring HP for all party members nearby, and performs <color=Highlight>Lucky Draw</color> once.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lucky Draw</color></size>\nYouhu obtains a random <color=Highlight>Antique</color> after the <color=Highlight>Lucky Draw</color>. With an <color=Highlight>Antique</color>, her next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> will activate the corresponding <color=Highlight>Antique Appraisal</color>.\nOnly one <color=Highlight>Antique</color> can exist at a time, and the newly drawn <color=Highlight>Antique</color> will replace the existing one.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Antique Appraisal</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Chime</color>: Attack the enemy with a Chime, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Ruyi has a higher DMG Multiplier.\n- <color=Highlight>Ding</color>: Ram into the enemy on a Ding, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Ding can effectively break the enemy's stance.\n- <color=Highlight>Mask</color>: Throw a Mask at enemies in front, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Mask can pull in enemies along its path.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, healing all party members nearby, and perform <color=Highlight>Lucky Draw</color> once.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lucky Draw</color></size>\nYouhu obtains a random <color=Highlight>Antique</color> after the <color=Highlight>Lucky Draw</color>. With an <color=Highlight>Antique</color>, her next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> will activate the corresponding <color=Highlight>Antique Appraisal</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Antique Appraisal</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Chime</color>: Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.       "skill": {
        "name": "Poetic Essence",
        "desc": "At four Auspices, hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button to release <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG, while restoring HP for all nearby party members.\nYouhu can hold up to four Auspices.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Poetic Essence</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> to enemies within the range and additionally obtain one of the following effects based on the Auspice combination:\n- <color=Highlight>Free Verse</color>: Four different types Auspices. Additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of hit enemies.\n- <color=Highlight>Antithesis</color>: A pair of Auspices. Increase <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color>'s DMG by {0}.\n- <color=Highlight>Double Pun</color>: Two pairs of Auspices. Additionally restore HP for all nearby party members.\n- <color=Highlight>Triplet</color>: Three identical Auspices. Increase <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color>'s DMG by {1}.\n- <color=Highlight>Perfect Rhyme</color>: Four identical Auspices. Simultaneously activate the effects of <color=Highlight>Free Verse</color>, <color=Highlight>Double Pun</color>, and <color=Highlight>Triplet</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color> removes all Auspices.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Auspice</color></size>\n- Youhu gains an Auspice through <color=Highlight>Antique Appraisal</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> while holding an <color=Highlight>Antique</color> to receive the corresponding Auspice.\n- Youhu unlocks <color=Highlight>Antiques</color> by casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scroll Divination</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Scroll of Wonders</color>, Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fortune's Favor</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.",
        "param": [
          "70%",
          "175%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "At four Auspices, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> while healing all nearby party members.\nYouhu can hold up to 4 Auspices.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Poetic Essence</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and also gain one of the following effects based on Auspice combinations:\n- <color=Highlight>Free Verse</color>: 4 unique Auspices additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of enemies.\n- <color=Highlight>Antithesis</color>: 1 pair of Auspices increase DMG by {0}.\n- <color=Highlight>Double Pun</color>: 2 pairs of Auspices additionally heal all nearby party members.\n- <color=Highlight>Triplet</color>: 3 identical Auspices increase DMG by {1}.\n- <color=Highlight>Perfect Rhyme</color>: 4 identical Auspices activate the effects of <color=Highlight>Free Verse</color>, <color=Highlight>Double Pun</color>, and <color=Highlight>Triplet</color> all at once.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color> removes all Auspices.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Auspice</color></size>\nYouhu gains Auspice through <color=Highlight>Antique Appraisal</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "70%",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Snapshot",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to deploy <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>. A cursor will move along the <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>. \n- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button when the cursor falls outside of <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.\n- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button when the cursor falls within <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>, dealing increased <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring additional <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> will cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color> instead of deploying <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> continues to expand when <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color> and automatically collapses when fills the whole <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>, triggering <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>.\nHolding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, and 3</color> in sequence, and deploys <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color> during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Shortly after performing this attack, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> deploys a <color=Highlight>ring</color>.\nLanding the cursor within the <color=Highlight>highlight area</color> allows Lucilla to deal increased <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restore additional <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.",

        "name": "Clear As Day",
        "desc": "Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Reminiscence</color>:\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, the DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. Casting this skill grants Lucilla {0} Basic Attack DMG Bonus for {1}s.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, the DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>. Casting this skill grants Lucilla {0} Echo Skill DMG Bonus for {1}s.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Reminiscence</color>, Lucilla's resistance to interruption is increased, and she cannot cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>. Her <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Reminiscence</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It: Hard Cut</color> respectively.\nCan be performed in mid-air.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to continuously attack the target.\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>, releasing the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or finishing the whole <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color> automatically casts <color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Letting It Go</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>/<color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color> is immune to interruption, and Resonator switching is disabled while casting.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color> ends <color=Highlight><te href=110905>Reminiscence</te></color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 2</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Reminiscence</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. Enemies defeated by <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> DMG during this time is credited to the nearest active Resonator.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, Resonators in the team gain {2} Echo Skill DMG Bonus for {3}s.\nThese enhancements end when Lucilla switches the Resonance Mode.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Memory Palace",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Déjà Vu</color></size>\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day</color>, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, gain <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=110903>Film Roll</te></color> for {1}s, stacking up {2} times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, gain <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of <color=Highlight><te href=110904>Zoom</te></color> for {7}s, stacking up {8} times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Film Roll</color></size>\nWhen Resonators besides Lucilla inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> onto the target, Lucilla consumes <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of <color=Highlight>Film Roll</color> to inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=time SapTag=4} on the target. This effect can be triggered once every {5}s.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Zoom</color></size>\nEach stack of <color=Highlight>Zoom</color> increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by {9}.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Oblivion</color></size>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color> consumes 1 <color=Highlight><te href=110902>Photo</te></color> to perform <color=Highlight>Oblivion</color>, dealing 1 instance of <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <SapTag=A>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of Concerto Energy:\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, this instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. The skill inflicts <SapTag=B>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=B} of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on the target.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, this instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>. The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd <color=Highlight>Oblivion</color> cast during <color=Highlight><te href=110905>Reminiscence</te></color> are considered Echo Skills not of the same name. \n\n<size=40><color=Title>Quick Glance</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Aim to enter the camera mode. During this mode, Reverberations, collectibles, and specific items within a certain range of Lucilla's shot will be marked. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the shutter to capture the moment, and the marked items will be gathered.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Trace</color></size>\nLucilla can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Trace</color>.\nRestore <SapTag=C>{13}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It</color>.\nRestore <SapTag=D>{14}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Spotlight</color>.\nRestore <SapTag=D>{14}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>.\nRestore <SapTag=E>{15}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Compensate</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Photos</color></size>\nLucilla can hold up to {16} <color=Highlight>Photos</color>.\nEvery <SapTag=F>{17}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color> restored generates 1 <color=Highlight>Photo</color>.",

        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge</color></size>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> restores <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> restores <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>. Landing the cursor within the <color=Highlight>highlight area</color> increases the restoration amount.\nFor every certain amount of <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> restored, generate 1 <color=Highlight>Photo</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode Enhancements</color></size>\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, Lucilla gains certain stacks of <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe: Enhancement</color>. When Resonators besides Lucilla inflict <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color> onto the target, Lucilla consumes <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe: Enhancement</color> to inflict additional <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color> on the target.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, Lucilla gains certain stacks of <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo: Enhancement</color>. Each stack of <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo: Enhancement</color> increases the Crit. DMG of Echo Skill for all Resonators in the team.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Photo Attack</color></size>\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Enhanced State Stage 3</color>, Lucilla consumes <color=Highlight>Photos</color> to restore Concerto Energy and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>:\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, inflict <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color> onto the target hit.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, casting this skill is considered as casting Echo Skills not of the same name.",
