    "talent_name": "Gallant Blaze",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2893-G]\n\nResonator Chixia experienced her Awakening 6 years ago after being exposed to extreme temperatures and blazing flames.\n\nResonator Chixia's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located in her lower left abdomen. Post-Awakening observations found a change in hair color to red and a significant increase in body temperature.\n\nShe is capable of converting the frequencies of high-temperature substances into tangible flame ammunition. \nThe Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Chixia has been observed to align closely with that of flames. A strong Syntony reaction has been observed, yet the cause of Chixia's Awakening remains unclear.\n\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a steep rise in the middle section. Resonator Chixia is thereby classified as a <te href=850069>Mutant Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "The waveform graph for Resonator Chixia displays stable elliptical fluctuations in the Time Domain with no abnormal patterns. Upon examination, all results fall within normal parameters. \n\nResonant Criticality: High. Resonator Chixia's frequency displays high stability with a minimal risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n\nResonator Chixia has no documented history of Overclocking. Routine examinations are recommended, while psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Cai Na",
    "cv_name_jp": "Nagase Anna",
    "cv_name_ko": "Kang Eun Ae",
    "cv_name_en": "Harriet Carmichael"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Morning Routine",
      "content": "Chixia's ancestors were migrants to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> from the Central Plains, with their later generations settling in the city ever since. The family is well-known for their deep passion and expertise in the world of spices.\n\nAs the sun painted the Jinzhou skyline with its morning light, the first sign of activity would always come from Panhua's Kitchen, where plumes of smoke billow from its chimney.\n\n\"Mornin', Mrs. Panhua. A bowl of handmade noodles, please. Extra numb and spicy.\" A loud and clear voice overshadowed the rising hustle and bustle of the city outside the kitchen, immediately capturing the attention of several children nearby, their eyes lighting up with admiration.\n\n\"Miss Chixia, when are we having today's <te href=850113>Overdash</te> lessons?\" one of the children asked eagerly.\n\n\"Your students look more psyched than you are,\" Panhua teased as she served Chixia and the children their breakfast.\n\n\"What's the hurry, I'm not even warmed up yet! Plus, ya can't work on an empty stomach,\" Chixia replied between mouthfuls of spicy noodles.\n\nFor her, an energetic day begins with a spicy tingle to the taste buds.\n\nChixia relished each bite of spicy chili peppers, washing them down with steaming soup. Her body glowed with warmth as the food settled in her stomach.\n\nWith the last slurp of noodles, Chixia wiped her mouth in satisfaction.\n\n\"Now I'm all fired up!\""
    },
    {
      "title": "The Famous Hero",
      "content": "A saying in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> goes: \"One should do good deeds anonymously.\" Chixia, however, doesn't like that.\n\n\"If we all stay anonymous, how will people know who to call for help next time they're in danger?\"\n\n\"A hero must shout their name loud and clear for everyone to remember!\"\n\nShe set this goal on her first day of aspiring to become a hero.\n\nSince childhood, Chixia has been enamored by superheroes like Speedster and Fiamma from Hero Plays. Their names invoked courage and comfort. She dreamed of making her own heroic name, one that would be remembered. Whenever she helped someone, Chixia always made sure to leave her mark, even teaching children to write down her name one stroke at a time.\n\nAnd just like that, her name has spread throughout <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> like wildfire. Her name has become a staple in the city, with people constantly calling out \"Chixia\" wherever they need help. Foreign merchants, unable to speak the local language, mistook \"Chixia\" as a customary greeting. Since everyone is shouting it, so why not follow the trend?\n\nDespite her unwavering determination and fiery passion, Chixia still has her worries. She has been bravely battling bandits, <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, and those suspicious figures in red on the outskirts of Jinzhou. But dangers always surface in unexpected ways, despite her efforts to protect the city.\n\nHas she truly lived up to the standards of a hero in everyone's eyes? Despite her doubts, Chixia finds solace in the smiles of those she protects. In that moment, all worries dissipate in an instant.\n\nOn the other hand, the children of Jinzhou don't care about all of that. In their games of play-pretend, they have already given the hero's role to their fiery big sister Chixia."
    },
    {
      "title": "Ignite the Shadows",
      "content": "<te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is known for its spectacular Hero Plays, and Chixia can't get enough of them. The drum beats, poised actors, and graceful water sleeve movements never fail to impress. But her favorite technique is the Kindlefire move, symbolizing Fiamma's grand entrance. A torch is lit in darkness, shooting a fiery ball into the sky and igniting surrounding candles. The audience is mesmerized by this stunning display, as the faint smell of burning wood fills the air. \n\nIt was a familiar light and a familiar smell, one that always takes Chixia back to her childhood. She remembers journeying in the wild with her parents, setting up camps as they migrated to Jinzhou. At night, the wilderness was treacherous. The silent darkness swallowed everything in its path, including Chixia's small tent where she huddled for safety. In the dark, Chixia clung to her blankets and recited the hero stories mother read her before bed, hoping for Fiamma's protection against the lurking <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. Soon, a small fire flickered in her mind. Little Chixia's gaze fixed on the tent's fabric wall, captivated as the flame grew brighter and brighter...\n\n\"Look! It's Fiamma!\" Jiu in the seat next to her shouted excitedly as he tugged at the corner of Chixia's shirt, bringing her attention back to the stage.\nAnd lo, the majestic Fiamma descended from the sky with a triumphant wave of his torch, causing the wicked Fluffernox to flee in a hurry. The crowd erupted in applause, with Chixia clapping the loudest of all.\n\nAfter returning home from the theater, Chixia readied for patrol and grabbed a plain torch before heading out.\n\n\"You're still holdin' on to that doodad? I've lost count of the years you've had it. Didn't the department give you a lot of new equipment and stuff?\" Chixia's mother remarked as she spooned a generous scoop of hot sauce into her stir-fry.\n\"No worries! This one's bright enough to last another hundred years!\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Rooftop Encounter",
      "content": "Chixia encountered Jiu during one of her nightly patrols. She was investigating a strange case where residents complained of weird noises on their roofs for several nights in a row, but whenever they went outside to check, nothing was there.\n\nArmed with a torch and shrouded in darkness, Chixia climbed the roofs. As she scanned the area, a crumpled Fiamma clipart caught her eye, hidden between roof tiles.\n\n\"...?\"\n\n\"...Score!\"\n\nAs Chixia was about to crouch down for a closer look, an unexpected shadow leaped out of nowhere, giving her a startle. She quickly directed her torch toward the stranger, only to see the face of a small child. Taking advantage of Chixia's moment of confusion, the child snatched the clipart from her hand before quickly disappearing into the boundless dim of night.\n\nChixia rushed over for a quick check, but that child was already gone without a trace.\n\nShe continued her search all night until the break of dawn, when she reached a half-open window and heard a child singing, \"Once I pick up the Torch Sword...\"\nThat's one of Fiamma's lines! Chixia followed, \"I will eradicate that monster!\"\n\nA small head poked out of the window, his bright eyes shining with the excitement of finding a fellow fan.\n\nSince they were both Fiamma admirers, it made things a lot easier. After all, a person who loves Fiamma can't be a bad person!\n\nJiu's family had recently moved to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, and with his parents working long hours, he and his sister were often left alone at home. His sister was timid and always worried that there was a Fluffernox on their roof. Therefore, to protect his sister, Jiu would patrol the rooftops every night.\n\n\"It's a shame I never got to see Fiamma in person,\" Jiu said with a hint of embarrassment, \"I've only heard those lines from outside the theater. I didn't get them wrong, did I?\"\n\n\"Not at all. You nailed it!\" Chixia reassured him. \"You should definitely take your sister to the theater and see how Fiamma kicks Fluffernox butts for yourselves. I guarantee you she won't be scared afterward.\"\n\n\"I... I'll pass. Mom and dad are already having a hard time as it is...\"\n\n\"Here, promise me you'll stay away from the roofs from now on. It'll make my job a whole lot easier, and in return, I'll get you tickets to the plays. Deal?\"\n\n\"Yes, ma'am!\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Thunder and Flames",
      "content": "Chixia's colleagues were surprised by her decision to become a Community Patroller on the day of her graduation from training. \n\nShe went through a lot of trouble to finally join the Public Security Bureau, after multiple failed attempts at the entrance exam. She was also well-known for her unwavering pursuit of heroism. Many people were under the impression that Chixia was aiming at a higher position, and her choice left them scratching their heads.\n\nWhen asked about her decision, Chixi would simply respond with a wide smile, \"I just can't leave <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. The spicy noodles, the theater, and my friends: Jiu, Qianqian, Ali...\"\n\nBut the real reason behind her choice was a tale too intricate for words. Only Chixia knew the depths of her decision.\n\nThe spark of her dedication was ignited during her childhood, fueled by her family's torches, and intensified by the heroic images she saw in the theater. On a particularly dark and stormy night, that spark almost went out, but it was reignited to its brightest by a bolt of lightning.\n\nThat day, young Chixia bravely wielded a torch, pretending to be Fiamma as she tried to scare off the bandits. But her attempts were futile as one of them picked her up and threw her next to her captive friend, Ali. Chixia opened her arms to shield Ali with her body, her eyes shut in fear. Suddenly, a deafening bolt struck, and when she timidly opened her eyes, lightning crashed down on the bandits, causing them to tumble and fall.\n\nIn the midst of lightning flashes, she saw the bright badge her savior wore. \nYears later, Chixia finally passed the entrance exam for the Public Security Bureau, hoping to follow in those heroic footsteps. However, the enigmatic person who wielded that lightning had vanished without a trace. As time passed, she came to understand why that person must stay hidden, and why she wasn't suited to become one of them.\n\nAnd so, she looked at the option for \"Community Patroller,\" the least sought-after role, and placed a resolute checkmark next to it. Though she couldn't become the lightning, there is still something she is best suited to do: to safeguard the simple yet precious everyday lives of civilians."
    }
  ],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_to_player01.play_favor_word_chixia_to_player01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "You should check out Uncle Mahe's for freshest groceries and Auntie Panhua's for the best cuisines. Oh, I'm not saying this because we're related. The food's just that good! Say, I'll bring you over so you can give 'em a try yourself when we have the time.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_to_player02.play_favor_word_chixia_to_player02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "Auntie Panhua always told me how tastebuds can store memories. Maybe the taste of a familiar dish could jog your memory? Even if that fails, a yummy meal will certainly lift your spirits! I want to make everyone happy, especially you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_to_player03.play_favor_word_chixia_to_player03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,

      "content": "<te href=850113>Overdash</te> racing, hero plays, plus the secret bases out in the suburbs... There are so many more places that I want to take you to. I've never been hyped for days off like this before you came. It's amazing how time flies when we're together!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_to_player04.play_favor_word_chixia_to_player04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,

I-I just want you to think of me when we're not together!",

      "title": "Disliked Food",

    {

      "title": "Ideals",

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_story_obj.play_favor_word_chixia_story_obj"

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but \"Fiamma\" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Yangyang",
      "content": "Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!",

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Baizhi",
      "content": "Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,

    },
    {
      "type": 1,

    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XIV",
      "content": "Sucks to be you!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_skill_14.play_favor_word_chixia_skill_14"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XV",
      "content": "Comin' in hot!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_skill_15.play_favor_word_chixia_skill_15"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Watch and learn!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_burst_skill_01.play_favor_word_chixia_burst_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Flame on!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_burst_skill_02.play_favor_word_chixia_burst_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Time for some hot action!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_burst_skill_03.play_favor_word_chixia_burst_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge",
      "content": "Close one!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_evasion_success.play_favor_word_chixia_evasion_success"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_behit_fly_01.play_favor_word_chixia_behit_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Hmph! Won't happen again.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_behit_fly_02.play_favor_word_chixia_behit_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "Play nice, will ya!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_behit_fly_03.play_favor_word_chixia_behit_fly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Tch... No biggie!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_hp70.play_favor_word_chixia_hp70"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Still fine and dandy!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_hp50.play_favor_word_chixia_hp50"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "I can do this all day!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_hp30.play_favor_word_chixia_hp30"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "I must... protect...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_die_01.play_favor_word_chixia_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Ugh...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_die_02.play_favor_word_chixia_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "A hero... will not...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_die_03.play_favor_word_chixia_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Ally of Justice!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_hx_summon.play_favor_word_chixia_hx_summon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "It's morphin' time!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_hx_change.play_favor_word_chixia_hx_change"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Ooh, bring it on!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_qte.play_favor_word_chixia_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Let's give 'em hell!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_enter_battle.play_favor_word_chixia_enter_battle"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Up, up, and away!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_fly.play_favor_word_chixia_fly"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "Fhwip！",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_hook.play_favor_word_chixia_hook"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Ooh! What's that!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_scan.play_favor_word_chixia_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Think you can catch up?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_dash.play_favor_word_chixia_dash"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash",
      "content": "Takin' the high road!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_fast_run.play_favor_word_chixia_fast_run"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Now, what do we have here? Ya can't hide from me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_chest_01.play_favor_word_chixia_chest_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Lucky me, lucky you!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_chest_02.play_favor_word_chixia_chest_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Ohhh... please have something good this time!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_chixia_chest_03.play_favor_word_chixia_chest_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Headline Screenshots",
      "content": "Chixia's heroic actions have made her a celebrated figure in Jinzhou. Though she doesn't seek fame, the heartfelt praise she receives motivate her to continue chasing her dreams.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure16_UI.T_Treasure16_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Victor Savor",
      "content": "A jar of special hot sauce, made according to Chixia's secret family recipe, served in a trophy that Chixia had won before. Chixia cherished this trophy a lot, but this amazing sauce certainly deserves to be put in here. Its flavor is fresh, salty, tangy, and numbing, and in Chixia's words, \"That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure15_UI.T_Treasure15_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Badge of Hero",
      "content": "A Patroller badge and a Fiamma merchandise. \nThe badge has been meticulously decorated, and the merchandise has many signs of wear and tear. \nBoth have been polished to a gleaming shine.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure17_UI.T_Treasure17_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Heroic Bullets",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA!</color></size>\nHold Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Whizzing Fight Spirit</color> to enter <color=Highlight>DAKA DAKA!</color>. In this state:\n- Chixia continuously consumes \"Thermobaric Bullets\" to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\n- Tap <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Then she exits the \"DAKA DAKA!\" state.\n- If {0} \"Thermobaric Bullets\" have been fired when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is activated, Chixia will cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Boom Boom</color> and exit \"DAKA DAKA!\" state.\n- Chixia exits the \"DAKA DAKA!\" state when all \"Thermobaric Bullets\" are consumed.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: Boom Boom</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thermobaric Bullets</color></size>\nChixia can hold up to {1} \"Thermobaric Bullets\".\nInherent Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Magazine</color> increases Max \"Thermobaric Bullets\" by {2}.\nChixia obtains \"Thermobaric Bullets\" for every Normal Attack <color=Highlight>POW POW</color> on hit.\nChixia obtains \"Thermobaric Bullets\" upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Grand Entrance</color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Whizzing Fight Spirit</color>.",
        "param": [
          "30",
          "60",
          "10"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA!</color></size>\nHold Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Whizzing Fight Spirit</color> to enter <color=Highlight>DAKA DAKA!</color>. In this state:\n-Chixia continuously fires Thermobaric Bullets to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n-Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and exiting the DAKA DAKA! state.\n-If {0} Thermobaric Bullets have been fired when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is used, Chixia will cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Boom Boom</color> and exit the DAKA DAKA! state.\n-Chixia exits the DAKA DAKA! state when all Thermobaric Bullets are fired.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: Boom Boom</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thermobaric Bullets</color></size>\nChixia can hold up to {1} Thermobaric Bullets.\nInherent Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Magazine</color> increases Max Thermobaric Bullets by {2}.\nChixia gains Thermobaric Bullets through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "30",
          "60",
          "10"
        ],

    "info": "A girl accompanied by one black and one white Wooly. Encore, consultant from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, dreams of creating happy stories with candies, fairy tales, and her imagination.",
    "talent_name": "Wooly-Counting Game",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1631-G]\nThe exact time of Resonator Encore's Awakening remains uncertain. According to Encore's reports and resonance inspection, the sheep-like entities that accompany her are considered to be manifestations of her imagination and psychological state. They are believed to represent her Forte abilities.\n\nEncore's Resonance Assessment was found to be influenced by the collective emotion in the testing environment, exhibiting a strong Syntony response. The cause of her Awakening remains unconfirmed.\n\nEncore bears a <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> on her upper back, and Post-Awakening examinations have revealed minor physical mutations, including wool-like hair tips. In times of heightened emotional states, she may also manifest sheep-like horns, requiring caution from testing personnel.\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a noticeable periodic waveform, which classifies Encore as a <te href=850068>Congenital Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Encore's waveform graph shows zigzag fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is irregular. Both the upper and lower peak values are high and manifest proximity to the Criticality level. The waveform displays segments of partial fuzziness and abnormal waveform can be seen.\n\nResonant Criticality: relatively high, combined with low stability. Risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> is significant.\n\nIt is recommended to contact her guardian for routine examinations and provide psychological intervention if necessary.\n\n<i>Scribbled annotation: Encore says Aalto is NOT her guardian! Don't want examinations! She likes stories better!</i>\n\n<i>Annotation to the annotation: Please be good, little one. We have candies for you if you want some.</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Shi Haku",
    "cv_name_jp": "Ibuki Chikano",
    "cv_name_ko": "Lee Serena",
    "cv_name_en": "Carina Reeves"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Let's be Friends!",
      "content": "\"If you've got questions that can't be solved, no worries, just ask Encore for help! If you've got answers that feel out of grasp, no worries, just ask Encore to help! If there are places you can't reach... still, no worries, let's all shout that name together—'Encore'!\"\n \nFor those new to <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, please don't let the eerily beautiful Blake Bloom and the organization's unique way of doing \"horticulture\" throw you off. \n \nWith Little Encore by your side, any doubts will be dispelled by her warm and enthusiastic greetings. She is passionate, confident, and truly genuine. This charming friend will make sure your journey is anything but dull. Just remember to fully immerse yourself in those intimate moments with Encore's Woolies — Oh! Apologies if Cosmos accidentally bumps into you, it just tends to get a little too... excited. But no need to worry, not a single scratch will be left on your beautiful face, really.\n \nVisitors from afar, please cast all your worries aside, clear your minds, and listen to Encore's captivating stories. It's safe to accept her little gifts — usually handmade by herself. But if, by chance, the gift turns out to be some sweets, or... well, food, just make sure you're ready for its \"bold look.\" Though, truth be told, if you close your eyes while eating, you might be surprised to find it's not half bad.\n \nEncore is always a delightful companion. With her, your journey will be filled with boundless excitement and treasures. She'll take your hand and guide you through every nook and cranny of the world. Worried about <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>? Fear not. Encore isn't the average little girl who'd hide behind the adults. With a little bit of her flames, any Tacet Discords would be turned into ashes. Now, what if she accidentally sets your hair on fire? Encore assures you she'll be more careful next time! After all, changing your hairstyle every once in a while doesn't sound like a bad idea, does it?\n \nCome now, let's join Encore in the great adventure. Trust me, there's nothing in the Black Shores more enjoyable than this. Of course, you'll need to be fully prepared. Take a deep breath now, count to three, and ask yourself — Are you ready?"
    },
    {
      "title": "A Kid from the Theater",
      "content": "Encore can't quite remember how long Cosmos and Cloudy have been part of her life. It feels as if they have always been there, intertwined with her existence from the very beginning. Perhaps she met them when she was too young to remember? Anyway, her first vivid memories of these Woolies trace back to a cramped yet lively theater.\n \nBack then, a captivating play unfolded amidst enthusiastic applause and the cheers of children. Kids around her age passionately called out the hero's name, but the stage was dimly lit with tightly closed curtains. After a brief confusion, the children regained their rhythm, chanting in unison for an encore until drums sounded, and the curtains lifted, welcoming the return of the hero.\n \nHer mother—more precisely, the Wooly knight \"portrayed\" by her mother—graced the stage, wielding a long sword that sent the villain fleeing in defeat. The black Wooly saved the white Wooly princess, and then they had a happy ever after.\n \nFor a long time, Encore associated her mother with the black Wooly knight. This brave protector of the kingdom reminded her of how her mother took care of her. Sometimes, when Encore acted up, she saw the same faked stern expression in both her mother and the Wooly knight.\n \nAs a child, Encore secretly favored the cute Cloudy, a detail she never shared with Cosmos.\n \nCloudy represented a gentle princess with a kind heart, adorned in beautiful dresses and a crown, residing in a dreamlike castle. The young Encore aspired to be a princess, longing for elegant dresses, a majestic crown, and a sumptuous bed to rest on. Free-spirited children like her didn't fret over monsters beyond the castle; it was the black Wooly's duty to keep her safe — outside the castle was the knight's battlefield.\n \nDuring those days, Cosmos and Cloudy were mere plushies. They were Encore's good friends, but after playtime, they would always maintain a quiet distance, lying still in a box without uttering a word. It was only when the night fell that faint whispers would emerge beside Encore's bed.\n \nTheir fluffy little hands would tenderly stroke Encore's cheeks, offering comfort and freeing her from the clutches of nightmares.\n \nDon't be afraid, Encore; sweet dreams await you. Sleep well, for the adventures with the Woolies will be carefully preserved in dreams."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Heroine's Return",
      "content": "The first time Cosmos and Cloudy spoke to Encore was at her mother's funeral. It was sudden; she still vividly remembers hearing them, as dirty soil and wilted leaves fell onto the coffin.\n\nInitially, the plushies were nestled quietly in Encore's arms, like how they always lay inside the box her mother carried for performances. However, as the funeral attendees began shoveling soil onto the coffin, Cloudy emitted an almost inaudible breath. The small episode went unnoticed by everyone except Encore.\n\n\"Encore, Encore...\" the plushies gradually upped their volume when they realized no one else was paying attention. Encore glanced around warily, trying to confirm no one else heard their voices.\n\n\"Let's go, Encore. I'm sooo bored,\" Cosmos bluntly complained. Surprisingly, its voice resembled Encore's more than her mother's.\n\n\"But... but Cloudy doesn't want to leave...\" Cloudy whimpered. Encore struggled to discern who it sounded like—sometimes like herself, and sometimes more like her mother.\n\nThen, a brief silence followed. The cold morning wind howled through the cemetery, across the mourning crowd, carrying the sound of soil falling onto the coffin further away.\n\n\"No!\" Cosmos impatiently urged, \"We can't wait anymore! The show's almost over!\"\n\nAs if it suddenly remembered something, Cloudy became anxious, \"Encore, Encore! Go to the theater! Let's go to the theater!\"\n\nGazing into the distance, beyond the shadowy trees of the cemetery, Encore fixated on the theater\"s worn but still eye-catching sign. She heard the laughter of children—their uninhibited joy contrasting with the somber sounds of gravel and dirt.\n\nAmidst disapproving stares of her relatives, Encore fled the cemetery and arrived at the abandoned theater. As she pushed open the door, dusty silence was disturbed. Warm spotlights glimmered on the stage, revealing a sea of flowers.\n\nAmid the flowers, her mother's once withered figure now shone brilliantly, igniting Encore's longing for the woman she loved so dearly.\n\n\"Mommy...\" tears shimmered in Encore's eyes as she stumbled toward the stage. But right before she could touch her mother, she was forcefully pulled into darkness.\n\nThe show was over. The lights dimmed, and the curtains closed tightly. An eerie silence filled the theater, as the demons of sadness and fear crept in. Encore was trapped once again in her haunting nightmare.\n\n\"Encore!\" Cosmos shouted.\n\n\"Encore!\" Cloudy echoed.\n\nTo dispel Encore's fear and help her regain courage, Cosmos and Cloudy continued to shout the very word that could bring back the show: \"ENCORE.\" They kept trying until Encore regained her senses and joined them in shouting her own name.\n\nMoments later, the curtains lifted once more, accompanied by drum rolls. As the lights dispelled the darkness, Encore emerged onto the stage as the new leading role, welcomed by enthusiastic applause from Cosmos and Cloudy.\n\nOverwhelmed, Encore couldn't help but burst into tears. All the sadness and fear were washed away with her streaming tears. Soon, her usual smile reappeared on her face. Now, it was Encore's turn to play the brave Wooly knight. A new adventure was about to unfold.\n\nThis time, she'll make sure her story has a happy ending."
    },
    {
      "title": "Orphanage and Candy House",
      "content": "Being the great Consultant of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> as she is now, Encore still refuses to act like a grown-up girl. To her, growing up means bidding farewell to bedtime stories, a prospect she firmly rejects. The very idea of drifting into sleep with empty, dark dreams instead of the vibrant hues of wonderful tales doesn't sit well with her.\n\nLuckily, the adults in the Black Shores are happy to indulge her. However, there lies a challenge—who among the busy grown-ups can spare the time to read Encore a brief bedtime story? That's when Cloudy raises its little fluffy hand, promptly followed by the dark, fluffy hand of Cosmos.\n\nOn this particular evening, Cloudy brought Encore the old story of the Candy House.\n\n\"Then... then...\" Cloudy's voice trailed off, growing softer. Oh no, it seemed to have forgotten the next part. Nervously, Cloudy glanced at its companion, lifting the blanket and attempting to hide itself from the intense embarrassment.\n\n\"I know! I know!\" Cosmos eagerly pushed Cloudy aside, standing beside Encore's bed, proudly taking over the storytelling. \"Then, The Great Encore, blessed by blazing flames, defeated the big bad cat! Its dirty fur was all burnt!\"\n\n\"And what about the Great Encore's friends?\"\n\n\"Everyone was safe because of the Great Encore, of course. From then on, people lived in happiness without worrying about the big bad cat!\"\n\nEncore immersed herself in the story until her eyelids succumbed to the irresistible call of sleep. She wanted to add that \"Director Mama is NOT a big bad cat,\" but she was too tired to form a complete sentence. In the end, Cloudy and Cosmos, confused by Encore's muttered objection, joined her under the soft covers, and they all drifted into a deep sleep.\n\nIn her dream, Encore found herself back at the orphanage, standing before the Candy House devoured by scorching flames.\n\nThe roof melted in the inferno, and boiling syrup oozed onto the dying black cat, adding to its suffering. The creature was a grotesque symbol of its own transgressions. Encore witnessed its demise, the inevitable consequence of its wicked deeds.\n\nHowever, the Reaper refused to easily forgive this sinful soul soaked in innocent blood, choosing instead to torture it and revel in its reluctant confession.\n\nAgonizing screams reverberated through the forest. All creatures, once aggressive hyenas and arrogant crows, cowered in fear. In this silent place, only Encore and the dying souls endured.\n\n\"It must hurt a lot...\" A fiery blaze cast a glow on Encore's face as she approached the dying cat. She gently pressed her cheek against its body, using her scarred little hands to stroke its fur.\n\nThe giant cat resented Encore for foiling its plan, expecting her to feel the same. After all, its evil deeds were cruel enough to earn the resentment of everyone. But why? Why did it feel nothing but warmth and sorrow from Encore's little hand?\n\nFrenzied flames danced around the Candy House, seemingly intent on devouring everything. Yet, Encore was not afraid. She leaned against the giant cat and started singing a lullaby.\n\nIt's a melody the cat had heard when it was still called \"Director Mama\" by Encore and other children in the orphanage. It had sung this same song countless times for every one of its children.\n\nEncore kept on singing, her voice becoming hoarse, until the blazing flames went out, until the first morning glow graced the sky. She felt the warm sunlight on her fingertips, and the cat's \"blessing\" faded away, disappearing into the misty depths of the forest.\n\nLooking down, the once huge, ugly cat had transformed into a small kitten, curling up in Encore's arms, sleeping soundly.\n\n\"Director Mama isn't a big bad cat!\" Encore's sleep talk startled the night patroller passing by. \"Encore has defeated the bad guys, so Mama no longer needs to be the big bad cat now!\" The night patrol shook her head in resignation, amused by the girl's unruly sleeping posture. She gently tucked Encore in and continued her patrol."
    },
    {
      "title": "A New Story, A New Adventure",
      "content": "Encore's initial impression of Aalto fell somewhere between good and bad. \"A weird but fun grown-up,\" she remarked. The sight of someone donning sunglasses indoors intrigued her, but wearing them in a dimly lit place also struck her as peculiar. Encore couldn't quite figure out the reasoning behind it.\n\nUpon noticing the nurse guiding this weird grown-up inside, Encore hastily returned to her bed, pretending to read her storybook.\n\n\"So... you're that kid from the news? The one from the orphanage...\" Aalto removed his sunglasses, scrutinizing Encore with care. The idea of such a small child achieving all THAT seemed impossible to him. He recalled the headline he had glimpsed in the newspaper—\"Nine-Year-Old Girl Cracks Sensational Case.\" While uncertain about the reliability of tabloid content, he had a mission here. Well, even THAT ONE said, \"This is the decision of <te href=850110>Tethys</te>.\" And the Tethys System could never go wrong.\n\n\"What a strange uncle you are. Encore doesn't know what you're talking about.\" Setting aside her storybook, Encore studied Aalto, mirroring his earlier scrutiny. To her, Aalto looked like a big dog, or maybe a wolf—an affable gray wolf that wouldn't bare its fangs at her.\n\n\"Oh yeah, you are Encore. That's right. You're the one I'm looking for. Wait! How could you call me an uncle? Take a closer look. Do I look that old?\" Aalto's distressed expression only made Encore laugh. Perhaps a bit bored from her hospital stay, she decided to make fun of this weird grown-up a little more.\n\n\"Okay, let Encore take a closer look... Yup! You're still a big old guy! An uncle!\"\n\nAalto sighed in exasperation. \"Aww...\" He continued, \"C'mon, say something nice. This is no easy task, you know? I've got to take care of the other little ones from that orphanage, too.\" He pleaded, knowing that being teased by a child was insignificant compared to fulfilling his duties for <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>.\n\n\"Anyway, back to the point. Little one, are you coming with me?\" Aalto's tone shifted from lighthearted to serious, but soon reverted to his usual playfulness, \"You can have as many candies as you want. Well... not too many, though. It's bad for your teeth.\"\n\n\"That sounds suspicious,\" Encore replied, her bright eyes blinking with curiosity. Rather than answering Aalto's question, she picked up Cosmos and Cloudy, bringing them close to her ears. \"Woolies? You got something to tell me? Hmm... Wow, really? So this weird uncle is actually a good guy? No way!\"\n\n\"Hey, I'll forgive you for calling me an uncle now, but what's with the 'No way'? Do I not look like the perfect good guy?\"\n\n\"Since Cosmos and Cloudy said you're a good guy, Encore will go with you,\" she said, trying to make her tone sound formal, \"but Cosmos and Cloudy are coming too. They are my best friends.\"\n\n\"Sure,\" Aalto agreed without hesitation. Those are just some ordinary plushies, aren't they? Aalto studied the plushies before him, trying to understand a child's perspective. It felt strange to him, but Encore seemed to truly believe that they were alive.\n\nIt was an adventure, a new adventure! Encore embraced her Woolie companions with joy, spinning first with Cosmos and then with Cloudy. As she grew older, she learned to treat all her friends with equal love and care.\n\nSuddenly, a crucial question struck Encore. \"What are we going to do?\"\n\n\"Well...\" Aalto donned his sunglasses once again, replying, \"To save the world, of course!\""
    }
  ],

      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "You're in for it now!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_burst_skill_01.play_favor_word_anke_burst_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "No one picks on Encore's friends!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_burst_skill_02.play_favor_word_anke_burst_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Into Woolies' belly you go!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_burst_skill_03.play_favor_word_anke_burst_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: IV",
      "content": "Leave me... Alone!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_burst_skill_04.play_favor_word_anke_burst_skill_04"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Baa…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_behit_fly_01.play_favor_word_anke_behit_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Hey! What's the big idea!?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_behit_fly_02.play_favor_word_anke_behit_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "Woolies, behave!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_behit_fly_03.play_favor_word_anke_behit_fly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Oopsie-daisy!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_hp70.play_favor_word_anke_hp70"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "That didn't hurt at all... *whimpers*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_hp50.play_favor_word_anke_hp50"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "The story... isn't over...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_die_01.play_favor_word_anke_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "I wanna go home…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_die_02.play_favor_word_anke_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Yet... Can't sleep...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_die_03.play_favor_word_anke_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Dummy Funny, I choose you!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_hx_summon.play_favor_word_anke_hx_summon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "This is SO MUCH fun!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_hx_change.play_favor_word_anke_hx_change"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Here we go again!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_qte_01.play_favor_word_anke_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "Woolies attack!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_qte_02.play_favor_word_anke_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Woolie sense is tingling!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_enter_battle.play_favor_word_anke_enter_battle"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Time for Encore's aerial recon!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_fly.play_favor_word_anke_fly"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "Woohoo—",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_hook.play_favor_word_anke_hook"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Baa baa! It's treasure!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_scan.play_favor_word_anke_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Woolies, let's race!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_dash.play_favor_word_anke_dash"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash",
      "content": "Woolies, keep up!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_fast_run.play_favor_word_anke_fast_run"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Ooh, shiny! It's gotta be a dragon's treasure!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_chest_01.play_favor_word_anke_chest_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "There has to be more. Right?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_chest_02.play_favor_word_anke_chest_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Finders keepers!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_anke_chest_03.play_favor_word_anke_chest_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Wooly Dolls",
      "content": "The Wooly dolls are gifts from Mama. They always listen to Encore, and always stay by her side. The Woolies are not only Encore's emotional projection, but also important friends in her life.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure18_UI.T_Treasure18_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Coral Bowl",
      "content": "Encore's specialty dish, made of purple coral from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> and carefully cooked with various ingredients. Encore always tries to make something new, and somehow, the flavor is surprisingly good. But the thing looks so horrible that it takes a lot of courage to try. Not even Aalto can handle it.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure7_UI.T_Treasure7_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Prank Toy",
      "content": "Aalto had added his own twist to this prank toy. It made its debut on one of Encore's birthdays, much to Camellya's disapproval of Aalto's taste in toys. At every <te href=850109>Black Shores</te> member's birthday party, Encore plays the recorded birthday song from this little toy as a small surprise. After all, unexpected and unpleasant surprises are a frequent occurrence on their adventures.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure35_UI.T_Treasure35_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Cosmos Rave",
        "desc": "As Encore loses control, Cosmos breaks free and wreaks havoc on its surroundings.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: Cosmos - Frolicking</color></size>\nDuring Cosmos Rave, the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Cosmos - Frolicking</color>, which performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Cosmos: Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDuring Cosmos Rave, the <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Cosmos - Heavy Attack</color>, consuming STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: Cosmos - Rampage</color></size>\nDuring Cosmos Rave, <color=Highlight>Flaming Woolies</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Cosmos - Rampage</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Cosmos: Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDuring Cosmos Rave, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "Enter the Cosmos Rave state.         "simple_param": [],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Black & White Woolies",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Cloudy Frenzy</color></size>\nWhen Encore's \"Mayhem\" is full, after casting a <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, Encore will consume all \"Mayhem\" to enter the Mayhem state, reducing damage taken by {0}. Switching Characters does not interrupt the Mayhem state.\nAfter the Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast <color=Highlight>Cloudy Frenzy</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation damage.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Cosmos Rupture</color></size>\nDuring Cosmos Rave, when casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, if \"Mayhem\" is full, Encore will consume all \"Mayhem\" to enter Cosmos' Mayhem state, reducing damage taken by {1}. Switching Characters does not interrupt the Cosmos' Mayhem state.\nAfter Cosmos' Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast <color=Highlight>Cosmos Rupture</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mayhem</color></size>\nEncore can hold up to {2} \"Mayhem\".\nWhen Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Wooly Attack</color> hits a target, Encore restores \"Mayhem\".\nWhen Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Flaming Woolies</color> hits a target, Encore restores \"Mayhem\".\nWhen Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energetic Welcome</color> hits a target, Encore restores \"Mayhem\".\nWhen Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Woolies Helpers</color> hits a target, Encore restores \"Mayhem\".\nDuring the duration of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Cosmos Rave</color>, Encore restores \"Mayhem\" when hitting a target.",
        "param": [
          "70%",
          "70%",
          "100"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Cloudy Frenzy</color></size>\nWhen Encore's Mayhem is full, after casting a <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, Encore will consume all Mayhem to enter the Mayhem state.\nAfter the Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast <color=Highlight>Cloudy Frenzy</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Cosmos Rupture</color></size>\nDuring Cosmos Rave, when casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, if Mayhem is full, Encore will consume all Mayhem to enter the Cosmos' Mayhem state.\nAfter the Cosmos' Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast <color=Highlight>Cosmos Rupture</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mayhem</color></size>\nEncore can hold up to {2} Mayhem.\nEncore gains Mayhem through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "70%",
          "70%",
          "100"
        ],

  "name": "Mortefi",

  "desc": "Mortefi, a skilled expert in Applied Tacetite Study and a member of the Academy’s Department of Safety, possesses the unique ability to transform his accumulated frustration into fiery flames.\nFrom a burning wrath that consumes all, the red dragon shall descend.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_13_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_13_UI",

  "chara_info": {

    "info": "Mortefi, a skilled expert in Applied Tacetite Study and a member of the Academy’s Department of Safety, possesses the unique ability to transform his accumulated frustration into fiery flames.\nFrom a burning wrath that consumes all, the red dragon shall descend.",
    "talent_name": "Dragon's Breath",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2183-G]\n\nAccording to Resonator Mortefi's reports, indications of his Awakening began to manifest during his youth. His actual Awakening was accompanied by a surge of intense anger.\n\nMortefi's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on his right chest. When Mortefi's Forte is activated, crystalline matter in the shape of dragon scales materializes around his Tacet Mark. These scales burn intensely as he harnesses his power.\n\nResonator Mortefi demonstrates the ability to generate and manipulate fire through the focused concentration of heat. The intensity of the flames produced is closely linked to Mortefi's emotional state. Extensive experimentation has revealed that the fire is a tangible manifestation of Mortefi's accumulated negative emotions over a certain threshold.\n\nThe Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Mortefi has been observed to align closely with that of the Dragonkin, a species that is currently declared extinct. Due to the unavailability of living Dragonkin for Syntony tests, it is currently not possible to empirically confirm the cause of Mortefi's Awakening.\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te>, with a steep rise in its middle section. Resonator Mortefi is thereby classified as a <te href=850069>Mutant Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Mortefi's waveform graph shows zigzag fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is regular, though the peak values show an increasing tendency. Peak values are currently under Criticality level, and abnormal waveforms are not identified.\n\nResonant Criticality: High, combined with low stability. A high risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> is present.\n\nResonator Mortefi has a documented history of Overclocking. Maximum Overclocking rating: Moderate.\n\nDuring Overclocking, the scale-shaped red crystalline matter on Mortefi's chest continuously expands to cover a larger area of his skin. This transformation is accompanied by a significant rise in body temperature, resulting in the manifestation of intense Frequency Fluctuation. Notably, a fiery apparition resembling a dragon becomes visible behind Mortefi during this stage.\n\nMortefi was the cause of a major fire in Desorock Highland. This event was classified under code EX67891 as a Class 3 hazard. Fortunately, no casualties were reported. Resonator Mortefi's Forte and Overclocking history indicate that negative emotions are his primary trigger for Overclocking, which warrants a higher risk of Overclocking. Therefore, it is recommended to closely monitor Resonator Mortefi's psychological status and implement regular counseling and examinations.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Liu YiJia",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "The International Research Fellow",
      "content": "As the only International Research Fellow at <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te>, Mortefi raises a lot of interest from the locals.\n\nMortefi's passion for classical music, his habit of having exquisite desserts and afternoon tea, and lastly, his almost pathological obsession over cleanliness... These details are enough to tell Mortefi's noble background.\n\nMortefi acknowledges that his family background played a role in shaping his personality, but it was not the only factor.\n\nA theory suggests that all music has already been composed, and it is the duty of musicians to discover these melodies. Similarly, scientists spend their lives trying to understand the melodies of the universe. Mortefi draws inspiration from the precise and harmonious nature of classical music for his research.\n\nHe loves sweet desserts, because after long hours of research he needs a quick energy fix to keep his brain functioning and mood pleasant.\n\nHis obsession with cleanliness stems from the need for a sterile lab, leading him to detest anyone who contaminates it.\n\nUltimately, it is his passion and dedication for scientific research that truly defines Mortefi's character.\n\nHowever, Mortefi's foreign identity still drew suspicion and rumors. Some claimed family connections secured his spot, others accused him of bribing officials.\n\nMortefi ultimately proved himself with his undeniable capabilities: The fact that he developed five Tacetite weapon prototypes in under three days was enough to shut down most rumors."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Art of Language",
      "content": "Despite his occasionally intimidating demeanor, Mortefi is not quick to lash out. \n\nInstead, he reserves his snarky tongue for moments of dire need, especially when colleagues encounter illogical and unreasonable clients. In these situations, Mortefi always makes sure they get a good taste of his linguistic arsenal. Mortefi's use of perplexing metaphors and literary allusions favored by the New Federation's elites, along with the latest <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> slang, may leave one baffled.\n\nTo truly grasp the underlying messages in Mortefi's scathing words, perhaps one must experience it themselves. But then again, some mysteries might be best left unsolved. People have even compiled Mortefi's sarcastic remarks into little handy notes, carrying them around as portable ammo for unjust situations where they can't find the right words to fight back.\n\nMortefi was momentarily speechless when he found out about this. He laughed, exasperated, \"It's not that they didn't know what to say, but societal pressures and cultural norms kept them silent. As an outsider unbound by Huanglong's conventions, it just so happens I could speak on their behalf without restraint.\"\n\nWith no social obligations or funding issues to worry about, indeed someone like Mortefi, a foreign man with an elite background, can attain such freedom.  \n\nOver time, this trait somehow gained Mortefi a considerable number of followers among a group of socially inept scientists. After all, he really never hesitates to stand up for any stranger he just met."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Tender Grump",
      "content": "In the eyes of his colleagues, Mortefi's laboratory is an absolutely forbidden territory. However, to the children of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, his lab is a promised wonderland.\n\nMortefi can turn any outrageous request into a reality with efficiency and reliability. Just provide a clear description and some sincere compliments to sweeten the deal, and your desired item will be in your hands before you know it.\n\nHe may appear reluctant when the kids pester him for a new toy, and he'd even half-jokingly remark on how they are \"so good at bossing me around\". But despite this, he is wholeheartedly dedicated to fulfilling their every request. He is willing to go without sleep for days to bring their ideas to life. Yet he is awkwardly unwilling to let the kids know the effort he puts into their entrusted tasks. Instead, he downplays his creations as simple works completed in a few hours.\n\nIn Jinzhou, Mortefi is the creative force behind 80% of popular children's toys and entertainment facilities. From the Spinning Bloop to the Swinging Loongboat and the Sabyrboar Scooter, his designs always captivate young minds. Surprisingly, he doesn't charge any patent fees for these designs. \n\nFor Mortefi, it's not about money; it's about seeing the joy, wonder, and admiration in children's eyes. \n\nOr perhaps, it's a way for him to recapture his own lost childhood.\n\nOn the other hand, many believed it to be a complete waste of his talent. Unfortunately, some people assumed that clear communication would be enough to control Mortefi, and some even tried to coerce him into service. But those who dared were met with clever inventions crafted solely to mock them. Witnesses claim these inventions were diabolical enough to torture like an interrogation, yet still fulfill the requested task. Those who got away swore never to get on Mortefi's bad side again in their lifetime.\n\nIf there was a department in Jinzhou for devising creative punishments for criminals, Mortefi would definitely excel as its leader."
    },
    {
      "title": "Shattered Crown of Prodigy",
      "content": "Mortefi's childhood was suffocating, trapped by hypocritical high society norms and neglect from his parents.\n\nLocked away in his grim study, he resorted to venting his anger on household objects. But even this small act of rebellion soon lost its appeal as his parents simply replaced the destroyed items. New and shiny, they were always neatly arranged, a constant reminder of Mortefi's futile attempts at defiance.\n\nThe only moments of peace Mortefi could have were when he disassembled and rebuilt the mechanical objects. A unique form of communication between man and machine brought him much-needed tranquility: In these moments, he could trust without doubt, be himself without flattery, and no longer endure unwarranted anger. In the world of gears and cogs, there was no room for ambiguity. If a machine malfunctioned, he could simply identify and tackle the problem one step at a time.\n\nMortefi's parents didn't scold him when they found out what he was doing; instead, they were proud. The cult of technology ran deep in the blood of every citizen in the New Federation, and his talent were recognized as a valuable asset.\n\nWith their support, Mortefi gained rare resources, top-notch mentorship and access to esteemed research events. He received endless acclaim and was hailed as the country's youngest scientific prodigy.\n\n...Until everything changed when he met a certain young man.\n\nEven to this day, Mortefi still vividly remembers that encounter at the New Federation's World Expo, when he was 17 years old.\n\nIt was a masterpiece, crafted from inexpensive materials yet possessing the stability of top-grade ones. The design's apparent simplicity warrants in-depth research, with numerous papers devoted to it. While being simple and affordable, it outshone all of Mortefi's inventions in terms of practicality and usability. It was a true innovation for humanity, a stroke of genius.\n\nMortefi stared at that young man in the crowd, who seemed to sense his gaze and looked back to meet his eyes. \n\nSurrounded by the deafening cheers and clamor, he only managed to memorize that young man's place of origin: <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>."
    },
    {
      "title": "The \"Magic\"",
      "content": "Before Wutherology was formally established as a branch of modern science, Tacetite technology was once thought to be \"magic\".\n\nLittle is known about why Mortefi left the New Federation on the day of his coming-of-age ceremony, or what exactly he went through on his way to <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>... And now, he is fervently obsessed with the study of Tacetite.\n\n\"I have improved the Tacetite module in this turret, just a little bit. It is now capable of outputting at a hundred times the power. But be sure to follow these 100 operating rules...\"\n\n\"Wait, what will happen if I don't?\"\n\n\"The Tacetite energy will be enough to uproot this city and set it on a heavenly journey.\"\n\n\"...\"\n\n\"Tsk. What is that look on your face? I am only responsible for getting you what you need and providing necessary explanations. It's up to you to decide how you'll use it.\"\n\nSimilar cases are in their dozens, ultimately putting <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te> on one of the Directors' special attention list at the <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te>. This relentless drive has fueled the rapid advances in Wutherology, but it came at a cost. \n\nIn the end, even the other scholars at the academy began to worry about Mortefi, who often went several nights without sleep in pursuit of perfection. He worked tirelessly, but at this pace, he risked burning out too soon like a fire consuming itself.\n\nMortefi often remembered his tutor's reminder: always keep in mind what you are working for. Perhaps, he thought, I am just seeking joy in communicating with the machines.\n\nIf his fire were to someday burn out, he hoped to leave behind a legacy of knowledge for future generations. To make the flame burn even brighter as it lasted, further illuminating the path for those who would follow in his footsteps.\n\nWith the test results he had been waiting for finally coming out, Mortefi closed his eyes and collapsed into his chair.\n\nPerhaps the real \"magic\" for the Academy lies in its devoted researchers, one such as Mortefi. Unconstrained by societal expectations, he works tirelessly to advance humanity's knowledge of the world.\n\n...That being said, there will presumably be more complaints for the newly appointed Director to handle."
    }
  ],

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_hx_change.play_favor_word_motefei_hx_change"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Fury boils!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_qte.play_favor_word_motefei_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "What a nuisance.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_enter_battle.play_favor_word_motefei_enter_battle"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Nice view.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_fly.play_favor_word_motefei_fly"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_hook.play_favor_word_motefei_hook"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Hmph... Quite good at hiding, aren't you?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_scan.play_favor_word_motefei_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,

    {
      "type": 2,

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_fast_run.play_favor_word_motefei_fast_run"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "...It works, at least.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_chest_01.play_favor_word_motefei_chest_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Tsk, the quality... Nevermind.",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Better than nothing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_motefei_chest_03.play_favor_word_motefei_chest_03"
    }

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Emotion Switch",
      "content": "Unlike the other expensive items on Mortefi's person, it's a lighter of ordinary build and very commonplace. Though Mortefi won't say where it came from, it's clear that this lighter is a prized possession of his. \nWhen he feels annoyed, he subconsciously flicks this lighter in an attempt to control his emotions a little.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure14_UI.T_Treasure14_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Homemade Candy",
      "content": "Mortefi's homemade nutritional candies in sterile storage. Convenient to carry, easy to absorb and replenish energy anytime, anywhere. It has a sweet flavor and is popular with children.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure29_UI.T_Treasure29_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Shattered Skies",
      "content": "A valuable gemstones that was inlaid and later shattered. \nThe original blue hue has been taken over by a fiery bright red, revealing the true undertones. That day when the Red Dragon descended, the monstrous flames of fury burned down his past built on lies.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure43_UI.T_Treasure43_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Impromptu Show",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nMortefi uses his dual pistols and flames to perform up to 4 consecutive shots, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nMortefi enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.\nThe aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nMortefi consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Violent Finale",
        "desc": "Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, and apply <color=Highlight>Burning Rhapsody</color> to all characters on the team.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Burning Rhapsody</color></size>\nWhen the active character's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> hits the target, Mortefi launches a Coordinated Attack, firing {0} <color=Highlight>Marcato</color>.\nWhen the active character's <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> hits the target, Mortefi launches a Coordinated Attack, firing {1} <color=Highlight>Marcato</color>.\nMortefi can launch one Coordinated Attack every {2}s.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Marcato</color></size>\nDeals <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",
        "param": [
          "1",
          "2",
          "0.35"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, and apply <color=Highlight>Burning Rhapsody</color> to all Resonators on the team.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Burning Rhapsody</color></size>\nWhen the active Resonator's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> hits the target, Mortefi launches <color=Highlight>Marcato</color> as the Coordinated Attack.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Marcato</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "1",
          "2",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Fury Fugue",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: Fury Fugue</color></size>\nWhen Mortefi's Annoyance reaches {0}, his <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Fury Fugue</color>.\nWhen casting Fury Fugue, Mortefi consumes all Annoyance to unleash high-speed flame lightning, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Annoyance</color></size>\nMortefi can hold up to {1} Annoyance and can restore Annoyance in the following ways:\n- When Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Impromptu Show</color> hits the target\n- When Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Dissonance</color> hits the target\n- When Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Passionate Variation</color> hits the target\n- Within {2}s after casting <color=Highlight>Passionate Variation</color>, Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Impromptu Show</color> that hits the target restores Annoyance additionally.",
        "param": [
          "100",
