  "name": "Changli",
  "nick_name": "An error occurred. Please contact our Customer Service for assistance.",
  "desc": "Changli is a counselor serving the <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, and former Secretary-General in the capital. \nShrouded in flames, she's fated to burn brightly until her final embers.\nWith her fiery determination and strategic mindset, she rises to power, always thinking ahead to reach her ultimate goal.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_26_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_26_UI",
  "background": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRolePile/T_IconRole_Pile_changli_UI.T_IconRole_Pile_changli_UI",
  "background_stand": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/RoleHalfBody/T_ActivityRoleOntrialHalfBodyChangli.T_ActivityRoleOntrialHalfBodyChangli",
  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "June 6th",
    "sex": "Female",
    "country": "Huanglong",
    "influence": "Jinzhou",
    "info": "Changli is a counselor serving the <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, and former Secretary-General in the capital. \nShrouded in flames, she's fated to burn brightly until her final embers.\nWith her fiery determination and strategic mindset, she rises to power, always thinking ahead to reach her ultimate goal.",
    "talent_name": "Eternal Blaze",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2326-G]\n\nThe precise timing of Resonator Changli's Awakening remains uncertain. Reports indicate that Resonator Changli displayed early signs of fire manipulation during her childhood, often struggling to control it. However, as Changli matured into adulthood, the frequency and stability of these manifestations notably improved.\n\nResonator Changli's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is situated on her lower chest. Post-Awakening examinations have identified specific alterations in her physical attributes. These include a gradual fading of hair color at the tips and feather-like burn marks on her left arm, emitting a fiery glow influenced by her Forte.\n\nThe Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Changli mirrors the characteristics of fire, displaying a robust Syntony reaction in testing. Despite the exact trigger for her Awakening remaining uncertain, no other sample with a Resonance Spectrum Pattern similarity exceeding 60% has been identified. Resonator Changli's Forte aligns closely with the mythical spirit bird from <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> folklore, possibly influenced by her early immersion in tales related to this legendary creature.\n\nResonator Changli possesses the unique ability to compress flames into delicate feather-shaped projectiles. Her Forte, once unleashed, has the power to create scorching fires of exceptional heat, capable of devastating a large area. A telltale sign that her Forte is active is the emergence of a lone fiery feather with an eye-like pattern on her forehead, which she describes as the \"Mind's Eye.\"\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a stable rise. Occasional fluctuations within normal range have been detected. Therefore, Changli is identified as a <te href=850070>Natural Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Changli's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is stable, with no abnormal waveform.\n\nResonant Criticality: High. Resonator Changli's frequency displays high stability, and the risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> is minimal.\nResonator Changli has a documented history of Overclocking. \nMaximum Overclocking rating: Negligible.\n\nAccording to Changli's report, she experienced Overclocking during her childhood due to prolonged exposure to a hazardous environment. This caused her Forte to go into an explosive state multiple times for self-preservation or the protection of others, resulting in a permanent burn mark on her left arm. \n\nHowever, as she grew up and gained more control over her Forte, the frequency fluctuation stabilized and the burn mark did not worsen. There may be irreversible physical damage from the Forte burst, which could potentially shorten Resonator Changli's lifespan. \n\nRegular physical check-ups are recommended, while psychological counseling is not currently necessary.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Mufei",
    "cv_name_jp": "Chiwa Saitô",
    "cv_name_ko": "Shin Na Ri",
    "cv_name_en": "Ashleigh Haddad"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Beneath the Whispers",
      "content": "People who visit the City Hall lately rarely see the legendary Counselor, Changli, as they would report.\n\nAlthough Counselor Changli never has been a public figure, as the most trusted aide to the <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, she is known to everyone in Jinzhou. However, there are varied and strange restless rumors about her. \n\nIt is said that Counselor Changli, during her time in the capital, proposed the renovation of the <te href=850126>Shelter Homes</te> across Huanglong to provide a better home for the refugees who lost their homes in the <te href=850075>Lament</te>'s aftermath; she also pushed for the reduction of commercial taxes in Jinzhou and allocate food and funds to better relieve Jinzhou from the aftermaths of the Battle Beneath the Crescent. \n\nIt is said that as soon as Counselor Changli arrived at the City Hall, she effortlessly resolved two bandit forces that had been entrenched around Jinzhou for a long time. Just a conversation and an \"obvious trap\" were enough to make the two forces suspicious of and fight each other until neither was a threat anymore. \n\nIt is said that Counselor Changli did not become a Counselor after the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> chose the Jinzhou Magistrate, but she had long volunteered to come to Jinzhou, to teach the young Jinhsi, and to help her take over the power that was too heavy for a child.\n\n\"Is that true? The version I heard said those were actions carried out by the previous Secretary-General, and she was only demoted to the border because she offended the power that was, right?\" \n\n\"Well, from what I heard, she became a direct disciple of <te href=850127>Master Xuanmiao</te> and was recommended by the previous Secretary-General. Her orations and debates throughout the realm have convinced all the great minds of our country. How could she be a flatterer?\" \n\n\"What are you talking about? I heard she is the descendant of a great hermit, and she came to Jinzhou because her family needs a voice in the power centers...\"\n\nAs people gossiped about her, Changli remained unfazed. When she passed by those whispering behind her back, her gaze gently but firmly silenced their words.\n\nRumors spread like wildfire about the new Jinzhou Magistrate, chosen by the Sentinel. A young girl, seemingly not yet of age, held this powerful position. Some whispered that Changli had too much influence and sought to overthrow the current Magistrate before taking over herself.\n\nAfter the ceremony, Changli gave up power to Jinhsi and became her Counselor. In three years, life improved for everyone in Jinzhou, and they were grateful to the Magistrate. However, nobody knew how much Changli helped behind the scenes.\n\nThose who have met Changli all say that she always has a gentle smile, and treats everyone from generals to soldiers equally, but when she is alone, she always has a kind of awe-inspiring aura that turns potential visitors away.\n\n\"Last time I met Counselor Changli at the <te href=850089>Patrol Station</te>, she seemed super interested in the courtyard trees, for some reason... I thought she had important duties to attend to, but she just spent a whole afternoon... watching ants...\"\n\n\"And then?\"\n\n\"Then a wanted suspect suddenly turned himself in! We were initially wary, thinking it was a trap. But when Counselor Changli appeared, the villain became visibly frightened and confessed everything, even old cases that were still unsolved. It was the biggest case of my career...\"\n\n\"What about Counselor Changli?\"\n\n\"She left at some point. We didn't even notice. Hmm, she really is an inscrutable person...\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Master and Minister",
      "content": "Before becoming Jinhsi's tutor, Changli had only met her once when she was a young girl.\n\nWhile in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, Changli once heard chanting from a nearby room while walking inside the City Hall. A young girl sat amidst stacks of books, struggling to grasp theories beyond her years. \n\n\"'He who can't see the cause of order or chaos shall not make law'... But how can I see the very roots of everything? How can I gain such insights?\" While she chanted, the girl could not help but fall muddled. \n\nThat hard-working, petite figure reminded Changli of how she used to struggle in a similarly desperate way to swallow as much knowledge as possible, trying to become an adult she wasn't.\n\nShe followed the impulse to lean forward and answered the little girl's doubt.\n\n\"Thank you, madam. You have enlightened me,\" the girl expressed her gratitude word by word, with her immature voice. After a moment of careful hesitation, she looked up again and asked, \"Then, how should I become a good <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, and bring order to this city?\"\n\n\"Why this question?\"\n\n\"The people of Jinzhou have long fallen victim to warfare. I want to bring them peace and prosperity.\"\n\n\"...That is no easy task.\"\n\n\"True, but I must try everything I can.\"\n\n\"Peace and Prosperity\"...\n\nAs Changli gazed into the girl's eyes, she saw determination and strength, like little sparkles of starlight.\n\n\"Very well. Then I will aid you in fulfilling your wish,\" she declared.\n\nEventually, the girl became the Magistrate of Jinzhou, appointed by its <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. As Jinhsi works tirelessly at City Hall, Changli remains by her side, answering questions and offering advice whenever needed.\n\nTo most, heroic tales are too grand and inconsequential. They only value simple comforts like a warm meal and restful sleep as ways to improve life.\n\n\"A Magistrate shouldn't get lost in bureaucracy, but rather engage with the people,\" Changli warned Jinhsi.\n\n\"Yes, my teacher,\" Jinhsi obeyed. Through the traditional Jinzhou wish-making rituals, Jinhsi managed to build a connection with the citizens and worked towards a thriving, empathetic city.\n\nChangli watches as Jinhsi is crowded by excited people, whose faces are no longer covered by gloom and fatigue, but true delight and gratitude.\n\nNow that a wise governor has emerged in Jinzhou, neither the people nor the capital would doubt Jinhsi's competency.\n\n\"Do as you wish, I will support you,\" Changli said as she sowed seeds of knowledge and lit up Jinhsi's path ahead. The torch set the sky ablaze, illuminating the future of this young girl.\n\nDespite Jinhsi's lingering childishness, she knew this girl would one day become a capable Magistrate, protecting every inch of Jinzhou. Just as her master had done for her, she would guide her student and light the way forward."
    },
    {
      "title": "Lone Feather in the Alley",
      "content": "The owner of Yanqing Bookstore, Changqing, recently encountered two strange incidents.\n\nThe first involves his business.\n\nWith so many to be offered from the vast and rich land of <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, items popular in Jinzhou are never there to stay. Recently, paper books have fallen out of fashion and the local bookstore has suffered. \n\nHowever, business has unexpectedly picked up in the past few days, and Changqing's bookstore has seen an influx of customers.\n\nMany of the customers at the bookstore appeared to be officials from the Central Court, judging by their attire. \n\nWhen a puzzled Changqing asked them about it, most mentioned that the Secretary-General had recommended this particular place. \n\nThe Secretary-General? Although he knew there was a new Secretary-General in office, Changqing couldn't fathom why someone like him, a humble bookstore owner, would be tied to such high-ranking individuals.\n\nThe second strange incident revolves around the neglected facade of Yanqing Bookstore.\n\nUnder the weight of depression, it had been left unattended for too long. Even the grocer next door advised Changqing to repair the gate before it deterred potential customers.\n\n\"Changqing, you should fix your gate. If it gets worse, no one will ever visit your store!\" \n\n\"Don't worry. Although my store may not be as fancy as those in the capital, I have the greatest collection of antique and classic texts. People will surely find out!\"\n\nWhile he might have appeared confident, Changqing was uncertain about renovating the old store himself. He considered hiring someone during the current boom in business.\n\nThe next day, he arrived at the store to find that the facade had miraculously transformed overnight. The plaque and gate were gleaming, proudly displaying \"Yanqing Bookstore.\"\n\nA note on the counter read, \"In gratitude for the bookstore owner's kindness, I took the liberty to do some renovation work as a thank you gesture.\"\n\nThe note was not signed, but the vermilion-colored feather pattern on the paper seemed somewhat familiar. Changqing held the note and slowly sat down, falling into memory. \n\nMore than decade ago, the bookstore was thriving with customers coming and going. One day, a little girl around eight or nine years old started sneaking in and spending whole afternoons reading books.\n\nInitially, Changqing didn't mind when customers read without purchasing as long as it didn't damage the books or affect business.\n\nBut after several days of declining sales and fewer customers, he grew concerned.\n\n\"So hot. It's too hot in here! I can't stand it anymore. Let's go somewhere else!\" \n\nDespite the early autumn weather, the room was unusually sultry. Changqing wiped his forehead and searched carefully, eventually finding a little girl curled up under a bookshelf, completely engrossed in her book.\n\nIn front of her, a fire was floating, heating up the whole premise as the girl was absorbed into the world of the books. This sight filled Changqing with rage.\n\n\"What are you doing, kid? You're burning my store!\"\n\nThe girl was startled by a shout, immediately snuffing out the fire. Changqing watched as the page she held tightly turned yellow, as if it would catch fire soon.\n\n\"You, you are...!\"\n\nThe girl hurriedly threw the book away. Her flushed face revealed a mix of panic and guilt as she surveyed the charred pages.\n\n\"Sorry, it's too dark here, I just wanted to make it brighter...\" \n\nAs Changqing saw his beloved book being damaged, he couldn't help but remember the recent decline in sales. His face darkened as he grabbed a broom from the side of the bookshelf and prepared to strike the girl responsible.\n\nHowever, she was surprisingly quick for her slender frame. When Changqing pursued her out of the bookstore, all he could see was her fiery red hair disappearing in the bustling market. He stood at the gate, fuming and bewildered.\n\n\"Never show your face again!\"\n\n\"What's wrong?\" The grocer next door came out with a smile and asked, \"Isn't that the little girl who can control fire?\" \n\n\"You know her? She almost burned down my store!\" \n\n\"Hey, she's a good girl, I kid you not. Helped me out a few days ago, just to get some steamed buns. It's a pity she had to walk here alone, so young and all. I heard her hometown was attacked by the <te href=850081>TD</te> Outbreak and no one made it. Not sure how she managed to escape...\"\n\n\"Why didn't you tell me earlier?\"\n\n\"Well, you didn't ask! But now that this happened... she probably won't come back again.\" \n\nThe little girl disappeared down the alley, and sounds of children playing drifted over from the neighboring walls. Changqing gazed at the book lying on the ground, unsure of what to feel."
    },
    {
      "title": "Radiance's Return",
      "content": "Business at Yanqing Bookstore had returned to normal, with a steady stream of book lovers, but the little girl who used to read quietly between the bookshelves was nowhere to be seen.\n\nTo Changqing's surprise, the girl returned a week later.\n\n\"This is all my money. I swear, I earned it! Sorry for the books I burned... Only you have the books I'm looking for. Please, may I...\" \n\nThe girl bit her lip, timidly placing the scattered <te href=850104>Shell Credits</te> from her hands on the counter. Her petite figure was not even as tall as the counter, so only half of her head was visible. She was on her tiptoes, her body slightly trembling, but her bright, somewhat stubborn eyes were still fixed on him, and wouldn't evade.\n\n\"...Alright.\"\n\nAfter all the days, Changqing's anger had long since subsided. He waved his hand, \"Go, take your money, and don't disturb my business.\"\n\nThe girl bowed and left without a word. She kept stopping and looking back as she walked away. Changqing sighed heavily, watching her frail figure and worn-out clothes in silence. He rose, grabbed a lamp, and gave it to the girl with the store's spare key. \n\n\"Take it. Don't use fire for light anymore. Come read at night when there are no customers.\"\n\n\"...\"\n\n\"I'm not letting you read for free. You'll need to open the shop for me in the morning.\" \n\n\"T-thank you, sir...\" \n\nIt was his first glimpse of the girl's innocent, beaming smile.\n\nAfter their initial encounter, the girl became a regular at Changqing Bookstore. As arranged, she would only come in the evenings and spend her time solely absorbed in reading. In the mornings, when Changqing returned, he always found the store immaculately clean and organized.\n\nDuring colder days, the girl also visited during daylight hours. Despite the wintry gusts outside, the room was filled with a cozy warmth. Though Changqing occasionally glanced at her reading material, he could only make out books on literature and history.\n\nThe girl's calm demeanor belied her youth, only animated when lost in her books.\n\nOne day, the girl vanished. Rumors spread—was she taken by <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>? Or did she succumb to injuries on her journey to the capital city? \n\nSeeing the flame pattern on the letter, Changqing felt a spark of hope. Could she still be alive?\n\n\"Excuse me?\" \n\nChangqing's reminiscing was interrupted by a tall, elegant lady standing at the counter. Her soft eyes and flame-colored hair, like a mythical bird's feathers, gently swayed in the wind. She placed some Shell Credits on the counter and asked with a smile, \"Sir, only you have the books I'm looking for. Please, may I borrow them?\"\n\nShe had transformed from a delicate girl to a confident young Secretary-General, the talk of the town. As the sun rose and filled the room with morning light, the aged bookshop owner chuckled and gestured for her to continue reading. \n\n\"Go on… Read it, even if you don't pay. I doubt I can force you to now.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "The Myth-Laden Savior",
      "content": "Master Xuanmiao had been looking for a certain person.\n\nYoung Changli accompanied her aged mentor across the landscapes of <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>. Though he was initially reluctant to mentor another student, the revered elder dedicated himself to passing on every ounce of wisdom to her in their limited time together.\n\nMaster Xuanmiao was a devoted Weiqi player. During breaks on their weary journey, they would settle by the roadside to engage in intense matches. He utilized these moments not just for play but also as teaching opportunities for Changli, imparting wisdom on strategic thinking and power dynamics within each move. Sometimes, he would analyze an unfinished game of Weiqi with her, but he always seemed somewhat dissatisfied with her responses. \n\nIt was during these times that he would mention an old friend of his, hinting at a quest to reconnect with this individual through Changli's tutelage. Despite Changli's curiosity about this mysterious person's identity and location, her mentor would simply shake his head and tell her, \"The time has not yet come.\"\n\nOn the day he felt his final moments approaching, he entrusted Changli with his Weiqi game record and his cherished journal. With solemnity, he told his devoted disciple, \"In this unfinished game, you shall find the ultimate truth.\" \n\nAnd so, carrying on the legacy of Master Xuanmiao, Changli embarked on her path ahead.\n\n\"...A celestial being descended, wielding the limitless might of the universe, embracing the inaugural Echo within...\"\n\"...The enigmatic figure with eyes of gold amidst swirling clouds and waning lights.\"\n\"...Steadfastly by the side of <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> Jué, in a bond of intimate camaraderie.\"\n\nFollowing the notes in her late mentor's journal, she continued her search, uncovering traces of that enigmatic figure in various unexpected places. At times, it was the captivating tales spun by seasoned storytellers; elsewhere, it was mere slivers gleaned from ancient archives. Like a silent guardian, this person acted as a sturdy anchor in turbulent seas, leading humanity through the wreckage of past calamities towards a hopeful horizon. The subtle imprints they left behind wove an almost imperceptible yet unyielding thread that bridged vast stretches of time and history far surpassing the ordinary span of mortal lives.\n\nShe had been told that the signs of <i>that person</i>'s arrival would be impossible to miss. That said person had the power to truly change the world. However, her vision of a peaceful and prosperous world required more than mere hopeful anticipation of a savior. Understanding that achieving her dreams necessitated acquiring substantial power and influence, she embarked on a journey through diverse lands, immersing herself in wisdom, and persisting through every challenge without faltering to meet the expectations placed upon her.\n\nUpon assuming the esteemed role of Secretary-General, she at last gained entry into the revered <te href=850117>Grand Libraries</te>. Within the vast expanse of knowledge stored within their walls, she uncovered a pivotal revelation: a clue leading her to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, a border city in Huanglong.\n\nFrom then on, everything unfolded precisely as Sentinel Jué predicted. The person she had been searching for emerged in Jinzhou and protected the city from a reviving Threnodian. The once nebulous being from ancient records and myths now solidified into a clear and distinct presence within her mind.\n\nOn the day of their foretold encounter, she returned to Jinzhou from Mingting, the capital city of Huanglong. She witnessed the esteemed guest of Jinzhou waiting at the ferry port in the rain, looking uncertain.\n\nFollowing the prophecies of Jué, she had faith that their paths would converge at the right moment. \nAnd that awaited moment was upon her. \n\nConcealing a whirlwind of emotions behind her gaze, she advanced towards them with measured steps. Using her paper umbrella adorned with a spirit bird motif, she gently angled it to provide cover from the rain, as their eyes locked in a wordless exchange. The sole audible presence was the hushed melody of raindrops tapping against her umbrella.\n\nShe smiled and softly asked, \"Are you trapped here by the rain?\""

      "title": "Basic Attack: III",
      "content": "Mind's eye.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_atksp04_02.play_favor_word_changli_bat_atksp04_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack",
      "content": "Burn!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_fallingatk02_01.play_favor_word_changli_bat_fallingatk02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Perish in flames.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_skill_01.play_favor_word_changli_bat_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Feathers incinerate.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_skill_02.play_favor_word_changli_bat_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Crosscut, sever.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_skill_03.play_favor_word_changli_bat_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Be reduced to cinders.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst01_01.play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Beckon the divine flames.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst01_02.play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Who is the caged bird now?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst01_03.play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: IV",
      "content": "Break!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst02_01.play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: V",
      "content": "Sever.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst02_02.play_favor_word_changli_bat_burst02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge",
      "content": "Think fast.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_limitdodge_01.play_favor_word_changli_bat_limitdodge_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack",
      "content": "From defense to offense.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_counteratk_01.play_favor_word_changli_bat_counteratk_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Now that's a hassle.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_changli_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Silly mistake...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_changli_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "I am fine.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_changli_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Triumph through sacrifice.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_changli_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "No need to dwell on it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_changli_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "The cycle of life...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_die_01.play_favor_word_changli_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "One... wrong move...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_die_02.play_favor_word_changli_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "A necessary sacrifice...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_die_03.play_favor_word_changli_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Reveal yourself.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_hxsummon.play_favor_word_changli_bat_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Take form.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_hxchange.play_favor_word_changli_bat_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Together we vanquish.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_qte01.play_favor_word_changli_bat_qte01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "Strike!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_bat_qte02.play_favor_word_changli_bat_qte02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Guests of the unkind.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_engage.play_favor_word_changli_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Winds, heed my command.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_changli_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "(Effort Sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_hook_01.play_favor_word_changli_com_hook_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "*light chuckle*... There you are.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_scan.play_favor_word_changli_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Make it fast.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_dash_01.play_favor_word_changli_com_dash_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "How do you like these?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_changli_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Oh... Look, shinies.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_changli_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Glad you found them useful.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_changli_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_changli_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Firmament Weiqi Manual",
      "content": "A battered weiqi manual, documenting the legendary games left by a peculiar visitor at Mt. Firmament.\nThe pages have yellowed over the long years and dog-eared from countless readings. This manuscript once accompanied its owner through many perilous and lonely paths. Now it has been restored and rebound, with new pages added, ready to record new games.\nNow that the worthy opponent she has been seeking stands before her, another historic game to be remembered and studied for centuries shall take place. As long as the players remain, the pages will continue to be filled.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure60_UI.T_Treasure60_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Flame-Soaked Cloth",
      "content": "A fabric of unknown material, soft to the touch and said to be fireproof. After being cleansed by flames, it becomes even cleaner and whiter, like freshly fallen snow. The plants required to weave this fabric went extinct during the <te href=850075>Lament</te> and are now almost impossible to obtain, making every remaining piece extremely precious.\nAfter the Appointment Ceremony, the new <te href=850084>Magistrate</te> of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> presented it as a gift to her esteemed teacher.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure58_UI.T_Treasure58_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Blaze Feather",
      "content": "A pair of feathers formed by Changli's flames. One of the pair has been gifted to a distinguished guest of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, while the other Changli keeps close to herself.\nThough they blaze brightly, the feathers only radiate a gentle warmth when cradled in one’s palms, reflecting Changli's near impeccable mastery of her Forte. Like her robe, the feather is entirely made of flames.\nIn bedtime stories once told to a young girl, a fire-born phoenix would bestow its most precious tail feather upon the person it held most dear.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure59_UI.T_Treasure59_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Blazing Enlightment",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nAfter releasing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight><te href=850003>True Sight</te></color>, lasting for 12s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume Stamina to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nAfter releasing <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight><te href=850003>True Sight</te></color>, lasting for 12s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> on the ground to perform an upward strike at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within a certain time to release <color=Highlight>Mid-Air Attack 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>\nShortly after holding <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> in mid-air or using Basic Attack <color=Highlight>True Sight: Charge</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform a plunging attack at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within a certain time to release <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nAfter <color=Highlight>Ground Basic Attack 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nAfter <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform an upward strike, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Mid-Air Attack 3</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within a certain time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Tripartite Flames",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>True Sight: Capture</color></size>\nAfter releasing <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, Changli dashes towards the enemy and enters <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, lasting for 12s. In the end, she releases a plunging attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>True Sight: Capture</color> has 2 initial charges and holds up to 2 charges at maximum. The number of charges is replenished by 1 every 12s.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, if Changli uses <color=Highlight>Ground Basic Attack</color>, she releases <color=Highlight>True Sight: Conquest</color>, dashing towards the enemy and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG. After releasing <color=Highlight>True Sight: Conquest</color>, <color=Highlight>True Sight</color> ends.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, if Changli <color=Highlight>jumps</color> or uses <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> in mid-air, she releases <color=Highlight>True Sight: Charge</color>, dashing towards the enemy and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG. After releasing <color=Highlight>True Sight: Charge</color>, <color=Highlight>True Sight</color> ends.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>True Sight: Capture</color></size>\nAfter using her <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to attack an enemy, Changli enters <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>True Sight: Capture</color> has 2 initial charges. Changli can hold up to 2 charges. 1 charge is replenished every 12s. It can be cast in mid-air.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, if Changli uses <color=Highlight>Ground Basic Attack</color>, she dashes towards the enemy, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG), after which <color=Highlight>True Sight</color> ends.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, if Changli <color=Highlight>jumps</color> or uses <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> in mid-air, she dashes towards the enemy, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG), after which <color=Highlight>True Sight</color> ends.",
        "simple_param": [],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Flaming Sacrifice",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice</color></size>\nWhen releasing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, if Changli carries 4 stacks of Enflamement, she consumes all stacks of Enflamement to cast <color=Highlight>Flaming Sacrifice</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Flaming Sacrifice</color>, Changli takes {0} less DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enflamement</color></size>\nChangli can hold up to 4 stacks of Enflamement.\nChangli obtains 1 stack of Enflamement for every Basic Attack: <color=Highlight>True Sight - Conquest</color> on hit.\nChangli obtains 1 stack of Enflamement for every Basic Attack: <color=Highlight>True Sight - Charge</color> on hit.\nChangli obtains 4 stacks of Enflamement for every Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Radiance of Fealty</color>.",

Unpredictable and full of life, he is the beating heart of the troupe.\n\nOn stage, he slips into countless roles, donning new masks to breathe life into every story. Yet beyond the spotlight, he is unwaveringly genuine, offering nothing but true sincerity to those around him.",
    "talent_name": "Flamebound Compass",
    "talent_doc": "[Troupe Medic Benir's Notes (Unnumbered)]\n\nI still recall that night as if it were yesterday. My first real trial after joining the troupe. Storm clouds blanketed the sea, and rain pounded down in sheets while monstrous waves threatened to capsize our ship at any moment. We were tossed about like driftwood, the helmswoman lost in the chaos, the ship spinning through the tempest. I huddled in the cabin, trembling as fear seeped through me.\n\nThen I saw him.\n\nThere, atop the mast, stood the captain. The <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> on his chest shone like St. Elmo's Fire, a beacon showing us the way.\n\n\"Steady now, my friends!\" I heard his voice cut through the howling wind, \"Follow my command! Hard to starboard!\"\n\nThe crew rallied at once, the disarray falling away as they returned to their posts with newfound focus. I quickly jotted down in my notes: While I lack the tools to confirm it, I am certain of one thing—Captain Brant is a Natural Resonator. The flames he conjures can light our way, even in the darkest of seas!\n\n<i>Interestingly, I often catch Captain Brant spinning in the air during combat. Is it a trick to sharpen his sense of direction, or his secret to navigating the seas? I do hope someone finds the courage to ask him. I'm dying to know!</i>",
    "talent_certification": "[The <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te> \"Revel in Freedom\" Tour - <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> Stop Application]\n\n...\n\nLead Performer: Brant\n\nThe subject's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The Time Domain pattern is regular, and no signs of abnormal fluctuations are observed. The test results fall within the normal phase range.\n\nResonant Criticality: High. This test subject displays high stability with a low risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n\nRecords indicate no history of Overclocking.\n\n...\n\nApproval Verdict: Stable. The Troupe of Fools' application is approved. They will assume full responsibility for any unforeseen incidents during the performance.\n\n<i>Note from a certain captain: Mark my words, not a thing will go awry!</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Ray Mo",
    "cv_name_jp": "Kishio Daisuke",
    "cv_name_ko": "Lee Ju Seung",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "An Improvised Afternoon at the Tavern",
      "content": "A crack of thunder shattered the bartender's rhythm as he shook the cocktail mixer, and the downpour that followed immediately dampened the last bit of cheer among the patrons. The tavern, now nothing more than a soggy refuge, was bereft of any tale worth telling. The bartender shook his drink slowly, the faint clink of ice barely audible. Patrons yawned incessantly as if even their drinks had lost their flavor.\n\n\"Well, well... this hardly feels like a tavern, does it, friends?\" A young man stepped through the door, bringing a gust of damp air and salty rainwater with him. He strode straight to the bar, swiping the empty glass from a patron nearby.\n\n\"Oi! What are you—\"\n\n\"Shhh...\" the young man interrupted, casually tossing a handful of <te href=850104>Shell Credits</te> into the bartender's tip jar. \"Fill it to the brim, would you? It's not every day I find myself in a tavern. Surely, there's something of more... entertainment value here?\"\n\n\"Entertainment? You must be joking. Look outside, the rain isn't going anywhere. And don't get me started on the menu. Duller than a sack of potatoes, and twice as overpriced.\"\n\n\"Of course, I did come in from the rain. See? My hair is practically drowning in it. But even in a storm, there are tales to be had. Like this charming little wanted poster.\" He deftly plucked the poster from the patron's hand.\n\n\"Ah, we already talked about this. Something about the Immortal Returned, wearing a strange mask... What did he do again...?\"\n\n\"He and his crew ventured through fog thick with sirens, dredging up shiploads of songs from the ocean's deepest whirlpools. They rescued the Pilgrim's Sails capsized by towering waves and reclaimed stolen supplies from pirates!\"\n\n\"Hmm... That's not quite right, is it? You're just telling a story now!\"\n\n\"Ha, of course, it is a story!\" He laughed, raising his glass, \"Drink up, my friend, and I'll tell everyone the real tale of the Immortal Returned!\"\n\nThe glasses clinked. In an instant, the dreary tavern was transformed into a stage of imagination. Brant swiped the patron's hat and placed it on the bartender's head, his eyes sparkling as he presented the bartender's long-awaited rose to the woman beside him. The bartender, now donning the hat, became the ship's helmsman. The bald patron became a sailor, firing cannons at <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> from the rolling sea. The woman who received the rose burst into a spontaneous dance.  With every spin of the young man's yarn, the patrons found themselves part of his intoxicating tale.\n\nThe revelry ended abruptly when the door crashed open.\n\n\"Now <i>this</i> feels like a tavern!\" The leader of the intruders sneered, holding up a wanted poster. \"Take him, lads. The reward is doubled this time!\"\n\n\"How about saving it for the next time!\" With a mocking bow, the young man tossed a mask alight with violet flames into the air, vanishing in the commotion it caused.\n\nWhen the dust settled, the tavern was filled with colorful ribbons, balloons, and scattered gifts from the sea.\n\nThe tavern's patrons picked up the scattered gifts. To their surprise, each one was a ticket to a show by the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>."
    },
    {
      "title": "Dusk, When Fools Sing",
      "content": "At the close of rehearsal, crimson clouds seemed to ignite the edge of the sea.\n\nThe captain called a few of the crew to set up tables and grills on the beach for dinner. Battier hauled in a bountiful catch of fish, Lavito returned with a bundle of hares from his hunt, and Roccia, with her loyal companion <te href=850122>Pero</te>, returned with a basket of meat they'd bought with one of the bounties earned in the name of Captain Brant.\n\nLaughing, Brant uncorked his cherished bottles of Nectarwine and passed them around.\n\n\"The <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> is just around the corner, my friends,\" he declared. \"After all our hard work, we deserve a celebration! In fact, we should celebrate every day!\"\n\nYes, Carnevale was drawing near, the day they had all been waiting for. It would be their moment to perform the stories of the Fools on the grand stage for all to see. For this, they had worked tirelessly. Lavito had poured his very soul into the compositions, Tina spent a whole night perfecting a single high note... Each member was giving their all for the Carnevale, driven by their unshakable faith in their captain and his words—\"We'll ask the world a question at the Carnevale: What makes life sing? And we'll give them our answer. But more than that, we'll show them we're not madmen... just a merry band of Fools.\"\n\nYes, just a merry band of Fools. But what, then, did being a Fool mean to the captain?\n\nAs they gathered for dinner, a group of children, new recruits to the troupe, crowded around the captain. They chimed in unison, \"Captain, Captain! What exactly <i>are</i> Fools?\"\n\nThe captain simply smiled in response, pulling a handful of candies from his pocket and handing them to the children.  He glanced around at his crew. Battier and Lavito were deep in a heated debate, Hymer and Budd were playing rock-paper-scissors, and Tina was coaching Roccia on breathing techniques for singing. When he said nothing, one of the children mischievously popped a candy into his mouth.\n\n\"Alright, alright! Now, Little Katy, I was just thinking of how to answer you!\" The captain narrowed his eyes, surrendering to the sweetness of the candy before it gave him a toothache. \"Here comes the answer. Listen closely, little ones!\"\n\n\"In this troupe, anyone who pursues freedom is a Fool! You, me, all of us!\"\n\nKaty pouted slightly, \"Is that it? Doesn't sound very special... What are we even trying to prove at the Carnevale?\"\n\n\"Nothing. We don't need to prove a thing.\" Brant rose to his feet, adjusting his captain's hat with a flourish. \"We are there to sing and show the world who we truly are!\"\n\n\"And now, my fellow Fools, let's fill our stomachs!\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Reflections by the Campfire",
      "content": "Late at night, Brant sat by the campfire to organize everything needed for the performance.\n\nFirst came the masks. He polished each one meticulously, pausing now and then to don one and improvise a scene. Over the years, Brant had played countless roles: the unstoppable hero, the comical clown, the extravagant nobleman, the scheming courtier, and even the devout <te href=850100>Acolyte</te>. He paused, a faint smirk crossing his face at the thought. For him, those were hardly pleasant experiences.\n\nHe despised courtiers. Acolytes, too. But on stage, he became each of them fully, burying his true self behind the mask and stepping into their lives. He respected the stage and every role he played because he knew the stage was his ocean.\n\nOnce the masks were done, he turned to his costumes, carefully pressing each one.\n\nThe costumes had to be immaculate under the spotlight. Not just for the role, but for the audience as well. To bring a smile to their face, respect was the first rule. So he smoothed out every crease, not allowing a single fold to remain. He knew the applause would be his ocean.\n\nFinally, he began arranging the stage props.\n\nThe hero's sword, the clown's tambourine, the nobleman's family crest, the courtier's scepter, the Acolyte's scripture, and then... a small wooden box.\n\nThe box his parents left for him. It bore the carving of a tern, a silent reminder of the name he had long buried. Inside, the swirling patterns of the Ammonoid fossil served as a testament to his very first adventure. It had been his loyal companion through every day and night aboard the Pilgrim's Sail as he witnessed sickness, pain, and separation. The fossil stayed with him, a reminder to never forget what he had seen.\n\nA reminder to observe life beyond the stage.\n\nA reminder to see the sincerity behind the performance.\n\nA reminder to face the self behind the mask.\n\nWith great care, he put away this most important of all stage props.\n\nBecause he knew that only by respecting himself could he truly make the place he stood his <ano=stage>ocean</ano>."
    },
    {
      "title": "Through the Sea Storms",
      "content": "Thunder roared in his ears, and torrential rain drowned out every sound but its own.\n\nThis was the fiercest storm they had ever faced. Waves flung them skyward, only to slam them down mercilessly. Behind them loomed a colossal monster, its deafening roars cutting through the chaos. That night, the sea unleashed its full wrath to remind them just how insignificant their lives were in its domain.\n\nHe opened his eyes, gazing into the untamed sea before him.\n\n\"Give up, Fools!\" The <ano=fear>wind</ano> howled in his ear. \"Look at your pitiful ship! How will you ever lead your crew to safety?\"\n\n\"It's over, Fools!\" The <ano=stage>sea</ano> mocked deep within his heart. \"Look behind you! The beast waits, jaws wide, ready to devour you all!\"\n\n\"Give the order, Captain!\" His <ano=home>troupe</ano> called, their voices steady and unwavering. \"We'll follow wherever you lead!\"\n\nHis voice pierced the tempest, bold and unshaken. \"Full speed ahead! Let's move, my friends! Tonight, we will tame this sea!\"\n\nFlames burst from the mast, blazing downward to engulf the troupe's banner and the ship itself. Amidst the sea's ferocious roars, the solitary flame pressed forward. Against the flames and waves, like a daring tern, he hurled himself forward with the grapple, laughing as he leaped straight into the heart of the tempest.\n\n\"Leave the beast to me!\"\n\n...\n\nThe storm relented.\n\nThe small ship drifted alone upon the vast sea, rocking gently. The crew stood on deck. Under their captain's command, they had weathered the storm and returned to their course.  At that moment, they all began to whisper a name:\n\n\"He'll be okay.\"\n\n\"Captain…\"\n\n\"He'll come back, won't he?\"\n\n\"Really?\"\n\n\"I believe in him.\"\n\n\"Brant…\"\n\n\"Brant!! Captain! It's Captain Brant!!!\"\n\nCheers erupted as if the curtain had been lifted again for an encore.\n\nIn the golden light of the rising sun, they saw him—their Captain Brant, riding atop the colossal sea beast's head in triumphant return.\n\n\"Friends, meet our new companion, Lario! We've got ourselves a new ship now!\"\n\nIn time, they would build their stage upon the beast's back. Later, they would also discover that Lario was no ordinary Tacet Discord, but a rare Pliosaurus Somnii. Together, they would sail across <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>, performing their stories for all to hear.\n\nBut for now, Brant stood tall atop the beast, saluting his crew. \"And this, my friend, is a perfect opening! Now, cue the applause!\"\n\n\"BRAVO! BRAVO!\""
    },
    {
      "title": "When the Carnevale Ends",
      "content": "The all-night revelry had finally come to an end. In Liberty Square, the confetti and streamers still glistened faintly in the early light. Passersby murmured about last night's performance, a fleeting spectacle to them. But for the performers on stage, the falling of the curtain wasn't just an ending, it marked the beginning of something new.\n\nFor the first time in ages, they could walk freely through the streets of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, returning to the homes they had long left behind. When the stage lights dimmed, they cheered for themselves, for in that moment, they reclaimed the simple joy of standing on solid ground once more.\n\nBut now that they were on land, what were Fools like them supposed to do? That night, the captain had heartfelt conversations with many in his troupe. Some decided to part ways, returning to families they had missed. With blessings and warm embraces, the captain wished them happiness in their new lives. Others chose to stay with the troupe, eager to seek out new horizons, and the captain welcomed their continued companionship. Then there were those who felt lost, unsure of their next step. For them, the captain offered them a break.\n\n\"After all,\" he said with a playful grin, \"once the Carnevale's over, you need time to clean up the confetti.\"\n\nSome were curious about the captain's own plans, and he happily shared how he spent a day in Ragunna:\n\nOne morning after the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te>, he asked the first mate for a day off. Leaving behind the mask, costume, and even the captain's hat, he set out. First, he bought a pizza from Margherita's, then made a bet with the pigeons in the square. Later, he strolled to the <te href=850098>Cathedral of Mercury</te> and pointed at the statue of the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>, saying, \"Hey! Nobody's ever seen you!\"\n\nFinally, he returned to his old home.\n\n\"But I didn't go inside. After being away for so long, the house had already been sold. It's not mine anymore. I thought I'd come to say goodbye, but when I got there, I realized it wasn't needed. But I did hear the sound of a piano.\"\n\n\"It was a piece I didn't recognize. A new family has started their life there, just as I've been walking my own path for years now. I remember how my father used to teach me the piano when I was little, telling me, \"You must find the music you love.\"\n\n\"You can play the piano, Captain?\"\n\n\"Sadly, no. Before I could master it, the Order handed me a ticket for the Pilgrim's Sail. But that's fine. Now, I'm learning the hurdy-gurdy with you all!\"\n\n\"For me, this is home. The songs we sing, the stories we tell. That's the music I've been searching for all along. There's no need to dwell on the past. Because once the confetti's swept up, it's time to prepare for the next revelry!\"\n\n\"So, friends, fancy exploring this big, wide world with me?\"\n\nThe captain extended his invitation, for his next course had long been charted."
    }
  ],

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "With your strength, this massive wave is just a splash in our show! Bring it on!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_bulante_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "Haha! Now this is the strength worthy of a true swordsman of the seas! Join me on this voyage to the world's end, my friend! Together, we'll face that fleeting moment when the world turns upside down!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_bulante_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: I",
      "content": "More passion!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_atk_airatk02_02.play_favor_word_bulante_atk_airatk02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: II",
      "content": "Listen carefully!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_atk_airatk_sp02_02.play_favor_word_bulante_atk_airatk_sp02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: III",
      "content": "Victory's mine!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_atk_airatk_sp01_02.play_favor_word_bulante_atk_airatk_sp01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: IV",
      "content": "Perfect finale!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_atk_airatk_sp01_03.play_favor_word_bulante_atk_airatk_sp01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: V",
      "content": "Keep the cheers coming!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_atk_fallingatk01_01.play_favor_word_bulante_atk_fallingatk01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: VI",
      "content": "Here's to me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_atk_fallingatk01_02.play_favor_word_bulante_atk_fallingatk01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "Right behind you!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_atk_heavyatk01_01.play_favor_word_bulante_atk_heavyatk01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "Focus, will you?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_atk_heavyatk01_02.play_favor_word_bulante_atk_heavyatk01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill",
      "content": "Don't blink.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_skill_skill01_sp.play_favor_word_bulante_skill_skill01_sp"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "In the limelight!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_bulante_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Climax of the show!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_bulante_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Let the flames rise!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_bulante_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Epic shot.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_skill_qte_01.play_favor_word_bulante_skill_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "At the helm.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_skill_qte_02.play_favor_word_bulante_skill_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Careful!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_bulante_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "No worries.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_bulante_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "A little mishap.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_bulante_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "'Tis but a splash.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_bulante_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Let the tempest strike harder!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_bulante_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Haha, this is getting fun!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_bulante_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "The curtain falls...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_die_01.play_favor_word_bulante_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "This is... not the end...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_die_02.play_favor_word_bulante_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "The Fool's... final act…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_die_03.play_favor_word_bulante_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Your moment on stage!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_bulante_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Same actor, different role!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_bulante_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Brant salutes you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_engage.play_favor_word_bulante_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Beyond my beloved horizon!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_fly_02.play_favor_word_bulante_com_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "The compass points... this way!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_scan.play_favor_word_bulante_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "First to the treasure!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_dash_01.play_favor_word_bulante_com_dash_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Any wine inside?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_bulante_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "The scent of history.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_bulante_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "You earned it, you keep it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_bulante_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_bulante_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "The Initial Treasure",
      "content": "A meticulously preserved Ammonoid fossil. Little Brant once stood atop a table, proudly declaring to his father that he had found a treasure hidden among the books. His father took off his glasses for a closer look, recognizing it as the Ammonoid fossil tucked away at the bottom of the bookshelf. Seizing the moment, his father recounted an adventure about unearthing the past and seeking the truth.\n\nThat Ammonoid became Brant's first treasure and marked the beginning of his journey into a world of endless adventure.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure86_UI.T_Treasure86_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "All the World's His Stage",
      "content": "A sculpture of stacked masks, each crafted for a different play and occasion.\n\nOn stage, he is the star, the center of all eyes. With each mask, he breathes life into the tale, captivating the audience with joy and wonder. But offstage, there is no need to conceal his true self.\n\nIn that moment, he is, at last, simply Brant.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure85_UI.T_Treasure85_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Testament to a Captain",
      "content": "A tricorn hat, embroidered with the emblem of the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>.\n\nBrant still remembers the first performance he witnessed aboard the Fool's Sail. The captain, undeterred by the crashing waves, led his crew through the Stygian Fjords and placed a tricorn atop the head of the eager young boy. The captain, with a playful wink, called him, \"Captain Brant.\"\n\nYears later, Brant also remembers his own first performance. Standing high on the mast, he shouted commands to raise the sails and steer the ship clear of deadly whirlpools that threatened to swallow them whole. At that moment, one of the crew reverently placed the very same tricorn upon his head. Cheers erupted as the entire crew shouted in unison, \"Captain Brant! Captain Brant!\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure87_UI.T_Treasure87_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Captain's Rhapsody",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n- After performing Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stage 2</color> or <color=Highlight>Stage 4</color>, hold Normal Attack to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff</color>.\n-  After performing <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 4</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack following Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Stage 1</color> or <color=Highlight>Stage 2</color> to swing to the target with Grapple. Brant will attack the target if he reaches them with the swing. Release while in action to <color=Highlight>flip backward</color> after the attack hits; or hold Normal Attack to attack the target continuously and <color=Highlight>flip backward</color> after the finishing move. Brant <color=Highlight>flips backward</color> automatically after <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after each <color=Highlight>flip</color> to perform the next stage of <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>. <color=Highlight>Flip</color> resets Mid-air Dodge attempts.\n- If Brant fails to reach the target with the Grapple swing of <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color>, he instead performs a slash forward, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n- If Brant reaches the target with the Grapple swing of <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color> or <color=Highlight>Stage 2</color> but the attack fails to hit the target, he will drop down after a temporary suspension in mid-air.\n<size=10> </size> \n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n- Hold Normal Attack following Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stage 2</color> or <color=Highlight>Stage 4</color> or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Stage 4</color> to cast.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack during <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color> or <color=Highlight>Stage 2</color> to attack the target or hold the button to attack continuously. <color=Highlight>Flip backward</color> automatically after each of the first three <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stages</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after each <color=Highlight>flip</color> to perform the next stage of <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>.\nIf <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color> misses, lunge forward instead, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size> \n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",
        "simple_param": [],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Anchors Aweigh!",
        "desc": "Brant launches himself into the air and blasts all targets in an area, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.         "name": "Ocean Odyssey",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Theatrical Moment</color></size>\nBrant gains additional ATK based on his Energy Regen: For every 1% of his Energy Regen over {0}, Brant gains additional {1} points of ATK, up to {2}.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Waves of Acclaims</color></size>\nHeal all nearby Resonators in the team when Bravo reaches {3}, {4}, {5}, and {6}.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Returned from Ashes</color></size>\nWhen Bravo is full, replace Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Anchor Aweigh!</color> with <color=Highlight>Returned from Ashes</color>.\nConsume all Bravo to perform <color=Highlight>Returned from Ashes</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>, and generate a shield for all nearby Resonators in the team. Casting this skill when in <color=Highlight><te href=850051>Aflame</te></color> ends this state after <color=Highlight>Returned from Ashes</color> ends.\n- The shield cannot be transferred when the Resonator on the field is switched off.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Bravo</color></size>\nBrant can hold up to {7} Bravo.\n- Obtain Bravo when Normal Attacks hit the target.\n- Obtain Bravo when Intro Skill hits the target.\n- Obtain Bravo when Resonance Skill hits the target.",

  "chains": {
    "1": {
      "name": "By Currents and Winds",
      "desc": "<color=Highlight>Returned from Ashes</color> temporarily causes nearby targets to stagnate while casting. The stagnation effect is removed when Brant is switched off the field.\nAfter casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Applaud for Me!</color> or each <color=Highlight>flip</color> following Mid-air Attack, Brant's DMG dealt is increased by {0} for {1}s, stacking up to {2} times.",
      "param": [
        "20%",
        "5",
        "3"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_BulanteM1_UI.T_IconDevice_BulanteM1_UI"
    },
    "2": {
      "name": "For Smiles and Cheers",
      "desc": "Casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Returned from Ashes</color> increases Brant's Crit. Rate by {0}. \nBrant's Outro Skill <color=Highlight>The Course is Set!</color> gains a new enhancement:\nWhen <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> cast by the incoming Resonator (or nearby Resonators who activate Brant's Outro Skill) hits a target within {2}s after Brant's Outro Skill, Brant blasts the hit target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> equal to {1} of Brant's ATK (considered Basic Attack DMG). This explosion can be triggered <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3} per second, up to {4} explosions in total.\n- This effect remains active when Brant is switched off the field.",
      "param": [
        "30%",
        "440%",
        "20",
        "1",
        "2"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_BulanteM2_UI.T_IconDevice_BulanteM2_UI"
    },
    "3": {
      "name": "Through Storms I Sail",
      "desc": "The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Returned from Ashes</color> is increased by {0}.",
      "param": [
        "42%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_BulanteM3_UI.T_IconDevice_BulanteM3_UI"
    },
    "4": {
      "name": "To Freedom I Sing",
      "desc": "The Shield obtained from <color=Highlight>Returned from Ashes</color> is increased by {0}. Casting <color=Highlight>Returned from Ashes</color> restores HP for all nearby Resonators in the team ({2} HP for every {1} Energy Regen).",
      "param": [
        "20%",
        "1%",
        "6.60"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_BulanteM4_UI.T_IconDevice_BulanteM4_UI"

    "info": "A Gladiator of Septimont, a radiant star of the arena.\nFiery and straightforward, Lupa lives like a wild lone wolf. As long as she can savor the adrenaline rush of battle, she doesn't mind if that same fire ends up consuming her whole.",
    "talent_name": "Howling Flame",
    "talent_doc": "[Excerpt from Gladiator Resonance Assessment]\nContender Name: Lupa\n\nThe contender is classified as a Non-congenital Resonator, with her Resonance ability first manifesting during a childhood gladiatorial event. No signs or history of Overclocking.\n\n<i>\"Contender Lupa has consistently undergone health assessments on schedule. Among high-profile Gladiators, few maintain such disciplined routines.\"</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Shuo Xiaotu",
    "cv_name_jp": "Takahashi Minami",
    "cv_name_ko": "Kim Ye Reong",
    "cv_name_en": "Kaja Chan"
