  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Burning Inside",
      "content": "Scorching. That was Lupa's earliest memory of the small village where she was born.\n\nSummers stretched on endlessly, the heat so intense that even the lake seemed to boil. But the children of Septimont hardly cared. Far away, in the city atop Capitoline Hill, the Great Agon was about to begin. The village had rarely produced a Gladiator skilled enough to enter the match, but the excitement still pulsed through the air. Even the children couldn't resist picking up weapons and staging their mock battles in celebration.\n\nLupa was called home halfway through one of those kids' Agons.\n\nStepping through the door, she was greeted by the same old conversation. Her parents asked if she would be willing to move to Capitoline Hill. She said yes. They asked if she would be willing to become a Gladiator since she showed signs of being a Resonator. And again, she said yes. These questions had been repeated many times, and her answers stayed the same. Yet each time, her parents seemed relieved, as if they feared she might someday refuse, even though she never had.\n\nThen the usual arguments began. Should they try to mend ties with the House of Silva, who had once turned their backs on them in their darkest hour? Or should they start over somewhere new? Whenever they spoke of that glittering city on the hill, and the House they once served, their voices would take on a tone—one caught between yearning for acceptance and fearing for rejection, just like when they spoke to Lupa about her future.\n\nLupa sat for a while, listening. When it became clear her parents had drifted into their own quarrels again, forgetting she was even there, she quietly got up, stepped outside, and made her way back to her arena. The stifling heat inside her body seemed to cling, heavy and wet, growing larger as it loomed over her. It burned in her veins, a restless, humid anger that only grew hotter. It drove her forward, made her run faster, strike harder, and lunge at her opponent with everything she had.\n\nAnd it was then that she heard the gasps from the crowd.\n\nLupa looked down and saw flames spilling from her limbs, fierce and untamed, curling to engulf her whole."
    },
    {
      "title": "Up On the Hill",
      "content": "Later, Lupa followed her parents to the City of Septimont.\n\nWhite stone walls, the crisp chime of windbells, and sculptures of heroes at every turn—the city was a dazzling spectacle. But what captivated Lupa most was the most common sight in the city, the Gladiators. Their weapons, their <te href=850082>Echoes</te>, the way their eyes lit up as they talked about the teams and scores... They all sent a spark through her veins. That little flame in her heart roared to life, urging her to dash straight to Colosseum Olymdos and throw herself into the thrill of battle.\n\nBut that didn't happen. Instead, her parents led her to the Silva estate, where many other young hopefuls like her stood waiting.\n\nMatch after grueling match, Lupa fought. Until at last, teeth gritted and spear clutched tight, she stepped over her fallen rivals into the Silva's grand hall.\n\nThat was when Domina Julia singled her out from the crowd.\n\nLupa stepped forward and found herself pinned by the Domina's sharp gaze. Those clear green eyes were like deep, fathomless wells, weighing her worth as a potential asset. Instinct made her glance back, but her parents were already gone, their figures swallowed by the shadows.\n\nThey had likely received a reward generous enough to drown any guilt over abandoning their own child.\n\nHowever, Lupa didn't linger in sorrow. The packed schedules and the endless social obligations allowed no room for grief. Soon enough, Domina Julia thrust her debut match into the spotlight. And her voice, whatever it might have been, was lost beneath the thunder of the roaring crowd, swallowed by silence."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Lone Wolf",
      "content": "By the time Lupa returned to the training room, the teammate she had partnered with for the past few months was already gone.\n\nShe stood there for a moment, dazed, before moving forward through the unlit room. Her Forte had gifted her with many things: fire, a sharpened sense of smell, and the ability to see in the dark. Without hesitation, Lupa made her way to a chair and sat down, settling quietly into the darkness.\n\n\"Well,\" she thought, \"the Domina or manager will send someone new soon.\"\n\nThis farce was finally over.\n\nThey had found the mole, the one leaking the team secrets, the source of the rumors. Julia wasn't one for mercy. Therefore, that former teammate who sold them out would likely be barred from setting foot on any arena of Capitoline Hill for a very long time.\n\nOver the years, as Lupa's fame grew, her teammates had come and gone. Some couldn't keep up with the way she fought. Others were dismissed simply because Julia didn't like them. A few, like her former teammate, had come with ill intent from the very start. And then there were those who... simply couldn't stand how the crowd's cheers always found her, leaving them forgotten in her shadow.\n\nLupa had tried to say something about it, but she quickly learned that even the act of \"trying to say something\" could cut like blades.\n\nMaybe it was because she had never truly been in their shoes. After all, she had never tasted failure. Or maybe it was that unspoken \"You'll never know what it feels like,\" and the fact that, when the dust settled, she was always the one who came out ahead.\n\nEventually, Lupa learned to stay silent.\n\nAfter sitting there a while longer, she got up and walked over to the cabinet where the match recordings were kept. From the shelves, she pulled out one particular recording she had watched many times before. Perhaps it was a kind of self-consolation, clinging to the idea that even those without talent could still find joy in the arena, even though the Gladiator in that recording didn't last long and disappeared from the arena all too suddenly.\n\nThe light from Breen the Screen cast flickering shadows across Lupa's face, leaving deep, hollowed patches of darkness behind."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Nameless",
      "content": "The Nameless staggered forward, passing a silent Giant of Glory.\n\nHer legs were leaden, her memories fraying at the edges. Even piecing together a complete thought was becoming a struggle. Sometimes, when Cartethyia spoke to her, she had to pause for a long while before she could muster a reply.\n\nThis brief journey was likely nearing its end.\n\nSeptimont, her city, the city of splendor, now drenched in the Dark Tide… The Nameless no longer knew if it could still be saved. Maybe the investigation they were clinging to was already doomed to fail. Cartethyia didn't think so, but the Nameless could no longer hold on. That nauseating sensation of the cold sea creeping up from within her was growing through her bones and blood, slowly turning her into something else.\n\nThe good news was that she could feel her existence weakening. Perhaps she could simply fade away before she was completely possessed by the Dark Tide. At least then she'd spare Cartethyia that final burden.\n\nWhen working alongside others, the Nameless was rarely the one being looked after. Now, this helplessness gnawed at her for the first time. Cartethyia had to slow down because of her. Shame burned inside the Nameless, but there was nothing she could do except hope—yes, hope that the Righteous One Cartethyia had trusted would arrive soon.\n\n\"Wish I could still be of use to my new friend here.\"\n\nGritting her teeth, she braced herself against her weapon and forced another step forward.\n\n\"Wish I could still do more...\"\n\nThe Nameless lifted her head. Above her, a hero who had once claimed glory in the history of Septimont stood tall, spear in hand, gazing down. The stone-carved face seemed to hold a silent compassion, shielding her from the dark rain falling from the sky, offering a wordless shelter to those who came after."
    },
    {
      "title": "Big Little Things",
      "content": "After the \"story\" ended, Lupa kept her promise. She whisked {PlayerName} and Cartethyia on a carefree whirlwind tour through Septimont.\n\nOnly the three of them would ever know the truth, but it truly was a winding, thrilling journey worthy of being told in an epic poem.\n\nBut as everything was settled and the tension finally eased, a faint, nagging worry began to stir again in Lupa's heart, a worry for {PlayerName}, her best teammate ever.\n\nShe had seen {PlayerName}'s strength firsthand. Saving Septimont would have been impossible without {PlayerName}'s help. But it was precisely because {PlayerName} had once again won so naturally that Lupa felt a new kind of unease. She was no stranger to victory, and she knew better than most the double-edged nature of constant triumph. After the winning streak, a true defeat—not just a minor stumble, but a real fall—could sometimes destroy a person.\n\nTrue, {PlayerName} was formidable. Lupa couldn't imagine what kind of fate could bring {Male=him;Female=her} down. But if that day ever came...\n\nYet she had no words for that. All she could do was silently talk herself into believing that she would always be there, ready to offer help. Somehow, Lupa could feel that {PlayerName} was destined for something greater, something too vast to reach or change for her. Yes, some things were big, and others were little. Saving a city was a great thing. Winning a match, a small one...\n\n...Or maybe not.\n\nShe never told {PlayerName}, but while saving the city had been a grand achievement, the short journey they had walked together had gifted her just as much. Even though for {PlayerName}, it had likely been no more than another easy victory, for Lupa, it meant a lot. When they won the semi-finals and leaned against each other for a brief moment in the waiting room, she was filled with a happiness she had never known before. It was exactly because {PlayerName} treated it as another effortless routine that hardly warranted a second thought, Lupa was able to savor that pure, unclouded joy of competition once again.\n\nIn that moment, the wild, restless flame that had always howled within her finally, at long last, fell silent."
    }

      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "Sparring with you always takes me back to my childhood. Back then, we'd fight with cardboard \"weapons.\" No crowd, no cheers, no glory, just pure fun. Whether we won or lost, we'd always laugh and hug it out. Warrior… can I get a hug now, too?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_toplayer02.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_toplayer02"

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "You wish to try? Sure, go ahead! Here, take this comb, my assistant bought it. They say you need a whole collection for a tail like mine. Mmm… wow, you're really good at this! Even I can't run a comb through it like that... Why am I suddenly so sleepy...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_toplayer03.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_toplayer03"

      "content": "Being apart, going solo... I remember feeling a little uneasy. Cartethyia had passed the hope to you, and you entrusted it to me. It was a fight I had to win. I couldn't let you down.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_toplayer04.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_toplayer04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "I have received many honors, but the championship medal I won with you is the one I cherish the most. I love this city, the land it rests on, its sights, and its people. But for me, it will burn like fire. No matter what darkness comes next, this memory will always light my way.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_toplayer05.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_toplayer05"

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Lupa's Hobby",
      "content": "I love going to the Septimont baths after a training session. The warm water does wonders for easing weariness. You should give it a try.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Lupa's Trouble",
      "content": "Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_worry.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the <te href=850097>Ragunnesi</te>!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_foodlike.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_foodlike"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "The \"vittles.\" Oh, it means food cooked exclusively by <te href=850082>Echoes</te> sans human input. All \"vittles\" taste very bland... Do Septimont Echoes hate seasoning?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_foodhate.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_foodhate"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "I just want to enjoy the thrill of competition, win or lose. I can hear my heart pounding when I strike, weapon in hand, my cheeks burning as the crowd cheers... It's simple. Pure. No need for extra pomp or returns. The hard work, the strategy, the sacrifice... It's all worth it to feel that joy! Sticking with this for life won't be easy, but would I have to quit? Not a chance.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_dream.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_dream"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "This spear? It was a gift from Domina Julia... Yeah, the same weapon I carried into my very first match in Septimont. Back then, I was just a child with \"some natural talent.\" She spotted me in the crowd and brought me into the limelight. So, in the following years, I turned a blind eye to the outrageous contract terms, willfully ignoring the fact that she sought to use me for her own gain. I used to believe her pride would hold her back, that it would stop her from crossing the line...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_story_obj.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_story_obj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "It's now all a blur to me... the memory of being trapped in that empty city... Walls crawling with Tidal Blight, monsters prowling the streets. Everyone had vanished without a trace. It was the lowest I'd ever seen Septimont. I couldn't bear to see such hellish sights. But I told myself, \"I can still hold on.\" I had to keep going... keep searching for a way to save this city, no matter how many times it took.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_story_exp.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_story_exp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Cartethyia",
      "content": "In that empty city, Cartethyia was there for me during my most delirious and painful moments. At first, our conversations were a bit stiff. Guess she hadn't spoken to anyone in who knows how long. But as we spent more time together, I realized that she was actually easygoing and carefree. For someone like her, being trapped in one place for so long must've been unbearable... Now that our long journey is over, I hope my friend can fully enjoy this moment of peace.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_katixiya.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_katixiya"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Augusta",

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_aogusita.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_aogusita"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Iuno",
      "content": "A spirited, nimble girl... That's my impression of her. Once, I saw her sprint along the narrow bricks at the top of the high wall and leap onto a statue like a cat. No clue who was chasing her, but I cheered loudly along with everyone else at the foot of the wall!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_younuo_b.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_younuo_b"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Brant",
      "content": "Many Gladiators of the Blue Furies come from the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>. I remember once, at Cliffside Harbor, I saw their captain leap off the deck just to hug his crew. They chattered on for a while, and then suddenly broke into song...!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_bulante.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_bulante"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Mya",
      "content": "When I first saw the footage of Contender Mya, I was merely impressed by her raw, unfiltered determination. At the time, my team had some problems, and my teammates accused me of not understanding what it felt like to be left behind. Normally, I'd brush it off, but the sounds of sorrow grew louder and started to weigh on me. Strength, weakness, winning, losing... I began to question if I had only made it through by luck. But Mya has shown me the answer with her whole life. Victory is about giving everything you've got.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_miya.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_about_miya"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "Happy birthday, Fellow Warrior! Hahaha, did I scare you? How could I ever forget your special day? I've already set up a party at the Leonidas Hotel—whenever you return to Septimont, I'll be there waiting. Now, look out the window! These fireworks are for you. We Septimontians know how to put on a show, thanks to all the contests and celebrations we throw. Okay, let's kick things off with a cup of wheat juice! No? Seriously? Alright, fine. Then close your eyes and make a wish.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Oh? You're here!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_lupa_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "In my previous match, I slipped and left an opening, but my opponent failed to notice. He gradually lost his advantage... and here, he started to panic, until... I knocked him down with a single blow!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_lupa_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_lupa_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "Oh, is a new match calling?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "You called, Warrior?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Time to hunt!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "I'm joining your battle.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "Our teamwork is getting better.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "Awesome! I'll record our training and savor every detail of it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "Do I look overexcited? Because in truth, I am. All I want is to keep sparring with you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "More... Get me more... One more round, Warrior! I want a rematch!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "As we advance from one battle to the next, do you ever feel tired? I want to become stronger, wiser, and better. I want to be someone who's got your back, to be your... most trusted Fellow Warrior.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_lupa_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "Time to fight!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_atk_heavyatk01_sp_01.play_favor_word_lupa_atk_heavyatk01_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "All or nothing!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_atk_heavyatk01_sp_02.play_favor_word_lupa_atk_heavyatk01_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: III",
      "content": "Let's start!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_atk_heavyatk01_sp_03.play_favor_word_lupa_atk_heavyatk01_sp_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Caught you now!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "I'll end you!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Face me coward!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Lackluster.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_01.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "I smell fear.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_02.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Is that all?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_03.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "Break! Darkness.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_pro_01.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_pro_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VIII",
      "content": "Die! Evil.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_pro_02.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_pro_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IX",
      "content": "Flee! Filth.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_pro_03.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_pro_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: X",
      "content": "Into the spotlight.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_pro_01.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_pro_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XI",
      "content": "Glory is upon us.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_pro_02.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_pro_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XII",
      "content": "Together, we howl.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_pro_03.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill02_pro_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XIII",
      "content": "Nice teamwork!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_sp_01.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XIV",
      "content": "Timely support!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_sp_02.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XV",
      "content": "Attack as one!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_sp_03.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_skill01_sp_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Triumph at the speartip!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_lupa_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "The fight is on!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_lupa_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "With me, to victory!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_lupa_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Cheer for me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_qte_01.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "Applaud for me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_qte_02.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Try that again!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_lupa_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Meaningless move.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_lupa_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Hah, that's some attack.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_lupa_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Now's the second half!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_lupa_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "The shame...!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_lupa_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "A warrior... dies with honor.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_die_01.play_favor_word_lupa_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "The scent of... Bloodleaf Viburnum...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_die_02.play_favor_word_lupa_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Does the Vale of Glory await me?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_die_03.play_favor_word_lupa_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "With me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "New tactic.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_lupa_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "I hear cowering prey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_engage.play_favor_word_lupa_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Winds of the wild!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_lupa_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Hiding there, huh?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_scan.play_favor_word_lupa_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Prey secured!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_lupa_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Heh, pretty good haul.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_lupa_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "You get first dibs!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_lupa_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_lupa_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Old Medal",
      "content": "Ever since Lupa's parents severed ties with her, their faces began to blur from her memory.\n\nWhat lingers is the way they used to reminisce about their days on Capitoline Hill, far from the small village she called home. They had once borne the name Silva, until they were cast out, shamed by defeat in the arena. From then on, their lives were marked by regret, hardship, and finger-pointing. \n\nAnd yet, when they heard Lupa had won her first match, they still went to the blacksmith and had this medal forged, a gift to commemorate her victory.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure103_UI.T_Treasure103_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Viburnum Bouquet",
      "content": "This was one of many bouquets Lupa received in the arena. Bloodleaf Viburnum, the flower of Gladiators, a mark of victory and glory.\n\nThe first time she stepped into Colosseum Olymdos, she fought like a creature unleashed. Relentless. Instinctive. Wolf-like. The crowd gathered and roared. Applause crashed over her like waves, the lights above sharp and dizzying. \n\nOnly when she returned to the waiting room, the bouquet still in hand, did she hear herself laughing out loud.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure105_UI.T_Treasure105_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Mini Ta-da Figurines",
      "content": "The people of Septimont have a deep love for sculptures. They immortalize many things with that art. Gryphons, heroes, legends... and of course, the ever-lovable <te href=850082>Echoes</te>.\n\nLupa's favorite? Ta-da. Just one glance at those cheerful, chubby little things is enough to make her day. That's why she chose a pair of Ta-da figurines as a gift for her fellow warrior.\n\nCaptured mid-flap with their oversized ears and fearless charm, they look ready to charge into the arena, just like Lupa and {PlayerName} once did. That journey they shared remains one of her brightest memories.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure104_UI.T_Treasure104_UI"
    }
  ],

    "rarity": 4
  },

      "skill": {
        "name": "Flaming Star",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n- After Basic Attack Stage 3, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack in the right time to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color>.\n- After <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Starfall</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color>, or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack in time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color></size>\nWhen <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {0} points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Wolf's Gnawing</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {1} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color></size>\nWhen <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {3} points and <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {4} point, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Wolf's Claw</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n- If <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {5} points and <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {6} point after performing <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in time to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>.\n- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {7} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain <SapTag=8>{8}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=8} of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size> \nConsume STA to perform up to 3 attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. The <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle will not be reset.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color></size>\nWhen <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {9} points, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Heavy Attack DMG).\n- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {10} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain <SapTag=11>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=11} of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Plunging Attack</color></size>\nHold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. After performing this attack, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack in time to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Starfall</color>.\n- If a <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> is performed while casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color> in time at the cost of STA.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Starfall</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",

        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size> \nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Wolflame</color> reaches certain points, perform <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Wolflame</color> reaches certain points, perform <color=Highlight>Enhanced Mid-air Attack</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>).\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chain Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Fire-Kissed Glory",
        "desc": "Attack the target and deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Performing this attack consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> and restores {0} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Use Basic Attack or Resonance Skill in time to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Foebreaker</color>.\nCan be performed in mid-air close to the ground.\nPerforming this skill strengthens all Resonators in the team. Within {1}s:\n- All Resonators in the team gain <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> effect.\n- If the active Resonator is hit or launched into the air, they immediately recover and are considered to have successfully dodged the attack when they are on the ground. Can be triggered up to 3 times.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Pack Hunt</color></size>\nResonators with <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> gain a {2} ATK increase, and {3} Fusion DMG Bonus when they attack Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets (Both are non-stackable). If there are {7} Fusion Resonators in the team, the Fusion DMG Bonus against Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets additionally increases by {8}. When the active Resonator casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> is enhanced, granting an additional {4} ATK increase to all Resonators in the team, up to a maximum of {5}.\nIf Lupa's <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> reaches its cap within its duration, she enters <color=Highlight>Wild Hunt</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> becomes available. <color=Highlight>Wild Hunt</color> can be triggered once per <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Foebreaker</color></size>\nConsume all <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform <color=Highlight>Foebreaker</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and entering <color=Highlight>Burning Matchpoint</color> state. \n\n<size=40><color=Title>Burning Matchpoint</color></size>\nNormal Attacks retore {6} more <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> on hit. Cannot perform Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color> in this state.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Ignis Lupa",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Wildfire Banner</color></size>\nLupa's ATK is increased by {0} for {1}s when performing the following actions:\n- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.\n- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fire-Kissed Glory</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> and <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf</color></size>\nWhen <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {2} points, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color>. Performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).\nCan be performed in mid-air close to the ground.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color></size>\nWhen <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {3} points in the <color=Highlight><te href=850177>Burning Matchpoint</te></color> state, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>. Performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color> consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG). <color=Highlight>Burning Matchpoint</color> is removed when the skill ends.\nCan be performed in mid-air close to the ground.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Set the Arena Ablaze</color></size>\nWithin {4}s after performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> or <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>, Lupa will remain on the field after switching to another Resonator and back up the active Resonator when they perform <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG). This effect can only be triggered once in its duration.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Wolflame</color></size>\nLupa can hold up to {5} points of Wolflame.\n- Restore Wolflame when Normal Attacks hit the target.\n- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Skill.\n- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Liberation.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Wolfaith</color></size>\nLupa can hold up to {6} points of Wolfaith.\nWolfaith lasts for {7}s. The duration is reset when Wolfaith is restored. At the end of its duration, each remaining point of Wolfaith becomes {8} points of Wolflame.\n- Restore {9} point of Wolfaith when casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.",
        "param": [
          "12%",
          "8",
          "2",
          "2",
          "8",
          "100",
          "2",
          "10",
          "50",
          "1"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "ATK is increased when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attacks</color>, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Mid-air Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, <color=Highlight>Chain Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill Finisher</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge: Wolflame and Wolfaith</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Chain Resonance Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> grant <color=Highlight>Wolflame</color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Wolflame</color> reaches certain points, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attacks</color> and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Mid-air Attack</color> become available, granting <color=Highlight>Wolfaith</color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Wolfaith</color> is full, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> becomes available, which deals <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Wolfaith</color> is full and <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color> is active, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill Finisher</color> becomes available, which deals <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>, and ends <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Assisted Attack</color></size>\nWithin a certain period after Lupa performs <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill Finisher</color>, Lupa will assist the active Resonator in their assault when they perform <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.",

    "info": "Cold and decisive, she is the \"Discord Slayer\" who hunts across Solaris and the same \"Fiend of Ever-burning Flame\" spoken of in whispers. Now, she serves as a Black Shores Consultant, active across the world.",
    "talent_name": "Infernal Descent",
    "talent_doc": "[Special Containment Risk Assessment Record – X666]\n  \n\"...The subject's Resonance Ability shows prior contamination by the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>. The frequency spectrum is heavily obscured and cannot be analyzed via the Rabelle Method. Based on the subject's own testimony, corroborated by external sources, she is classified as a <te href=850068>Congenital Resonator</te>.\"\n  \n\"...Overlord-Class Tacet Discords detected within the subject's body. Testing is to be transferred to the <te href=850110>Tethys System</te>. All non-essential personnel are to evacuate to designated safe zones without delay!\"\n  \n\"...Sample database linked. Comparative analysis initiated.\"\n  \n\"...The subject's internal frequency confirmed. Partial matches identified with known <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>: <te href=260005>Chimera</te>, Galbrena, Harpyia, Dullahan, Balor, and the Nameless Dreadshade. Remaining correlations pending verification.\"\n  \n\"All identified Tacet Discords exhibit no hostile behavior under suppression by the subject's own frequency. Behavioral stability confirmed under high-stress conditions. Final assessment: containment not advised. Recommendation: routine examinations.\n  \nThe cause of the subject's Awakening cannot be confirmed. Her innate flame, once corroded by the Dark Tide, decayed but was never fully extinguished. Subsequently, it fused with the Tidespawn known as Chimera, altering the flame's nature and granting her the capacity to consume other frequencies.\n  \nThrough this process, the subject proactively hunts Tacet Discords, absorbing and transforming their frequencies into her own power. At present, she is able to wield multiple Tacet Discord abilities in combat.\n  \nFor \"demons\" devoured by her flame, there are only two outcomes: purification and transformation into her own power, or utter destruction.\n  \n<i>\"A walking museum of Tacet Discords… Can such power truly belong to a human? Worse still, it evolves.\"</i>\n<i>\"No… it's an inner empire. I saw it… an empire rising within her.\"</i>",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Galbrena has a prior history of Overclocking. Maximum severity rating: Mild.\n  \n<i>Black Shores Bloom Bearer Research Report</i>\n  \n<i>Despite the immense power Ms. Galbrena exhibited after <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>—including marked transformation of both appearance and physiology—we nevertheless classify her historical Overclock severity rating as Mild.</i>\n  \n<i>This assessment must be understood in context: her Resonance Ability was once corrupted by the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>, leaving her almost entirely depleted of her Resonance Ability. For a Resonator so diminished to achieve Overclocking at all—to move from deficit to surplus, from absence to presence—is nothing short of miraculous.</i>\n  \n<i>Traditionally, Overclocking has been defined as a state that exhausts the mind and body, signifying the dominance of destructive tendencies over regenerative ones within Resonators. Galbrena's case, however, compels us to reconsider this definition. In her, Overclocking did not manifest as deterioration, but as a signal of rebirth. It suggests that the phenomenon may be closely tied to the will of the Resonator and that, if properly guided, Overclocking could potentially yield constructive outcomes, transforming into a power that Resonators could one day learn to wield with intent.</i>\n  \n<i>Important Note: All research personnel are strictly prohibited from attempting, by any method, to replicate Ms. Galbrena's Overclocking method. Any such action, once discovered, will result in immediate containment measures.</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Zhang Wenjie",
    "cv_name_jp": "Shouji Umeka",
    "cv_name_ko": "Lee Da Seul",
    "cv_name_en": "Devora Wilde"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Day of a Hunter",
      "content": "\"The demon has fallen. The children may sing once more.\"\n \nThe Discord Slayer folded her burning wings and descended from the skies into the waiting crowd. The heat still rising from the gun at her hip betrayed that her hunt had just ended.\n \n<te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>—supernatural beings born from the chaotic remnants of human frequencies and energy—were the embodiment of malice and destruction in this world. Although science had long since classified them, in many places they were still referred to as demons or vengeful spirits, with names derived from old legends and ghost stories. And across the world, there were those who hunted them. For bounty, for research, or simply to test their own strength. To face such terrifying foes with both respect and defiance, these hunters bore a title passed down through the ages—Discord Slayer.\n \nMost Discord Slayers proved their kills by extracting the monster's frequency through their Terminal, or by returning with its Tacet Core. But not her. She always came back empty-handed, offering only her word that the job was done. She would calmly recount each monster's weakness and the best way to slay it. But words alone earned no trust. And so, she raised her right hand and whispered its name… the Shrieking Legion, the Tacet Discord she harbored, emerged. The crowd had no choice but to believe. Fear thickened the air. Silence fell like a blade.\n \nShe heard their murmurs, their doubts, their suspicions. She felt their hostility, but never once tried to explain herself. Some whispered she was the product of a human–TD hybrid experiment, created for the sole purpose of killing. Others believed she was forged from altered TD frequencies, a being born of sin. Still more were convinced she had struck a pact with a demon and traded her emotions away. She always nodded in agreement to that. To her, it was a convenient shield, an excuse to silence the questions she didn't want to answer.\n \nMost days, she would turn away from the stares. But sometimes, she allowed herself small indulgences. She would ignore the wary looks and take a seat at an open bar, quietly ordering a few glasses of a blueberry ice cream shake. Only the hunters who fought beside her knew the truth. Beneath her cold, distant mask burned an intense lust for the hunt. And when she faced her prey, she was merciless.\n \nThe Shrieking Legion was a beast-type Tacet Discord of the forest. Born of jealousy, it mimicked human voices to lure children close before stealing their voices. She had warned the squad not to engage it on its own ground. But her youthful appearance earned no trust. They ignored her and fell into its trap. The valley walls amplified the monster's shrieks into a storm of sound that nearly broke the entire squad. But she did not hesitate. With cold resolve, she ruptured her own eardrums, blood trailing behind her as she charged forward. In the next breath, flames surged around her. She pressed her gun to the monster's chest and pulled the trigger. In the smoking silence that followed, she left only her verdict:\n \n\"Your penance starts now.\"\n \nThe crowd witnessed the monster's reckoning. With her right hand, she seized its throat, and serpentine flames engulfed it completely. The Legion released a final, distorted wail before dissolving into a sliver of essence—absorbed by her as due payment. Her own bloodied, burnt body began to regenerate with unnerving speed. For a moment, it was hard to tell... who the real demon was. \n \nBut one truth was undeniable. She could have escaped alone. Instead, she stayed. And because she did, they lived.\n \nShe brushed the ashes from her shoulders, conjured a handful of popsicles as if from thin air, and offered them to the trembling survivors with a casual grin.\n \n\"Want one?\"\n \nTo her, this deadly hunt was nothing more than a mundane errand on an ordinary day. \n \nOnce the sweetness of the ice cream cooled the fire still smoldering in her chest, she unfurled her wings and vanished into the skies.\n \nNo one knew where she came from, or where she was going. Children called her the \"Ice Cream Demon\" after watching her devour three towering cups of frozen delight. The more learned saw the baleful fire that clung to her and thought instead of the legendary Flame Demon. But if one dared to gather her fallen feathers, they would discover something else. Those razor feathers sharp enough to cut Tacet Discords in two carried a strange gentleness, and... a bitterness weathered with time. Perhaps it was only natural. Such freedom, such untamed spirit, could only be born of displacement.\n \nShe rarely spoke of her past. When pressed, her answers were brief, evasive.\n \nTo know her story, one would have to go back a long, long time ago. Back when her hair still shimmered pale gold and her eyes still blazed with radiant light. Back before the world ever called her… \"Galbrena.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Of a Childhood Long Gone",
      "content": "People always said Angel was born \"in the embrace of light and flame.\" She came into the world at golden dawn, swathed in radiant fire.\n \nHer parents' Resonance Abilities were modest. In <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, her birth might have been hailed as a miracle. But in Septimont, divinity held no sway. Here, only strength commanded respect.\n \nFor a child, a powerful Resonance Ability early in life was not always a gift. It came with a constant risk of losing control. Young Angel clung to her parents' teachings, carefully regulating her emotions to ensure her flames never harmed others. At an age meant for laughter, she stood apart from the other children—reserved, distant, cold. Some called it arrogance. The timid avoided her, while the bold sought to provoke her, eager to test themselves against a peer so unlike themselves. Perhaps these children meant no harm. But to them, her nature, her talents, her very identity were simply too... different.\n \nHer parents were exiles from Ragunna, traveling far before settling in Septimont. Her father stepped forward to fight when monsters attacked. Her mother, even with little to spare, gave food to those with less. At a time when prejudice still lingered between the two city-states, these acts of kindness earned them a place in the town.\n\nHer mother raised her by the Codex: to be kind, compassionate, tolerant, and forgiving. Angel took such lessons to heart. But in Septimont, kindness alone never guaranteed respect. Shaped by two distinct cultures, Angel developed a creed of her own: Treat others with goodwill. Never start a fight. But if someone strikes you, strike back harder.\n \nFortunately, bruises were common among children in Septimont. Still, Angel avoided causing her parents trouble. Over time, she learned to enjoy solitude. She found sanctuary in a smithy run by her father's friend, Uncle Filo. Few children went there, but something instinctual in her was drawn to the blazing fire, the sparks that flew, and the clear, ringing clash of hammer against iron. It was there she met a red-haired girl. With her bold, straightforward nature, that girl had many friends. She offered Angel the laughter her childhood had long lacked. They would sit by the forge and talk deep into the night about their troubles and dreams. The girl, Augusta, cared most for the stories behind each weapon, while Angel was captivated by the mysterious ritual of \"quenching.\" Uncle Filo once explained: \"Even the finest blade is just raw metal, unless it is quenched and tempered.\"\n \nMany things puzzled Angel, like why the winds of Septimont always carried the scent of rust. She thought it was simply the breath of the forges and bellows. Only later, as she grew older, did she learn what it truly carried. The wind came from the Plateaus: From fallen spearheads, broken swords, and... the freshly spilled blood of warriors.\n \nSixteen years ago, the <te href=850159>High Tide</te> swept across the Plateaus. In <te href=260006>Fabianum</te>, the hunts became endless. Angel watched her parents return exhausted, saw others come back bloodied and broken, and heard the constant refrain of \"strength.\" It was then that a vow took root in her heart.\n \nFrom that day on, she trained with relentless resolve. She sought out adults for combat lessons, shadowed rangers to learn the hunt, and sparred with anyone willing. Like a parched beast at a watering hole, she drank deeply from every source. All for one goal: the Initiate's Proving Grounds. The victor would receive elite <te href=850164>Gladiator</te> training, and with it, a faster path to becoming a true hunter.\n \nEffort bore fruit. In the arena, Angel cut through dozens of rivals until she faced the favored contender: Arkyria, famed for once fending off the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>'s creations alone. Arkyria's will, tempered in life-and-death trials, forced Angel to retreat again and again. She could not let this chance to slip away... So, for the first time, she unleashed her Resonance Ability.\n \nLight erupted from Angel like fire. Blazing, but not scorching. Dazzling, but not blinding. In that instant, the tide turned. Victory was hers. She stepped forward to check on her fallen rival, only to be met by bitter words: \"Why you? Why were you gifted with such power?\"\n \nIt was the question Angel had carried since childhood: Why me?\n \nThere were others who worked harder, with more talent. Why didn't they receive this gift?\n \nIf they had the same power, would they be spared pain?\n \nIf she could master this power, could she help them? What if...\n \nHer thoughts were interrupted by the cries of Griffrexes overhead. They soared toward the Plateaus—where every hunt began.\n \nYes. At the very least, she had proven she could control her power. Soon, she too would ride a Griffrex into battle, striking down evil Tidespawn to defend more people. That was her vow. Her \"hunt\" was about to begin.\n \nEverything was supposed to go that way. Everything did go that way. Yet fate, whether through a cruel twist of words or some long-planned deceit, finally revealed its face: What it gives, it takes. What is kind, it teaches to do harm. What is fearless, it breaks—until it kneels and never rises again.\n \nBut Angel had never set foot in Tetragon Temple. She never sought to understand fate. She didn't want to. She only knew this: if someone struck her, she would strike back harder. Whether it was man, divinity, or... fate itself."
    },
    {
      "title": "Angel's Ashes",
      "content": "She would never forget the first time she \"devoured\" a <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te>. Her body's rejection tore through her, an agony that seared her insides, as if her very soul would be reduced to ash. But more unbearable than the pain was the weakness it revealed.\n \nShe knew what had granted her a second chance at life, and she remembered the vow she had once sworn. But when she stood before the \"true forms of evil,\" she understood just how powerless she truly was.\n \nSo she surrendered her frequency, striking a pact with the demon that dwelled within her. That day, she set foot on a path with no return.\n \nYet to her, this was the \"hunt\" she was always destined to begin: the hunting ceremony she never attended, the Sacred Flames the <te href=850152>Priestess</te> should have lit... Now ignited instead by the infernal blaze of \"Galbrena.\"\n \nAnd so, the girl bearing fire wandered between civilization and wilderness, listening to whispers and sifting through legends. She wandered desolate ruins littered with corpses and bones, seeking only to hunt the monsters born of mankind's emotions.\n \nShe once fought up on a sheer cliff and plummeted with her foe into the depths—though she had not yet learned to fly.\n \nShe once battled beneath the surface of a dark lake, for her enemy feared the water—though she herself could barely swim.\n \nShe had slain countless monsters, and had nearly been slain by countless more.\n \n<te href=260005>Chimera</te> once believed that those granted a second life would cling to it, doing anything to survive, until their will buckled under the weight and they fell into his trap. Never had Chimera imagined that he would be undone by the very bloodlust he sought. Again and again, the girl challenged foes far stronger than herself, wagering her life each time, until she became a living prison of flesh and blood that bound him.\n \nThis second life had come at a cost. To live it in cowardice would make it meaningless. She did not fight merely to tame the demon inside her. She fought to wrest more power from fate itself.\n \nYet Chimera's words were not without truth: kindness without power is the cruelest tragedy. To save, one must also learn to harm. She recalled her mother's words, \"If a tree's roots cannot pierce into hell, then its branches will never reach heaven.\" But she had never yearned for heaven. If hell awaited her, then she would descend deeper, dragging demons down with her, forcing them to kneel before infernal fire, or consigning them to eternal ruin… Even if that inferno consumed her as well.\n \nStill, she sometimes wondered if she had already become the demon people whispered about. Could her current body... even be considered \"human\"? Could she truly wield darkness for good, without being devoured by it?\n \nFor while she gave her kindness freely… she had done things only demons would.\n \nOnce, she traveled to a remote southern town to hunt the Nameless Dreadshade. It was said that its influence had driven the townsfolk mad, making them obsessed with a \"frequency exchange\" technique. They butchered travelers to harvest their frequencies in pursuit of immortality. When the Dreadshade was slain, instruments shattered and the so-called immortals withered away, shrieking in insanity until their final breaths. Still unrepentant, still scheming, still thinking of how to sacrifice others for their own survival...\n \nIn that moment she realized it was not the Dreadshade that had twisted them. Their own deranged desires had summoned it forth. And so, with one great blaze, she reduced that town of living hell to ashes, purging the evil at its source.\n \nThat hunt taught her two truths: the demons of this world are not only Tacet Discords, and every demon is born from the human heart.\n \nPerhaps the fact that she still asked these questions meant she was still human. Or perhaps, the world had already delivered its answer.\n \nShe had seen men claw and kill for the smallest profit, and others sacrifice their lives for the faintest flicker of hope. She had seen cities crumble to greed, and white blossoms bloom in the mud and rubble left behind. Human nature was a fragile and captivating paradox. Kindness and cruelty. Baseness and greatness. Always intertwined. The world was never just black or white. And it was within that endless gray that she found herself most at home.\n \nThe young Discord Slayer grew accustomed to the way others treated her and to her place between worlds. Where once her fiery wings had left her bruised and bloodied, she now learned to soar with grace.\n \nBy day, she circled the borderlands like a hawk in search of prey, watching the world in silence. By night, she rested alone on barren branches, guarding the ancient stars, just as they guarded her.\n \nShe still remembered her vow. Once, she feared the shadows and the power they held. Later, she learned to wield that fear. And now, she had chosen to become fear itself. A being so terrifying... even demons trembled before her."
    },
    {
      "title": "Skies Within",
      "content": "Sunset. Sands. Smoke. This hunting ground was no more brutal than those before it.\n \nThe girl of yesterday had long hardened into a woman covered in scars. From beneath her tattered clothing radiated a killing intent so fierce that even <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> instinctively fled at her approach.\n \nAnd yet, even she seemed insignificant before the iron bulk of Dullahan, the headless knight who razed the land. Its arrival came without warning. Steel clashed. In that instant, Galbrena understood why she had failed to sense it. Its frequency was overwhelming, so powerful that even the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te> refused to touch it. She had long since unbound <te href=260005>Chimera</te>, letting him loose to revel in bloodshed... But even his ferocity could only slow the knight's warhorse.\n \nRun? The thought crossed her mind more than once. But just a few hundred meters behind her, a mother and son were fleeing for their lives. Each moment she stood her ground was another moment bought for their survival. They would carry the warning onward, to the tribe in the distance, and perhaps summon reinforcements to halt Dullahan's advance before it reached the gates of civilization. For that reason, the choice was clear. This was not about victory. It was about standing, no matter the cost.\n \nShe did not fear death, but she refused to fall here. Harpyia's razor wings had already been broken. Now, her only remaining weapon was \"Galbrena's\" dying hellfire. And on this barren battlefield, there was no hatred left to stoke her flames.\n \n\"…You've always known how to keep that fire burning.\"\nA childlike voice stirred in her mind.\n\"If Galbrena was born to feed on hatred…\nThen hate yourself.\nHate your weakness. Hate your helplessness. Hate your hesitation…\nIf the Flame Demon's blaze isn't enough, then burn yourself.\nIf the Beholder claims Dullahan's armor cannot be broken, then trust your own 'eyes.'\"\n \nShe did not know to whom the voice belonged. But its words rang true, urging her to trust her instincts, just as she always had.\n \nHatred and flame welled at her fingertips. Faint, but sharp enough to cut through her wounds and set her blood and body alight.\n \nDullahan's greatsword came crashing down once more. But this time, she didn't meet it head-on. She dove straight into the hollow where its head should have been, hurling herself into its empty armor. Scorching fire swallowed her whole. But as she had guessed, this was its weakness: its inner flame was feeble compared to hers. Two fires clashed and roared inside the suit of iron. That towering body shuddered… Until, at last, silence fell.\n \nThe next time she opened her eyes, she was in the arms of that mother and child.\n \nAlive? Galbrena was grateful. She lit her fingertips once more, ready to burn herself—relieved that she could still use the same trick. They stopped her quickly, reminding her that the headless knight was already gone. Later, she would hear that when reinforcements arrived, all they saw was a golden dawn blazing on the horizon. And Galbrena, collapsed alone in the sands. \n \nIt wasn't until others pointed it out that she noticed her body had changed. In that pure, internal clash of fire, she had already won. Dullahan's frequency had fused into her blood and bones. The headless knight's regenerative power had healed her nearly destroyed body, erasing even her oldest scars. The Immortal Flame Demon, once only a name, now lived in truth. But Galbrena felt no warmth in this new life. All she knew was that she could use the same trick again and again, without end.\n \nHer garments, already in tatters, had been burned away. Some tried to gather the scattered white feathers from the ground, hoping to weave her new clothes from them. But she only touched the black feathers on her shoulder and said, \"This will do.\"\n \nPerhaps Dullahan, too, had feared that radiant dawn. As for who brought it forth, she did not know. A trick of nature, perhaps? And the white feathers? Left behind by passing birds. They had nothing to do with her. Besides, black suited her far better.\n \nNot long after she set off again, Chimera stirred. \"What was that voice I heard?\" she asked.\n\"That,\" he answered, \"Was the oldest and strongest demon within you.\"\n\"Even older than you?\"\n\"Of course. She's been part of your flesh and soul from the beginning. If not for her, I would've devoured you long ago. It was she who helped you defeat 'Galbrena.'\"\n\"I don't remember ever absorbing such a Tacet Discord.\"\n\"Not a Tacet Discord… You truly don't know her name?\"\n\"No.\"\n\"…Your ignorance never ceases to amaze me. How have you survived this long?\"\n\"Spare me your chatter. Tell me.\"\n\"…Angel. Her name… is Angel.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "A Return Long Awaited",
      "content": "She had once turned the gun upon herself, but this was not her dream.\n \nShe had slain countless Tidespawn in the boundless dark. At last, spent and staggering, she collapsed atop the black waters. Once more, she found herself in the net spun by fate.\n \n\"No… I can't fall here. Too much remains undone. I made a promise to {Male=him;Female=her}… I must not fall here.\"\n \nWhen her eyes opened again, <te href=260006>Fabianum</te> lay before her. Her rivals, her friends, her family... they all smiled warmly as they walked toward her.\n \nBut was this another illusion conjured by the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>? Did Leviathan believe she feared happiness? Or rather, an undeserved happiness? For how could one possessing such dark power ever be seen, accepted, and loved?\n \nOnce, she might have wrestled with that question. Now, she no longer needed an answer. She only needed to remember her aim. She rose, ignited her flames, loaded the barrel, and leveled her gun at the \"old friend\" before her.\n \n\"Hahaha! Little girl, looks like you've honed yourself into something sharp indeed.\"\n \nIf this were a dream, Uncle Filo's laughter rang far too true. Yet when she saw the marks of the Dark Tide's corruption on them, she understood at last: those who had once given her all their frequencies, who by all rights should have become Leviathan's kindred, were still resisting Its embrace. For decades, they had refused Its so-called \"gift.\" And for that, Leviathan had cast them into the deepest reaches of the Dark Tide, condemning them to torment without end.\n \nShe fell silent. Along her journey, she had faltered. She had hesitated. Maybe, if she had only pushed harder, she might have mastered this power sooner. Might have come back earlier, might have saved more lives. Maybe...\n \n\"Hunter, you've already done enough.\"\n\"Live with pride, head held high. Free and unbound. That has always been our wish.\"\n\"You will forever be our pride.\"\n \nThey all answered with radiant smiles. And her mother gave voice to the question she had long carried in silence. One she had never dared, nor ever been given the chance, to ask.\n \n\"But my child, you know this is not home.\"\n\"Your journey must continue. Someone is still waiting for you.\"\n\"Remember when we fought? Give Leviathan a taste of that! Do it for all of us! Avenge us with joy!\"\n\"Farewell, Angel. This time… may truly be forever.\"\n\"Don't forget, we will always be with you.\"\n \nAt the end, her father struck a pose, lifting his hands in a clumsy, exaggerated \"V\" for victory. \"Foolish old man...\" she laughed bitterly in her heart. But she knew the meaning it carried. No need for hugs. No looking back. It was both comfort and farewell.\n \nTheir figures blurred into specks of light, pointing her toward a fleeting direction... That was why they had come. They had no strength left to give, but once again, they saved her.\n \nHow laughable Leviathan's trick turned out to be. It sought to drag her down into the endless darkness of the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>, yet instead, It helped her finish a farewell she had long been denied.\n \n<te href=260006>Fabianum</te> faded before her eyes, crumbling and vanishing. But she was no longer that little girl. Her past held beauty, but she would not drown in it. Her heart held softness, but she would forge herself sharper still.\n \nAnd so, without hesitation, she turned and walked into the boundless dark.\n \nOnce more, <te href=260005>Chimera</te> stood before her.\n \nShe never expected this savage Tacet Discord to understand humanity, nor to be her friend. She only wished that, once her path was clear, he would cease causing her trouble. And for that, there was only one solution: she had to tame him.\n \nShe braced for battle. Yet this time, Chimera did not strike. He only watched her in silence as she approached, burning quietly in her flames—Angel's flames. <i>Her</i> flames.\n \nAt last, so many questions found their answers.\n \n\"Can't handle such a small flame?\"\n\"An abysmal jest! Try not to die here. This is not where our hunt shall end.\"\n\"We have survived worse before, haven't we?\"\n \nThere was no demon that could not be hunted. The Threnodian was only the strongest of them. And besides, she wasn't alone in this fight.\n \nChimera spoke no more and stepped aside. Behind him, countless Tacet Discords she had once devoured revealed their forms. She had fought them to the death, again and again across endless dreams, seizing their power by force. But now… \n \nShe walked past them without fear. A blazing road unfurled at her feet. And on either side, creatures that once struck terror into countless souls now bowed in reverence, as if escorting their master to battle. Were they bowing before a demon greater than themselves? Or before something else, something even demons feared?\n \nIt no longer mattered. Her power had long surpassed theirs. She required no recognition. Only obedience.\n \nAnd she would wield this cursed power to hunt down greater sins—just as she had sworn in childhood, a vow unbroken unto death.\n \nFor herself. For those who could never return. To ensure the tragedy of Fabianum... and that of her own suffering would not be repeated.\n \nHer hunt would never end."
    }
