      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "Galbrena. Ready to join the hunt.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Let the gunshots ring.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "I'm here.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "An unusual way to gain strength... thanks.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "...You didn't need to do this just for my power.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "Hah... what now? Trying to make a pact with the \"devil\"?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the \"devil\" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "This blood... let it drip into your palm. There. Now our \"pact\" is sealed.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: I",
      "content": "Galbrena: Fight fire with fire.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Let strength speak!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_atk_atk05_sp_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_atk_atk05_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: II",
      "content": "Galbrena: Tainted hellfire.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Devour them all!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_atk_atk05_sp_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_atk_atk05_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: III",
      "content": "Galbrena: Explode.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: To hell with you!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_atk_atk05_sp_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_atk_atk05_sp_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "More bullets for you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_atk_heavyatk03_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_atk_heavyatk03_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "Let's settle the score.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Lock on.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Devour.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Reap.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Rise from hellfire...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill03_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill03_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Bathe in flames...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill03_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill03_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "The flames roar...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill03_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_skill03_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Galbrena: By my trigger... enter hell's gates!\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Scorched to ash!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst02_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Galbrena: The hunt ends here.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Time to gorge!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst02_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Galbrena: I've come... to send you to your grave.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: A fresh feast!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst02_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: IV",
      "content": "Galbrena: I'll show you...\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: The gates of hell!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst02_04.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_burst_burst02_04"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "You can't escape me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_qte_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "Gotcha.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_qte_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: III",
      "content": "Speak of the devil.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_qte_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_skill_qte_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge: I",
      "content": "You missed.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_limitdodge_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_limitdodge_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge: II",
      "content": "Timing's everything.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_limitdodge_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_limitdodge_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: I",
      "content": "I'll Gal-ve you double.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_parry_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_parry_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: II",
      "content": "Jackpot.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_parry_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_parry_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: III",
      "content": "That's it?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_parry_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_parry_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Galbrena: ...Again.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Pain sharpens your mind.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Recalibrate.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Galbrena: …Just a scratch.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: No time to lick your wounds.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Galbrena: ...Very well.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Your fury begins to stir.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Galbrena: ...Till my last breath!\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: This hunt shall never end!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Galbrena: Through death...\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: ...We will return.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_die_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Galbrena: The flames... never die...\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: We... will not retreat...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_die_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Galbrena: Hunt...\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: ... through eternity.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_die_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Behave now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "In disguise.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Galbrena: Gift-wrapped prey?\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Satisfy my hunger.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_engage.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Handy.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Nowhere to hide.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_scan.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Live to hunt.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Day of reaping.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "The hunter finds their prey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Good. Take them.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_jiabeilina_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Portable Frequency Cassette Recorder - Prototype",
      "content": "An old cassette player Galbrena picked up in Lahai-Roi. With the march of technology, this model has long since been discontinued. Though outdated, it still retains its key function of recording the holder's \"frequency essence.\" For Galbrena, it is both a weapon against the corruption of the Tacet Discords within her and a rare comfort in the long silences between hunts.\n  \nShe has used it to record many of her favorite songs. If you are interested in getting to know her this way, she is more than happy to share \"her songs\" with you.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure119_UI.T_Treasure119_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"Sweet Dreams\"",
      "content": "A handicraft made by Galbrena, woven from her own feathers along with carefully chosen common materials. Each element carries a quiet wish.\n  \nFor Galbrena, a peaceful night's sleep is a rare luxury. She is often disturbed by the Tacet Discords within her, forced to clash with them again and again in dreams within dreams. She once tried to find a way to break free, hoping this crafted item might guard her fleeting moments of rest... But the results were often disappointing.\n  \nYet something changed when she began giving them to children. The craftwork revealed its true power: in their dreams, whenever a \"Nightmare\" struck, a white-clad lady would appear to drive away the monsters, guiding the children out of the darkness and watching over them until dawn.\n  \nChimera explained to Galbrena that the feathers carried her frequency, allowing them to repel \"Nightmare Tacet Discords.\" But against the ones already dwelling within her, they could do nothing.\n \nThe thought brought her a quiet sadness... but also a quiet relief. At the very least, she wasn't destined to only bring fear.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure120_UI.T_Treasure120_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"The First Blood Pact\"",
      "content": "The \"first bullet\" condensed from Galbrena's own blood. Her gift to you.\n \nDuring her travels in the Lawless Zone of the New Federation, Galbrena encountered a secret association and learned a brutal technique known as the Blood Pact. Its practitioners were either fugitives with no path back, or those like her, already bound by darkness. Each had chosen the Way of the Hunter for their own reasons, seeking only to deliver a single, deadly strike at the most unforeseen moment. Galbrena mastered the art quickly. Her results were more extraordinary than most—her blood had long since burned like fire. She was already well accustomed to walking this path.\n \nEvery hunter who swore the Blood Pact carried such a bullet, known as the \"First Blood Pact.\" An old saying among them was, \"The bullet bears your name.\" It was a mark of resolve to hunt their prey to the bitter end. Yet in the Lawless Zone, where allies could turn to enemies in an instant, genuine bonds of trust became precious. From this was born the Rite of Covenant. Though Galbrena herself never performed it, she still remembers its weight and meaning.\n \nWhen a hunter offers their First Blood Pact to another, they carve the recipient's name upon it. The simplest, yet most binding and ancient contract: to become {Male=his;Female=her} bullet. To never betray. To never flee. Not until the blood runs dry and the fire burns to ash.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure121_UI.T_Treasure121_UI"
    }
  ],

    "rarity": 3
  },

      "skill": {
        "name": "Slayer's Trigger",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Basic Attack Stage 1 to 3 DMG are considered as <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>, and Basic Attack Stage 4 DMG as <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Volley of Death</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target and perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Stage 3 DMG is considered as <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 1</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 2 or 3</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage</color></size>\nWhile in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.\nWhile in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets below, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. If Galbrena does not land when interrupted during the barrage, she cannot immediately cast this skill again. Release Normal Attack during the barrage to cast Plunging Attack.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after casting Plunging Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Blood for Blood</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color>.",
        "param": [
          "20%",
          "4"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack to consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack when in mid-air, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nHold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets below, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>",
        "simple_param": [],

        "name": "Edge Transcended",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color></size>\nDash forward and leap into the air. Flip backward upon hitting the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color></size>\nUpon reaching 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>.\nSlash at enemies with her wings, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Upon casting this skill:\n- Galbrena enters <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.\n- <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color> is converted into an equivalent amount of <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color>.\n- Can be followed by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 2</color>.",
        "param": [],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Beyond Threshold",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Threshold State</color></size>\nBy default, Galbrena is in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, and in this state, she accumulates <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Demon Hypostasis</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Dodge Counter - Blood for Blood, and Resonance Skill - Encroach are replaced with Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage, Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge, and Resonance Skill - Ravage, which consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit.\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, every point of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> increases the DMG of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color> by {0}, up to {1}, which is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> depletes or after staying in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> for over 50s, <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> ends automatically.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color></size>\nPerform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. Stage 1 to 3 DMG are considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>, and Stage 4 & 5 DMG <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target and perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. Stage 3 DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 1</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 2</color>. \n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 2 & 3</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color></size>\nWhile in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to consume STA to perform aerial attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit.\nWhile in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. If Galbrena does not land when interrupted during the barrage, she cannot immediately cast this skill again. Release Normal Attack during the barrage to cast Plunging Attack. \n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after the Plunging Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 4</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color></size>\nDash forward and leap into the air. Flip backward upon hitting the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color> share a cooldown.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hellstride</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge on the ground while casting <color=Highlight>Galbrena's own skills</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> to deal a fixed amount of <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from DMG buffs. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> can trigger successful Dodges. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> cannot be cast consecutively.\nCasting this skill does not reset the attack cycles within a short period of time.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Burning Drive</color></size>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Seraphic Execution Basic Attack Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> increases Galbrena's resistance to interruptions and ATK by {2} for {3}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Afterflame</color></size>\nGalbrena can hold up to 40 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, Galbrena recovers 8 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> when Resonators in the nearby team cast Echo Skill. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. This effect resets when Galbrena exits <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.\nAll <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sinflame</color></size>\nGalbrena can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, hitting an enemy with Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Resonance Skill - Encroach, and Intro Skill - Hellflare Overload recovers <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.",
        "param": [
          "1.5%",
          "60%",
          "20%",
          "4"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Threshold State</color></size>\nBy default, Galbrena is in <color=Highlight>Threshold State</color>, and in this state, she accumulates <color=Highlight>Afterflame</color> and <color=Highlight>Sinflame</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Demon Hypostasis</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Demon Hypostasis</color>, Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter, and Resonance Skill are enhanced, which consume <color=Highlight>Purging Flame</color> on hit.\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Demon Hypostasis</color>, the more <color=Highlight>Afterflame</color> Galbrena has, the more DMG enemies take from <color=Highlight>various enhanced moves</color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Purging Flame</color> depletes, Galbrena exits <color=Highlight>Demon Hypostasis</color> automatically.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Mid-air Attack</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack to consume STA to enhance Mid-air Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nHold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Release Normal Attack to cast enhanced Plunging Attack. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color></size>\nCharge forward, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hellstride</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge while in combat action to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nThis skill does not interrupt the hit counter of Basic and Heavy Attack Stages.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Burning Drive</color></size>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color>, <color=Highlight>enhanced Basic Attack Stage 4</color>, and all <color=Highlight>Resonance Skills</color> increases Galbrena's ATK and resistance to interruptions within a certain period of time.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge - Afterflame and Sinflame</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Threshold State</color>, Galbrena recovers <color=Highlight>Afterflame</color> when nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. This effect resets when Galbrena exits <color=Highlight>Demon Hypostasis</color>.\nAll <color=Highlight>Sinflame</color> is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight>Demon Hypostasis</color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Threshold State</color>, hitting an enemy with <color=Highlight>various types of skills</color> recovers <color=Highlight>Sinflame</color>.",
        "simple_param": [],

  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_61_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_61_UI",

    "influence": "Spacetrek Collective",
    "info": "Mornye, a Spacetrek Collective Research Institute engineer and a Department of Exostrider Engineering professor at Startorch Academy.\nEach step on her prosthetic legs carries her toward the stars of her dreams.",
    "talent_name": "Astral Mapping",
    "talent_doc": "[<te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> Senior Researcher Routine Health and Capability Evaluation Report]\nName: Mornye\nAffiliation: Spacetrek Collective - Research Institute and Department of Exostrider Engineering\n \n1. Forte Assessment\n\n1.1 Baseline Classification\nThe subject is classified as a <te href=850070>Natural Resonator</te>, with a <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> located on the lateral aspect of the left thigh.\n1.2 Parameters & Characteristics\n- Effective Range: Approximately 20 meters. Within this radius, the subject demonstrates direct, fine-grained manipulation of mechanical entities with complex internal structures. Precision of manipulation remains stable across the entire effective range, with no observed signal degradation.\n- Activation Prerequisite: Forte initiation requires a complete structural analysis of the target's internal mechanical composition. The Forte cannot be initiated on objects with unknown internal structures.\n \n<i>\"Wait, what is that supposed to mean…? I've never seen Professor Mornye fail to take control of a machine!\"</i>\n \n2. Physical Condition Overview\n\n2.1 Diagnosis\nThe subject presents with congenital hypoplasia of the lumbosacral plexus, resulting in permanent loss of motor function distal to the coccygeal region and an absence of autonomous locomotion capability.\n 2.2 Rehabilitation Status\nThrough a custom neural-interface prosthetic limb system, the subject has achieved full independence in ambulation and daily activity. Functional stability has been maintained for several years. This evaluation constitutes a routine review.",
    "talent_certification": "Waveform analysis of the test sample indicates an elliptical oscillation pattern with a stable Time Domain. While a prolonged tendency toward irregular fluctuations was previously documented, the waveform has since stabilized. Examination results are determined to be within normal parameters. \n \nConclusion: Resonant Criticality is within normal range. Subject stability remains robust. No present risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n \nResonator Mornye has a prior history of Overclocking. Maximum severity rating: Mild. \nThe subject reported inducing a brief episode several years ago to sustain the operation of a critical signal tower. Due to timely medical intervention, no post-Overclocking symptoms were observed.\n \nRoutine physical examinations are advised. Psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Tong Xinzhu",
    "cv_name_jp": "Iwami Manaka",
    "cv_name_ko": "Oh Ro ah",
    "cv_name_en": "Michelle Fox"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "A Thump",
      "content": "Mornye had known from a very young age that she was a burden to others.\n \nHer family, most of the time, treated her with great care. Her mother quit her job to look after her at home, while her father worked long hours to pay for her endless medical bills and examinations. In those early years that still blurred at the edges, her mother would often lift her into her arms, murmur soft words, then lay her gently back onto the small bed that was hers alone. One year, on her birthday, her father even made it home while she was still awake. The three of them sat together to sing a birthday song. They wished her peace, joy, and health as she grew up.\n \nMornye always accepted these moments quietly. She knew her mother believed she couldn't understand what was said or how they felt, and she always caught the sadness that flickered across her mother's face each time she lifted her unresponsive legs. She remembered, too, the tiny, almost imperceptible hesitation whenever they said the word \"health.” But they loved her. She understood that very early on.\n \nThere was only one exception. One night, the sound of an argument jolted her awake. Her father's voice was raised, and her mother sobbed through her words. The unfamiliar threat in the air frightened her so badly that she began to cry. She was certain they heard her, because their shouting paused for a heartbeat, then returned louder, sharper, pitched toward a new kind of despair.\n \nIn that fragile pause, a feeling she had never known took root: she had to stop them herself.\n \nThe wheelchair sat by the bed, just within reach. She clutched the rail on the edge of the bed and began to move. First her chest, that was easy. She could lean forward and close the distance. Then her stomach. She felt her insides clench against the hardwood until a dull pain bloomed, a strange sign that she was making progress. Finally, her legs. She gathered every shred of strength and forced those disobedient limbs to slide over.\n \nAnd then came a thump.\n \nThe argument stopped at once.\n \nSilence flooded the house. The wheelchair lay overturned from the force of her fall. Numb with pain, Mornye pushed herself up with trembling arms. Something warm was trickling down from her temple, sliding over skin that was always cold to the touch.\n \nHer mother rushed in, dropped to her knees, and lifted her. She held her close, tears of exhaustion streaming down her face."
    },
    {
      "title": "Silent Duty",
      "content": "Mornye was always quiet, or so most of her classmates from her hometown believed.\n \nThe bulky wheelchair had isolated her from the careless, chasing play of her peers from a young age. As compensation, she poured her extraordinary energy entirely into her studies, filling every crack of time with endless reading and calculation. Teachers often held her up as a model student, until they themselves began to struggle to keep pace with her mind. Among the students, whispers circulated: her father worked for one of the New Federation's more notorious corporations, and every day after school, a stern attendant would appear to wheel her away with flawless, icy precision. Mornye sat in the chair like a carefully arranged doll, silently compliant.\n \nWhat unsettled her peers even more was her constant refusal of goodwill. Even when teachers instructed the class to look out for her, even when other students approached with generous smiles and asked if she needed help, she would lower her head, letting her bangs veil her eyes, and gently shake her head, silently rejecting everything.\n \nA child's patience is always limited. Once the advantage of being the giver was lost, quiet exclusion grew. Soon, when she wheeled slowly down the hallway, no one approached her. They exchanged glances in silence and parted to give her chair a wide, straight path, like a school of fish dividing in a stream.\n \nMornye had never minded those withdrawn gestures of concern. She clung to academic excellence, her one silent form of gratitude to the world, and knew that if she asked for help, whether out of genuine need or just compliance, someone would inevitably respond.\n \nBut she remembered the weary look in her mother's eyes. And so, she remained silent."
    },
    {
      "title": "Admission Letter",
      "content": "At sixteen, Mornye received an admission letter from <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>.\n \nHer Forte had awakened even earlier, on an otherwise ordinary afternoon, when she realized she no longer needed to push the heavy wheels of her chair by hand. There was nothing particularly thrilling about it, for she had already understood the mechanics perfectly. Making them turn in her mind or in reality made little difference. Her immobilized body was still trapped atop that cumbersome metal frame.\n \nThat night, as she moved herself to bed, she caught sight of the faintly glowing Tacet Mark on her thigh. It felt like a dark joke designed just for her.\n \nBut the admission letter was different.\n \nStartorch Academy was widely known as the premier institution for nurturing talent across <te href=850079>Solaris</te>, and its parent organization, the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>, represented the cutting edge of human technology. That finely printed sheet seemed to tear a crack in Mornye's narrow world, proof that even someone who could not move, even someone with a Forte she herself considered useless, could still be considered \"worthy.\"\n \nCould someone like her truly be one of the morning stars meant to light humanity's future?\n \nShe quickly completed the Preparatory Program, and her Forte was deemed most suited for the Department of Exostrider Engineering. She became the genius whispered about in the halls, the favored apprentice of her mentors, the youngest teaching assistant in the department. Yet it was never enough. She spent countless nights immersed in reports and experiments, often throwing herself into dangerous tasks that pushed her Forte to the edge of Overclocking. One night, light-headed from missing a Nutri-Pack, she wondered—if, just if—her body could one day become a cornerstone of the scientific halls she dreamed of. If so, it would be a satisfying conclusion.\n \n\"It's midnight now. Aren't you going to rest?\"\n \nShe looked up and met a pair of golden eyes.\n \nShe remembered this person. The initiator of her current project, her senior and mentor at Startorch Academy. She had always been drawn to those gold eyes, carrying a vast loneliness that Mornye had yet to understand. They regarded everyone with the same impartial calm, with no trace of the pity she was so accustomed to.\n \n\"If you don't rest,\" that person said, voice even and steady, \"you'll miss the stars.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "The Stars",
      "content": "There were no stars at <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>.\n\nBack then, the Sky Projection Array could only manage the most basic precipitation patterns, and the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>, still in its early exploratory stage, had no spare resources to adorn the unfamiliar underground world with starlight.\n \nBut Mornye hadn't realized that the \"stars\" her mentor spoke of were the ones above the frostlands.\n \nIt happened during an expedition to the frostlands. Normally, no one would have thought to invite Mornye on such a mission, so when her mentor extended a hand toward her, she did not refuse.\n \nShe boarded the Starward Riseway bound for the world above. To her surprise, she was treated no differently from the rest of the team. She sat quietly in the humming vehicle, analyzing in real time the data collected by its roaring machinery. Occasionally, when the transport could go no further or when there was simply something worth seeing, her mentor would lift her onto {Male=his;Female=her} back and carry her through the snow.\n \nWind swept across the plains, cold flakes tearing at warm cheeks. The distance blurred into white, yet something vast and new seemed to unfold before her. At the end of the expedition, they arrived at the wreckage of an old machine. Sitting atop the ruins, they looked up at a sky thick with stars.\n \n\"Do you like the stars?\"\n\nHer mentor's voice broke the quiet. Mornye followed {Male=his;Female=her} gaze, looking up at those fragments that had traveled from light-years away.\n \n\"Seeing the stars makes us curious. They make us ask what else is out there.\" \n\"I think... One day, you'll all prove that the blockage in the sky isn't the end. There will come a day humanity reaches the stars.\" \n\nAh. So that was it.\n\nThe first thing she realized was that she and everyone else were equally small.\nShe, her father, her mother, her classmates back home, and this person next to her. Beneath the boundless night, they were nothing more than dust drifting on a single planet.\n \nThen came the memories she had forced herself to bury.\nThe pain of falling the first time she tried to climb the railing.\nThe cry she choked back when her mother left home. \nThe secretive glances in her old school, the way silently made for her passage.\nThe unsettling calm she felt when she once imagined ending everything herself.\n\nAnd then, a restless yearning surged.\n \nIt was unlike anything she had ever felt, a fierce tide rising so violently it felt like a defiance of something vast and incomprehensible. A cold spark ignited in her silenced chest, tearing apart the quiet she had built to survive her narrow world.\n \nThen the starlight leaned toward her.\n \nTears spilled. Heartbeat thundered. She reached out toward the person beside her, toward the distant light stretching into infinity.\n \n\"I… want to reach that future, too.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "And Then, Another Step",
      "content": "\"Professor Mornye, Cody and Vance are arguing over the Helios test components this time. We probably need you to, um...\"\n \nMornye let out a barely audible sigh. Above her, the modified Starstack hummed steadily, channeling her Forte into the floating keyboard as it replied to emails about the status of the New Solar Ceremony. Her left hand adjusted ignition‑simulation parameters on another floating display, while her right worked through a sequence of elastoplastic calculations. She could manage a dozen streams of work at once, but interpersonal disputes like this would always grind her progress to a halt.\n \nThe quarrel was between two fresh graduates—bright, ambitious, desperate to prove themselves. Mornye had never experienced that kind of youthful fervor firsthand. Still, the scene pulled up memories from her early days at the Research Institute. She remembered the first time she clashed with the board over her proposal to recreate a starry night's sky, and how, after finally gaining approval, a <te href=851070>Void Storm</te> struck. She remembered <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> to keep the signal tower from failing, and, of course, the moment when a falling component smashed into her legs.\n \n...Well, maybe she wasn't so different from these young graduates after all.\n \nBy the time the dispute was settled, the Sky Projection Array had already shifted into night mode. A Hover Cannon delivered her dinner—today's Nutri-Pack came in \"Smoked Steak\" flavor, a new addition from the Agronomy Wing. She twisted the cap open, dimmed the last floating screen, and let her gaze drift to the artificial stars outside the window.\n \nHer mentor had been gone for a long time.\n \nSo much had happened since then. She had graduated and joined the Institute. Her first assignment had been to build a sky above <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>. Her legs, rebuilt over multiple surgeries, now carried her with accustomed ease. And on the day she and her mentor last saw each other, {Male=he;Female=she} said that Lahai‑Roi was ready to continue forward on its own feet.\n \n{Male=He;Female=She} didn't belong to Lahai-Roi. That was when Mornye understood why those golden eyes held everyone at a distance. {Male=He;Female=She} was never meant to stay anywhere for long.\n \nBut that was all right.\n \nBelow, in the test hall, Helios cast silver light in the dark. The New Solar Ceremony—Even her mentor had never imagined this immense undertaking to awaken the Exostrider.\n\n—\"I've found what I want to do now, Mentor. And… I can go further than you ever did.\"\n—\"So when you return someday… will I be ready to stand beside you?\""

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Modified Starstack",
      "content": "A Starstack device, standard issue for all <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> personnel. It's used to monitor students' frequency signals and assess their condition in real time.\n \nMornye, however, modified her device to do much more. It stores and autonomously activates her Forte on command. Now, the Starstack can monitor the status of her prosthetic limbs, reply to work messages, pilot vehicles on autopilot, and even command Hover Cannons to deliver Nutri-Packs—all without interrupting her current train of thought.\n \nIn short, efficiency above all.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure132_UI.T_Treasure132_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Old Student ID",
      "content": "An old student ID from Mornye's days at <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>.\n \nRenowned throughout <te href=850079>Solaris</te>, the Academy stands as the pinnacle of talent cultivation. Before enrollment, she was confined to a wheelchair. Quiet and withdrawn, she spent her days alone in a small room stacked with theoretical papers. Everything changed the day she received Startorch Academy's admission letter. Renowned as a cradle for the exceptional, it offered a new possibility—that her worth would not be measured by the limits of her body, but by the reach of her mind.\n\nThere had to be a wider, brighter world waiting for her.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure133_UI.T_Treasure133_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"Gaze\"",
      "content": "\"Your bangs are so long. Are you sure you can see okay?\"\n \nPrompted by this offhand remark from a senior, Mornye did something rare for herself. She stepped out of the lab and wandered into a marketplace to buy two simple hair clips. They were small and plain, barely strong enough to pin up her heavy bangs. But when she looked in the mirror, an unfamiliar, uneasy feeling stirred within her. It felt like her entire field of vision was now waiting, exposed, for someone's gaze to meet it.\n \nThese days, she has long gotten used to trimming the long strands that once obscured her sight. Yet those two hair clips, stripped of any real function now, still remain tucked in her hair.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure131_UI.T_Treasure131_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Ground State Calibration",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after performing this attack to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to counterattack and deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nWithin a certain time afterward, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3</color>.",

        "name": "Resolution",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Expectation Error</color></size>\nHeal all nearby Resonators in the team and enter the Parry state, during which DMG taken is reduced by 100% for a time. Switching to another Resonator ends this state immediately.\nIf attacked while in the Parry state, exit the state and cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution</color>.\nIf not attacked while in the Parry state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to exit the state and cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Optimal Solution</color></size>\nStagnate nearby targets and deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, reducing the cooldown of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Expectation Error</color> by {0}s.\nSwitching to another Resonator ends the Stagnation effect early.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Distributed Array</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color>.\nHeal all nearby Resonators in the team and summon Hover Cannons to strike the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Mass-Energy Equivalence",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Baseline Mode</color></size>\nWhile in her default <color=Highlight>Baseline Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> reaches {0} points, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color>.\nCast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color> to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Afterward, Mornye jumps into mid-air, consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> and enters <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Wide Field Observation Mode</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> lasts for {11}s.\n- Upon entering <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye generates a <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color>.\n- While in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color>.\n- If <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> is below {0} when holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3</color> in sequence. If <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> reaches {0} during this time, cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> instead.\n- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.\n- When <color=Highlight>Dodging</color> with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.\n- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to {12} times, which resets when <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> are unavailable. If Jump is {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapped PC=pressed Gamepad=pressed} when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. She will leave the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> also when she <color=Highlight>Dodges</color>, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.\nAdditionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Syntony Field</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> lasts for {1}s.\n- When the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> is generated, deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.\n- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>, triggered once every {2}s.\n- Increases the <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Buildup Rate</color> of all nearby Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> by {3}.\n- Enhances the resistance to interruption of nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color></size>\n- When <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> reaches {0} points, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>.\n- Consume all <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.\n- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> upon the target on hit for {4}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Observation Marker</color></size>\nWhen a Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG to a target inflicted with <color=Highlight>Observation Marker</color>, Mornye inflicts an <color=Highlight><te href=120906>Interfered Marker</te></color> on the target for {5}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Interfered Marker</color></size>\nTargets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> take increased DMG from all nearby Resonators in the team. For every {8} of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding {7}, their DMG is increased by {9}, up to {10}.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Visual Field</color></size>\nWhen a Resonator in the team defeats a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=120906>Interfered Marker</te></color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight>Visual Field</color> for {6}s. While in this state, Mornye inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> on the target hit whenever any Resonator in the team deals damage.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet</color></size>\nMornye deals one instance of <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets in the <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> state within range, considered <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Rest Mass Energy</color></size>\nMornye can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Rest Mass Energy</color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120901>Baseline Mode</te></color>, she gains <color=Highlight>Rest Mass Energy</color> when performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution</color> hits a target.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Relative Momentum</color></size>\nMornye can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, she gains <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color> hits the target.\nMornye cannot gain <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>.",
        "param": [
          "100",
          "25",
          "3",
          "50%",
          "30",
          "8",
          "3",
          "100%",
          "1%",
          "0.25%",
          "40%",
          "30",
          "3"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge</color></size>\nMornye gains <color=Highlight>Ground Mode Energy</color> while on the ground, and <color=Highlight>Hovering Mode Energy</color> while in the air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Ground Heavy Attack</color></size>\nWith full <color=Highlight>Ground Mode Energy</color>, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Ground Heavy Attack</color> becomes available.\nConsume all <color=Highlight>Ground Mode Energy</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Enhanced Ground Heavy Attack</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Afterward, enter <color=Highlight>Hovering Mode</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hovering Mode</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hovering Mode</color> lasts for {11}s.\n- Upon entering this mode, generate a <color=Highlight>Field</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Field</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Field</color> lasts for {1}s.\n- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team.\n- Increases the <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Buildup Rate</color> of all nearby Resonators in the team. Increases resistance to interruption of the nearby active Resonators in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>\nWith full <color=Highlight>Hovering Mode Energy</color>, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Mid-air Heavy Attack</color> becomes available.\nConsume all <color=Highlight>Hovering Mode Energy</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Enhanced Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and <color=Highlight>Marking</color> the target for {4}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Marker</color></size>\nUpon dealing <color=Highlight>Tune Break</color> DMG to a <color=Highlight>Marked</color> target, inflict an <color=Highlight>Enhanced Marker</color> on the target for {5}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Marker</color></size>\nAll nearby Resonators in the team deal more DMG to targets affected by <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture - Interfered</color> or <color=Highlight>Tune Strain - Interfered</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Visual Field</color></size>\nWhen a target with <color=Highlight>Marker</color> or <color=Highlight>Enhanced Marker</color> is defeated, within a certain period of time, whenever a Resonator in the team deals damage, Mornye <color=Highlight>Marks</color> the targets hit.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet</color></size>\nMornye deals <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.",

    "talent_doc": "[Retrieved from the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> Archive: <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te> - Student Records]\n[Resonance Ability Assessment Report RA2362-G]\n\nStudent Name: Aemeath\nSynchronist Qualification: Affirmative\nForte Overview: Tests reveal a <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a steady upward trend, converging into a stable oscillatory state. Not sure if that's really part of my Forte or just a perk of my unique Resonance condition... ▇▉▇▇▂▇\n\n<i>\"That's odd... why is this student's file corrupted?     "talent_certification": "Rabelle's Waveform test sample analysis shows an elliptical oscillation pattern and a stable Time Domain. No abnormal fluctuations were observed.   "stories": [
    {
      "title": "On the Frostlands",
      "content": "A snowflake landed on Aemeath's nose, a cold, wet tickle. She stared at the lake for a moment, then decided against playing in the water.\n\nA while back, she had painstakingly hauled a few huge stalks of Foxtail Kelp from the water, pretending they were mighty swords. She and the Snowfluff Seals had the best battles. She was the hero, of course, and they were the villains. Granted, these gentle, docile creatures never put up much of a fight, and Aemeath always won. But that one time, she had gone too far. Pieces of kelp ended up scattered all over the cabin, leaving a dreadful mess. When that person came home and saw it, {Male=he;Female=she} just stood in the doorway, silent for a long, long time.\n\nAemeath got a proper scolding, of course. But afterward, maybe feeling guilty for being too stern, that person soon returned with a stack of game cartridges as both apology and distraction. It worked like a charm. The video games captivated Aemeath and she promptly forgot all about her battles with the seals.\n\nOut of all of the games, her favorite was the Space Fantasy: Katya series. Getting to travel through space and save the universe? Of course! Who wouldn't want to role-play as that unflappable, charismatic, and slightly melancholic hero?\n\nOne day, Aemeath pushed the door open to find that person reading on the sofa. She happily squished in beside {Male=him;Female=her} and held up a controller.\n\n\"Play with me,\" Aemeath's whole posture shouted.\nThat person smiled, booped her nose lightly, and agreed.\n\nOutside, winter stretched on forever. But inside, the fireplace glowed, wrapping the room in warmth and quiet peace.\nAfter playing for a while, Aemeath piped up. \"Let's stop here today. Oh! Guess what? I found a secret room on the right side of the map! The password is 9072. You can play Lahai-Roi Blocks there. It's so fun!\"\n\n\"That's surprising,\" that person said. \"Weren't you in a hurry to finish the quest and save the world just yesterday?\"\n\nAemeath shook her head and laughed. \"I was, but not today. And if we finish the quest, the game ends. I want to play with you longer. You gotta take breaks, even when you're saving the world, right? Can't be all work and no play!\"\n\nA warm hand settled on her head, gently ruffling her hair. After a brief pause, {Male=he;Female=she} said quietly, \"You're right, Aemeath. I'll try.\"\n\n\"Then… let's start now?\"\n\n\"Alright. Starting now.\" That person smiled. \"Honestly, being here with you already feels like a rest. Come on, let's play Lahai-Roi Blocks. You go first.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "The Young Ones",
      "content": "The afternoon the Voidmatter Reverse Engineering grades were released, the usual lunchtime cheer Aemeath and her friends usually had was replaced by gloom.\n\nAlara's vibrant red hair seemed to have lost some of its shine as she let out a weak groan: \"Ugh... the cafeteria food doesn't even taste good anymore!\" Beside her, Nova, diligently working through a bowl of some unidentifiable substance, remarked calmly, \"Yes, girl. The scores do sting. But let's be real, the food here was never that great to begin with.\" Lynn looked utterly crushed by her results, and Celeste gently comforted her. Aemeath, on the other hand, wore a distant, absent-minded expression as she took a sip of her custom-flavored Squeezy Jelly, chatting idly with her fellow <te href=700009>Synchronists</te>.\n\nSuddenly, Alara turned to her.\n\n\"Aemeath! How come you don't seem bothered at all?\"\n\nAemeath blinked. \"Worried about what? ...Oh, the grades, you mean?\" She paused, then waved a hand airily. \"But everyone's scores were basically the same this time. Professor Sakya is just way too strict. It's not like we're actually that bad. Just relax.\" She pulled out a tissue and handed it to their group's biggest crybaby. \"Here, Lynn! Dry your eyes!\"\n\nCeleste handed the tissue over, exchanged a glance with the others, and said softly, \"You really don't seem to care much about your future as a Synchronist.\"\n\nWhat would Aemeath usually do in moments like this? Probably crack a joke, change the topic, laugh it off. But today was that person's birthday, and thoughts of {Male=him;Female=her} filled her mind. For once, she forgot to hide her feelings from her friends.\n\n\"Being a Synchronist... It's just one path,\" she said evenly. \"Someone once told me {Male=he;Female=she} hoped I'd live a happy, carefree life. I think that matters more. My dreams aren't as grand as yours. Isn't it normal for a slacker like me to take it easy?\"\n\n\"Really?\" her friends asked, watching her closely.\nAemeath just smiled back. \"Really.\"\n\nBut that wasn't the truth.\n\nHer real dream was far too heavy, too arrogant, too absurd to be spoken aloud in calm, measured words. It grew larger every day, sinking its roots deep into her heart. Yet she refused to acknowledge it, because she had already accepted that promise. If day after day of simple happiness was enough, then she would remain happy like this forever. She would keep her word. Unless...\n\nHer thoughts were abruptly interrupted as Alara pinched her cheek hard.\n\"Ow! What was that for?\" Aemeath protested, her words muffled.\n\"You little liar,\" her friend grumbled. \"Fine, fine. We'll stop asking... Library this afternoon? Group study session?\"\nAemeath nodded. \"Of course!\"\n\nLaughing and jostling with her friends, Aemeath drifted toward the elevator. They were all still young, in no rush to find answers just yet. In this Academy brimming with prodigies, the future stretched out before them, full of endless possibilities."
    },
    {
      "title": "Only the Unseen Shall See",
      "content": "Aemeath walked up to the mirror, but no reflection appeared.\n\nAfter her death, the world had fallen out of step. Her <te href=700009>Synchronist</te> friends had once debated what made the essence of humanity. Alara said it was love, Nova believed it was memory, Celeste argued that it was the self, and Lynn declared it was faith... \"No,\" Aemeath thought. \"Humanity's essence is frequency.\" Given what she had become, it was the only framework that made sense.\n\nWas it her Resonance with the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te> that had altered her state of being? Her physical body had been torn apart in the simulation cockpit. She should be dead. Yet here she was. She no longer bothered thinking about the essence of existence, though for a digital ghost, she had all the time in the world to contemplate such things.\n\nWhat she understood now was far more important.\n\nWhen she entered the Exostrider's <te href=700010>Reactor Drive</te> hanging in the sky, she saw the message hidden within.\n\n\"So that's how it was,\" she realized. The message had never been read because, from the very beginning, it had been placed where it could not be accessed. Only now, as a Synchronist resonating with the Exostrider, could she see it. The entire underground cavern relied on this \"sun\" for survival, so of course, the people of <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te> had never stood a chance to know.\n\nShould she feel happy? The content of the message gave her the chance to realize her grandest vision, but in a way she had never imagined. A bitter, cosmic joke. Yet this was a task only she could accomplish.\n\n\"If I can help, I will. I have to.\"\n…Yes. That's how it should be.\n\nAemeath thought of that person and quietly cheered herself on. She could be braver. More steadfast. She wasn't ready yet, but that was fine. There was still time to prepare. In that sense, fate had already done her a favor. Lost in thought, she found herself softly humming a tune. It was a pity that Fleet Snowfluff wouldn't be able to release her new song. If she had known what tomorrow would bring, she would have finished it.\n\nThe mirror did not reflect her face, so Aemeath did not see her own smile. It resembled a streak of crayon dragged sideways, its color ending in a sudden, blunt end."
    },
    {
      "title": "What She Fears, What She Dreads",
      "content": "There was nothing but stillness.\n\nAemeath turned and saw it.\n\nIt resembled an eye, yet she knew it was not. A black hole? Maybe that was the closest human concept. But to the one who resonated with the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te>, it was a different order of existence: a \"phenomenon\" of ceaseless, overflowing occurrence. Whatever it engulfed simply ceased to be. The <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> named it Voidmatter. Let it be called that. Beings of a lower dimension needed a term for it, just as humans needed to call that \"eye\" Aleph-1.\n\nThis was not her first time meeting its so-called \"gaze.\" Such encounters were unavoidable in her repeated journeys between Voidspace and the outside world. Over time, she had learned not to react.\n\nUntil not too long ago, its gaze had always affected her. A hollowness. A quiet wish for dissolution. A sense that nothing mattered set against a silent, unanswering universe. These were the aftereffects of staring into Aleph-1 that not even death had freed her from. But now, after exploring the ruins of one of the civilizations it had devoured, she looked into that impossibly vast eye that transcended space and time and heard only her own laughter, thin and verging on hysteria.\n\n\"So this is what {Male=he;Female=she} was searching for?\"\nThe laugh that escaped her was brittle.\n\"This is… the truth?\"\n\nHow absurd.\n\nEvery ideal and vision nurtured since childhood collapsed at once, emptied of all meaning. Aemeath was exhausted. Beneath the fatigue stirred a dull ache, followed closely by something colder.\n\n\"What about {Male=him;Female=her}?\"\n\"Did {Male=he;Female=she} know?\"\n\nIf {Male=he;Female=she} did, Aemeath could not imagine how {Male=he;Female=she} had kept moving forward while carrying this knowledge. And if {Male=he;Female=she} didn't... then this truth could never reach {Male=him;Female=her}. It had to be buried. Shattered. Erased completely. Cold concern settled in her heart, even as it burned with a pure, clarifying rage. For the first time, she understood hatred.\n\nThe illusion of the paper plane she had conjured crumpled in her fist. She let the scraps slip from her fingers and watched them drift away, dissolving into the endless void."
    },
    {
      "title": "Every Unspoken Word",
      "content": ""
    }

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "How did I come up with the name Fleet Snowfluff? Totally random! It just popped into my head while I was registering a domain for my site. But hey, I did go all out on that digital Snowfluff Seal design! My fans even turned it into official merch, and the price on these in the marketplace is through the roof! Crazy how my merch just flies off the shelf, even when I'm long gone.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer01.play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "In the depths of the <te href=851070>Void Storm</te>, sometimes I catch that \"eye\" staring back at me, with all its void and craving for death, senseless and silent. This is the perilous world the students of Startorch long to explore. From one prodigy to the next, they go on their trek for the truth like moths to flames. Do I see myself among them? Haha, how would I know? I'm just a student going through my sentimental phase.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer02.play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "I remember how you used to tell me stories on stormy nights like this, when memories of my parents' disappearance glared awake in me. You'd hold my hand until I fell asleep. The warmth from your palm quieted down my fears. I used to love your stories for their twists and turns, danger and thrills—until it dawned on me they were from your own experiences. And then I told myself, \"I don't want to hear these stories anymore. All I want… is for you to live safe and happy.\"",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer03.play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "When I learned the truth about you, the first thing I felt was anger. The more warmth you showed me, the more my hatred grew toward the things that caused you pain. I was furious, wishing I could cut apart those wretched things like you showed me. It's only been a few decades since I became a ghost, but it's become increasingly difficult to keep the loneliness at bay. To think that... the endless time that flowed through you—You came to this world in solitude, do you intend to depart in that way, too?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer04.play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "I know being a savior isn't as glorious as it sounds. The title is too heavy to bear and only the bigheaded would say otherwise. And I'll walk beside you, down the same path you've always walked, until the tomorrow you longed for finally dawns.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer05.play_favor_word_aimisi_sys_toplayer05"

      "type": 1,

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Game Cartridge",
      "content": "Space Fantasy: Katya VI is an absolute classic among players across <te href=850079>Solaris</te>. Renowned for its immersive RPG experience and refined combat system, the game invites players to step into the journey of a lone hero who recruits a diverse cast of companions to stand against the universe's encroaching evil.\n\nBeyond its epic narrative and battles, Aemeath's personal favorite is an easter-egg mini-game. After clearing the main story, she would often return to it, playing together with her family in their cabin.\n\n<i>\"Haha! Look at me, I'm No. 1 in that block-stacking leaderboard!\"</i>",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure138_UI.T_Treasure138_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Exostrider Figurine",
      "content": "When the hands covering Aemeath's eyes lifted, a small box lay waiting before her.\n\nHer four friends gathered around her, smiling brightly and urging her to open it. Inside rested a miniature <te href=700008>Exostrider</te> figurine. The young <te href=700009>Synchronists</te> chirped excitedly like a flock of little birds as they wished her a happy birthday. They hoped she would become the one to successfully pilot the Exostrider one day, that they would all make it to the true starry sky together. Aemeath's lips parted as if to respond, but in the end, she kept the wish cradled in her heart to herself.\n\nGently, she brushed a finger over the gift. Then she stood and, with a radiant smile, threw her arms around her friends.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure135_UI.T_Treasure135_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Paper Plane",
      "content": "Aemeath sat on the roof of an Academy building, quietly enjoying the breeze.\n\nShe had folded countless paper planes, but she always remembered the very first one from the cabin. Afternoon light streamed through the window, the cold wind and snow held firmly at bay outside. Only the crackle of the hearth fire filled the air, mingling with the hearty aroma of stew simmering for dinner. Beside her, the one she called family deftly folded a plane for her, one meant to fly far. Aemeath looked up and saw {Male=him;Female=her} smiling as {Male=he;Female=she} offered the finished plane to her. \n\nThe scene faded into the haze of memory, leaving only the Academy's landscape before her once more. With a faint smile, Aemeath released her newly-folded paper plane into the wind.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure134_UI.T_Treasure134_UI"
    }
  ],
