      "skill": {
        "name": "Infinity Calibration",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Aemeath</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to charge the attack by consuming STA, release to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged I</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> longer to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color>, dealing higher <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nWhen in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color> charges more quickly. Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color>, or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> ends <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>.\nThis Skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged I</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Aemeath</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.       "skill": {
        "name": "Shared Voyage",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Form Switch</color></size>\nAemeath can switch forms between herself and her Mech. The Mech inherits Aemeath's Stats and unlocks new moves.\nAemeath automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stage 1</color> upon casting <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color>.\nWhile in the Mech form, Aemeath casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> automatically upon casting <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2, 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nSwitch into the Mech form after casting this skill. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2, 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Mech</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\nSwitch into Aemeath after casting this skill. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Mech</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Mech</color></size>\nHold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button to charge by consuming STA, release to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged I</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nHold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button longer to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color>, dealing higher <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nWhen in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color> charges more quickly. Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color>, or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> ends <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>.\nThis Skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged I</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Mech</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Mech</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Form Switch</color></size>\nAemeath can switch forms between herself and her Mech. The Mech inherits Aemeath's Stats and unlocks new moves.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sync Strike</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stage 2, 3 & 4</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sync Strike</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and switching to the other form.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Towards the Daybreak",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Switch into Mech form after casting this skill.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\nCasting this skill grants the following effects:\n- Enter <color=Highlight><te href=121002>Stardust Resonance</te></color> for {0}s.\n- Enter <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> for {1}s.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to perform Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.\nThe next <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> cast within {2}s after casting this skill doesn't consume <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Stardust Resonance</color></size>\nEnhance the effect of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>.\nThis effect ends after <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> is cast {3} times.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color>.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> reaches the limit, enter <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>. <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> is removed when the <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color> state ends.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> when the following conditions are met:\n- Be in the <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> state.\n- <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> reaches the limit.\n- <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> reaches the limit.\nCasting this skill depletes all <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, and ends the <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> state and <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state.\nSwitch back to Aemeath after casting this skill.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.",
        "param": [
          "30",
          "60",
          "30",
          "2"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill and unlock the <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation Finisher</color>.\nCasting this skill sends Aemeath into the <color=Highlight>Enhanced Sync Attack Boost</color> state.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation Finisher</color> is unlocked and <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color> reaches the limit, enter the <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Boost</color> state. In this state, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> charges faster and recovers <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> to the max.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Sync Attack Boost</color></size>\nThe next {0} <color=Highlight>Enhanced Sync Attacks</color> grant the following effects:\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Sync Attack</color> increases the additional instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color> dealt.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Fusion Burst</color> triggered by <color=Highlight>Enhanced Sync Attack</color> is additionally increased against the main target.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation Finisher</color></size>\nWhen both <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color> reach the limit, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation Finisher</color> becomes available, dealing massive <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and switching back to Aemeath form.",
        "simple_param": [
          "2"
        ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "To Sculpt the Silence",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Seraphic Duo</color></size>\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> for {1}s. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Overture</color></size>\nWhen Aemeath is in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Overture</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\nSwitch into the Mech form after casting this skill and exit <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Encore</color></size>\nIn the Mech form, when in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Encore</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\nSwitch back to Aemeath and exit the <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>\n- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> on the target for {4}s, stacking up to {3} times.\n<size=10></size>\n- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> for {7}s, stacking up to {6} times.\nWhile in combat, when the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on targets near the active Resonator reaches {8} stacks, inflict {9} stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>. If the targets have more than {10} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.\n<size=10></size>\nIn <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every {27}s:\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>.\n<size=10></size>\nResonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals {11} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, each time to a random target within range. For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> against the target is increased by {12}. This effect lasts for {28}s. The target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes the <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> stacks on targets if they are inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, and trigger the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the main target by {13}.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Stardust Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:\n- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> additionally deal {14} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.\n- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> on the main target is additionally increased by {15}. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Starburst</color></size>\nActive in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>. Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets within range that are affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Starflux Thrust</color></size>\nWhen in the Mech form and <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color> is more than {16}, use the Utility button to cast <color=Highlight>Starflux Thrust</color> and soar in the air by continuously consuming <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Synchronization Rate</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> is capped at {17} points.\n- Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Mech</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color> recovers <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.\n- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color> and <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color> recovers {18} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.\n- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {19} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.\n- When in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> at the same time, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> recovers {21} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Rate</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color> is capped at {22} points.\n- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> recovers {23} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.\n- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {24} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Starlume Acceleration</color>, casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> additionally recovers {25} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Starflux</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> is capped at {26} points.\n<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> recovers naturally over time.",

        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Synchronization Rate</color></size>\n- Recover <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> when specific skills deal damage or Aemeath casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.\nIf <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> is no less than {0} points, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Sync Attack</color> is available within a short duration after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>\n- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team respond to <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture - Interfered</color>, inflict <color=Highlight>Rupturous Trail</color>.\n- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight>Fusion Burst</color>, inflict <color=Highlight>Fusion Trail</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Sync Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. This DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, deal more instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, each time to a random target within range. The DMG increases with the number of the stacks of <color=Highlight>Rupturous Trail</color> on the target.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, trigger <color=Highlight>Fusion Burst</color> based on the max stack limit of <color=Highlight>Fusion Burst</color> without removing its stacks. The DMG Multiplier against the main target is increased based on the stacks of <color=Highlight>Fusion Trail</color> on the target.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Rate</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Enhanced Sync Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> recover <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "100"
        ],

      "desc": "When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, the required number of stacks to trigger <color=Highlight>Fusion Burst</color> reduces. Aemeath can inflict <color=Highlight>Fusion Burst</color> on the target, and <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet</color> can trigger <color=Highlight>Fusion Burst</color> based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks.",

  "chains": {
    "1": {
      "name": "Gilded Glimmer of the First Dawn",
      "desc": "In <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color> gain {2} Crit. DMG increase and continuously pull in nearby target while charging.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen Aemeath remains in a state that meets all of the following conditions for over {1}s, she enters <color=Highlight>Instant Response - Brilliance</color>:\n- Out of combat;\n- Not performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color>, or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Instant Response: Brilliance</color> inherits all effects of <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> and remains active even when out of the duration of <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</color>. \nWhen in <color=Highlight>Instant Response - Brilliance</color> and not in <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> grants {5} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\nIn <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Aemeath defeats a target affected by <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, she enters <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> for {3}s.\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color>, Aemeath records the highest stack count of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> among the targets defeated.\nHer next skill that directly damages the target immediately inflicts the targets with the recorded stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, up to the current max limit of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>. This ends <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> and Aemeath cannot enter <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> for {4}s.",

        "1",

    "2": {
      "name": "Downy Notes of Snowfluff",
      "desc": "The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Overture</color> is increased by {0}.\nThe DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Encore</color> is increased by {0}.\n<size=10></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when the additional instances <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> hit the same target, the DMG Multiplier of the <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> against this target is increased by {1} for {2}s, stacking up to {3} times.\n<size=10></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, gain the following effects:\n- In the <color=Highlight><te href=121002>Stardust Resonance</te></color> state, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> is further increased to {4} against the main target of the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>.\n- <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> now additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>. Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> removed now provides a {5} DMG Multiplier increase to <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the main target.\n- In combat state, when a target near the active Resonator in the team is defeated, immediately trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> based on the target's current stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>.",

        "15%"

    "3": {
      "name": "Fervor Sightly Burns Bright as New",
      "desc": "Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color>'s DMG Multiplier is increased by {0}.\nResonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color>'s DMG Multiplier is increased by {3}.\n<size=10></size>\nIn <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, Aemeath now inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on nearby targets while casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color>, based on her current Resonance Mode.\n<size=10></size>\nInherent Skill <color=Highlight>Between the Stars</color> is replaced with the following effects:\n<size=10></size>\n- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> or deal <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, Aemeath's Crit. DMG is increased by {1}, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> DMG is now Amplified by {2}.\nResonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.\n<size=10></size>\n- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, Aemeath's Crit. DMG is increased by {1}, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> DMG is now Amplified by {2}.\nResonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.",

      "desc": "When Aemeath defeats a target directly with her skills, <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color> is reset to {0}.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen taking fatal damage, Aemeath is knocked out and turns into <color=Highlight>2D Digital Ghost</color> for {2}s.\nIn the <color=Highlight>2D Digital Ghost</color> state, Aemeath grants Resonators in the team a Shield equal to {1} of her ATK for {3}s. As she exits from the <color=Highlight>2D Digital Ghost</color> state, she revives and recovers {4} of her Max HP and {5} points of Resonance Energy.     "6": {
      "name": "A Zephyr-Kissed Journey to You",
      "desc": "Targets take {0} more Resonance Liberation DMG from Aemeath.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, Aemeath's Tune Rupture DMG can critically hit, with a fixed Crit. Rate of {1}, and fixed Crit. DMG of {2}.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color> and in combat state, Fusion Burst DMG triggered on targets near the active Resonator in the team can critically hit, with a fixed Crit.   "stories": [
    {
      "title": "\"Dogs of War\"",
      "content": "Calcharo \"the Vicious\" was once one of the Exiles in the New Federation's Lawless Zone. He has long mastered all kinds of insidious strategies to survive. Nowadays, he has grown even more ruthless for his mercenary: Poisoning, assassination, bribery, kidnapping, bombs... He'd do whatever he found necessary to get the job done. Rumors of Calcharo's impossible feats circulated endlessly. Some spoke of him staying in the desert for 7 days without water for a planned ambush, others of him donning bombs all over his body during a past negotiation. There were even whispers of him hiring killers to fake his assassination in a scheme to garner trust.\n\nWhile potentially exaggerated, the rumors were not entirely unfathomable to those who knew Calcharo personally. However, the stories became even more outlandish as time passed... \n\n\"He single-handedly stopped a truck at 12; when he turned 15, his Forte made the whole New Federation shudder in fear. He even fought the entire country's cops at 18 and left unscathed...\" \n\n\"His chest is home to the dead spirits, and his forehead bears curses of the gods. Beneath his feet strikes thunder, and out of his eyes shoots flames. His rage will never be quenched until heaven burns down...\" \n\n\"He has been to hell and back, time and time again... He will always come as a lightning, a phantom, and reclaim everything he deserves...\" \n\nThe latest rumors about Calcharo have become one of the go-to topics among the mercenary members when off-duty.\n\nBut the man himself seems unfazed... He's either desensitized already or scheming to capitalize on the rumors.\n\nIn the Lawless Zone, friends can become enemies in an instant—as common as changing air currents. Change is constant, even in the most unexpected places. What once seemed harmful can instantly become a useful tool. It all depends on how we choose to use it.\n\nRumors sow prejudices. Prejudices grow into misconceptions. Misconceptions produce misjudgments.\n\nAnd in a cut-throat game, misjudgment of enemy strength is always a bane."
    },
    {
      "title": "Quid Pro Quo",
      "content": "Calcharo started from scratch but made his reputation in only a few short years. His success stemmed from two factors: One, he was willing to take on dangerous but lucrative jobs others didn't dare to tackle. Two, he had a flexible moral code that allowed him to work with all types of people.\n \nHe took the cash, he did the job. He promised, he delivered.\n \nFrom armed protection to disposal of hazardous materials, he always got the job done flawlessly. But if his clients reneged on their end, they were in for a lifetime of being hunted by Calcharo.\n \nSuch \"impartiality\" earned him fear and acquiescence from other powers in the area.\n \nCalcharo sees business as a mere exchange of values, where no job is too immoral, and no secrets are kept. Every transaction is fair game.\n \nNevertheless, value is not always weighed in terms of money. When faced with desperate, impoverished people begging for help, Calcharo would charge a symbolic fee of one <te href=850104>Shell Credit</te> in his own name. The grateful beneficiaries were unaware that this gift became their binding contract with Calcharo, and favors are never easy to repay.\n\nNever accept a deal that brings no benefits. That's Calcharo's core principle.\n\nThis approach allowed Calcharo to cultivate many eyes and ears among the common folk, creating a formidable intelligence network that spans all walks of life.\n\nVenal, merciless, and vengeful—these are just some of the words others used to describe Calcharo. Yet even his critics admit that his network has prevented much unnecessary bloodshed. No one can be sure if a lady selling street food in an alley is one of Calcharo's informants. Any bully aiming to harm the common people must consider that before acting."
    },
    {
      "title": "Beast Instict",
      "content": "Many Exiles were blocked from finding legitimate work in the New Federation, facing endless discrimination and prejudice.\n\nThey resorted to building camps in the country's outskirts, and the place where they gathered became the \"Lawless Zone\". \n\nTo better survive, Exiles in the Lawless Zone formed various gangs. \n\nBack then, a gang named the \"Underdogs\" quickly rose to fame. \n\nThe first members of the Underdogs were just a bunch of children around the age of 12. As children, they were bullied and ousted, until one fearless boy united them. He observed those who were bullied and invited them to join. With strategic planning and unwavering bravery, the Underdogs gained notoriety among rival gangs.\n\nIn this gang, there was no hierarchy or politics—only a primal need for survival and freedom.\n\nHowever, the members died one after another: murdered by rivaling gangs, betrayed by those they trusted, or trapped by deceitful patrons.\n\nTime showed them no mercy in the Lawless Zone. It was every man for himself.\n\nIn the end, the leader boy decided to take fate into his own hands once again, risking it all in a daring gamble for power.\n\n...\n\nYears later, the New Federation waged war against \"the Underdogs,\" the last gang in the Lawless Zone. In a sudden twist, a new mercenary group known as \"Ghost Hounds\" annexed the \"Underdogs\" overnight and put an end to the chaos. \n\nOnly then did people discover that the mercenary group's leader shared a name with the former head boy of the \"Underdogs.\" \n\nHe had returned in a horrific figure, almost like a ghost. He was surrounded by shadowy thorns, and accompanied by fearsome phantoms. \n\nThis time, he would reach the top of the ladder, and finish what he once failed to accomplish due to naivety, sympathy, and indecisiveness. \n\nBut despite all the time that had passed, he couldn't shake off the memory of that one afternoon. The sun was shining down on them as they established the Underdog in a desolate dump site. \n\nIt was a rare moment of tenderness in his life."
    },
    {
      "title": "Let Sleeping Dogs Lie",
      "content": "\"Always count your ammo, check your weapons, wear your protective gears, and make sure your Terminals are online...\"\n\nThough fully aware of the inherent danger in their profession, Calcharo still finds himself going over safety reminders before missions, or silently observing his team as they take on quests or report back. It's a fatherly instinct he can't shake, always worrying about their well-being despite the inevitable bloodshed.\n\nTo ensure their safety, Calcharo made a set of rules:\n\n\"Team formation is free, but members must be informed and not coerced.\"\n\n\"Job details must be kept secret to external parties.\" \n\n\"Observe local laws and regulations.\" \n\n\"Betrayal is forbidden, punishable by execution.\" \n\n...\n\nBehind the rules lies Calcharo's deep care for his group.\n\nCalcharo has always known that the abyss looks back. Staying in this kill-or-be-killed business is never the best solution.\n\nTherefore, Calcharo decided to keep a low profile and start looking for legal business ventures.\n\nHowever, his caution drew threats as some new rivals attempted to replace Ghost Hounds. In an act of provocation, they severely injured a Ghost Hound recruit, breaking one of the \"unstated rules\" of the underworld.\n\nThe group thought they had gotten away with their actions against Calcharo, but the following day they were wiped out from the surface of the planet. The incident was dismissed as an accidental fire. No one spoke out, though everyone knew the truth.\n\nBarking dogs do not bite, but if you cross the sleeping dog's line, it will be too late to run when it wakes and shows its teeth."
    },
    {
      "title": "Domestication",
      "content": "When in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, you have to do as the Huanglong people do. \n\nBecause of reasons unspecified, Calcharo stumbled upon Jiyan's troops inside the borders of Huanglong.\n\nAs a seasoned mercenary, Calcharo recognized the strategic value of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> and the threats it faced. He then proposed a deal: He would assist the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> in their \"war\" against Tacet Discords, and in return, Jinzhou would collaborate with him.\n\nAfter careful consideration, Jiyan accepted this mutually beneficial deal.\n\nJiyan advised against Calcharo wearing his previous uniform while in Jinzhou city. Instead, he suggested adapting his attire to blend in and potentially stay for a long time due to the situation. \n\nFollowing diplomatic etiquette and for practicality's sake, Calcharo followed Jiyan's advice and adopted Huanglong colloquialisms and attire. While his new combat uniform was functional and flexible, the decorative ribbons and patterns perplexed him. Likewise, the Jinzhou people's unwarranted kindness left him bewildered.\n\nFamiliar with human cruelty, Calcharo could not help but suspect that this was all part of Jiyan's secret plot against him. But Jiyan simply assured him that he'd become used to it.\n\nNow, as the deal progressed, Calcharo has grown comfortable with the culture shock the Huanglong people brought him.\n\nOn the Loong-rising Day, one of the most celebrated festivals in Huanglong, Calcharo sat on a roof alone, watching over this \"defenseless\" city.\n\nPeople danced in costumes of Lions and Loongs. The air was filled with joy and festivity.\n\nDespite having endured countless battles and sacrifices, they still tried to live every day to the fullest.\n\nThese people showed him how grief is not the only way to honor the fallen. Celebrating life is another powerful way to say goodbye.\n\nIt wouldn't be bad to permanently base the Ghost Hounds in this city, Calcharo thought.\n\nThen something unusual interrupted his mulling.\n\nClouds were gathering, and thunder was crackling... Those were the omens of a forming <te href=850078>Tacet Field</te>.\n\nIf he and his people were to eventually go live under the sun one day, then his mission was to dispel the darkness, as much as he could, before that shift eventually happened.\n\nCalcharo unsheathed his blade and walked into the dark night. Behind him, the city's lights glimmered with liveliness and prosperity."
    }

      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "The deaths of our kind are likely to go unnoticed. It's our destiny—fleeting, like dust in the wind. Each of us bears a dog tag with our name and story etched upon it, as a form of legacy... A symbol of our existence, no less than a declaration of it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_story_obj.play_favor_word_kakaluo_story_obj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "In the Underworld, it's all about survival of the fittest. Either you dominate as the apex predator, or you're doomed to be devoured by those above you. It's the brutal law of the land. In a world where might makes right, we must rise to the very top to remain free from others' schemes, and preserve our autonomy.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_story_exp.play_favor_word_kakaluo_story_exp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Jiyan",
      "content": "He's a capable leader. He once recommended me an ancient tome on the art of war from <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, one that I regret not acquiring sooner—it could have saved me some effort. As for the deal between us... *scoff* It was merely an exchange of interests. Nothing more.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_jiyan.play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_jiyan"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Mortefi",
      "content": "Pretentious, arrogant, and self-absorbed... That man epitomizes every trait associated with those snooty New Federation nobles. That said, I cannot deny his talent in crafting Tacetite Weapons. I can arrange a meeting with our trusted arms dealer, if he's interested.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_motefei.play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_motefei"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Aalto",
      "content": "Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_qiushui.play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_qiushui"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Yinlin",
      "content": "Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_yinlin.play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_yinlin"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Verina",
      "content": "I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_weilinai.play_favor_word_kakaluo_about_weilinai"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_birthcele.play_favor_word_kakaluo_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Keep your fangs sharp.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_idle01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_idle02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "...I see my way clear.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_idle03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_introduction.play_favor_word_kakaluo_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "I'll handle your commission, alone.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_get_card.play_favor_word_kakaluo_get_card"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "You should have the payment ready by now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_join_team_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_join_team_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Curious you'd want me to join you in person...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_join_team_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_join_team_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_join_team_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_join_team_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "...Your kindness, I have certainly received. Naturally, I'll work for you in return.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name \"Ghost Hounds\" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "*amused huff* Impressive, you've got a much bigger ambition than I thought. The offer you made is too enticing to ignore... Very well. I will repay you with my unwavering loyalty.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup04.play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "I owe you a debt that cannot be easily repaid. The Ghost Hounds have their stance to maintain, and I cannot make decisions for my people lightly. However, I am willing to accept this \"contract\"... on my own terms. Speak, and your wish will be granted, no questions asked.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup05.play_favor_word_kakaluo_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Sever!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_skill_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Strike!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_skill_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Exterminate!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_skill_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "War spares no one!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_burst_skill_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_burst_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Misery follows!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_burst_skill_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_burst_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Unleash the fangs!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_burst_skill_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_burst_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Liberation: Intro Skill",
      "content": "Let slip the dogs of war!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_qte_sp.play_favor_word_kakaluo_qte_sp"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge",
      "content": "Saw that coming.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_success.play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_success"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: I",
      "content": "Weaklings.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_parry_success_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_parry_success_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: II",
      "content": "Do your worst.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_parry_success_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_parry_success_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: III",
      "content": "Pointless.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_parry_success_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_parry_success_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter: I",
      "content": "Caught you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_attack_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_attack_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter: II",
      "content": "Too slow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_attack_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_attack_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter: III",
      "content": "Now!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_attack_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_attack_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter: IV",
      "content": "Crush.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_burst_attack_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_burst_attack_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter: V",
      "content": "Shred.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_burst_attack_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_burst_attack_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter: VI",
      "content": "No escape.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_burst_attack_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_evasion_parry_burst_attack_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Stay put.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_behit_fly_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_behit_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Caution.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_behit_fly_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_behit_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_behit_fly_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_behit_fly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Stay calm.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_hp70.play_favor_word_kakaluo_hp70"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "The dice is cast.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_hp50.play_favor_word_kakaluo_hp50"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Stand down.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_hp30.play_favor_word_kakaluo_hp30"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Live... no matter what...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_die_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "My day... has come...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_die_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "I can hear the... calling...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_die_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Fight for me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_hx_summon.play_favor_word_kakaluo_hx_summon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "\"All is fair in war.\"",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_hx_change.play_favor_word_kakaluo_hx_change"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Target confirmed.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_qte.play_favor_word_kakaluo_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Who's the prey now?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_enter_battle.play_favor_word_kakaluo_enter_battle"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Keep your eyes open.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_fly.play_favor_word_kakaluo_fly"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_hook.play_favor_word_kakaluo_hook"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Nowhere to hide.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_scan.play_favor_word_kakaluo_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "It's time.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_dash.play_favor_word_kakaluo_dash"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash",
      "content": "Follow me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_fast_run.play_favor_word_kakaluo_fast_run"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_chest_01.play_favor_word_kakaluo_chest_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "I trust you can use it to the full.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_chest_02.play_favor_word_kakaluo_chest_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "...This should come in handy.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kakaluo_chest_03.play_favor_word_kakaluo_chest_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "The Underdog's Nameplate",
      "content": "Calcharo's nameplate from his childhood. It has lost its original color due to rust, all that remains visible are the rusty carvings of a dog. The markings appear to have been crudely drawn by a child.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure6_UI.T_Treasure6_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Military Rations",
      "content": "For Calcharo, it's a life-saving treasure. \nIt's rough, but it's good for the stomach. \nIn the case of extreme hunger, no matter what flavor you eat, it will feel like a heavenly delicacy. \nPungent, braised, spicy... According to him, the canned rations produced in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> are a bit tastier than the ones from other regions.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure12_UI.T_Treasure12_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Broken Fang",
      "content": "A short sword that Calcharo has carried since childhood. \nIt was there when he first rose to fame as the vicious Underdog. \nUnfortunately, it was broken in an unknown encounter. \nCalcharo doesn't like to talk about the battle, but sometimes you can catch him touching the broken blade as a way to remember those who died and a time that has passed.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure0_UI.T_Treasure0_UI"
    }
  ],
  "special_cook": {
    "id": 80001005,
    "name": "Ration Bar",
    "desc": "Reduces Cooldown for Grapple by 30% for a selected Resonator in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.",
    "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconCook/T_IconCook_SP_12_UI.T_IconCook_SP_12_UI",
    "rarity": 3
  },

      "skill": {

        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nCalcharo performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsumes STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",

After <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state ends, Calcharo's next Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill <color=Highlight>\"Necessary Means\"</color>, which deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Intro Skill DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Deathblade Gear</color></size>\n-<color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Hounds Roar</color>.\n-<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> deals increased DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.\n-<color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> deals increased DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: Hounds Roar</color></size>\nCalcharo performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "Calcharo attacks the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and enters the <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state.       "skill": {
        "name": "Hunting Mission",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: \"Mercy\"</color></size>\nWhen Calcharo has {0} \"Cruelty\", his <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>\"Mercy.\"</color>\nWhen casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>\"Mercy\"</color>, Calcharo consumes {1} \"Cruelty\" to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG, and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>\"Cruelty\"</color></size>\nCalcharo can hold up to {2} \"Cruelty.\"\nIn Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state, \"Cruelty\" cannot be acquired.\nWhen Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Extermination Order</color> hits the target, gain {3} \"Cruelty.\"\n<size=10> </size>\n<color=Title>Heavy Attack: \"Death Messenger\"</color>\nWhen Calcharo has {4} \"Killing Intent\", his <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>\"Death Messenger.\"</color>\nWhen casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>\"Death Messenger,\"</color> Calcharo consumes {5} \"Killing Intent\" to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG, and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>\"Killing Intent\"</color></size>\nIn Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state, Calcharo's Forte Gauge is replaced with \"Killing Intent\", stacking up to {6}.\nWhen Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Hounds Roar</color> hits the target, Calcharo gains 1 \"Killing Intent.\"",
        "param": [
          "3",
          "3",
          "3",
          "1",
          "5",
          "5",
          "5"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Mercy</color></size>\nWhen Calcharo has {0} Cruelty, his <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> becomes Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Mercy</color>.\nWhen casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Mercy</color>, Calcharo consumes {1} Cruelty to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Cruelty</color></size>\nCalcharo can hold up to {2} Cruelty.\nCalcharo gains Cruelty through <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.\nCruelty cannot be gained in the Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state. \n<size=10></size>\n<color=Title>Heavy Attack: Death Messenger</color>\nWhen Calcharo has {4} Killing Intent, his <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> becomes Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Death Messenger</color>.\nWhen casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Death Messenger</color>, Calcharo consumes {5} Killing Intent to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Killing Intent</color></size>\nIn the Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Deathblade Gear</color> state, Calcharo's Forte Gauge becomes Killing Intent, stacking up to {6}.\nCalcharo gains Killing Intent through Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Hounds Roar</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "3",

          "1",
          "5",
          "5",
          "5"
        ],

    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2917-G]\n\nResonator Yinlin's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on the exterior side of her left thigh.
