  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Scarlet in the Shadows",
      "content": "The <te href=850087>Patrollers</te>, dressed in a unified uniform, are well-known among the residents of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. Their duty involves upholding law and order while ensuring the safety of individuals and their possessions.\n\nHowever, there are also select Patrollers who are not able to don uniforms. They are not permitted to easily disclose their identities.\n\nThese individuals, known as Secret Agents, work covertly to infiltrate criminal organizations, gather proof of criminal activities, or prevent unlawful behaviors, all while maintaining their anonymity.\n\nInstead of dealing with minor theft, they frequently confront dangerous and malevolent criminals, and if their identities are exposed, it often leads to failed missions or even loss of life.\n\n...\n\n\"Who in their right mind would want to be a Secret Agent?\" the Exile Leader exclaimed, punctuating his words with a sharp stab of a dagger into the broken table. Everyone around burst into raucous laughter in the dim warehouse. \n\n\"Any moles from the Patrollers here? Speak up now and I'll save myself a seat at the celebration party.\" \n\nThe group laughed again, though they couldn't help stealing a couple glances at each other.\n\n\"According to our intel, a convoy will depart from Jinchou tonight with valuable cargo. Thanks to the rumors we spread, the shipper didn't work with <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>.\"\n\n\"Great job, Ming,\" the leader patted his sleazy-looking companion on the shoulder, who smirked in response.\n\n\"Still, he hired a group of Resonators as bodyguards…\"\n\n\"Don't worry about it. Hey newcomer, your turn is coming up soon.\"\n\nThe leader turned his attention to a corner, where a woman with striking scarlett hair and a subtle grin on her face sat.\n\n\"Boss... I've been meaning to ask, can this chick really hold her own in a fight? I'd hate for our crew to get taken down by someone who looks like they couldn't even beat me.\"\n\nMing's lips curled into a sly grin as he reached for the woman's arm. But just as his fingers were about to touch her smooth skin, he suddenly froze.\n\n\"W-What's happening? You wretched woman! What have you done to me?\" \n\nThe Exile Boss scowled and waved his hand in frustration, noticing the glowing threads of lightning enveloping Ming.\n\n\"Leave him be, for my sake. All he has left is his sharp tongue. Save your games for later.\"\n\nThe woman calmly brushed her hair and the threads of lightning disappeared from Ming's body.\n\n\"Alright, let's get this show on the road. Come on boys, it's time to make it big!\"\n\n...\n\nSome time later…\n\nMing lay on the ground, powerless and stunned as the convoy they were supposed to attack passed by in the distance. Memories of the events from earlier that day flooded his mind.\n\n(It's the same paralyzing feeling… That woman! She's the mole!)\n\nAs he struggled to get up and warn his team, he saw a horrifying puppet looming over him, causing him to let out a blood-curdling scream. \n\nBefore he could even process what was happening, a sudden flash of lightning drowned out his cries."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Puppet Show",
      "content": "In the bustling city of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, a tall man in a hooded cloak walked through the crowded streets with a young boy in tow. They appeared to be a father and son enjoying a holiday outing, but observant onlookers could sense the fear hidden behind the boy’s facade.\n\n\"Yes, his beloved grandson is now in our hands... Once we send him out of Jinzhou, no one will find him.\"\n\nThe man stared at the little boy beside him as he talked through the contact, signaling him not to mess around.\n\nWith this boy and his grandpa around, even the <te href=850087>Patrollers</te> in Jinzhou gotta watch out for us a bit... Let’s get in touch after I leave the city.\"\n\nAs they approached the city gate with lax security, it was clear that the child’s grandpa had not reported the kidnapping — likely because he was also an outlaw himself.\n\nThe cloaked man hurried through many alleyways, but had to stop abruptly when he bumped into something.\n\nA woman dressed in vibrant attire with long scarlet hair, was performing a puppet show. Her captivating act drew a crowd of children and their parents. The flying puppets seemed so lifelike that all the children couldn’t take their eyes off them, including the young boy in his grasp.\n\nThe puppet show drew in a large crowd of children, making it difficult for him to maneuver through. But he didn’t have to rush, as the performance was coming to an end. \n\nAs expected, the woman with crimson hair took an elegant bow, amidst thundering applause and her puppet waving goodbye. Taking advantage of the break, he motioned for the boy to follow as they slipped through the bustling crowd.\n\n\"Alright everyone, who wants to join me for the next show? Raise your hand!\"\n\nSuddenly, the red-headed puppeteer asked with a dazzling smile, scanning the children in the audience. Almost all hands shot up in excitement.\n\n\"Yes, you in the back with your father. Come on down!\"\n\nAll eyes turned to the little boy with his hooded \"father\", both surprised to be chosen.\n\n\"Me...? Is she pointing at me?\"\n\nThe little boy looked up at the man with a mixture of excitement and fear. After some hesitation, the man made their way to the front. \n\n\"I’m sorry, but we’re in a hurry...\"\n\n\"It’s alright, it will be done soon... Will you join us too, mister?\"\n\n\"Me...? I’ll pass...\" The man instinctively refused, but he failed to notice how the little boy had already wriggled free from his grasp.\n\nHe went to grab the boy, but only grabbed a weird puppet instead. In that instant, a strong electric current knocked him unconscious.\n\n...\n\n...\n\n\"Boss! Bad news!\" \n\nA rough-looking man burst into the old mansion, shouting loudly.\n\n\"Idiot! Can’t you see I’m already annoyed?\"\n\nStartled, the elder man in the center of the hall scolded him for his rudeness. Stressed and worried about his kidnapped grandson, he lost his usual calm demeanor and angrily threw his teacup at the intruder in frustration.\n\n\"It’s that woman, that redhead woman returned... She had come back with our young master!\"\n\n\"What?\"\n\nBefore the old man could fully comprehend, the woman in question walked inside, accompanied by a young boy — his kidnapped grandson. She was none other than the puppeteer who had just performed in the alleyway.\n\n\"Grandpa!\"\n\nAt the sight of the old man, the boy burst into tears and ran towards him, seeking refuge in his embrace. The old man was both surprised and delighted.\n\n\"Oh, my sweet child...! Are you hurt? How did you make it?\"\n\nThe boy shook his head to indicate that he was not hurt, and then pointed to the red-haired woman not far away.\n\n\"This lady brought me back from the bad guys!\"\n\n\"Why are you here? A spy for the Patrollers, yet you want to help me?\"\n\nThe redhead woman only gestured to her puppet, which revealed a hooded man, captured.\n\n\"I’m only after them, they happen to be your enemy. I’m just using you,\" she said nonchalantly. \"But your grandson is innocent.\"\n\nShe scanned the crowd of gangsters filling the hall, a sly smile playing on her lips.\n\n\"Or do you really believe you can thwart me, the infamous mole, with your little crew?\"\n\nThe old man closed his eyes and sighed, signaling for his men to lower their weapons.\n\n\"Get out of here and don’t show your face again.\"\n\nWith graceful poise, the woman exited. The old man sighed once more and let out a bitter laugh.\n\n\"Grandpa, what are you laughing about?\"\n\n\"She's always in and out as if she knew I won't stop her, talking about we aren't the target 'yet'... Sounds like I'm never off the hook.\"\n\nAs he gazed at his grandson’s cherubic face, the old man silently lost himself in thoughts."
    },
    {
      "title": "Names Born From Ashes",
      "content": "\"I regret to inform you that 'Sparrow' and 'Canary' have been confirmed deceased. Their identities were compromised and the criminal organization took swift action.\"\n\"That can't be true! How could they...\"\nThe young man's anger caused him to knock over a bottle, startling the baby in the cradle. He quickly scooped her up.\n\"Speaking of which, they left behind a child who is also a Resonator. This could complicate matters... It seems she will be in your care from now on. But since you're currently suspended from work, you'll have plenty of time for her.\"\n\"I will take care of her. It's none of your business to worry about.\"\n\"Your mentor was investigating something before. Do you know about it?\"\n\"I don't have any information about that...\"\nThe young man knew the real question was about the mole in the Public Security Bureau, who might just be behind this dubious meeting tonight... He couldn't afford to say a single word.\n\"Our investigators will come to this house tomorrow for further investigation. Please cooperate.\"\nHe couldn't stop them, especially with a baby in tow.\n\"Tomorrow then. I'll pack tonight and find a new place to move to. Is that okay?\"\n\"Of course, feel free to use this opportunity for a fresh start.\"\nThe young man pretended to pack while secretly noticing the suspicious glint in the <te href=850087>Patroller</te>'s eyes.\n...\n...\nAmidst the roaring flames, a young man held tightly to the baby in his arms. The child remained calm, gazing blankly as people rushed past them.\nAs a stranger approached, the young man lowered his hood and hid the baby deeper into his coat. \nFailing to notice him, the stranger passed by and disappeared into the shadows to make a report. \n\"It's done,\" the stranger said. \nThe young man smirked, knowing this was all part of their plan. \nHe had created puppets of himself and the baby using his Forte, fooling their enemies into thinking they were sound asleep. With this deception, they could escape through a hidden passage and disappear from their pursuers' reach. It was the only way to ensure their safety and protect the secrets hidden in his mentor's former home.\nFrom that day forward, he and the baby girl in his arms would no longer be known by their former names. They would adopt new identities: new faces, new names.\nSilently, he took out an ugly mask from his pocket and put it on his face. Then, shielding the child's eyes with his hand, they slipped away from the raging flames and vanished into the night without looking back.\n\"From this moment on... I will go by 'Dollmaker', and you shall answer to 'Yinlin' - a name your parents had long chosen for you.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Farewell to the Past",
      "content": "\"Master Dollmaker, I want to join the Public Security Bureau,\" Yinlin declared. \n\nHer words were met with little surprise from Dollmaker, but the elderly woman beside him wore a worried expression. \"Miss Yinlin, you are like my own granddaughter. I don't want to see you put yourself in danger. The Public Security Bureau is not a place for us.\"\n\n\"Don't worry, no one knows who I really am. To them, I'm just an ordinary citizen. Master Dollmaker will create a fake identity for me.\"\n\n\"Maybe, but I don't want to lose my family again... Please stay here at the Séance Society. Don't go anywhere else.\"\n\nThe Dollmaker shut his notebook and gestured for Lady Guan to halt. \"Go for it, Yinlin. My research has reached a critical point and conflicts with the <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> Public Security Bureau are inevitable. To have insiders among their high-ranking officials should prove beneficial to us all.\"\n\n\"No, I want to become a Secret Agent... just like my parents. I want to carry on their ideals in this way.\" \n\nShe couldn't see behind the Dollmaker's mask, which he never removed in her presence since as far back as she could remember. But she caught a glimpse of complex emotions shimmering in his eyes — something rare and elusive.\n\nAfter a long pause, he finally nodded. \"Before I bring your parents back with the puppets, you have the freedom to do whatever you please... Once my plan succeeds, we will seek revenge on the Public Security Bureau and eliminate all those who betrayed them in one swift strike!\"\n\nYinlin tried to say something but Dollmaker had already turned his attention back to the puppet he was working on. In the end, she silently nodded before turning and leaving, knowing that they were now going their separate ways."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Corner in Darkness",
      "content": "Grimacing through the pain in her side, Yinlin struggled to stand up using a nearby table for support.\n\nA figure emerged from the shadows, yanking out the sharp blades of a puppet embedded in his body and carelessly tossing them aside.\n\n\"I don't know why you risked everything to infiltrate our organization just for some records on two dead <te href=850087>Patrollers</te>... But it appears that I have emerged victorious,\" he taunted.\n\nWith great effort, Yinlin summoned a crackling whip of lightning to her fingertips and hurled it at the man, but her aim faltered due to the excruciating pain and it landed several meters away on the ground.\n\n\"My Forte can induce arrhythmia. As long as you're a human, there's no way you can avoid it.\"\n\nAs the <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> on the man's arm emitted another bright light, Yinlin lost her hold and collapsed to the ground, her body losing all strength.\n\n\"We don't have Resonators on your level on our team yet,\" the man continued. \"But we do have spies among the Patrollers. Hmm, how did you even...?\"\n\nAs he continued to speak, realization dawned on him and a smirk spread across his face. \n\n\"Aha, you're a Secret Agent, aren't you? How foolish to risk your life for something this trivial. Even if you were to uncover our secrets, what difference would it make?\"\n\nAs Yinlin's breathing grew fainter, the man knew her heart had stopped beating.\n\n\"Time to finish you off. What a pity. You should have known not to mess with the Fractsidus...\"\n\nBut just as his dagger was about to strike, a sudden surge of powerful lightning ran through it, paralyzing him in place.\n\n\"How... How did you...\"\n\nBefore he could pass out, he caught a glimpse of flickering lightning within Yinlin's chest. She had given herself an electric shock to bring her heart back from the brink of death.\n\nYinlin manipulated her puppet, \"Zapstring,\" with flicks of her hands to advance on the man as she was too drained to move herself. From his pockets, she retrieved a set of documents.\n\n\"The Fractsidus... It's time to uproot this hidden darkness.\""
    }
  ],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "Perhaps you haven't noticed, but you seem to always draw in some... rather interesting people. Not sure if it's a blessing or a curse for you, but it certainly makes my job easier... *chuckle* After all, my targets are usually the more peculiar types.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player01.play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "Contrary to what you may believe, many crimes are motivated by love and responsibility. Ironic, isn't it? The two fundamental values of human society can also lead to its downfall. When love becomes all-consuming and responsibility turns into obsession, crimes find fertile ground to thrive.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player02.play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "I've seen what you're capable of, so I'm not worried about you in a fair fight. That being said, not everyone plays fair. Just watch your back out there... wouldn't want you to get caught off your game.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player03.play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "The Fractsidus... You've dealt with them before, correct? Though we still don't know their origins or motives, I do know one thing from experience—criminals are most dangerous when we don't understand their intentions. You may run into them again anytime, so stay vigilant.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player04.play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "Being a secret agent means constantly adapting to new identities. When the situation calls for it, I'm ready to shed any of my current personas and slip into a new one. But with you, perhaps I can just be myself, Yinlin... and no one else. It doesn't feel awful... to have someone who knows and remembers me for who I truly am.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player05.play_favor_word_yinlin_to_player05"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Yinlin's Hobby",
      "content": "Speaking of the puppet show... It's an old tradition in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, though not as popular here as in other places. Dollmaker taught me the tricks to help me manipulate my own puppet better. More importantly, it's a useful way to hide in plain sight while performing. I can teach you a move or two, if you're interested.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_taste.play_favor_word_yinlin_taste"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Yinlin's Trouble",
      "content": "Lately, it seems I've been \"running into\" you a lot lately... Just a heads up, I like to stay under the radar, and being seen with someone as high profile as you tends to attract unwanted attention... *pause, sigh* Not that I don't want to see you, but you'll need to be more subtle than that.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_worry.play_favor_word_yinlin_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "I've tried many so-called delicacies through my job, but none has left a lasting impression like the plate of Aureate Fried Rice I once had. I believe it's not the fancy ingredients that make a dish truly special, but the skill and care put into its preparation.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_food_favor.play_favor_word_yinlin_food_favor"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "Dining with a target requires always catering to their taste. When the food is subpar, I know how to choke it down with a grin. That's why there isn't any dishes I truly dislike... It's not the food that ruins a meal, but the company. With you by my side, I suppose I'd be pleased to eat anything.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_food_hate.play_favor_word_yinlin_food_hate"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "A utopia free of all vices and crimes may sound tempting, but once you think about it, it is nothing more than a naïve dream. That's why we exist—to uncover the hidden and unapproachable darkness that the majority refuse to acknowledge, and do the dirty work in their place.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_dream.play_favor_word_yinlin_dream"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "This puppet? I call it Zapstring. It used to be a basic puppet made by some novice, but I've revamped it for battle. It hasn't let me down yet, despite its wear and tear.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_story_obj.play_favor_word_yinlin_story_obj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "Members of the Séance Society were lured in by Dollmaker's false promises, but they too must bear responsibility for what had transpired. I can only hope that upon their release, they will break from the illusions of the past... Despite the loss of loved ones, life must continue.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_story_exp.play_favor_word_yinlin_story_exp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Chixia",
      "content": "I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the <te href=850087>Patroller</te> position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_about_chixia.play_favor_word_yinlin_about_chixia"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Rover",
      "content": "Being skilled as a <te href=850087>Patroller</te> doesn't necessarily make one suited for undercover work, but curiously enough I see potential in you. Have you considered applying to the Bureau? Just kidding, unless you're interested.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_about_zhujue.play_favor_word_yinlin_about_zhujue"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "Happy birthday... What's with that look? Come on, I promise it's really your special day. And no, I'm not playing any games this time. Oh well. I can already tell you have nothing planned, so... Will you let me have you all to myself, for the entire day?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_birthcele.play_favor_word_yinlin_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Hehe...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_idle01.play_favor_word_yinlin_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_idle02.play_favor_word_yinlin_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "Hmph... You done staring?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_idle03.play_favor_word_yinlin_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_introduction.play_favor_word_yinlin_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "What's that look on your face? Surprised to see me?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_get_card.play_favor_word_yinlin_get_card"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "Anything you need me to deal with?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_join_team_01.play_favor_word_yinlin_join_team_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "So we're teaming up? Fine, though I'm more used to fighting alone.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_join_team_02.play_favor_word_yinlin_join_team_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "My turn already?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_join_team_03.play_favor_word_yinlin_join_team_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup01.play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup02.play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "I have finer control over Zapstring now. It's all credit to you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup03.play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "I will make good use of this power and fight by your side... We'll confront evil, wherever it lies.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup04.play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "This special power you have entrusted me... Should I take it as a sign of trust in my abilities? Or...perhaps a token of affection for me? Either way, I appreciate the gesture. Your straightforwardness is quite endearing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup05.play_favor_word_yinlin_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "Cleave it!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_01.play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "Begone!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_02.play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: III",
      "content": "Back off!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_03.play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: IV",
      "content": "*huff* Think you've got the permission?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_04.play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_04"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: V",
      "content": "You're not getting away.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_05.play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: VI",
      "content": "Hmph... Now you'll behave.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_06.play_favor_word_yinlin_heavyatk_06"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack",
      "content": "What are you looking at!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_airatk.play_favor_word_yinlin_airatk"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Zapstring... the stage is yours.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_01.play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "No mercy.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_02.play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Watch and learn!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_03.play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Crush them!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_04.play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_04"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Your time is over!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_05.play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Don't blink!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_06.play_favor_word_yinlin_skill_06"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Time to wrap it up.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_burst_skill_01.play_favor_word_yinlin_burst_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "I've had enough. Get lost.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_burst_skill_02.play_favor_word_yinlin_burst_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Zapstring, it's our curtain call!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_burst_skill_03.play_favor_word_yinlin_burst_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Tsk... Such nerve.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_behit_fly_01.play_favor_word_yinlin_behit_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "'s nothing...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_behit_fly_02.play_favor_word_yinlin_behit_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "You'll pay for this...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_behit_fly_03.play_favor_word_yinlin_behit_fly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "I'll pay it back tenfold.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_hp70.play_favor_word_yinlin_hp70"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "You won't cast me down...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_hp50.play_favor_word_yinlin_hp50"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "*grunt*... I can keep going!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_hp30.play_favor_word_yinlin_hp30"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "A temporary... setback...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_die_01.play_favor_word_yinlin_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "My oversight...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_die_02.play_favor_word_yinlin_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Obedience... is for weaklings...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_die_03.play_favor_word_yinlin_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Obey me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_hx_summon.play_favor_word_yinlin_hx_summon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "My field of expertise.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_hx_change.play_favor_word_yinlin_hx_change"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Tear them to pieces.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_qte_02.play_favor_word_yinlin_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Zapstring, our turn.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_enter_battle.play_favor_word_yinlin_enter_battle"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Where's the destination?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_fly.play_favor_word_yinlin_fly"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_hook.play_favor_word_yinlin_hook"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "*huff* Found it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_scan.play_favor_word_yinlin_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Good. There's no time to waste.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_dash.play_favor_word_yinlin_dash"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_fast_run.play_favor_word_yinlin_fast_run"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Not bad. Found any keepers?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_chest_01.play_favor_word_yinlin_chest_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "All yours. You're welcome.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_chest_02.play_favor_word_yinlin_chest_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yinlin_chest_03.play_favor_word_yinlin_chest_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Zapstring the Puppet",
      "content": "Once a simple puppet, now a fierce weapon thanks to Yinlin's Resonance abilities. She may deny it, but her love for the doll is evident in every detail, despite its wear and tear from years of battle. It was once just a practice piece for a doll maker, but now it serves as Yinlin's trusted ally on the battlefield.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure4_UI.T_Treasure4_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Book on Qipao",
      "content": "Yinlin's qipao may seem to be merely a fashion choice, but it actually serves as a secret codebook for communicating with her liaison. This book on qipao designs is constantly changing and filled with encrypted images and symbols, making it challenging even for experienced liaisons to use. In addition to its hidden equipment and weapons, the qipao also helps Yinlin move around undetected, but its distinctive appearance can sometimes draw unwanted attention.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure27_UI.T_Treasure27_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Magnifying Glass",
      "content": "This Investigative Magnifying Glass is given to new <te href=850087>Patroller</te>s by the Public Security Bureau. It's small but powerful, helping them find hidden clues. Yinlin, as a secret agent, doesn't use it often. But it still holds significance for her: It is a tribute to her late parents and a reminder of her true identity.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure44_UI.T_Treasure44_UI"
    }
  ],

    "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconCook/T_IconCook_SP_11_UI.T_IconCook_SP_11_UI",
    "rarity": 3
  },

      "skill": {
        "name": "Zapstring's Dance",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nYinlin controls the puppet \"Zapstring\" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nYinlin consumes STA to control \"Zapstring\", dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nYinlin consumes STA to control \"Zapstring\" to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Magnetic Roar",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Magnetic Roar</color></size>\nThe puppet \"Zapstring\" deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, and puts Yinlin in Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Execution Mode</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Execution Mode</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> will trigger 1 <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color> when hitting a target.\nEach stage of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> can only trigger 1 <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color>, up to 4 times.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Electromagnetic Blast</color></size>\nAttack all targets marked with Forte Circuit <color=Highlight><te href=850029>Sinner's Mark</te></color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lightning Execution</color></size>\nUse Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Magnetic Roar</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\nIf Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color> is not activated in a while or this Character is switched, this Skill will be put on Cooldown.",
        "param": [
          "8"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Magnetic Roar</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, and put Yinlin in <color=Highlight>Execution Mode</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Execution Mode</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> will trigger <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color> when hitting a target.\n<color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color> can be triggered up to 4 times.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Electromagnetic Blast</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to all targets marked with <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lightning Execution</color></size>\nUse Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Magnetic Roar</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "8"
        ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Chameleon Cipher",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Chameleon Cipher</color></size>\nWhen Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chameleon Cipher</color>, which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. When it hits a target marked with <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color>, the <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color>, lasting for {0}s. <color=Highlight>Chameleon Cipher</color> deals Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sinner's Mark</color></size>\nBasic Attack <color=Highlight>Zapstring's Dance</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Thundering Wrath</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Roaring Storm</color> apply <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> to the target on hit.\n<color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> is removed when Yinlin is switched out.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Punishment Mark</color></size>\nWhen a target marked with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color> takes damage, <color=Highlight>Judgement Strike</color> will fall, triggering Coordinated Attacks to all targets marked with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. This can be triggered up to 1 time per second. <color=Highlight>Judgement Strike</color> deals Resonance Skill DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Judgment Points</color></size>\nYinlin can hold up to {1} Judgement Points. Yinlin gains Judgement Points through the following ways:\nUpon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Raging Storm</color>\nWhen Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Zapstring's Dance</color> hits a target\nUpon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Magnetic Roar</color>;\nWhen Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color> hits a target;\nUpon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color>.",
        "param": [
          "18",
          "100"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Chameleon Cipher</color></size>\nWhen Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Chameleon Cipher</color>, which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the targets, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. It replaces the <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> on the targets with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sinner's Mark</color></size>\nNormal Attack <color=Highlight>Zapstring's Dance</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Thundering Wrath</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Raging Storm</color> will apply <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> on hit.\n<color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> is removed when Yinlin leaves the field.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Punishment Mark</color></size>\nTargets marked with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color> will take additional <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> when hit.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Judgment Points</color></size>\nYinlin can hold up to {1} Judgement Points.\nYinlin gains Judgement Point through <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "18",
          "100"
        ],

  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_15_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_15_UI",

    "info": "Yuanwu owns a boxing gym where he teaches <te href=850114>Leihuangquan</te> and health management. He is well-respected in the community for his cordial demeanor and pleasant temperament.",
    "talent_name": "Fist of Thunder",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1425-G]\n\nThe exact time of Resonator Yuanwu's Awakening is unclear. Resonator Yuanwu recounted that he was exposed to powerful electrical energy for extended times before his Awakening.\n\nResonator Yuanwu's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on the right side of his neck. After his Awakening, blue crystal-like structures appeared on his front limbs, with scar-like tissue visible on his hands and wrists. These changes have since stabilized.\n\nResonator Yuanwu has extraordinary control over the frequency fluctuations of his body. He can engineer the amplitude and range of his frequencies in an instant, seemingly without doing any harm to himself. Tests have concluded that he is 82.58% more proficient in manipulating frequencies than the average Resonator.\n\nThe Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Yuanwu has been observed to align closely with that of thunder. A strong Syntony reaction has been observed, yet the cause of Yuanwu's Awakening remains unclear.\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a gradual rise. Resonator Yuanwu is thereby classified as a <te href=850070>Natural Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Yuanwu's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. Pattern of the Time Domain appears stable with no abnormal waveforms observed.\n\nResonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Yuanwu's frequency displays high stability with minimal risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n\nPrevious records indicate no history of Overclocking; however, in Resonator Yuanwu's adolescence, during the earliest recorded use of his Resonance Ability, there was a near Overclocking event that produced violent frequency fluctuations and uncontrolled behavior. The incident was classified as a Class 2 hazard and archived under code EX42978.\n\nSubsequent examinations revealed that this episode was caused by emotional distress. No aftereffect of Overclocking was noted.\n\nPresently, Resonator Yuanwu's psychological state is deemed stable and healthy. Routine examinations are advised to prevent future incidents of Overclocking.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Liu BeiChen",
    "cv_name_jp": "Shirokuma Hiroshi",
    "cv_name_ko": "Park Sung Tae",
    "cv_name_en": "Adam Diggle"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Popular Boxing Gym",
      "content": "Yuanwu maintains a simple daily routine. Every day in the early morning, he opens up his gym and proceeds to clean the pieces of training equipment one by one. Then he boils a pot of tea and greets customers while savoring it.\n\nFor those seeking to learn martial arts, Yuanwu assesses their physique and current condition before suggesting a suitable style. The intensity of training can be tailored to individual preferences, whether for physical fitness or making a name in the martial arts world. Every customer is heard attentively, with Yuanwu patiently crafting a personalized practice plan for their goals. Even those who enter without a clear purpose are welcomed with warm hospitality and offered guidance in exploring their interests.\n\nAs soon as a client steps through the gym's front door, Yuanwu's kind eyes immediately meet theirs. \n\n\"Leave your worries behind and lift your spirits in our gym. Let's start with some easy punches to unwind.\"\n\nFrom just a few moves and punches, Yuanwu can tell the guest's current physical condition and recommend a suitable training plan.\n\n\"Your posture is slouched, and your walk lacks stability... The lower back muscles appear strained. Try this set of moves: three slow punches followed by one fast. This should provide relief.\"\n\nAfter practicing as per his instructions, the customer should feel a significant sense of relaxation, both mentally and physically. Before leaving, Yuanwu would say goodbye with just the right amount of genuine concern, almost like an old friend.\n\n\"Feeling better now? That's good. And don't forget to ease up on those usual tense days. Take this pack of tea with you, it'll help you unwind.\"\n\nAmong the numerous boxing gyms of various sizes in Jinzhou, only Yuanwu's gym enjoys such sustained popularity."
    },
    {
      "title": "Bad Bargain",
      "content": "It is said that Yuanwu Boxing Gym's owner is willing to help his customers with any kind of trouble, even those not related to working out.\n\nOne day, Mahe, a customer usually focused and devoted during workouts, was suddenly off his game. Yuanwu picked up on that and asked him if something was wrong. Mahe's demeanor was somber as he led Yuanwu to the gym's locker, where he pulled out a delicate dinner plate from his belongings.\n\nThe plate had a circle of small red flowers on the edge. Yuanwu recognized it as an enamel craft from overseas. The flowers were perfect, except for a small missing piece of the gold rim. The entire plate appeared incomplete without it.\n\nIt was a gift Mahe prepared for Panhua. A few years ago, when Panhua Restaurant opened, Mahe promised that he would find the world's most beautiful dinner plate to serve the world's most flavorful meals. Even though the two of them later parted ways due to differences in ideals, Mahe still remembered his promise.\n\nHe stuck to his ideals, but couldn't let go of his affection for her.\n\nFor years, he searched for the perfect dinner plate, one that wasn't too flashy or tacky. Finally, his eyes landed on this simple yet elegant piece - white with red flowers. It was just right.\n\nThe plate was expensive, and he had a hard time securing the funds to buy it. His anxiety mounted as he debated whether to give the gift. Would it be appropriate? Should he send it anyway? During his hesitation, a section of the filigree gold rim that adorned the plates went inexplicably missing. He asked all the vendors in Jinzhou, but they either weren't familiar with imported porcelain or didn't dare to attempt fixing such valuable items. Mahe was left in a predicament.\n\nHaving listened to Mahe's situation, Yuanwu gently picked up the dinner plate, telling Mahe to come pick it up a week later.\n\nWhen Mahe came back, the flowers were perfectly arranged in a circle, with no signs of repair.\n\nIn return, Yuanwu only asked Mahe to bring him and the repaired plate to Panhua Restaurant for a meal.\n\nServed on the beautiful plate adorned with enameled flowers, the spicy, fragrant dishes looked even more enticing. Panhua's smile looked peculiarly charming that day, and the usually reticent Mahe managed to put a smile on his face too. It was truly an enjoyable dinner.\n\nNo matter how popular the gym was as a business, to charge so little for work like this seemed like a bad bargain to many.\n\nYuanwu, however, simply shrugged it off with a smile, as if money was the least important thing to him."
    },
    {
      "title": "Lightning on Stage",
      "content": "Located on the frontier, <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> boasts a robust martial arts culture, featuring numerous gyms of varying sizes. In this relatively tranquil era, the once stringent and harsh customs governing duels gradually waned, making way for more \"amicable\" consultations and exchanges between gyms.\n\nWhere people gather, politics inevitably follows. Despite the activities being cloaked under the banner of exchanges, behind the scenes, individuals engaged in secret competitions, employing every means to emerge victorious. After all, this provides a rare opportunity for publicity. A simple statement from the winner about their affiliated gym brings about a surge in attention and lucrative business contracts.\n\nAs the event gains more influence, an increasing number of gyms decide to participate. Surprisingly, even Yuanwu, known for his indifference to fame and fortune, threw his hat into the ring.\n\nYuanwu's gym was already a flourishing and enviable business. His participation immediately stirred up trouble among some vested interests, with the most perturbed being the previous top-ranker, Wenxi. Wenxi, a businessman, treated both his gym and participation in the event as mere publicity tools for his weapon workshop, emphasizing commercial benefits. Notably, his top rank was purchased, not earned.\n\nUnderstanding Yuanwu's capabilities and recognizing that his gym was not overly corporate, Wenxi personally visited and extended a tempting offer to buy out Yuanwu. However, Yuanwu rejected the proposal without a second thought.\n\nUnfazed, Wenxi resorted to paying substantial sums to some of Yuanwu's regulars to divulge every detail of Yuanwu's boxing techniques. He then went on to bribe the referees and staff overseeing the finals, ensuring they turned a blind eye to the tampering he did with the fighters' suits.\n\nOn the day of the finals, a surprising surge of thunder filled the air, only to dissipate in an instant. Between the flash and the sudden calm, both suits were struck open. The scorching thunder precisely hit the costumes, avoiding unprotected skin; a little further, and the fighters' joints would have been burned. The exposed inner workings of the broken suits revealed all the clandestine schemes, causing an uproar among the spectators and thus leading to the suspension of the match.\n\nFollowing an investigation, the horrifying thunder during the match was attributed to accidents caused by the concealed devices within the suits. Simultaneously, Wenxi's weapon workshop, responsible for manufacturing such devices, came under scrutiny.\n\nBefore long, the workshop mysteriously vanished, fading into oblivion along with the rigged fighting events.\n\nAfter the storm had settled, Yuanwu Boxing Gym returned to its usual lively state, a small haven bustling with patrons. For the sharp-eyed customers, a subtle difference might be observed–a few familiar faces were absent from the crowd coming in and out of the premises."
    },
    {
      "title": "Soothing Tea",
      "content": "The standout feature that sets Yuanwu Boxing Gym apart from others is the emphasis on comfort.\n\nUnder Boss Yuanwu's guidance, practitioners go through their routines, ending each session by wiping away the sweat and indulging in a pot of tea. The comfort! Whether practicing the nimble Xianfengquan, the powerful <te href=850114>Leihuangquan</te>, or the flexible Sanfuquan, Yuanwu has paired each style of boxing with a specific tea boasting complementary benefits. Practitioners, sipping the hot brew after their workouts, relax their muscles, invigorate circulation, and dispel fatigue.\n\nYuanwu personally tested these tea formulas before handing them over to the neighboring teahouse, which thrives with a booming business. Requests for tea bookings are usually made months in advance, and while occasional delays occur, they never affect Yuanwu's orders to be delivered as scheduled. Speculations arise about Yuanwu not being the ordinary, idle gym boss he appears to be, but rather a big shot overseeing multiple enterprises. Could this highly sought-after tea be just another facet of his business?\n\nWhen confronted with inquiries, Yuanwu merely smiles and hands over a cup of tea, saying, \"Stop chasing shadows. Have some tea and refresh. Sweat more, conjecture less.\" After a practice session and a cup of tea, with the nose filled with the fresh aroma, doubts and anxieties disperse with the droplets of sweat. Questions about Yuanwu's wealth and how he accumulates it become irrelevant. A profound sense of relaxation envelops the whole body, momentarily dispelling worldly plots and pursuits.\n\nIn this world, most things demand pace and balance. When tired, take a break and enjoy some tea. It's a moment to pause, refresh, and then continue."
    },
    {
      "title": "Timeless Heritage",
      "content": "Yuanwu Boxing Gym was once renowned as the gym for <te href=850114>Leihuangquan</te> successors. The gym boasted countless honors, and each of its masters achieved fame across <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>.\n\nLeihuangquan's reputation rests on its aggressive style, but such intensity often comes at a cost. Unfortunately, the last three masters met rather unfortunate fates, with the most recent one experiencing a particularly tragic downfall. Rumor has it that he, in the heat of competition, punched through the boxing equipment, violating the rules and leading to his expulsion. Seeking solace from the blow to his career, he embarked on a ship tour, only to encounter a fatal thunderstorm. Coincidentally, he possessed a skill for manipulating thunder, and in a twist of cruel irony, he succumbed to the very force he once controlled. It seems that karma refuses to let anyone go.\n\nAs the property agent finished his introduction of the gym's history, he paused to gauge the middle-aged man's reaction. \"This property isn't really auspicious. Do you still want to buy?\" The man simply smiled and nodded, undeterred.\n\n\"Well, I've said everything I have to,\" the agent sighed, cautioning, \"If you still want to buy it, go on, but just don't turn it into a martial arts gym again. It's unlucky.\"\n\nYuanwu pushed open the creaky wooden door, allowing sunlight to spill into the space. Dormant dust danced in the hard-earned sunlight's warmth, settling on familiar yet weathered furnishings—the worn wooden stakes, the boxing ring with a worn floor, the quiet display case, and dusty medals of honor.\n\nYuanwu delicately wiped down these objects from the past, along with memories obscured by dust. The wooden stakes bore the marks of his late fellow apprentices' intense practice. The medals in the display case were hard-earned victories, and as for the floor, it was indeed broken by himself.\n\nBack in the match, he knew no fear and no restraint. A single punch shattered the delicate balance maintained by masters over the years, breaking the floor and throwing him into the storm of reality. The storm, which was also called reality, tore apart the young martial artist who knew nothing but fight. Perhaps, as the rumors suggested, he was truly buried at the bottom of the sea.\n\nAs the gym reopened under new ownership, a middle-aged owner with a warm smile welcomed customers coming and going. \"Welcome to Yuanwu Boxing Gym.\""
    }

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yuanwu_qte.play_favor_word_yuanwu_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Careful.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yuanwu_enter_battle.play_favor_word_yuanwu_enter_battle"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "*Effort Sounds*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yuanwu_fly.play_favor_word_yuanwu_fly"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "Surging forward.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_yuanwu_hook.play_favor_word_yuanwu_hook"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Nice. Let's go check it out.",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,

    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Might come in handy later.",

    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Found what you're looking for? Good.",

      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Now that's quite the discovery.",

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Dried Fish",
      "content": "Dried fish made from Tetra. The fish is usually brought to Yuanwu Boxing Gym by Lingyang, as a thank-you to Mimi for \"sparring\" with him. When Mimi can't finish her fish, Yuanwu dries it out for future use.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure45_UI.T_Treasure45_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Blue Flask",
      "content": "The secret of <te href=850114>Leihuangquan</te> lies in the good control of power and balancing combat with mindful self-care. The deadlier the strike, the greater the devotion to health.\nThat's why Yuanwu always carries a flask with him during his daily activities. Some say it contains his secret potion for staying fit, but in reality, it's usually just ordinary hot water.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure25_UI.T_Treasure25_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Old Gauntlet",
      "content": "An antiquated gauntlet, long since out of production. Its exterior shows clear signs of wear and tear from extensive use, with most of its interior components exposed. Yet it has been carefully cleaned and maintained, to the point that every line and crevice on the weapon is still starkly visible.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure23_UI.T_Treasure23_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Leihuangquan",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nYuanwu performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nYuanwu consumes STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nYuanwu consumes STA to launch a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Leihuang Master",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Wedge</color></size>\nYuanwu summons <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, and forms a <color=Highlight>Thunder Field</color> centered on the <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color>. <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> lasts for {0}s.\nForte Circuit <color=Highlight>Rumbling Spark</color> and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Blazing Might</color> will immediately detonate Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> on the field, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Field</color></size>\nThe active character gains the effects below when in the <color=Highlight>Thunder Field</color>: a Coordinated Attack from Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> is triggered when attacks hit a target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. This can be triggered once every {1}s. The effect lasts for {2}s.",

          "1.5"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Wedge</color></size>\nYuanwu summons <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, and forms a <color=Highlight>Thunder Field</color>.\nForte Circuit <color=Highlight>Rumbling Spark</color> and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Blazing Might</color> will immediately detonate <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> on the field, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Field</color></size>\nWhen a Resonator is in the <color=Highlight>Thunder Field</color> and hits the target, <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> will perform a Coordinated Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Unassuming Blade",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Rumbling Spark</color></size>\nWhen \"Readiness\" is full, hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to consume all \"Readiness\" and cast <color=Highlight>Rumbling Spark</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and entering the <color=Highlight>Lightning Infused</color> state.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Uprising</color></size>\nWhen \"Readiness\" is full, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> will be replaced with <color=Highlight>Thunder Uprising</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lightning Infused</color></size>\nThe character in <color=Highlight>Lightning Infused</color> state has a greatly increased resistance to interruption.\nWhen Yuanwu is in this state:\n-<color=Highlight>Basic Attacks</color>: Hit targets in a larger range, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.\n-<color=Highlight>Heavy Attacks</color>: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.\n-<color=Highlight>Dodge Counters</color>: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.\n-Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within {0}s after casting a <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> or a successful <color=Highlight>Counterattack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thunderweaver</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.\n-Does not recover \"Readiness\".\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Readiness</color></size>\nYuanwu can hold up to {1} \"Readiness\".\nWhen Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> is on the field, Yuanwu gains {2} \"Readiness\" every second, even when he is not the active character;\nWhen Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> hits a target with a Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu gains {3} \"Readiness\".",
        "param": [
          "3",
          "100",
          "6",
          "5"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Rumbling Spark</color></size>\nWhen Readiness is full, hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to consume all Readiness, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, and enter the <color=Highlight>Lightning Infused</color> state.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Uprising</color></size>\nWhen Readiness is full, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> will be replaced with <color=Highlight>Thunder Uprising</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lightning Infused</color></size>\nThe Resonator in the <color=Highlight>Lightning Infused</color> state has an increased resistance to interruption.\nWhen Yuanwu is in this state:\n- <color=Highlight>Basic Attacks</color>: Hit targets in a larger range and reduce enemy Vibration Strength more efficiently.\n- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attacks</color>: Reduce enemy Vibration Strength more efficiently.\n- <color=Highlight>Dodge Counters</color>: Reduce enemy Vibration Strength more efficiently.\n- Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within {0}s of a <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> or a <color=Highlight>Counterattack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thunderweaver</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n-Readiness does not regenerate.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Readiness</color></size>\nYuanwu can hold up to {1} Readiness.\nYuanwu gains Readiness when:\n<color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> is on the field.\n<color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> triggers a Coordinated Attack.",

          "3",
          "100",
          "6",
          "5"
        ],

  "name": "Jinhsi",
  "nick_name": "Jinhsi's Title",
  "desc": "Jinhsi, <te href=850118>Magistrate of Jinzhou</te>, gently brightens the hopes of her people, like rays of winter sunlight. \nAs the revered Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, she displays humility and wholeheartedly commits herself to guiding her people towards a brilliant future.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_24_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_24_UI",

  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "March 6th",
    "sex": "Female",
    "country": "Huanglong",
    "influence": "Jinzhou",
    "info": "Jinhsi, <te href=850118>Magistrate of Jinzhou</te>, gently brightens the hopes of her people, like rays of winter sunlight. \nAs the revered Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, she displays humility and wholeheartedly commits herself to guiding her people towards a brilliant future.",
    "talent_name": "Thawborn Renewal",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2100-G] \n\nThe exact timing of Resonator Jinhsi's Awakening remains unclear. Signs of her Awakening manifested early in her life, establishing a profound resonance with <te href=850116>Sentinel Jué</te>. \n\nPositioned at the midpoint of her back, Jinhsi's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is a distinct feature. When activating her Resonance Ability, crystalline formations resembling Loong horns materialize above her head. \n\nThrough her unique gift, Jinhsi can manipulate light to create holographic projections mirroring Sentinel Jué, showcasing power comparable to the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s own abilities.\n\nObservational data points towards the exceptional growth capacity of the subject's Resonance Ability. The pinnacle of this ability hints at the remarkable prospect of time shifting.\n\nDetailed analysis of Jinhsi's Resonance Spectrum Pattern has unveiled a striking resemblance to that of Sentinel Jué. Rigorous testing has uncovered strong Syntony reactions. Nevertheless, the precise trigger behind Jinhsi's Awakening remains enigmatic due to the Sentinel's special position.\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a noticeable periodic waveform, which classifies Jinhsi as a <te href=850068>Congenital Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Jinhsi's waveform graph displays elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is stable with no abnormal waveform.\n\nResonant Criticality: Extremely high. Resonator Jinhsi's frequency displays high stability. It is almost certain that she bears no risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n\nResonator Jinhsi has no past record of Overclocking.\n\nRoutine examinations are recommended, while psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Jiang Yue",
    "cv_name_jp": "Yoshino Aoyama",
    "cv_name_ko": "Park Ha Jin",
    "cv_name_en": "Anna Devlin"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Her Leadership",
      "content": "Jinzhou, on the borderlands, often conjures images of desolate lands and barren mountain ranges.\n\nOnce a merchant was tasked with a journey to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. \"I'm not well,\" he promptly refused. \"I would die halfway if I were to go there.\" His colleague smiled and responded, \"You'll know what it's like once you see it for yourself.\"\n\nReluctantly, the duo set out for Jinzhou. They traversed countless barren wastelands and perilous jungles until they finally reached a picturesque place embraced by lush mountains and clear water.\n\nStanding at the end of the forest path were towering city gates. Soldiers on guard gave them a friendly welcome, granting them entry after a quick check of their papers.\n\nA lively tapestry of life unfurled before them as they ventured into Jinzhou. Contrary to expectations, the city was a bustling hub of activity and lacked any trace of desolation or bleakness. Lost in the lively atmosphere, they sampled Kungfu Tea at Liuxian Teahouse, savored the specialty dish at Panhua's Restaurant, and immersed themselves in the shows at Jinzhou Theater. With each experience, their weariness faded away, replaced by the invigorating energy of Jinzhou and the warm hospitality of its people.\n\n\"Unbelievable! Who would have thought a borderland city could thrive like this? It feels like a utopia. No matter your circumstances, with determination and effort, you can achieve your dreams. It couldn't have been easy, but each of you made it happen. Truly impressive.\"\n\n\"Well, it's not as tough as it seems with our great magistrate leading the way. We just follow her lead, and she takes care of everything here.\"\n\n\"Yeah, she seems really wise and capable. I bet she has years of experience too?\"\n\n\"Nope, she's still young, only in her teens!\"\n\n\"Teens?!\""

    {
      "title": "Her Wish-granting Magic",
      "content": "When Jinhsi became the <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, she was young and inexperienced. The people of Jinzhou placed their trust in her decisions, but she knew it was not her alone, but also her role as the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s Resonator, that earned their faith.\n\nTaking on this great responsibility, Jinhsi felt determined to guide Jinzhou towards a better future, despite her initial challenges. She also understood that trust had to be earned through hard work and dedication.\n\nDespite the skepticism she encountered, Jinhsi was more troubled by the weariness etched on the faces of the people—a weariness born of life's hardships and a lack of hope.\n\nShe realized that beyond addressing tangible issues like material shortages and external threats, her true challenge was to restore the hope and confidence of the people of Jinzhou, who had been worn down by life.\n\nIn such times, what the people needed most was a reliable source of hope, regardless of who provided it.\n\nDuring a reconstruction event, the young magistrate performed a \"miracle\" known as \"Sentinel Granting Wishes.\" The remote village had been plagued by weather anomalies for years. Even though the Tacet Discords had stopped, villagers still suffered from extreme cold and gloom.\n\nJinhsi asked the villagers to voice their wishes. At first, silence hung heavy until a sneeze broke the silence. A timid voice then followed, \"It's so cold… I wish it was a bit warmer here.\"\n\nStanding amidst the crowd, Jinhsi held a Loong Scale, closed her eyes, and nodded, \"I will convey your wish to the Sentinel.\"\n\nRight after her words fell, loong horns sprouted from her head, and a Sentinel-like light pierced the dark clouds and the snow on the ground—just in an instant, the ice thawed, and the land once again sprang to life.\n\nWitnessing this spectacle, the crowd exclaimed, \"The Sentinel... the Sentinel has shown itself!\" People observed the loong-shaped light in awe, with hope rekindling in their eyes.\n\nNews of the young magistrate's wish-granting ability spread rapidly in Jinzhou. Wishing became a popular custom, with people submitting their desires to her at City Hall. She meticulously examined each one and devised effective strategies to fulfill them.\n\n\"Dear Magistrate, I'm worried about <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> infiltrating our city.\"—Taoqi, director of the Defense Division, was then tasked with fortifying the city defense walls.\n\n\"Dear Magistrate, I pray for my father's safe return and an end to the war.\"—Jinhsi prioritized research on Tacetite weaponry and material engineering, pushing for new weapons against Discords and faster upgrades for defense.\n\n\"Dear Magistrate, the Exiles have been spotted in the city. I'm scared.\"—Jinhsi expanded <te href=850089>Patrol Stations</te>, added <te href=850087>Patrollers</te> in the city, and assigned more <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> to guard outside.\n\nWithin three years, the city defense walls were renewed, new weapons were created, and Tacet Discords were repelled. Jinzhou finally ushered in peace and prosperity.\n\nAs time passed, people came to realize that the so-called \"Sentinel Granting Wishes\" was just a white lie from the young magistrate.\n\nHowever, they also discovered her true dedication to addressing their problems and concerns, always being on the spot at lightning speed.\n\nThe lights in City Hall never went out, even on holidays. Jinhsi worked tirelessly until midnight, developing feasible plans to fulfill people's wishes. \n\nAnd eventually, they came to understand that she possessed an incredible power - without a Loong Scale, she could summon a dazzling light that could pierce through ice and turn the tide of time.\n\n...\n\nToday, making wishes has become a habit for Jinzhou people, an unspoken agreement between them and their young magistrate.\n\n\"Dear Magistrate, I hope you can take some time to relax and come watch our latest show.\" This was the last wish of the year.\n\nSmiling, Jinhsi closed the file in her hands, leaned against the window in her office, and listened to the melodious singing from Jinzhou Theater, where the new Hero Play, Loong Maiden and Wishes, was being performed."

      "content": "Jinhsi possesses an exceptionally good temper; no matter the circumstances, she always maintains a graceful and gentle smile, and hardly anyone has ever seen her get angry. \n\n\"Does our <te href=850084>Magistrate</te> even know how to get angry?
