      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "I am aware that I have rather peculiar frequencies. It is rare for me to encounter someone whose vibrations align with mine so perfectly... Could it be that you also share a mysterious connection with our <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>? I do hope so, as that would make me feel… even closer to you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_jinxi_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "As I get to know you better, I can't help but notice the similarities between us. Our frequencies, powers, and even purposes seem to align. Defending <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is my duty, and now I sense a deep connection between you and this land… I once believed that mankind should control our own destiny, but my meeting with you has shown me the power of fate. I am grateful for its hand in bringing you into my life.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_jinxi_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "The hour of hope.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hvatk_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hvatk_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "Shine forevermore.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hvatk_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hvatk_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: III",
      "content": "The time is nigh.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hvatksp_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hvatksp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: IV",
      "content": "Divine Loong's blessing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hvatksp_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hvatksp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: I",
      "content": "Fallen star.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_airatk_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_airatk_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: II",
      "content": "Beckoning light.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_airatksp_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_airatksp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Moment of awakening.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01a_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01a_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Thawing harmony.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01a_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01a_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Embrace the change.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01a_03.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01a_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Our lights shine through.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01b_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01b_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Florescent Shadows.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01b_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01b_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Bask in starlight.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01b_03.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill01b_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "Take flight!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skillair_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skillair_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VIII",
      "content": "The sky beckons!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skillair_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skillair_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IX",
      "content": "Strike fast!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skillair_03.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skillair_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: X",
      "content": "Thus it ends!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill02_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XI",
      "content": "Evil be cleansed!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill02_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XII",
      "content": "Sacred light!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill02_03.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_skill02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Thunder guide us!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_burst_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_burst_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Heaven ordains. Banish all vice!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_burst_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_burst_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "O stars... Heed my calling!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_burst_03.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_burst_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Insolence.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Negligence on my part...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "So be it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Worry not.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "There is... much to be done...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_die_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "I must not... falter...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_die_03.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Take form.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hxsummon.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Lend me your strength!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hxchange.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Together we fight.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_qte01.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_qte01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "Strike as one!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_qte02.play_favor_word_jinxi_bat_qte02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "I shall lead the way.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_engage.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider: I",
      "content": "As far as the eye can see.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider: II",
      "content": "Soar against the winds.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_fly_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "Be swift.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_hook_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_hook_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "A lucky find.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_scan.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Onwards.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_dash_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_dash_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash: I",
      "content": "A different approach.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_fastclimb_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_fastclimb_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash: II",
      "content": "All paths converge.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_fastclimb_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_fastclimb_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Jumps over Obstacle",
      "content": "Forgive me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_jump_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_jump_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Found anything useful?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "The lands of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> are filled with riches.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Would these be enough for your needs? Tell me if there is anything else you want.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_openbox_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: IV",
      "content": "That's a lovely find.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jinxi_com_openbox_04.play_favor_word_jinxi_com_openbox_04"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Loong Bun",
      "content": "A plate of Loong Buns made by Jinhsi herself, each adopting a pink hue and a sprinkling of osmanthus powdered sugar.\nEach Loong Bun has a unique filling: custard, lotus seed paste, or sweet bean paste...\n\"Our honored guest awaits just beyond the threshold... I wonder which flavor will tick the box...\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure47_UI.T_Treasure47_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "To-do List",
      "content": "The <te href=850084>Magistrate</te> is constantly overwhelmed with work. From military matters to city defense and civilian security issues, she must handle everything. The City Hall is always filled with pending documents, but they alone cannot aid her in making accurate judgments. Jinhsi prefers to be present and listen to the people's demands firsthand. To make this possible, she asked <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te> to create an electronic to-do list that she could access on-the-go, allowing her to review documents while attending to other tasks.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure48_UI.T_Treasure48_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Loong Scale",
      "content": "Jinhsi had frequent nightmares in her childhood. \nOnce, she was drowning in her dream, caught in the surf and about to sink to the bottom of the ocean. A piece of driftwood floated by, and she clung to it, returning to shore against the tide. \nWhen she woke up, what she was holding in her hand was a piece of scale. If you look closely, you'll notice that the scale looks similar to the ones on the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s body...",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure49_UI.T_Treasure49_UI"
    }
  ],

    "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconCook/T_IconCook_040_UI.T_IconCook_040_UI",
    "rarity": 3
  },

        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nPerform a charged attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nPerform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to counterattack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

        "desc": "Dash forward and perform consecutive strikes that inflict <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<color=Title>Overflowing Radiance</color>\nAfter Jinhsi uses <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color> or, while not in <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Loong's Halo</color>, an alternative Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overflowing Radiance</color> is available within {0}s.\nResonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overflowing Radiance</color> inflicts <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and sends Jinhsi into <color=Highlight><te href=850001>Incarnation</te></color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Luminal Synthesis",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Incarnation</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color>:\n- Alternative Basic Attack <color=Highlight>\"Incarnation - Basic Attack\"</color> becomes available. Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> considered as Resonance Skill DMG. The basic attack cycle of this will not be reset. Can be cast in mid-air.\n- Alternative Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>\"Crescent Divinity\"</color> becomes available. Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Can be cast in mid-air.\n- Alternative Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>\"Incarnation - Heavy Attack\"</color> becomes available. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n- Alternative Dodge <color=Highlight>\"Incarnation - Dodge\"</color> is available while in mid-air. Can be cast multiple times at the cost of Stamina.\n- Alternative Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>\"Incarnation - Dodge Counter\"</color> becomes available. Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany</color></size>\nAfter Stage 4 of <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color> terminates and Jinhsi gains <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color>. \nCan be cast in mid-air.\nWhile <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color> lasts:\n- Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>\"Incarnation - Heavy Attack\"</color>. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n- Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>\"Illuminous Epiphany\"</color>. Send out <color=Highlight>Solar Flare</color> that detonates as <color=Highlight>Stella Glamor</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> after a short delay. Consume up to {0} Incandescence, with each point of Incandescence granting bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to <color=Highlight>Stella Glamor</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n- After casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Illuminous Epiphany</color>, Jinhsi gains <color=Highlight>Unison</color>. This can be triggered once every {1}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Unison</color></size>\nWhile Jinhsi has <color=Highlight>Unison</color>, switching to other Resonators will remove Jinhsi's <color=Highlight>Unison</color> to trigger Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. <color=Highlight>Unison</color> will be consumed in priority in place of Concerto Energy when Concerto Energy is full.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Incandescence</color></size>\nJinhsi can hold up to {2} Incandescence.\nWhen Jinhsi is in the party, all nearby Resonators in the party gain <color=Highlight>Eras in Unity</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Eras in Unity</color> provides 2 independent effects:\nJinhsi gains {3} Incandescence anytime Resonators in the party inflict Attribute DMG. This effect may be triggered by damage of the same Attribute for up to {5} time(s) every {4}s. Additionally, Jinhsi gains {6} Incandescence when Resonators in the party damage the enemy with Coordinated Attacks. This effect may be triggered by Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute for up to {8} time(s) every {7}s.",
        "param": [
          "50",
          "25",
          "50",
          "1",
          "3",
          "1",
          "2",
          "3",
          "1"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Incarnation</color></size>\nWhile in the <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color> state:\n- Basic Attack becomes <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Basic Attack</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n- Resonance Skill becomes <color=Highlight>Crescent Divinity</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n- While in mid-air, Heavy Attack becomes <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Heavy Attack</color>, consuming STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n- While in mid-air, Dodge becomes <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Dodge</color>.\n- Dodge Counter becomes <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Dodge Counter</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany</color></size>\nAfter <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Basic Attack</color> 4, <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color> ends and Jinhsi gains <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color>. \n<size=10></size>\nWhile <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color> lasts:\n- In mid-air, Basic Attack becomes <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Heavy Attack</color>, consuming STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n- Resonance Skill becomes <color=Highlight>Illuminous Epiphany</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Consume Incandescence to increase the DMG Multiplier of this skill.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Illuminous Epiphany</color> grants <color=Highlight>Unison</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Unison</color></size>\nWhile Jinhsi has <color=Highlight>Unison</color>, switching to other Resonators will remove Jinhsi's <color=Highlight>Unison</color> to trigger her Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Incandescence</color></size>\nJinhsi can hold up to {2} Incandescence.\nJinhsi gains Incandescence when she or other Resonators on the team deal Attribute DMG or Coordinated Attack DMG.",

    "info": "Principal Investigator at <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te>, and the Academy's youngest multi-disciplinary scientist. \nA gentle soul with a sharp mind, whose relentless passion for Automata Mechanics always translates into constructive findings and insights.",
    "talent_name": "Matter Weaver",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2603-G]\n\nResonator Xiangli Yao's awakening occurred two years ago, following an incident at the Court of Savantae Ruins where he lost his arm and came into contact with an unknown metal substance.\n\nResonator Xiangli Yao's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on his prosthetic right arm. Post-Awakening observations revealed his ability to perform Metalmorph by manipulating the shape and storing energy of his prosthetic arm.\n\nThe Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Xiangli Yao has been observed to align closely with that of thunder. A strong Syntony reaction has been observed, yet the cause of Xiangli Yao's Awakening remains unclear due to the inability to recover samples of the unknown metal substance.  \n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a consistent, flat <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> followed by a sharp ascent and stabilization. Therefore, Xiangli Yao is identified as a <te href=850069>Mutant Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Xiangli Yao's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is stable with no abnormal waveforms.\n\nResonant Criticality: High. Xiangli Yao's frequency displays high stability with minimal risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n\nRecords indicate no history of Overclocking.\n\nRoutine examinations are advised, with no current need for psychological counseling.",
    "cv_name_cn": "BanMa",
    "cv_name_jp": "Kobayashi Chiaki",
    "cv_name_ko": "Jung Eui Jin",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "An Interview",
      "content": "Years later, I found myself standing at that door again.\n\nThe Xiangli family had always been a star in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>'s journalistic circles. Back then, doing a piece on the family was considered an honor, and indeed, their scientific heritage continues to produce admirable accomplishments. The last time I stood on this doorstep, I was still a rookie, eager for recognition, and the Xianglis helped me with just that by allowing me to take their family portrait. A piece that ticked all the boxes.\n\nThe photo won me a small award and secured my job.\n\nAs the door opened, I looked down to see a boy with bright and clear eyes looking back at me. I flashed my press badge, and he ushered me inside.\n\nXiangli Yao, the \"Son of the Genius\" and \"Paragon's Descendant.\" His father's brilliance had turned heads across Jinzhou, and his mother's perseverance saved the lives of countless children in the city.\n\nThis very house once drew the attention of many, and it remains that way to this day.\n\nI prided myself on conducting interviews, but this young boy seemed more comfortable than I was. Xiangli Yao, like his parents, possessed a natural eloquence, his demeanor gentle and poised. The interview flowed smoothly, and after setting aside my notebook, he offered me a cup of tea. I thanked him, but he shook his head.\n\n\"I should thank you for visiting because of my parents,\" Xiangli Yao smiled, \"I've heard a thing or two about what's been happening.\"\n\nJinzhou, with its vast lands and rich resources, is not without its share of discord.\n\nThe Xianglis had done me a favor in the past, one I felt compelled to repay, both professionally and personally by making sure their son was okay. Xiangli Yao smiled wistfully, his expression hinting at a memory relived. \"My parents are always busy with work, so I'm glad someone remembers them. Your reports capture their moments, research results, words spoken, and many other details that I didn't even know about... When I read those news and interviews, I feel like I get to know them better.\"\n\nI hesitated for a moment but still went on to ask.\n\n\"Do you think... it's unfair? Perhaps your parents should have spent more time with their child?\"\n\n\"They both have their passions, and it's the same for me. I'm happy they're doing what they love.\"\n\n\"...Is that so.\"\n\nI took a deep breath and prepared to leave, but Xiangli Yao asked me to stay. I forgot the exact reason he gave. However, I'm sure it must've been a good one. Xiangli Yao had a way with words that made refusing his hospitality difficult. I only remember having another cup of warm tea and continuing to chat for a while before finally taking my leave.\n\nAs I reached for the door, the boy remarked with a straight face, \"If there's anything you want to confirm, it's best to do it in person. When I was little, my mother and I often talked about the importance of companionship—we even exchanged small notes. Though I was still very young then, those notes, with their few simple words... I find them just as comforting today.\"\n\nI nodded and left the house, ready to pen my next piece.\n\nBut before that, I would send a message to my child, whom I had neglected to contact for several days."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Persuasion",
      "content": "Xiangli Yao leaned forward in his chair and stared resolutely at the elderly man in front of him.\n\nThe older man held a prestigious position in the education system and had personal connections with Xiangli Yao's father. Today, it was another attempt at persuasion, much like the previous ones.\n\n\"I am not attending a separate class. Regular school is fine for me,\" Xiangli Yao reiterated.\nThe elderly man tapped on the table, \"Your current pace might not fit into the standard curriculum. Moving too quickly can bring challenges. You and your classmates are not on the same playing field.\"\n\nXiangli Yao shook his head.\n\n\"There's no point wasting resources opening a special class just for me. I already have access to the <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> archives for study. Besides... I'm just like the others,\" he said, counting on his fingers, \"I have a great time watching hero plays with them, and we trade cards... Oh, and when they invite me over for dinner, I get to test my gadgets out on them and get their feedback!\"\n\nThe elder sighed deeply. \"Your teacher has mentioned such things to me. He says you get along well with your classmates. But this isn't just about you, it's about getting you into the Academy faster,\" he said, staring at the young person before him. \"Xiangli Yao, your father also accelerated his studies and had more time to conduct all the research he loved.\"\n\n\"I am not my father.\"\n\n\"Yet you share his talents and temperament. That I've noticed.\"\n\nXiangli Yao gripped the textbooks in his hands, as he slowly and firmly shook his head, \"But that's not what I want. I want to take things slow, like the way it is now.\"\n\n\"Playing trivial games with your classmates won't do you any good... You'll tire of it sooner or later. It's a waste of time.\"\n\nThe elder stood by the window, looking out at students playing and laughing in the schoolyard. Xiangli Yao went to him, patting his shoulder.\n\n\"That won't happen,\" Xiangli Yao said softly, also looking at the same view. \n\nThey were his friends.\n\n\"I want to be like them, going to school, talking about snacks, catching fish in the river, and watching cool <te href=850082>Echoes</te>. Hey, they even taught me when and how to smile and compliment someone. That's important to me. I know you mean well, but... I get to decide what's best for me, right?\"\n\nOld and young faced each other in the silent office.\n\nThe elder sighed again. \"You remind me of your father. But the two of you are not quite the same.\"\n\nXiangli Yao smiled, \"Well, like I said... I'm not my father. I'm not the student you once had.\"\n\nThe door opened again.\n \nThe next day, Xiangli Yao returned to his regular classes."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Question",
      "content": "\"Here. Another package of yours.\"\n\nHis friend placed the box in a forgotten corner of the dorm, then sprawled out in bed, \"Xiangli Yao, you should definitely sign up for <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> membership. With how often you've been getting these deliveries, it's worth it.\"\n\nXiangli Yao turned his chair to face his friend, \"Haha. I'll think about it.\"\n\n\"Latest issue?\"\n\n\"Yeah, they sent me a sample.\"\n\n\"Jealous! I wish I could work that fast, popping out articles left and right while taking classes at the same time. Man.\" He waved his arms and grinned, \"I guess you already have that Imperial Academy exam in the bag. So, where's it gonna be?\"\n\nWith that, he tossed over a can of soda.\n\nThe can drew a perfect arc in the air, landing squarely in Xiangli Yao's hand.\n\n\"Too much sugar,\" sighed the model student, known for his healthy habits as his lips quirked into a smile, cracking open the can anyway. \"About that...\"\n\nA brief silence followed. Then Xiangli shook his head softly. \"I haven't decided yet.\"\n\nHis friend raised an eyebrow, surprised. \"Well, that's new. I thought you made up your mind already. Professors must be fighting over you.\" \n\n\"There are a few things I haven't figured out yet.\"\n\n\"Which are...?\"\n\n\"Boundaries. The boundaries of truth,\" Xiangli Yao said slowly, twisting a cube in his hands. \"Pascar, do you suppose that humanity will hold itself back in pursuing the boundaries of truth?\"\n\n\"Maybe. There are plenty of nut job scientists out there, so who knows.\"\n\n\"We chase after the stars, only to fall beneath them. Boundaries limit our scope... but without it, there's no way to tell whether you're progressing.\"\n\n\"Well... you and I have different opinions on this, and I'll keep mine to myself to avoid an argument. But what's all this got to do with your admission? You trying to change the subject on me?\"\n\nXiangli Yao smiled softly. \"It does. After my father pursued his own path, I've heard little about him. But I've uncovered some leads... Perhaps they'll lead me to the Court of Savantae, the place he went searching for.\"\n\n\"You sure you're going? After so many years, plenty of people have tried to find even a smither of hint related to the CSC, with little success.\"\n\n\"I feel that I must go. Even if I end up finding nothing. I want to know...\" \n\nThe young scholar spoke slowly, his voice gradually softened, \"I want to know... if my father crossed that boundary.\"\n \nA month before exams, Xiangli vanished.\n\nHe left behind a video, revealing his confusion and the sense of emptiness he felt on his path of pursuing the truth. But whichever path he chose henceforth, he would embrace its outcome.\n\nEmpty seats lingered in the dorm, as life carried on."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Ruin",
      "content": "It took over ten days to get inside the ruins.\n\nAt every step, remnants of the Court of Savantae's defenses were giving Xiangli Yao a hard time. Despite his meticulous preparations, some supplies and provisions had been lost along the way.\n\nXiangli Yao assessed what remained, weighing his options, and ultimately chose to press deeper into the ruins.\n\nHe had long since departed from the borders of <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, and returning a second time to explore further would prove highly difficult. After surveying the soil upon arrival, the young scholar conjectured that these ruins, like those before, had little time left.\n\nInternally, however, conditions were far better. The bulk of the instruments were well-preserved and intact. Cerulean fluids surged and circulated in the conduits of all the mechanisms with a vitality outlasting their creators. Each mechanism, precise, robust, and elegant, was meticulously cataloged by Xiangli Yao as he discerned subtle deviations from Huanglong's existing technologies.\n\nThe more he explored, the more an irrepressible thrill seized him. Like a poet enraptured by fine wine, Xiangli Yao felt drunk on the outpouring of knowledge that surrounded him.\n\nHis Terminal had lost its connection to the outside world, but he still did his best to record everything. His fascination with mechanics, a domain where Savantae had made unparalleled strides, led him to wonder whether his father had known of these innovations, and where he was now on the path of chasing the stars.\n\nYet amid the marvels, signs of a strange intrusion became apparent. Ever since the <te href=850075>Lament</te>, most technologies should have reverted back to their rudimentary states. But here, structures once familiar bore alien marks of alteration, defying erosion yet imbued with an elegance surpassing even Savantae's other creations.\n\nThe deeper Xiangli Yao went into the ruins, the anomalies intensified. Xiangli Yao's recordings slowed. The need to distinguish between anomalies and original designs demanded meticulous care. Eventually, he landed on a guess: The people here were trying to create some sort of door.\n\nA door. A gateway. A... portal.\n\nFor the first time, Xiangli Yao hesitated.\n\nBesides the danger, the doubt was about direction. So far, no alternate passage into the ruins had revealed itself, suggesting his father's departure had taken a different path. Had his father fallen here? Or...\n\nIf truth had a path, perhaps this was its nearest gateway."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Smile",
      "content": "Later, when Xiangli Yao reflected on his journey through the Court of Savantae ruins, he realized that parts of his memory had become foggy. He suspected it was due to the effects of the ancient mechanisms and force fields—devices that transcended current technological limits and boasted near-unfathomable levels of advancement. Creating them was clearly unwise, at least for the CSC researchers. Since the <te href=850075>Lament</te>, exploration beyond had halted due to the warping of the laws of physics. Yet, many scholars still yearned to traverse the skies again and explore interstellar space.\n\nThat portal might have been built for that very purpose: to leap into the sky, or perhaps even further, into the heart of the civilization that had transformed these ruins.\n\nXiangli Yao wasn't sure if they had succeeded, but he paid a steep price for his curiosity—his arm. He could only speculate that he had managed to solve the sequence and activate the mechanism. He recalled the marks etched into the enormous cavity. They were rugged and twisted, as if a huge <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> was carved onto it.\n\nThen, crystalline, delicate butterflies emerged from the fracture. A strange power seeped from the gap, glowing with the mysteries of another civilization. As Xiangli Yao stared into it, past barriers that once seemed insurmountable now appeared solvable within this new framework. The waves of knowledge surged, capable of bending, subduing, and intertwining all frequencies in existence.\n\nHe took a step forward, almost forgetting the blood gushing from his torn flesh. The dizziness from blood loss and a faint euphoria blurred his senses.\n\nAt that moment, he noticed a familiar object lying dust-covered on the workstation. His childhood memories were hazy, but he recognized it immediately as a gift from his mother to his father. Xiangli Yan had once shown it to him as a child, a father and son photo of them together. Suddenly, he understood. Even at the end, his father held onto a memory of their family. He hadn't abandoned everything.\n\nBeyond that threshold, could he still see himself progressing, at the end of pure theory where no one could observe…?\n\nHis father devoted everything to theoretical science, his mother to applied science. Xiangli Yao was like them, always longing to reach for the stars, even willing to burn himself in the process.\n\nThey had given their all.\n\nAnd what about him?\n\nStanding just a step away from the ultimate answer, the young scholar found himself thinking about trivial, unrelated things. He recalled how, after his parents' departure, friends and neighbors had dragged him out to join a <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> festival. It was supposed to be the Moon-Chasing Festival, but the threat from the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te> had forced a simpler celebration. Yet, a festival is always a festival, a reminder to celebrate even in hard times. He had demonstrated one of his newest creations, a small gadget, which won applause from the crowd.\n\nHe was like his parents.\n\nHowever, he was not their clone. Even as his shadow followed theirs, he found himself unable to journey the same roads they had traveled.\n\nWith trembling hands, the young scholar searched for scattered parts, trying to assemble a device to stop the bleeding. His newly acquired Forte gently surged and began to warp the metal structures according to his will.\n\nAs the bleeding ceased, so did the grand opportunity before him.\n\nIt was only a few steps away... but Xiangli Yao had already turned his back.\n\nHe knew he had found his own answer."
    }
  ],

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Science is life's questioning of truth.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "An interesting new perspective. Thank you. Now I should be able to further improve my prosthetic arm's energy output.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "I can now achieve even greater things with Metalmorph. Is there a particular thing you desire? Please let me offer my new creation as a gift. It wouldn't exist without you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "I'm headed to test the new combat techniques I've learned. Care to join me? It's time to put theory into practice. I believe I have reached a critical point, and overcoming it will bring a new horizon.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "The pursuit of truth is a rocky path to tread. Some stumble and push forward, others lament their weariness, and a few may even turn back. Our ranks thin as we near the ultimate goal. But Rover... Though you blaze your own trail, I know you are always with us, guiding the truthseekers forward.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Disruption.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_skill01.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_skill01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Reconfiguration!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_skill02.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_skill02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Exploit primed!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_skill_sp.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_skill_sp"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "All shall reveal itself.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_burst_01.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_burst_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Pierce through the stars.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_burst_02.play_favor_word_xiangliyao_bat_burst_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,

    {

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Xiangli Yao's ID Card",
      "content": "Xiangli Yao's work ID card reads \"Xiangli Yao, Researcher, <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te>,\" neatly printed. \n\nIt took Xiangli Yao an extra year to wear this simple, plain card with a built-in ID chip on his chest compared to his peers at the Academy—a year ago, he had chosen not to take the Academy exam, instead leaving <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> in search of answers to life's deeper questions. A teenager at the time, he stood at a crossroads, uncertain whether to follow in his parents' footsteps or forge his own path. However, a year later, his heart led him down a path entirely different from theirs...\n\nOn his first day as a researcher, Xiangli Yao placed his ID card neatly on his desk, opened the window, and let the bustling sounds of Jinzhou City drift in.\n\n\"Huaxu Academy. It's a nice place.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure61_UI.T_Treasure61_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Beep-Boop",
      "content": "This charming little robot, with its slightly yellowed surface, is both simple and compact. Give its tiny head a pat, and it will recite one of the classic Hero Play lines, accompanied by adorable pixel emojis displayed on its somewhat aged monitor. This was Xiangli Yao's first creation during his student days and served as the prototype for his later inventions, Xiang-Lee and Patty. Despite being Yao's initial attempt, the robot's design, materials, and programming beautifully showcase its creator's ingenuity.\nAffectionately named Beep-Boop, this lovable machine eventually found a home with one of Yao's lucky classmates. From that point on, Xiangli Yao devoted much of his free time to crafting models, robots, and other fascinating gadgets for his friends.\nWhether in school or now at the <te href=850092>Academy</te>, Yao's generosity in dedicating time and effort to those around him remains a constant. His selfless nature has always been, and continues to be, an integral part of who he is.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure63_UI.T_Treasure63_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "CSC Lock Puzzle",
      "content": "A puzzle crafted from intricately interlocking joints, a testament to its ingenious design. It is said that such trinkets served as gifts from elder members of the Court of Savantae to their younger generations.\n\nXiangli Yao can still recall the warmth of his father's rough fingertips as he handed him the puzzle on his birthday. Yet what truly captivated him were its complex arrangements and perplexing structures—such puzzles were what drew him into a world of intricate logic, leaving him spellbound for years to come.\n\nThis was Xiangli Yao's first encounter with a puzzle, but certainly not his last.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure62_UI.T_Treasure62_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Forever Seeking",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Decipher</color></size>\nWhen Capacity reaches {0}, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Deduction</color> is replaced by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Decipher</color>.\nConsume {8} Capacity to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Decipher</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Law of Reigns</color></size>\nWhen Performance Capacity reaches {1} in <color=Highlight><te href=850025>Intuition</te></color> state, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Divergence</color> is replaced by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Law of Reigns</color>.\nConsume {9} Performance Capacity to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Law of Reigns</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Revamp</color></size>\nShortly after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Decipher</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Divergence</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Revamp</color> at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Capacity</color></size>\nXiangli Yao can hold up to {2} Capacity.\nEvery Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Probe</color> on hit grants Capacity.\nEvery Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Deduction</color> on hit grants Capacity.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Performance Capacity</color></size>\nXiangli Yao can hold up to {3} Performance Capacity.\nWhen in <color=Highlight><te href=850025>Intuition</te></color> triggered by Resonance Liberation:\nObtain {4} Performance Capacity when Stage 1 of Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Pivot - Impale</color> hits a target.\nObtain {5} Performance Capacity when Stage 2 or 3 of Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Pivot - Impale</color> hits a target.\nObtain {6} Performance Capacity for every Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Divergence</color> on hit.\nObtain {7} Performance Capacity for every Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Revamp</color> on hit.\nObtain {10} Performance Capacity for every Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Unfathomed</color> on hit.",
        "param": [
          "100",
          "5",
          "100",
          "5",
          "1",
          "2",
          "2",
          "3",
          "100",
          "5",
          "2"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Decipher</color></size>\nWhen Capacity reaches {0}, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Deduction</color> becomes Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Decipher</color>.\nConsume {8} Capacity to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Decipher</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Law of Reigns</color></size>\nIn the <color=Highlight>Intuition</color> state, when Performance Capacity reaches {1} , Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Divergence</color> becomes Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Law of Reigns</color>.\nConsume {9} Performance Capacity to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Law of Reigns</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Revamp</color></size>\nShortly after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Decipher</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Divergence</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Revamp</color>, consuming STA to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Capacity</color></size>\nXiangli Yao can hold up to {2} Capacity.\nXiangli Yao gains Capacity through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Performance Capacity</color></size>\nXiangli Yao can hold up to {3} Performance Capacity.\nXiangli Yao gains Performance Capacity in the <color=Highlight>Intuition</color> state through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Revamp</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Divergence</color>, and Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Unfathomed</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "100",
          "5",
          "100",
          "5",
          "1",
          "2",
          "2",
          "3",
          "100",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "The Whisper",
      "content": "\"Clang!\"\n \nAs the sword was struck from her hand, the girl's consciousness was also cast into chaos.\n \nHeat pulsed through her limbs. Then, numbness. Nerves stretched too tight snapped one by one, plunging her into a cold, silent dark.\n \nShe no longer remembered how many times she had been knocked down. She didn't know how many more times she would have to get back up.\n \nFear began to take root in her chest. It wrapped around her unraveling will like a cocoon spun of silk.\n \nShe was scared. Scared she'd collapse before achieving anything. Scared she'd fall on a path with no way back.\n \n\"Accept this feeling, Augusta...\"\n \nThat voice rang in her ear, cutting through the dark like a match struck in a void.\n \n\"Learn fear. Learn dread. This is your very first lesson...\"\n \n\"Learn to accept your weakness. Only by knowing weakness can you understand strength.\"\n \n\"Only by tasting defeat can you grasp the worth of power...\"\n \n\"The path of glory wasn't paved for you. But if you reach its end, no one will care whose name you bore at the start.\"\n \n\"The will to become a hero... That alone is enough to begin becoming one...\"\n \n\"So walk the path, Augusta... You have no other choice. And you need no other choice.\"\n \n\"Don't chase the light like a moth. Be the blazing sun no one dares to look at.\"\n \n\"Now rise, Augusta.\"\n \nThe whisper tore through the cocoon of fear, leaving her bare again in the freezing dark.\n \nThe cold stung what little will she had left, and then—\n \nShe stood.\n \nHer legs shook. One foot dragged behind the other. She reached for her sword. Picked it up.\n \nAnd once more, she challenged the Gladiator named Cato.\n \nFrom that moment forward—\n \nShe wielded her very first victory like a blade, carving out her path to glory."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Right of the Strong",
      "content": "Confront. Assess. Deliver the blow. Then came the verdict, the applause, and the cheers.\n \nShe ignored the burning gazes and turned to leave without a second glance.\n \nSomewhere along the way, Augusta had lost all passion for victories that came too easily.\n \nShe wanted a whetstone. Someone who could sharpen her edge. But in all of Septimont, such opponents had grown scarce.\n \n\"Not enough... Still far from enough...\"\n \n\"Two strikes to break their offense. One to crush their defense. One final blow to end it.\"\n \n\"An opponent of this level... I should've ended that fight in four moves...\"\n \nIn the lounge, Augusta sat alone, reviewing the flaws in her performance.\n \n\"No need to rush, Augusta...\"\n \n\"You already possess the mindset of the strong. That's good...\"\n \n\"Searching for openings, scraping for chances—that's how the weak fight. For the strong, victory is never the goal. It's only the beginning.\"\n\nAs always, the whisper came.\n\nIt was like a mentor, patient yet firm. A persuasive elder who showed up to offer insight whenever she needed it the most.\n\n\"The strong...?\" Augusta tightened her grip on her sword, uncertainty in her voice.\n \n\"Have I... really become one of them?\"\n \n\"Without question, Augusta. You are no longer that helpless little girl.\"\n \n\"Drain every ounce of worth from the weak. Let the stronger ones become your fuel.\"\n \n\"Climb the stairs their bodies build and take the throne meant for you...\"\n \n\"...!\"\n \nAs if a spike of ice pierced her spine, Augusta's eyes shot open.\n \n\"What is it, Augusta?\"\n \n\"Nothing... I just...\" She pressed a hand to her face, brow furrowed, trying to remember.\n \n\"I just... can't remember what today's opponent even looked like...\"\n \nA few days later, Augusta received an invitation to attend the underground pits. Once, she stood there as a Gladiator. Now, they welcomed her as an esteemed guest, seated among the nobles.\n \n\"Accept it, Augusta. Broaden your horizons. Only by stepping beyond that little cage can you rise to the summit of Septimont.\"\n \nShe had meant to decline. But in the end, she listened to the whisper. So she sat stiffly in a plush seat she wasn't used to, replying to upper-class small talk with polite phrases that didn't sound like her. Discomfort tugged at her, so she shifted her gaze to the arena below.\n \nThat's when she noticed, behind the iron bars, far more Gladiators than any standard match required.\n \n\"Augusta, our brightest star!\" said the noble beside her. \"Everyone hopes a worthy challenger will rise to meet you. Alas, we've yet to find one.\"\n \n\"So we've prepared something special. An Agon that no one has ever seen before. No rules, no limits. A huge free-for-all to the death!\"\n \nA strange unease stirred in Augusta's chest, slipping quietly into her blood.\n \n\"Look, Augusta! All those waiting to enter. They once fell to your blade. All of them.\"\n \n\"Now, they've been granted a second chance. To fight again. To earn the right to challenge you once more.\"\n \n\"And that right… belongs only to the last one standing.\"\n \nA buzzing filled her head. She heard her blood pounding against her eardrums.\n \n\"Enjoy the show, Augusta…\" The whisper murmured. \"Enjoy the feast prepared for you. A right that only the strong possess…\"\n \n\"The right… of the strong…\"\n \nHer murmur collided with the whisper's voice, two flints striking, and something inside her caught fire.\n \nIt ignited her blood. It ignited her doubts and the questions she had long held.\n \n\"No need for all that trouble…\"\n \nHer <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> flared on the back of her hand. A streak of wind cut through the air. Her sword flew straight into her grip.\n \nThe nobles gasped as Augusta rose from her seat and leapt down into the arena.\n \n\"If you wish to challenge me, you need no right!\" She drove her sword into the ground, her voice ringing across the arena.\n \n\"If you share the same dream, then point your blade at the one you most want to defeat. Right now!\"\n \nAt her words, the iron gates creaked open. Gladiators stepped in, one by one, encircling her.\n \nIn that instant, memories flooded Augusta's mind. She scanned the crowd. What seemed like nearly a hundred eyes stared her down. Not a single one was unfamiliar.\n \nShe remembered their names. Their moves. Their strengths. And their weaknesses.\n \nShe waited, calm and still, for the warhorn to sound.\n \nThat day, she was the last one standing in the arena. But she took no lives.\n \nThat day, she heard the roar of a thousand voices. But the whisper… was not among them."
    },
    {
      "title": "The \"Flawless\" Hero",
      "content": "\"Who is he?\"\n \n\"Are you kidding? That's Ephor Magno! There's not a soul in Septimont who doesn't know him.\"\n \n\"Ephor...\"\n \nIn the shadow of a street corner, Augusta took the last bite of her dry bread, her eyes fixed on the tall figure speaking in the square. He looked to be in his thirties. His features were chiseled like marble, yet softened by a warm, open smile. As his speech rose to its peak, he spread his arms wide. The crowd erupted in thunderous applause.\n \nAn undefeated champion of the public Agons. A once-in-a-generation Gladiator prodigy. He had slain seven Corrosauruses in the Sanguis Plateaus and returned alive, bathed in dragon's blood. They called him the \"Dragon Slayer.\" At that time, tales of his deeds echoed throughout Septimont.\n \nHe listened to the people. Never turned away a plea. He ruled without greed. An Ephor chosen by the will of the masses. Many believed he would rise as the prophesied Hero of Heroes of their era. \n \nTo Augusta, that title had always felt distant and unreachable. But for the first time, she saw someone who might truly ascend to it.\n \nA fire lit in her chest. Those feats she once thought exaggerated, those soul-stirring legends... Someone in her own lifetime had actually lived them. That meant her dream wasn't just a fantasy. It could be within her reach.\n \nBut slowly, that fire began to cool. She studied the man's face, her gaze lingering on that impeccably beautiful smile—\n \n\"Why couldn't someone that strong... save Fabianum?\"\n \nNot long after, Augusta stood face-to-face with that same man, those questions still heavy in her heart.\n \n\"Congratulations, young one. You've earned Arsinosa's blessing. You shall be crowned the new Champion.\"\n \nOn the medal platform, Augusta faced Magno as he prepared to pin the medal to her chest. But behind the smile he strained to maintain, she saw eyes dulled by weariness.\n \nThe hero she once imagined no longer stood there. Nor did the fire. The warrior once hailed as the Dragon Slayer was gone.\n \nAugusta accepted the honor in silence. Then, just before stepping away, she whispered, low enough that only he could hear—\n \n\"Were those legends about you... ever true?\"\n \nHe answered with the same silent smile.\n \nSometime later, a nameless Gladiator appeared in the underground pits. He wore a helm that concealed his face, and armor black as obsidian. He fought like a man with nothing to lose. Sought out only the strongest. No flourish. No dignity. He didn't fight for honor. He fought like he was hunting death.\n \n\"The Nameless\" racked up wins at a terrifying pace, soon drawing Augusta's attention. Though she was already crowned Champion, she accepted his challenge.\n \nThe moment their blades met, she knew. Helm or not, it couldn't hide those same clouded, exhausted eyes.\n \nShe didn't know why a revered Ephor, a hero with nothing left to prove, would descend to the shadows to fight in a bloodstained cage. But in that moment, none of it mattered. All that mattered was the strong opponent before her and how to defeat him.\n \nSteel clashed, again and again. Neither yielded an inch. To break the standoff, the Nameless's sword sparked with electricity. Arcs of crimson lightning danced along the blade. Lightning forged into a weapon. His ultimate strike, one meant to end it all.\n \nAnd in that blinding flash, Augusta saw it. The legend. The warrior of the Sanguis Plateaus, lightning in hand, ripping through stormclouds and despair to bring hope to those behind him.\n \nHer <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> flared on the back of her hand. She could never summon lightning like his. Her Forte was a whisper compared to his roar. But even so—\n \nThat faint flicker of resistance bent the lightning, just slightly.\n \nAnd in that breath of an opening, Augusta struck with everything she had. One final swing.\n \nAfter that day, the Nameless vanished from the pits. To the world, it was just another of Augusta's many victories. No one realized that a legend had quietly ended.\n \nSome time later, on an otherwise ordinary day, Augusta received a letter. A handwritten invitation from the Ephor's Palace."
    },
    {
      "title": "Throne of Thorns",
      "content": "\"Before you ask all your 'whys'... allow me one question first.\"\n \n\"Are you... from Fabianum?\"\n \n\"Yes.\"\n \n\"I thought so. To think an orphan from Fabianum would become the Champion of Septimont.\"\n\n\"Are you surprised?\"\n \n\"No. Just... regretful.\"\n \nIn the reception room of the Ephor's Palace, Magno's signature smile had faded. Though barely a decade older than Augusta, his expression, in contrast to her youthful fire, resembled that of a man already at death's door.\n \n\"That strike of yours,\" he said suddenly, recalling their duel in the underground pit, \"was beautiful. I doubt even my younger self could've parried it.\"\n \n\"Why… even though everyone calls you a hero,\" Augusta asked, \"can I only see resignation in you?\"\n \n\"I might have lived up to being a hero, but not to being Ephor.\"\n \n\"As a hero, I could answer the hopes of ten... a hundred, even a thousand. But as Ephor, I could not realize a single true vision for Septimont.\"\n \n\"You sit at the pinnacle of power. How can you claim to be powerless?\"\n \n\"I do not make excuses for myself. When I first took this role, I truly believed I could carry the weight of a thousand hopes.\"\n \n\"But I can lie to myself, but not to reality. Young one... I knew who you were from the very beginning. The day you were brought to Septimont, I knew you were the last survivor of Fabianum.\"\n \n\"Your existence was a blade hanging over me. And the day you became Champion… that blade finally fell. I could no longer hide from the mistake I made—turning a blind eye to Fabianum's fall, just to preserve my own pitiful crown.\"\n \n\"Are you telling me this out of guilt?\"\n \n\"Maybe. Or maybe… hope.\" Magno rose and took out a glass from a drawer hidden beneath the desk.\n \n\"The crown gave me immense power, but it also turned me into a coward. I am no longer the hero Septimont needs.\" He raised the empty glass toward her. \"Wear the crown, Augusta. You've defeated every opponent you can see. Now it's time to face the ones you can't.\"\n \n\"And you think I'm worthy just because I beat you?\"\n \n\"No. Nothing so shallow.\" Magno shook his head. \"It's because I heard your name. From the heights of Septimont to its depths, from gilded halls to humble alleyways. Regardless of wealth, strength, class, or creed, the people have been connected by just one name. And I believe, one day, that connection will become the new force that drives Septimont forward.\"\n \n\"I tested the weight of that name with my own sword. That... is the last thing I could offer as Ephor.\"\n \n\"Even if your bones are burned to ash, do not go gentle into that false night.\" For the briefest moment, through the rim of his glass, a flicker of fire returned to Magno's eyes.\n \nLater that night, the cleaning servants found Magno seated upon the Ephor's throne. His face was pale, lips purple. Poison, they said. A shattered glass lay at his feet, the spilled liquid glistening as it streamed down the steps.\n \nSome said it was the work of rivals.\n \nOthers said it was the Senate's gift. An elegant death in a glass.\n \nBut most agreed that Septimont needed a new \"hero.\"\n \nAnd just as Magno had foretold, Augusta's name began to spread across Septimont like a wind.\n \nSpring gave way to autumn, and the Ephor's throne welcomed its new occupant.\n \nAugusta stood where she once had only looked up. She gazed at the throne of thorns that had devoured so many heroes. She thought of Magno on that final night. And in her mind, she saw him raising his glass to the one who would one day sit here, and drinking deeply from the poison.\n \nAugusta didn't have many complicated thoughts in her mind. She hadn't borne hatred toward anyone. She had seen darkness for herself, but she also knew what light looked like.\n \nHer thoughts were simple—\n \nOnly one who surpasses all heroes can be called a Hero of Heroes.\n \nAnd the throne's thorns were just another trial to overcome.\n \nShe took her seat and, with steady hands, placed both the shackle and the crown upon her head.\n \n\"Ephor Augusta, a message from the Senate. The Senators request an audience... to discuss urgent matters.\" The herald bowed before the throne.\n \n\"Very well,\" Augusta said, smiling.\n \nShe was eager to meet these \"opponents\" beyond the arena.\n \n\"Lead the way.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "One Day, In the Arena...",
      "content": "For Augusta, life as a Hero of Heroes was not so different from before.\n \nWhen the brief celebrations ended, the mountain of paperwork still remained. However long the thrill of victory lasted, it would always be swept away by the quiet tide of daily life.\n \nBut Augusta didn't mind uneventful days like these. The Agons still roared with passion. No matter the era, Septimont remained a nation that burned with fervor.\n \nEverything was moving toward a brighter future. Everyone was moving forward.\n \nAnd yet, Augusta still had one small worry.\n \nAs Septimont's Ephor, she was more than ready to envision a shining future for her people. But as Augusta, she found herself lingering at the footnote of her own story.\n \nFrom childhood to now, she had walked the path of glory. And now, she stood at its end.\n \nShe had fulfilled the ancient prophecy and become the Hero of Heroes she once looked up to.\n \nShe had met those destined to walk beside her and overcome trials she once thought impossible.\n \nIf one were to write a tale to be passed down through the ages, this might well be its conclusion. The final chapter of Hero of Heroes, Augusta.\n \nA perfect ending. One that left no room for regret.\n \nBut life is not a play. It doesn't end just because the climax has passed.\n \nShe had to wonder, and she wanted to wonder—\n \nWhen Septimont no longer needed Augusta, when this land began to give birth to new legends—\n \nWhen this story truly came to an end... What could she become next?\n \nWith that question nagging at her, Augusta slipped away from the Ephor's Palace.\n \nShe didn't choose a direction. She let her instincts lead.\n \nAs she wandered, she kept thinking—\n \nShould she pursue even greater strength? Seek out new, formidable foes? Explore lands beyond Septimont? Or perhaps, when all was settled, lay down her sword and live out a quiet, contented life?\n \nSo many possibilities. So many roads stretched out before her.\n \nBy the time Augusta came back to herself, she realized she had walked to the arena. The place that held so many of her memories.\n \nToday was a rest day. The arena, for once, stood empty.\n \nNo, not completely empty.\n \nAs if drawn by some silent agreement, someone else had wandered in as well.\n \n{Male=His;Female=Her} eyes met Augusta's. And they both smiled, as if sharing a secret known only to the two of them.\n \nJust like that, all of Augusta's worries melted away.\n \nShe didn't have the answer yet. But she still had time to find it.\n \nThere was no need to rush.\n \n\"It's been a while since I've stretched properly…\"\n \n\"Well, my dear friend—\"\n \n\"How about a long-overdue spar?\""
    }

  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "Strong—that was my first impression of you. Few have ever made me think that, but you were an intriguing exception. It was then I decided: when the time came, we would fight by each other's side. And as you know, I seized that opportunity when it came.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_toplayer01.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_toplayer01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "Deceit and vanity are the fragile facades I despise most. One must face their feelings in the light, be it joy, pain, ambition, or evil. That's why I admire you. You've never tried to hide the fire in your eyes. It's that honesty that made us comrades.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_toplayer02.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_toplayer02"

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_toplayer04.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_toplayer04"
