    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "I know well that your path stretches far beyond <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>—that is what sets us apart. I, Augusta, Ephor of Septimont, was born of this land, and to its soil I shall one day return. My gaze reaches every hill and peak of Septimont, but it ends at the sea. You, however, are meant to embrace the world. So go. Seek the lands far and wide. That is where your true arena lies.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_toplayer05.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_toplayer05"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Augusta's Hobby",
      "content": "From the heights of the Ephor's Palace, one can overlook the entire City of Septimont. Whenever I finish my duties, I enjoy climbing up to the rooftop to feel the wind. At times, Griffrexes returning from the Sanguis Plateaus soar above the palace. I listen to their cries, eyes tracing their wings as they sweep across every inch of Septimont's land, a land that we, and our forebearers, reclaimed from the jaws of calamity. We Septimontians rarely dwell on the pain of struggle, for we understand that the road to victory is never smooth. And I will carry this glorious legacy forward. It is the promise I make to our people, and to this land that burns with pride.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_taste.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_taste"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Augusta's Trouble",
      "content": "Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to \"fight,\" everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_worry.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "My favorite food? Haha, that's a difficult question. The food in Septimont suits my taste just fine, though I do enjoy some foreign dishes as well. But if you ask me to recommend something, well, I'll spare you. Iuno always says my choice in food leaves much to be desired. Still, if you're in the mood for something, don't hesitate to speak up. I'll treat you. Good food is best shared with friends.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_foodlike.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_foodlike"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "Uhm, I'm not a picky eater. As long as it satisfies, I'm content with anything. As for sweets, I don't indulge much. When I was young, Angel had a great fondness for desserts, so I would often leave her the treats that the adults gave us. Over time, I grew indifferent to sweets. But I wouldn't say I dislike them, either.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_foodhate.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_foodhate"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "When I was appointed as Ephor, I swore to defend the glory of Septimont until my last breath. Since that moment, my conviction has never wavered for even an instant. The passage of time has not dulled my vow. On the contrary, with each clash of blades, each call of the hunt, my resolve has only grown steadier and stronger. This is the mission I have chosen, and the path I must conquer.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_dream.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_dream"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "This greatsword is forged from the blades of countless Gladiators. You may have heard its tale. At first, I took those swords to spare the defeated a crueler fate. I took their blades, so they could live. I've always believed that a Gladiator's blood should be shed only for the greater good of Septimont. Of course, back then, I needed those blades to serve as my own fangs. Now, Gladiators no longer fight to the death in the Colosseum, and I no longer need a sword to prove myself. Yet somewhere along the way, this weapon became part of me, fused with my very flesh and blood. It bears witness to who I was... and shapes who I must become.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_storyobj.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_storyobj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "Not many know about my past, or rather, my whole past. It's not that there are dark secrets to hide, just... the things I did in my younger, more reckless days still make me cringe a little. But with you, I don't feel the need to hide anything. Honesty is the least I can offer in return for your trust.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_storyexp.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_storyexp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Avidius",
      "content": "A formidable opponent. His words and actions have indeed earned the Senate's favor. I'm well aware the Senate is far from clean, but I trust Avidius has no intention of sinking into its filth. What I do wonder, though, is how fiercely his ambition will burn… or whether the confusion I now see in his eyes will one day consume him, leaving only cold embers in the wake of a fire gone out.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_aweidiya.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_aweidiya"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Lupa",
      "content": "A genius made for the arena whose passion burns pure. Had we met in the early days of the Colosseum, perhaps we would have fought side by side, as you two do now. Just watching her reminds me that my efforts to reform the arena were not in vain. The Colosseum is always meant to be a stage for passion and glory, not a mire of corruption and decay.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_lupa.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_lupa"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Buling",
      "content": "Buling... Heh, just from the name alone, I can tell she's from Huanglong. From the moment we met, this remarkable young lady made an impression. I'm grateful she kept her promise and gave Septimont a fighting chance. For me, and for everyone in this land, her kindness is a debt we will never forget.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_buling.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_buling"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Angel",
      "content": "Angel... I've never forgotten Fabianum, nor the past we shared. When our homeland fell... I don't know what kind of nightmare she faced that day in the depths of Oak Hollow. But there is a voice in my heart that never fades... it tells me she's still alive. And I believe, one day, Angel will find her way home, back to our land.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_anjier.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_anjier"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Iuno",
      "content": "Iuno and I became friends because we're so alike—stubborn, headstrong, and relentless in the face of defeat. In many ways, we walked in each other's footsteps, each unwilling to fall behind, and so we ended up on the same path. Even so, there are times I wish she could live more freely. I know the pain she carries runs deeper than what she's ever told me. To others, she may seem arrogant or willful, but that defiance stems from her certainty that every step she takes must be the right one. And such certainty… always demands a price.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_younuo.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_about_younuo"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. Take this, my dear friend. It's crafted by the finest blacksmiths of Septimont, a sword worthy of you. I know your hands are never without a sharp blade, but what true Gladiator would ever say they have too many? If this gift doesn't quite meet your expectations, just let me know. Any friend of mine deserves nothing less than the best.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "The blade most worn is often the sharpest.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_aogusita_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_aogusita_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "Hehe... Good boy. Go fetch it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_aogusita_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "I am Augusta, Ephor of Septimont. Etch this name into your memory—it belongs to the one who stands above, and whose mark will never fade. Whether we meet as foes or friends, my sword and I await the fierce fight between us.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "All the sun touches is ours to fight for.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "March on toward destined victory.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "The hunt never ends.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "Septimont flows through me, but my blood answers to neither the Senate nor the Colosseum. My veins run deep in the soil of my hometown and spread wherever I go. Each battle I fight, each path I choose, makes them pulse stronger.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "I will not stop here... My hometown's fall revealed the truth: only with the everblazing sun can darkness have nowhere to hide.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "When the rules are rigged, power turns into a weapon of destruction. Yet as I rewrite those rules with my own power, I realize just how much I still need to learn to keep Septimont balanced—and to lead as a true ruler.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "There was a time I felt lost atop Capitoline Hill. Not about the present, but the future. When age catches up to me, when the weight I carry is no longer mine to bear, no longer needed by Septimont... what then? Will I live a quiet life in a small town? Or maybe become a weaponsmith? It's hard to say. But if I had my way, I'd return to the arena with silver in my hair, facing worthy foes to the roar of the crowd... Hah, my blood will never grow old.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack",
      "content": "Roars of conquest.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_atk_heavyatk03_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_atk_heavyatk03_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Pathetic struggle.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Sing of my triumph.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "For Septimont.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Moment of victory.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill02_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "In one strike.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill02_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Undying glory!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill02_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_skill02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Rulers rule. Winners win.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Stand tall before the eternal sun!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "All glory to Septimont.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: IV",
      "content": "It ends now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst02_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: V",
      "content": "One strike is enough.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst02_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VI",
      "content": "My valor never fades.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst02_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_burst_burst02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VII",
      "content": "Unmatched.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_atk_burst_atk06_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_atk_burst_atk06_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VIII",
      "content": "Invincible.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_atk_burst_atk06_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_atk_burst_atk06_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Conquest begins now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "This is my moment.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: III",
      "content": "Fight by my side.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: IV",
      "content": "In the name of glory.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_double_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_double_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: V",
      "content": "Honor to you, my friend.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_double_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_skill_qte_double_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Well played.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "A worthy opponent.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Barely felt it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "...Never back down.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "The sun... never sets...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_die_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "I will not fall here...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_die_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Fight... or fall...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_die_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "To arms.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "In control.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Honor cannot be sullied.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_engage.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "To the lands afar.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Call it precision.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_scan.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Stay behind me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "A hunt isn't complete without a prize.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Worth the chase.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Nice trophy.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_aogusita_com_openbox_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: IV",
      "content": "Bounty of the sea.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_gondola_treasure.play_favor_word_aogusita_sys_gondola_treasure"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Seal of Sun and Gryphon",
      "content": "The stone used to craft this seal was quarried from the very mountains where Septimont's ancestors first set foot. Smooth and resilient, its pure white surface bears winding patterns carved by time itself, an indelible mark of history etched into the land.\n\nAdorning the seal are a gryphon and a sun, both forged from precious metals. The former represents valor and vision, while the latter represents eternity and glory. This small seal carries the hopes and dreams of Septimont's founders, a constant reminder to its bearer not to forget the resolve that began it all.\n\nAugusta still remembers the feel of it at her fingertips when she held it for the first time. It was cold yet tinged with a quiet heat. The heat of power. She knows well that behind that power lies more than just honor. The seal, though light enough to be tossed in the air, rests heavy in the palm, like the weight upon her shoulders, a burden that cannot be cast off.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure110_UI.T_Treasure110_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Old Headband",
      "content": "Before Augusta made a name for herself, she scraped together earnings from odd jobs to buy this headband adorned with the traditional patterns of Septimont. Back then, she was just another nameless Gladiator living a hard life, unseen and unheard. Every time before stepping foot into the arena, she would tie this headband around her head. It bore witness to every battle she fought and quietly wiped away every silent tear she shed.\n\nOn the eve of a bloody Agon, Augusta laid the headband flat across her knees. With clumsy hands, she stitched a single line of small words onto its underside:\n\n\"May I never forget why I draw my blade when I bleed.\"\n\nThe characters were crooked, the needlework rough. When the final thread was pulled, she stood and tied the headband tight once more.\n\nShe didn't look back at the road that had brought her here.\n\nShe didn't need to.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure111_UI.T_Treasure111_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"Little Acorniator\"",
      "content": "When Augusta was a child, she made a \"playmate\" out of an acorn. Just like its oddly shaped, ill-fated siblings, it too came from the great oak in Fabianum.\n\nBack then, Augusta hadn't yet learned the art of crafting. Most of the \"Acorniators\" she made were misshapen, some with broken legs, others with squashed heads. She gave each of those short-lived little fellows a name, then laid them to rest in the garden. Until one warm evening, she handed an unfinished Acorniator to her father. And in his hands, it came to \"life.\" Solid. Handsome. Just like a real, mighty Gladiator.\n\nThat's right. Little Acorniator was a decorated Gladiator. Its heroic feats included:\n\n—Defeating a spider that tried to spin a web on its helmet.\n—Defeating a storm that blew in through the window.\n—Defeating Acorniator \"Chunky.\"\n—Defeating Acorniator \"Lanky.\"\n\nIn young Augusta's boundless imagination, Little Acorniator was the perfect image of a Hero of the Heroes.\n\nYears have passed. Now, Little Acorniator rests quietly in the corner of her study, like a weathered veteran enjoying a well-earned retirement. Meanwhile, the girl who once looked up to it still marches forward, steady as ever, down her own path to greatness.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure112_UI.T_Treasure112_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Hunter's Path",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after performing Heavy Attack to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Dodge Counter</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> after a successful Mid-air Dodge to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep</color></size>\nWhen <te href=130602>Prowess</te> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.\n- While in action, <color=Highlight>release</color> or <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> again within a certain period to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color> is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color></size>\nAugusta whirls and lashes out with her Broadblade, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump</color> when <te href=130602>Prowess</te> is full to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.\nIf Prowess is full when casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade</color>, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.\nIf Prowess is full when casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter – Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color>, <color=Highlight>release Normal Attack</color> after a certain period or <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Jump</color> again to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color>, dealing, <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color></size>\nWhen <te href=130602>Prowess</te> is full, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep</color></size>\nWhen <te href=130603>Ascendancy</te> is full, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> following a successful Dodge on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep</color> in place of <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n- <color=Highlight>Release</color> or <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> again within a certain period into the action to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color> is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Prowess</color></size>\nAugusta can hold up to {0} points of Prowess.\n- Prowess is obtained when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack -       "skill": {
        "name": "Sunward Conquest",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} and release Resonance Liberation</color> to cast this skill. Augusta will sweep her Broadblade forward, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color></size>\nWhen <te href=130604>Majesty</te> reaches {0} stacks, <color=Highlight>hold Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color> costs no Resonance Energy but {0} stacks of Majesty instead.\n- When casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color>, Augusta generates the <color=Highlight><te href=130605>Ruler's Realm</te></color> and enters the <color=Highlight><te href=130606>Sworn Allegiance</te></color> state for {1}s. Within this duration, time is temporarily stopped, and <color=Highlight>Resonator switching</color> is disabled. Only <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne</color>, <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> can be performed in the <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> state. <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> is available while airborne.\n- In the <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> state, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press}</color> or <color=Highlight>hold Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne</color>. Augusta can walk on water without consuming STA in this state.\n- Performing <color=Highlight>environmental, gameplay, or other interactions</color> ends <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> without triggering <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. After casting <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne</color> {2} times, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Casting <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color> ends the <color=Highlight><te href=130606>Sworn Allegiance</te></color> state and consumes all stacks of <te href=130601>Crown of Wills</te> later. All other Resonators in the team will be made to leave the field.\n- When <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> ends, <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color> is automatically cast.\n- During <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color>, <color=Highlight>hold Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color> early.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ruler's Realm</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Ruler's Realm</color> lasts for {3}s.\n- When Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> within <color=Highlight>Ruler's Realm</color>, they gain a shield equal to {5} + {4} of Augusta's Max HP for {6}s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Majesty</color></size>\nAugusta can hold up to 2 stacks of Majesty.\n- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color>.\n- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when other Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight>Outro Skill</color> under the effect of Augusta's <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Battlesong of the Unyielding</color>.",
        "param": [
          "2",
          "7",
          "9",
          "30",
          "5%",
          "650",
          "10"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} and release Resonance Liberation</color> to cast this skill.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color></size>\nWhen Majesty is full, <color=Highlight>hold Resonance Liberation</color> to cast this skill and enter <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> for {1}s.\n- During the <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> state, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press}</color> or <color=Highlight>hold Normal Attack</color> to perform up to {2} strikes, which unlocks a powerful finisher move. While in <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color>, <color=Highlight>hold Resonance Liberation</color> to cast the finisher early.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Majesty</color></size>\n- Augusta obtains 1 stack of Majesty when casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color>.\n- When other Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight>Outro Skill</color> under the effect of Augusta's Outro Skill, Augusta obtains 1 stack of Majesty.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Call Me By the Sun",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color></size>\nWhen <te href=130603>Ascendancy</te> is full, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill</color> during the action to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color> can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.\n- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color> can be cast some time again after being interrupted.\n- Can be cast mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill</color> during the action to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color> can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.\n- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color> can be cast some time again after being interrupted.\n- Can only be cast mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color></size>\nConsume all <te href=130603>Ascendancy</te> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n- Casting this skill grants 1 stack of <te href=130604>Majesty</te>.\n- Can only be cast mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color></size>\nWhen <te href=130603>Ascendancy</te> is full, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill</color> after a successful ground Dodge or <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill</color> after successful Mid-air Dodge to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\n- <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill</color> during the action to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color> can be cast again some time after being interrupted.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ascendancy</color></size>\nAugusta can hold up to {0} points of Ascendancy.\n- Ascendancy is obtained when <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color> deal damage.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare</color> restores {1} Ascendancy.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade</color> restores {2} Ascendancy.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath</color> restores {3} Ascendancy.",
        "param": [

          "20%",
          "10%",
          "40%"

        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color></size>\nWhen Ascendancy is full, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color>, which can be chained with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ascendancy</color></size>\nObtain Ascendancy through <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade</color>,  <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath</color>.",

    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Spectral Examination Report RA1556-G]\n\nResonance duration unknown.     {
      "title": "The Patroller and the Taoist",
      "content": "On <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> City's Main Street, a stall owner was still scrolling through forums when a girl with fiery red hair stopped at her stand. She glanced up over her slipping glasses and smiled.\n\n\"Hey there, boss. Want to try something? Exorcisms, talisman readings, fortune-telling… You name it, I 'bling'—wait, you're a <te href=850087>Patroller</te>?\"\n\n\"That's right! Chixia, <te href=850112>Jinzhou Patroller</te>!\" Chixia straightened with pride at being recognized, then quickly regained her serious tone. \"I've had reports about you setting up a stall without permission, offering readings to anyone who walks by. It's almost like—\"\n\n\"A scam?\" Buling's grin didn't waver.\n\n\"…I wouldn't go that far. But I'd appreciate it if you came by the <te href=850089>Patrol Station</te> to give a statement about your… business.\"\n\n\"Aiya, Boss, it's all honest work, building good bonds lah. Take that young fellow from <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te> who came yesterday morning. He asked me to divine his research project. By now, I'd wager he's on his way here to thank me.\"\n\n\"Seriously?\" Chixia began to question, but before she could finish, a young man in a lab coat came hurrying up the street and stopped at the stall.\n\n\"Thank you, Master! My experiment finally succeeded—the data fit perfectly! I can finally publish a paper!\"\n\n\"No need to thank me,\" Buling said, waving him off. \"That was all your hard work and persistence paying off.\"\n\nUnder Chixia's astonished gaze, the researcher bowed his thanks several more times before hurrying away.\n\n\"He just needed a little more confidence in his research, that's all,\" Buling said, nudging her round glasses back into place.\n\nAll afternoon, Chixia tailed this suspicious stall owner as she guided a <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> courier anxious about the career, sold a prosperity talisman to a travelling merchant, and read a local's palm for signs of love. Each request was different, Buling's answers just as varied, yet every customer left looking satisfied.\n\nBy sunset, Buling began packing up her stall. She glanced toward the shade of a nearby tree and called out, \"Relax. I've earned enough for now, so no more stalls for a while. And I'm starving. How about dinner at your auntie's place? My treat. But just so you know that I'm not ordering anything spicy.\"\n\n\"Wait—how do you even know Mrs. Panhua is my… Did you divine that too?\" Chixia stepped out of the shadows.\n\n\"Oh, that?\" Buling grinned. \"She told me herself. Over lunch.\"\n\nNot long after, <te href=850154>Mengzhou</te>'s wandering Taoist Buling and Jinzhou's famed Speedster Chixia would team up to tackle a so-called haunting event on Main Street. But that, of course, is another story."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Way of Flexibility",
      "content": "Thick clouds smothered the moonlight that night, plunging the world into darkness.\n\n\"It's right there, Master!\"\n\nAt his young disciple's cry, the aged Taoist shaped a quick mudra with one hand and leveled his peachwood sword with the other. Golden light leapt from the blade, streaking toward the corner of a wall. It struck something unseen, flared outward, and flooded the alley with daylight-bright radiance—revealing a Whisperin <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te> crouched in the shadows.\n\nHis eyes flicked to his disciple. She had already drawn a talisman and begun her chant:\n\"Body and seal align, thunder at command… All evils, repelled!\"\n\nThe words had barely left her lips when a bolt of lightning split the sky, crashing down upon the Tacet Discord. Wrapped in thunderlight, the creature began to fade. Though her talisman was already spent, the girl stayed on guard, fishing a copper coin from her pocket as she stepped closer.\n\n\"…Finally… home…\"\n\nThe broken whisper froze her in place.\n\n\"Pull yourself together, Buling,\" came her master's deep, steady voice. \"A Tacet Discord is nothing but a monster. It's no ghost, and certainly nothing human.\"\nShe nodded, flicked the coin into the air, and another flash of lightning cleaved the darkness. The Tacet Discord vanished completely. The old Taoist's furrowed brow eased as he turned toward the house, whose gates were tightly shut.\n\nThree measured knocks. The door creaked open, and a silver-haired elder stepped out.\n\n\"Master, was it really… my son who returned?\"\n\nIt was Buling's first time following her master down the mountain to \"exorcise a ghost.\" On their way back to the sect, she couldn't help but ask,\n\"Master, you always say there are no such things as ghosts. So why tell that lady her son's spirit came home to see her? And even pass along a message for her to live well?\"\n\"…That's called the Way of Flexibility. Someday, you'll understand.\"\n\"Mm… Seems the world beyond the mountain really does hold a lot to see.\"\n\"Heh… when you're strong enough to stand on your own and want to travel alone, then go,\" he said, grinning up at the endless stars. \"Cultivation isn't confined to our temple's four walls. Your world should be far wider than this.\"\n\nAt that, Buling's clear eyes filled with the same bright starlight.\n\n\"…But if you ever stir up trouble out there,\" Master Jiufeng added quickly, \"don't speak of my name.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Peers of Different Sects",
      "content": "That year's Martial Arts Championship took place on a lone peak straddling the border of <te href=850154>Mengzhou</te> and <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. The nearest edge of the <te href=270001>Land of Xuanfang</te> was still a hundred miles away or so, yet martial art sects from across the world flocked to the mountain. Rumor had it that even a reclusive master from Xuanfang might descend to watch.\n\n\"Hehe, my disciple's a straightforward child, only knows how to throw punches. So please, tell yours to go easy on her,\" Master Shiling stroked his long beard and smiled.\n\"Ah, I heard that the Fengyiquan Sect is full of talent, and Jianxin is undoubtedly unmatched. My own disciple just toys with coins and talismans, hardly worth anyone's attention,\" Master Jiufeng wasn't about to be outdone.\n\nOn the ring, Buling and Jianxin faced each other.\n\n\"Did you hear that, Jianxin? They're basically dueling through us,\" Buling whispered. \"Maybe we should just qui—\"\n\"Understood,\" Jianxin was already in Fengyiquan's Calming Air stance. \"Let's face this match with the respect it deserves. After you.\"\n\nBuling sighed and formed her hand mudras. Against Jianxin's flawless technique, she would only get one shot. Her Casket of Fate burst open—talismans whirled like a storm, lightning split the sky, and the Five Thunders Spell Array snapped shut around Jianxin. A breath later, Jianxin surged forward. Wind and cloud followed her fists. In the next instant, talismans shattered and the array crumbled. By the third breath, her fist hovered at Buling's side.\n\n\"Well fought, Buling. Another round?\" Jianxin said, bowing as she stepped back.\n\"No need. I quit.\" Buling raised her hand in surrender.\n\nLater, Buling found a good spot in the stands, munching on New Federation popcorn as she watched the young martial artists clash. Jianxin tore through her opponents like a gale, already closing in on the reigning champion.\n\n\"Why did you hold back?\"\n\nThe voice was cool and clear. Buling jumped, as she hadn't even heard anyone approach. A white-robed woman sat nearby, a guqin in her arms, her expression serene and detached, nothing like an ordinary martial artist.\n\n\"If you triggered the talismans behind her, the match might have gone differently.\" \n\"I wasn't thinking that far ahead at the time… Master,\" Buling answered with an awkward laugh.\n\nThe woman simply nodded. She said nothing more, only stayed beside Buling and watched the rest of the matches in silence."
    },
    {
      "title": "Earthly Immortal, Heavenly Sheep",
      "content": "Buling made friends with Encore on an unexpected occasion.\n\nBack then, she had just passed Camellya's test and arrived at <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> archipelago for the first time as a Consultant. The Gardener who welcomed her mentioned a bit of gossip: people in the Haven of Sprouts had been whispering about faint, sorrowful female cries haunting the dorm at midnight.\n\nIt wasn't serious enough to count as an emergency that required proper investigation, probably just a stray Reverberation rambling around. Still, on an island carved from a massive Tacetite, even a random Reverberation could twist into a dangerous <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te>. Someone had to check it out. Buling, known for her sharp ear for these things, volunteered.\n\nThat night, she waited in the dorm corridor, scrolling forums to pass the time as she heard soft footsteps. When she looked up, she nearly dropped her device: two \"Wooly Ghost Guards\" of black and white stood before her with ferocious looks.\n\n\"Hooray! The brave Wooly Warriors have found a new team member,\" a cheerful voice said. Encore poked her head out from behind the plush toys, grinning.\n\nThe truth turned out to be simple: a <te href=850110>Tethys</te> Terminal in the Haven had picked up an old cassette of ghost stories. A faulty signal module accidentally broadcast it over the dorm speakers, and thus the \"haunting\" event.\n\nBy morning, a post went viral on the Black Shores' internal forum with its eye-catching title:\n\"Turns out, the creepy midnight cries coming from the Haven of Sprouts are actually...\"\n\nThe poster ID was \"Earthly Immortal,\" and the first enthusiastic reply came from \"Heavenly Sheep.\"\n\nThat was the day the now-famous mystery-busting duo was born. From the Black Shores to <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> and <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>, \"Earthly Immortal\" and \"Heavenly Sheep\" became legends by exposing hoaxes, chasing rumors, and unraveling every supposed haunting that crossed their path.\n\nWhenever people ask Buling why she chose to join the Black Shores, she just laughs it off. Her bestie Encore, however, always gives the same teasing answer:\n\"She thinks if the Black Shores can clear all the 'ghosts' in the world, then she'll finally be free to roam wherever she wants!\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Free Spirit in Travel",
      "content": "Compared to the quiet temple on the mountain, the world beyond felt vast and unruly, alive with a thousand voices. Without her master's sheltering, Buling's first days away from home were uneasy and frustrating. Had she not rescued that <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te> researcher from <te href=850154>Mengzhou</te>, who repaid her with a prototype headset that muffled intrusive sensations, she might have suffered from those ceaseless whispers far longer.\n\nShe drifted through crowded streets, learning the rhythms of modern city life step by step. Her master's words on flexibility became her compass: times change, and so must the sect. Talismans and tools should evolve with the world. Every so often, she sent her master some exorcist gadgets she bought or improved upon: a microwave alchemy furnace, an exorcism bell with a built-in alarm clock, or a fly-whisk that glowed neon at night. Her proudest creation was a voice-controlled peachwood sword, able to swerve midair at a single command, far more convenient than the old sword-riding techniques.\n\nHer master's patience eventually wore thin. One day, a letter arrived with just two bold words written in clean calligraphy: \"UTTER NONSENSE.\" But when Buling finally returned to the temple, she found him waiting there—wearing that very sword on his back.\n\nHer journey stretched on, a winding road of self-cultivation. She crossed most of <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, stood on <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, and ventured into the New Federation. She marveled at Mengzhou's endless waters, braved Chongzhou's jagged peaks, walked through rule-based nations, and wandered lawless lands where only the strong survived.\n\nMuch later, in <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>, she received an assignment through the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> system: assist a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores who, like her, had traveled far. From the start, she sensed {Male=his;Female=her} identity was more complicated than the records suggested, as {Male=his;Female=her} fate lines were tangled beyond divination. Their paths crossed again and again: in Septimont City with both bright and dark sides, in hunting grounds haunted by the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>, and in the ruins of destroyed Honami City. None of those places could be called peaceful.\n\nBuling thought of herself as a free spirit, roaming wherever whim led her. That Rover was different—no carefree traveler, but someone forever running from one storm to the next. And still, for reasons she could not name, she wanted to see that person smile, as if {Male=he;Female=she}, too, could take a moment to enjoy the journey. The quiet gathering at Shashou Cafe was one of those rare, unburdened moments.\n\nWhere would their journeys converge next? Buling's hand hovered over her divination set, then she let it fall. When the time is right, their fates will meet again. And when they do, she will be there to offer {Male=him;Female=her} a steady hand, just as she always has."

      "content": "After these enlightenments, I think I can now read more in you. Something I missed before. It's like a knot, but... still unclear. Master once said, if I can't read something, then it must be the world's deepest mystery. Doesn't matter. Even if I'm just a tiny drop in the ocean of fate, when I can finally see it, I will help you break the bind and rewrite the stars.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_buling_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "Thunder over mountain!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_a_01.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_a_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "Thunder Seal, break!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_a_02.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_a_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: III",
      "content": "Your force, back at you!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_a_03.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_a_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: IV",
      "content": "Fu Talisman, go!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_b_01.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_b_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: V",
      "content": "Yi Gua, shift!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_b_02.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_b_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: VI",
      "content": "Quaking thunder.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_b_03.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk01_b_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: VII",
      "content": "Twin thunders, together!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_a_01.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_a_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: VIII",
      "content": "Patching you up.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_a_02.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_a_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: IX",
      "content": "Take a breath la!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_a_03.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_a_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: X",
      "content": "Two mountains, crush!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_b_01.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_b_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: XI",
      "content": "Quiet now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_b_02.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_b_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: XII",
      "content": "Here, some life force.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_b_03.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk02_b_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: XIII",
      "content": "Ah. Too greedy...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk03_01.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk03_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: XIV",
      "content": "No one saw that, right?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk03_02.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk03_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: XV",
      "content": "Aiya, rusty hands, rusty hands...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk03_03.play_favor_word_buling_atk_heavyatk03_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Hear the thunder!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_buling_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Cleansing!",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Binding!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_buling_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Five Thunders have spoken. Demons, perish!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_buling_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Thunder commands. Hell, tremble!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_buling_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Heaven's thunder awakens. Ghosts, vanish!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_buling_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "All evils, repelled!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_skill_qte_01.play_favor_word_buling_skill_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "By heaven's mandate.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_skill_qte_02.play_favor_word_buling_skill_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: III",
      "content": "Deities, hear my call.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_skill_qte_03.play_favor_word_buling_skill_qte_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Ugh, bad luck.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_buling_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Tsk. Always trouble.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_buling_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Chill la, I got this.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_buling_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "No more playing around.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_buling_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Where's my Fu talisman?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_buling_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Spells... all used up...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_die_01.play_favor_word_buling_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Heaven, have pity...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_die_02.play_favor_word_buling_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Sorry, no can do...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_die_03.play_favor_word_buling_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Spirit, I command you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_buling_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "My guardian, show yourself.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_buling_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Got \"ghosts\"? Gotta bust 'em all la!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_engage.play_favor_word_buling_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider: I",
      "content": "I go where wind goes.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_buling_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider: II",
      "content": "Wooohooo.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_fly_02.play_favor_word_buling_com_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Big luck, big score!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_scan.play_favor_word_buling_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Tao says go!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_buling_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Saw this in the hexagrams.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_buling_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Good timing, fortune flows!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_buling_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Nice! Lemme post a picture!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_buling_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_buling_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Tinted Sunglasses",
      "content": "Many have wondered whether the Master Exorcist's tinted sunglasses hold any special powers—blocking disturbances, perhaps? Or identifying demons and deities?\n\nWhen Buling finally bought this stylish pair in a bustling store, she just wanted another shiny accessory to brighten her look. Still, somewhere deep down, she might have desired such speculations. After all, it's the fanciful meanings people project onto an object that make it worth more than its price.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure124_UI.T_Treasure124_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Casket of Fate",
      "content": "On her first few trips down the mountain, Buling used to stuff her talismans into her pockets, only to pull them out all wrinkled when it came time to fight. Sometimes they even scattered across the ground, leaving her scrambling in a panic to gather them up during a fight.\n\nTo save herself from further embarrassment, she repurposed a charming little casket she found, refitting it to hold an entire stack of talismans and adding a few convenient extras: navigation, feng shui reading, and fortune-telling. As for what the casket originally carried, well… probably bubble gum.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure123_UI.T_Treasure123_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Noise-Cancelling Headset",
      "content": "As Buling grew older and her Forte matured, the noises in her ears grew sharper, impossible to ignore. Beyond the temple's walls, she couldn't keep chanting to hold them back the way she could in quiet practice. The relentless clamor gnawed at her mind. Then one day, dazed and aching after dragging someone out of a swarm of Tacet Discords, that person gently placed a Huaxu Academy's invention on her head. In that instant, her world fell completely silent.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure122_UI.T_Treasure122_UI"
    }
  ],

    "rarity": 2
  },

      "skill": {
        "name": "Hexagram Calls, Lightning Falls",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume the highlighted Trigram - Mountain and Trigram - Thunder from left to right and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume the highlighted Trigram - Thunder and Trigram - Mountain from left to right and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain</color>, dealing a small amount of <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and additionally reducing the target's Vibration Strength.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume the highlighted 2 Trigrams - Mountain from left to right and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color>, healing all nearby Resonators in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume the highlighted 2 Trigrams - Thunder from left to right and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color>, healing all nearby Resonators in the team once per second for {0}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Ghost Gate Omen</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>holding Normal Attack</color> with fewer than {1} Trigrams, Buling fails the divination, becoming temporarily immobilized and losing all Trigrams and {2} of her current HP. This effect will not consume HP if Buling's current HP is below {3}.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Mid-air Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> right after a successful Dodge to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n- After performing <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Trigram</color></size>\nBuling can hold up to {4} Trigrams. When Trigrams reach the max number, gaining new Trigrams moves all Trigrams {5} slot to the left, and the original leftmost Trigram will be removed.\n- Trigram - Mountain is obtained when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> deals damage.\n- Trigram - Thunder is obtained when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> deals damage.\n- Trigram - Thunder is obtained when casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - In Shadow Thunder Stirs</color>.",
        "param": [
          "8",
          "2",
          "20%",
          "1%",
          "4",
          "1"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume Trigram - Mountain and Trigram - Thunder in sequence and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume Trigram - Thunder and Trigram - Mountain in sequence and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain</color>, dealing a small amount of <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and additionally reducing the target's Vibration Strength.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume 2 Trigrams - Mountain and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color>, healing all nearby Resonators in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume 2 Trigrams - Thunder and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color>, continuously healing all nearby Resonators in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Ghost Gate Omen</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>holding Normal Attack</color> with fewer than {0} Trigrams, Buling fails the divination, becoming temporarily immobilized and losing some of her current HP.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Trigram</color></size>\n- Trigram - Mountain is obtained when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> deals damage.\n- Trigram - Thunder is obtained when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> deals damage.\n- Trigram -       "skill": {
        "name": "Thunder Begets Life",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Yin-Yang Balance</color></size>\nWhen Buling obtains Minor Yin and Minor Yang, she enters the <color=Highlight>Yin-Yang Balance</color> state, replacing her <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell</color> with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell: Harmony</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Flashing Thunder Spell - Harmony</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and generating a <color=Highlight>Five Thunders Spell Array</color> at the target area. The array deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and inflicts {1} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on all targets within it every {0}s, lasting for {2}s. When <color=Highlight>Five Thunders Spell Array</color> is active, all Resonators in the team enter the <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> state.\n- While in the <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> state, when any Resonator in the team casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>,  <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color> grants {3} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> DMG Bonus to all active Resonators in the team. When any Resonator in the team casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> during this state, <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color> grants {4} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> DMG Bonus to all active Resonators in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Minor Yang and Minor Yin</color></size>\n- Minor Yang is obtained after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain</color>.\n- Minor Yin is obtained after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color>.",
        "param": [
          "2",
          "2",
          "24",
          "10%",
          "25%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Yin-Yang Balance</color></size>\nWhen Buling obtains Minor Yin and Minor Yang, she enters the <color=Highlight>Yin-Yang Balance</color> state, replacing her <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell</color> with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell: Harmony</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Flashing Thunder Spell - Harmony</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and generating a <color=Highlight>Five Thunders Spell Array</color> at the target area. The array continuously deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and inflicts <color=Highlight>Electro Flare</color> on all targets within it. When the array is active, all Resonators in the team enter the <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> state.\n- While in <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color>, when any Resonator in the team casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color> grants <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> DMG Bonus to the active Resonator in the team. When any Resonator in the team casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> during this state, <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color> grants additional <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> DMG Bonus to the active Resonator in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Minor Yang and Minor Yin</color></size>\n- Minor Yang is obtained after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain</color>.\n- Minor Yin is obtained after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color>.",
        "simple_param": [],
        "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Atlas/SkillIcon/SkillIconBuling/SP_IconBulingC2.SP_IconBulingC2",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Mix-'n'-Match",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Huntress</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Huntress</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to continuously fire at enemies, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n- Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while Rebecca is not casting <color=Highlight>Tactical Dodge - Huntress</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress</color>\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Comin' in Hot! - Huntress</color></size>\nSomersault in mid-air and land.\nKeep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with <color=Title>Heavy Attack - Huntress</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Plunging Attack - Huntress</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Huntress</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> shortly after a Successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Tactical Dodge - Huntress</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Press Dodge</color> to attack the target while dodging, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\nCan be done while:\n- Performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Huntress</color>.\n- Performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Huntress</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Comin' in Hot! - Huntress</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Tactical Dodge - Huntress</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me!</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!</color>.\nAdditional <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> is dealt upon a Successful Dodge during <color=Highlight>Tactical Dodge - Huntress</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Guts</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Tactical Dodge - Guts</color> does not reset <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Huntress's</color> combo.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Guts</color></size>\nConsume STA and attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Plunging Attack</size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Guts</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> shortly after a Successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Tactical Dodge - Guts</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Press Dodge</color> and attack the target while dodging, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\nCan be executed while:\n- Performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Guts</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Tactical Dodge - Guts</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!</color>.\nAdditional <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> is dealt upon a Successful Dodge during <color=Highlight>Tactical Dodge - Guts</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. When holding <color=Highlight>Huntress</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> continuously deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>; While holding <color=Highlight>Guts</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> deals one instance of <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>.\n<size=40><color=Title>Special Dodge</color></size>\nWhile performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, Heavy Attack - Huntress, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>; <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge</color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",
        "simple_param": [],
