      "skill": {
        "name": "Tactical Tweaks",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill</color> when in the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> state to close the distance and spray lead at enemies, then switch to <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> state to blast the target, dealing </color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Guts</color> Stage 2.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me!</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill</color> when in the <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> state to spray lead at the enemy, afterwards shoot the ground, using the gun's recoil to close the distance to the enemy, then switch to the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> state to spray more lead at enemies, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack</color> when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with <color=Highlight>Comin' in Hot!: Huntress</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill</color> to switch between the <color=Highlight>Huntress</color> and <color=Highlight>Guts</color> states while dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",

        "desc": "Switching to <color=Highlight>Mk. {0} HMG</color> mode generates a field of Stagnation for {1}s, in which:\nRebecca fires the <color=Highlight>Mk. {2} HMG</color> automatically, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG, while accumulating <color=Highlight><te href=130803>Overload</te></color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> shortly after Rebecca starts firing to enhance her <color=Highlight>Mk. {3} HMG</color>'s firepower and accumulate <color=Highlight><te href=130803>Overload</te></color> faster. Fireworks!</color></size>\nAfter <color=Highlight>Mk. {13} HMG</color> mode ends or when <color=Highlight><te href=130803>Overload</te></color> is maxed, <color=Highlight>BOOM!       "skill": {
        "name": "My Turn!",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!</color></size>\nWhen in the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> state, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy and sprays lead, then switches to the <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> state to blast the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Press Basic Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Guts</color> Stage 2.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!</color></size>\nWhen in the <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> state, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy using the recoil force from shooting at the ground, then switches to the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> state to spray lead at the enemy, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Press or hold Normal Attack</color> when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with <color=Highlight>Comin' in Hot! - Huntress</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "Switch between the <color=Highlight>Huntress</color> and <color=Highlight>Guts</color> states while dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Gloves Are Comin' Off!",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Switch Gears!</color></size>\nUpon casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, Rebecca can freely switch between the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> states.\n- The <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> state increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by {0}.\n- The <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> state allows Rebecca to ignore {1} of the target's DEF.\nBy default, Rebecca starts in the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> state.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hack - Shifting</color></size>\nRebecca inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color> upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every {2}s:\n<color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hack Response - Meltdown</color></size>\nDeal all targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> within range <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Hack DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color></size>\nAt {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Huntress</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color>. <color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to cast<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color> which consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\nDuring <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Huntress</color>, if <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> is at {4} points and Rebecca is not in the action of <color=Highlight>Tactical Dodge - Huntress</color>, <color=Highlight>release Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts</color></size>\nAt {5} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Guts</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts</color>. <color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack </color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts</color>, which consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Fervor</color></size>\nRebecca can hold up to {6} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color>.\n<color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color> restore <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> upon damaging the target.\n<color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> restores <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> upon damaging the target.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!</color> restores <SapTag=7>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Fervor.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hot Hand</color></size>\nRebecca can hold up to  {8} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130806>Hot Hand</te></color>.\nRegenerates over time at a rate of <SapTag=9>{9}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=9} per second.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack -     "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1011-G]\n\nThe exact time and cause of Resonator Yangyang's Awakening remain unclear. While a strong Syntony reaction is present, the pattern also shares over 5% similarity with multiple other existing samples, indicating potential multiple or contaminating causes of Awakening.\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a stable rise. Fortunately, there were no casualties or hazards reported, though she suffered several comatose episodes due to the overstimulation.     "cv_name_cn": "Jen Zhang",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "The Secret to Excellence",
      "content": "In any social group, there are those who exude a convincing, reliable aura that convinces people they could achieve anything, despite not having started or done it before. \n\nYangyang is one such person.\n\n\"Yangyang? It seems... She can do everything so well.\" People would always say so. This trust probably stems from their experiences with her. \n\nSince childhood, Yangyang has excelled in her studies, including etiquette, music, literature, mathematics, and martial arts... She always ranked at the top in all subjects and exams every year. Even when encountering new knowledge or difficult problems, Yangyang never showed frustration; rather, she would actively try to solve any problem that came her way.\n\nYangyang was always chosen to give speeches at her school's annual ceremonies. But, like everyone else, she would take a deep breath before speaking, hiding her nerves. Despite having some talent for understanding complex concepts, she lacked true genius. And while others may see her as successful and confident, she struggles just as much with everyday problems.\n\nIn her first swordsmanship lesson, she struggled to control her swings and execute proper techniques. Despite this setback, she resolved to work even harder. For the next two months, she practiced 100 times a day and sought guidance from experienced seniors, humbly acknowledging her weaknesses. She then continued to practice with a reflective mindset, improving upon the deficiencies pointed out by others. Eventually, her muscles adapted to the pain and she could withstand several strikes from an opponent.\n\nAnd in another two months, Yangyang, once again, emerged as the top student in her swordsmanship class.\n\nConcerned individuals tried to console Yangyang, reminding her that life is not perfect and that she should be content with the affirmation and praise she receives. But Yangyang would kindly reject this advice, knowing that her drive came from within and not from seeking validation from others. \n\nWas she giving her all? Was everything done to the best of her ability? These were the questions that consumed her. \n\nWith a smile and a gentle shake of her head, she would reject any advice to take it easy, determined to push herself to perfection with no room for regrets or shame.\n\n\"That's our Yangyang, doing amazing as always. We knew you'd make it!\" \n\nThat was when Yangyang became an <te href=850139>Outrider</te> and successfully helped resolve a regional <te href=850081>TD</te> crisis. People praised her excellence as usual.\n\n<i>\"Yes, I did it this time, but how about next time? There are still so many things I could have done better; so many things I don't know. Perhaps I should go seek advice from senior members of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>...\"</i>\n\nBeing consistently reliable is daunting, yet crucial. It takes relentless effort and dedication.\n\nYangyang is determined to give her all to achieve this goal. She strives to be the one others can seek help from anytime, and won't stop until she succeeds."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Secret to Listening",
      "content": "Most people didn't know that Yangyang had a perfect pitch. \n\nPerhaps it was because how she was always a passive presence, never singing in public or taking the spotlight. She preferred to stay in the background and listen. It seemed like she was born to be a listener.\n\nThat's why Chixia was shocked at Yangyang's ability to accurately hum a melody she had only heard. She couldn't help but exclaim, \"How did you memorize that so fast? And it sounded amazing! Good heavens!\"\n\nSuddenly, everyone remembered Yangyang's other identity, the second daughter of a family of musicians. It would be only unnatural if she didn't understand music theory or know how to sing. \n\nThis revelation resolved some of the previous confusion. That perfect way of dealing with people, that etiquette which seemed faultless to even the most demanding people. Yes, of course, she had to come from such a well-educated family. \n\nHowever, it also begged another question: Why would the daughter of such a renowned family go to the border city alone, at the expense of her otherwise luxurious life and promising career? Was there an underlying reason that compelled her to leave? \n\nIf there really was such a reason, Yangyang never mentioned it to anyone. She never complained or avoided responsibilities, whether when she fulfilled her <te href=850139>Outrider</te> responsibilities, or when she spent time with friends. If one had to say, it was her Outrider companions that bothered her more, because... She was always patiently lending an ear.\n\nMany sought solace in confiding to Yangyang, not seeking solutions but simply venting their stress. She knew this well and remained neutral, empathizing with the narrator's feelings. She listened without interruption, offering guidance when needed before returning to a silent role. With her help, the tangled emotions were untangled unnoticed. These cathartic sessions proved valuable. However, Yangyang's support was not blind agreement; she offered advice prioritizing the speaker's desires.\n\nSoon enough, Chixia told everyone else about Yangyang's amazing talent, sparking playful requests for a song.\nYangyang shyly waved off their request, saying, \"Maybe... I'll sing it for everyone later, when I am ready?\" \n\nYangyang looked sincere, so it seemed not just perfunctory or an excuse. It was truly what she thought from the bottom of her heart. But when would that be? Perhaps she wanted to wait until everyone else who wanted her to hear out their worries had finished talking?\n\nUnderstanding and critiquing performances requires a deep knowledge of music. \nHowever, being skilled in music does not necessitate taking the stage. \n\nSo thought Yangyang, as she again chose to step back, allowing others to shine."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Secret to Believing",
      "content": "To some extent, there isn't much difference between the sixteen-year-old Yangyang and the six-year-old Yangyang.\n\nShe still holds the same expectations for the world, believing in fairy tales as always, believing in the goodness between people, believing in miracles, believing that all things beautiful will eventually happen.\n\nMany would call this naive luck, the thoughts of a spoiled child who has never faced the harsh realities of life.\n\nIndeed, Yangyang grew up in a privileged and nurturing home, shielded from suffering. Her life was perfect...\n\n...Until that fateful day.\n\nAt age 11, her tranquil life was shattered by a ruthless attack from Exiles while traveling with her family's caravan. The brutal reality of death and cruelty left her reeling as she fled and sought refuge among strangers in an unfamiliar settlement. These resilient people lived off the land, cautious yet resourceful. She was forced to fend for herself, adapting to this harsh new world at a young age. She couldn't tell if they were like the ruthless attackers or not. The constant alertness of these settlers made her question if it was safe to trust anyone. Dressed in fine clothes and alone, she stood out among them, and they too were suspicious of her. Could it be a trap?\n\nIn the end, they passed food to her, and she took it, though she'd never seen anything like it.\n\nKindness found its roots even in the most barren of lands. Yangyang wanted to repay the trust they released before her, but her knowledge proved not helpful at all in the wild, and her sword skills proved too childish against real hostility. Everything seemed entirely unfamiliar to her, yet this was the harsh reality most people had to face. The reality felt so overwhelmingly agonizing.\n\n\"Grandma, have you... been living like this all the time?\" As Yangyang tried to help an old lady sort out the meager resources they had, she couldn't help but ask this abrupt question.\n\n\"Yes, why? City girl. You shocked? Relax. Everything will be fine.\"\n\n\"But when? Will things really be fine one day?\"\n\n\"Of course. How will good things come true if you don't even believe them yourself? We were skeptical of you, too, but we chose to believe. It's the same for you. Gotta have faith in something in life. Even if you don't know how it'll turn out. That's what faith is all about.\"\n\n\"When? Hm, maybe when you grow up, little one.\"\n\nSo yes, perhaps Yangyang hasn't experienced enough hardship yet. Or maybe one's inclination to show kindness isn't based on past experiences, but inherent in their character.\n\nIn the darkest of situations, some will show kindness simply because others choose to trust them. And this in turn will spark more acts of goodwill.\n\nEver since, Yangyang always spread kindness to strangers, sparked by that one encounter.\n\nOf course, her kindness is not without boundaries. Betrayal can turn her warm breeze into a harsh storm.\n\nBut she holds onto hope, believing in the power of goodness. She chooses to trust and expects the best from others. This is her chosen way to make the world a better place."
    },
    {
      "title": "What Wind Taught Her",
      "content": "Yangyang had fallen into the winds three times.\n\nThe first time was when she fell from her mother's arms.\n\nShortly after Yangyang's birth, she was already surrounded by love. Her mother playfully swung her in her arms, pretending she was flying and landing. \n\nBut when the swing went a little too high, Yangyang felt the whispers of wind and sensed an approaching storm, even before she could speak. As she landed, her babbling was mistaken for fear from the accident, but it was actually a reaction to the oncoming tempest.\n\nThe second time was when she passed out from sensory overload.\n\nAs she grew up, Yangyang's once vague sensing ability strengthened, allowing her to feel intangible airstreams in her palms. She called them the \"Streams,\" and they gave her insights into energy fluctuations, anomalies, and even the smallest physical details of a person. \n\nTrapped in a self-destructive cycle, Yangyang yearned to explore her ability and gain more insight. But the more she tried to be thorough, the deeper she fell into a maze of details.\n\nWhat followed cannot be called a fall, for it was a descent through time, not space. The sensory overload lasted for months, between faintness and sobriety. Yangyang felt as light as a feather caught in a raging storm, perpetually falling.\n\n\"I must focus on the key details within my reach, rather than trying to capture everything...\" Finally, Yangyang pulled herself out of the never-ending free fall and safely landed.\n\nThe third, but maybe not the last time, was when Yangyang leaped up and threw herself into the winds.\n\nThe continual sensory overload altered her hair and taught Yangyang to tolerate the discomfort. Despite the Streams' excessive information, the recipient could sift through and extract crucial details. Signs of a struggle at the disappearance site, unusual fluctuations outside the city, and a steady rise in energy reactions...\n\nYangyang had never used her ability in such a dire situation, but her determination to help overrode any hesitation. The Streams surged, forming a distinct line that led to a missing child, being chased by <te href=850081>TDs</te> and teetering on the edge of a cliff. Without hesitation, Yangyang leaped towards the precarious figure, stretching out her hand to save the child.\n\nFeathers danced in the air, carrying Yangyang and the child in a gentle yet powerful wind. The child looked around at the floating feathers and asked, \"Are you the lark fairy that flies in the wind, miss?\" \n\nLost in memories, Yangyang smiled. She thought of the times when she fell into the winds, again and again. Perhaps she truly was one with the winds."
    },
    {
      "title": "Answer Lies in the Winds",
      "content": "On her journey away from home, Yangyang met two kinds of people.\n\nThe first kind always seemed in such haste, yet remained unsure where they were heading, and often ended up lost and returned in regret. The other kind always had a clear destination in mind. They always made it finally, despite arduous roads and occasional stumbles. Yangyang held up her head and looked at Jinzhou city on the horizon, unsure if she could be considered one of the second kind of people. Once again, she thought of the term \"One Instrument for Life.\"\n\n\"One Instrument for Life.\" That is the most important principle in Yangyang's family teachings. Originally, it meant that every family member could strive to excel in everything, but they must choose one musical instrument to specialize in and practice continuously throughout their life to become a master. As circumstances changed, the principle gradually evolved into dedicating one's entire life to one pursuit, striving for excellence to make this life worthwhile.\n\nHer mother's Instrument was composing. Yangyang had seen people dancing to her mother's songs. On the other hand, Yangyang's sister was already a successful figure in the chamber of commerce.\n\nHowever, Yangyang could not easily decide on her own Instrument as they once did. What was the thing worthy of dedicating her life to? What person should she be?\n\nShe turned to her mother for help: <i>Mother, do you want me to inherit the family business? Or, what do you want me to do? I can try anything and I will strive for excellence. Although life is full of infinite possibilities, in the end, we can only choose one path, right?</i>\n\nHer mother looked at her with love and said, <i>my child, it is precisely because of this that you should not seek answers from me, but rather ask your own heart. This is a difficult question, but you need not rush an answer.</i>\n\nAnd so, Yangyang held onto her question, waiting patiently for an answer that seemed to elude her. She waited through her returning home from the desolate settlement, through the climbing out of an abyss, and through growing weary of her family's overprotectiveness. Her desire to join the world and experience its harshness grew stronger, no longer content with being a mere leaf drifting in the wind. She longed to bear the weight of reality, instead of hiding away from it.\n\nThat was when a sudden ambush in the wilderness resulted in heavy casualties from <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te> attacks on the frontline. News of this tragedy quickly spread through the city, igniting feelings of sorrow, anger, and despair among its inhabitants. Emotions boiled over, with people gathered around a bonfire. Tears flowed freely, hoarse cries echoed through the night. But by morning, grief became a luxury as life returned to normal. \n\nYangyang stood among them, tears streaming down her face. She hadn't experienced any personal loss, but witnessing their sorrow and the joy of the rescued children stirred something inside her. It was a transformative moment, as she realized her true calling: to protect others, just as she had been protected before. She wanted to shield them from misfortune and give them hope for a brighter future.\n\nAs Yangyang stood at the edge of Jinzhou on her enrollment night as an <te href=850139>Outrider</te>, she gazed at the sky and the bustling residents below. Doubt crept in as she questioned her ability to protect these lively citizens, a responsibility she had always dreamed of fulfilling.\n\nThe Streams came from afar and gently held Yangyang in their embrace, dispelling her last bits of doubt.\n\nThey silently whispered: Jinzhou is the place. It is the destination for Yangyang the wealthy daughter, and the beginning of her journey as Yangyang the Outrider."

    {
      "title": "Striped Ribbon",
      "content": "Yangyang's blue beret always has a delicate ribbon attached to its brim. It's her signature look, and a precious gift from her mother before she embarked on her journey.   \nTo Yangyang, it symbolizes her mother's blessing and marks the start of her own journey. She holds onto the resolution she made when putting on the ribbon, determined to see it through until the end.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure20_UI.T_Treasure20_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Sound Recorder",
      "content": "As Yangyang grew accustomed to the constant presence of Streams, she began to contemplate capturing the fleeting sound of the wind. With the help of Baizhi's modifications and innovative energy conversion technology, a device was created to store the Streams as visual and tangible information. Whether it be the gentle sound of snow falling on a mountain, an untold story, or a poignant moment that brings tears to one's eyes, Yangyang now had the ability to record these realities that her senses were attuned to.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure28_UI.T_Treasure28_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "All in One",
      "content": "Yangyang has been crafting wind chimes since she was a child, using polished jade crystals in the shape of birds as plectrums. Starting with just a few, she has now collected and gifted dozens of them to her loved ones. Each one is different, with intricate designs that evolve over time as Yangyang adds new plectrums and adjusts their placement. She sees it as a never-ending journey, with endless possibilities for interpretation. Despite not knowing what kind of melody the wind chimes will eventually create, Yangyang stays true to her original intention—a lifelong pursuit of perfecting her craft, just like her family's tradition of \"One Instrument for Life.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure33_UI.T_Treasure33_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Feather as Blade",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nYangyang performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nYangyang consumes STA to lunge forward, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Zephyr Song</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Zephyr Song</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nYangyang consumes STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to thrust forward, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size> \nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Zephyr Song</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> right after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Zephyr Song</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Echoing Feathers",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Stormy Strike</color></size>\nWhen Yangyang has {0} Melodies, she can cast <color=Highlight>Stormy Strike</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Feather Release</color></size>\nWhen Yangyang has {1} Melodies, cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> in mid-air to consume all Melodies and perform consecutive strikes, diving from mid-air, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. As Yangyang lands, she sheathes her sword with an attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Melody</color></size>\nYangyang can hold up to {2} Melodies\nYangyang obtains {3} Melody with every <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color> on hit.\nYangyang obtains {4} Melody for every Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Zephyr Song</color> on hit.\nYangyang obtains {5} Melody for every Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Zephyr Domain</color> on hit.\nYangyang obtains {6} Melody upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Cerulean Song</color>.",
        "param": [
          "3",

          "1",
          "1",
          "1",
          "1"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Stormy Strike</color></size>\nWhen Yangyang has {0} Melodies, she can cast <color=Highlight>Stormy Strike</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Feather Release</color></size>\nWhen Yangyang has {1} Melodies, she can cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> in mid-air to consume all Melodies and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Melody</color></size>\nYangyang can hold up to {2} Melodies.\nYangyang gains Melody through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Zephyr Song</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.",

    "info": "Aalto is an enigmatic Information Broker, known for his elusive nature and welcoming smile. Underneath the facade, he is closely affiliated with <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>.\nRumor has it he'll provide any information at the right price.",
    "talent_name": "Mistcloak Strike",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1617-G]\n\nAccording to Resonator Aalto's reports, there was a rare occurrence of heavy fog on the day of his birth. Aalto's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on the left side of his neck. Other than gaining the ability to briefly transform into a mist-like form, no significant physical changes have been observed in Aalto's body after his Awakening.\n\nResonator Aalto excels in the art of camouflage and transformation, often assuming an elusive and fluctuating physical state, akin to the characteristics of mist. Further tests conducted to ascertain the properties of the mist he conjures yielded inconclusive results.\n\nThe Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Aalto matches our known Spectrum Patterns of fog. Strong Syntony Reactions have been observed during testing, confirming the connection between fog and Aalto's Awakening. \nAdditionally, analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a noticeable periodic waveform, which classifies Aalto as a <te href=850068>Congenital Resonator</te>.\n\n\n<i>Researcher's Annotation: As stated in the report, this Resonator is cunning and a master of disguises, thus rendering the credibility of his recounts questionable.</i>\n\n<i>Annotation to the annotation: As a broker honoring integrity. I, Aalto, solemnly swear that the recount I presented is 100% truth. Nothing more, nothing less.</i>",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Aalto's waveform graph shows stable elliptical fluctuations in the Time Domain with no abnormal patterns. Upon examination, all results fall within normal parameters.\n\nResonant Criticality: Medium. Resonator Aalto's frequency displays high stability with a low risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>. \n\nResonator Aalto disappeared halfway through the Overclock diagnosis, thus no Overclocking history records were obtained.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Liang DaWei",
    "cv_name_jp": "Iwasaki Ryota",
    "cv_name_ko": "Im Chae Bin",
    "cv_name_en": "James Day"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "A Bad Deal",
      "content": "A bad deal.\n\nOr so it seemed.\n\nOne day, Aalto became known for the intel he had on some ancient treasure. From naughty children to old men in their sixties, many wanted to buy that intel from him, but he politely turned down every offer. \n\n\"Hey, little one. Better not spend your allowance on this. Let's get you home.\"\n\n\"Sorry, gramps. I don't accept retirement funds.\" \n\nThese people all assumed they didn't offer enough to pique Aalto's interest, but actually, he was simply waiting for the right buyer. \n\nThen, one day, that very buyer finally appeared, cloaked in layers. The man struck the deal with Aalto at a shockingly low price. Others were baffled by Aalto's willingness to accept such a bad offer. \n\nDays later, an electronic display in the New Federation police department office broadcasted the latest news: the long-sought theft ring had finally been caught. \n\nA cloud of mist crept into the police chief's office, obscuring the display.\n\n\"Enough TV. It's time to settle our deal.\"\n\nThe chief slammed a folder of files onto the desk, along with a suitcase filled with Credits.\n\n\"That's quite a trick you pulled off back there. Tell me, Mr. Aalto, how were you so sure they'd take the bait? Touting valuable intel about the legendary treasure in broad daylight, weren't you worried about catching their suspicion?\"\n\n\"Don't underestimate cash-chasing gamblers. They'll risk it all, even their lives. Profit is worth any danger to them.\"\n\nThe police chief pushed the files and suitcase towards Aalto.\n\n\"Here's your payment, and the list of names you requested. Pleasure doing business.\"\n\n\"Same to you.\" \n\nAalto opened the suitcase, took out a single piece of Shell Credit, and flipped it into the air. Before the Credit could touch the ground, he had already transformed into mist, vanishing from sight."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Fair Exchange",
      "content": "A fair exchange.\n\nUnder Aalto's rules.\n\nAccording to Aalto, every customer is equal. Be it a high-ranking official, an aristocrat, a commoner on city streets, or an Exile shunned by society, they are no different. Aalto never categorizes his customers into ranks — no high and low; no rich and poor. Treating every customer equally has always been his unwavering principle.\n\nYet, there would always be those who try to test his limit.\n\n\"Aalto, right? You're comin' with us.\"\n\nAalto sensed the ill intention behind the visitor's approach, but he put on a welcoming smile as usual.\n\n\"Aww... Sorry, pal, but that's a no-can-do. This customer right here was in line first.\"\n\nSuddenly, the other client was shoved aside as the thugs barged in, causing chaos and panic in the crowded room. The other patrons all fled, fearful of injury.\n\nAalto quickly came to the victim's aid, guiding them to safety with a gentle hand. With a calm demeanor, he righted a toppled chair and casually draped an arm around the agitated thug's shoulder.\n\n\"Listen, buddy, everything has its rules. I've got mine written down right here, see? 'First come, first served. No pushing or shoving.' What am I supposed to do with you breaking two rules in one go?\" \n\nThe thug shook his arm off, \"If our boss wants to see someone, he gets what he wants. That's the rule we go by.\"\n\nMist obscured the crowd as Aalto's words ended. He swiftly incited chaos, causing the thugs to turn on each other in panic.\n\n\"Oops, my bad. I forgot to mention another rule: 'No hustling deals.' Let your boss know not to break any rules next time. Can't do business without them.\"\n\nWith their tails tucked between their legs, the thugs fled, leaving Aalto to return to his usual welcoming smile. \n\n\"Alrighty then! Let's pick up where we left off. What was it you wanted to inquire about again, good sir?\""
    },
    {
      "title": "A Perfect Duo",
      "content": "A perfect duo.\n\nThat's how they dub themselves.\n\nWhenever Aalto the information broker is brought up, people can't help but think of that little girl with pink ponytails. The two are almost inseparable, and their presence brings a burst of noise wherever they go.\n\nOutside a heavily guarded building, a man in sunglasses leaned casually against the wall, while the little girl next to him used her hands as binoculars to scan the area.\n\n\"See the target? The one we're after.\"\n\n\"Yuppers! Target sighted. Encore will get it done real quick, as long as Aalto doesn't drag behind me!\" \n\n\"Aw. Encore, you broke my heart. My plan is flawle—\"\n\nBefore he could finish, Encore had already dashed out with Cloudy and Cosmos, leaving Aalto's words hanging in the air.\n\nIn the distance, Aalto could see Encore talking to the guard, making big gestures in the air, and occasionally pointing at him. \n\nWhen Aalto got there, the guard let him in and patted his shoulder. He looked sympathetic.\n\n\"Buddy, must be hard raising your daughter alone all these years.\" \n\nAalto simply nodded along in silent camaraderie. He took Encore inside the building without encountering any problems. \n\n\"Why do people always believe your stories, Aalto? They all sound so fake!\"\n\n\"You see, my stories are tailor-made for each situation.\"\n\n\"What's that supposed to mean?\"\n\n\"He's a single dad. He'd find that heartbreaking family tale you told super relatable. Also, what do you mean my stories are fake? \"\n\nCloudy and Cosmos jumped onto Encore's shoulders and sang a chorus of \"Baa, baa baa.\"\n\n\"Look! The Woolies think they sound super fake, too.\" \n\n\"Well, fake or not, they got the job done just fine. Alright, here comes the real deal. Time to bring out your A game.\"\n\n\"Woolies Adventure time. Let's do this!\""
    },
    {
      "title": "A Free Service",
      "content": "A service free of charge.\n\nAt least, that's how Encore saw it.\n\nAalto is well-known to be a profit-driven broker. Pay enough money and he'd readily provide any information. And so, his potential customers always come with a hefty sum of money prepared.\n\nHowever, his desired payments can sometimes be unpredictable and bizarre — ranging from a black pearl to a cloud in the sky or even a piece of music.\n\nSome may throw a tantrum over the seemingly ridiculous request, but Aalto would simply show them the door with a polite smile.\n\n\"My dear customer, ever heard of the saying 'amiability makes you rich'? You really need to mind your language. Besides, it's just business, not charity. If you can't be bothered with the payment, then I'm afraid we'll just have to do business at another time.\" \n\nOnce, a ragged little boy paced back and forth of Aalto's door for several days.\n\n\"Howdy, little man, what's with the long face? Let me guess. Lost your puppy?\"\n\n\"Wow! You really know everything! So, do you know where Pebbles went?\"\n\n\"You know, there's no such thing as a free lunch. You want my help, then you'll have to pay up.\"\n\nThe boy shook his head, disappointed,\"But I don't have anything on me.\"\n\n\"Well, that's rather unfortunate... Let's see. How about you pay me after I find Pebbles for you?\"\n\nAalto's mist soon spread to every corner. Eventually, he found the lost puppy outside the city and safely brought it back.\n\nBeneath the twinkling night stars, a happy puppy ran to the little boy, wagging its tail in excitement. \n\nAs today's story came to an end, Encore couldn't help but ask, \"I didn't know you'd help people for free!\"\n\nAalto responded with a smile, idly twirling a small marble in his hand. On its surface was a roughly carved smiley face, reminiscent of a young boy's crafting."
    },
    {
      "title": "Water the Flowers, Dear Guest",
      "content": "\"Welcome to <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>! Would you like to start by watering the flowers, or saving humanity?\"\n\nThe Black Shores is situated on a remote island. Aside from the regular monsoons, currents, and butterflies, the island is only ever visited by the rising and falling tides. This uncharted area is not found on any world map.\n\nThis secretive organization is dedicated to the lofty goals of world salvation: the kind people would only expect to see in tales.\n\nIt's no wonder that people often struggle to believe Aalto, a seemingly unserious and elusive figure, is tied to this enigmatic group.\n\nTo truly understand Aalto, one needs to see through his enigmatic exterior to uncover the kind and steadfast heart beating within.\n\nHe was well aware that his mist alone could never hide the permanent wounds inflicted by the <te href=850075>Lament</te> on this planet.\n\nThis is why he readily agreed to a long-term cooperation with the Black Shores upon first setting foot on the island through an invitation.\n\nSo far, he has provided the Black Shores with a wealth of intelligence and helped them recruit trustworthy candidates to bolster their Think Tank.\n\nHe will aid the Black Shores in putting together their plans... Until <i>that person<i> returns."
    }

      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Running out of mist.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_hp50.play_favor_word_qiushui_hp50"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Time to bring out my A-game.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_hp30.play_favor_word_qiushui_hp30"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "The mist never fades…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_die_01.play_favor_word_qiushui_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_die_02.play_favor_word_qiushui_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Time for tactical retreat.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_die_03.play_favor_word_qiushui_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Mind if I borrow this?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_hx_summon.play_favor_word_qiushui_hx_summon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Be right back!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_hx_change.play_favor_word_qiushui_hx_change"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Count me in!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_qte.play_favor_word_qiushui_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "We've got company.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_enter_battle.play_favor_word_qiushui_enter_battle"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Wow. Ain't that a view?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_fly.play_favor_word_qiushui_fly"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_hook.play_favor_word_qiushui_hook"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Seems like a new lead.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_scan.play_favor_word_qiushui_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_dash.play_favor_word_qiushui_dash"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_fast_run.play_favor_word_qiushui_fast_run"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Well, would you look at that! Easy money.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_chest_01.play_favor_word_qiushui_chest_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Now, that's a total steal.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_chest_02.play_favor_word_qiushui_chest_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Aaand… What's inside mystery box No. 01!?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiushui_chest_03.play_favor_word_qiushui_chest_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Wind Chimes",
      "content": "A seemingly inconspicuous bone flute that is, in fact, a tape recorder that Aalto has owned since he was a child. Aalto carries it with him on various occasions, and this small device has gathered a substantial amount of valuable intelligence for him.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure11_UI.T_Treasure11_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Intelligence Network",
      "content": "Aalto is a master at building connections and gathering information. He sees everyone as a potential asset in his intelligence network, making business cards highly valued. True friends are rare, but Aalto knows the key to success lies in knowing more people.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure10_UI.T_Treasure10_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Vintage Console",
      "content": "A retro-style gaming console. This console may only offer simple, old-school pixel games, but it ignited the competitive spirit within Aalto and Encore. Both of them have been trying to seize every opportunity to secretly play and outdo each other's high scores on the console. However, for Aalto, the greatest joy comes from having his own records surpassed.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure42_UI.T_Treasure42_UI"
    }
  ],

        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nAalto fires up to 5 consecutive shots, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.   "name": "Jiyan",
  "nick_name": "Windborne Rider",
  "desc": "Jiyan, leader of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>, acts with swift and resolute righteousness. He possesses the formidable ability to conjure a powerful Qingloong from the winds, making him invincible on the battlefield.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_11_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_11_UI",
  "background": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRolePile/T_IconRole_Pile_jiyan_UI.T_IconRole_Pile_jiyan_UI",
  "background_stand": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/RoleHalfBody/T_ActivityHalfBodyJiyan.T_ActivityHalfBodyJiyan",
  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "December 14th",
    "sex": "Male",
    "country": "Huanglong",
    "influence": "Jinzhou",
    "info": "Jiyan, leader of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>, acts with swift and resolute righteousness. He possesses the formidable ability to conjure a powerful Qingloong from the winds, making him invincible on the battlefield.",
    "talent_name": "Windborne Rider",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2141-G]\n\nResonator Jiyan's Forte-Awakening was observed at Camp Overwatch located in Desorock Highland. This event was characterized by the accumulation of air currents around his body, forming a distinctive lance.\n\nJiyan bears a distinctive <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> situated atop his dorsal ridge. Post-Awakening observations found some growths that resemble Loong scale on his left jaw. No indications of progressive expansion have been detected.\n\nResonator Jiyan possesses the ability to manipulate wind energy, which he can channel into a <ano=Teal Dragon>\"Qingloong\"</ano> that aids him in battle. Additionally, he possesses exceptional perception and leadership skills, utilizing his connection to the winds to gather and analyze battlefield information with astonishing accuracy. Empirical testing has shown an impressive accuracy rate of 99.12% in evaluating dynamic situations.\nJiyan's Resonance Spectrum Pattern shows no resemblance to known samples. The cause of his Awakening remains unknown.\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a steep rise in its middle section. Resonator Jiyan is thereby classified as a <te href=850069>Mutant Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "The waveform graph for Resonator Jiyan shows non-periodic rectangular pulse fluctuations, with sustained peak values during specific time intervals. These waveforms demonstrate rapid and substantial changes within a short temporal span. There are two distinct waveforms identified, each with exceptionally high peak values.\n\nResonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Jiyan's frequency displays high stability with a low risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n\nNo history of Overclocking has been documented. Routine examinations and counseling are recommended.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Sun Ye",
    "cv_name_jp": "Ono Yuki",
    "cv_name_ko": "Nam Doh Hyeong",
    "cv_name_en": "Alex Jordan"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "The Unyielding Will",
      "content": "Shortly after Jiyan's appointment as the Midnight Ranger's general, an unexpected <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te> Outbreak occurred. It was during this battle that he suspected the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>'s resurrection.\n\nAs the weary soldiers recovered from a fierce battle on the frontline, they were greeted by an ominous sight: shadow ravens circling above and swarms of Tacet Discords charging towards their position at the Norfall Barrens and Desorock Highland pass. \n\nThe outnumbered army knew that failure to defend this stronghold could spell doom for the entire Huanglong.\n\nEven seasoned veterans had never faced a crisis as urgent as this one. Amidst the chaos, Jiyan alone remained composed.\n\n\"All of you. Prepare to fight.\"\n\n\"Absurd! If we lose now, it's truly over. We can still retreat and protect the city!\"\n\n\"Choose now: stand with courage, seize our chance. Or run and face defeat. For centuries, the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> have held this pass without retreat. Or do you prefer to go down in history as cowards?\"\n\nThe veterans left, their emotions ranging from disappointment to rage.\n\nJiyan's resolve remained unshaken. He carefully studied real-time images from monitoring devices and noticed a connection between the Tacet Discords and the shadow ravens above. Quickly summoning the other commanders in the military, Jiyan devised a plan and led their coordinated army to face the enemy head-on. With precision, they used Sound Emulators set in a narrow valley to emit the shadow raven's frequency. As he expected, the Tacet Discords were drawn towards the sound, allowing for their easy capture.\n\nMeanwhile, the Midnight Rangers stationed at Norfall Barrens were instructed to join hands with their comrades in the Desorock Highland, and carry out a pincer attack on the Tacet Discords. In the midst of a sandstorm, Jiyan bravely fought off hordes of enemies, paving the way for his fellow soldiers with unmatched strength.\n\nThe <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> on Jiyan's nape was flickering, a sign of Forte overexertion, but he pressed on. His Qingloong flew high in the sky like a proud banner of resolution, never once faltering to the ground."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Reason to Fight",
      "content": "Jiyan is the youngest general in the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>' history. He is the Qingloong that everyone looks up to, and the invincible warrior no enemy stands any chance against. However, at some point, Jiyan became haunted by a recurring nightmare.\n\nIn that dream, the city of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> was engulfed in flames and consumed by <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. The monsters raged on, feeding on the frequencies of the dead. Chaotic sounds echoed throughout the city, creating a symphony of destruction.\n\nOn the flame-lit battlefield, a lone figure fought relentlessly with a lance in hand. Each swing tore through the air. One, two, three... Hundreds of thousands of Tacet Discords fell under his fierce and restless strikes.\n\nDespite his best efforts, the man could not quell the endless swarm of Tacet Discords ravaging the land. Day after day, year after year, he fought in vain until he was the sole survivor on a desolate battlefield. The Tacet Discords transformed into his fallen comrades, encircling and closing in on him.\n\n\"That's a clueless kid! How can we trust him with our lives?\"\n\n\"You said you would protect us... but why?\"\n\n\"Jiyan, what on earth are you fighting for?\"\n\nDespite being known for his calm and decisive nature, few were aware of the nightmares that would sometimes jolt him awake, haunted by the voices of the dead.\n\nAs the general, it was Jiyan's duty to safeguard not only the borders, but also the entirety of his nation. Every move he made and every plan he enacted carried immense responsibility and consequence.\n\nThis is why he seems to be always frowning, thinking, and planning ahead. One day, perhaps, he will finally turn around and answer those questions from the dead.\n\nHe fights for the living, and for the deceased."
    },
    {
      "title": "Silent Caretaker",
      "content": "Strange things do happen in the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>' camps.\n\nA soldier with a knee injury received specialized pain relief patches from the medics each time the seasons changed, despite the fact that he never told anyone about it.\n\nAnother soldier, previously inattentive during training, learned a few days later that the Midnight Rangers' General Affairs Department had paid for his mother's surgery.\n\nWhen the logistics department was short on funds, it received a budget increase notice for the next quarter before any budget request was officially made.\n\nRegardless of the size or age of the problem, there is always someone present to provide timely solutions when they are needed most. Just as a gentle rain quenches parched soil, this person carefully orchestrates aid and ensures that no area goes without assistance. \n\n\"Team 3's captain obviously had difficulties using his left leg during the drill. I went through his operation records, and it seems to stem from his prolonged exposure to the swamp during one of the previous missions. Pass along this prescription to the medics. They'll know what to do.\"\n\n\"Transfer some money to this account in the name of the General Affairs Department. Debit my account for the funding.\"\n\n\"I remember there has been a 20% increase in the number of recruits this year. Verify this with the Logistics. If confirmed, adjust next quarter's budget accordingly.\"\n\nThis is Jiyan, whose ruthlessness is reserved for enemies, while his tenderness is shown to comrades."
    },
    {
      "title": "What's Inside His Gourd?",
      "content": "When asked about his childhood, Jiyan recalls a plethora of memories: the smell of medicine, the bright lights of the operating room, the sound of medical equipment clashing, and the hallway where many goodbyes were exchanged.\n\nBorn into a medical family, Jiyan became his mother's assistant at the age of 10. He excelled at medical skills and was popular among patients, not only for his expertise, but also for his great ability to soothe their upsets and cater to their needs.\n\nDespite his exceptional medical prowess, there were still some lives that Jiyan couldn't bring back from the jaws of death—the last patient he couldn't save was Beiwang, his friend and mentor, who was heavily injured by <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. \n\nBeiwang was initially known to Jiyan as the latter's patient, among many other <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> who had to visit a doctor after fighting the frequent Tacet Discord tides plaguing the land. \n\nBeiwang was impressed by Jiyan's intellect and intuition, leading him to share details of the Midnight Rangers' marches and provide military instruction. Conversely, Jiyan actively contributed his analytical skills to strategy discussions, despite never experiencing battle firsthand. His unique perspectives injected vitality into their conversations, invigorating Beiwang's perspectives with a fresh outlook.\n\nBeiwang's passing ignited a transformative spark in Jiyan—his wistfulness, frustration, and regret turned into his strength to wield the lance on the battlefield. \n\nJiyan began to realize that the <te href=850075>Lament</te> is such a deep-seated disease in the world's veins that not even the most sophisticated medical instrument or the most adept surgeon could remove it. This realization drove him to cure the world in another way—he took up arms and fought the Tacet Discords head-on, with unwavering resolve.\n\nNow, only the gourd-shaped pill case on his belt loop indicates that he was once a doctor. Speculations abound about the contents of the case, with some claiming he uses sugar pearls to comfort children and others saying he drinks from it after battles.\n\nIf someone asks Jiyan about it, he would answer frankly, \"Just some common medicines, in case someone needs them.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "The Temporary Team",
      "content": "Amidst the lively Jinzhou <te href=850129>Riverside Games</te>, a group of young men stood together.\n\n\"Here's the thing. Our captain's got an urgent matter to attend to, so we're one man short for the race. If you don't join us, we might have to forfeit.\" \n\n\"Please, please help us. We've been training so hard for the Gulpuff Relay. So please...\"\n\n\"Yeah, please, Jiyan!\" they chorused, their urgency palpable.\n\nStanding at the center was a bright-eyed young man. Meeting their sincere gaze, he nodded in agreement. Therefore, a temporary team was formed.\n\nThe young man asked about each teammate's conditions and the relay order. Then, he decided to adjust the strategy and take on the anchor leg himself.\n\nThe Games, initially held to relieve the tension of Jinzhou people after their first triumph over the <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te> Outbreaks, had evolved into a major event in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, in which the Gulpuff Relay was one of the biggest highlights.\n\nThe whistle blew. The relay racers charged forward, skillfully evading obstacles as they piloted their Gulpuffs. Crowds of cheering audience lined the banks.\n\nHowever, a mistake occurred during the baton exchange between the first and second runners, leading the temporary team to lag far behind.\n\n\"Oops, looks like this team's hit a little snag! As a temporary team, their teamwork might be a bit rusty. Pity for them!\"\n\nThe commentator then shifted his attention to the top three contenders.\n\nAmidst the cheers, the race reached its climax as the final runner of the temporary team swiftly closed the gap with their opponents, unnoticed by everyone.\n\n\"Oh man! Look at the temporary team! There was a hiccup earlier, but now the last runner is overtaking! There's a key curve ahead... Wha-what's happening? He's overtaking everyone on the curve! That's absolutely amazing!\"\n\nUndisturbed by the noise and excitement of the audience, he kept his eyes locked on the finish line. A single thought was driving him forward—faster, just a little faster. His heart pounded, drowning out the loud cheers.\n\nAs confetti descended with a loud bang, the cacophony of sounds once again poured into his ears.\n\nThey won!\n\n\"Who could've imagined this temporary team would break the record! Congratulations to the young lads!\"\n\nHis teammates swarmed him in excitement, surrounding the young man. Raising the weighty trophy, they vowed to team up again for the next Games."
    }

  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "I have long been stationed in the borderlands, with little knowledge of entertainment or places of leisure. However, if you are looking for tactics against <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> or beautiful natural vistas, I can provide some suggestions.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player01.play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "While the borderlands cannot rival the city's clamor and glamor, they do possess their unique charm. Should you find time, I suggest you come and witness the full moon and twinkling stars that grace the tranquil night skies. Rest assured, your safety will not be a concern; I will be there with you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player02.play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "The <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> are a source of solace for many, while I see them as a scalpel, with the duty of eradicating maladies. Me? I am the hand that guides this scalpel, I suppose.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player03.play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "Soldiers of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> have entrusted their lives to me. Therefore, every time I wield the scalpel, I must do so with absolute precision so as not to betray their trust. One day, this scalpel will eradicate all <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, and when that moment arrives, I hope you can witness it with me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player04.play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "Flowers in the Knell Square are planted to honor the deceased. These flowers are of a unique variety, and they require significant attention. Here is a cultivation guide.       "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player05.play_favor_word_jiyan_to_player05"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Jiyan's Hobby",
      "content": "Though I no longer practice medicine, I still discuss medical knowledge with my mother in my spare time. This gourd-shaped pill case is a gift from her the year I joined the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_taste.play_favor_word_jiyan_taste"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Jiyan's Trouble",
      "content": "In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_worry.play_favor_word_jiyan_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "Jinzhou Stew is renowned for its wide variety of ingredients and easy preparation, making it a beloved homemade dish in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. Having been stationed in the borderlands for most of my time, I sometimes miss that taste.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_food_favor.play_favor_word_jiyan_food_favor"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "In <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, there is a vegetable known as \"Bittberry\". It possesses a bitter and slightly astringent flavor, and is renowned for its detoxifying properties. When I was young, my mother was somehow convinced \"those who can endure bitterness will rise above others.\" She frequently incorporated this vegetable into our meals. I must confess that its taste was far from pleasant. However, now serving in the army, I have grown accustomed to its flavor.     {
      "type": 1,

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "This spear was modeled after the weapon of Captain Beiwang, bearing the significance of quelling chaos and warding off external threats.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "My family has been in the medical profession for generations. I once aspired to follow in their footsteps, saving lives and providing care. However, I soon realized that a doctor could never fully alleviate the pain caused by the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. It was this realization that led me to join the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>. Over the years, I have found my way of bringing solace to the world.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jiyan_story_exp.play_favor_word_jiyan_story_exp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Mortefi",
      "content": "Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Jinhsi",
      "content": "The \"battle\" Magistrate Jinhsi has been taking on may prove more complicated than our situation in the borderlands: stipulating rules, overseeing trade, ensuring the well-being of the people, and managing the city's functioning all demand her coordination and judgement.       "skill": {
        "name": "Lone Lance",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume Stamina to thrust forward, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Windborne Strike</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Windborne Strike</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> ends, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Abyssal Slash</color></size>\nRelease <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Abyssal Slash</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> ends, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-Air Attack</color></size>\nConsume Stamina to perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\nAfter performing the <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform a follow-up attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-Air Attack: Banner of Triumph</color></size>\nAfter casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Windborne Strike</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color> in mid-air, Jiyan can perform a mid-air attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Windborne Strike</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Windborne Strike</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> after the <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> ends.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Abyssal Slash</color></size>\nRelease <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Abyssal Slash</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> after the <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> ends.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Banner of Triumph</color></size>\nAfter casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Windborne Strike</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color> in mid-air, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Qingloong at War",
        "desc": "When casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color>, if Jiyan has {0} or more \"Resolve\", he consumes {1} \"Resolve\" to increase the DMG of this Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color> by {2}.\nWhen Jiyan is in <color=Highlight><te href=850031>Qingloong Mode</te></color>, DMG of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color> is increased by {3} and no longer consumes \"Resolve\".\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation: Emerald Storm - Finale</color></size>\nWhen casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Emerald Storm - Prelude</color>, if Jiyan has {4} \"Resolve\" or more, he will consume {5} \"Resolve\" to cast Emerald Storm - Finale, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\nEmerald Storm: Finale can be cast in mid-air at low altitude.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resolve</color></size>\nJiyan can hold up to {6} Resolve.\nJiyan gains \"Resolve\" when his Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Lone Lance</color> hits the target.\nJiyan gains \"Resolve\" when the Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Tactical Strike</color> hits the target.\n\"Resolve\" will gradually decrease if Jiyan does not hit a target within {7}s.",

        ],

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Untainted Soul of the Woods",
      "content": "The girl lived in the mountains. She slept under the sky, rested on the earth, befriended green hills, and played with animals. Agile and free, she roamed the fields with her animal companions.\n\nAs Shiling ventured into the forests, a strange noise caught his attention. He glanced over and saw a child among the branches, with pure eyes and an innocent demeanor.\n\nSuch a rare, untainted soul, untouched by the world's corruption.\n\nEnthralled by her gaze, Shiling cautiously approached, but the girl retreated higher, wary of him.\n\nShiling noticed her thin frame and ragged clothing, so he pulled out a piece of flatbread for her. She eagerly snatched it, shielding it with her body in a feral manner. Her behavior seemed undomesticated, as if she had forgotten her humanity. In response, Shiling placed another piece of flatbread next to hers.\n\n<i>Should I bring this child with me and make her my apprentice?</i> Sitting cross-legged next to her, Shiling pondered while watching her eat the flatbread. <i>But we are currently short on funding... It may be difficult support another child</i>, he thought. Ultimately, he decided to let the girl choose her own path.\n\n\"Hey, kid, you see this path ahead? This is the only path up the mountain, where my sect is located. Our founder spent every effort to open it up back then. If you can catch up with me and climb to its top before sunset, I will make you my new apprentice. How about that?\"\n\nDespite his offer, the girl continued to eat as she blinked at him nonchalantly, as if she didn't understand what he was saying at all.\n\nHaving set his heart on the promise, Shiling stood up and started to climb up the mountain. He looked back now and then, hoping for a change of heart from the girl, but she remained rooted in place, fixated on her meal.\n\nDisappointed, Shiling resigned himself to leaving her behind and continued on towards the top. As he neared his sect atop the mountain, faint laughter drifted from near the hall gate. Approaching, he saw his students crouched, offering water to the girl he had just left behind.\n\n\"Master, you're back. Look, this kid climbed up the mountain all by herself.\"\n\n\"W-When did she arrive?\"\n\n\"I don't know. I have been here for a while, and she was here before I arrived.\"\n\nWithout saying anything else, Shiling extended his hand to the still girl, who remained motionless, not understanding the meaning behind his gesture.\n\nShiling took her hand and placed it firmly in his. He guided her up, and they walked side by side into the hall."
    },
    {
      "title": "Innocent Heart's Valor",
      "content": "The girl knows her life's purpose: to perfect one move at a time. All she wants is to master her martial arts, a feat that requires intense focus and dedication. It's a level of concentration that eludes most, but for her, it's the ultimate goal.\n\n\"Master Deqing, any other misses in my moves?\"\n\n\"Three. Here, I'll show you once more. Do take note. You don't have to memorize everything right now, as long as you get it right in the end.\"\n\n\"Jianxin, it's already late. Practice tomorrow.\"\n\n\"I'll go back once I'm done with this! You should go rest, master!\"\n\nIn the darkening practice ground, the girl tirelessly repeated her moves. From cautious to swift, she practiced until they became second nature.\n\n\n\nThe girl's pure heart guides her choices, free from fear and weakness. Her mind is simple, yet unwavering in its convictions.\n\n\"Jianxin, he's too strong. Let's run. We'll let him have those supplies.\"\n\nJianxin, however, prepared herself for a fight, \"I'm not leaving. I know we're outmatched, but I want to give it a try.\"\n\n\"What? A try? This is no joke! We're leaving!\"\n\n\"I'll try to take back our stuff without getting injured.\"\n\n\"Wait! Ugh... Here she goes again...\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Benevolent Hand of Grace",
      "content": "One day, on her way up the mountain to collect some bamboo, Jianxin encountered another Taoist on Qingyang Bridge. \n\nShe didn't know this person or where he came from. \n\nHowever, Rongfu, the Taoist, upon seeing Jianxin, stopped in his tracks. \n\n\"You have potential indeed, but you are not yet a human,\" he commented.\n\n\"Me? What do you mean? I am a human,\" Jianxin argued. \n\n\"To love is human, yet you don't love,\" Rongfu stared into her eyes and said, \"You are pure to the extreme, but still empty inside.\"\n\n\"I know how to love. I honor my Masters and follow etiquette. I revere the elders in my sect, always trying to assist them.\" \n\n\"When I said 'love', I meant to help those in need and care for the suffering people in this troubled world,\" Rongfu explained. \n\n\"Master Shiling once said something similar. But what good does it do?\" Jianxin questioned.\n\n\"The best sages gain enlightenment in the military, the mediocre sages gain enlightenment in the bustling cities, and the worst sages gain enlightenment in seclusion. Tao cannot be attained solely through solitude or meditation. It is through real-life interactions with others that one can achieve both spiritual freedom and physical elevation. Seeking personal gain and lacking in meditation shows a misguided pursuit of Tao. Instead, seek insight into your path and strive for perfection in all aspects of life.\"\n\n\"Then how can I learn to love?\" Jianxin asked.\n\n\"You have never left this mountain, have you?\" Rongfu asked. \n\n\"No,\" Jianxin replied. \n\n\"Perhaps it wasn't time for you to leave. But now, the time has come. How can you truly attain Tao without truly experiencing the world?\"\n\nRongfu sat beside Jianxin, and the two of them talked for a long time on the bridge about what it means to love people.\n\n\n\n\n\n\"Master Rongfu, long time no see!\"\n\n\"Jianxin, since our paths have crossed again, why not join me in helping those in need?\"\n\n\"Sure do!\"\nHearing their heartfelt thanks and feeling the warm touch of their unfamiliar hands, Jianxin knew her actions had made a small impact. A smile lit up her face, replacing any previous confusion."
    },
    {
      "title": "Dilligent Devotion",
      "content": "\"This is my final treat, Jianxin. You must provide for yourself and earn your own money for food from now on.\"\n\n\"But Master, I don't know how to read palms or divine fortunes.\"\n\n\"You don't have to make money by doing the typical Taoist stuff! You can do anything. You're a fast learner, and that's one of your strong suits.\"\n\nJianxin traveled the world, working hard and using her earnings to support herself and help others. She took on even the most insignificant tasks with diligence and determination, building a strong reputation for herself along the way.\n\n\"Hey Jianxin, tour customer flow has really improved because of you! By the way, could you share those dietary recipes? They've been a hit with customers and we can make them our signature dish. Here's your pay for the month, keep up the great work!\"\n\n\"Of course! I'll write them down for you.\"\n\n\"Ever since you started working here, the shop has been so much cleaner. You're amazing! We're lucky to have you.\"\n\n\"I used some cleaning tricks I learned from my previous job. How did he pay?\"\n\n\"He just tapped it here, and boom—payment made.\"\n\n\"Hold on, that's not a real thing. He's trying to pull one over on you for a free meal.\"\n\n\"What? So that's not a new invention... I'll track him down and get the money back.\"\n\n\"Just be careful, don't hurt him too much! It's not worth it for me!\"\n\n\"I won't go too far. Don't worry!\""
