Life's lessons are more than chance encounters. Harness their power and let your soul flourish with wisdom.\" \n\nWith Shiling's guidance, she embraced self-spiritual cultivation and let go of her past achievements. Taoism's natural principles taught her to appreciate and love the world around her, harnessing the emotions of others as her own strength. In a state of intense concentration, she relied on simple martial arts techniques to connect with the world around her. It was a near-madness state, but one that brought unity and harmony. Her fists and palms held the world and her ego, merging into one. Each punch carried compassion and benevolence, repeated three thousand times. Turbulent thoughts settled into a stronger spiritual power. \n\nShe stood in the same place, mastering basic techniques three thousand times, regardless of the seasons. Sitting on the grass, she became one with nature. Breathing in harmony with the wind and feeling the vitality of the surrounding greenery, she entered a state of symbiosis. Mind, body, and environment merged into a natural flow, cultivating peace within.\n\nWhen the mind is calm, the strength becomes gentle. When the strength is gentle, the essence becomes solid. When the essence is solid, the spirit becomes vigorous. \n\nNow, Jianxin's martial arts practice has evolved beyond physical boundaries, fueled by a strong inner power that is impervious to external influences. In her world, every moment is focused and intense, a reflection of the vibrant natural world. Her punches move at invisible speeds, harnessing the power of wind with gentle force. Through her softness, she conquers all obstacles with love and reverence for the world around her."

      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "I wasn't the brightest kid, but I was lucky to find my talent in martial arts. That's why I really admire people with both brains and courage. Of all the smart people I know, you're the best, being a great martial artist and a true defender of justice. You are the one I look up to the most, beside my masters.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_to_player04.play_favor_word_jianxin_to_player04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "I adore being part of nature's harmony. Every songbird in the sky, every leaf on the ground, and every glimmer of sunlight makes me feel a serene joy, as the sweet breezes surround me, whispering life's many blessings. Your presence brings me the same kind of feeling, Rover. With you, everything feels so right, like I belong where I should.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_to_player05.play_favor_word_jianxin_to_player05"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Jianxin's Hobby",
      "content": "My life's goal is to one day fully master Fengyiquan. For me, every place—be it in the valley, on a mountain peak, or a bustling market—provides an opportunity to perfect my art. I find joy in connecting with various energies and Chi available across different places; this connection gives me new chances of growth.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_taste.play_favor_word_jianxin_taste"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Jianxin's Trouble",
      "content": "Worthy opponents are always hard to find. I always yearn for a good fight from which I can learn and improve myself. That said, I'm not too invested in looking for challenges anymore. One can only find inner peace when they let go of their desires. I can find my growth without engaging in frequent battles.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_worry.play_favor_word_jianxin_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "My favorite food? It's the Guokui Flatbread! We'd always have it at our sect, and when I was little, I got extra servings like other younger disciples. Master Shiling even said that I'd followed his scent of freshly made flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how I joined our sect. I'm not sure if it was true or not though, he loves to rib us like that sometimes.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_food_favor.play_favor_word_jianxin_food_favor"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "There isn't any particular food that I dislike. I'm not much of a food person, I guess. People mix various ingredients for a variety of purposes—to gain muscle, to treat illnesses, or to stay healthy. The flavors of these food combinations are just natural outcomes. All types of food serve a purpose and can be beneficial.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_food_hate.play_favor_word_jianxin_food_hate"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_dream.play_favor_word_jianxin_dream"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "I got the Mirrors of Clarity from Master Shiling when I was little. The mirrors represented my masters' good wishes for me: to stay dedicated, disciplined, and become a well-rounded individual. Each day, I carry them with me to honor their teachings, but more importantly, to remind myself of how much they cared for me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_story_obj.play_favor_word_jianxin_story_obj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "To reach where our sect is, one must take the Ancient Path—it's the only way up the mountain. This is usually difficult for new disciples, but Master Shiling said when he took me in, I almost made it up the mountain as fast as he did. He said I was like a little wild animal: agile, vibrant, and naive. I can't remember any of that, though. The earliest memory I have is practicing martial arts with fellow disciples.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_story_exp.play_favor_word_jianxin_story_exp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Chixia",
      "content": "Chixia always invites me to spar. She's really good with her guns, and I've learned so much from those fights. I admire her dedication and genuineness. It's great to have made a friend while honing my fighting skills.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_about_chixia.play_favor_word_jianxin_about_chixia"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Yuanwu",
      "content": "Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my \"martial senior\". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_about_yuanwu.play_favor_word_jianxin_about_yuanwu"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "I've only celebrated birthdays for my masters and fellow disciples before, and we'd usually make peach buns of longevity for the birthday person. So... here, I've made some peach buns for you! Happy Birthday! I wish you good health and great happiness!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_birthcele.play_favor_word_jianxin_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Oh?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_idle01.play_favor_word_jianxin_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "Self-awareness leads to wisdom... hmm?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_idle02.play_favor_word_jianxin_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_idle03.play_favor_word_jianxin_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "I am Jianxin, the successor of <te href=850134>Fengyiquan</te>. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_introduction.play_favor_word_jianxin_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_get_card.play_favor_word_jianxin_get_card"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "Enemies ahead? I'm ready.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_join_team_01.play_favor_word_jianxin_join_team_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "What will I learn from this fight?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_join_team_02.play_favor_word_jianxin_join_team_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "I'll do my best!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_join_team_03.play_favor_word_jianxin_join_team_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "This is a different practice, but it feels similar to how I usually do seated cultivation as my master taught. Hmm... how do I put this? I'll tell you once I've come up with a better way to describe.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup01.play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup02.play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "This is... the feeling of standing on top of a mountain, watching the billowing sea of clouds beneath my feet. The spirit within me resonates with every life in this universe... Yes, that's it! That's how it feels! I've finally figured out how to put this feeling into words!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup03.play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "Now my body and mind have gained a newfound clarity, and even my senses are keener than before. The Chi that surrounds me seems more... Oh no! Sorry! Are you alright? Phew... I should have paid more attention to keep it in check. I'll focus on improving my control of this power from now on. Thank you, Rover! I'm now another step closer to my goal!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup04.play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "Is this real? I can't believe... Thank you, for everything you've done for me. No one, apart from my masters, has shown me more kindness in this life than you have. I can never repay in full what I owe to you, but I want to try anyway. There is something I've wanted to tell you for a while now: beyond seeking martial excellence, I've found another goal in life—to do everything I can for you, until my very last breath.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup05.play_favor_word_jianxin_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Come forth.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_skill_01.play_favor_word_jianxin_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Serenity.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_skill_02.play_favor_word_jianxin_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Clarity.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_skill_03.play_favor_word_jianxin_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Chi lasts evermore!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_burst_skill_01.play_favor_word_jianxin_burst_skill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Universe in my psyche!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_burst_skill_02.play_favor_word_jianxin_burst_skill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Embrace the Oneness!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_burst_skill_03.play_favor_word_jianxin_burst_skill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack",
      "content": "Tranquility!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_evasion_parry_attack.play_favor_word_jianxin_evasion_parry_attack"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_behit_fly_01.play_favor_word_jianxin_behit_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Caution.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_behit_fly_02.play_favor_word_jianxin_behit_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "Stay alert.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_behit_fly_03.play_favor_word_jianxin_behit_fly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_hp70.play_favor_word_jianxin_hp70"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "A decent challenge.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_hp50.play_favor_word_jianxin_hp50"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Worthy opponent!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_hp30.play_favor_word_jianxin_hp30"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Life renews itself...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_die_01.play_favor_word_jianxin_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Death is not the end...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_die_02.play_favor_word_jianxin_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "My time has come...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_die_03.play_favor_word_jianxin_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Hah!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_hx_summon.play_favor_word_jianxin_hx_summon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Hmm. Like this?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_hx_change.play_favor_word_jianxin_hx_change"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Evils begone!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_qte_01.play_favor_word_jianxin_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,

    },
    {

    },

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "A contented mind is a perpetual feast.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_chest_01.play_favor_word_jianxin_chest_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Hmm. What's it gonna be this time?",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "A well-deserved reward.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_jianxin_chest_03.play_favor_word_jianxin_chest_03"
    }

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Mirrors of Clarity",
      "content": "As a child, Jianxin was gifted a precious trinket by her master. It held a set of mirrors, with some missing pieces. Throughout her training, she used it to reflect on herself and her progress, understanding that self-cultivation and martial arts require patience and dedication. On her return to the sect, her master carefully replaced the missing mirrors. It was then that Jianxin saw her reflection in the completed piece—a symbol of all the teachings and growth she had experienced on her journey.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure52_UI.T_Treasure52_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Coupon Clip",
      "content": "Jianxin learned to collect all kinds of coupons the first time she followed her master down the mountains to live in the city. To her, it is not only a unique way to survive, but also a symbol of people's friendliness. \"Exclusive dishes... FREE!\" Jianxin didn't understand the deeper meaning of the businessman's use of font size to create a visual focal point, not to mention the staggering list of additional conditions that followed.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure53_UI.T_Treasure53_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Velvet Grass",
      "content": "The plant stood tall and strong, as if still swaying in the winds of its mountain home. Its very sight brought a refreshing sense of being atop the highest peaks. This particular species is on the brink of extinction, with only traces remaining in Jianxin's brief description. Even after thorough investigation, the Academy still could not pinpoint where she had found it. All that is known is that this rare plant was once in her possession. Some believe it holds mystical powers, while others see it as a symbol of resilience and survival.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure54_UI.T_Treasure54_UI"
    }
  ],

    "rarity": 4
  },

      "skill": {

        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nJianxin performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nJianxin consumes STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nJianxin consumes STA to plunge and unleash a powerful kick, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Primordial Chi Spiral",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral</color></size>\nWhen \"Chi\" reaches max stacks, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Primordial Chi Spiral</color> and start <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Zhoutian Progress</color></size>\nJianxin's resistance to interruption is increased, and her the damage taken is reduced by {0}:\nJianxin continuously consumes \"Chi\" and casts <color=Highlight>Chi Strike</color> to attack targets nearby, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\nAs <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> accumulates, Jianxin reaches different Zhoutian and gains effects accordingly.\n-Before Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 1 shield. When <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> is interrupted, cast <color=Highlight>Pushing Punch</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n-Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 2 shield and cast <color=Highlight>Shock</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.  When <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> is interrupted, cast <color=Highlight>Yielding Pull</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n-Major Zhoutian - Inner: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast <color=Highlight>Shock</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. When <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> is interrupted, cast <color=Highlight>Yielding Pull</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n-Major Zhoutian - Outer: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast <color=Highlight>Shock</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n-When <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button is released, interrupt <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> and lose all \"Chi\";\n-When all \"Chi\" is consumed, end <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> ends, regain a shield according to the Zhoutian Progress reached;\nAs the shield provided by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral</color> persists, the active character is healed once every {1}s.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chi</color></size>\nJianxin can hold up to {2} Chi.\nChi is obtained when Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Fengyiquan</color> hits the target.\nChi is obtained when the Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Calming Air</color> is cast.\nChi is obtained when the Resonance Skills <color=Highlight>Chi Counter</color> or <color=Highlight>Chi Parry</color> hits the target.\nChi is obtained when the Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Essence of Tao</color> hits the target.",
        "param": [
          "50%",
          "6",
          "120"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral</color></size>\nWhen Chi is full, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to start <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Zhoutian Progress</color></size>\nContinuously consume Chi to attack nearby targets, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\nAs <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> continues, Jianxin deals more damage and her shield toughens.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> ends, Jianxin gains one last shield based on the Zhoutian Progress reached.\nAs the shield from <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral</color> persists, the on-field Resonator is healed once every {1}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chi</color></size>\nJianxin can hold up to {2} Chi.\nJianxin gains Chi through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "50%",
          "6",
          "120"
        ],

  "stories": [],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Will there be new discoveries?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup04.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup05.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: I",
      "content": "Wind, be my blade.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_atk_atk01_pro_01.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_atk_atk01_pro_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: II",
      "content": "Whirl and wuther.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_atk_atk01_pro_02.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_atk_atk01_pro_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: III",
      "content": "Purging all evil.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_atk_atk01_pro_03.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_atk_atk01_pro_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Wind rises.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Tempest of slashes.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Annihilation.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "The wicked...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill02.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Will face judgement!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill03.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_skill03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Wind howls—unfettered by bounds!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Waves rise—judgment strikes!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "I am the tempest!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Wind calls, waves follow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_qte.play_favor_word_wind_nanzhu_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_behit_fly_01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_behit_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Ugh... Bad timing.",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "One more time.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_behit_fly_03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_behit_fly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "*Exhale*",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Keep it together.",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Last chance...",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "I must not... falter.",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Is this the end...",

    {
      "type": 2,

    {
      "type": 2,

      "skill": {
        "name": "Wind Cutter",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting the skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> directly.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Razor Wind</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Razor Wind</color>. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after landing to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color>.\n- At max <te href=850056>Windstrings</te>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after landing to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Unbound Flow</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Razor Wind</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> at the cost of STA.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Cycle of Wind",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cloudburst Dance</color></size>\nPerform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and healing all nearby Resonators in the team. Cast through the following 3 ways:\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Awakening Gale</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Razor Wind</color>.\nWhen casting Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Cloudburst Dance</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Unbound Flow</color></size>\nAt max Windstrings, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Awakening Gale</color> becomes Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Unbound Flow</color>: Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks. Each attack consumes 60 Windstrings, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered Resonance Skill DMG.\nSwitching to another Resonator after Stage 1 automatically triggers Stage 2 of this skill. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Windstring</color></size>\nRover can hold up to 120 Windstrings.\nEach stage of Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Cloudburst Dance</color> restores 25 Windstrings on hit.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> restores 20 Windstrings.\nHitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 or 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> restores 10 Windstrings.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cloudburst Dance</color></size>\nAfter casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Awakening Gale</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, or Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Razor Wind</color>, Rover can cast Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Cloudburst Dance</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Unbound Flow</color></size>\nMid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Cloudburst Dance</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> restore Windstrings.\nAt max Windstrings, Rover can cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Unbound Flow</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>",
        "simple_param": [],

  "name": "Ciaccona",
  "nick_name": "Ciaccona",
  "desc": "A wandering bard from <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>, Ciaccona. She sings not only for the Divinity, but also for the common folk.\nShe records stories along her journeys, turning them into songs that evoke laughter, emotion, and tears in both the storytellers and the audience.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_37_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_37_UI",
  "background": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRolePile/T_IconRole_Pile_xiakong_UI.T_IconRole_Pile_xiakong_UI",
  "background_stand": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/RoleHalfBody/T_ActivityRoleOntrialHalfBodyXiakong.T_ActivityRoleOntrialHalfBodyXiakong",
  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "Unknown",
    "sex": "Female",
    "country": "Rinascita",
    "influence": "Ragunna",
    "info": "A wandering bard from <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>, Ciaccona. She sings not only for the Divinity, but also for the common folk.\nShe records stories along her journeys, turning them into songs that evoke laughter, emotion, and tears in both the storytellers and the audience.",
    "talent_name": "Woven Melodies",
    "talent_doc": "Journal Entry of Veron Toccata—Head of Toccata Family\nI do not know if this is a blessing or a curse that has befallen my child.\nThe child has mastered numerous instruments with ease. She tells me that the melodies in the music sheets appear not just as notes to her, but also as a series of scenes: they are stories of the instruments and their performers... She took my hand and shared this perception with me, and that is when I discovered that Ciaccona can recreate aspects of the world through melodies. It is a realm of her own making.\n<i>As long as she can sense these melodies, Ciaccona can transform her poetry and music into anything. The child has an innate curiosity about everything, making it easy for her to empathize with the stories and experiences of others. I fear this gift may bring her misfortune. That she will hear the echoes that hide within the darkness of shadows.</i>",
    "talent_certification": "Journal Entry of Veron Toccata—Head of Toccata Family\n \nThe Order was inevitably made aware of Ciaccona's ability. They deemed her destined to become the Toccata Family's most radiant chorister. Per protocol, they conducted a Forte examination on her. These were the results:\n \nThis member's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations with a stable Time Domain. No signs of abnormal fluctuations were observed. The test results are assessed as being within the normal phase.\n \nResonant Criticality: High.   "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Music and the World",
      "content": "The little girl always loved to look up. Whether at the clear blue of day or the glittering blue of night. She once wondered to herself why, but the words she knew couldn't express how she felt. All she knew was a sense of awe at the great unknown and the mysteries that lay beyond... Eventually, she stopped wondering, for she had discovered that gazing at the skies was an inexplicable beauty in itself.\n \nWith this discovery, she began to look up while reading, while sleeping, even while walking...\n \n\"Hey, hey. Eyes up front, Ms. Ciaccona. Why do you keep staring at the ceiling? Watch where you're going!\" After taking a hard bump to the head, young Ciaccona decided it would be best not to stare at the sky so much... at least not while walking. The next time she looked up, she saw something that would become her lifelong passion.\n \nIt was an ordinary afternoon when Ciaccona pushed open the door of her father's study. The object tucked away on top of the cabinet was the first thing she noticed after looking up. She took it down nice and slowly—it was a violin and her first encounter with an instrument. Picturing how her father had played it before, she decided to give it a try.\n \n\"Screech...\"\n \nIt was undoubtedly a harsh sound. Yet she felt a peculiar sensation, like she was sinking toward the bottom of the sea. All sounds but the violin began to fade away. The light and shadows of the setting sun blurred. The world before her eyes seemed to draw its curtains, and by the time they opened again, a new world appeared before her. The air was filled with dancing music notes, and in the distance, a group of people played music.\n \n\"H-Hello?\"\n \nNo one responded to the young girl. She walked closer, and though their faces were blurry, the melody seemed familiar.\n \n\"It's a piece Father often plays. Composed by our family.\" Young Ciaccona recalled the music's origins.\n \nThe group seemed unaware of her presence as they played, surrounding the girl with melodies that sounded of cries of newborn babies, and life's joys and tragedies...\n \n\"Thud.\" The music came to an abrupt stop at the sound of a door opening. Noticing the violin in Ciaccona's hands, her father gently patted her head with a slight look of resignation before putting it away.\n \n\"I'll teach you how to play when you're a bit older,\" he said, taking Ciaccona's hand and leading her out of the room. Just before the door closed behind them, Ciaccona turned around and waved goodbye to the violin.\n \nFrom that day on, Ciaccona began searching for information about the music. The more she learned, the clearer her visions became whenever she touched an instrument.\n \nShe never told anyone what she saw that day. It wasn't until much later that Ciaccona learned it was due to her Forte: the power to recreate the past through melodies.\n \nPeople of different times, brought together through music and poetry. It was the greatest miracle the girl could have ever imagined."
    },
    {
      "title": "Poems and the World",
      "content": "With a quill in hand, the young girl leaned on her desk, feeling the nib's metallic cold against her fingertips as her thoughts withered away in the barren deserts of inspiration.\n \nOutside her window were busy crowds, birds, the wind, and <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> in prayer... In Ciaccona's eyes, they were scenes that could be transformed into words and punctuations, yet they refused to string together into sentences. The words were hollow and lifeless when placed side by side. That was... far from poetry.\n \n\"Lady Ciaccona. May I trouble you for a moment?\" A maid knocked on the door, entering the room after receiving a nod from the girl.\n \n\"I was wondering if I could ask for a favor, since you have a way with words. Could you help me write a letter? It's for my family.\"\n \nCiaccona motioned for the maid to sit down and began to write on a blank sheet of paper: \"Dear...\"\n \nWhen the maid received a return letter from home, she shared it with Ciaccona. Together, they began to write a second letter...\n \nWhat poured forth were heartfelt snippets of the maid's life and thoughts. Ciaccona smiled with the maid's joy and wept with her sorrow.\n \nWord of Ciaccona's prowess spread, and more people came to her to write letters. She grew to understand each person's intents more deeply. For those seeking to send a letter to the sailor at sea, her quill carried the salty taste of the sea. For those seeking to send a letter to the father working in wheat fields, her ink bore the scent of wheat. She kept everyone's stories a secret, of course.\n \nBefore she knew it, she discovered the words in her letters were becoming more like poetry, forming a soul.\n \nShe picked up her quill and glanced out the window once again, but the scenery remained stubbornly unchanged, and the piece of paper before her remained blank. A knock sounded at the door, likely someone with another letter request. As the girl got up to answer, the voice of the visitor blended with the sound of the creaking floor, and at that moment, she understood what had been holding her back for so long. Before she could write, she needed to first listen.\n \n\"Coming! Who would you like to write to today?\"\n \nCiaccona smoothed out the creases on the paper as the wind carried the prayers from the <te href=850098>Cathedral of Mercury</te> into the room. She continued to be moved by the joys and sorrows of countless stories, all the while searching for the romance and soul within their verses."
    },
    {
      "title": "Fate and the Door",
      "content": "The young girl stood anxiously before the door. Still, she stood on tiptoes and slid the key into the lock.\n \nWith her father and the rest of the family preoccupied with choir rehearsals, and no one around to keep an eye on her, Ciaccona knew this was her only chance at opening this door.\n \nThe door slowly creaked open, revealing nothing but darkness inside. Ciaccona braced against the wall and felt her way to the light switch.\n \nHer father had forbidden anyone from entering this room. He told her it was his abandoned study, one he never had the time to clean out. He warned that the floorboards were so rotten they might break underfoot. But this wasn't enough to deter young Ciaccona's curiosity. Just as she had read in a poetry book: \"Do not go gentle into that good night. Rage, rage against the dying of the light...\"\n \nThe lights flickered on, lighting up the room. Immediately, Ciaccona knew her father had lied. It was indeed a study, but it was immaculate.\n \nBookshelves towered along the walls and various instruments slept in corners. It was a paradise for a girl with so much love for poetry and music.\n \nShe gently touched the instruments, waking them from their long slumber, and began to skip and sing. Right, then left... until she collided with a bookshelf. A book fell at her feet, and Ciaccona opened the first page.\n \n\"This anthology is attributed to the <te href=850125>Golden Anthem</te>. May these poems bring a glimmer of hope for those strayed from their destined paths...\"\n \nCiaccona repeated the preface, captivated by the words. She quietly sat down, turning page after page, and as she did, her own destiny began to turn as well..."
    },
    {
      "title": "For the Stories, She Shall Sing",
      "content": "\"The knight, clad in battered armor, stumbles toward his homeland. Step by step, he leaves behind one footprint of determination after the other along the path ordained by the Divinity. What is destiny? The knight did not know. In this very moment, if the Divinity were to grant him a blessing, he would have but one wish—To return home a hero, and live the simple life he once knew...\"\n \nCiaccona's narration ended as the music faded. Applause erupted around her like sparks leaping from a bonfire.\n \n\"Ciaccona, are you going somewhere else tomorrow?\" The children gathered around her, eager for more stories.\n \nCiaccona had grown into a wandering bard, planting the seeds of poetry and music wherever her journey took her.\n \nThe fair winds guided the shepherds home, while the rolling clouds carried their thoughts across distant lands. The gentle rain, veiling tears, awaited the dawn.\n \nThe knight, with courage unyielding, charged toward the river's edge. The loaves of bread, heavy with parting, bore the family's silent sorrow.\n \nThe birds in the sky were the souls of <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>, striving, wings spread boldly even through the storm.\n \nCiaccona sang of tales far and wide but never once spoke of her own. When asked about her past and why she became a bard, she would always smile and reply, \"Let the past stay where it belongs.\"\n \nWhen the time comes for Ciaccona to finally unveil her past, the stories hidden behind her family name may become the most heart-wrenching chapters of her life."
    },
    {
      "title": "For Herself, She Shall Sing",
      "content": "\"Music itself holds no emotion. It's the heart that grants it meaning. So, dear listener, tell me. What feelings did my piece evoke in you?\"\n \nIn Egla Town, countless people may meet and part with every passing moment. As a wandering bard, Ciaccona had always been an observer of stories, witnessing their beginnings, progression, and endings...\n \nUntil one morning, when she glimpsed an outlander from afar in the morning light, she knew that a new melody was about to sound.\n \nThat was Ciaccona's first conversation with you. But to her, it may not have been the first time the two of you met.\n \nUnder the night sky ablaze with fireworks, she witnessed the masked outlander claim the <te href=850103>Laurel</te>, outshining the stars and sparks amid the crowd's cheers.\n \nWhat defines a hero praised in legends? Is it strength? Courage? Kindness? Or justice...?\n \nThose qualities all converged on the radiant silhouette standing before her.\n \n\"If given the opportunity, I'd like to write a poem for you, Laureate.\"\n \nThe gentle breeze of Whisperwind Haven silently rides along the tides, passing over windmills and chimneys, then sweeping across the wilderness until it reaches a red-haired girl with antlers. She plays her lute among dancing birds, and the lingering wind soon carries her song to distant places.\n \n\"In her world, poetry and music each hold equal sway...\"\n \nAs the girl with antlers watches you and Carlotta emerge from the wind, something tells her she too might soon be swept into a story.\n \nBards have always remained in the shadows as observers of another's legend. But stepping out from the pages, Ciaccona finds herself drawn into a story. There is both excitement and a hint of unease.\n \nThis time. For herself, she shall sing."
    }
  ],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "You must be exhausted from your long journey. Well, time to sit down, take a break, and enjoy some poetry and music. What do you have in mind today? A heroic epic, or a simple jolly tale of rural life?",

    {
      "type": 1,

      "content": "While reality may not have those magical swords and spells flying around in stories, that doesn't mean they have no meaning. The enduring goodness and beauty we find in those tales help us love the world even more.",

    {
      "type": 1,

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Oops. Bum note.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Better get serious.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "The pitch is lowered.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Wonders and tragedies go together.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Playing the last note...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "I hear the weeping aria…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_die_01.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "The poems will be sung again…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_die_02.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "The melodies... have faded...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_die_03.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "A perfect chord.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_xiakong_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Seeing is believing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_xiakong_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Tuning in.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_engage.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Nice and easy.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "A pleasant surprise.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_scan.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Mind the tempo.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_dash_01.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_dash_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Fortune's singing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xiakong_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_xiakong_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Quill of Poetry",
      "content": "An exquisitely crafted quill that speaks through its feather. In the hands of a poet, it gives rise to endless inspiration, recounting lively tavern tales of thousand-year glaciers, the grand ruins of underground cities, and enchanted forests. \n \nWhere will the hero's legend unfold this time?",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure97_UI.T_Treasure97_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Miniature Instrument",
      "content": "A trinket Ciaccona bought from a marketplace. She was told it was a miniature instrument capable of producing sound.\n\nShe often says that a performer's state of mind is intimately tied to the music, and that an instrument is not defined by its price. Not even if it is a tiny one... \n\nWith eyes wide open, the crowd waits for this young girl to bring forth sounds that create miracles.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure96_UI.T_Treasure96_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Musical Remembrance",
      "content": "A music box of fine craftsmanship, gifted to Ciaccona by a merchant after hearing her performance. Ciaccona's melodies can be recreated at a gentle turn of the handle. This made her realize that music can exist forever in another form.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure100_UI.T_Treasure100_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Quadruple Time Steps",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title> Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> upon the target hit.\n- When the first three stages of Ciaccona's Basic Attack are interrupted by dodging, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Basic Attack in time to resume the attack cycle and cast the corresponding Basic Attack stage.\n- After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona starts a <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>. If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 or <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> ends early (proactively or being interrupted), an <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylph</color> is generated.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Solo Concert</color></size>\nWhen Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Ensemble Sylph</color></size>\nUp to 2 Ensemble Sylphs may exist simultaneously.\nIf Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will finish the attack for Ciaccona and enter <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.\nIf Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> is interrupted, the <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylphs</color> generated will continue the <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> for Ciaccona.\nAside from the two situations mentioned above, Ensemble Sylphs generated by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> will finish Ciaccona's current attack without entering <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to jump into mid-air and attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Aimed Attack</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Aim to enter Aiming Mode to fire charged shots, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 2 to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nFollow up successful <color=Highlight>Dodges</color> with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color> inflicts <color=Highlight>Aero Erosion</color> on the target.\nInterruptions to <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color> generate <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylph</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ensemble Sylph</color></size>\nFinishes Ciaccona's interrupted attack after being generated.\nAll nearby Resonators in the team gain Aero DMG bonus when a green light circle appears beneath Ciaccona or <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylph</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Aimed Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Singer's Triple Cadenza",
        "desc": "Ciaccona and <color=Highlight><te href=850059>Ensemble Sylphs</te></color> perform an <color=Highlight>Improvised Symphonic Poem</color> together, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> once to the nearby targets and entering <color=Highlight>Recital</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Recital</color></size>\nWhen in Recital, sound waves will periodically radiate around Ciaccona. When the sound wave overlaps with the circle indicator, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the green or yellow buttons to generate <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> of the corresponding color and recover a certain amount of Concerto Energy.\nDuring Recital:\n- Switching to another Resonator doesn't end Recital, but automatically generates a <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> matching the color of the last generated Tonic before switching. A green <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> is generated by default if no interaction input is given before switching to another Resonator.\n- Ciaccona is immune to interruptions and takes {0} less DMG.\n- Exit Recital by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} Resonance Liberation again or switching Ciaccona back onto the field.\n- <color=Highlight><te href=850059>Ensemble Sylphs</te></color> can now directly grant Aero DMG Bonus provided by <color=Highlight><te href=850060>Solo Concert</te></color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color></size>\nGreen Tonic: Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets and inflict a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on targets hit.\nYellow Tonic: Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets and inflict a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> on targets hit.",
        "param": [
          "50%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and enter an <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced State</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the interactive button at the right time to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and trigger different effects based on the color of the button hit:\n- Green: Inflict <color=Highlight>Aero Erosion</color>.\n- Yellow: Inflict <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color>.\nCiaccona will stay in the <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color> after switching to other Resonators, and will trigger the effect of the last hit button again before the switch.\n<color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylphs</color>' Aero DMG Bonus effect can be triggered in the <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Symphony of Wind and Verse",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat</color></size>\nWhen there are 3 segments of Musical Essence, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat</color>.\nConsume all Musical Essence to shoot <color=Highlight>Downbeat Notes</color> forward to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, pulling in the nearby targets and inflicting 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the target hit.\n<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat</color> can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Musical Essence</color></size>\nCiaccona can hold up to 3 segments of Musical Essence.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> recovers 1 segment of Musical Essence.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> restore <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> is full, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color> is enabled.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight>Aero Erosion</color> on the target, continuously pulling in nearby targets.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Wind Cutter",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting the skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> directly.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Razor Wind</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Razor Wind</color>. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after landing to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color>.\n- At max <te href=850056>Windstrings</te>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after landing to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Unbound Flow</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Razor Wind</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> at the cost of STA.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Illusion Breaker",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Awakening Gale</color></size>\nJump up into the mid-air and slash the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Skyfall Severance</color></size>\nWhile in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, which removes all stacks of <te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te>, <te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te>, <te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te>, <te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te>, and <te href=850013>Electro Flare</te> from the target hit and inflicts 1 stack of <te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te> for each stack removed.",
        "param": [],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Cycle of Wind",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cloudburst Dance</color></size>\nPerform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and healing all nearby Resonators in the team. Cast through the following 3 ways:\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Awakening Gale</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Razor Wind</color>.\nWhen casting Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Cloudburst Dance</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Unbound Flow</color></size>\nAt max Windstrings, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Awakening Gale</color> becomes Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Unbound Flow</color>: Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks. Each attack consumes 60 Windstrings, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered Resonance Skill DMG.\nSwitching to another Resonator after Stage 1 automatically triggers Stage 2 of this skill. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Windstring</color></size>\nRover can hold up to 120 Windstrings.\nEach stage of Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Cloudburst Dance</color> restores 25 Windstrings on hit.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> restores 20 Windstrings.\nHitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 or 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> restores 10 Windstrings.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cloudburst Dance</color></size>\nAfter casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Awakening Gale</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, or Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Razor Wind</color>, Rover can cast Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Cloudburst Dance</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Unbound Flow</color></size>\nMid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Cloudburst Dance</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> restore Windstrings.\nAt max Windstrings, Rover can cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Unbound Flow</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "The Knight's Faded Hours",
      "content": "A retired dramatist enjoys telling a certain story: Once upon a time, in the countryside of Egla Town, there was a wandering knight. With sword in hand, he journeyed far and wide in search of a legendary giant. A giant who stood as tall as a windmill, with arms long and slender like its blades. Time after time, the wandering knight fought with everything he had against the giant, but the giant never spoke a word, only ever waving its arms, rendering the knight's attacks futile.\n\nSome mocked the knight's foolishness, some pitied his delusion. After all, that so-called giant was nothing more than a windmill, and his battles were but a fantasy. But the countryside's most mischievous girl saw it differently.\n\nShe found herself a knight's helmet and begged the dramatist for a small wooden sword. \"To fight for such a giant,\" she said, \"he must possess a heart of pure nobility.\" And so, she too wished to be like the knight, to seek out the giant who destroyed homes and scattered livestock, and see that the Golden Thiefbats lurking along roads could no longer steal a single treasure from travelers.\n\nRiding flamboyantly on a Tumbleyak, she raced through the wheat fields. The world had never felt so vast. This was where the Blessed Maiden's legends began. Through the fields, through the festivities, and into the Inverted Tower.\n\nIt would be a grand quest."
    },
    {
      "title": "Steadfast in the Final Dance",
      "content": "This quest continued for some time.\n\nIn those unnoticed moments, the girl visited every field in Whisperwind Haven. Mischievous and free-spirited by nature, she even stole sips of sacramental wine under the watch of guards, danced away on high platforms, and turned a solemn ceremony into complete madness. Even the Order's prison walls became her personal canvas.\n\n\"She's really the most rambunctious girl in the countryside,\" people would say. \"A serious fate isn't one she's meant for, and no wall, no matter how strong, could ever keep her from spreading her wings.\"\n\nYet to everyone's surprise, she was chosen by the Divinity.\n\nWhy her? Some questioned. She was only the daughter of an official, a peasant girl lacking discipline! Not a drop of noble blood ran in her veins. How would she ever come to understand the hierarchies of the world?\n\n\"She is the one!\" others exclaimed. \"She listens to our sorrows and replaces them with joy! If anyone is worthy of Divinity's crown, it is her.\"\n\nBut what would the one bearing the name Fleurdelys think of all this? Before the ceremony to receive her holy name, in a dull and stuffy hall, she performed her final dance as Cartethyia.\n\nWas she confused by Divinity's whispers? Fearful of an uncertain future? Confident that she could wield the sacred sword?\n\nShe simply kept the name \"Cartethyia\" hidden deep within her heart. Farewell, grain fields swaying in the breeze, and the Tumbleyaks roaming so free. In a world so vast, someone must take up the sword. Someone must bind themselves in thorns. Someone must accept the weight of responsibilities. Someone—\n\nMust become Fleurdelys, the guardian of <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>."
    },
    {
      "title": "Hesitation Amid Gale and Tide",
      "content": "As Fleurdelys, she must march to war with a sword in hand.\n\nFor this, she learned everything she could. She studied Order scriptures and honed her combat skills. She listened to the voices of the people, devoting herself to fulfilling their wishes. When someone prayed for good health, she arranged for the delivery of valuable medicines. When someone sought peace, she would listen to their confessions, taking in their past sorrows. When a <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te> Outbreak occurred, she drew her sword and crushed it in its infancy. These actions were no different from what she had done back home.\n\nThe only difference was that she was no longer facing a small village or familiar faces. Most of those seeking her help were strangers, and she understood that each of them was like a small lamp. The more she helped, the more they would shine in the night sky of <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>.\n\nYet, the world was so vast, and the Order was far from flawless, as the books had claimed. The nobility were fixated only on their own interests, and self-proclaimed devout Acolytes merely performed their faith, turning a blind eye to the people's cries. She saw nobles who boasted of their good hearts while stuffing their pockets, refusing to hear the pleas of those suffering.\n\nAt times like these, all she could do was tighten her grip on her sword.\n\nShe experienced doubt, disturbance, and disappointment. And because of this, her grip only tightened as she faced the Dark Tide—She would question the Divinity. She must.\n\nNo matter the answer that awaited her, Fleurdelys was ready for it.\n\nWith this resolve, she walked into the tower. Alone."
    },
    {
      "title": "Yet Within Solitude",
      "content": "She seemed to have dreamed for a very long time.\n\nIn that dream, hymns and praises poured toward her in endless waves, engulfing her. She raised her sword to cut through the waves again and again, battling the giant sea creature in those waters. She fought with all her might. Even when the waters turned into blades sharp enough to slice flesh, she did not take a single step back.\n\nWhen she opened her eyes, she found herself alone in an unfamiliar place.\n\nWhere was she? What was her purpose? Who was she? Questions whose answers had slipped beyond memory.\n\nShe wandered the tower in search of what was lost. She even tried to find a way into the central tower to seek answers. But after exploring every corner she could reach, she found nothing but herself. There was no \"other\" existence. She was the only soul there.\n\nSo she began to converse with herself. She stitched dolls from scraps. She invented stories.\n\nCuriously, the fog of her memories began to lift, little by little, beneath her fingertips.\n\nShe made one doll of a sword-wielding girl and another of a sea monster. She muttered a few lines of dialogue between them, then paused. She knew this story. She'd heard it before. The <ano=wandering knight>sword-wielding girl</ano> had journeyed to confront the terrifying <ano=sea monster>giant</ano> of legend. Time and time again, she fought it with everything she had. \n\nNo matter what the <ano=wandering knight>sword-wielding girl</ano> was fighting for, she understood one thing—\n\nEach time she raised her sword, she did not care about her past. She only cared about what needed to be done at that very moment.\n\nAnd if that were true, then losing her memories was no great loss. In a world so vast, she would find herself again.\n\nAnd when that time comes, whether she turns out to be the warrior or the monster, it's an answer she would be willing to accept."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Wandering Knight Marches To Freedom",
      "content": "Inside a small restaurant in Whisperwind Haven, a young girl orders several Laurus Salads. While waiting for her food, she quietly sneaks into the kitchen, following the head chef and carefully observing her culinary techniques.\n\n\"Hmm. A few more of these Viscum Berries, please. Ah, yes, yes. And another!\"\n\n\"You can add more honey as well... Yes, thank you!\"\n\n\"And where did you come from, little rascal? If you're waiting for your food, you need to wait outside.\" The head chef puts down her utensils and looks up, pausing in astonishment. The girl before her seems familiar, but she can't quite place a name.\n\n\"I-I'm so sorry! I just wanted to pick up some of your cooking skills. I have a long journey ahead of me, and I might not have the fortune to come across a restaurant serving such delicious food again. If my apology isn't enough, I'll chop some firewood for you instead.\"\n\n\"Is this your first time eating at our restaurant? I have a feeling I've seen you before.\" The head chef hands the curious girl her food. \n\n\"Was it from that stained glass window...?\"\n\n\"This isn't my first time, actually! But it's been quite a while since I last visited,\" the girl replies, taking the plate. \"Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Cartethyia. I'm a wandering knight preparing for a new quest. If you ever need help, do let me know.\"\n\n\"I just had to try this before I begin my journey!\" The girl scoops up a spoonful of salad and takes a bite.\n\nIn a world so vast, a salad full of Viscum Berries made the beginning of her journey feel just right.\n\n\"How delicious.\" She praises from her heart."
    }

      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "Haultir is my sword and my very first companion.       "type": 1,
