      "content": "I was born from the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>'s curse and malice. It made me wear the crown, bathe in the glory of the Blessed Maiden, surrounded by the reverence of countless faithfuls. I fought against Its false faith, day after day, until I was finally overwhelmed by the tides... In that long slumber, those familiar prayers no longer felt warm, but cold and sorrowful. At one point, I thought I'd never want to hear them again. But after you saved me from the tower, I secretly visited <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> City… Oh, then I knew, I've never resented the prayers of those longing for happiness. And to ensure these pure voices aren't twisted, there's still much I need to do, and can do.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_story_exp.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_story_exp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Cantarella",
      "content": "I… took away the brilliant future she was meant to have. The future of being the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s true Blessed Maiden. All the goodwill and hopes placed upon me, and the power I now possess… all of it should have belonged to Cantarella. Yet, she never seemed bothered by it. Someone as mature as her must have already found her own path within the <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family. But still, I'll always remember that I owe her so much… so much.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_kanteleila.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_kanteleila"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Phoebe",
      "content": "That girl has a kind and gentle heart. Duties aside, she always does her best to be there for others. Honestly, when it comes to knowledge of the Order's doctrines, I'm nowhere near as good as Phoebe. It's because of so many true and faithful believers like her, I find it difficult to reveal the truth to the people of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>. People turn to faith for many reasons, not just out of devotion to the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. To unveil such unsettling truths would bring forth countless difficult choices and challenges...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_feibi.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_feibi"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Carlotta",
      "content": "As the daughter of <te href=850101>Montelli</te>, she has really brought fresh ideas to the city. If this island were to stay isolated, the air would grow stifling. The people of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> need new ships, new horizons, and new discoveries. I'm not very skilled in business matters, though. My nanny in the Order always said I didn't even know how to haggle... If I ever get the chance, I'd love to learn a few tricks from Miss Carlotta!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_kelaita.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_kelaita"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Ciaccona",
      "content": "When I was a child, I used to beg the bards passing through town to sing me stories of knights. After I was freed from the tower, I wandered through a field one day, and the wind carried a piece of beautiful music to me. I stood beneath a tree in the distance, listening as Ciaccona sang a new poem, one with the melody of Egla Town's folk songs… In the blink of an eye, noon had already given way to dusk.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_xiakong.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_xiakong"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Lupa",
      "content": "The nature of the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>'s power to converge often makes me appear dangerous and unsettling after battle, but Lupa has never once recoiled. She never treats me as more or less than I am, and she has never distanced herself. She is honest, tenacious, and unwavering in her care of her friends. Even though I'm shorter than her when not in my Fleurdelys form, I still feel that I should take on the role of the \"older sister\" in our friendship.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_lupa.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_about_lupa"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "Happy Birthday, {PlayerName}! You're probably wondering why I brought you here. Just look at the clouds, the soaring birds, the Inverted Tower, and the golden glow of the morning sun... As long as you hold my hand, I can guide you to float above the sea like this. It's fascinating, isn't it? Later, when the sun sinks into the ocean, the view will be even more mesmerizing. I used to stare at this every day from the tower, and I grew weary of it. But now, everything feels different, all because of you. I'm not the true Maiden. I don't have the power to grant blessings, but I still want to offer you my best wishes. May your heart's deepest desire come true.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Today's story is... the great battle between a righteous knight and the wicked <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>! The victor is—Cartethyia the Knight!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_katixiya_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "Smells so good...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_katixiya_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "Time for a little nap... It's... It's just a dream...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_katixiya_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Cartethyia, now a wandering knight. The <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>'s malicious creation, the Order's unsuspecting <te href=850103>Laureate</te>, the defier lost in the tides of fate... These titles, once portrayed in poems and books, have long since slipped from my grasp. As for what lies ahead... let’s explore it together,  \"Swordbearer.\"",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "The crown of winds... has been engulfed by the sea. Tell me, are you the one who summoned this blade?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "Now begins the knight's story!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "This sword shall follow your will.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Ready to venture forth together?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "My swordsmanship has reached new heights!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "Can you feel it? The frequency of the wind... it's resonating between us.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "During my studies at the seminary, I knew that to uphold justice, I would need to work harder and sacrifice more than others to overcome the shadows that sought to destroy it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "The power within me once terrified me. I wondered how monstrous I'd become if it consumed me... But such terrors have started to fade, with you by my side.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "The currents of fate pull everything into their depths. At times, as I drift in its grasp, I sometimes feel resistance. Everything I once achieved, every ounce of trust I earned, was consumed by the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>. How ironic that the power I gained to protect others once served to sustain my nemesis. But I know I cannot let this fear hold me back. The <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> granted me life, and I must honor that blessing by guarding all that remains in Their stead.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_katixiya_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: I",
      "content": "Exonerate",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_atk_atk04_pro_01.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_atk_atk04_pro_01"

    },
    {

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_skill_skill02_02.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_skill_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Oceans, bow before me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_katixiya_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "True form, revealed at last.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_katixiya_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Repent, for silence beckons.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_katixiya_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,

      "content": "Windstorm, sweep all away!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: V",
      "content": "My blade, purge all evil!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VI",
      "content": "Furious tides, split the heavens!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VII",
      "content": "The fallen, embrace your end.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst02_01.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VIII",
      "content": "Heretic, face your reckoning.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst02_02.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_burst_burst02_02"
    },
    {

    },

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Too reckless!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {

      "content": "If it's a duel you want...",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: IV",
      "content": "Impudent!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_behitfly_02"

    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "The trial isn't over yet.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "I won't back down.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "This sword... shall not be shattered!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: IV",
      "content": "A mere scratch upon my blade.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: V",
      "content": "Vexing malice.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: VI",
      "content": "The haunting whispers return…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "I'm… sorry…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_die_01.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "My quest... ends here...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_die_02.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Yet another long, dark dream.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_die_01.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: IV",
      "content": "Echoes of turbulent waves…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_die_02.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: V",
      "content": "This sword… lies broken.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_die_03.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon: I",
      "content": "Such is Their blessing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_katixiya_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon: II",
      "content": "Charge forth with me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform: I",
      "content": "A \"divine envoy\" then?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_katixiya_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform: II",
      "content": "What form do you look for?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near: I",
      "content": "The knight's challenge has arrived!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_engage.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near: II",
      "content": "Shadows must be purged.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_engage.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "I can fly too.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "My knightly instinct says... this way!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_scan.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Just like the treasure chests from the stories!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "This should afford us more provisions.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Let's call it... A Knight's Great Harvest.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_katixiya_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_katixiya_com_openbox_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: IV",
      "content": "What is it you wish for?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: V",
      "content": "Fortune is on your side.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: VI",
      "content": "Your wish for wealth is granted.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_fuludelisi_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Worn Wooden Sword",
      "content": "A small wooden stage prop sword. Even the quiet countryside of Egla Town wasn't untouched by <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>'s popular stage plays. Spinning windmills and brilliant knightly legends shaped Cartethyia's childhood. This wooden sword was a gift from a retired dramatist. Each day after her lessons, she would patrol the village with bright eyes and high spirits, brandishing it as she dealt with every \"injustice\" she encountered.\n\nThis should have been the start of her journey to becoming a wandering knight.\n\nFate is full of what should have been, but it never unfolds as we imagine.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure102_UI.T_Treasure102_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Golden Laurel",
      "content": "A small golden <te href=850103>Laurel</te>.\n\nWhen the golden crown was placed upon her head, the Divinity's whispers reached her ears for the first time.\nFrom that moment on, she was no longer Cartethyia. She would become <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>'s Blessed Maiden, the \"Fleurdelys\" spoken of by all.\n\nFate can be too kind at first, only to become a rain that never stops falling.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure101_UI.T_Treasure101_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Hand Puppets",
      "content": "Hand puppets locked in a scuffle.\n\nShe had searched the tower for what felt like forever, yet found no trace of another soul. So she made puppets, staging play after play, just to keep from forgetting how to speak, and to fill the silence of being alone.\n\nShe missed the plays she had seen in the world of the living, missed the wheat fields of the countryside, missed sweet drinks and the sounds of people laughing.\n\nFate can fill us with nostalgia, even as it sends us onward alone.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure106_UI.T_Treasure106_UI"
    }
  ],

  "skill_trees": {
    "1": {
      "parent_nodes": [],

      "consume": [

        }
      ],
      "skill": {
        "name": "Sword to Carve My Forms",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\nFollowing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color> Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on targets hit and summon <color=Highlight><te href=850186>Sword of Divinity's Shadow</te></color>.\nUp to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850186>Sword of Divinity's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.\n \n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color></size> \nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and summoning <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color>. Can be performed in mid-air.\nUp to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.\nThis instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>\nRelease <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, also considered <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after the <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color> recalls all <color=Highlight>Sword Shadows</color>. Based on the types and number of <color=Highlight> Sword Shadows</color> recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color>, and <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Cartethyia</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and inflict <color=Wind>Aero Erosion</color> on the target. Summon <color=Highlight>Sword Shadow II</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and summon <color=Highlight>Sword Shadow I</color>.\nThis instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and recall all <color=Highlight>Sword Shadows</color>.\nThis instance of DMG is also considered <color=Wind>Aero Erosion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Cartethyia</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "simple_param": [],

      "skill": {
        "name": "A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color></size>\nBy reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, unlocking new moves and entering the <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> state for 12s.\nCan be performed in mid-air.\nEntering <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> clears all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>.\nAs <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> instantly trigger 1 instance of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG and reduce the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stack on the target hit by 1.\n- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.\n- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.\n\n<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> attacks restore <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> reaches 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.\n\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to transform back into <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>. When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.\n\nWhen <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:\n- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4</color> will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.\n- <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> resistance to interruption increases. \n<color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.\n\nWhen <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>: \n<color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>.\n<color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.\n \nWhen <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> or after <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> deals damage, raise the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.\n<color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.\n \n<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> will transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> during <color=Highlight>quest dialogues</color>, <color=Highlight>environmental interaction animations</color>, or using <color=Highlight>Utilities</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.\n \n<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Cartethyia</color></size>\nAs <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, when <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color> and temporarily transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>, which pauses the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color>.\n \n<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Fleurdelys</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting Resonance Liberation as <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> performs <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, which resumes the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>, ends <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.\nCan be cast in mid-air.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Cartethyia</color></size>\nAt the cost of HP, transform into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, during which certain attacks immediately trigger <color=Wind>Aero Erosion</color> DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Manifest</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> gains the following effects corresponding to the different types of <color=Highlight>Sword Shadow</color> recalled.\n- <color=Highlight>Sword Shadow I</color>: Certain attacks propagate the highest stacks of <color=Wind>Aero Erosion</color> on targets hit to all nearby targets.\n- <color=Highlight>Sword Shadow II</color>: The damage interval of <color=Highlight>Aero Erosion</color> DMG is reduced and the <color=Highlight>Aero Erosion</color> DMG taken by the target is Amplified.\n- <color=Highlight>Sword Shadow III</color>: Certain attacks Stagnate the enemy. Gain increased resistance to interruption.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation Finisher </color></size>\nRestore HP and deal a massive amount of <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Tempest",
        "desc": "<color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> unlocks new moves when she transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>:\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size> \n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.\nPerform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size> \n<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.\nWhile airborne, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.\nFollow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.\nWhile airborne, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> resets the cycle of <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.\nThrust forward to deliver a focused strike, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size>\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> again to cast Enhanced <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>: fall back and blast the area in a straight line in front, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.\nFollow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Upward Cut - Fleurdelys</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Upward Cut - Fleurdelys</color></size>\nWhile <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> is on the ground, <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys</color></size> \n<color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.\nFollow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 </color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color></size> \n<color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color>.\nSummon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color></size>\nFollowing <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to ground targets, and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.\nFollow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.\nThe Resonance Skill enters cooldown if <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator. \nCan be cast in mid-air.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Fleurdelys</color></size>\nTransform into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> and unlock new moves.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> is able to freely transform between herself and <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge</color></size>\nAs <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, attacks restore <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> is full, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation Finisher</color> is available.",
