  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "Unknown",
    "sex": "Female",
    "country": "Rinascita",
    "influence": "Septimont",
    "info": "She is favored by fate under one name, and swept away by it in another. Yet never once has she been defeated, nor has she ever yielded.\nNow, witness the defiant Priestess. Witness what keeps her striding forward, never to look back. Witness how she walks the intricate web of destiny and becomes the only answer.",
    "talent_name": "Stasis, Cycle, Renewal",
    "talent_doc": "[Excerpt from the <te href=850152>Priestess</te> Register, Tetragon Temple]\nThis entry concerns the 127th Priestess of the Tetragon Temple, known as Iu▇.\n\nShe was born on the night of hollowed moon. As a <te href=850068>Congenital Resonator</te>, her eyes are said to hold the power to ▇▇▇▇.\n\nHer Tacet Mark is located atop her left foot. When she activates her Resonance ability, ▇▇ energy constructs with the shape of lunar phases manifest around her, and the tips of her hair turn translucent, radiating a gentle glow that is almost indistinguishable from actual moonlight.\n\nResonance spectral analysis reveals that her Forte aligns extraordinarily closely with the frequency pattern of the natural moon, exhibiting a continuous, phase-like modulation. Notably, three years ago, her Forte appeared to ▇▇▇▇. It became capable of An▇ and Mani▇, enabling her to shape moonlight into solid arrows that can reveal marked monsters hid▇ in the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>.\n\n<i>When we archived this entry, Grandmother Lillibet asked us to verify it multiple times. Oddly, none of us could remember who had written it in the first place. And stranger still, no one seems to recall the Priestess described here. Could a powerful Priestess like her have truly existed? Somehow, this out-of-nowhere record feels as if it was written by the moonlight itself!</i>",
    "talent_certification": "[Excerpt from the <te href=850152>Priestess</te> Register, Tetragon Temple]\nThis entry concerns the 127th Priestess of the Tetragon Temple.\n\nThe waveform of this Priestess remains largely within controllable parameters, with no signs of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> risk. However, multiple interruptions of varying durations have been observed, accompanied by a gradual and consistent decline in her frequency. This suggests a possible state of long-term depletion. The underlying cause remains unknown. The Priestess has refused further examination and shows limited willingness to engage in deeper dialogue on the matter.\n\n<i>It‘s clear she understands far more about her own condition than she lets on. But if this waveform continues to diminish beyond the controllable range, or even to zero… what would possibly happen then?</i>\n<i>Is she truly unafraid? Or has she already found a way to intervene?</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Jiang Yingjun",
    "cv_name_jp": "Lynn",
    "cv_name_ko": "Yoon Eun Seo",
    "cv_name_en": "Ella Boyes"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "At First, She Closed Her Eyes",
      "content": "Iuno awakens as if pulled from the deep water.\n\nAir fills her lungs little by little. The stone steps beneath her feet are cold and solid. Every growing trace of sensation surprises her. Too vivid, too real. To disappear means nothing remains. The past, the present, and all that might have been... nothing but silence. She has already accepted that cost and her vanishing. So why, like some sunken, waterlogged remnant, is she still here?\n\nIn fact, she doesn't even know where she is. Everything around her looks normal, yet carries a heavy and sluggish pull, as if time might stand still at any second. Only the path beneath her continues. It's damp, cracked, yet stubborn. So she walks. Each step feels like treading on cooled bones, carrying her deeper into the unknown.\n\nKeep walking.\n\nThat was what Iuno did most as a child. She walked over stone, moss, petals, even across bubbling springs. She never needed a reason, never chased meaning. She simply couldn't sit still. Just the thought of unseen places and untried things filled her with joy. She wanted to feel everything.\n\nHer mother, Sibylla, was perhaps the only one who truly knew how to raise a child like that—free-spirited, wild, yet never arrogant. Sibylla bound her with no noble rules. She let Iuno run wild and embrace her longing. There was never just one path. Whichever one Iuno chose, her mother waited at the end.\n\nThat day began like any other. Young Iuno darted up the stairs, running straight into her mother's arms. Sibylla bent down to pull her close, her hand on the back of her head, her voice warm. \"My Iuno did wonderfully as usual.\" Of course she did. Iuno blinked proudly. That Grandmother <te href=851017>Lillibet</te> had said she'd be the most gifted <te href=850152>Priestess</te> Septimont had ever seen. But... why just Priestess? Why couldn't she be gifted in something else?\n\nBack then, Iuno still held a pure, innocent curiosity toward prophecies. She was too young to realize that to be favored by fate was a cost in itself.\n\nBut fate was tired of waiting.\n\nIuno's smile froze. She saw her mother coming apart, unraveling. Flesh sloughed off like melting wax. Blackness gnawed at her, but what spilled wasn't blood. It was darker and thicker than night, surging forward as if it would flood into Iuno's eyes the next second.\n\nShe stumbled back, then shut her eyes tight. It was too dark, too cold, too close. She clung to her mother's sleeve, trembling. Then, she forced her eyes open again, and everything was normal. The tide of fate had swept over her, sudden and unannounced. And just as swiftly, it had receded, leaving behind only the faintest touch.\n\nShe would speak of what she never truly saw that day, again and again. And her mother would only smile and smooth her hair. \"It's alright, my dear. You've seen enough.\" \n\nAnd then, in a support operation, her mother was taken by the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>, drowned in the endless filth. Those comforting words sank with her and never rose again. Iuno replayed that ordinary day countless times. When had the gray calcified matter begun to creep across her mother's body? When did the blackness first start to flow? Was that the key?\n\n\"If I had known… could I have saved her?\"\n\"What if... I hadn't closed my eyes?\"\n\nYoung Iuno stands once more on the stone steps and looks back. She opens her eyes wide, trying to etch the missing part into her gaze. But even now, in the realm devoid of reality, she sees nothing.\n\n\"One more chance.\"\nHer voice is barely a whisper, like it wants to dissolve in the damp air. Maybe she speaks to herself. Maybe to something else entirely.\n\n\"Just give me one more chance… Let me see it.\"\n\nBut fate never looks back. Only the path below remains, layered like bones, pulling a shadowed figure closer with every step.\n\nThat is Iuno herself. She comes forward, step by step, passing the spot where her mother always stands waiting, toward the younger version of herself. The pull is nearly paralyzing. Soon, everything might return to silence. But it is alright. There is still enough time for one response.\n\nShe has been pulled from the depths. And in this brief breath, she chooses to pull something up in return.\n\nIuno kneels. The child before her has tear-bright eyes, lashes trembling, as if they might shut again. She reaches out and gently taps those small eyelids.\n\n\"Then, just don't close them.\"\n\"No matter how dark, how cold, how close… Don't close them.\"\n\nSuddenly, the wind rises. It blows from nowhere, across the tallest spires, through the low trees, and stops, just there, upon the layered steps. Just enough to dry the corner of Iuno's eyes."
    },
    {
      "title": "I Offer You the Bitterness of a Moongazer",
      "content": "Once again, Iuno awakens as if pulled from the deep water.\n\nEver since the moment she first met her younger self and answered her, Iuno has begun to relive more and more of these strange awakenings.\n\nSometimes, she sees the past. Sometimes, she sees herself. But more often, she is simply made to bear it all again as she is, reliving memory as if it were the present, again and again, until everything slows, until silence swallows her whole, until the next awakening comes.\n\nShe grows used to the cycle. It begins to feel almost normal. But still, a quiet absurdity lingers. No one else remembers these moments stripped of meaning. Yet they cling to her, the one who chose to disappear. She alone is made to carry them in endless cycles. Is this fate's cruel trick? Or punishment for vanishing?\n\nBut there are no answers. She is awake again, and that means another fragment of the past has caught up to her.\n\nThat day, the rain was heavy and cold, but it didn't stop the crowd from gathering inside the Tetragon Temple. They had come to witness the arrival of the long-foretold prodigy, soon to join the ranks of the <te href=850152>Priestesses</te>. That day, Iuno heard more about the Priestesses than ever before: awe, reverence, and fantastical rumors. Some claimed that Priestesses could glimpse the ultimate truth and discover perfection buried within despair in their final moments.\n\nAfter all, Priestesses stood closer than anyone to fate, to the future, to the unknown, and to the right path. That alone was enough to stir envy. But to Iuno, half of those claims were lies. And the other half, delusion. Because the night before that very day, while resting in the garden with the others, she had witnessed a Priestess's death.\n\nA white dove had landed beneath the ancient laurel tree, its wings fluttering, barely covering the sound of weakening sighs. The dying Priestess turned to her, voice faint, and whispered:\n\n\"You... you're not like us. You were born able to see. So go. See it for us.\"\n\n\"I will,\" Iuno replied, almost inaudibly.\n\nIt was something she could do. But the one who heard her promise would never live to see it fulfilled. So yes, even those who walk beside fate, future, and the unknown in between aren't always stronger than others. They can't always see how it ends for themselves. And they, too, long for an answer.\n\nProphecy is both a chain and a key. Iuno wants to hold the key. But if she can, she also wants to break the chain. That was why she chose to become a Priestess, yet was unbound by others' expectations or ideals.\n\nThat day, she wore not the ceremonial robe, but an ancient garment adorned with satin and gold. Not as a supplicant of fate, but as someone who dares to meet its gaze. She stepped forward, candelabrum in hand.\n\nWhispers stirred through the crowd. An Elder, rigid with tradition, muttered with disdain,\n\"Insolence... How can she be so lacking in humility?\"\n\nIuno heard him. And for the first and last time, she answered:\n\"One who sees needs not kneel.\"\n\nShe raised her head. Her grey-blue eyes, with the light shining down from the Temple's high dome in them, were sharp as blades, gleaming as if eager to cut something open.\n\nAfter that day, she began her long, unending dredge through the tide of chaos, reaching into the unknown for clarity. She saw more of the future. They were fragmented, frightening, and inescapable. She passed these visions on. Those who received them treated her words as scripture, a hope to clutch at. But Iuno knew better. They were only glimpses, fleeting slivers of fate slipping through the cracks.\n\nAnd the more she saw, the more she realized that these visions were just like blades. If one wielded them without cutting something open, they themselves would be cut instead.\n\nSince then, Iuno has never closed her eyes again. But deep inside, she begins to feel something tearing at her too.\n\nMaybe it's memory.\nMaybe it's the name people call her by.\nMaybe it's just a piece of herself that fades a little more each time she looks too closely at the world.\n\nStill, she is not afraid.\n\nShe stands in the wind of Septimont, rain clinging to her lashes like silver threads.\n\nGrandmother <te href=851017>Lillibet</te> once told her she was born to see it all. And she has. But now, she wants to see something else:\n\nWhether she can walk away from the blade and live to reach somewhere further."
    },
    {
      "title": "With Uncertainty, With Danger, With Defeat",
      "content": "Before the <te href=850159>High Tide</te> truly surged, Iuno was the first to foresee the devastating future.\n\nThe ominous creatures spawned by the tide were as dark as a moonless night. <te href=850164>Gladiators</te> fought with everything they had, but it was no use. Every time their weapons were about to pierce the Dark Tide creatures' bodies, those things would scatter and melt back into the tide, only to merge and be reborn. All they left behind was a trail of sneering, glistening sludge at the Gladiators' feet.\n\nSome things in this world won't bend to your will simply because you see them coming with perfect clarity.\n\nThat night, Iuno barely slept. In her dream, it wasn't the creatures drowning in the Dark Tide. It was her. The tide swallowed her mouth and nose, drawing her down inch by inch. She had never known how deep it went. When her feet finally touched the bottom, her eye caught a colder, sharper version of herself standing on the other side.\n\n\"You really believe that to see is to save?\"\nThe other Iuno smiled. In her eyes were countless shattered versions of Septimont—burned, sunken, rebuilt, and collapsed again.\n\"You can see everyone… except yourself.\"\n\nIuno tried to reply, but no sound came.\n\nThe Dark Tide still churned across the Plateaus. Gladiators charged time and again, always to little avail. More and more people gathered in the Tetragon Temple, waiting for her and the other Priestesses to offer some prophecy, something useful. They spoke of finding the end by tracing the beginning, of altering outcomes by understanding causes. They wanted to shape a better fate, but Iuno found herself speechless. She saw her mother's figure before buried by the Dark Tide. She saw buildings collapse, crowds scatter, and arrow after arrow loosed from her bow, each one engulfed in darkness before it could land.\n\nNothing had changed. She could see. But that was the only thing fate had ever allowed.\n\nAnother white night. Iuno sat again at her divination table. Ripples spread across the water. In the silence, she thought she heard a whisper:\n\n\"You can see it all… but if you only watch, what does that make you?\"\n\nFor a moment, every piece of foretold future in the past rose in her mind once more. Stone walls etched with insight stood still. Scrolls spilling over with prophecies unfolded. Threads of fate's light twisted around her. And she looked up, toward where it all converged. She saw the moon reflected overhead, the only thing that ever gave her direction. Perhaps that was the closest thing to the deep, unfathomable fate itself.\n\nIt never gave her answers. But this time, she didn't need one.\n\n\"If I can't change what I see… then let me shatter it.\"\nSo she raised her hand and severed it all. Drawing every line of power she could wield, with a reckless, defiant smile, she plunged the arrow downward.\n\nThe arrow struck without fanfare, but in that moment, it pinned the once hidden path of the Dark Tide, and nailed it between Septimont and destiny. For the first time, the monsters didn't slip away unseen but were torn apart, inch by inch, by the crackling blue-white light.\n\nBut the cost? After the battle, at a camp in the Plateaus, people raised their glasses in relief. The fire crackled, voices overlapped, and the celebration swelled on its own. Iuno stood at the edge of it all, away from the brightest flames.\n\nSomeone noticed her.\n\n\"...Who's that?\"\n\"Are you stupid or what? She's that Priestess… Wait, what's her name again? Iuno?\"\n\"Iuno the Priestess? You mean that prodigy everyone talked about?\"\n\"Weird. How could I've never heard of such a household name?\"\n\nA young Gladiator approached hesitantly. He raised a glass with polite care, his voice unsure. \"You… you were with us earlier, right? Anyway, just come join the celebration.\" \n\nIuno raised her eyebrows and said nothing. She just lifted her glass and clinked it against his.\n\nLater, outside the lantern light, she sat alone by the lakeside, chin resting on her knees, laughter hidden in the crook of her arm. She looked back at the path she had taken and the shadows that had followed her. Some were blurring, others had already cracked. She heard people calling behind her, but none of them used her name. She saw the eyes that had once met hers, now drifting away in confusion and unfamiliarity. Just not long ago, they had called her \"Iuno\" with such certainty when she gave her prophecy. They had stood with her before the arrows flew. And yet, everything they'd been through and survived was fading.\n\nBy the lake, she traced the surface with her fingertip, ripples breaking the reflections. She saw herself in the water. The outline was clear, but always veiled. She reached into the water, trying to touch the face. The moment her finger brushed it, the reflection shuddered, as if trying to flee.\n\n\"Don't run,\" Iuno laughed at the water. \"Even you can't recognize me now?\"\n\nThe surface rippled again, as if the reflection whispered back:\n\"Do you want to be remembered?\"\n\nIuno said nothing. She just brushed the water again, trying to make the image clearer. But her finger only shattered the surface, scattering the reflection with it.\n\n\"…Doesn't matter.\"\nAfter a long silence, she muttered softly, then tilted her head back, glaring at the moon. It hung above like a silver coin, bitten at the edge. A symbol of imperfection.\n\nIuno smiled at it, like greeting an old rival at last.\n\"…Even if you're the only one left who knows me… that's enough.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "A Thousand Times Has the Moon Fallen",
      "content": "Stillness. Submersion. Solitude. Waking. \nWithin this endless cycle, Iuno sometimes finds herself in moments that don't belong to her past.\n\nThat starless night, the moon hung lower than ever, so close it looked ready to fall into her open palm as she sat atop the roof. She didn't remember how she fell asleep. Or maybe she hadn't slept at all, just drifted, carried by moonlight into a gentle illusion she never dreamt of. A quiet retaliation, perhaps, for the arrow she once loosed into the sky… and the defiance she once dared to speak aloud.\n\nIn that place, there was no <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>. No doomsday. Only a strange yet familiar field. Children ran barefoot beneath the morning sun. Smokes spiraled up in the dusk. A girl, about her age, lounged on a bough of a fruit-laden tree, legs dangling lazily, expression soft, free like fish drifting in a sunlit sea. Iuno could almost see her smile, rippling out like circles across still water.\n\n\"You see?\" the moon spoke, its voice warm and honeyed. \"This, too, is a way to live.\"\n\nIuno didn't answer. She simply watched as that other version of herself waved at someone in the distance, then swung lightly down from the tree and gave her skirt a playful shake.\n\n\"That is you,\" the voice whispered. \"Such is the magic of illusion. You can glimpse snow and seas you never knew… lives you never lived.\"\n\nShe turned and saw the moon behind her. No longer just a quiet ornament of the sky, but more like a vast hollowed eye, always watching.\n\n\"There's nothing left for you to hold onto,\" it said again, voice gentle and ancient, like the way firelight once carried prophecy to her bones. \"So why not stay? It isn't real, no. But what harm is there in a little joy? Why be so cruel to yourself?\"\n\nAnd then, everything began to rewind.\nThe final ending. The thousandth. The hundredth… The tenth… The first.\nWhen one moves far enough backwards, crosses every threshold back to the starting point, the in-between becomes just numbers, easy to rewrite.\n\nThe other her laughed, running through the field, a basket of fruit spilling at her feet. Sunlight wrapped around her arms like a ribbon. Her companion stepped toward her now, smiling. \"Want to go to the seaside today?\" she asked, like it was the most natural thing in the world.\n\n\"Have you ever considered,\" the moon murmured, \"that everything you have become is because you were bound by prophecy from the start? That you never truly had a choice? But… what if you did?\"\n\n\"You know this isn't real,\" Iuno said quietly, her gaze lifting to the moon, strangely present now in the blue daylight sky.\n\n\"And you know you can never go back,\" it replied. Not cruel, just softly persuasive.\n\"Everything you had is buried. This is where you belong now, and every day forward,\" the moon paused. \"Even now, in illusion, you still refuse to forget yourself. You won't let go of your past and embrace a new, possible life. Such infuriating stubbornness.\"\n\nIuno said nothing.\nShe looked down at her palm. No bow. Only a bundle of unbloomed wildflowers.\n\nAfter a long pause, she gave a small, lopsided smile. \"And you're just like me,\" she whispered. \"Stubborn.\"\n\nShe looked again at her other self. That girl was now wandering a lively street, pausing in front of a glass storefront, laughing freely.\n\n\"Are you lonely?\" the moon asked.\nIuno tilted her head. \"Maybe… a little,\" she admitted.\n\"Don't you want someone to hear that loneliness?\"\n\"That would make me look fragile.\"\n\"Then would you deny it?\"\n\"That's just another kind of fragility.\"\n\"So?\"\n\nShe whispered back, \"So I embrace it. I'll carry it through the nights only I remember.\"\n\nShe stepped into the shop and saw the other Iuno adjusting her hair in front of a mirror.\nMoving closer, she reached out and gently tucked the loose strands behind the other Iuno's ears, just the way their mother used to do. After a moment's pause, she placed the flowers into the other Iuno's arms.\n\n\"You're wonderful,\" she spoke gently. \"But I could never be you. Not since a long time ago.\"\n\nAnd with that, she turned and left, leaving behind the shop and the illusion the moon had woven. Moonlight stretched her shadow across the ground, trying one last time to pull her back. But Iuno kept walking. Slowly. Steadily. Without turning. Behind her, the moon made one final attempt.\n\n\"You know,\" it said, \"sometimes… I truly pity you. You're so stubborn. So unwilling to bend.\"\n\nLet it pity her, then. She doesn't care. Life, after all, is but a game. No matter who is sitting beyond the table, she intends to win. Every time.\n\nShe has come this far, and she will not surrender. Not even to herself."
    },
    {
      "title": "At Last, the Cycle Begins Again",
      "content": "After countless times, Iuno wakes again as if pulled from deep water.\n\nShe is weary of the hollow, bitter cycle. Numb to her past. But she cannot stop, because now, at last, she understands where she is: adrift in the chaos between existence and vanishment. In the world she once came from, her name has long since peeled away. For every creature of the Dark Tide she Anchored, a piece of \"Iuno\" was taken. She chose this ending, one with no way back.\n\nSo she continues.\n\nDrifting from one shattered cycle to the next, cycling through borrowed selves in a haze, until one moment, she reaches out her hand. And for the first time, someone else's warmth meets her own.\n\nThe Unwritten One. The first being in this chaos that is not her echoes.\n{Male=He;Female=She} sees her as she is, suspended between moonlight and the Dark Tide.\n\n\"…Iuno.\"\n\nEverything changes the moment {Male=he;Female=she} speaks her name. {Male=He;Female=She} remembers. And because of that, so does she. Two exceptions, in a place where memory should not exist. And suddenly, the chaos no longer feels endless.\n\n\"Where are you taking me?\" The Unwritten One walks beside her, voice soft, like a stone gently touching water.\n\nIuno smiles faintly. \"To finish something. Or maybe... to start again.\"\n\nThey part ways, only to meet again at the battlefield where it all began. There, beneath a broken moon, lies the mark of her sacrifice. A proof fate could not erase. A narrow seam left for her to step through.\n\n\"If you go through, you will return to that moment. With {Male=him;Female=her}, you will Anchor your forgotten self. But everything you have Anchored before, everything you wanted to Anchor, even fate itself, will need to be Anchored again. Do you understand what that heralds?\"\n\nShe hears herself. It sounds like a warning, or a persuasion.\n\nIuno lifts her face and looks straight at the moon.\n\"…I do.\"\n\nShe speaks almost casually. Her expression still carries that familiar, proud curve.\n\n\"I used to think that if I saw more, predicted more, I could change something. That knowledge would give me power. But the more I saw, the more I was trapped by it.\"\n\nThe Unwritten One stays silent, only watching her.\n\nIuno raises her hand. The lingering traces of her past gather into a single form, revealing another Moon Arrow. Its fletching glows with silver and soft blue, like the hush before dawn.\n\n\"This time, let's change the order,\" she says, drawing the bowstring tight. Her eyes hold no grief, no resentment. \"I'll Anchor myself first. Then everything that tries to run. And after that... I'll go see something new.\"\n\nShe draws her bow.\n\nThe Moon Arrow gleams, suspended like a full moon before the ruined wall. Wind sweeps past, tangling her hair, but her breath stays steady. The Unwritten One sees her silhouette cast upon the wall, and for a heartbeat, it looks like the moon completing itself.\n\nWhen the arrow flies, there's no sound. Light pours from the broken moon, rushing backward like a reversed tide. It washes over her, drowning and lifting her at once. The names once lost and the shadows once swallowed by fate return to her, Anchored again by a single shot.\n\nTime passes.\n\nWhen she finally steps out of that void of infinite possibility and returns to the world of celebration, flower petals fall from the sky like rain.\n\nBy the firelight, someone lifts a wine glass and catches her eye. He blinks in confusion.\n\n\"You're, um… How strange. I don't think we've met, but… do I know you?\"\n\nIuno raises her eyebrow and says nothing, just as before. She lifts her glass and clinks it against his.\n\nAfter that night, no one remembers the girl who shot an arrow through fate. But from then on, Iuno's moon is no longer one of simple waxing and waning. It turns again and again, not in repetition, but in renewal.\n\nShe has written her own meaning into the cycle. And now, it continues, always changing, always hers."
    }
  ],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "A void… I was taken aback when I first heard Grandmother Lillibet describe you as such. We Priestesses revere the Sacred Flames, for their light grants us revelation. Wherever it shines, shadows and reflections emerge. Yet a void... Could it be a barrier, or perhaps some form of falsity that refuses to be seen? As the Unwritten One, do you embody endless unpredictability, or is it an absolute emptiness? Only now, walking this path with you, do I understand. This void is nothing obscure. It's like Chaos, yet different. It's where countless possibilities wait to be chosen.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer01.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "Seeing is simple. But facing what you see isn't. It may be a blessing to see the future, but the real curse is knowing what's coming and being powerless to stop it. Yet I won't accept the prophesized end. Only the weak would stand by and just watch it all unfold... I must try to make a change. Even if I have to look at the same agonizing truth over and over again. Even if the struggle never ends. Even if I'm only giving fate a little dent.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer02.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "What would happen if I shot that arrow...? Well, I sort of knew what to expect. My existence... might vanish completely, or simply fade from others' memory. In the years of using the Moon Arrow to mark and uncloak the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>'s creations, I experienced that too many times. The costs were always small, and the reactions were barely noticeable. At most, people's memories of me would grow hazy for a few days, and I would have to remind them who I was... That much I can bear. And to rewrite the whole end at such a cost? Quite the bargain no matter how you look at it, right?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer03.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "Sometimes those who remember suffer more than those who forget. To remember is to bear a weight, to remain unbroken when you'd rather break, and to be forced to carry on. Forgive me... Back then, I had no clue that returning to the real world was even possible, and because of that, this selfish desire of mine for you to remember me now looks even more willful... But even if I had to do it all again, I'd still... If anyone were to remember me, to keep some piece of me alive, it would be you. You'd be the exception.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer04.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "What will I do now? I haven't decided yet. Well... I spent so much time looking into the future that the idea of living in the present feels strange. But now, Septimont and I are in the same position. No more chains. No more limits. Just endless possibilities spread out before us. With so many paths to take, why rush to choose the \"best\" one? I'll just do what I feel is right, and take what I truly want... And right now? This is what I want. That's for sure.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer05.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_toplayer05"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Iuno's Hobby",
      "content": "I love surprises. Fate can be generous and stingy at the same time. To outsmart it and bring about some \"accidents\" takes real work. Countless preparations, endless calculations... Until you finally make something completely unexpected real. For such extraordinary feats, no matter how big or small, I'll always give them my wholehearted applause.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_taste.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_taste"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Iuno's Trouble",
      "content": "Settling for less? No. Never an option. It has to be my favorite and most satisfying choice... Others, you say? How they choose to handle things is never my problem, so naturally, I haven't the slightest care as to what they say.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_worry.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "A perfectly ripe, plump fruit, fresh and begging to be eaten. You don't even have to pick it yourself. Just stand under the tree, and it'll drop right into your hands. Take a bite, and its cool, juicy sweetness flows out from the pulp... With all that said, why not try one together?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_foodlike.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_foodlike"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "Ugh, protein dishes should be less greasy, lightly seasoned, and absolutely free of any gamey or fishy flavors. And mushy vegetables? Out of the question... And don't get me started on those foods with sticky, sloppy textures. They've got no strength at all! Also... What's that look on your face? I'm not finished yet!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_foodhate.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_foodhate"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "Fight against fate? No, not exactly. In the end, I just willfully chose the freedom I wanted. When fate refuses to give people what they desire, they have to claim it themselves. I just happen to be greedy and blatant, taking what I want recklessly, honestly, and gracefully... As for the price, is there anything that doesn't come with it?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_dream.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_dream"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "That bow, crafted from Lunarum Bough, was the last thing my father left me. I got it when I'd just decided to become a Priestess and prepared to leave for the Tetragon Temple, and never thought I'd need to use it back then. But over time, I realized I rather take fate into my own hands than spend my days praying to some higher power. And now, the one who once merely followed the moon's guidance and traces has become one who dominates and anchors its phases. This \"lunar arc\" has long been rooted in the causality of my story, tying my beginning to my end.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_storyobj.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_storyobj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "Well, just as Grandmother Lillibet prophesized, I... Wait, haven't you already witnessed my whole past in the Chaos? It's so strange to repeat what others already know... B-but fine! I'll tell you again... But only because I'm gracious! And as I said before, don't tell anyone else! And don't you dare forget a single word!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_storyexp.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_storyexp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Augusta",
      "content": "Here's a little secret even Augusta doesn't know. When we first met, I told her she'd lead Septimont into a new era, and she believed it to be one of my prophecies. But really, it was just a hunch. I never peep into her fate because it's always been in her hands. She's the kind of ruler who'd sacrifice everything for her people, even her own flesh and blood. You don't need a coronation to see that. It's obvious at a glance. Yet, that kind of responsibility she carries is heavier than anyone else can imagine. Even though I know she can handle it alone, I still want to help somehow. As a Priestess, as a friend... or even as someone she has forgotten.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_aogusita.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_aogusita"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Lillibet",
      "content": "After prophesizing about me, Grandmother Lillibet took me to the Tetragon Temple to teach me everything about fate. I'm never the obedient type, and she's more of the authoritative model of what Septimont expects in a Priestess. We rarely saw eye to eye on what makes the most gifted Priestess or how to handle fate and prophecies. But she never forced her views on me, never pushed me to be like her or any other Priestesses. She said rules only matter if they're worth following, and one is always free to choose as long as they do not harm others... She taught me that Priestesses aren't just symbols fixed on the wall, but living, breathing people, too.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_lilibei.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_lilibei"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Lupa",
      "content": "Anyone who's seen her matches probably feels the urge to challenge her as well, wouldn't you agree? Her passion for competition is really something... Pure, simple, and completely genuine. For her, victory and glory are just icing on the cake compared to the joy of the fight. She's not afraid to lose, but her passion always drives her to give her all and never back down, no matter the odds.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_lupa.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_lupa"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Avidius",
      "content": "He roared at fate with everything he had. Sure, that roar was swiftly reduced to whimpers, then silence, but we all heard it. It left its mark... I think he's more like the Hero of Heroes when he stops worrying about what that even means or what others expect from him.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_aweidiya.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_aweidiya"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Carlotta",
      "content": "She and her family always manage to bring something fresh to Septimont and Ragunna, even to themselves. And before you know it, those little novelties spark whole new trend.... Me? Yep, I usually end up buying whatever it is. It's just hard to resist. She always gets what I like. Those Montellis, cunning as ever!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_kelaita.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_about_kelaita"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "For a Priestess, the day of birth is the starting point that stretches towards the end. Hmm, a rather suitable line to mark the beginning of a prophecy. But the infinite possibilities of the void are already perfect. There's nothing more I could offer. So, I've prepared something else. See this little moon? It can change its phases. Take it and place it in your void. If you ever find the infinite paths ahead overwhelming, it will at least serve as an anchor of certainty... Happy Birthday, {PlayerName}.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "(Effort sounds)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_younuo_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "Hmm... Perfect.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_younuo_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "Pleasing to the ears, hm?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_younuo_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Iuno, the prodigy born under the lunar eclipse. The Priestess who sees the true future. Curious about what lies ahead? Come to me... But no promises of the perfect ending you seek.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Oh. What will you do without me?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "I am the moon that never falls, here to rewrite the ending.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "From one moon to another, through endless cycles... until it's beyond measurement.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "Can I have anything else I want other than power? Think carefully before you answer. Once you say it, I won't stop until I get it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "Entertain me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk01_01.play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "Praise me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk01_02.play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: III",
      "content": "Face me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk01_03.play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: IV",
      "content": "Seek.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk02_01.play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: V",
      "content": "Seize.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk02_02.play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: VI",
      "content": "Settle.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk02_03.play_favor_word_younuo_atk_heavyatk02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Wane.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Wax.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Cycle.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "I am the moon.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill02_01.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Bow before me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill02_02.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Present your offerings.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill02_03.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "World, at my string.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill03_01.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill03_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VIII",
      "content": "Fate, in my mark.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill03_02.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill03_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IX",
      "content": "Foes, be my prey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill03_03.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill03_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: X",
      "content": "Causality... overturned.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill04_01.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill04_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XI",
      "content": "Future... reshaped.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill04_02.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill04_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: XII",
      "content": "Fate... revealed.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill04_03.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_skill04_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Taste my resolve!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_younuo_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Answer my call!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_younuo_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "The moon is full!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_younuo_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "I'll indulge you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_qte_01.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "With style and grace...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_qte_02.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: III",
      "content": "Now, watch closely.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_qte_03.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_qte_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Outro Skill: I",
      "content": "My turn to watch.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_01.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Outro Skill: II",
      "content": "I've had my fun.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_02.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Outro Skill: III",
      "content": "With pleasure.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_03.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Outro Skill: IV",
      "content": "To the Hero of Heroes.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_double_01.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_double_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Outro Skill: V",
      "content": "Miss me already?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_double_02.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_double_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Outro Skill: VI",
      "content": "We bask in glory.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_double_03.play_favor_word_younuo_skill_exitskill_double_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Nonsense.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_younuo_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "The nerves.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_younuo_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "Heh. This is nothing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_younuo_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Is that all?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_younuo_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "You dare test me? The insolence.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_younuo_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Face me... All of me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_younuo_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "No. I... won't yield!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_die_01.play_favor_word_younuo_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "I've... left my mark…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_die_02.play_favor_word_younuo_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "The moon... falls.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_die_03.play_favor_word_younuo_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "On you go.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_younuo_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Surprise!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_younuo_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "I shall bear witness.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_engage.play_favor_word_younuo_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Let's seize the moon.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_younuo_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Predictable.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_scan.play_favor_word_younuo_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Keep up.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_younuo_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Now that's more like it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_younuo_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "A well deserved reward.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_younuo_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Like it? I've got plenty more of that.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_younuo_com_openbox_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: IV",
      "content": "A windfall? Fate can be rather generous sometimes.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_younuo_sys_gondola_treasure.play_favor_word_younuo_sys_gondola_treasure"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Broken Rebirth",
      "content": "A broken branch sprouted from a once-fractured wound. It resembles the Lunarum Bough you once shaped in Chaos. However, with Iuno's bow already forged, a flawless bough no longer holds much meaning. Standing all the wear and tear of fate, it's no longer an offering for sacrifice, just a simple bough—undefined, unburdened, and free, as it should be.\n\nAs a result, you and Iuno can finally watch it grow gently in peace now, in the unwritten future beyond the final end.\n\nA fresh sprout suits a new beginning, one rooted in hope.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure113_UI.T_Treasure113_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Lightly Tossed Suspense",
      "content": "These several irregular, asymmetrical dice belong to Iuno.\n\nSeptimontians seek joy in their competitive games, whether it's the spectacle of a gladiatorial match or the thrill of a casual wager. Iuno is no different. But she favors serendipity over regularity.\n\nBeginning with a simple twelve-sided die, she continues to add new restrictions and rewards for her games at random. One by one, stranger dice emerge, each tied to its own little game. With uneven faces and symbols appearing at different probabilities, the odds are clearly skewed. But under the same rules, using the same die, both players take the same risks. The fairness of the games remains intact.\n\nIn truth, this is how she adds spark to a long and uncertain struggle. By keeping outcomes just beyond prediction, she resists the pull of inevitability.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure115_UI.T_Treasure115_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Permanence Measured by Moments",
      "content": "An instant camera, and a handful of photos where Iuno's silhouette still lingers.\n\nThe device, brought to Septimont by the Montellis, quickly captured Iuno's fascination. She soon found in it a quiet purpose for herself: to capture the fleeting moments of joy, sorrow, and silent connection with others, and preserve them in these delicate prints.\n\nEach photo became a safeguard, a small defiance against the side effect of her Anchoring ability, which blurred her presence in the memories of those around her. And in time, it became her way of preparing for the inevitable: the moment she would vanish completely.\n\nEven if those who once gazed upon her have now forgotten her, even if the images have begun to fade, what was captured remains. However fuzzy, those beautiful moments were real. They happened, and they are proof of her existence.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure114_UI.T_Treasure114_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Moon Steps",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Moonring - Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the <color=Highlight>Moonring</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Moonring - Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with <color=Highlight>Moonring</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color></size>\nEnter <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te> - New Moon</color> by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color>. When in this state, Iuno will attack with <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>.\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonbow - Basic Attack Stage 3.\nCan be cast in mid-air.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nAttack with the <color=Highlight>Moonring</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nAttack with the <color=Highlight>Moonring</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color></size>\nIuno will enter <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te> - New Moon</color> by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color>. When in this state, Iuno will attack with <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>.\nAttack with the <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color></size>\nAttack with the <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Foresight Fugue",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Pulse of Origins</color></size>\nDash forward, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Closing Refrain</color></size>\nWhen not in <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te></color>, casting <color=Highlight>Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, or <color=Highlight>Pulse of Origins</color> replaces Iuno's Resonance Skill with <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> for 5s.\nCasting Closing Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, and activates <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Unfinished Refrain</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>, Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color>.\nCasting Unfinished Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\nUnfinished Refrain shares the same Cooldown as Closing Refrain.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Arc Beyond the Edge</color></size>\nWhen Iuno is in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, her Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Arc Beyond the Edge</color>, which has 2 initial charges.\nCasting Arc Beyond the Edge causes Iuno to shift position and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.\n- Directional input can be used to extend the travel distance. If Iuno is hit or launched into mid-air, casting <color=Highlight>Arc Beyond the Edge</color> immediately makes her recover from the attack.\nCan be cast in mid-air.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Pulse of Origins</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Closing Refrain</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, or <color=Highlight>Pulse of Origins</color>, Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color>.\nCasting Closing Refrain deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and activates <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te></color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Unfinished Refrain</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>, Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color>.\nCasting Unfinished Refrain deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Arc Beyond the Edge</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Lunar Phase - New Moon</color>, Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Arc Beyond the Edge</color>.\nCasting Arc Beyond the Edge deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Ebb and Flow",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle</color></size>\nIuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.\nLunar Cycle has two states: <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> and <color=Highlight>New Moon</color>. By default, Iuno enters the <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> state when activating Lunar Cycle and can switch between the two states by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>.\nWhen in Lunar Cycle:\n- Iuno's Jump is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>. STA won't recover when Iuno is in mid-air. \n- Iuno's movement becomes <color=Highlight>Meandering</color>, which consumes STA continuously in mid-air to move in a unique manner.\n- Performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or holding Jump will end <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color></size>\nIuno attacks using the Moonring, restoring <color=Highlight><te href=141003>Sentience</te></color> on hit.\nShe can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> can be cast in mid-air.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color></size>\nIuno attacks using the Moonbow. While in this state, casting <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge</color>, or <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color> consumes <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> to increase the skill's DMG Multiplier, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.\nIuno can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> can be cast in mid-air.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness</color></size>\nWhen Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Absolute Fullness</color>.\nCasting Absolute Fullness ends <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, provides healing for nearby Resonators in the team, deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG), and conjures a <color=Highlight>Full Moon</color> domain at her location. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Full Moon Domain</color></size>\nResonators inside the domain periodically restore  HP and STA.\nGaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Blessing of the Wan Light</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Blessing of the Wan Light</color></size>\nThe receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Sentience</color></size>\nIuno can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.\nCasting Intro Skill restores 40 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.\nCasting Resonance Liberation restores 60 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color> restores 25 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.\nWhen Iuno is in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> on hit.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle</color></size>\nIuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.\nLunar Cycle has two states: <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> and <color=Highlight>New Moon</color>. Iuno switches states when she Jumps.\n<color=Highlight>Half Moon</color>: Attack with Moonring, restoring <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> on hit. \n<color=Highlight>New Moon</color>: Attack with Moonbow, consuming <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> to increase DMG, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness</color></size>\nWhen Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Absolute Fullness</color>.\nCasting Absolute Fullness heals nearby Resonators, deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to targets nearby and conjures a <color=Highlight>Full Moon Domain</color> at her location.\nResonators inside the <color=Highlight>Full Moon Domain</color> periodically restore HP and STA. Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Blessing of the Wan Light</color>, which grants 4% all DMG Amplification for the receiving Resonator, stacking up to 10 times.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Sentience</color></size>\nIuno restores <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> upon casting Intro Skill, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color>.\nWhen Iuno hits a target in <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color>, she restores <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.",
