  "name": "Qiuyuan",
  "nick_name": "Qiuyuan",
  "desc": "Former senior agent of Mingting's Internal Security Agency. \n\nThough enmity filled his younger days, loyalty defined his later years. However, scapegoated for a murder, he is now but a blind swordsman wandering the world alone.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_56_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_56_UI",
  "background": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRolePile/T_IconRole_Pile_Qiuyuan_UI.T_IconRole_Pile_Qiuyuan_UI",
  "background_stand": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/RoleHalfBody/T_ActivityRoleOntrialHalfBodyQiuyuan.T_ActivityRoleOntrialHalfBodyQiuyuan",
  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "Unknown",
    "sex": "Male",
    "country": "Huanglong",
    "influence": "Mingting",
    "info": "Former senior agent of Mingting's Internal Security Agency. \n\nThough enmity filled his younger days, loyalty defined his later years. However, scapegoated for a murder, he is now but a blind swordsman wandering the world alone.",
    "talent_name": "Bambooscape",
    "talent_doc": "Miscellaneous Records of <te href=260009>Mingting</te>'s Minister of Sentinel Affairs: Correspondence Collection\n\nMy dear friend Dongyuan,\n\nA few days prior, the <te href=260001>Internal Security Agency</te> forwarded documents from the Justice Commission and the Huaxu Academy to the <te href=260002>Ministry of Sentinel Affairs</te>. Without delay, I instructed the Chongzhou official to assist in the matter and thoroughly examine the local Resonator register. It has now been confirmed that the individual in question has no connection with the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> or the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te> of Chongzhou.\n\nAccording to the Ministry's records, this individual has been a Resonator for over fifteen years. Described as one who \"sees the world through bamboos and hides his blade within them,\" he is blind yet wields a remarkable ability known as <te href=260003>Mindsight</te>. Through this power, he perceives his surroundings through a \"bamboo forest\" in his mind, enabling him to discern opponents' intentions and vulnerabilities. He can even manifest the Mindsight into tangible illusions. This is not a person to be underestimated.\n\nMoreover, his swordsmanship appears to stem chiefly from personal skill rather than his Resonance Ability. Observations indicate that he consistently restrains the use of his Resonance power. He claims that the bamboo flask he carries contains a concoction—prepared by a wandering healer in Chongzhou—that stimulates his Mindsight and Forte, and is used only when necessary. This matter may be forwarded to the Academy for further analysis.\n\nAs for the detailed test data, please await the Academy's formal report...\n\nDongyuan's annotation: Simply ensure this is recorded clearly. We follow the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs's judgment… My my, Lin still writes with his characteristic formality.",
    "talent_certification": "Miscellaneous Records of <te href=260009>Mingting</te>'s <te href=260002>Ministry of Sentinel Affairs</te>: Correspondence Collection\n\n…In my recent observations over the past few days, it appears less that he refuses to employ his Forte and more that he consciously restrains himself from using it. Regarding the nature of the ability itself, he remains decidedly reserved. Only from the Academy's report may one glean a few particulars:\n\n<i>Test subject waveform analysis presents an elliptical oscillation. Time-domain readings are stable, with no anomalous patterns observed.\nResonant Criticality: High. Stability is high with no risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>. \nNo prior history of Overclocking. Psychological intervention is deemed unnecessary.\nNote: The subject admits to repeated offenses involving violent breaches of the law, though his demeanor was notably composed. It is recommended that these claims should be verified by the Ministry of Justice and local authorities in Chongzhou.</i>\n\n…Yet, in my own assessment, this man harbors no murderous intent. His composure is unwavering, his demeanor steady. His swordsmanship is among the finest, and few in all of Mingting could rival him. He could have been a remarkable asset to the <te href=260001>Internal Security Agency</te>. That such an individual is listed in the Justice Commission's dossiers as a perpetrator of unlawful violence is difficult to believe. I have already communicated with the Ministry of Rites, outlining the advantages and implications of recruiting said individual. Should you wish to employ this man, I expect no obstacle shall arise on that account.\n\nDongyuan's annotation: Naturally, the steadier the better. But judging from this report... isn't this lad a little too devoid of emotion?",
    "cv_name_cn": "Gan Ziqi",
    "cv_name_jp": "Miki Shinichiro",
    "cv_name_ko": "Kim Min Ju",
    "cv_name_en": "Jeremy Ang Jones"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Tempered",
      "content": "\"Every mountain stands as a trial. Pass this one, and you are free to take your own path. Fail… then this mountain shall keep what you have.\"\n\nThose were the first words Qiuyuan heard from the old man five years ago, spoken in a hell of fire and blood. Words impossible to forget.\n\nHe called him Master, though he never knew his face. A white-bearded elder in rags, perhaps. The old man trained Qiuyuan relentlessly, taught him martial arts sharp enough to let him \"see\" the bamboo forest swaying in his mind.\n\nRumors about his master spread like mist. Some said he was the Sword Specter of Chongzhou, a butcher who left trails of corpses in his wake. Others whispered that he had once been <te href=260009>Mingting</te>'s celebrated general, a conqueror of vast lands whose power nearly rivaled that of the Huanglong ruler, only to fade into solitude after a fall from grace. And there were those who claimed he was no more than a myth. After all, who could believe a mortal could slay a mountain of Tacet Discords with nothing but a bamboo stick?\n\nBut Qiuyuan believed. For five years, he enjoyed countless victories, but never once bested his master.\n\n\"You said the same words five years ago, Master.\"\n\"Five years… gone in a blink.\"\n\nQiuyuan had been waiting for this day. Defeat this old man, and he could leave the bamboo forest, cross this mountain, and finally, surpass the one who had always won.\n\n\"I've taught you almost everything. But the last move, the most vital one, I'm still keeping for myself. Do you know what it is?\"\n\"I beg for your teachings, Master.\"\n\"Then tell me, Qiuyuan, what does the bamboo forest show you?\"\n\"Leaves like spears. Stalks hiding dangers. Shadows upon shadows, like ghosts surrounding me.\"\n\"So, the flame from five years ago is still burning in your heart.\"\n\"Isn't it also burning your heart.... Sword Specter?\"\n\"It has been... many years since the last living soul called me by that name. Very well, I see you don't need more explanation. Now, come take the final move from me.\"\n\nIt was he who wrought the hell of fire and blood five years ago. It was also he who brought Qiuyuan out of that hell of fire and blood.\n\n\"With this blade, I will honor your teachings!\"\n\nThe flame has never died."
    },
    {
      "title": "Concealed",
      "content": "\"Lie still. Don't even think of moving.\"\n\nA harsh voice reached Qiuyuan as he awoke, body aching, wounds bound. Yet within it lingered a gentleness so unlike the killing intent he had grown used to. It was then that the memory of how he came to be broken in the first place returned.\n\n\"I…\"\n\"You killed dozens with your bare hands. Not a creative way to beg for death, I'd say.\"\n\"…I should be dead.\"\n\"Many who live deserve to die, and many who died should have lived. Such is fate.\"\n\nRegret tangled in vengeance had taught Qiuyuan when to sheathe the blade. But it couldn't cleanse the hatred he had carried for five long years. The flame that couldn't be quenched by the pouring rain from five years ago is still burning vividly in his mind, just like the old man who once stood before him among the fires, with a sword in his hand.\n\nBut there had been no rain when he left the mountain. Only liquor dripping down his face and a whispering sigh.\n\nA hatred born of blood may only be washed away by blood in return. But what comes after? No one ever knows. \n\nHe was left with no reason to raise his sword. When his opponents' weapons struck, he simply stood and let them come...\n\n\"Heh… whether you deserve life or death, I cannot say,\" that voice murmured. \"The choice lies with you alone.\"\n\nAnd so, Qiuyuan laid aside his blade. With only a bamboo stick in hand, he idled outside the hut as decoctions simmered on the stove, spending his days picturing the patients who came, and the stubborn middle-aged man they called Doctor Zhang.\n\nFor the first time in years, he enjoyed peace again. Since the day Doctor Zhang saved him, he could not \"see\" the bamboo forest of blades anymore—only pure, silent darkness, free of hatred and rage. There were sighs and tears, words of gratitude and joy, the scent of medicine, and the crackle of stove fire.\n\nIt was moments like these that made him realize he was no different from the ordinary.\n\n\"Here, take this flask. And my recipe too. You need three bowls of water for one bowl of decoction. Keep that in mind.\"\n\"…What's this?\"\n\"My potent regimen pulled you back from death that day, but your Forte has been crippled.\nThis medicine restores your <te href=260003>Mindsight</te>, at least for a little while. It will be of some help on the day you raise your sword again.\"\n\"I won't. You saved me, Doctor. The least I can do is stay and take care of sundry matters for you.\"\n\"I don't think so. Bloodshed clings to your face. Your palm's lifeline is cut off. Followed by fears, haunted by distress... You are bound to die in battle, not of old age here in my hut.\"\n\"Followed by fears, haunted by distress... My master once told me the same.\"\n\"Master, you say? To have a disciple like you… He must be a tough nut.\"\n\"…Even so, Doctor, I will not take up the blade again. But I'll accept your recipe. Let me stay here. If trouble comes to this hut because of me, I'll leave.\"\n\"Well… medicine is like a blade. It all comes down to the usage and dosage. It can kill, but also save.\"\n\"Now, go open the door, Qiuyuan. Light the stove. I won't claim I'm better than you, but no one dares stir trouble under my roof. That I can guarantee.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Unsheathed",
      "content": "\"Hah… all that strength wasted in the wilderness. How will you answer the lives that fell beneath your blade?\"\n\"You've got the wrong man. Doctor, another patient is here.\"\n\nQiuyuan ignored the older man and kept tending firewood under the stove. At first, the man had merely come by to exchange idle words with Doctor Zhang. Later, he began appearing more often, spouting riddles and nonsense.\n\nThis time, though, he suddenly hurled a fist-sized iron weight at Qiuyuan. Instinct took over. Qiuyuan raised his hand and caught it against his brow without flinching.\n\n\"You're the Doctor's friend. Why treat me so?\"\n\"You should recognize what you're holding.\"\n\nThe beast's head, forged from the finest steel, radiated a chill that ran down the spine. Yes, there was no mistaking it.\n\n\"The <te href=260001>Internal Security Agency</te>… are you here to arrest me?\"\n\"If you are a wanted man, I wouldn't be the one to catch you. You've left behind a trail of death. Normally, the Justice Commission would prosecute your crimes.\"\n\"Then let them do it.\"\n\"...Do you truly wish to die on the execution ground?\"\n\"Death comes either way. What difference does it make?\"\n\"It would be a waste of your strength.\"\n\"…\"\n\"Blood debts are paid in blood. That is the natural order. Perhaps the noose is your end, but before then, you can at least make up for some of what you've done.\"\n\"Come with me. I can't spare you from your death penalty, but I can promise you this—you won't rot in a cell, nor waste away on a sickbed.\"\n\nQiuyuan knew the power of <te href=260009>Mingting</te>'s ISA all too well. That iron head of the Qiongqi beast, bestowed by <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>'s highest authority, embodies the Emperor's very presence. Wherever it appears, officials must bow low. Its envoys traverse the realm unfettered by any court, answering only to the throne, entrusted with only the gravest matters. Should they seek a man's life, not even death itself dares to intervene.\n\n\"You may wield a sword for yourself, sure, but you may also raise it for the greater good. Serve Mingting, punish the wicked, shield the innocent.\"\n\"I am but a blind man. The weight of the greater good is far heavier than I can bear.\"\n\nThe man picked up a piece of wood and stared at the stove.\n\n\"Do you know why Doctor Zhang left Mingting?\"\n\"…No. He never said, and I never asked.\"\n\"To heal all, rather than to heal one.\"\n\nThe man chucked his firewood under the stove and spoke no more.\n\nThree days later, Qiuyuan stood with the man at the hut's door. The mountain dew of Chongzhou's deep valleys had yet to soak their straw hats. No smoke rose from the stove's chimney. Only the faint dawn light touched them.\n\n\"He must have told you why I left Mingting… Hmph.\nThat man from the Internal Security Agency is... like me, stubborn to a fault. But perhaps that is why he could persuade you to follow him. \nThe world is vast. All I can do is try my best to save more lives. But that man, Liang Dongyuan… he's the one in court who can 'save' people.\nThe time has arrived. Go now. Linger here too long, and you'll only scare my patients away.\"\n\nThe doctor patted Qiuyuan's shoulder and slipped into the hut without a backward glance, leaving him no chance to reply.\n\nYears later, Qiuyuan would still recall that morning, prostrating on the dirt path worn smooth by countless patients.\n\n\"Thank you, Doctor. For everything.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Shattered",
      "content": "Shackles clattered in the prison cell.\n\nQiuyuan sat within, no different from the corrupt officials and rogues he had once cast into jail.\n\n\"Open the gate.\"\n\"B-but, Minister Lin, the execution is about to begin—\"\n\"Open it.\"\n\nThe bars groaned as the cell gate slid open. A man stepped inside, bringing with him the faint aroma of food and wine.\n\n\"What now? You here to supervise the <te href=260002>Ministry of Sentinel Affairs</te>?\"\n\"Forgive me, Minister… I'm only carrying out my duty.\"\n\"Very well. Then you must know that the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs is required to question every felon before their execution. Now, I must also fulfill my duty. Leave. All of you.\"\n\"As you command…\"\n\"And lock the gate. I will summon you when I am done.\"\n\nHurried footsteps faded, leaving only the two of them within the cell.\n\n\"The execution is supposed to begin at noon, the forty-fifth minute. You're an hour and a half early.\"\n\"…Are you here to see me off, Master Lin?\"\n\"First, drink this. A toast to his memory.\"\n\nQiuyuan rose slowly, the heavy chains dragging against the ground. He took the cup, but instead of drinking, poured the wine onto the ground—a libation for the dead.\n\n\"Sigh… Only you were there when Dongyuan met his wretched end. This is such a dire case that even the top brass are watching. With no trace left by the true culprit, the Justice Commission had no choice but to scapegoat you.\"\n\"I could not save Grandmaster Liang. That failure is mine alone.\"\n\"Do you still recall the fiend who… peeled themselves from Dongyuan's body?\"\n\"I'll never forget their frequency, even if they were reduced to ashes.\"\n\"The Ministry scoured every record, but nowhere was there mention of a Resonator who could take on another's form and body.\"\n\"…I cannot say if some fragment of Grandmaster Liang still lingered in that moment.\"\n\"Perhaps Dongyuan was no longer himself when he sent you on that case in Jinzhou. A man so righteous would have never ordered the pursuit of a minor official who only killed Tacet Discords to protect the people.\"\n\"That is why I spared him—that man, Geshu Lin. The Grandmaster Liang I knew would never have given such an order.\"\n\"Dongyuan was never wrong about you. If you wish to know the truth behind his death, you can only begin from that case. Though I fear… you may never sort everything out.\"\n\"I have spilled more than my share of blood. But because of you, Grandmaster Liang, and Doctor Zhang, I was able to live differently, if only for a time… I could only repay such trust in another life.\"\n\nThe Minister moved toward the gate. His face was solemn, but his eyes held a firm reassurance.\n\n\"Dongyuan once promised that you would not end your life in a cell or on a sickbed.\"\n\"According to <te href=260009>Mingting</te>'s law, to execute a felon like you, the Justice Commission must first receive a decree approved by both the Emperor and the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>, forwarded by the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. The execution can only be carried out an hour after they receive the decree.\"\n\"Without those writs returned, no man dares execute you.\"\n\"Therefore, Qiuyuan, remember: from now on, the path ahead is yours alone. Even if it costs you your life, you must see this case to its end. If you are to die, let it be on the road to avenging Dongyuan.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Reforged",
      "content": "Five years had passed since he had escaped <te href=260009>Mingting</te> and became a wanted fugitive across the six cities.\n\nWhile Mingting remained unchanged—bustling and prosperous, his own clothes had grown tattered, worn by the dust and frost of the endless journey across Huanglong. Minister Lin from the <te href=260002>Ministry of Sentinel Affairs</te> had fallen ill and retired. The young man who had survived his blade became a general guarding the border, but even he had fallen to the madness of the Threnodian.\n\nHis master had taught him when to draw the sword and when to sheath it. Yet when he held back, everything had plunged into the abyss.\n\nThe doctor once said that a sword could both kill and save. Yet he had failed to save the one he wished to.\n\nFate twisted relentlessly. Everything had changed, yet somehow, nothing really changed. He still had not found the one who killed Grandmaster Liang. But he had never stopped seeking the truth.\n\nIf Minister Lin had not sent word of a lead from the <te href=260008>Grand Marshal</te>, the head of the <te href=260010>Ministry of War</te>, he might never have dared return to Mingting.\n\n\"You've come.\"\n\nThrough the torrential rain, a straw-hatted figure emerged from the shadow of the bridge, face hidden.\n\n\"Scar, the Fractsidus Overseer, escaped from Jinzhou's prison not long ago.\nIntel places him near Septimont City in <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>. He's a wanted criminal of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> and of <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>. He must be captured.\"\n\"You could do it yourself.\"\n\"Rinascita's different. Individuals who resemble the Threnodian's Resonator have been sighted there.\"\n\"…So this reminds you of me?\"\n\"You were the key to Dongyuan's case, and Geshu Lin is the key to your case. Since Jinzhou's <te href=850074>Threnodian</te> is what brought Geshu Lin down… Follow the thread, and you may learn why Dongyuan gave you that order, and... perhaps discover the true culprit.\nEverything on Fractsidus and Rinascita's Threnodian is in this dossier. Take this letter with my seal and start with Jinzhou. Your niece, the <te href=850124>Magistrate's Bodyguard</te>, is there. Find out how Scar escaped, then head east to Rinascita.\"\n\nQiuyuan rarely saw this distant niece, let alone spoke to her, given the long distances between cities. All he knew was that she had become the Jinzhou <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>'s bodyguard.\n\n\"She may not meet me.\"\n\"She will. You are family. She will believe in your words. Also… {PlayerName} is in Rinascita.\"\n\"…That {PlayerName}?\"\n\"Yes. You may ask {Male=him;Female=her} about what happened in Jinzhou as well.\"\n\"…Understood. Give me the dossier. I'll leave at once.\"\n\nQiuyuan turned, but the figure called after him.\n\n\"Wait! Since you're back, visit Dongyuan. I know you offer incense at his grave every year.\"\n\"I'll find the clues first, then return to honor his spirit. As for that fugitive you mentioned…\"\n\"Capture him if you can, execute him if you can't. I'll handle the Justice Commission.\"\n\"Understood.\"\n\nQiuyuan nodded, vanishing into the rain without further words.\n\nHe knew he carried the weight of unseen court intrigues. Mingting would not even formally assign someone to capture Scar. He, a lone fugitive, was entrusted to do so. Yet he didn't care. His aim was simple: uncover the truth that he had been denied.\n\nAnd when that day came—when vengeance was taken, debts repaid—then what? Would that be the sheath he had been seeking?\n\nPerhaps, with age, he would finally know."
    }

      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Next.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Winds howling.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "I hear you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill02_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "I move as the blade.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill03_sp_02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill03_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Rise.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_sp_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Slash.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_sp_02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "No escape.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_sp_03.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill01_sp_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VIII",
      "content": "Blend into the woods.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill03_sp_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill03_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IX",
      "content": "Found you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill04_sp_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill04_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: X",
      "content": "Surrender.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill04_sp_02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_skill04_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Your life, is mine to take.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Mandate calls, judgement falls.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "One strike, to settle it all.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "What sleeps within bamboo.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_qte.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge",
      "content": "Too slow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_limitdodge_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_limitdodge_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack",
      "content": "A flawed stance.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_parry_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_parry_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter",
      "content": "Break.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_atk_dodgeatk_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_atk_dodgeatk_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Did I mishear?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Retreat to gain ground.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Nothing that won't heal.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Interesting.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Feints demand restraint.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "I'll repay your trust... in another life.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_die_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "The winds... settled.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_die_02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "I see... darkness.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_die_03.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Behold this blade.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Constant in change.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Let's not linger.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_engage.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Into the wind.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "I hear it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_scan.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash: I",
      "content": "Onward.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_dash_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_dash_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash: II",
      "content": "Can you keep up?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "You may keep it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Good.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "If you insist.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_qiuyuan_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Bamboo Flask",
      "content": "A bamboo flask Qiuyuan often carries, crafted from black bamboo native to Chongzhou. Its natural fragrance has long faded, replaced by the lingering scent of the medicinal decoction it always contains.\n\nWhen Qiuyuan once teetered on the brink of death, a doctor from Chongzhou saved him with a potent regimen. While he recovered, his Forte did not, though it can be temporarily restored to full strength with the decoction in this flask. Yet even this power serves only as an embellishment to the already refined swordplay he takes pride in.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure116_UI.T_Treasure116_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Iron Weight",
      "content": "A token of Mingting's <te href=260001>Internal Security Agency</te> that Qiuyuan always carries. It should have been confiscated along with his uniform after he left the service, yet someone within Mingting ensured he kept it.\n\n\"…I hereby entrust this to you. Let all officials of every state know: whoever bears this token carries my presence.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure117_UI.T_Treasure117_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Bamboo Flute",
      "content": "He came to know the world through his ears, not his eyes.\n\nThe weary sighs of his parents, the whispers of wind coming from Chongzhou's hollow bamboos, the clash of blades, the drop of his master's blood, the furious cries of his foes...\n\nAnd then, in Mingting, he heard light, but also the shadows lurking beneath it. He heard the greedy begging for mercy. He heard schemes snarled with lies. He heard resentment and hope spoken in another kind of voice.\n\nHe cannot see, yet he hears all things clearly and inevitably. They are already there before the sounds ever reach him, as natural as iron becoming a sword, jade slumbering within stone, or music waiting in the heart of a bamboo flute.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure118_UI.T_Treasure118_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Inkwash",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period of time after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color> Stage 4.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.\nMoments after a <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, Qiuyuan becomes immune to the next instance of DMG he takes and casts <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> upon being attacked, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Through the Groves",
        "desc": "{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to dash forward for a distance, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Echo Skill DMG. If <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is cast upon being attacked by an enemy target, Qiuyuan becomes immune to this instance of DMG and stagnates nearby enemies, while gaining immunity to interruption during this <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.\nSwitching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect from enemies.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Undaunted Wayfarer</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to dash forward for a distance at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to the target, considered as Echo Skill DMG.\nIf there are no targets nearby, Qiuyuan will leap up and dash through the air by continuously consuming STA until it runs out. Release <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to immediately end the dash and land. If there are targets nearby when Qiuyuan lands, deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets, considered as Echo Skill DMG. This skill can be cast in mid-air.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Verdant Edge",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color></size>\nWhen Qiuyuan reaches {0} points of <te href=141101>Swordster's Soliloquy</te>, his <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color>, which chains together up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Bamboo's Shade</color></size>\nWhen Qiuyuan reaches {1} points of <te href=141101>Swordster's Soliloquy</te>, he gains the <color=Highlight>Bamboo's Shade</color> effect, granting all nearby active Resonators in the team {2} Echo Skill DMG Bonus for {3}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Inksplash of Mind</color></size>\nWhen <te href=141101>Swordster's Soliloquy</te> is full, Qiuyuan enters the <color=Highlight>Inksplash of Mind</color> state for {4}s, during which <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save</color>.\nIn this state, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to consume Swordster's Soliloquy to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach</color>, <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save</color>, and <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice</color> in order, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n- Performing <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach</color>, <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save</color>, or <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice</color> is considered as performing <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.\n- Inksplash of Mind ends when Swordster's Soliloquy is used up.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Swordster's Soliloquy</color></size>\nQiuyuan can hold up to {5} points of Swordster's Soliloquy.\n- {6} points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> Stage 3.\n- {7} points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing each stage of Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color>.\n- {8} points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.\n- {9} points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.\n- Swordster's Soliloquy cannot be obtained in the Inksplash of Mind state.\n- Swordster's Soliloquy is cleared when the Inksplash of Mind state ends.",

  "name": "Sigrika",
  "nick_name": "Sigrika",
  "desc": "Sigrika, a student of Startorch Academy and a Resonator of Royan Runes.\nDetermined to live up to others' expectations and become a true Solsworn, she devotes herself fully to every challenge.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_65_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_65_UI",
  "background": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRolePile/T_IconRole_Pile_Xigelika_UI.T_IconRole_Pile_Xigelika_UI",
  "background_stand": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/RoleHalfBody/T_ActivityHalfBodyXigelika.T_ActivityHalfBodyXigelika",
  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "Unknown",
    "sex": "Female",
    "country": "Lahai-Roi",
    "influence": "Roya Tribe",
    "info": "Sigrika, a student of Startorch Academy and a Resonator of Royan Runes.\nDetermined to live up to others' expectations and become a true Solsworn, she devotes herself fully to every challenge.",
    "talent_name": "True Name Manifestation",
    "talent_doc": "[Filed by <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>: <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te> Student Records]\n[Forte Examination Report: RA2326-G]\nStudent Name: Sigrika\n<te href=700009>Synchronist</te> Qualification: Negative\nForte Overview: Tests reveal a <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a pronounced periodic waveform. Therefore, the student is classified as a <te href=850068>Congenital Resonator</te>. Her <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on her back.\n \nAccording to the pre-admission personal file and the student's own account, the student demonstrates exceptional aptitude in deciphering rune frequencies and converting them into usable power. However, she reports that this ability remains unstable and is highly dependent on her mental state as well as her depth of knowledge regarding particular runes.\n \n<i>\"In the field of rune deciphering, Sigrika displays a rare talent, one that may pose a significant risk to herself if not treated carefully.\"</i>",
    "talent_certification": "Rabelle's Waveform test sample analysis shows high-amplitude, non-periodic fluctuation patterns. Partial waveform blurring is observed, along with visible abnormal waveforms. \nConclusion: <te href=850073>Resonant Criticality</te> is within normal range. However, subject stability is poor, with a potential risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\nCurrently, Resonator Sigrika has no history of Overclocking, and her <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> remains stable.\nRoutine psychological counseling is required.\n \n<i>\"Sigrika is too hard on herself. Honestly, if she just eased up a little, her Resonator stability would improve dramatically.\"</i>\n<i>\"...Students like her are not uncommon at Startorch Academy. They come in thinking their talent means something. Then they realize that here, it just gives them an edge in a few courses. Nothing more.\"</i>\n<i>\"Still, I don't want our students to feel defined by grades, talent, or ability. They deserve to see how much more the world has to offer.\"</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Qian Chen",
    "cv_name_jp": "Akasaki Chinatsu",
    "cv_name_ko": "Jang Ye Na",
    "cv_name_en": "Maya Lindh"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Her Family",
      "content": "\"I'm back...\"\n\nThe moment Sigrika closed the door, a round Kronapuff that could've been a ball launched itself into her arms, sending her stumbling back two steps.\n\n\"Hey, Crackle! Did you have fun at home?\" she laughed, steadying herself. \"You look bigger again. Have you been eating too much? Alright, alright, let go of me! Where's Mother? Wait, don't tell me. My nose already knows.\"\n\nShe dashed into the kitchen. The fatigue of the journey melted away the instant she spotted the pot of rich, bubbling Smoked Meat Stew.\n\n\"You're back?\" her mother glanced over. \"Look at you, filthy from head to toe. Off chasing birds with your friends again, were you? In a few days, you will receive the <te href=700010>Reactor Drive</te>'s blessing. After that, you'll be considered a grown-up. A Solsworn can't be seen running around like that.\"\n\"No, no! I was helping Aunt Astrid with her herd. That doesn't count as running around.\"\n\nHer mother reached out and pinched her cheek. Sigrika winced and scrunched up her face. It only made her mother's smile soften.\n\n\"Alright, alright. Go wash your hands. We'll eat once your father gets home.\"\n\"Okay!\"\n\nSigrika grinned. She washed her hands carefully, then took the plates and utensils from the cupboard and laid them out neatly on the table.\nWhen her father returned, their small home welcomed a dinner that wasn't lavish, but was warm enough to fill the room.\nAt the table, Sigrika counted the little gifts her father had brought back—flower crowns, hairpins, clear bits of glass, and a few small blocks whose purpose she couldn't quite guess. As she tucked them away, her mother sighed and began to complain about his buying strange trinkets again. Her father scratched his head, fumbled for an explanation, then, catching Sigrika's eye, seized his chance to change the subject.\n\n\"So, feeling confident about the coming Trial?\"\n\"Of course,\" Sigrika answered without hesitation.\n\nShe liked this. Being with her family. Even when her parents nagged and rambled, she never felt annoyed. She knew, deep down, that all of it came from love and their high expectations for her.\n\nHer parents wanted her to become an outstanding <te href=700025>Solsworn</te>. They hoped she would use her talent to help others, and more than that, they hoped she would grow into an outstanding person. Sigrika knew how to live up to those expectations. That was why she studied runes every day. Learned something new every day. Even when exhaustion crept into her bones.\n\nStill, as the Trial drew closer, she couldn't help but feel nervous.\n\n\"It's alright,\" her parents said. \"Our little Sigrika will pass with flying colors. After that, you'll be heading to <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>. That place has trials of its own waiting for you.\"\n\"Mhm!\" Sigrika nodded, pushing her anxiety out the front door along with the dust of the road. For now, she would just enjoy dinner. After all, the stew really smelled good.\n\"Oh, right, Mother,\" she added suddenly. \"Has Crackle put on weight? I could barely pick it up.\"\n\"Ask your father.\"\n\"Papa?\"\n\"Haha… I might have... fed it a bit more than a little.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Her Gift",
      "content": "The rune unfolded before her eyes, like a sun rising into the sky.\n\nFew people knew that runes were never meant to be flat symbols, but something with great depth—just like what she was witnessing now. This small sun rose and unfurled, spilling its light freely and generously onto everything around it.\n\nSigrika watched in silence. If she were asked to explain what was happening, she would just say that runes carry meaning. She was only interpreting that meaning and allowing it to manifest in the world.\n\n\"Only?\" she thought to herself.\n\nPeople called it her gift. As if she had been born able to read the True Names of runes, born able to draw on the power sealed inside them. And so, of course, she could apply this gift elsewhere, like calculating the paths of the stars, fulfilling everything a <te href=700025>Solsworn</te> was expected to do.\n \nBut... that was all it was. A gift.\n\nA gift meant that this was the one place where she could give her all and nowhere else. She could recreate the True Names of runes, but she could not truly understand their essence. Why did runes hold such immense energy? What were those fleeting visions she sometimes glimpsed when touching them? And when she deciphered runes, what were those syllables hinting at, the ones she heard but could never understand? \n\nShe didn't know.\n\nStanding here now, waiting to be marked with the \"blessing of the <te href=700010>Reactor Drive</te>,\" she held a quiet hope: that once the blessing was imprinted onto her, once she crossed this threshold into adulthood, understanding would come naturally to her. But of course, it didn't.\n\nThe rune merely unfolded before her eyes. Nothing more. Even if it shone like a sun.\n\nThis was what being \"gifted\" meant. It meant that it ended here and only here. Anything beyond that, she would have to seek out herself. See it for herself. Think it through on her own.\n\nEven now, when she had no answers at all.\n\nEven if this <ano=Rune>gift</ano> felt like a <ano=True Name>shadow</ano> cast upon her by some <ano=civilization>greater entity</ano>."
    },
    {
      "title": "Her Limits",
      "content": "The frostlands.\n\nSigrika exhaled softly, a plume of white drifting into the air as she watched the herderless <te href=700022>Exoswarm</te> roaming in the distance.\n\nShe had been trailing them all night.\n\nIt had taken her hours to pull the Exoswarm out of their extreme agitation. Now, they wandered the frostlands in loose, aimless loops, but Sigrika knew this was not a good sign. Something in their command and navigation units had malfunctioned, leaving them to trace one pointless circle after another. And sooner or later, without warning, they would spiral back into a frenzied rampage. When that happened, the nearest Royan settlement would be the first to suffer.\n\nIt was a riddle. And she didn't have much time left to solve it. But that was fine. She was ready.\n\n\"These True Names… Illuminate.\"\n\nThe next instant, runes flared to life across the Exoswarm, then detonated. The aimless circling stopped. And in its place came rage. The Exoswarm recalibrated as one, locked onto Sigrika, and charged. \n\nTheir thunderous steps shattered the silence of the frostlands. The ground trembled beneath them. Sigrika tightened her grip on her dagger and began tracing runes in the air.\n\nCalm. Focus. These were the absolute requirements when drawing and deciphering runes. Stroke by stroke, the runes formed before her. And all the while, the Exoswarm bore down, their fury heating the very air, melting the snow beneath their pounding steps.\n\nThree... They carved deep, stretching grooves across the ice. Runes flickered on their bodies, but did nothing to slow them down. Driven by the single command to charge, they only accelerated, faster and faster—\n\nTwo... Sigrika tapped the final point with her blade. She vanished. At almost the same instant, every rune on the Exoswarm ignited, and Sigrika slipped between them, shuttling through their ranks on the paths her runes had carved.\n\nOne! The rune trap activated. Chain explosions erupted. Wind blades tore through the Exoswarm, cutting off their advance. And at the center of it all, Sigrika's dagger found its mark—the key to the riddle. When the shockwaves finally faded, she landed lightly, pulled forward by a <te href=700026>Soliskin</te>. Behind her, the Exoswarm herd that had raged all night finally fell silent, and the last rune clenched in her fingers scattered into specks of starlight.\n\n\"That was… close.\"\n\nIf not for Soliskin steadying her, she would have collapsed right there. Her hands were still trembling. Her heart hammered against her ribs. She knew why. The most important rune had never lit up. It hadn't responded to her deciphering. It hadn't worked at all. If the pre-set traps hadn't triggered exactly as calculated… If the wind blades had been even the slightest bit weaker…\n\nIn that moment, she understood her limits. And she understood that the gift she relied on was far from omnipotent. There would be times when runes could not be deciphered. Her gift, too, had boundaries.\n\nAnd this—only this—was what she had to rely on. She had to read the runes correctly. Because if she made even a single mistake, everything would turn out differently.\n\nNo one said those words to her. So now, she said them to herself."
    },
    {
      "title": "Her Shadow",
      "content": "She stood still.\n\nStudents streamed past her, some eagerly debating club activities, some rushing to class, others grumbling about the weight of their coursework. They flowed past her into the Academy in an endless current, a stream that didn't seem to run dry.\n\nAnd there she stood among them. A stake driven in place, struggling just to hold her ground.\n\nThis was the new life waiting for her.\n \nSigrika jolted awake. It took her a moment to realize she wasn't home anymore. She was a freshman at <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>.\n\nWhat awaited her wasn't just runes. New courses. New knowledge. New people. A buffet of novelty lay spread before her. But the light of it all cast shadows. Heavy ones.\n\nShe still hadn't found her footing here. Just yesterday, working as a teaching assistant for the first time, she had been asked to explain Royan customs to her classmates. Halfway through, a strange confusion and pressure had washed over her, something she had never felt before. Two days ago, she hadn't even known how to make TARD-E stop its incessant singing. And before that…\n\nShe had stood at the Academy gate, watching people pass by, unable to decide which way to go.\n\nAll of it was new. Vast. Overwhelming. Unlike runes, these things weren't built from points and lines. They offered her no familiar handholds.\n\nSigrika threw off the covers and sprang out of bed. She washed up quickly, then gathered her things: the notes she had organized yesterday, her Bionics assignment, the preview materials for Ecology and Communications, and...\n\nMoments later, arms full of books, she hurried out the door and merged into the stream.\n\nShe would bite into these shadows. She would find their shape, their structure. And she would wrest the knowledge from inside."
    },
    {
      "title": "Her Words",
      "content": "Sigrika stood at the front door of her childhood home, her hand resting on the handle. She didn't open it for a long time.\n\nAh... It was still hard. Hard to say everything out loud, to admit how tired she was, how unhappy. Even facing her own family, she found it difficult.\n\nOr maybe... it was because they were her family that made it so hard.\n\nAfter all, she didn't want them to worry.\n\n\"It's okay,\" she comforted herself. \"If I can't even face my own family, how can I ever face myself?\"\n\nAt last, she made up her mind and reached to turn the handle—but the door swung open on its own.\n\nHer mother stood there, looking at her with helpless fondness. \"Why didn't you come in?\"\n\n\"Mother...\"\n\n\"What's wrong?\" her mother asked gently. \"You've been out there for so long. Did something happen that you're afraid to tell me?\" She smiled softly. \"It's alright, we can take our time.\"\n\nSigrika stepped forward and wrapped her arms around her.\n \nSomething inside her crumbled all at once. Maybe it was the wall she had built, brick by brick, stone by stone, between herself and her family. Built from her pride. Her exhaustion. Her love. She had wanted so badly to be someone they could be proud of, so she never spoke of how tired she was. Never let it show. But now… she felt that she finally could.\n\n\"I've met some friends,\" she began. \"Really good friends.\"\n\nAnd there was so much more she wanted to tell them."
    }

      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Feel the breath.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill02_02.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Uh-oh, careful—",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill03_01.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill03_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "One, two, three...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill03_02.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill03_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Know what \"explosion\" means?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill04_01.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill04_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Boom!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill04_02.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill04_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "Detonate!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill04_03.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill04_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VIII",
      "content": "You're gonna remember this!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill05_01.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill05_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IX",
      "content": "Cool your head!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill05_02.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_skill05_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "True Name, illuminate!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_xigelika_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Straight to the stars.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_xigelika_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "(Effort Sounds)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_xigelika_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Let me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_qte.play_favor_word_xigelika_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Ouch! That hurts!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "I flew!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "I should be more careful.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Just a tiny slip.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Can I keep going like this?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "This doesn't define me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Couldn't live up to... those expectations...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_die_01.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Even stars fall sometimes...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_die_02.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Was it... my fault?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_die_03.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Greet my friends.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "<te href=700026>Soliskin</te> Sigrika!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Leave this riddle to me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_engage.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Just like a bird...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "The answer is nearby.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_scan.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Faster than a rabbit.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Shining like a star!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "A reward for solving a riddle.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "I'll keep it safe.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_xigelika_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_xigelika_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Markings of Life",
      "content": "A diary dear to Sigrika, filled with the traces of her life and thoughts.\nIn <te href=700021>Bjartr Woods</te>, it held her joy and discoveries. At <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>, it holds her doubts and sorrow.\nLife stretches far beyond the pages of a diary. Growth, too, never happens overnight.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure140_UI.T_Treasure140_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Carrier of Passion",
      "content": "A bird journal Sigrika keeps, though most entries are just blurry silhouettes. The sketches and notes brim with the collector's unfiltered excitement.\n\"Stay still! Don't flash me your tail, Blubbin Puffin! Stay there! Stop moving! Ugh, your tail AGAIN?! Please stay still! Ugh, again?! Blubbin Puffin!\"\n\"New species discovered! White bird! New species! White bird! New species! White bird! New species! White bird! New species! White bird!\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure141_UI.T_Treasure141_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "A Mother's Love",
      "content": "A pouch sewn by Sigrika's mother, filled with candies, hairpins, and little trinkets whose purposes are anyone's guess.\nWhen Sigrika left home, her mother pulled her into a warm embrace. It left Sigrika with encouragement, love, and the gentlest of tethers.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure142_UI.T_Treasure142_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "One, Two, Three",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\nEnter the <color=Highlight>Decipher</color> state for {0}s after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color>. This effect ends early if Sigrika is switched off the field.\nWhen Sigrika has at least <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color>, her Basic Attack cycle starts from Stage 2.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Elucidated</color></size>\nWhile in the <color=Highlight><te href=141207>Decipher</te></color> state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Elucidated</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).\nLeave the <color=Highlight><te href=141207>Decipher</te></color> state upon casting this skill.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting Plunging Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Decipher</color></size>\nWhile in the <color=Highlight><te href=141207>Decipher</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Decipher</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).\nLeave the <color=Highlight><te href=141207>Decipher</te></color> state upon casting this skill.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Dodge Counter</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge in mid-air to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Royan Close Quarters Combat",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>BOOMY BOOM!</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>BOOMY BOOM!</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color></size>\nWhile in the <color=Highlight><te href=141207>Decipher</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).\nLeave the <color=Highlight><te href=141207>Decipher</te></color> state upon casting this skill.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Soliskin to the Aid</color></size>\nWhile in the <color=Highlight><te href=141207>Decipher</te></color> state, with at least <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color>, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Soliskin to the Aid</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).\nLeave the <color=Highlight><te href=141207>Decipher</te></color> state upon casting this skill.",
        "param": [
          "50"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>BOOMY BOOM!</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color></size>\nWhile in the <color=Highlight>Decipher</color> state, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Soliskin to the Aid</color></size>\nWhile in the <color=Highlight>Decipher</color> state, with at least <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight>Full Stop</color>, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Soliskin to the Aid</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "50"
        ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Within Infinity's Embrace",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume two <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color> and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Based on the types of the <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color> consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:\n- When consuming <color=Highlight>Rune: Trust</color> and <color=Highlight>Rune: Answer</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>.\n- When consuming two <color=Highlight>Runes: Trust</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>.\n- When consuming two <color=Highlight>Runes: Answer</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color>.\nWhen consuming <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color>, if Sigrika holds at least <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color>, consume <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, and <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> by {2}. Obtain a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=141203>Innate Gift?</te></color>.\nWhen consuming <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color>, if <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color> is lower than <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3}, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color>. Every <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color> consumed grants the current <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, and <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> {5} DMG Amplification.\n<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color> deals Echo Skill DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Runic Outburst</color></size>\nDeal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Runic Chain Whip</color></size>\nStagnate nearby targets and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Runic Soliskin</color></size>\nPull in nearby targets and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color> reaches <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=6}, if <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> is not on Cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM!</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color>. <color=Highlight>Hold Resonance Skill</color> to consume all <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Innate Gift?</color></size>\nSigrika can hold up to <SapTag=7>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=7} of <color=Highlight>Innate Gift?</color>. Each stack grants <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> and <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> {8} DMG Amplification.\nThis effect ends after Sigrika casts <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> or is switched off the field.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Rune</color></size>\nSigrika holds up to <color=Highlight><SapTag=9>{9}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=9}</color>. Without <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color>, Sigrika can only hold up to <color=Highlight><SapTag=A>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=A}</color>. When Sigrika gains a new <color=Highlight>Rune</color> at max capacity, the existing <color=Highlight>Runes</color> shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost <color=Highlight>Rune</color>. With at least <SapTag=B>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color>, Sigrika can hold <SapTag=C>{12}</SapTag> additional {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=C}.\nHitting a target directly with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Elucidated</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Decipher</color> in the duration of the moves grants one <color=Highlight>Rune: Trust</color>.\nHitting a target directly with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color> in the duration of the moves grants one <color=Highlight>Rune: Answer</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Full Stop</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color>, gain <SapTag=D>{13}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of <color=Highlight>Full Stop</color>, up to 100 points.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Soliskin Vitality</color></size>\nWhen any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains <SapTag=E>{14}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight>Soliskin Vitality</color>, up to <SapTag=F>{15}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F}. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - In This Very Moment</color> resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.",

        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Rune</color></size>\nHitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Elucidated</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Decipher</color> grants one <color=Highlight>Rune: Trust</color>.\nHitting a target with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color> grants one <color=Highlight>Rune: Answer</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Soliskin Vitality</color></size>\nWhen any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains <color=Highlight>Soliskin Vitality</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume two <color=Highlight>Runes</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Based on the types of the consumed <color=Highlight>Runes</color>, gain different enhancements and launch various enhanced attacks.\nIf Sigrika holds at least <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight>Soliskin Vitality</color>, the enhanced attacks deal more DMG and Sigrika gains a stack of <color=Highlight>Innate Gift?</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Innate Gift?</color></size>\nEach stack of <color=Highlight>Innate Gift?</color> grants the chained attacks of <color=Highlight> Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color> and <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> DMG Amplification.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Full Stop</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color>, Sigrika gains <color=Highlight>Full Stop</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Full Stop</color> is maxed, <color=Highlight>hold Resonance Skill</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color>, dealing substantial <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).",

      "name": "The Gleam Meant for Radiance",
      "desc": "The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Elucidated</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Decipher</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color> are increased by {0}.\nSigrika becomes immune to interruptions while casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Elucidated</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color>.\n<color=Highlight><te href=141208>Encapsulated</te></color> now stacks up to {1} times. After casting Outro Skill <color=Highlight>In This Very Moment</color>, Sigrika obtains <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> additional {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2}.",

  "stories": [],

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "(Hmm...)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "It is natural to feel dreadful of the unknown, yet... there are times when the unknown harbors hope, like how I can never know what else this power has to offer.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Will there be new discoveries?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup04.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup05.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "The show begins.",

    {
