      "skill": {
        "name": "Vibration Manifestation",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nRover performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nRover consumes STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Resonance</color></size>\nAfter <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, press the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button at the right time to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Resonance</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Aftertune</color></size>\nAfter Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Resonance</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> hits a target, press the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Aftertune</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nRover consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Resonance</color></size>\nAfter <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> at the right time to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Resonance</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Aftertune</color></size>\nAfter Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Resonance</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> hits a target, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Aftertune</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "World in a Grain of Sand",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin</color></size>\nIf \"Diminutive Sound\" exceeds {0} when <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is used, consume {1} \"Diminutive Sound\" to cast <color=Highlight>Resonating Spin</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. This DMG is considered as Resonance Skill DMG and applies {3} stack(s) of <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> along with <color=Highlight>Shimmer</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Shimmer</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Shimmer</color> prevents <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> stacks from reducing over time.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes</color></size>\nAfter Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Resonating Spin</color> ends, follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Resonating Echoes</color>.\nLaunch forward to attack the enemies, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Diminutive Sound</color></size>\nRover can hold up to {2} \"Diminutive Sounds\".\nRover obtains \"Diminutive Sound\" for every Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Vibration Manifestation</color> on hit. \nRover obtains \"Diminutive Sound\" for every Heavy Attack <color=Highlight> Aftertune</color> on hit.\nRover obtains \"Diminutive Sound\" upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Waveshock</color>.",
        "param": [
          "50",
          "50",
          "100",
          "2"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin</color></size>\nIf Diminutive Sound exceeds {0} when <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is cast, Rover consumes {1} Diminutive Sound to cast <color=Highlight>Resonating Spin</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and applying <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> and <color=Highlight>Shimmer</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes</color></size> Right after Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Resonating Spin</color> ends, using <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> casts <color=Highlight>Resonating Echoes</color> that launches attacks forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Diminutive Sound</color></size>\nRover can hold up to {2} Diminutive Sound.\nRover gains Diminutive Sound through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "50",
          "50",
          "100",
          "2"
        ],

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_idle02.play_favor_word_nvzhu_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "(Contemplating)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_idle03.play_favor_word_nvzhu_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_01.play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Will there be new discoveries?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_02.play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_03.play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_rankup01.play_favor_word_nvzhu_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_rankup02.play_favor_word_nvzhu_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_rankup03.play_favor_word_nvzhu_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_rankup04.play_favor_word_nvzhu_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.",

    },

      "skill": {
        "name": "Vibration Manifestation",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nRover performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nRover consumes STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Resonance</color></size>\nAfter <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, press the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button at the right time to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Resonance</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Aftertune</color></size>\nAfter Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Resonance</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> hits a target, press the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Aftertune</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nRover consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Resonance</color></size>\nAfter <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> at the right time to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Resonance</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Aftertune</color></size>\nAfter Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Resonance</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> hits a target, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Aftertune</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "World in a Grain of Sand",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin</color></size>\nIf \"Diminutive Sound\" exceeds {0} when <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is used, consume {1} \"Diminutive Sound\" to cast <color=Highlight>Resonating Spin</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. This DMG is considered as Resonance Skill DMG and applies {3} stack(s) of <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> along with <color=Highlight>Shimmer</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Shimmer</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Shimmer</color> prevents <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> stacks from reducing over time.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes</color></size>\nAfter Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Resonating Spin</color> ends, follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Resonating Echoes</color>.\nLaunch forward to attack the enemies, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Diminutive Sound</color></size>\nRover can hold up to {2} \"Diminutive Sounds\".\nRover obtains \"Diminutive Sound\" for every Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Vibration Manifestation</color> on hit. \nRover obtains \"Diminutive Sound\" for every Heavy Attack <color=Highlight> Aftertune</color> on hit.\nRover obtains \"Diminutive Sound\" upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Waveshock</color>.",
        "param": [
          "50",
          "50",
          "100",
          "2"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin</color></size>\nIf Diminutive Sound exceeds {0} when <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is cast, Rover consumes {1} Diminutive Sound to cast <color=Highlight>Resonating Spin</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and applying <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> and <color=Highlight>Shimmer</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes</color></size> Right after Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Resonating Spin</color> ends, using <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> casts <color=Highlight>Resonating Echoes</color> that launches attacks forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Diminutive Sound</color></size>\nRover can hold up to {2} Diminutive Sound.\nRover gains Diminutive Sound through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "50",
          "50",
          "100",
          "2"
        ],

  "name": "Verina",
  "nick_name": "Nature Calling",
  "desc": "With an extensive knowledge of botany, Verina is always solicitous, always smiling, and always wishing for every flower to be blessed with the miracle of life.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_3_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_3_UI",
  "background": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRolePile/T_IconRole_Pile_jueyuan_UI.T_IconRole_Pile_jueyuan_UI",
  "background_stand": "",
  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "May 18th",
    "sex": "Female",
    "country": "New Federation",
    "influence": "Jinzhou",
    "info": "With an extensive knowledge of botany, Verina is always solicitous, always smiling, and always wishing for every flower to be blessed with the miracle of life.",
    "talent_name": "Nature Calling",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1916-G]\n\nAccording to Resonator Verina's reports, she has had significant exposure to botanical samples since childhood and is able to audibly detect their frequencies. The timing of her Awakening is unknown.\n\nVerina's resonance frequency shows an increasing trend over time, leading to speculation that her Forte abilities will also continue to strengthen with age. The extent of this growth is still being monitored.\n\nResonator Verina bears a <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> below her clavicle. Following her Awakening, physical changes have been noted, such as the emergence of vines on both ears and dorsal spine.\n\nThese vines form a symbiotic relationship with Verina and assist in converting her resonance frequency into Spectro energy for efficient storage and release during use of Forte.\n\nAdditionally, Verina's Resonance Spectrum Pattern aligns with known patterns of plant life. Strong Syntony reactions have been recorded during testing, yet the exact cause of Verina's Awakening remains inconclusive.\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a noticeable periodic waveform. Therefore, Verina is classified as a <te href=850068>Congenital Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "The waveform graph for Resonator Verina displays stable elliptical fluctuations in the Time Domain with no abnormal patterns. Upon examination, all results fall within normal parameters. \nResonant Criticality: Low, with high stability. Examination results appear to fall within normal parameters with no risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n<i>Annotation: Resonator Verina's emotional state and volitional level are generally very stable, and only fluctuate slightly and briefly when she is situated away from the natural environment. Test results indicate her symbiotic plants are capable of transmitting a special frequency band to Verina, which aids her in returning to a stable state of mind. This is a rare case in the relationship between a Resonator and the symbiotic plants and serves as a useful reference for related research.</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Zhao Shuang",
    "cv_name_jp": "Sasahara Yu",
    "cv_name_ko": "Kang Sae Bom",
    "cv_name_en": "Heather Nicol"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Mushrooms 101",
      "content": "\"If you're asking about Verina. Boy, you're in for a story,\" When asked about Verina, Riggs, leader of one of the Pioneer exploration teams, always begins with these words, \"When she first came aboard our team, she was always by herself and didn't really talk to people. We were all worried about her, since she had lost her parents...\"\n\n\"We couldn't help but feel sad for her. She was so young, but already had it rough in life. And she was such a kind girl. We loved exploring, but it's no walk in the park. But Verina never complained. She did all the hard work like mountain climbing and getting water by herself. She even went scavenging for food without being asked. She was such a big help to us, but we worried about her keeping everything bottled up inside for too long... what if something happened?\"\n\n\"Until one day, something actually happened. And it was funny, to say the least. One of the lads on the team really liked mushrooms and went out to pick a few for the soup he made. Verina held on to that pot and wouldn't let it go as if her life depended on it. By the time we got over to them, they were already in a shouting match.\"\n\n\"The lad was bragging to Verina about his wildlife experiences. Hell, don't know what'd gotten into his head, thinkin' he could out-talk our little botanist! Verina had all the mushrooms spread out and started naming out all the rings, caps, and butts of each and every one of them. Being out exploring for so long, we all caught on that she was telling us the mushrooms were poisonous. She's got more knowledge of them than any of us, even gave us a lecture on the spot, teaching us how to tell them apart one by one. Now that was a lesson.\"\n\n\"After she was done, she even tapped on a piece of wood she found somewhere like an instructor, and asked if we understood it all. We looked at each other and blinked dumbly, then burst into laughs, which drove her nuts.\"\n\n\"W-why are you all laughing... Did I get something wrong? Eugh... Sob...\" She was so panicked that she started picking out the mushrooms still in the pot and went over them again one by one, but we were already all clapping for her. And then I yelled, \"Bravo! That's our little botanist, folks!\"\n\nEver since then, Verina would still think of that day and feel super embarrassed; she'd put her head inside a mushroom pot if she could. But she'd still give her opinions carefully and patiently whenever it came to anything plant-related."
    },
    {
      "title": "Cultivating Flowers",
      "content": "The people of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> love flowers.\n\nDuring tense battles, the military often requested extra bouquets with their supplies. These orders would end up in Verina's hands, which felt strange at first.\n\nThe bouquets bloomed for only a short time. Those picked today would wilt tomorrow. A bouquet that blooms in a greenhouse may have withered petals by the time it makes it to its recipient. At this point, the flowers would have already lost most of their beauty in people's hands, so why the need for them?\n\nUntil one day, she read the wishes attached to one of the orders. \n\n\"In honor of my comrade in arms. He gave his life for the peace of Jinzhou, yet his name is not known to many. Yet I still remember his heartfelt smile when he received an Iris from a friend long ago. If one's name cannot be remembered, let the meanings of these flowers honor him forever.\"\n\nThat night, Verina locked herself in the greenhouse.\n\nFlowers are adored for their intricate leaf patterns, but it's the fleeting feelings they evoke that truly captivate us. Verina carefully selected and cultivated the finest seeds, preserving those precious emotions in her garden.\n\nShe longed to preserve the stories and emotions associated with each bouquet, wishing for them to last beyond their natural lifespan. She hoped that by doing so, recipients would experience the true essence and beauty of the flowers, igniting a deeper connection to the emotions they held within.\n\nIt was at these times that Verena wished she could work a little harder and a little longer."
    },
    {
      "title": "Noting the Differences",
      "content": "People always ask Verina why she loves plants so much. It's a question that Verina has answered countless times, but she knows that people will always start off the conversations with question after question, so each time she would give out her well-thought-out answer: \"When I was little, my mom would place two pieces of leaves in my hand and ask me what the differences were between them.\n\nI would reply, 'Aren't they exactly the same? They came from the same tree.'\n\nAnd Mom would shake her head, 'Look closely, Verina.'\n\nSo I gave them a closer look, and then I realized that even though they looked the same on the outside, their veins spread out in varying directions. They drew completely different patterns.\"\n\nThis changed Verina's perspective entirely, the differences which she had never noticed nor cared about in the past were now displaying right before her eyes.\n\nSome flowers may look similar but grow in completely different environments. Some trees or plants may grow in near identical environments but end up taking on various shapes.\n\nVerina was captivated by the similarities and differences among plants, spurring her passion for botany. She meticulously studied their traits to help them thrive in different environments and cultivate stunning flowers. Through this, she also began to notice the unique qualities of those around her. Just as every leaf is distinct, so are people and experiences. Verina observes her friends closely, noting their preferences and sorrows with care.\n\n\"For example, some people like to eat Lemongrass and some people don't. It must feel nice to have someone remember their preferences.\"\n\nWith this sentiment in mind, Verina carefully and conscientiously jotted down every little thing about her friends."
    },
    {
      "title": "Moments of Woe",
      "content": "Being an ordinary girl, Verina has her moments of woe, too.\n\nPlant cultivation can be unpredictable. Often, Verina would wake up to find dried seedpods in the petri dish after a night's rest. And then after working tirelessly all day, she would realize she had skipped her lunch again. In these moments, she missed her parents dearly.\n\n\"If Mom and Dad were still around, I wouldn't have to worry about all this...\" Verina thought. A hot, hearty lunch would be right there waiting for her as she walked in the door, and she would get all the help she needed in time whenever she wanted to figure something out. But all of that had long since become a memory, left in the notes that she had lost when she departed the New Federation a long time ago.\n\nNow she would have to pull herself together and live on her own.\n\nSometimes, she wondered: <i>Is there any meaning to all the work I've done? Is there any meaning in the life I'm living?<i>\n\nBut then, she would always find the answer in her thriving plants.\n\nDespite the struggle, the dry seedpods continued to produce new life and their growth whispered tales of perseverance and joy into her ears. As she nestled herself in this green oasis, Verina could hear the plants sharing their stories of pain and triumph, reminding her of the beauty of growth and blooming.\n\nPerhaps this was the meaning of her endeavors. Verina thought as she stood up and put on her gardening gloves again.\n\nEven if her parents aren't by her side, she is still determined to keep working hard and show them how much she's grown.\n\nAfter a brief moment of sorrow, she picked up the spray can and carried on with her day's work."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Little Time Off",
      "content": "Verina would give herself some time off from time to time.\n\nVerina set the flower room temperature and watering schedule. As she finished, she exhaled in relief. \n\nAfter days of work, she knew the importance of taking a break for both herself and her plants. She cleared her mind and grabbed her adventure notes to explore the streets of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>.\n\nJinzhou was a far cry from her hometown in the New Federation. No inflated flower prices or elaborate competitions here. As she strolled through the bustling alleyways, Verina was struck with a sense of genuine relief. The steam rising from vendors' stalls and the busy shoppers around her brought a comforting normalcy to this new city.\n\nThis is good, this is good. As she walked along the road, Verina thought to herself. Memories flooded her mind of studying plants with her parents, and the painful loneliness she felt after their absence. But now, standing on her own two feet, she could finally treat herself to a peaceful vacation. After what felt like an eternity of walking alone, she had grown into her own person.\n\nAnd then she saw her friends waving to her: Chixia and Yangyang were walking towards her with freshly purchased Salted Milk Tea in their hands. The <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> must be taking a little vacation as well. Verina hurriedly rummaged through her satchel, pulling out a few bouquets of tiny, star-like flowers from it.\n\nThis was the most precious gift Verina would ever give her friends. The selection had taken far, far too long, and while the <te href=850133>Starflowers</te> had waited for the best of times and sunshine, she had also waited for sunshine that would make her feel warm.\n\nNow that she saw her sunshine, Verina ran toward her friends.\n\nThere was a long road ahead, and it would take some time for the flowers to bloom.\n\nAnd for now, she is content to enjoy the vacation."
    }
  ],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player01.play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "You saw me in the Dim Forest late at night? My bad, I was probably too caught up waiting for a Noctemint to blossom to notice you. Those plants wait their whole lives for that one bloom. I think they'd be happy to have someone there, witnessing and recording it all.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player02.play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "O-of course we can talk about something other than plants. I do take breaks from the greenhouse, you know. Um... Do you like Morri Pot? The various types of mushrooms in it are so... What? M-mushrooms are not plants. They're fungi!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player03.play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "When you have the time, how about we take a walk together? The world is going to look very different when you don't have a particular destination in mind. Want to give it a try?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player04.play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "Sometimes, it feels like the two of us are dandelion seeds, drifting wherever the wind takes us. We have our ups and downs, just like weathering a storm, but one day we may finally land and flourish, after a good rain. Rover, as fellow travelers, let's embrace what lies ahead, wherever and whenever we may be. To me, that's what truly makes life worth living.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player05.play_favor_word_weilinai_to_player05"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Verina's Hobby",
      "content": "During my free time, I enjoy strolling around <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> on my own. Every brick and tile looks slightly different from one another, and I can find resilient little flowers growing in the cracks. The streets are always bustling with people, and the smell of steaming food brings a cozy atmosphere. Whenever I wander around and take in all these sights and sensations, I feel... hmm, is \"invigorated\" the right word for it?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_taste.play_favor_word_weilinai_taste"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Verina's Trouble",
      "content": "I've noticed a trend of people sharing Terminal-generated images online, saying those must be new plant species. While I understand their interest and curiosity, I'm worried this could mislead the public. As a botanist myself, I always try to be accurate and honest when I'm sharing information about plants. I've been wanting to find a way to help people tell the difference between fake images and real photos, but it seems there's still a lot of work to do. What should I do...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_worry.play_favor_word_weilinai_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_food_favor.play_favor_word_weilinai_food_favor"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_food_hate.play_favor_word_weilinai_food_hate"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "Maintaining a balanced ecosystem is no easy feat, especially when it involves regulating the population of various species. But what if we could grow flowers that have a calming effect on the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>? This could greatly reduce the strain on our frontline soldiers and potentially save lives.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_dream.play_favor_word_weilinai_dream"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "My adventure journal isn't just about plants. Check it out - this story is about an old lady patiently waiting for a flower to bloom, and this one is about an adventurer going all out to snap a photo of a rare type of grass. Each leaf represents a unique story that has bloomed into something beautiful. I wrote them down to remember every one of these stories.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_story_obj.play_favor_word_weilinai_story_obj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "When I was little, I thought showcasing the beauty of flowers would make people appreciate and protect them... Reality hit me hard when I saw people plucking and flaunting expensive flowers instead. It used to upset me, but then I'd remind myself: Verina, remember the value of every plant's life. Remember what mom and dad had wanted you to do.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_story_exp.play_favor_word_weilinai_story_exp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Yangyang",
      "content": "Miss Yangyang was curious about my plant growing skills, and she asked me many questions earlier. Then, she patiently listened to me explaining details for a long, long time. Hanging out with her feels like basking in a gentle breeze.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_about_yangyang.play_favor_word_weilinai_about_yangyang"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Chixia",
      "content": "Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_about_chixia.play_favor_word_weilinai_about_chixia"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Baizhi",
      "content": "Did you know? \"Baizhi\" is actually an old name for Angelica, a plant that can bloom beautiful flowers in freezing temperatures. It kinda makes me think of Miss Baizhi herself—some might say she seems a bit chilly, but I have a feeling she's got a warm and gentle heart underneath.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_about_baizhi.play_favor_word_weilinai_about_baizhi"

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Mortefi",
      "content": "Mr. Mortefi's dedication to his work is remarkable, but I do worry about his well-being... Whenever I go and check on the nocturnal plants at night, I can see the lights on in his lab from a distance.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Encore",
      "content": "Little Encore is full of intriguing ideas, and she always has a lot of curious questions to ask. Hmm... I've got to keep looking for all the answers she wants. Oh, you're wondering why I call her \"little\"? Hehe, we're just playing big sister and little baby.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_about_anke.play_favor_word_weilinai_about_anke"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Calcharo",
      "content": "I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_about_kakaluo.play_favor_word_weilinai_about_kakaluo"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "H-here. This <te href=850133>Starflower</te> is for you, and it represents... hope and miracles. Happy birthday! Sorry, I'm not really used to celebrating other people's birthdays yet, erm... Yeah. I just want you to always be happy, Rover.",

    },
    {

      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Wow, such a rare species! It's my lucky day!",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "I wonder how they're growing...",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_weilinai_idle03.play_favor_word_weilinai_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "I'm Verina. If you come across any plants that pique your interest, do let me know! Huh? You want me to go on field researches with you? Of-of course! It's my honor. But it can get quite dangerous out in the wild. Please be careful and stay close to me.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!",

    },

    {

    {

  "goods": [

      "title": "Expedition Goggles",
      "content": "Verina cherishes her Pioneer Association expedition goggles, remnants of a journey and warm memories like <te href=850133>Starflower</te>. Now useless for danger detection, they hold sentimental value to her.",

      "title": "Eternity in Bloom",
      "content": "The flower sample from Verina's first fieldwork. She waited for the flower to bloom and carefully preserved it. Verina sees the blooming of a flower as an everlasting moment of life's beauty, encapsulating her love for both flowers and life itself.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure2_UI.T_Treasure2_UI"

    {

      "skill": {
        "name": "Cultivation",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nVerina performs up to 5 consecutive attacks with vines, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nVerina consumes STA to charge forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nVerina consumes STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to consume STA and perform a mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to consume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Starflower Blooms",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms</color></size>\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, if Verina carries \"Photosynthesis Energy\", Verina consumes {0} stack of \"Photosynthesis Energy\" to recover Concerto Energy and heal all characters on a nearby team.\n<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms</color> deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms</color></size>\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, if Verina carries \"Photosynthesis Energy\", Verina consumes {0} stack of \"Photosynthesis Energy\" to recover Concerto Energy and heal all characters on a nearby team.\n<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms</color> deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.\nVerina can cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms</color> by using <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Photosynthesis Energy</color></size>\nVerina can hold up to {1} stacks of \"Photosynthesis Energy\".\nVerina obtains {2} stack of \"Photosynthesis Energy\" for every <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 5</color> on hit.\nVerina obtains {3} stack of \"Photosynthesis Energy\" after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Botany Experiment</color>.\nVerina obtains {4} stack of \"Photosynthesis Energy\" after casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Verdant Growth</color>.",
        "param": [
          "1",
          "4",
          "1",
          "1",
          "1"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms</color></size>\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, if Verina has Photosynthesis Energy, she consumes {0} stack of it to recover Concerto Energy and heal all nearby party members.\n<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms</color> deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> on hit.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms</color></size>\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, if Verina has Photosynthesis Energy, she consumes {0} stack of it to recover Concerto Energy and heal all nearby party members.\n<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms</color> deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> on hit.\nVerina can cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms</color> by using <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Photosynthesis Energy</color></size>\nVerina can hold up to {1} Photosynthesis Energy.\nVerina gains Photosynthesis Energy through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "1",
          "4",
          "1",
          "1",
          "1"
        ],

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Mountain Memories",
      "content": "Outside an old house in Yuezhou lies a patch of reeds beside a lake. To the north, the water narrows; to the south, it widens, resembling a sliced pear, with the surface shimmering under the night sky.\n\nThe summer air hung thick with heat, lulling the world into a drowsy stupor.\n\nIn the quiet of the evening, Lumi nestled in her mother's arms on a rocking chair by the window. Her eyelids drooped as she gazed out sleepily. The soft breeze from a fan brushed her skin, making her squint with contentment. The chorus of insects filled the yard, and Lumi curled even closer to her mother, lulled by the comforting sounds of the village.\n \nThis small place was Changzhuang. No one could quite remember why it was called that, but they grew accustomed to this name over time.\n\nThe disasters following the <te href=850075>Lament</te> had spread across all of <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>. Even here, deep in the mountains of Yuezhou, they had left their indelible mark by cutting the village off from the outside world—technology crumbled, and the villagers returned to the old ways—farming, hunting, surviving as their ancestors once had. Life was dictated by the rising and setting sun. Over time, people in Changzhuang became used to the peace and simplicity of this lifestyle.\n\nThe day Lumi was born, the whole house lit up. The swaddled infant glowed softly, catching the eye of every villager. They gathered in the yard, curious to see the newborn who shone like a small beacon. Resonators were rare here, and ones like Lumi, with such innate power, were even rarer. But in a village as tranquil as Changzhuang, there were no grand challenges that even needed a child Resonator to solve. Therefore, Lumi grew up carefree, just like other ordinary children in the village. She learned the ways of the mountains and fields—how to track wild animal traces and how to distinguish which plants might sate a hungry belly.\n\nPeople in Changzhuang enjoyed cooling off under the shade of a tree. As Lumi ran through the trees with her friends, her inborn light flickered as if performing a cheerful dance. The village elders lovingly called her \"Sunshine,\" while her friends dubbed her \"Lumi the Firefly.\" Yet Lumi often wondered about her strange gift, unsure of its purpose. More often than not, it was a nuisance. On hunting trips, her light would flash uncontrollably, startling prey.\n\nAfter being asked to temporarily sit out from the hunts, Lumi's heart sank with a pang of frustration. Alone, she wandered to the marshes by the reeds and sat down. Her glow flickered, dimmed, and then brightened again as she practiced, trying to control the light. Finally, exhaustion set in, and she drifted off to sleep. Despite her struggles, Lumi never felt rushed. \n\nLife in Changzhuang was slow, and there was always time to grow and to learn. \n\nThe shimmering surface of the lake returned to darkness. The night breeze ferried the croaks of frogs away. Tomorrow was another day."
    },
    {
      "title": "Towards the Horizon",
      "content": "\"Tuesday, clear skies. I watched the sunset from Caidong Peak! But Zhangzhang didn't come… She seems to have lost interest in this kind of thing...\"\n\nLumi paused and closed her notebook in the golden light of the setting sun.\n\nIt was a thick hardcover notebook—a birthday gift from her parents, one she had chosen herself. Once a diary, it had transformed into an exploration journal as she grew older. As a child, Lumi was content wandering the pebble paths of Changzhuang, but now, those paths felt too small. Her curiosity stretched beyond the borders of the village. She longed for the roads that led to the world outside. \n\nThe only problem was—no one had found those roads in a long, long time.\n\nHer father once told her about the many failed attempts. Over the years, many had tried to find a way beyond the mountains, but all had returned empty-handed, lost, or worse. Eventually, the villagers gave up, their focus shifting to more immediate concerns. Life in Changzhuang was demanding—farming from spring to autumn, then bracing for the long winter when the mountains would disappear under a blanket of silver frost, making exploration impossible.\n\nLumi understood the demands of life, yet her curiosity and yearning for adventure burned even brighter. She quickly gathered a group of friends and formed a small exploration team, determined to find a way out. But despite their excitement, failure kicked in—the aftermath of the <te href=850075>Lament</te> had seemingly twisted the terrain, eliminating every possible way out, just like it had their forebears.\n\nAt first, the setbacks didn't bother them. They were kids, after all, full of energy and hope. But as time passed, they drifted away. The older ones joined the labor teams, others lost interest. Lumi's once lively group dwindled, and today, her exploration ended earlier than planned as everyone was eager to hurry home before dusk settled in.\n\nLumi sighed. \n\nShe knew that for most of her friends, this was just a way to pass the time. \n\nShe stood up, cupped her hands around her mouth, and shouted toward the mountains, her voice echoing against the rocks and trees before fading into the evening air.\n\nThe sunset blazed across the sky, casting the horizon in shades of red and gold before melting into the soft kiss of the night. \n\nLumi smiled, patting her cheeks lightly. It didn't matter. The thrill of discovering something new, something unknown, still filled her with excitement.\n\n\"…Oh! I'll tell Zhangzhang all about the view when we meet for ice pops tonight. And Beihai, Ming…\"\n\nShe whispered the names of her friends as she waved goodbye to the mountains, then turned and made her way down the hill, alone but content."
    },
    {
      "title": "Neon City",
      "content": "\"You're awake? Here, drink this.\"\n\nAs her eyes fluttered open, her parched lips met the cool, sweet droplets of water. Her hand instinctively gripped the container, and she eagerly gulped it down.\n\n\"Easy now, don't rush,\" the voice urged, gentle and concerned. \"You'll choke if you drink too fast.\"\n\nAs the last drop slipped down her throat, Lumi blinked, her mind finally clearing. She looked up at the faces of her rescuers—a small squad, three of them, dressed in similar clothing. Their leader, a girl with a kind smile, helped her sit up.\n\n\"Are you from around here? That's a surprise. We were told there's no one living in these parts,\" the girl said, a hint of curiosity in her voice. \"Guess we'll need to update our map.\"\n\n\"Thank you… for saving me,\" Lumi whispered, her words faltering. The world she knew was small, confined to the mountains and the narrow boundaries of Changzhuang. \"A-are you from the outside?\"\n\nThe squad exchanged glances, and it was then that Lumi noticed the emblem on their uniforms—a chubby hamster wearing a straw hat, grinning adorably.\n\nA hand reached out, helping Lumi to her feet. \n\n\"Sorry for the late introduction. We're from <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>, a delivery squad.\"\n \nMonths later, Chengxiao smiled, setting down the comb and patting Lumi's shoulder. \n\n\"Take a look. How do you feel?\"\n\nLumi stared at her reflection, stunned by the unfamiliar face in the mirror. The girl staring back at her had neat curls and wore a clean, fitted Lollo Logistics uniform—looking every bit the city dweller she had become.\n\nChengxiao, the leader of the squad that had rescued her, had taken Lumi from the quiet of Changzhuang to the bustling city and taken her under her wing. She was quick-witted, reliable, and now Lumi's mentor at Lollo Logistics.\n\n\"I look… different,\" Lumi muttered, scratching her head shyly. \"Thank you, Chengxiao.\"\n\n\"None of that formality now,\" Chengxiao laughed. \"I'm off to deliver some documents. Cafeteria later?\"\n\n\"Sure!\"\n\nAs the door closed, Lumi returned to stare at the mirror, her gaze lingering on her reflection for a while. \n\nHaving just passed the Lollo Logistics assessment, she was still adjusting to city life. The city was a whirlwind compared to the quiet village she had left behind. The streets buzzed with life, day and night. Even in the dead of night, lights flickered, and voices filled the air. Walls and doors were everywhere, and restrictions at every corner. In Changzhuang, she could run free, straight through the open land for as long as she wanted. Here, every step had to be measured carefully. The crowded markets left her both energized and overwhelmed.\n\n\"Take it slow, Lumi,\" she murmured to herself. \"No rush. No rush…\"\n\nGrabbing her straw hat, Lumi took a deep breath and opened the door, ready to face the city once more."
    },
    {
      "title": "Through Waters and Mountains",
      "content": "\"Squeakie, I'm feeling dizzy…\" \n\nLumi murmured, leaning against the edge of the bed as the ship rocked beneath her. The waves crashed against the hull with a roar, and the violent turbulence made one feel like it might drag them into the depths. She clutched her hamster plushie tightly, closing her eyes, waiting for this torturous journey to end.\n\nDays later, the port finally came into view, where the sea met the sky. Seagulls squawked in the distance, and Lumi exhaled a breath of relief as she stepped onto solid ground. \"Thank goodness,\" she muttered. Her two companions, Tangtang and Fulei, staggered behind her, still pale from seasickness. \n\n\"You two okay?\" Lumi ran her fingers through her curls and led them to a nearby bench for rest.\n\n\"Lumi, was it this bad when you first came to <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>?\" Tangtang, his head still drooping, asked.\n\nLumi chuckled. \"Oh yeah! That's why I told you to stay fit. There are places way harder to reach than this.\"\n\nTangtang groaned, nodding. \"Why did you recover so quickly? You were just as seasick as us a moment ago...\"\n\nLumi grinned, remembering her first trip here with Chengxiao. \"Trust me, I was just as bad. My legs felt weak, I wanted to throw up, and I almost swore never to set foot on a ship again!\"\n\nFulei nodded in agreement, \"The ship did rock hard. It was terrifying…\"\n\nTangtang and Fulei were newbies who just joined <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> and were assigned to Lumi's team for training. Lollo Logistics had entrusted her with guiding them through the ropes, but leading a team? Lumi wasn't so sure she was ready for that kind of responsibility. It wasn't because she hated caring for others; she was just worried that she might not meet these hopeful newcomers' expectations. Chengxiao had always made it look easy—could she really do the same?\n \n\"Lumi,\" Tangtang said, interrupting her thoughts, \"You always talk about Chengxiao, but I've never seen her at the branch. Where is she?\"\n\n\"She doesn't work in the field anymore,\" Lumi replied softly.\n\n\"What? But didn't you say she was an 'Outstanding Navigator' every year? Why would she quit?\" Fulei asked, wide-eyed.\n\nLumi gazed up at the blue sky, the expanse above <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> remarkably clear. \n\n\"Because... of life,\" she explained, as she had once before in her childhood. \"Sometimes life leads you down different paths. Solaris is huge, and being in Lollo Logistics means traveling year-round. Chengxiao wanted something more stable, so she moved on.\"\n\nTangtang tilted her head. \"And what about you? Did your family mind you doing this?\"\n\n\"They had their concerns,\" Lumi admitted. \"But this is my life, and I love it—traveling, seeing new things, connecting people across <te href=850079>Solaris</te>. That's what Lollo Logistics is all about. Chengxiao taught me a lot, and I'll do my best to pass it on to you both.\"\n\nHer words hung in the air as the two newcomers considered them. \n\nLumi smiled. \"Life is full of comings and goings,\" she continued. \"Some people get off the ship, others get on. But as long as there are those willing to carry the torch, our 'We Promise, We Deliver' motto will keep going strong.\"\n\nLumi stood up and gave a good stretch. Squeakie perched on her shoulder, nuzzling her cheek. \"Rest for another ten minutes, then we're off. Oh, you want some famous Ragunna's triple scoop ice cream? My treat!\"\n\n\"Yes!\"\n\n\"Please!\""
    },
    {
      "title": "On the Road",
      "content": "Ever since its connection to the outside world resumed, Changzhuang had experienced a dramatic change. New buildings and amenities were everywhere, yet when Lumi returned home, she felt a deep wave of nostalgia.\n\nPerhaps those who longed for change had already departed, like Lumi once before, while those who remained had maintained their old habits and daily rhythms. The sun was dipping low, and as she walked through the village, smoke from cooking fires curled lazily into the sky, mingling with the sounds of laughter and the hum of evening insects.\n\nHer parents welcomed her home, placing a steaming bowl of noodles in front of her—the meat was generous, the broth rich, supplemented by a spoonful of fragrant chili oil. \n\nLumi dug in, the heat making her cheeks flush as she slurped the noodles eagerly. Her mother chuckled softly, passing her a glass of water.\n\n\"Slow down, Lumi, no one's going to steal your food,\" her mother teased.\n\nAfter a deep sip of water and broth, she leaned back, letting out a contented sigh.\n\nHer father, seated nearby, tapped his pipe. \"Been away for a long time, huh? How's your work?\"\n\nLumi smiled. \"It's been tough, but things are getting better. Someone really helped me out—a hero from <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, actually!\"\n\nHer mother raised an eyebrow, amused. \"Oh? Our little Lumi rubbing elbows with big shots now?\"\n\nLumi laughed, her eyes bright. \"It's true! I was struggling with some work stuff, but thanks to {Male=him;Female=her}, I turned it all around. Here's what happened…\"\n \nThe next morning, with the village still shrouded in the quiet calm of dawn, Lumi left home to enjoy the morning landscape of the fields. It hadn't changed beyond recognition. It still bore the vestiges of the place that had shaped her. \n\nShe wandered without aim, lost in thought until a gentle pat on the shoulder brought her back to the present.\n\n\"Lumi? What are you doing all the way out here?\"\n\nLumi blinked and turned to see Zhangzhang, her childhood friend, standing behind her, smiling.\n\n\"Oh, Zhangzhang! I was just… reminiscing. It's been a while.\" Lumi's gaze drifted to the newly paved road winding through the hills. \"I can't even tell where we are.\"\n\nZhangzhang laughed. \"Yeah, it just got finished recently—much smoother than before, huh? It was once your favorite place, you remember?\" She shifted her gaze to the road and continued, \"Not many people come through, though. But I hear your <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> team visits regularly.\" Zhangzhang paused, intrigued, \"Speaking of which, have you been to any cool places lately? Anything to share? You see, I've been thinking about leaving to see the world for myself as well…\"\n\nLumi nodded and began recounting her latest adventures, sharing the tales of distant cities and unknown lands with her childhood friend.\n\nWhen they parted ways, Lumi found a stone by the road and sat on it, propping her chin up as she gazed at the sky. She knew that she had to move forward—only then would she see new things, bring about change, and make a difference for others.\n\nAs night faded, the first light of morning washed over the slumbering mountains. \n\nThere in the distance, where the mountain path met the sky, the familiar silhouette of a Lollo Logistics vehicle, glimmering in the sun, was approaching Changzhuang."
    }
  ],

      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_dengdeng_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_dengdeng_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Squeakie, get 'em baddies!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_burst_burst_01.play_favor_word_dengdeng_burst_burst_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Squeakie, protect the cargo!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_burst_burst_02.play_favor_word_dengdeng_burst_burst_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Squeakie, clear the way!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_burst_burst_03.play_favor_word_dengdeng_burst_burst_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Together!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_skill_qte.play_favor_word_dengdeng_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Squeakie, watch out!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_behit_01.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_behit_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "It's breaking!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Time is ticking!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Cargo damaged!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Squeakie, run...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Navigation... failed...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_die_01.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Luminous no more...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_die_02.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Awesome!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_dengdeng_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Watch this!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_dengdeng_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Squeakie, alert!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_engage.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "The higher, the better!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Here it is!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_scan.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Woah, a great find!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Lucky me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Check this out, Squeakie!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_dengdeng_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Lollo Marker",
      "content": "Crafted by <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>, this pen has journeyed alongside Lumi throughout Solaris. She uses it to sign logistics documents and chronicle her adventures in her travel journal. \nIn her travels, Lumi has crossed paths with fascinating and kind-hearted strangers, savored local delicacies and quirky snacks, and documented bizarre <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> that remain uncharted... even the lighthearted anecdotes shared by her colleagues find their way into her travel journal, recorded with joy and enthusiasm.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure77_UI.T_Treasure77_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Navigator Baton",
      "content": "When Lumi first joined <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>, she faced challenges in mastering her Forte. \nUnder the guidance of a seasoned mentor, she fashioned this field command baton, which became her steadfast companion through her most anxious days. It witnessed her transformation from a trembling novice into a skilled navigator, and eventually, a trusted team leader. \nIn the dark of night, the baton's shimmering hue casts a reassuring glow, a symbol of Lumi's growth.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure74_UI.T_Treasure74_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Squeakie Plushie",
      "content": "A stress-relief squeeze plushie, designed by Lumi in the likeness of her beloved companion, Squeakie.\nAs life unfolds, Lumi faces many unexpected challenges. While she adeptly navigates her own challenges, the struggles of others can be quite a handful—each person's wishes and expectations are as varied as the packages she manages.\nWhile she's alone, Lumi sometimes squeezes the plushie tightly, letting the weight of her worries dissipate with each squeeze.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure73_UI.T_Treasure73_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Navigation Support",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Basic Attack</color></size>\nSummon Squeakie to shoot three shots in a row, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Sprint</color></size> \nDodge to perform <color=Highlight>Sprint</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Zoom Mode</color>. Lumi is unable to Dodge when performing <color=Highlight>Sprint</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Zoom</color></size>\nWhen in this state, automatically shoot <color=Highlight>Glitters</color> at a locked-on target and deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Plunging Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light: Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light: Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to strike the ground with Squeakie, causing an impact dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light: Plunging Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light: Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse Basic Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Sprint</color></size>\nUse Dodge to perform <color=Highlight>Sprint</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Zoom Mode</color>. Lumi is unable to Dodge when performing <color=Highlight>Sprint</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Zoom</color></size>\nWhen in this state, automatically shoot <color=Highlight>Glitters</color> on a locked-on target and deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Plunging Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light: Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light: Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light: Plunging Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light: Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.",

        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Pounce</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>, use Resonance Skill to perform Pounce, which consumes STA to pounce on the target before switching to <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>.\nLumi will perform a <color=Highlight>Pounce</color> without STA cost when switched onto the field.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Rebound</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>, use Resonance Skill to perform Rebound, which consumes STA to leap backward and attack the target before switching to <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light Mode</color></size>\nPerform ranged attacks when in Yellow Light Mode.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light Mode</color></size>\nPerform melee attacks when in Red Light Mode.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Pounce</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>, use Resonance Skill to perform Pounce, which consumes STA to pounce on the target before switching to <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>.\nLumi will <color=Highlight>Pounce</color> without STA cost when she is switched onto the field.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Rebound</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>, use Resonance Skill to perform Rebound, which consumes STA to backflip and attack the target before switching to <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light Mode</color></size>\nPerform ranged attacks when in Yellow Light Mode.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light Mode</color></size>\nPerform melee attacks when in Red Light Mode.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Signal Light",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Energized Pounce</color></size>\nWhen Yellow Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Pounce</color> that deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Red Light: Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Red Light: Heavy Attack</color> is increased, with an extra amount of Sparks recovered.\n<color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color> ends after performing altogether 4 Basic Attacks and/or Heavy Attacks.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Energized Rebound</color></size>\nWhen Red Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> that deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color>. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Glitter</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Glare</color>, with an increased DMG Multiplier and an extra amount of Sparks recovered.\n<color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color> ends after shooting 6 <color=Highlight>Glares</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Laser</color></size>\nCasting Outro Skill consumes all Sparks obtained in the current mode.\nLaser can be cast when the amount of consumed Sparks is greater than or equal to {0}, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.  The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. \nEvery {0} Sparks consumed generates {1} extra Laser beam, up to {2} Laser beams.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light Spark</color></size>\nLumi can hold up to {3} Yellow Light Sparks.\nLumi obtains Yellow Light Spark under the following conditions: \nWhen <color=Highlight>Yellow Light: Basic Attack</color> hits the target;\nWhen <color=Highlight>Glitter</color> hits the target;\nWhen <color=Highlight>Glare</color> hits the target;\nWhen Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> hits the target;\nWhen casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Special Delivery</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light Spark</color></size>\nLumi can hold up to {3} Red Light Sparks.\nLumi obtains Red Light Spark under the following conditions:\nWhen Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Navigation Support</color> hits the target in <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color> or <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>.",
        "param": [
          "25",
          "1",
          "4",
          "100"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Energized Pounce</color></size>\nWhen Yellow Light Spark is full, Resonance Skill becomes <color=Highlight>Energized Pounce</color> which deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, and Lumi enters <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color> (the evolved version of <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>).\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Energized Rebound</color></size>\nWhen Red Light Spark is full, Resonance Skill becomes <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> which deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, and Lumi enters <color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color> (the evolved version of <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>).\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Laser</color></size>\nCasting Outro Skill consumes all Sparks gained in the current mode.\nLaser can be cast when the amount of Sparks consumed is greater than or equal to {0}, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. Consuming more Sparks generates more Laser beams.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light Spark</color></size>\nLumi can hold up to {3} Sparks.\nLumi gains Yellow Light Spark when <color=Highlight>Yellow Light: Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Glitter</color>, <color=Highlight>Glare</color>, or <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> hits the target.\nLumi gains Yellow Light Spark when casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Red Light Spark</color></size>\nLumi can hold up to {3} Sparks.\nLumi gains Red Light Spark when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> hits the target in <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color> or <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>.",
        "simple_param": [
          "25",
          "1",
          "4",
          "100"
        ],
