  "name": "Shorekeeper",
  "nick_name": "Shorekeeper",
  "desc": "The Shorekeeper, guardian of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>—this title alone once defined her. \nBut desires, bonds, and emotions… She only began to understand these things after meeting you.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_28_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_28_UI",
  "background": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRolePile/T_IconRole_Pile_shouanren_UI.T_IconRole_Pile_shouanren_UI",
  "background_stand": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/RoleHalfBody/T_ActivityHalfBodyShouanren.T_ActivityHalfBodyShouanren",
  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "February 27",
    "sex": "Female",
    "country": "The Black Shores",
    "influence": "The Black Shores",
    "info": "The Shorekeeper, guardian of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>—this title alone once defined her. \nBut desires, bonds, and emotions… She only began to understand these things after meeting you.",
    "talent_name": "Euphonic Chrysalis",
    "talent_doc": "[Extracted Archive Record - A.A1001]  \nSubject: Second Instance  \nRecorder: ▇▇▇▇  \nRecord Segment: A.A-000  \n\nThe Second Instance (also known as the Shorekeeper) is composed entirely of high-purity <te href=850076>Remnant Energy</te> crystals. Its successful activation confirms the viability of ▇▇▇▇'s theory, which proposes the following:  \na. By modeling the \"Blazar\" module anchor, Remnant Energy can be attracted and condensed, resulting in the materialization of energy.  \nb. Pre-loading informational data into the energy entity grants it cognitive abilities.\n\nUnlike conventional resonance logic, the Second Instance (the Shorekeeper) can directly utilize Remnant Energy. When activated, the crystal-like marks on her chest emit a faint blue glow. Her frequency aligns with pure Remnant Energy but is affected by the selected module settings. Her ability cycle resembles stellar evolution. This is visually represented through phenomena such as butterfly-like nebula and domains that resemble star charts.\n\n▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇  \n<i>The subsequent status of the Second Instance will continue to be monitored by ▇▇.</i>",
    "talent_certification": "[Extracted Archive Record - A.A1001]  \nSubject: Second Instance  \nRecorder: ▇▇▇▇  \nRecord Segment: A.A-311  \n\nThe ▇▇▇ test results for the Shorekeeper are generally within controllable parameters. However, the <te href=850076>Remnant Energy</te> within her has shown signs of dissipation multiple times, leading to excessive energy loss and crystal fragmentation. This may be attributed to the processing of <te href=850075>Lament</te> data via massive computation. Notably, the Shorekeeper has detected these issues and has attempted to mitigate the damage by replacing her damaged parts with new energy crystals. The string-like wave marks on her shoulders and calves are likely scars from this healing process.\n\n<i>The possibility of this issue recurring cannot be ruled out, which may require increased monitoring and more frequent replacement of the energy crystals.</i>\n<i>If the ▇▇▇ test results exceed controllable limits, alternative contingency plans may need to be implemented.</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Tang YaJing",
    "cv_name_jp": "Suwa Ayaka",
    "cv_name_ko": "Kim Bo Na",
    "cv_name_en": "Stephanie McKeon"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "The Shorekeeper's Birth",
      "content": "<i>After the drumbeat, we call the heart dancing in the darkness the moon. This moon is largely formed by you.</i>\n \nSome lives are born by chance. Others are created with intent.\n \nAs the world edged toward its frozen end, those destined to face the final moment placed their hopes in a certain individual. They blessed {Male=him;Female=her}, wishing {Male=he;Female=she} would lead them to a brighter tomorrow. Yet this lonely odyssey required a timeless vessel to complete the Reverberations, and the best they could offer was an enduring tool. Thus, the Shorekeeper was born—a deliberate creation, a light blue crystal cocoon of <te href=850076>Remnant Energy</te> gathered from the Anchor.\n \nThe Shorekeeper knew what needed to be done long before she understood how. But a tool needs a guide. She waited aimlessly in the void until, as the sea surged to its edge, she sensed a heartbeat drawing near in the briny sea breeze.\n \nIn the stillness of the night, the Astral <te href=850111>Modulator</te> surveyed the land as the <te href=850075>Lament</te>'s roars faded into the distance, leaving only {Male=his;Female=her} steady heartbeat.\n \n\"Perhaps the underground needs a sky as brilliant as the one above...\" the Modulator mused, planning the future. As {Male=he;Female=she} reached out to activate the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System, an enigmatic allure from a blue crystal beckoned {Male=him;Female=her} closer. The meeting of their frequencies triggered a resonance that shattered the crystal, releasing a surge of energy that burst forth like a nebula or a butterfly emerging from its chrysalis.\n \nThe energy swirled and coalesced, taking the form of a young woman, who greeted the one who had awakened her.\n \n\"I am the Shorekeeper, a tool created for you.\"\n \n\"I will fulfill your needs and carry out your commands. I will assist you and Tethys in analyzing the origin of the Lament.\"\n \nHer voice, steady and devoid of emotion, awaited a command that did not come.\n \n\"Shorekeeper… to protect secrets and guard the shores. It's straightforward, but it hardly sounds like a name.\"\n \n\"A tool does not require a name—it is merely a title and will not affect my ability to perform.\"\n \nThey stood in silence, the Astral Modulator's golden eyes reflecting an emotion the Shorekeeper could not yet comprehend.\n \nFinally, the Astral Modulator sighed softly.\n \n\"Well, we will have plenty of time to talk about that.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Beyond the Value of Life",
      "content": "<i>The dreamer of the day glimpsed the sun in the night.</i>\n \nBefore being confined underground as the core of Tethys, the Shorekeeper once traveled beyond <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>.\n \nAt that time, civilization was steadily advancing. The Astral <te href=850111>Modulator</te> had established an organization called the Black Shores, recruiting new members selected by Tethys. Meanwhile, the Shorekeeper focused on recreating and analyzing the Reverberations they brought back, completing her calculations.\n \nLike an omniscient observer, the Shorekeeper could trace data to monitor any human's behavior at any time in her recreated <te href=850077>Sonoros</te>. She attempted to categorize and interpret humans like any other phenomenon, but quickly found herself perplexed by them. \n \nWhy do they cry in both joy and sorrow? Why do their actions so often contradict their desires? Why pursue something they know they'll regret, or persist in the impossible? How can they so easily harm others, yet sacrifice themselves without hesitation? Every time the Shorekeeper thought she was closer to understanding, an unexpected event would overturn her conclusions. Though confused, she wondered if this confusion even mattered—after all, it didn't stop her from completing her tasks. But then, the Astral Modulator gave her a mission: signs of an impending <te href=850075>Lament</te> had appeared, which required field research to gather data for analysis. They would go together and... see what more could be done.\n \nThe Shorekeeper followed the Modulator through the farmland of that region. It was harvest season—the soil underfoot was soft yet firm, the hanging heads of grain full and ripe, and the wind carried the sweet scent of rice. She understood these things, yet seeing them firsthand felt different. Lost in these unfamiliar sensations, the Shorekeeper was unaware that her expression mirrored the curiosity and wonder of a child stepping out of their home for the first time. The Modulator chatted warmly with the locals, their conversations filled with dialects and the hum of everyday life. A kind old woman offered them homemade food. Her skin was rough, while the baby she held had warm, sweaty fingers.\n \nBut just as <te href=850110>Tethys</te> predicted, the omens soon became reality, shattering the fleeting peace.\n \nThe once-friendly people fell into despair—fighting over resources, crying out in anguish, their faces twisted with desperation and fear. For the first time, the Shorekeeper witnessed the Lament herself, not through Sonoros, but in its raw, overwhelming reality.\n \nWhat surprised her even more was the Modulator. {Male=He;Female=She} led all the Resonators in resisting the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, encouraging everyone to hold on until reinforcements arrived. {Male=He;Female=She} was trying to alter a predetermined future, but why go to such lengths for a group of strangers? The Shorekeeper recalled the Tethys System's instructions:\n \n\"A future that has been altered is destined to be altered. Attempting to change predetermined outcomes should be avoided.\"\n \n\"I can't just stand by and do nothing. If this is the cost of reaching tomorrow, I question whether such a tomorrow is worth it.\" The golden-eyed Modulator's voice was firm.\n \n\"…Unable to process. But I will prioritize your needs,\" the Shorekeeper responded, as she expanded the Stellarealm to heal and protect.\n \nNight fell, and reinforcements finally arrived. Just as they prepared to leave, a child who had lost his parents blocked their path.\n \n\"W-wait, where are you going? I want to go with you… to fight those monsters!\"\n \nSeeing the child's bright eyes, the Modulator crouched down and pointed to the Blake Bloom on {Male=his;Female=her} attire.\n \n\"What we're about to do is too dangerous for you. But if you still want to join us when you grow up, look for someone wearing this flower.\"\n \nAs the ship sailed away, the Shorekeeper watched the child waving from the dock. Humans still perplexed her, but this time, she tried to express her confusion to the one beside her.\n \n\"Tethys didn't predict this. That child isn't a candidate we need.\"\n \n\"Not everything requires Tethys's command. Humans aren't bound by such restrictions. He may not be needed now, but in time… he'll find his own path.\"\n \n\"The freedom to choose is far more important than any answer. That's something I want to show you.\"\n \n\"I want you to see and experience these things for yourself. We aren't data or abstract concepts stored in records—you can think of us as companions.\"\n \n\"Companions…\" The Shorekeeper repeated the word, pondering its meaning. What the Modulator had said wasn't an order, nor was it an answer. Yet from that moment on, a subtle, hidden anticipation began to stir within her.\n \n\"Humans are truly complex beings… I don't yet understand them, but I hope, one day, I will.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Beyond the Endless Waiting",
      "content": "<i>Mourn not at my resting place; I am neither there nor gone.</i>\n \nWhen the robots mentioned the name \"Delone,\" the Shorekeeper immediately recalled all that was tied to it. This wasn't just due to her natural ability to store and record information, but because Delone was special—she was one of the few who sought out <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> herself.\n \nThe first time the Shorekeeper met her, Delone was a spirited girl, brimming with enthusiasm. She had complained about how hard it was to find the Black Shores, then raised her eyebrows with a hint of pride. \"I knew it! Others must be gathering to fight against the <te href=850075>Laments</te> and prevent further anomalies!\"\n \nAt that time, the Astral <te href=850111>Modulator</te>, who once held the highest authority in the Black Shores, had not yet been absent for long, and the Shorekeeper was still able to visit the surface. When the eager girl had grabbed her hand, her determination to join the Black Shores palpable, the Shorekeeper had been unsure how to respond. She felt the girl's warm hand—hot, just like the fire in her eyes.\n \nThe Shorekeeper granted Delone eligibility to sit for the entrance exam, despite it deviating from <te href=850110>Tethys</te>'s recruitment protocols. The Shorekeeper remembered what the Modulator had once said to her, \"Humans aren't bound by such restrictions… We aren't data or abstract concepts stored in records.\" The Shorekeeper believed the Modulator would probably have acted similarly, just to preserve the girl's burning enthusiasm. In the end, Delone passed the exam and became an official member of the Black Shores.\n \nThe Shorekeeper never imagined that they would meet again under such tragic circumstances.\n \nMore than a decade had passed, and the once fiery girl had matured into a composed woman. But now, she was reaching out to the Shorekeeper with a trembling hand, life sweeping away from a grievous wound. The Shorekeeper saw it clearly. Delone's life was fading away, and there was only one possible outcome.\n \n\"I did it,\" Delone said with a weak smile. \"I took down eight <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> in one go during the Lament. But Twala... they weren't so lucky. I was the only one left to bring the data back.\"\n \nThe time for farewell was drawing near. The other members, unaware of the Shorekeeper's true identity, assumed she was a close friend of Delone and gave them space for a final moment together.\n \n\"So much time has passed... I'm... I'm so old now... but you're just the same as before.\"\n \n\"Did I do well? I didn't disappoint you, did I?\" Delone's voice wavered with weakness, but her eyes still shone as brightly as they did when they first met. What would the Modulator have done? The Shorekeeper didn't know—there was no clear answer, no example to follow. But looking into those eyes, she felt something heavy in her chest, an indescribable emotion surging within her. It compelled her to break protocol once again, just as she had done all those years ago.\n \n\"You've done well. Very well.\"\n \nThe Shorekeeper answered, and this time, she held Delone's hand. Somehow, she knew this gesture might bring comfort to her, just as it had so many years ago.\n \n\"Thank you... Thank you, Shorekeeper,\" Delone whispered, deep relief in her voice. Then, she murmured, \"The stars... they're so bright. Will I become one of them... after this? There's so much I won't be able to see, but you will... they will...\"\n \nA tear fell from her eye, taking with it her last warmth.\n \nJust as Delone had said, the Shorekeeper transformed the frequencies of the departed into a \"star,\" leaving them within the constellations of data. She couldn't remember when she had started doing this. Time had withered the Blake Blooms and eroded the Black Shores—it had also taken the lives of those who deserved to be remembered. The ever-shining stars in the sky had become the only resting place for these fallen souls.\n \nUnder the starlit sky, the Shorekeeper stood on the shores, bathed in their glow, and gazed across the sea. Had the Modulator been right to entrust her with such authority? Had she done enough to look after the Black Shores as instructed? The answers to these questions lay with the one who had left... All that remained for her was the seemingly endless wait. And so, she waited, for time was the one thing she had in abundance."
    },
    {
      "title": "From the Beginning Till Now",
      "content": "<i>I offer you the kernel of myself that I have carefully preserved—a core untouched by words, untraded in dreams, and beyond the reach of time, joy, and adversity.</i>\n \nDisaster relief alone was not enough to save those who suffered. Rather than passively collecting data after each <te href=850075>Lament</te>, the <te href=850111>Modulator</te> sought to prevent its very occurrence. {Male=He;Female=She} led the Shorekeeper and the other members in issuing warnings and taking preventive measures, despite meeting little success.\n \nTo break free from the Möbius loop and create a new reality, the Modulator proposed a daring plan.\n \nThe time for farewell drew near.\n \nThe Modulator decided to erase all memories and travel beyond the Black Shores in search of a viable solution. Those who had walked in the Modulator's footsteps naturally chose to follow {Male=him;Female=her} again.\n \nOnly the Shorekeeper remained.\n \nIt was necessary because some things could only be done by the one who remained. The future pursued by the Black Shores opposed <te href=850110>Tethys</te>'s logic of using the Lament as a tool against itself, and a core was needed to assist with translation and computation. The Shorekeeper, who had accepted the Modulator's transferred authority, was the most suitable for this role.\n \nEveryone made their choice, and so did the Shorekeeper. As a being of energy, she decided to serve as the vessel through which all Reverberation data flowed, passing through her core into Tethys. With each analysis, each recreation, and each trace, she was no longer a bystander but someone experiencing the same disasters as those recorded in the data.\n \nGrief. Resistance. Exhaustion. Decay.\n \nBirds died in panic, their hollow eyes fixed on the earth.\n \nSuffering. Chaos. Loss. Extinction.\n \nScattered flowers were crushed to dust. Stiffened hands remained frozen in desperate grasping.\n \nFear. Loathing. Anger. Resentment.\n \nCracks spidered through her body, the sound of shattering echoing continuously within.\n \nAgony? Agony... Agony, agony!\n \nAll that had happened, was happening, and could happen, converged within her. Her light dimmed, her form losing its completeness. She could feel her body fracturing, falling apart piece by piece.\n \n\"It doesn't matter. A tool breaks, that's normal. The only distinction is whether it can still be used or not. I am just a collection of energy—once spent, another will take my place. There can always be another Shorekeeper.\"\n \nIt doesn't matter.\n \n\"Just like those predetermined choices, you too are part of the Möbius loop. The Modulator may not be aware, but you have always known, haven't you? This is the end they set for you when they gave you this mission.\"\n \nBut... why this yearning?\n \nIs this... yearning?\n \n\"I noticed your change after your first field mission.\"\n \n\"You no longer accepted everything Tethys told you. You felt confused and learned to voice that confusion.\"\n \n\"I rarely gave you direct answers to your questions. As I said, I wanted you to find your own answers. But this question is different. Before we... part ways, I want to share my thoughts with you.\"\n \n\"What does this shore mean? As the leader, I should probably say something inspiring now. But what I truly want is for this shore to be a home for every member of the Black Shores.\"\n \n\"This is where it all begins, and we are each other's companions. Now and always.\"\n \nSo... how could it not matter?\n \nThe one you awakened under the stars was me.\n \nThe one who took this form by your power was me.\n \nThe one who walked with you through the countryside was me.\n \nThe one you told to seek their own answers was me.\n \nThe one who keeps secrets, guards the shore, sustains this coast, and waits for your return is me.\n \nNot any other entity of energy, not any other being, but me.\n \nThe binding loop halted. She broke free from the sea of data that threatened to drown everything, gasping for breath. She didn't want to lose those things, didn't want to stay here, didn't want to disappear like this, because—because—\n \nI am the Shorekeeper.\n \nI am the Shorekeeper who was born because of you.\n \nI am the Shorekeeper you called a companion.\n \nI am the Shorekeeper who has been shaped by all these experiences, memories, and emotions.\n \nI am... the one and only Shorekeeper because of you."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Shorekeeper's Rebirth",
      "content": "<i>You are like the night, with its silence and stars.</i>\n \nThe long wait finally ended with the <te href=850111>Modulator</te>'s return. As promised, {Male=he;Female=she} found {Male=his;Female=her} way back to the Black Shores. Though {Male=he;Female=she} had lost {Male=his;Female=her} memories, {Male=his;Female=her} choices remained unchanged—together, they corrected <te href=850110>Tethys</te>'s errors and restored peace to the souls trapped within the <te href=850141>Necrostar</te>.\n \nYet, amidst the celebration, the Shorekeeper felt something more than just pure joy—there was an undercurrent of uncertainty. The paths that had been laid out by Tethys, by the Modulator, and even by herself, had reached their end. Where should she go next? As the other members reveled in their success, she quietly withdrew to the familiar shore.\n \nThe Shorekeeper wandered along the shoreline as she did so often before. This habit had formed while she waited for the Modulator's return. Sleep held little meaning for her. Instead, she preferred to stay awake, observing the shore and remembering all that time had etched into it. After all, someone needed to keep the memories alive for when the Modulator returned.\n \nTonight's walk felt much like all the others. Time in the underground seemed frozen, and the familiar stars above unchanged. As the path before her stretched on and the waves lapped gently at her feet, she reached toward the unseen horizon. Though she felt as if she were once again in a state of waiting, unsure of what to do next, she knew deep down that something had shifted.\n \nThe freedom to choose was finally and truly hers. She belonged in this world and shared it with that one person.\n \n\"Fill it with all that you desire.\" \n\"Fill it.\" \n\"Fill it.\" \n\"Fill it.\"\n \nThe stars she once guided seemed to whisper to her, their silent glow urging her to step forward into the new beginning that awaited her.\n \nFootsteps drew near, and the one who had walked with her from the very beginning appeared, ever attuned to her slightest emotions. This time, it was she who decided to break the silence first.\n \n\"My name... You once said we would have plenty of time to discuss it.\"\n \n\"So, have you decided?\"\n \n\"Shorekeeper, that's my name. Not because I guard secrets or the shore itself, but because I'm the one who watches over the roving star.\"\n \nShe paused and smiled gently.\n \n\"It represents all of me, past to present. In the future... I hope that in our story, I can be the shore where you find rest.\"\n \n\"And...\" she continued, with a rare hint of playfulness, \"those melodies we played together—I've composed a piece from them.\"\n \n\"I've given it a name... The next time I play it for you, you'll know.\""
    }

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_skill01_sp_01.play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_skill01_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "I am here for you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_skill01_sp_02.play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_skill01_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "In war with Time.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "I engraft you new.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Astral modulation.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: IV",
      "content": "Oath from the heart.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst02_01.play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: V",
      "content": "Vow from the soul.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst02_02.play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VI",
      "content": "Ordained.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst02_03.play_favor_word_shouanren_burst_burst02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Leave it to me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_qte.play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "I'm fine.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "The feeling of... pain.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Physical damage detected.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Durability lowered.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Do not impede.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "This is... not the end...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_die_01.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Shed no tear for me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_die_02.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Durability... depleted.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_die_03.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Loading.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Transformed.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_shouanren_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "At your disposal.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_engage.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "The wind rises.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Manifest.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_scan.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Is there anything of interest?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Echoes of the past.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_shouanren_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_shouanren_com_openbox_03"
    }

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Shattered Dim Star",
      "content": "A shattered crystal fell from the Shorekeeper's body, dimming as its energy waned.\n \nThe stars lit the path ahead as the tide of calamities ebbed. Steadfast in her duty, the Shorekeeper used herself as a medium, while the relentless occurrences of the <te href=850075>Lament</te> threatened to tear her apart. Energy crystals dimmed and detached, leaving cracks across her body, only to be replaced by new ones she forged from <te href=850076>Remnants</te>.\n \nThough parts of her were lost, the Shorekeeper endured, like the Ship of Theseus—a vessel of change, each fragment a record of her past and the essence of who she is today.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure70_UI.T_Treasure70_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Hourglass of Cycle",
      "content": "Stars flicker in the eternal night beneath <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, where time flows without the rhythm of seasons. In this place untouched by time, Rover created a self-sustaining hourglass for the Shorekeeper.\n\nAn energy substance flows endlessly between its twin chambers, completing a cycle every 42 days. This number, both finite and boundless, marks the time the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System requires for a full simulation and deduction cycle—from bloom to doom. During this 42-day interval set by Rover, the Shorekeeper finds brief yet comforting solace in her lifelong vigil as she waits for the day she's reunited with her one and only.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure71_UI.T_Treasure71_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"We Are One\"",
      "content": "A record crafted from a substance infused with <te href=850076>Remnant Energy</te>, possessing near-infinite storage. \n \nIt holds every sound the Shorekeeper has ever gathered from this planet—storm and wind, the cries of birds, the songs of whales. It captures music spanning countless eras and vowel whispers from over 50 languages... Each sound is a testament to the marvel of existence, a trace of life, science, and the civilizations that once thrived.\n \nThe Shorekeeper preserved her duet with Rover at the end of this record. To her, this melody is proof of their existence. As long as the record endures and the sounds of this planet continue, the contents of this record will forever grow.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure72_UI.T_Treasure72_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Origin Calculus",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Each hit generates 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850022>Collapsed Core</te></color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nHold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Unbound Form</color>, which consumes STA continuously. While in this form, Shorekeeper will:\n- Generate a segment of <color=Highlight>Deductive Data</color> every second;\n- Automatically collect nearby plant collectibles.\nUsing up all STA or actions such as casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> will end the <color=Highlight>Unbound Form</color> and deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to the target. Each accumulated segment of <color=Highlight>Deductive Data</color> will convert into a segment of Empirical Data and generate a <color=Highlight><te href=850022>Collapsed Core</te></color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack. Each hit generates 1 <color=Highlight>Collapsed Core</color>. Quickly Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> after the Plunging Attack to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nPress the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> after a successful Dodge to attack a target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Each hit generates 1 <color=Highlight>Collapsed Core</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nContinuously consume STA to enter <color=Highlight>Unbound Form</color>. In this form, Shorekeeper will:\n- Generate a segment of <color=Highlight>Deductive Data</color> every second;\n- Automatically collect nearby plant collectibles.\n- Using up all STA or actions such as casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> will end <color=Highlight>Unbound Form</color> and deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to the target. Each accumulated segment of <color=Highlight>Deductive Data</color> will convert into a segment of Empirical Data and generate a <color=Highlight>Collapsed Core</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, generating 1 <color=Highlight>Collapsed Core</color> on hit. Quickly follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Astral Chord",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Flare Star Butterfly</color></size>\nHitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a <color=Highlight>Collapsed Core</color>, which transforms into a <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterfly</color> after {0}s. <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterflies</color> automatically track and attack a target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. If there are already {1} <color=Highlight>Collapsed Cores</color>, Shorekeeper's next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> hit will instantly convert a <color=Highlight>Collapsed Core</color> into a <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterfly</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Illation</color></size>\nWhen Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will consume all segments to pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Meanwhile, all generated <color=Highlight>Collapsed Cores</color> will instantly transform into <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterflies</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Transmutation</color></size>\nWhen Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> will consume all segments to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Meanwhile, all generated <color=Highlight>Collapsed Cores</color> will instantly transform into <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterflies</color>. Quickly press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> afterward to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Empirical Data</color></size>\nShorekeeper can hold up to 5 segments of Empirical Data.\n- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, or 4</color> hits a target.\n- Obtain 2 segments of Empirical Data when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> hits a target.\n- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> hits a target.\n- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> hits a target.",
        "param": [
          "6",
          "5"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Flare Star Butterfly</color></size>\nHitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a <color=Highlight>Collapsed Core</color>, which transforms into a <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterfly</color> after {0}s. <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterflies</color> automatically track and attack a target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. If there are {1} on-field <color=Highlight>Collapsed Cores</color>, Shorekeeper's next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> will instantly convert a <color=Highlight>Collapsed Core</color> into a <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterfly</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Illation</color></size>\nWhen Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will consume all segments to pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Meanwhile, all generated <color=Highlight>Collapsed Cores</color> will instantly transform into <color=Highlight>Flare Star Butterflies</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Transmutation</color></size>\nWhen Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> will consume all segments to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.   "name": "Phoebe",
  "nick_name": "Phoebe",
  "desc": "Phoebe, <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> of the <te href=850099>Order of the Deep</te>, is a young woman of quiet devotion. With a kind heart, she fulfills her duties with unwavering diligence. Her prayers, like the light she carries, offer comfort and peace to all.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_45_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_45_UI",
  "background": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRolePile/T_IconRole_Pile_Feibi_UI.T_IconRole_Pile_Feibi_UI",
  "background_stand": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/RoleHalfBody/T_ActivityRoleOntrialHalfBodyFeibi.T_ActivityRoleOntrialHalfBodyFeibi",
  "chara_info": {
    "birth": "Unknown",
    "sex": "Female",
    "country": "Rinascita",
    "influence": "Order of the Deep",
    "info": "Phoebe, <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> of the <te href=850099>Order of the Deep</te>, is a young woman of quiet devotion. With a kind heart, she fulfills her duties with unwavering diligence. Her prayers, like the light she carries, offer comfort and peace to all.",
    "talent_name": "Graceful Luminescence",
    "talent_doc": "[Excerpt of Letter of Recommendation from the Order Orphanage]\n\nThe moment I saw the glowing <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> on her upper left thigh, I knew immediately that this was a blessing from <te href=850105>Imperator</te>.\n\n...Her Resonance Ability allowed her to manifest light, refracting it into various forms of prisms. Even on the darkest nights, when the storm has snuffed out all other light, she fills every room with a soft, radiant glow. A light so comforting it conveys the very essence of hope in the darkest of times. As written in the <i>Tenets of the Deep</i>, such light must have always existed in her heart, a sign of her relentless devotion...\n\n*This record has been transferred from the Orphanage to the <te href=850099>Order of the Deep</te>'s archives.\n \n<i>We have reason to believe that <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> Initiate Phoebe's unparalleled Resonance ability stems from her unwavering faith in the Divinity. \n\nThis is demonstrated by the rapport between her and the <ano=Divine Envoys><te href=850082>Echoes</te></ano>, a connection that has reinforced the trust some of our faithful have in her. Her active involvement in charitable works has already earned her recognition, therefore we have voted unanimously to grant her the title of Acolyte after her novitiate.\n \nHowever, some within the Order believe that her closeness with the Echoes violates the Order's doctrines. The blessings of the Divine Envoys are to be shared equitably, as the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s love for Their people is impartial and untainted by favoritism. Being too close to the Divine Envoys could lead to unforeseen risks. For this reason, we do not recommend her appointment to the Servitude Hall, and believe it would be most prudent to transfer her to the Ministry of Holy Rituals instead...</i>",
    "talent_certification": "[<te href=850099>Order of the Deep</te> - Ministry of Holy Rituals Records] \n\nResonator Phoebe's waveform graph displays elliptical fluctuations. The Time Domain pattern is stable, and no signs of abnormal fluctuations are observed. The test results fall within the normal phase range.\n\nResonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Phoebe's frequency displays high stability with a low risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>.\n\nRecords show no history of Overclocking. \n\n<i><te href=850100>Acolyte</te> Phoebe has always strictly adhered to the teachings of \"silence\" and \"self-restraint,\" making her stability unmatched among her peers. Observations show that Acolyte Phoebe's Resonance ability produces a stable frequency, strongly affecting Echoes and <te href=850076>Remnant</te> Creatures. Humans can also be affected to a certain degree, experiencing \"healing\" on a spiritual level. This makes her particularly adept in roles that require soothing and mediation.</i>\n\n*Latest Notes: A brief sawtooth fluctuation was detected in Acolyte Phoebe's regular waveform. No abnormalities have been noted at this time, but continued monitoring is advised, with increased attention if necessary.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Fu Tingyun",
    "cv_name_jp": "Hondo Kaede",
    "cv_name_ko": "Lee Bo Yong",
    "cv_name_en": "Rebecca LaChance"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "A Day in the Life of an Acolyte",
      "content": "On an ordinary afternoon, the wide streets of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> bustled with people, more lively than in previous years.\n\nThe long-anticipated <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> was set to return, news that had already spread throughout Ragunna and even across the seas to distant shores. Over the past few days, travelers from all corners had appeared in the city. Even before dinner time, Trattoria Margherita was already packed with eager diners.\n\nRagunna's fine wines were as captivating as its breathtaking views. Nectarwine had the power to lull someone into a sweet dream, though overindulgence occasionally led to incidents.\n\nWhat started as a small disagreement over taste soon escalated into a heated debate. Perhaps it was the weariness of restraint, or perhaps the sleepy afternoon simply needed a bit of excitement. Either way, more and more people gathered, joining the argument.\n\nThe debate grew fiercer and, in the end, exploded into a full-blown fistfight.\n\nFor a moment, the restaurant became a stage. Pizzas and desserts flew through the air, seafood leaped from plates and landed on the faces of passersby, and onlookers scrambled to hide, though many couldn't help but peek back to watch the chaos unfold. \n\n\"Everyone! Oh, don't do that! You'll shatter the plates! Put down your cutlery, it's dangerous, you hear?\" The owner cried out, her tail puffed up as she jumped up and down, waving a pizza paddle. Still, she was too afraid to get too close to the commotion.\n\nJust then, a small figure darted from the crowd.\n\n\"Please, calm down!\"\n\nWith a staff in hand, the little figure traced a wide arc through the air. A golden bird descended from the sky, seemingly carrying the weight of the heavens. It barely touched the two enraged men on their foreheads, like a dragonfly skimming the surface of a pond.\n\nThe two men, who had been at each other's throats just moments ago, instantly calmed and fell face-first onto the table with smiles, snoring softly.\n \n\"Don't worry, they've just fallen asleep,\" said the petite blonde <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> as she tucked away her staff, \"However, disturbing public order is a violation of Order regulations. Those who disturb the peace must face appropriate punishment.\"\n\n\"Temperance is a virtue granted to us by the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. It makes both food and Nectarwine all the more delicious... I hope this little incident hasn't ruined anyone's enjoyment of their time here in Ragunna.\"\n\nThe Acolyte's smile was gentle and warm as the silence around her stretched on.\n \nBy the time more Acolytes arrived with La Guardia in tow, the commotion had already ended.\n\n\"Yes, yes, I saw it with my own eyes! She knocked out those two big guys with just one tap of her staff! Then, out of nowhere, a huge Plushie Echo appeared and carried them off! She looked young, but you can't judge a book by its cover...\"\n\nA diner, who had stayed behind to help clean up the aftermath, described the scene with no small amount of enthusiasm.\n\nThe lead Acolyte pulled out his Terminal to file a report, only to find that one had already been sent to the Order, detailing the incident and the whereabouts of the two who had been taken away.\n\n\"So... does that mean it's all taken care of?\"\n\n\"Of course.\" The Acolyte put away his Terminal with certainty.\n\n\"Leave it to Acolyte Phoebe. She knows how to handle these things better than anyone.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Home",
      "content": "<i>Dear Mr. Claremont,\n\nI apologize for the delay in reaching out. I have been caught up with an overwhelming number of matters. It is with a heavy heart that I must bring you this tragic news: Our business partner, the Marinos, were attacked by <te href=850081>TDs</te> during their journey to the New Federation. Unfortunately, they did not survive. May the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> guide their spirits to peace.\n\nRegarding payment for the sunken cargo, as per our previous agreement, I have begun liquidating the remaining assets of the Marino family. It is a most reluctant measure. You and I both know how much we invested in that deal. Now, with nothing left to sustain it, I am left only with the task of trying to fill the void in the best way I can.\n\nYou must remember Phoebe. The poor girl has lost her parents. She has nowhere to go, and as I am often away on business, I am unable to care for her as she deserves. I was told that you have a close relationship with a distant relative of the Marinos, and I pray you might consider offering her a home...</i>\n \nI folded the letter carefully, checked the address once more, and knocked again.\n\nThe repeated knocking had already drawn curious glances from the neighbors, but there was no response from within. The little girl stood quietly behind me, her head bowed, as if accustomed to such situations.\n\n\"They went on a holiday a while back,\" a passing neighbor mentioned casually. \"Might not be back for quite a while.\"\n\n\"I see, thank you. Come on, Phoebe.\"\n\nAs we turned to leave, I caught a glimpse of the curtain fluttering in the side window. I tightened my grip on Phoebe's hand, leading her away from the ostentatious neighborhood.\n\n<te href=850097>Ragunna</te> City was large, yet finding a home here was no easy task. I had lost count of how many doors I had knocked on, and how many times I had been turned away.\n\nAfter years of working in an orphanage, I had grown accustomed to all sorts of refusals, but I couldn't bear for Phoebe to experience this. She was still so young. What she needed was a warm, stable home, somewhere to heal in peace.\n\n\"We're deeply sorry... You have our sympathy for the girl's misfortune, but you understand adopting a child is more than just adding another plate to the table... Here, this is the least we can give. We wish you the best of luck.\"\n\n\"A letter? Ahem... I don't recall receiving any letter of this kind. Besides, didn't she already find a home at the orphanage? It's a fine place for children to live with others their age.\"\n\n\"...I've heard that the Marinos still haven't paid off their debts. We'd rather not have creditors knocking on our door. Please understand.\"\n\n...\n\n\"Don't be sad, Sister Isabella.\"\n\nAn ice cream was suddenly held out before me. A group of little <te href=850082>Echoes</te> had appeared around me unnoticed, each holding out ice creams and sweets meant for tourists. They were crowded around me, or rather, around Phoebe.\n\n\"I know the grown-ups are busy, just like Mother and Father were. They always came home so late.\"\n\nI stared blankly at the melting ice cream, caught off guard by the fact that this tiny child was offering comfort to <i>me</i>.\n\nThe Marino family, in their kindness, had helped the orphanage survive the worst of the Dark Tide. Yet here I stood, unable to find a proper home for their daughter. She should have been smiling in her parents' embrace, living a peaceful and happy life without worry.\n\n\"It's okay, I can... live with everyone else. I'm happy being with everyone.\"\n\nWhen I remained silent for a long while, the young girl looked up at me and gave me a quiet, almost soothing smile. My heart trembled.\n\n\"Everyone will stay together, right? Sister Isabella? The <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> tell us the Sentinel is always with us, keeping us together so we will never be apart.\"\n\nShe recited the words with such certainty. In the end, I could only swallow the lump in my throat, hold back my tears, and pull her close.\n\n\"All right... then let's go back. Let's go back home.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Countless Nights",
      "content": "The storm in the dead of night seemed as if it would drain every last drop of water in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>. Lightning flashed across the sky, casting webbed shadows upon a young girl curled up in her blanket.\n\nPhoebe couldn't fall asleep. Every time she closed her eyes, she saw the churning, furious sea. There, a lone ship would never return home, and she was sinking with it. \n\nOn nights like this, her father used to slip a locket with the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s portrait under her pillow, telling her that the Divinity would guide her through the storms in her dreams to a safe harbor. Her mother would place a bouquet of daisies by her bedside and tell her bedtime stories. She would say that the Sentinel sends Divine Envoys to protect brave and kind children like her. \n\nBut now, the <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> would simply pat her head and tell her that she was like any other child. Every <te href=850096>Rinascitan</te> had to endure suffering before they could receive the Sentinel's forgiveness in the end.\n\nOnce, when she peered over an Acolyte's shoulder, Phoebe caught sight of the magnificent statue of the Sentinel for the first time. The sight of the immense, sinuous fishtail gave her a moment of panic, but the Acolyte's gentle hand on her shoulder and the soft, steadying prayer helped calm her trembling heart.\n\nShe was led into a warm, brightly lit room. The Acolytes treated her kindly, but she knew they probably preferred children who didn't bring trouble with them.\n\nPhoebe tried to remember the lullaby her mother used to sing, willing its melody to echo in her mind to drown out the howling storm outside.\n \nBut still, the relentless thunder and rain dragged her back to that dark night.\n \nShe had snuck aboard a merchant ship, peering through the porthole of the cargo hold to watch the distant horizon. When her parents returned, their sails would appear from that direction. She didn't want to wait for them anymore. This time, she was going to be brave and find them herself.\n\nBut the sea wasn't as gentle as her mother described in her stories. She began to hear hurried footsteps on the deck, the noise growing frantic until screams pierced the air as the ship was tossed violently in the storm's grip. The vessel began to sink.\n\nPhoebe cried out for her parents, but the raging waves seemed to whisper that they would never return.\n\nThe icy seawater engulfed her, and in her fading vision, she watched her father's locket disappear into the dark depths of the sea.\n\nWhen she opened her eyes again, she was lying on the shore, soaked to the bone. A <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> shone on her leg. The Acolytes who found her said no one could survive such a perilous sea, let alone a little girl. They believed it was a blessing from the Sentinel.\n\nBut Phoebe faintly remembered that something had saved her. A presence so gentle, like a soft breeze, had lifted her to the surface and laid her gently on the shore, telling her…\n\n<i>Don't be afraid. I'm here.</i>\n\nSomething pulled Phoebe from her dream. She felt the bed shift slightly, as though something soft and plush had nestled up beside her. It carried the dampness of the rain and the scent of daisies.\n\nThen Phoebe saw a pair of button eyes and soft, floppy ears—it was the stray <te href=850082>Echo</te> she had met in Whisperwind Haven earlier that day. She had untangled the kite string trapping it, naming it Brenno. Later, Brenno introduced Phoebe to many of its friends, took her cloud-watching on the hillsides, wiped away her tears, and even made her a wreath of pretty flowers.\n\n<i>Don't be sad, Phoebe.</i>\n\nThe Plushie's body felt warm and soft. In the haze of sleep, Phoebe felt a faint, familiar presence. It felt like the wind. \n\nShe buried her face into the Plushie's soft fur and slowly drifted back into a peaceful slumber."
    },
    {
      "title": "But Morning Came",
      "content": "As Phoebe woke up, she felt a lingering dampness at the corner of her eye.\n\n\"By the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s grace, another day to rise and shine!\"\n\nShe leaped out of bed and quickly smoothed the bed sheets. The small bed that had been a part of her childhood still looked as familiar as ever. Phoebe gave her cheeks a few quick pats to shake off the morning drowsiness before diving straight into the day's tasks. \n\nThe orphanage was hosting a small celebration, and she had joined her senior <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> to help with the preparations. It would be her first time back since becoming an Acolyte Initiate. She had spent the previous evening talking with her brothers and sisters for a long while. Maybe that was why she had that dream about the past.\n\nEveryone commented on how capable and grown she looked now. She couldn't afford to disappoint their expectations.\n\nAfter morning prayers, Phoebe began preparing the necessary items for the celebration. The life of an Acolyte was busy yet fulfilling. For her, following a plan and seeing it come to fruition made her feel reassured and content. By the time the sun had climbed high in the sky, she and the other Acolytes had transformed the simple dining hall into a vibrant, colorful space. Phoebe set out the tea and snacks and watched the children, dressed in freshly laundered clothes pressed by the <te href=850082>Echoes</te>, rush excitedly into their caregivers' arms to receive their carefully wrapped presents.\n\nTouched by this warm scene, Phoebe couldn't help but smile.\n\nShe remembered how her father would always buy her a present during the first stop of his business trips. How her mother would always come up with a story about the present. Sometimes they were thrilling adventures, other times gentle bedtime tales. Her favorite gift had been a pink rabbit stuffed toy. In the story, she was an elegant musician.\n\nAs the darker parts of her past faded away, Phoebe found herself remembering only the bright, happy moments.\n\nA little Echo tugged on her sleeve, proudly showing her a big balloon it had just made. Instinctively, she reached out to pat its head.\n\n\"Acolyte Initiate Phoebe!\"\n\nHer senior's stern voice made Phoebe flinch. She quickly withdrew her hand and watched the Echo shuffle off with a hint of sadness. The senior's intense gaze seemed to pierce through her.\n\n\"By the Sentinel's grace, be mindful of your position.\"\n\n...She still hadn't fully adjusted to her new role. As an Acolyte, she couldn't have close attachments to the Echoes.\n\nThe Sentinel had led her to kind people, given her food to eat and provided a roof over her head. With these gifts came new responsibilities. As an Acolyte, it was her duty to repay such kindness.\n\nHowever, as Phoebe, she still had her own time to meet with friends.\n\nUnconsciously, her hand went to the locket hanging around her waist. It was her own little miracle. A treasure that her friends had helped bring back from the depths of the sea.\n\n\"Ms. Phoebe, my balloon got stuck in the tree and I can't get it down. Jimmy said you can fly. Could you...\"\n\n\"Of course!\"\n\nThe child tugging at her clothes snapped Phoebe out of her reverie. She set aside her tangled thoughts and returned to the crowd, immersing herself in the busy work of the celebration once more.\n \nAs the sun began to dip lower in the sky, the evening colors slowly spread across the horizon.\n\nThe day's work was done, the crowd had dispersed, and everything fell into peaceful quiet. Phoebe sat on a bench, closing her eyes and letting the soft sea breeze wash over her. Time seemed to slow.\n\nHer small figure appeared lonely against the setting sun. Her senior came looking for her, but noticing her shallow breathing realized that she had already fallen asleep. \n\nAs the girl slept soundly on the bench, quiet little Echoes crept up from the sides and huddled close to her side. \n\nThe older Acolyte sighed softly, turning away to leave her be.\n\n\"This time... I'll pretend I didn't see it.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Within Distant Brilliance",
      "content": "Phoebe still had faint memories of the last <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> she had attended.\n\nSitting on her father's shoulders, she watched Wingrays soar overhead as bright streamers and petals fell like rain, the air filled with deafening cries. But those childhood memories were too hazy to hold onto. Now, whenever she thought of the Carnevale, all that came to mind was a soft glow and distant echoes.\n\nYet she still remembered the expressions on her parents' faces. Their laughter had come from the heart. Memories that once caused her pain now glimmered deep within her.\n\nScenes that had once lived only in her dreams now unfolded before her eyes.\n\nShe stood among the crowd, watching the dark-haired hero bathe in light as a golden wreath slowly descended, settling atop {Male=his;Female=her} head.\n\nHer heart skipped a beat. Amidst the cheers, her gaze uncontrollably followed the golden light wherever it went.\n\n\"It's the <te href=850103>Laureate</te>!\"\n\n\"Praise <te href=850105>Imperator</te>!\"\n\n\"The <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> has sent us a miracle!\"\n\nHer vision blurred amid the tearful cries of joy.\n\nWho wouldn't be moved by such a dazzling sight? Even the Divinity had bestowed a miracle for such a moment. At that instant, Phoebe couldn't help but wonder: how could the Sentinel be angered by the people celebrating the Carnevale? Surely, the Sentinel loved the Carnevale and the joy of the people.\n\nThe faint shadow that had loomed her heart since returning from the Atrium of Reflections resurfaced, only to be momentarily washed away by the singing and laughter.\n\nBut this time, Phoebe clung to that fleeting trace of doubt. The things she had noticed, but had pushed aside. The questions that had risen, but which she had instinctively avoided confronting.\n\nPhoebe blinked hard, wiping away the tears at the corners of her eyes. She turned her gaze once again toward the figure surrounded by the crowd.\n\nShe had an inkling that {Male=he;Female=she} might hold the answers to clear her confusion.\n\nAnd one day, she would seek out the truth behind that doubt."
    }

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feibi_com_scan.play_favor_word_feibi_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Cherish the gift not given lightly.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feibi_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_feibi_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Good fortune comes your way.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feibi_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_feibi_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Such joyful blessings They bring.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feibi_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_feibi_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Frozen In Time",
      "content": "A locket Phoebe carries with her, repurposed from an old pocket watch. Inside is a family portrait. \n\nIt was lost to the depths of the sea during a shipwreck, but thanks to the tireless search of her kind friends, it was eventually returned to her.\n\n\"In the fleeting waves of time... in the beautiful spray of the sea, and in the light, there are words I want to tell you, over and over again.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure88_UI.T_Treasure88_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"Envoy\"",
      "content": "A handcrafted souvenir from a land across the sea was the only item Phoebe kept when her family's possessions were sold off.\n\nIn the bedtime stories she once believed would never end, there was a bird with blue wings, the envoy of the Divinity. It had the power to cross through storms and bring happiness to the little girl who endured loneliness each night as she drifted to sleep.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure89_UI.T_Treasure89_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "A Vision Far Away",
      "content": "An old, faded edition of the <i>Codex of the Deep</i>, handbound by a loving and devout mother. \n\nA proper, dutiful <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> should be well-versed in the contents of the Codex, holding the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s guidance close to heart. Phoebe always adhered to the teachings in her heart, though, if truth be told, she preferred the color of the sky to that of the sea.\n\n\"The Codex says that suffering brings us closer to the Divinity. But I still hope for a peaceful and happy life for you, my child.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure90_UI.T_Treasure90_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "O Come Divine Light",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks of Holy Light, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to ride the staff and dive down from mid-air to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to ride on the staff for a distance.\n- Can be re-cast after a Mid-Air Dodge or using Grapple.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nAfter a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>, quickly use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n- When Phoebe is inside the <te href=850007>Ring of Mirrors</te>, Dodge Counter becomes <color=Highlight>Chamuel's Star: Dodge Counter</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to ride on the staff for a distance.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "To Where Light Shines",
        "desc": "Summon a Ring of Mirrors at the target location, making the target hit stagnate for {2}s and dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. The stagnation effect can be applied to 12 targets max for each Ring of Mirrors. Using <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> again shortly after the summoning teleports Phoebe to the Ring of Mirrors' location, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\nUnable to teleport if Phoebe is too far from the Ring of Mirrors.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ring of Mirrors</color></size>\n- Ring of Mirrors lasts for {0}s. When Phoebe summons a new Ring of Mirrors, the existing Ring of Mirrors disappears.\n- When Phoebe is outside of the Ring of Mirrors, a <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> that hits the Ring of Mirrors will refract Holy Light, which deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to targets inside the <color=Highlight>Ring of Mirrors</color> and pulls the targets hit to the center of the ring. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. Can be triggered once every {1}s.\n- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> becomes Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Chamuel's Star</color>, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.",
        "param": [
          "30",

          "2"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "Summon a Ring of Mirrors at the target location, making the target hit stagnate and dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. When Phoebe summons a new Ring of Mirrors, the existing Ring of Mirrors disappears.\n- When Phoebe is outside of the Ring of Mirrors, a <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> that hits the Ring of Mirrors will deal extra DMG and pull the targets hit to the center of the <color=Highlight>Ring of Mirrors</color>.\n- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> becomes Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Chamuel's Star</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Radiant Invocation",
        "desc": "When Phoebe's Prayer is full, consume all Prayer to cast one of the following skills:\n- Hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Absolution Litany</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and applying {0} stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> to the targets hit. Phoebe enters <color=Highlight>Absolution</color> status, which allows her to deal more damage.\n- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Utter Confession</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and applying {0} stack of <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> to the targets hit. Phoebe enters <color=Highlight>Confession</color> status, which allows her to better exploit Spectro Frazzle.\n- <color=Highlight>Absolution</color> and <color=Highlight>Confession</color> cannot coexist. Entering into one will end the other.\n- When Divine Voice is not exhausted, Phoebe is unable to cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Absolution Litany</color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Utter Confession</color>.\n- When Divine Voice is exhausted, Phoebe will not exit the <color=Highlight>Absolution</color> or <color=Highlight>Confession</color> status.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Starflash</color></size>\nWhen Phoebe has Divine Voice, casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> replaces the next <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Starflash</color>, which deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> at the cost of {2} Divine Voice.\n- <color=Highlight>Absolution</color> Enhancement: Reduce the cost of Divine Voice by {3}.     "talent_doc": "[Averardo Vault Employee Profile—Access Permission Confirmed]\n\nEmployee Name: Zani\n\nThe Awakening history of Employee Zani remains unknown.
