  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "\"A Regular\"",
      "content": "It was already past midnight, and the lights in the shop windows had flickered out, leaving the lively city of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> cloaked in a solemn, silent embrace. Even Signor Octopus on the bell tower seemed to have drifted off to the land of dreams. Well, if <te href=850082>Echoes</te> can dream, that is.\n \n\"Looks like there won't be any more customers tonight,\" Margherita yawned. \"Aye, best finish up with cleaning and head home.\"\n \n\"Ciao, Margherita. Same as usual. A Nectarwine and potato wedges. Extra gemberry jam and black pepper. Thanks.\"\n \nMargherita froze at the sudden familiar voice coming from behind her. It carried the unmistakable weight of exhaustion and weariness, as if the spirit of its owner had been whisked away to the heavens by <te href=850105>Imperator</te>, leaving behind only a weary shell. To anyone unfamiliar with Ragunna, that lifeless tone might have sent them running.\n \n\"It's been a while since you last came by, Ms. Zani,\" Margherita said, still focused on tidying up the pizza crumbs in the oven. \"Just getting off work? You've been busy lately?\"\n \n\"Well, sort of,\" Zani replied, her gaze fixed on the counter as if she were staring at a pile of freshly-printed reports instead of some appetizing pizzas. \"You know, with the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> just around the corner, the <te href=850135>Bank</te> is working one like three. Not that it really matters. The workload never seems to end anyway.\"\n \n\"To us <te href=850101>Montellis</te>, the Carnevale is both an opportunity and a challenge,\" Zani recalled Alberto's words when she received that assignment. \"For Ragunna's future, we all must play our part.\"\n \nTo Zani, those words felt hollow. She worked for the Bank because they paid her. She wasn't an actor there to \"play a part.\" Still, she had to admit that the guest she was tasked to protect did spark a small flicker of curiosity in her heart. The sizzling potato wedges in the fryer released a mouthwatering aroma that made her stomach grumble in protest.\n \n\"What should I have for breakfast tomorrow?\" she pondered. \"The pancake this morning was cold and gave me a bit of a stomachache. Maybe I should go for porridge with baked eggs... Oh, and definitely two spoonfuls of sugar...\"\n \nJust then, a faint cracking sound pierced the midnight air. Margherita, busy with the fryer, didn't notice. Perhaps the entire slumbering city of Ragunna didn't notice either. But Zani did. She looked up and saw a shadow dart across the rooftops. The sound had come from a loose tile knocked off by his careless foot.\n \nThe Carnevale attracted more than just law-abiding tourists. With a resigned sigh, Zani pulled out her wallet and placed a few <te href=850104>Shell Credits</te> on the counter. So much for her midnight snack.\n \n\"Ta-da! Your potato wedges are ready, Ms. Zani—\" Margherita called out, turning around with a plate in hand, only to find the seat where Zani had been sitting now empty."
    },
    {
      "title": "Shadow of the Blaze",
      "content": "Excerpt from the Pioneer Express special edition: <i>Guardian of the Night: An Incarnation of Justice or a Cunning Criminal?</i>\n \n\"Just as my scream caught in my throat, they swooped right over my head! He... No, no, she. Yeah, I think it was a woman. She was moving so fast, and in the darkness of the night, it was hard to see anything clearly. But I swear, there was something on her head, like some strange hairpins. Or maybe it was just her hair whipping in the wind? I can't say for certain...\"\n \n—Sabrina (Female, 36), one of the known eyewitnesses.\n \n\"The brothers of the <te href=800005>Chamber of Discipline</te> finally reached a consensus, declaring that outlaw a righteous one. I was vehemently against their judgment then, and I still am! This outlaw is responsible for dozens of assaults in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>! Yes, yes, I know the ones she attacked were criminals, but they should've been apprehended by the Chamber of Discipline under <te href=850105>Imperator</te>'s name and sentenced under the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s solemn gaze! Not by some thug dishing out street justice! This is a blatant defiance of the Sentinel's authority! Here in Ragunna, only the Sentinel has the right to judge the guilty!\"\n \n—Anonymous <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> from the Chamber of Discipline\n \n\"Yes, several neighbors of mine have seen her. Her methods are getting more extreme lately. They even call her the 'Butcher of Criminals'... She never kills, huh? Well, I don't buy that. She's dealing with the worst of the worst, after all. I don't think anyone can hold back when their life is on the line. Unless she's much stronger than those criminals, but could that even be possible?\"\n \n—El Lawson (Male, 42), from Egla Town, commenting on this mysterious figure's intervention during the attack on the Plushie <te href=850082>Echoes</te> by the \"Plushie Slaughterer.\" Since Egla's residents strictly avoid going outside after dark, no one saw her face.\n \n\"I've been tracking this avenger sent by the Sentinel. Why do I believe she's connected to the Sentinel, you ask? Haven't you heard about the blazing Flames of Retribution that surround her? Those holy flames must be a gift from the Sentinel. The greater the evil she faces, the fiercer the light burns. Some call her a demon? Oh, that's absurd... What kind of demon fights for justice?\"\n \n—Rhea (Female, 33), Acolyte from the Chamber of Discipline. She participated in an investigation into this mysterious figure several years ago.\n \n\"I was working late that night. As I passed the gate of the Chamber of Discipline, I saw Talos from the <te href=850136>Black Alley</te> tied up with his gang, all unconscious. Well, maybe it was just my imagination, but in the dim morning light, I think I saw someone squatting on the rooftop across from the Chamber. She was gone in a blink. I remember she was covered in wounds, like she had just fought through hell. What? You mean to say she took down Talos and his gang all by herself?!\"\n \n—Archived audio recording from years ago. The speaker remains unknown.\n\nMost of these cases occurred years ago, and the eyewitness accounts collected thus far are often contradictory and lack detail. However, one thing remains clear: <te href=850137>the second Dark Tide</te> and the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> incident a decade ago inflicted severe damage on Ragunna. During the chaos that followed, a mysterious figure emerged, punishing evil under the cover of night. In those dark days, many who had lost faith formed gangs, reveling in crime. It wasn't until this mysterious woman began hunting them down one by one, delivering them to prison, that order was finally restored to Ragunna.\n\nFew in the city are willing to talk about those painful years. Like the traditions of Carnevale, the people of Ragunna believe that Imperator wishes them to embrace joy rather than dwell on the scars of the past. As a result, records of this mysterious figure—or the so-called \"Blazing Nightwalker\"—have faded into distant legend. However, around the recent Carnevale, whispers began to circulate once more, as someone claimed to have seen a figure resembling the legends, roaming the streets.\n \nTo Ragunna, is this an omen of another crisis? Or merely an imitator of a past hero? Only time will tell."
    },
    {
      "title": "Best Employee",
      "content": "\"Yes, the Figaro family claimed they settled the payment three days ago. Their 'respected' guarantor? Vanished into thin air. Now they're trying to spin this flimsy evidence into a bookkeeping error on our part.\" Zani shrugged, her tone calm and casual, as if she were simply chatting with the Sword Acorus in the garden. \"Yes. Apparently, they're trying to chisel us. An old trick that's been around since the Ragunnesi first started fishing from Gondolas. No worries, I'll 'negotiate' with them. Alright, that's settled then. Ciao.\"\n \nZani hung up the call, tucking the ledger under her arm as she stepped out of the office. Behind her, hushed whispers spread through the workplace. It wasn't that her colleagues doubted her abilities. They all knew too well how this would end. A minor matter like this wouldn't make the front page of the newspaper. At most, it would be squeezed into the bottom corner of a column, alongside lost-and-found notices and cheap advertisements. The papers certainly wouldn't mention Zani or the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family. Perhaps there would be a brief report about a few Figaro members getting bruised by a toppled scaffolding near the clock tower or how the head of the Figaros generously funded the arts for their loyal business partner, the Montelli family.\n \nWas Zani the best employee at the bank? Without a doubt.\n \nHer outstanding job performance often piqued the curiosity of new hires. She worked late into the night every single day, arriving at work exhausted, dark circles under her eyes. On top of that, she handled the most dangerous fieldwork, yet never botched a single assignment. The older employees spoke of her in reverent tones, almost as if she were an omnipotent divinity. It was said that if she were assigned to catch <te href=850106>Cetus the Tidebreaker</te> with nothing but a soggy noodle, she would return with that \"little\" whale the next morning, right on time, as if it were merely a takeout pizza.\n \nHow did she do it? No one knew.\n \nSome rookies were keen to imitate Zani's every act and habit, believing it would unlock the secret to her excellence. They noticed she was never without an energy drink and assumed that was the source of her superhuman stamina, like the Heliobane Fungia for a Riccioli sailor in an old comic. So, they gulped down energy drinks, convinced it would fuel them through nights and help them complete legendary projects, just as it did for Zani. Yet, they often found themselves slumped over their desks, sore from sleeping in their chairs, only to be scolded by supervisors for underperforming the next day.\n \nWhat was she thinking? No one knew.\n \nThe older employees still vaguely remembered the Zani who first joined the bank. A silent, distant young woman, a bit reckless, and a bit too comfortable with violence. But within two months, she had mastered every procedure, and in another two, she was almost on par with the bank's best employees. By her third year, the \"Best Employee\" badge was nothing more than a trinket she received alongside her paycheck.\n \nBut what drove her to go this far? The answers varied. Some believed she had a deep love for <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> and felt it was her duty to protect the city. Others thought she was ambitious, aiming to earn the Montelli surname and perhaps even coveting the position of head of the family. Still, some suspected the Montellis were paying her a hefty sum beyond her standard salary to bind her to them through financial incentives.\n \nIf anyone ever asked Zani herself, she would simply blink, unfazed.\n \n\"That's interesting. But I'm just an ordinary employee. Though I do have an idea. If you're convinced that my department pays so well, why not transfer over? Help take some load off me. Since it's just an internal transfer, I don't think it'd violate any non-compete agreements, right?\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Night's Solitary Path",
      "content": "...There was just enough time.\n\nZani darted through the shadowy alleyways, the sharp pain in her shoulder a stark reminder of her close call. That brute of a man, whose wrists were nearly as thick as her neck, had nearly done her in. She had planned to knock him out before he could react, but he was faster than she had anticipated. Good thing her reflexes were sharper than his. Otherwise, that knife wouldn't have just left a deep gash on her shoulder but would have gone straight into her heart.\n\nIt wasn't her first injury. She had long lost count of the wounds she'd collected in the past few months of fighting crime. They healed, after all. Besides, she was certain that the ones who gave her those wounds had ended up far worse than she did.\n\nHer strategy was simple: give those criminals a real hard time without them ever knowing her identity, then vanish before the Chamber of Discipline arrived to clean up the mess. It wasn't about heroism. It's just that she wasn't foolish enough to paint a target on her back and risk being driven out of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, hiding in some miserable town without the blessings of pizza and Nectarwine.\n\nIt was always safer to be a nobody. Someone unremarkable. Someone no one saw as a threat.\n\nTonight's targets were kidnappers. She had been tracking them for days, and their leader—the tough man from earlier—wasn't just muscle. A tricky Resonator. But he had made a fatal mistake by wandering off alone, giving her the perfect opportunity to strike. Now, all she had to do was take down the rest before they realized their boss was missing.\n\nShe tightened her grip on her brass knuckles, rolling her wrists.\n\n\"Boss should be back soon, huh? That kid's home isn't that far,\" a lanky man yawned, glancing over at the little girl curled up in the corner of a wooden cage, clutching a doll. He lifted his chin at her, \"So, what's the plan after we get the money? I say we just let her go.\"\n \n\"But she's seen our faces,\" the shorter man sighed. \"If we just let her go, we might end up being hunted by that... What's their name? The Blazing what?\"\n \n\"The Blazing Nightwalker,\" the lanky man corrected. \"I get why the boss is worried, but a deal's a deal. We take the money, we let the girl go. Killing her is overkill.\"\n \n\"By <te href=850105>Imperator</te>'s name, Ragunna has long been a land without rules,\" the short man muttered, a grim silence falling between them. The lanky man turned to look at the girl in the cage, but quickly snapped his gaze away as if burned.\n \n\"...I need some air.\"\n \nThe lanky man stood up, irritated, and opened the door of their hideout. The cold air sent a shiver down his spine but that didn't last long. Before he could react, a cold, metallic object smashed into his forehead, and darkness swallowed him whole.\n \n\"Who, who the hell are you?\"\n \nThe short man scrambled for the gun on the other side of the table. He nearly made it, but the intruder was faster. Just as his consciousness began to fade, he felt his fingers brushed the gun's handle. That was it.\n \nI made it, Zani thought, letting out a sigh of relief. The wound on her shoulder had opened again, but it was still worth it.\n \nWith a single punch, she shattered the lock on the wooden cage, shrugging off the lanky man's coat and draping it over the trembling girl. She had sent an anonymous letter to the <te href=800005>Chamber of Discipline</te> on her way here. If everything went smoothly, they would arrive soon. It was time for her to leave.\n \n\"Ex-excuse me...\"\n \nZani turned at the sound and found the little girl standing behind her, hesitating. Summoning all her courage, the girl held out her cherished toy.\n \n\"This, this is for you! Thank you for saving me!\"\n \n<i>No need. I didn't do it for your gratitude.</i>\n \nHowever, Zani swallowed her words before they could leave her lips. She squatted down, meeting the girl's wide, fearful eyes. In those innocent eyes, she saw herself, her past self. The lonely Zani. The helpless Zani. The Zani who couldn't do anything.\n \nSo, she smiled and reached out her hand, ruffling the girl's hair before taking the doll from her hands.\n \n\"Thanks,\" she said softly. \"I'll take good care of it.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Eve of the Carnevale",
      "content": "Zani might have dreamed. Or maybe she didn't. If she had, it had slipped from her mind too smoothly like butter. She opened her eyes and silenced the alarm clock still ringing by her bedside.\n\nThe morning light streamed through the windows, outlining the edges of the carpet in a soft, golden glow. She took a minute to force herself to fully wake up, and with that, the last fragile fragment of the dream dissolved into nothing.\n\nNot that it mattered. It probably wasn't a good dream anyway.\n\nWith all the recent overtime, even Zani's dreams had become meaningless and fragmented, often just mishmashes of unfinished tasks running through her mind. There was no escape from the pressures in waking life, so why would she ever expect to find one in dreams?\n \n\"Alright, enough of that. I've got an important job to take care of.\" Zani gave her cheeks a light slap to snap herself out of her thoughts. She knew she needed to handle this assignment the right way if she ever wanted to secure that promised paid vacation from her supervisor.\n\nFacing the mirror, she straightened her attire meticulously, adjusting her tie until it was just right. She didn't know much about the mysterious guest. All Zani knew was that {Male=he;Female=she} had a very special <te href=850082>Echo</te>, and that the family had provided {Male=him;Female=her} with a fair sum of funds.\n\nFor some reason, she felt like there was more than met the eye. Perhaps it was just lingering unease from that strange dream, but she couldn't shake the feeling that whatever she and this guest did over the next few days would determine the fate of many in Ragunna.\n\n\"Heh, come on. I'm just an ordinary employee.\" So ordinary that if a billboard in the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> Quarter fell, she'd be crushed along with a dozen others. Zani pulled her cloak off the rack and draped it over her shoulders, just like she did every morning.\n\nShe yawned. Thankfully, none of her colleagues saw her.\n \nShe wasn't assigned too many tasks today. Mr. Alberto had said she'd be free to leave once she helped that esteemed guest in black complete {Male=his;Female=her} business at the <te href=850135>Bank</te>. After that, her only responsibility was to serve as {Male=his;Female=her} bodyguard and guide until the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> ended. Sounded like an easy task.\n\n\"Just do my job and I'll be good.\" Zani took a deep breath. Strangely enough, she felt nervous, her tail swishing behind her without her even realizing it.\n \n\"If {Male=he;Female=she} arrives at lunch time, I can suggest dining at Trattoria Margherita for <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s specialities. And if {Male=he;Female=she} refuses, I'll go with the backup plan,\" Zani quickly ran through her itinerary. \"We can have pizzas at Bratta's Bakery and enjoy a relaxing afternoon by the Whisperwind Haven...\" She went over the schedule again and again, only allowing herself to relax when she couldn't find any more gaps.\n \nA small smile tugged on the corners of her lips. There, through the bank's gate, she spotted that esteemed guest, dressed in black. With a pair of golden eyes to boot. Just as she had been expecting.\n \n\"We've been expecting you, {PlayerName}. Welcome to <te href=850107>Averardo Bank</te>, {Male=sir;Female=miss}.\""
    }
  ],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "So, {PlayerName}, were you satisfied with how I handled your reception before the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te>? Why bring this up now, you ask? Well, gathering client feedback is part of my job. As the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family's esteemed guest, your opinion naturally holds a special weight for me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer01.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "For an employee of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family, appearance is everything. No matter how busy the day gets, always present yourself flawlessly. The Employee Manual puts it best: \"Impeccable etiquette and attire give you the upper hand in negotiations.\"",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer02.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "I don't hate work or overtime, so long as it serves a purpose. If I'm forced to sit idly at a desk doing nothing or sacrifice my personal time on trivial tasks... Then what I'm earning isn't a salary, it's compensation for the piece of my soul that's been taken.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer03.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "You look tired, {PlayerName}. I understand you're shouldering some heavy burdens. But I suggest you catch a break whenever you can. You don't want to end up like me. Once I pulled my first overtime, I soon found myself working around the clock. Trust me, saving the world can wait.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer04.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "I used to think life was nothing but living the same day on repeat. Grinding through trivialities, running in circles until even the smallest joys faded away. But then you came along, just as I'd grown numb to this way of living. Like the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> itself, you brought a burst of color into my life.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer05.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_toplayer05"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Zani's Hobby",
      "content": "I <i>love</i> my job! Really. No joke. Was I smiling? No? Then you get the idea.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_taste.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_taste"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Zani's Trouble",
      "content": "Listen, efficiency is everything at work. It's all about hitting the nail on the head. Some people just don't get it. Instead, they waste so much time on unimportant details, prioritizing form over substance. A shame, really. That won't solve anything. All it does is complicate things even more.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_worry.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_foodlike.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_foodlike"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "Employees of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family swear by espresso—straight, no sugar or milk—to keep themselves energized. But as for me, work is already hard enough... I'd rather treat myself to something sweet.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_foodhate.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_foodhate"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "I grew up in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, and I know every corner of this city like the back of my hand. The sea breeze that greets you, the bustling plaza filled with familiar faces, the shiny new products in shop windows, the aroma of food from Trattoria Margherita. I hope this quiet life never ends. I hope everyone finds their place. For me, that would be enough.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_dream.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_dream"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "Hmm? Why is this pocket watch so big? Well, this is not a pocket watch per se, but an alarm clock. In the early days when I worked for the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>, I almost caused a major incident by being late. After that, I've carried this alarm clock with me everywhere and I haven't been late since.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_story_obj.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_story_obj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "My past? Nothing worth mentioning, really. I clock in, do my work, clock out—then do it all over again. Now and then, I straighten out a few troublemakers. Were you expecting some \"white-collar hero saves the day\" kind of story? Then you've read too many comic books.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_story_exp.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_story_exp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Carlotta",
      "content": "Lady Carlotta? Her vision has never been limited to <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, or even <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>. Hers was about the world beyond the sea horizon. I don't know what kind of future she sees, but I'll stand by her until the day her vision becomes reality.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_kelaita.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_kelaita"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Phoebe",
      "content": "To me, <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s fate lies in the will of its people, not the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. Many <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> would call this heresy, but not Phoebe. That's what makes her unique. She would never dismiss another's beliefs or efforts just because they do not align with her own.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_feibi.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_feibi"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Cantarella",
      "content": "The <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family has always clung to <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s traditions, stubbornly resisting change. But Signorina Cantarella, the current head, isn't as traditional as people imagine. As an employee, I do not get to influence how the <te href=850101>Montellis</te> handle their relationship with the Fisalias... but personally, I wouldn't mind working with her.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_kanteleila.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_kanteleila"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Brant",
      "content": "Brant is a skilled actor, a respected captain, and a fighter willing to sacrifice everything for truth and justice. But what I envy most is that he's never weighed down by stacks of paperwork. If I knew anything about acting, I'd quit this job, join the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>, and live the carefree life he does... Now, now. Just a pipe dream to keep me going.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_bulante.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_bulante"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Ciaccona",
      "content": "I've seen Ciaccona perform a few times outside the city. She often sings about <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>'s old folklore. I once asked her if she thought the age of heroes described in her poems had ended, whether heroes had already exited the stage of history. She answered that as long as there is suffering, someone will rise up to be the new hero.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_xiakong.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_about_xiakong"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "It's your birthday today right? According to <te href=850097>Ragunnesi</te> tradition, we must put aside all work and throw a grand party with all our friends. Nobody leaves before midnight! Rest assured, I've already lined everything up in Palazzo Agrotta. Today, my job is to make sure you have all the fun.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Alright, where are we off to next?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_zanni_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "(Effort Sounds)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_zanni_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "Time to get back to work.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_zanni_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "I am Zani. I work for the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "You're in good hands.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Rest assured. I'm on call 24/7.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Is that the alarm... Alright, time to work.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "As the Montelli saying goes, \"A blade only stays sharp if it's regularly honed.\" Even if it's just for work, exercise is necessary.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "Hmm? Have I become more... productive? How am I supposed to act busy now...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_zanni_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: I",
      "content": "That all you got?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_atk_atk03_02.play_favor_word_zanni_atk_atk03_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: II",
      "content": "I'm just getting warmed up.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_atk_atk03_03.play_favor_word_zanni_atk_atk03_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "And that was me holding back.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk01_01.play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "Pathetic.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk01_02.play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: III",
      "content": "I'm just getting warmed up.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk01_03.play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Come at me!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill01_pro_04.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill01_pro_04"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Give me your worst!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill02_01.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "You barely made a dent.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill02_02.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Is that all?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill02_03.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Just in time.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill01_sp_01.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill01_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Try this!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill01_sp_02.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill01_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "Hmph, you asked for it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill01_sp_03.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skill01_sp_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VIII",
      "content": "Don't stand in my way!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skillex03_02.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skillex03_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IX",
      "content": "Reduced to dust.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skillex03_03.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_skillex03_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "I don't have all day.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "All of you at once. I don't do overtime.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: IV",
      "content": "Ugh, now I have a report to write.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst02_01.play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: V",
      "content": "That's a wrap!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst02_02.play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VI",
      "content": "What a waste of time.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst02_03.play_favor_word_zanni_burst_burst02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "No contest.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk02_01.play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "Shatter!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk02_02.play_favor_word_zanni_atk_heavyatk02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: III",
      "content": "Huh? Overtime?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_qte.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Ugh. An oversight...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_zanni_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Didn't block it...?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_zanni_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "I'll return the favor tenfold.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_zanni_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "My shield can withstand more than that.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_zanni_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "That's... just a scratch.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_zanni_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "...You've made it personal now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_zanni_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "No… I've still got work to do...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_die_01.play_favor_word_zanni_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Impossible...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_die_02.play_favor_word_zanni_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Justice... shall be served.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_die_03.play_favor_word_zanni_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "All yours.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "I'm off duty, it's your turn.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_zanni_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_engage.play_favor_word_zanni_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Perfect wind to glide.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_zanni_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "...Mmm. Got ya.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_scan.play_favor_word_zanni_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Efficiency above all.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_dash_01.play_favor_word_zanni_com_dash_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Some pocket money? Won't say no to that.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_zanni_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Windfall profits.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_zanni_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "I'll take it as my overtime fee.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_zanni_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_zanni_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Personal Memo",
      "content": "A notebook, Zani's constant companion. It's not just for jotting down daily schedules and important tasks. It also keeps life hacks she's gathered along the way.\n \nFrom recipes she stumbled upon in a forum to success tips pulled from a bestseller, and even a quick tutorial on fixing a washing machine in five minutes, Zani collects all sorts of seemingly useless tricks. Correction. Completely pointless tricks.\n \nBut for Zani, each note is a valuable piece of her daily life. She holds onto the hope that one day, these tricks will come in handy. Maybe today when she's off from work, or on her next, distant vacation, or maybe...",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure95_UI.T_Treasure95_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"Master of Time Management\"",
      "content": "An alarm clock, Zani's constant companion. This alarm clock is a bit of a hybrid. It looks like a pocket watch from its design and material, but is much larger. Every weekday morning, its ring jolts Zani awake, signaling the start of her day.\n \nAs a <te href=850101>Montelli</te> employee, Zani handles immense wealth and hidden secrets, and even a minute's delay could lead to catastrophic losses. That's why punctuality is crucial for her.\n \nZani divides her day into meticulously timed segments, ensuring she meets all her deadlines with precision. While some might think she has a natural knack for time management, only the old employees know the truth: Zani has worked tirelessly to achieve such efficiency.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure94_UI.T_Treasure94_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "A Token of Gratitude",
      "content": "For Zani, lending a helping hand is just part of her everyday routine, nothing to brag about or seek recognition for. Having once been in a tough spot herself, she understands the value of support. Once she gained the strength to stand against cruelty, she chose to be that helping hand. No strings attached, it's simply who she is.\n \nA few of the scars on her body are reminders of a past abduction case long forgotten by <te href=850097>Ragunnesi</te>. After a long struggle, she managed to rescue the kidnapped girl. In gratitude, the girl gifted Zani this toy before her parents arrived.\n \nWhile Zani sees her actions as normal, they were life-changing for someone else. While she doesn't dwell on it, she still keeps the toy as a quiet reminder of her past.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure98_UI.T_Treasure98_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Routine Negotiation",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\nAfter performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> at the right time to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Breakthrough</color>, which can be followed by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} Normal Attack again.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a plunging attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Then {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> at the right time to cast Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Breakthrough</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chain Basic Attack</color></size>\nAfter Basic Attack Stage 3, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> at the right time to perform <color=Highlight>Chain Basic Attack</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Restless Watch",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Standard Defense Protocol</color></size>\nAttack the target to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and enter a block stance. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, recovering 10 points of <te href=850063>Redundant Energy</te> and Stagnating the target on hit.\nWhen attacked by an enemy while in block stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then cast <color=Highlight>Pinpoint Strike</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by  {0}. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by {3} within the next {2}s.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Crisis Response Protocol</color></size>\nWhen Zani is not in <color=Highlight><te href=850064>Inferno Mode</te></color> and has full <te href=850063>Redundant Energy</te>, her <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crisis Response Protocol</color>.\nHold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>. While in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. After releasing <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button or when the stance duration ends, consume all Redundant Energy to cast <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, which is also considered <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle DMG</color>.\nWhen attacked by an enemy in while in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and consume all Redundant Energy to cast <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> (also considered <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle DMG</color>), Stagnating the target, and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by {1}. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by {3} within the next {2}s.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color> or <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color> sends Zani into <color=Highlight>Sunburst</color> mode and inflicts a stack of <te href=850066>Heliacal Ember</te> upon the target on hit. The last stage of the attack recovers <te href=850065>Blaze</te>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Sunburst</color></size>\nThe <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> DMG dealt by Zani to the target is Amplified by {4}.",
        "param": [
          "5%",

          "30%",
          "20%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Zani can block attacks within a certain time after casting Resonance Skill. A successful block reduces DMG taken and triggers a counterattack.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge - Redundant Energy</color></size>\n- Perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> to obtain <color=Highlight>Redundant Energy</color>.\n- When <color=Highlight>Redundant Energy</color> is full, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> becomes available.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color></size>\n- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to <color=Highlight>charge up</color> the attack, during which Zani is immune to interruption and blocks attacks. A successful block reduces DMG taken and triggers a counterattack. Release the button in advance or fully <color=Highlight>charge up</color> to attack the target.\n- Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> (also considered <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> DMG), inflict <color=Highlight>Heliacal Ember</color> upon the target, and Amplify the <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle DMG</color> dealt by herself.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "There Will Be A Light",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heliacal Ember</color></size>\nWhen Zani is in the team and a nearby Resonator inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> upon a target, immediately consume all Spectro Frazzle stacks and trigger the corresponding DMG, then convert Spectro Frazzle into an equal number of Heliacal Embers. Every time the conversion happens, Zani obtains Blaze based on the stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted. Heliacal Ember is capped at {0} stacks, with each stack lasting for {1}s. Heliacal Ember stacks are counted toward the Spectro Frazzle stacks for the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Scorching Light</color></size>\nWhen Zani is in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> become available, which deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> that is considered both Heavy Attack DMG and <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> DMG.\nWhen Blaze is no less than {2}, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Standard Defense Protocol</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>.\nHold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, during which Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early when Zani is switched off the field. While in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, release <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button within a certain time to consume Blaze and perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>.\nWhen attacked in a certain time after entering <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, consuming Blazes and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by {3}. Zani's DMG taken within the next {4}s is reduced by {5}.\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, consuming up to {6} Blazes on hit, with each Blaze increasing the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>. If <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 1</color> is interrupted, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> again to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 2</color>.\nUpon releasing the button after a certain time or when <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color> ends, immediately perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.\nWhen Blaze is no less than {2}, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>. After entering <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> immediately replaces the current <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>.\nAfter performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> immediately to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color> at the cost of Blaze.\nAfter performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.\nIf <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is not replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color> after a successful Dodge and Zani has no less than {2} Blazes, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> at the cost of Blazes.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Redundant Energy</color></size>\nZani can hold up to 100 Redundant Energy.\nObtain Redundant Energy when Normal Attacks hit a target.\nObtain Redundant Energy when casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Immediate Execution</color>.\nObtain Redundant Energy when casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Standard Defense Protocol</color>.\nObtain Redundant Energy when casting  <color=Highlight>Pinpoint Strike</color>.\nCannot obtain Redundant Energy while in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Blaze</color></size>\nBlaze is capped at 100 when not in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.\nBlaze is capped at 150 in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color> or <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color> grants 10 Blazes.\nEvery stack of Heliacal Ember converted from <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> grants 5 Blazes.\nCasting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rekindle</color> grants 50 Blazes.",
        "param": [
          "60",
          "6",
          "30",
          "10%",
          "2",
          "30%",
          "40"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge - Blaze</color></size>\n- When a nearby Resonator in the team inflicts <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> upon a target, trigger the damage effect immediately and inflict <color=Highlight>Heliacal Ember</color> upon the target. Meanwhile, Zani restores <color=Highlight>Blaze</color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation </color> or <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> grants <color=Highlight>Blazes</color>.\n- When in the <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color> and <color=Highlight>Blaze</color> is higher than the tick mark, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slashes</color> become available.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heliacal Ember</color></size>\nIncreases Outro Skill DMG. Its stacks count towards the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Slash</color></size>\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight> Normal Attack</color> or hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast.\n- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to <color=Highlight>charge up</color>, during which Zani is immune to interruptions and blocks attacks. A successful block reduces DMG taken and triggers a counterattack. Release the button in advance or fully <color=Highlight>charge up</color> to attack the target directly.\n- Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered both <color=Highlight>Heavy Attak DMG</color> and <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle DMG</color>.",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "The Summer Where the Story Began",
      "content": "She spent her six-year-old summer riding on her father's shoulders.\n\nThe night breeze carried the mingled scents of fireworks and grilled squid from the festival stalls. With a marshmallow stick in one hand, little Chisa pointed toward the sky with the other. Goldfish-shaped lanterns swayed in the breeze, and fireworks blossomed overhead. She saw red threads tied to people's wrists stretching and intertwining, weaving into a warm, invisible web that softly enveloped the festival crowd.\n\n\"What wish did you just make, Chisa?\" her mother asked, the fireworks reflected tenderly in her eyes. Chisa's cheeks were sticky with apple syrup as she puffed them out and proudly declared, \"I want to be like Mom! To make the prettiest paper cuttings so I can keep every precious, happy thing—\"\n\nHer twelve-year-old summer was different. That year, her world fell into silence all of a sudden.\n\nHer father was away on endless business trips, and the refrigerator door was plastered with her mother's shift schedules. Over time, she grew used to the cold beeps that greeted her at the other end of the line.\n\n\"It's okay. I can take care of myself,\" little Chisa whispered to herself. With such resolution, she lifted the pot lid and decided to make herself a lemon-scented sukiyaki hotpot. The prepared meal package on the table read in bold print: a healing dish for a family gathering.\n\nThe broth began to bubble, filling the room with the rich scent of beef and vegetables. Steam fogged the windows. Turning her face to the misted glass, Chisa saw only her own faint, lonely reflection. No laughter, no clink of glasses.\n\n\"For a family gathering.\"\n\nSuch a gentle phrase, she thought, and yet so very far away."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Long Rainy Season",
      "content": "Her fifteenth summer smelled of pencil shavings and loneliness.\n\nOne afternoon, the ceaseless rain of the tsuyu season briefly relented. Carrying a stack of books to return, Chisa crossed the courtyard and passed the equipment room. From behind the door came muffled sobs. Through the narrow gap, she glimpsed her classmate Ritsuko cornered by three girls, her shirt blotched with ink, her eyeglasses shattered on the floor. The head of them pressed a lighter to the embroidered name on her uniform, filling the air with the bitter stench of scorched fabric.\n\nIt reminded Chisa of the frog in biology class, pinned flat to the dissection tray, limbs splayed, yet its heart still beating futilely. Before she could think, her hand had already acted. She pushed the ajar door open and drew out the scissors she always carried.\n\nThat small pair of scissors had been her mother's faithful companion throughout her career and was passed down to her. Now, it pointed at someone's face for the first time.\n\n\"Let her go,\" she demanded.\n\nRetribution came swiftly. By the next morning, her desk was carved with \"idiot.\" Her locker overflowed with shredded textbooks. But the worst part of it was the blurred faces—no sooner than when she tried to see who had tripped her did she realize every face around her had melted into smears of color. The doctor's report read \"psychogenic visual recognition disorder.\" In the wake of her awakened Forte, her brain had cut loose the thread that allowed her to recognize faces.\n\nIn that moment, she heard a faint snap—not the brittle break of nerves, but like the sound she heard when the strings of her goldfish lantern snagged on a tree during a festival years ago. The warm, vibrant threads that once bound people together unraveled, falling away in a rain of broken fragments.\n\nWhen her scissors shredded the final note filled with malicious words, rain hammered the classroom windows. Chisa stared at her hazy, flickering reflection on the window and suddenly realized that growing up meant learning to cut out every loose thread herself—lantern strings tangled in branches, the kite string unwinding between her and her parents, or the cruel arcs frozen on her bullies' lips.\n\nThe rainy season stretched on. Cicadas rose with the mounting summer heat. Clutching her scissors, Chisa began to imagine a path she could carve on her own: a path perhaps lonely, but true to her heart. The one she would never need to turn back from."
    },
    {
      "title": "Blurred Features",
      "content": "In her sixteenth summer, dark clouds stretched endlessly, and rain came pouring down. Thunder weighed against her eardrums as she stood before the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Resonator Monitoring Center.\n\n\"Did you hear me?\" The voice was sharp with discontent. Chisa lifted her gaze, only to find the speaker's features dissolving into nothingness.\n\n\"Loud and clear,\" she replied to the void.\n\nThe collar clicked shut around her neck, bearing the cold touch of surveillance equipment.\n\nWhen the storm finally subsided, she set out for home. Cutting through the park, she came upon a boy crying beside a slide, clutching a snapped kite string. In her vision, the kite caught in the treetop stood out with uncanny clarity: three branches formed a natural lock, and if the far-right one was severed—\n\n\"Hold there,\" she stopped the boy from tugging the string. His eyes widened. With a soft snap, the branch split, and the kite drifted down, alighting gently in his arms.\n\n\"Thank y—\" His cheer broke off at a shrill cry. \"M-monster! Stay away from my child!\"\n\nFollowing the woman's terrified gaze, Chisa then became conscious again of the collar biting cold against her throat.\n\nIt wasn't a big deal. She told herself she should be used to this by now.\n\nShe could see the kite's frame, the trajectories of raindrops, or even the currents of electrons surging through the storm clouds with such clarity, but she could never see through others' faces or their hearts.\n\nShe turned and was about to step into the rain, but a small tug caught her sleeve. The boy had wriggled free from his mother's grasp. He pressed a packet of star-shaped candies into her palm. \"Here. This is for you! My teacher says only the brave get star candy, so…\"\n\nThe plastic wrapper crackled faintly in her hand. Chisa stared at the boy. His face was still a blur, yet it glowed, like fireflies circling lanterns in a festival long ago.\n\n\"Mom says people with these collars are bad,\" He leaned closer, whispering. \"But I don't believe her. The way you cut that branch? It was so cool.\"\n\nChisa paused, then crouched to pat his head. \n\nThe device against her throat stayed still. Her Resonance Spectrum was showing a rare, steady curve. Like a summer sky after the storm, a hint of light finally broke through."
    },
    {
      "title": "Nighmare of the Second Month",
      "content": "\"...!\"\n\nChisa jolted awake from the nightmare, cold sweat soaking her back. In a daze, her side still throbbed with a sharp, phantom pain that clawed at her nerves.\n\nBut her flesh was unbroken, unlike in the dream. Drawing a deep breath, she pressed a hand to her chest, trying to calm the frantic pounding of her heart.\n\nIt had been two months since she was trapped in Honami. Her body was slowly adjusting to the endless loop day after day, but each night the nightmares dragged her soul deeper into the abyss.\n\nShe turned her head toward the sofa. Sumika lay fast asleep, one hand slipping from the cushion, the other resting beside an open notebook scrawled with numbers and scribbled notes.\n\nOutside, the rain fell in relentless torrents.\n\nBy the time Sumika woke up, dusk had already descended. The storm had weakened. Faint stars dotted the ink-blue sky, like silver nails scattered carelessly across the cold night. Still yawning, she followed Chisa into a convenience store. While Chisa carefully gathered food and supplies from the shelves, she turned to find Sumika absorbed in the flickering sign overhead, notebook and pen already in hand.\n\n\"Chisa, look at this—\" she whispered, voice brimming with restrained excitement. \"It's just the same as last time! The time, the flicker rate... Everything matches! If we can just gather a few more samples... these data will let us uncover the pattern behind the loop!\"\n\nCatching the brightness in her eyes, Chisa unconsciously clenched her fists. In her palm lingered the sensation of yesterday's cut when she severed the Tacet Discords' threads, a cold shiver, like the snapping of silk.\n\nWhenever she drew her scissors and used her Forte, crimson lines surfaced in her vision—the threads of life, visible only to her. Unlike the warmth of human veins, these threads reeked of decay. They pursued the Left Behind, tearing them apart and dragging those fragile lives into yet another loop alongside the Lament.\n\nChisa studied her reflection on the window: a face calm, almost pale, but with a single ember still burning in her eyes.\n\nYesterday, here in this very store, she had crossed paths with the same girl again. The one she met every loop, who always shared her snacks so earnestly, never once realizing that she bore the iridescent glow of the Left Behind. Perhaps it was that fragile but unyielding kindness that kept Chisa from accepting that this city had been forever imprisoned in the past.\n\nThe night stretched long, but dawn would always come.\n\nWhen the first light finally broke through the leaden clouds, she thought she could hear the trembling hum of threads. Pressing her hand to her chest, Chisa knew that when the next loop began, everything would reset once again.\n\nBut that was fine.\n\nAs long as the scissors remained in her grasp, as long as the fragments of warmth had not been completely forgotten...\n\nShe would keep walking forward until the day she could finally cut through the nightmare and sever the snare."
    },
    {
      "title": "Beyond the Summer's End",
      "content": "In the afternoon, a drizzle pattered against the window.\n\nChisa stood by the floor-to-ceiling window of the Spacetrek Archive. At eighteen, she finally had the leisure to listen to the rhythm of the rain—not the monotonous cadence of Honami's looping rains, but the natural raindrops of Lahai-Roi. Fresh, alive, tinged with a faint sweetness in the air. It was the kind of rain that would casually soak a school uniform left drying on a balcony, or drench an unsuspecting student on the way home.\n\nSteam curled gently from the coffee on her table. With her scissors, she unpacked a bag of sugar... Yes, she still carried them everywhere, though now they were used more for pruning potted plants or opening parcels. The sugar dissolved into the dark surface of the cup. Beyond the window, a few students in bright yellow raincoats splashed through puddles. Their vivid color pierced the gray veil of drizzle, stirring memories of days spent facing endless loops and relentless beginnings—of someone who once walked beside her to the destination of the endless loop, cutting a path through the long night; and of someone who chose to tread countless false paths alone, turning herself into a cornerstone of truth.\n\nWhen the rain eased, Chisa stepped out of the Archive with a book in her arms. The damp evening breeze lifted her freshly cut hair. The campus stretched before her, alive with the soft after-rain glow. A group of students from the Department of Engineering was engaged in a heated debate over a hovering device. Someone noticed her through the thinning mist, waved brightly, and called her to join—\n\nShe watched these young, fervent souls, companions beneath the same sky, all bound for the same sea of stars. And she realized, with striking clarity, that she was no longer a wanderer lost in an endless loop. Her life, after a period of stagnation, had already rejoined the rushing river that carried everyone forward.\n\nShe had truly left that endless summer behind.\n\nTaking a steady step, she walked toward her new future."
    }

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_about_bozai.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_about_bozai"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Buling",
      "content": "She's a very fascinating Taoist. If I remember correctly, she's from <te href=850154>Mengzhou</te>, in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>? She's always saying odd metaphors and local sayings, and showing off the rare antiques she carries around. Once even offered me a \"Buy two, get 20% off\" deal. Maybe... I'll take her up on it. Just to see.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_about_buling.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_about_buling"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Shorekeeper",
      "content": "Shorekeeper helped me a lot while I've been recovering at <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>. It took me a while to settle in, but in time, I started to feel the kindness there. Shorekeeper once took me to the beach at the Haven of Sprouts to see the stars. They were infinite. And I found myself thinking... Sumika must've stood beneath that same sky many times, imagining the future she hoped to reach.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_about_shouanren.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_about_shouanren"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "A birthday... isn't just the anniversary of your birth. It's also a reminder that you're still here. For me, that alone makes it important.\nSo... please continue to stay healthy, level-headed, endlessly capable, and someone others can count on. May each of your days pass smoothly, and may there always be someone walking alongside you.\n—That's the most concise and practical birthday wish I could come up with.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Hmm… That's not it. It's this one.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_qianxiao_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "(Effort Sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_qianxiao_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "…Off you go then.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_qianxiao_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Kuchiba Chisa. Tactical Development Program, Department of Engineering, Startorch Academy. Forte Specialization: structural dissection... Apologies, this might not be the time for formalities.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "I will… sever this deadlock.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "I'll cut to the chase.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Time to trim things down.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Let's work together again.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "...The threads. I see them more clearly now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "The structure is more complex, but also... more distinctly identifiable.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "This wasn't by chance, nor was it coincidental. The deadlock has cracked. We'll fight alongside each other... just like before.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "No matter where this leads… This battle, I'm all in.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_qianxiao_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,

    {

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Old-Style Scissors",
      "content": "A pair of scissors with a vintage design. Once a common sight in every market decades ago, they have since slipped quietly into obscurity.\n\nThey once trimmed loose threads from a school uniform. They had sliced through the ribbon of a birthday gift. Fate has a habit of hiding its foreshadowing in the smallest of gestures. With each opening and closing, they marked countless endings and beginnings in her life—snipping threads, ribbons, structures, and loops alike.\n\nEvery cut was never truly an end, but a quiet herald of something new.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure126_UI.T_Treasure126_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Red Hair Ribbon",
      "content": "Some say a red thread brings protection. Others believe it wards off evil. But in older tales, it is said to bind people with the inescapable pull of fate.\n\nAn unseen bond, tied to fate, has quietly linked her to others and to some unknown future with irresistible strength. \n\nFrom that moment on, no matter how long or lonely the journey, she continues forward with the echo of companionship.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure125_UI.T_Treasure125_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Protective Charm",
      "content": "She still remembers that day. The rain had just lifted, leaving the sky a flawless blue. Her parents held her hands as they rang the shrine's bell rope together. Amidst the lingering chime, her mother fastened a small protective charm to her wrist.\n\n\"It will always protect you, Chisa.\"\n\nThe little Chisa shook her wrist, watching the tassel sway in the breeze, as though answering a vow she was too young to understand.\n\n\"No matter how far you go, no matter when, we'll always be here, waiting for you to come home.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure127_UI.T_Treasure127_UI"
    }
  ],
