      "skill": {
        "name": "Reign of Silence",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Rending Lunge</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.\nUse <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Death Snip</color></size>\nOpen the scissors, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.\nUse <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during this skill to deal additional <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> again to immediately snip the target.\nThe skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thread Withdrawn</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. \nCan trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nLeap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\nThis skill cannot be cast while in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.\nPerform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>:\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>;\n- Cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing.\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. \nWhile not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting Mid-air Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. \nUse <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>.\nIf interrupted, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color> can be cast again by holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hanging Finality</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. \n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color> to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> on the ground or use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>. This effect is removed when Chisa enters <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.\n- While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Rending Lunge</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.  \n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Death Snip</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team. \n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during this skill to deal additional <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Fractured Composition",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Eye of Unraveling</color></size>\nStagnate and deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> on the ground or use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>. This effect is removed when Chisa enters <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.\n- While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Serrated Loop</color></size>\nWhile on the ground and <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Serrated Loop</color>.\nStagnate targets, and deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and pull in nearby targets.\nCasting this skill sends Chisa into <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and replaces <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> with <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.\nHold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> while casting this skill to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Release the <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button in the duration or keep holding it for a certain period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 1</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and <color=Highlight>mark</color> the targets.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> is full, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> becomes available. \nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and <color=Highlight>mark</color> the targets.\nCasting this skill sends Chisa into <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mark</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>marked</color> targets take damage, Chisa inflicts <color=Highlight>Havoc Bane</color> on them.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Moment of Nihility",
        "desc": "Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team. \nCasting this skill sends Chisa into <color=Highlight><te href=150805>Woven Myriad - Convergence</te></color> for {0}s.\nWhile not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Woven Myriad - Convergence</color></size>\nThe DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> are increased by {1}.\nThe bonus DMG Multiplier for <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> granted by <color=Highlight>Sawring- Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> when <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> is consumed additionally increases by {2}.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> ends <color=Highlight>Woven Myriad - Convergence</color>.",
        "param": [

      "skill": {
        "name": "Sight of Unraveling - Oblivion",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Unseen Snare</color></size>\nChisa inflicts <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> on the target for {0}s in the following 4 ways:\n- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.\n- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting <color=Highlight>Serrated Loop</color>.\n- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Locking</color> on to a target.\nWhen targets marked by <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every {2}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thread of Bane</color></size>\nWhen dealing damage to targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>, ignore {4} of their DEF.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa unlocks <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> consume <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> on hit.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Blitz</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.  \n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start the combo from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 1</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>, release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, successful Dodges can be triggered.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.\nWhile casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>.\nRelease <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to sustain the attack. When <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> ends, cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> automatically.\nRelease the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> automatically.\n<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> deals <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Eradication</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa casts <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> in the following 2 ways:\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after consuming all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> or <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.\nAttacking targets with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for {5}s.\nThe skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\nEvery {6} point of <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> consumed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>. Up to {7} points will be counted toward this effect.\nCasting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> and ends <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Fever</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> is at 100% by default.\nWhen Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color> and exits <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa resets <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.\nWhile in the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Glide</color></size>\nWhen Chisa is not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and has more than {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color>, she can consume {8} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> in the following 5 ways:\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> in mid-air before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.\n- While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> or <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> forward shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing when launched into mid-air.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.\nCasting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>.\nDuring the skill, hold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to glide a short distance on the weapon.\nCan trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ring of Chainsaw</color></size>\nChisa can hold up to {9} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.\nHitting a target with <color=Highlight>Normal Attack </color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> grants <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.\nCasting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> grants {10} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.\nCasting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> grants {11} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Jetstream</color></size>\nChisa can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color>. \nChisa continuously obtains <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> over time.\nChisa obtains {13} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> upon defeating a target. \nExiting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> resets <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> to the max limit.\nChisa cannot obtain <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> passively for a short period of time after casting  <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.",

        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge</color></size>\nChisa obtains <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> when not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.\nChisa consumes <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode Basic Attack</color>. The more <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> consumed, the higher DMG the next <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode Finisher Attack</color> deals.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Thread of Bane</color></size>\nIgnore some of the marked targets' DEF when dealing damage.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode Finisher Attack</color> become available.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode Finisher Attack</color></size>\nDeal a massive amount of <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>) and grant Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team. \nCasting this skill ends <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.",

  "chains": {
    "1": {
      "name": "Wandering Through the Desolate Corridors",
      "desc": "Chisa is immune to interruption during <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>,  <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>, and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>\n\nInflicting <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color> grants the following additional effects:\n- Chisa's ATK is increased by {0} for {1}s.\n- Deal fixed {2} points of <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. The target's HP can be reduced to {3} at most and each target can take this damage only once. This instance of damage is considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from damage bonuses.",
      "param": [
        "30%",
        "15",
        "61803",
        "61.80%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM1_UI.T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM1_UI"
    },
    "2": {
      "name": "Into the Web of Endless Bonds",
      "desc": "Ignore {0} of the target's Havoc RES when dealing damage.\nNearby Resonators in the team with <color=Highlight><te href=150802>Thread of Bane</te></color> gain {1} All-Attribute DMG Bonus.",
      "param": [
        "10%",
        "50%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM2_UI.T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM2_UI"
    },
    "3": {
      "name": "Across the Confusion of the Long Night",
      "desc": "The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> are increased by {0}. This effect is mutually stackable with that of <color=Highlight>Woven Myriad - Convergence</color>.\nThe bonus DMG Multiplier for <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> granted by <color=Highlight>Sawring- Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> when <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> is consumed is increased by {1}. This effect is mutually stackable with that of <color=Highlight>Woven Myriad - Convergence</color>.\nThe Vibration Strength Reduction Rate of <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> is increased by {2}.",
      "param": [
        "120%",
        "120%",
        "50%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM3_UI.T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM3_UI"
    },
    "4": {
      "name": "Severing the Endless Cycle of Tragic Fate",
      "desc": "The effect of <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color> becomes:\nWhen targets marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color> take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on them. This effect is triggered up to once every {1}s.",
      "param": [
        "1",
        "1"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM4_UI.T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM4_UI"
    },
    "5": {
      "name": "Thousands of Lights to Guide the Way Home",
      "desc": "Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> gains {0} DMG Bonus.\n<color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> costs {1} less <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color>.",
      "param": [
        "100%",
        "50%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM5_UI.T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM5_UI"
    },
    "6": {
      "name": "Thus, Hope is Rekindled with the Rising Dawn",
      "desc": "When Chisa takes a fatal blow during <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>, and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, she will remain standing with at least 1 HP.\n\n<color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color> becomes <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare - Finality</color>, which has the following effects:\n- <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare - Finality</color> has all the effects of <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color>.\n- Targets affected by <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare - Finality</color> takes {0} Amplified DMG from Negative Statuses.\n- Targets affected by <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare - Finality</color> takes {1} increased DMG from Chisa.",
      "param": [
        "30%",
        "40%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM6_UI.T_IconDevice_QianxiaoM6_UI"
    }

      "title": "Truancy Record",
      "content": "In <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>'s administrative system, Lynae's truancy record reads more like a colorful fantasy travelogue than a disciplinary file.\n \nWhile her classmates sat in the lecture hall listening to Professor Mauclair's World Cultural History lecture, Lynae was several kilometers away, perched in a tree carefully reinforcing a nest of newly hatched Kronapuffs. While they drilled combat forms on the training grounds, she was in the Spacetrek Archive, helping a frantic Energy Sciences student recover crucial graduation data from a pile of corrupted files. \n\nThe hands once trained to grip weapons and crack security systems now wielded spray cans with the same precise, startling gentleness. Lynae simply couldn't sit still. Her curiosity tugged her from one corner of the Academy to the next, and her reasons for skipping class were always inventive.\n\n\"I was helping a senior stop her graduation project from escaping.\" \n\"I was recalibrating the cafeteria droid's seasoning algorithms. I may have accidentally triggered a system-wide strike.\"\n\"The Rimewisps in the sim pod were showing abnormal spectral fluctuations. Obviously, I had to document it!\"\n \nAt first, Ms. Voss found it exhausting. That began to change. Recommend inclusion in the curriculum.\"\n\nFaced with Lynae's lengthy, bewildering, yet undeniably brilliant record, Voss could only sigh.\nThis girl was never in class, yet her presence was felt in every corner of the Academy. It seemed as though she was protecting the place she now called \"home,\" in her own, unconventional way. \n \n\"…You still have to write the reflection report, you know.\"\n\"…Yes, ma'am.\"\n\nHead lowered, Lynae shuffled out of the office. Still, her eyes twinkled at the familiar mix of exasperation and fondness in Ms. Voss's eyes."

    {
      "title": "Lurking Shadows",
      "content": "The harbor at night loomed like a slumbering beast. She stood on the dock, her breath lost to the wind, her grip on the gun absolute. Its dark muzzle held the same cold stillness in her eyes, locked unblinkingly on the figure before her.\n\nEven with the barrel pressed to his forehead, the \"target\" remained calm. A faint, taunting smile touched his lips as he met her stare.\n\n\"We both know this is just a game. And you? You're just a pawn in a much bigger lie.\"\n\"Look at you… so professional. But for what? Some fake promise? Put the gun down. Walk away. You could be anyone… anywhere.\"\n\"How long do you think you can keep hiding?\"\n\n—How long do you think you can keep hiding?\n\nHer heart hammered. A bead of cold sweat rolled down her temple. That numb fear she thought she had long buried seized her once again.\n\n\"...Shut up.\"\n\nHer own voice sounded foreign, hoarse, cracking like a stifled roar. Her finger trembled on the trigger.\n\n\"Bang—!\"\n\nThe shot never left her gun, but a gunshot rang out. Lights blazed on. She flinched. The last bead of sweat fell, landing with a soft tap on the prop gun in her hands. \nThen applause surged like a tidal wave.\n \n\"Cut! Yes, yes! That's it! Perfect!\"\n\"...Lynae! That was incredible!\"\n\"Arthus, your sound cue was early again!\"\n \nBlinking, Lynae looked around as if waking from a dream. The monochrome set began to fade. Color seemed to bleed back into the world, starting from her own palms. Her \"target\" approached excitedly, his expression no longer threatening but bright with admiration. \n\n\"You were amazing! Just like a real secret agent!\"\n\"...\"\n\n—Of course, she was in the Drama Fan Club, standing in for a senior who had been injured during a field expedition. The play was adapted from a classic New Federation spy film. \nYet for a moment, she had truly felt as if she were…\n\n\"Lynae…? Are you okay?\"\n\"…I'm fine,\" she said, forcing a smile and adding a theatrical wave. \"Got a little too into it, hahaha. Blame Annan's script. It's just way too good!\"\n\nLaughter and chatter filled the rehearsal room again as members set out to prepare the next scene's set and props. Lynae sat in the corner as the club leader passed her a bottle of soda.\n\n\"Lynae, are you sure you don't want to join? Your acting is incredible!\" the leader exclaimed, clenching his fists in excitement, \"I've already got the perfect role for you at the next time at the Celebration—\"\n\"Sorry, I think I'll pass…\"\n\"Oh… no worries. I know you haven't joined any clubs yet, figured I'd ask. But if you ever want to, you're always welcome! You there, Germain! You can't place that prop like that!\"\n\nAs the leader sprinted off to rescue the prop, Lynae's fingers tightened around the soda bottle.\n\n —How long do you think you can keep hiding?\n\nThe words echoed again, prickling under her skin.\n\n —How long do you think you can really stay here?\n\nShe didn't know. She didn't want to think about it.\nSo all she could do was live in the present and enjoy what was right in front of her."

      "title": "Shifted Winds",
      "content": "At first, she dismissed them as phishing emails.\n\nThey would arrive without warning. Early in the morning, between classes, late at night, or even in the middle of laughing with friends. Lines of red, indecipherable code would suddenly flash across her Terminal. Seeing it was like having her chest pierced by a sharp needle. It threads itself through her heart, her veins, even her bloodstream itself. \nIt took time to decode them. But when she finally restored the original message, a chill seized her from head to toe.\n\nThe Fractsidus.\n\nPerhaps she had known from the moment she picked up that acceptance letter, but had still clung to a sliver of hope. She chose not to think too much, allowing herself to sink blissfully into a campus life far more beautiful than anything she had ever dared imagine.\n —Until that \"mission\" arrived.\n\n\"Infiltrate the Institute's system. Retrieve and alter the parameters of the Hyvatia Detector.\"\n\nShe knew the significance of the New Solar Ceremony to both the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> and <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, and she knew how critical the Hyvatia Detector was to that event. A massive conspiracy was winding its way through the shadows of Lahai-Roi. In that moment, Lynae understood with chilling clarity: what she chose to do could very well plunge Lahai-Roi into danger.       "title": "Black and Gold",

A streak of gold on a fallen acceptance letter caught her eye, like a blot of paint on chalk-white plaster, a sliver of light through a crack. She couldn't look away.\n\n\"Lynae\"—the name embossed on the sheet felt like fate telling a joke, half lie, half truth. She bent down, brushing away dust and bloodstains. Her dark hair caught the reflected gold, igniting something in her chest that years of numb mercenary work had never been able to extinguish: a longing for freedom.\n \n\"Are you Lynae from the New Federation?\"\n\nFaced with the teacher's question, she felt a flicker of guilt. She curled a strand of her freshly dyed hair—once dark brown, now a soft pale gold, though she had kept a few strands of her original color—and nodded, summoning her brightest smile. \n\n\"Yes.\"\n\"No need to be nervous. We know how the New Federation treats Resonators… but here in Lahai-Roi, you're completely free. Every opportunity and every piece of knowledge is open to everyone.\"\n\nShe stayed quiet as the teacher flipped through the student file she had casually filled. She had assumed many disguises for missions, yet none had ever made her feel this tense.\n\n\"Hm? The 'Hobbies and Interests' section is blank…\"\n\nNot good. She should have written something... Graffiti, maybe? She did enjoy leaving a few flourishes of paint after a mission, a habit picked up from a movie, but a mercenary couldn't leave traces, so she always wiped them clean.       "content": "When I came to <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, all I brought with me was that acceptance letter. The one that never really had my name on it. It was a key. One that unlocked this wild, colorful dream... and all the chaos that came with it. Without it, I never would've met you or anyone else. So... I don't regret what I did. And hey, like you said—This time, this admission letter will be my own.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_storyobj.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_storyobj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "The New Federation isn't all bells and whistles. If you're a Resonator, you do what you're told. If you're a merc like I was, you do it for cash. No loyalty. No higher purpose. The only fun I had was spraying a little graffiti after a job was done.... even if I had to scrub it off two seconds later. Anyway, enough about that. So, about our rides. What's the new paint job gonna look like?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_storyexp.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_storyexp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Mornye",
      "content": "What do Professor Mornye and I have in common? Easy. We both hate sitting through class! So I took her for a drive one time. Total stone face the whole time, but I could tell she was loving it. The best part was the welcome committee when we got back. A whole pack of her researchers, swarming the gates like I'd just pulled a full-blown professor-napping. I mean, hello?! I kinda like my life here. And let's be real... if I were actually trying to sneak her out, nobody would've had a clue.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_moning.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_moning"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Sigrika",
      "content": "When I first got here, Sigrika helped me get a handle on student life... She's super serious, the kind who never lets up on herself, you know? She never complains though, just bottles it all up inside. She's gonna hit a wall one day if she keeps that up... So, how about you and I... pull a little \"intervention\"? You know, take her out to have some real fun.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_xigelika.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_xigelika"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Luuk Herssen",
      "content": "The first time I met Dr. Herssen at the infirmary, I got this weird feeling he could see right through me. Now I think I might've just imagined it. Anyway, the man can write a very generous doctor's note slip. I'll give him that.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_luhesi.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_luhesi"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Chisa",
      "content": "First time I saw Chisa, I thought that quiet, intense vibe meant \"keep your distance.\" Man, was I wrong. We clicked instantly. She took one look at my bike and knew exactly what part was malfunctioning. Way faster than any manual diagnostic I could've run! Now that's impressive...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_qianxiao.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_qianxiao"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About the Fractsidus",
      "content": "An organization full of crazies. Too harsh? Doesn't make it less true. I'm done with them. Really hope I won't have to deal with them ever again.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_canxinghui.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_about_canxinghui"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "Happy Birthday! A special day calls for special plans. Consider whatever you're working on handled. I'll help you finish it later. I promised you a surprise that'd blow your mind, so we're ditching the noise. Now, hop on! We're leaving all that boring stuff in the dust. Only thing on the agenda today is you. Oh, and one last thing... you're wearing this balloon hat.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Yeah... right there. A little more drip... Perfect.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_linnai_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_linnai_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "Heh. Time to shake off the rust... Good. Still got it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_linnai_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Hey, name's Lynae. Just Lynae. Looks like I'm your new classmate here at Startorch Prep. So... be nice to the new girl, hmm?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "Back in action together again!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Ahem... \"Just name the target.\"",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Relax, I can play by the rules.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "The spectrum I'm seeing got a whole lot clearer...!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "Didn't think I could get this big of an upgrade... Don't hold back on me now!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "I guess someone's potential is like an Energy Gel Sachet. You think it's empty, but there's always a little more if you squeeze harder...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "...Sometimes I think you could stand up there and teach the class yourself. With what you know, you'd own that classroom.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "A bright, big place to call my own. Friends to learn with. Allies to fight beside... Everything I've ever wanted is right here. So even when the training is over... this doesn't just end, right? Keep teaching me. Trust me with more. This peace, this beautiful life... I'm going to fight like hell to protect it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_linnai_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: I",
      "content": "Watch the corner!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_atk_atk01_pro_01.play_favor_word_linnai_atk_atk01_pro_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: II",
      "content": "Catch this!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_atk_atk05_pro_01.play_favor_word_linnai_atk_atk05_pro_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack",
      "content": "Perfect arc!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_atk_heavyatk02_01.play_favor_word_linnai_atk_heavyatk02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "I call the shots!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Name your color!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Yo, over here!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill02_a_01.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill02_a_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "That's all you've got?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill02_b_01.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill02_b_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Zip!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_a_01.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_a_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Marked!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_b_01.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_b_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "One more!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_c_01.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_c_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VIII",
      "content": "Woosh!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_c_02.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_c_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IX",
      "content": "New look.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_d_01.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_d_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: X",
      "content": "Need a ride, sweetheart?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_e_01.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_skill03_e_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Special delivery... goes boom!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_linnai_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_linnai_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Tie a bow and call that my signature!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_linnai_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Drive safe—",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_skill_qte.play_favor_word_linnai_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit",
      "content": "Tch, that sucked.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_linnai_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Hah, I'm just getting started.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_linnai_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Mind if... I bail here?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_linnai_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Tch… You haven't seen anything yet.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_linnai_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Knew this... day would come.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_die_01.play_favor_word_linnai_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Not done fighting yet...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_die_02.play_favor_word_linnai_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "A world... of black and white...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_die_03.play_favor_word_linnai_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Shake it up!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_linnai_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Guess who?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_linnai_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "I heard something.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_engage.play_favor_word_linnai_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Next stop, the horizon!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_linnai_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Target acquired.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_scan.play_favor_word_linnai_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Gotta go fast!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_linnai_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Alright, what's the jackpot?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_linnai_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Not bad. This'll work.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_linnai_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "She's all yours.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_linnai_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_linnai_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "\"A New Journey\"",
      "content": "After passing the entrance exam, Lynae received her very own acceptance letter, officially becoming a student of <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>. Once, a similar sheet of paper began an unknown journey. Now, this one marks her first true opportunity to choose her own path and her place of belonging.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure129_UI.T_Treasure129_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"Unsanctioned\" Mod Kit",
      "content": "A kit packed with all kinds of motorcycle mods and functional add-ons, including but not limited to a fireworks-launching module, folding glider wings, and a sidecar-mounted noodle cooker... Any single item is enough to send Mr. S.I.G.M.A. into a full-blown system alarm sprint.\n\n\"I only built them to test the idea! I never actually installed them on a real vehicle!\" That's Lynae's standard defense when the chaotic contents of her dorm are inevitably discovered.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure128_UI.T_Treasure128_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Cactus Pillow",
      "content": "A gift from a student Lynae once helped, given to welcome her to the Academy, said to be a classic design from her favorite New Federation road movie.\n\nSoft, green, and shaped like a cactus, it is entirely thornless, resting not on sandy grit but on the plush bedding of her dorm bed. It stands silent guard over every vivid, colorful dream… if you can look past its uniquely expressive face.\n\n\"Hm? This pillow? It's cute! And it's the limited re-release version!\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure130_UI.T_Treasure130_UI"
    }
  ],
  "special_cook": {
    "id": 80001081,

    "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconCook/T_IconCook_091_UI.T_IconCook_091_UI",
    "rarity": 4
  },

      "skill": {
        "name": "Chroma Drift",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color></size>\nWith full <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> in the <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color>, hold Normal Attack to enter a charging state.\nDuring this state, 15 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> will be converted to 12.5% of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> every 0.2s. Lynae is immune to interruption and takes {0} less DMG.\nUpon releasing Normal Attack or when <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> is full, Lynae casts Spark Collision of varying strengths based on the ratio of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>:\n- Spark Collision Lv. 1: <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> <50%\n- Spark Collision Lv. 2: 50% ≤ <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> < 100%\n- Spark Collision Lv. 3: <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>=100%\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack</color>.\nPerform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\nWith 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 1 & 4</color> track enemies in a greater distance.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, hold Normal Attack on the ground to cast this skill. Consume STA to continuously attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG. Release to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast this skill. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\nCannot gain new charges while in the air. The available charges reset when Lynae is the active Resonator and is on the ground.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack</color>.\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.",
        "param": [
          "50%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Charging State</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Default State</color> with full <color=Highlight>Overflow</color>, hold Normal Attack to enter a charging state and then release to dash toward the target.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Roller Skate Heavy Attack</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Roller Skating Mode</color>, hold Normal Attack on the ground to continuously cast Ground Heavy Attack and deliver a finisher blow upon release. Hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Mid-air Heavy Attack.\n<size=10></size>",

      "skill": {

      "skill": {
        "name": "Chromaticity Modeling",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Optical Sampling Stage</color></size>\nLynae is in <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color> by default. While in this state, <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> recovers during certain skills.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade</color></size>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> sends Lynae into <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster <color=Highlight>Free Skating</color> and <color=Highlight>Speed Skating</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, with at least 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, Jump is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>.\nConsume 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.\nWhile in combat, each stage of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> cast recovers 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.\nWithin a certain time after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1</color> {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2</color> also pulls in nearby targets.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color></size>\nDuring <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> is on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.\nThis skill consumes 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color></size>\nDuring <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and this skill is not on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.\nThis skill consumes 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color> and grants all nearby Resonators in the team {0} points of Tune Break Boost for {1}s.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>\nInflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> when hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!</color>.\nLynae can switch between <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>:\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis</color></size>\nDeal an instance of <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG, to targets within range affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Overflow</color></size>\nLynae can hold up to 120 points of Overflow.\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> recovers during Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter, or when Intro Skill is cast.\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> becomes available.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lumiflow</color></size>\nLynae can hold up to 120 points of Lumiflow.\nDuring <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>:\n- Restore 20% of <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> per second when Lynae is moving on the ground/climbing, or performs a successful Dodge on the ground, or within a certain time during <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Additive Color</color>, ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> starts to deplete by 20% per second while Lynae is staying still on the ground/climbing/swimming or off the field, or after a certain time following the use of the skills listed above.\n- <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> does not change while Lynae is not in any of the states described above.\nExiting <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>.\nWith 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases. <color=Highlight>Speed Skating</color> consumes STA over time.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>True Color</color></size>\nLynae can hold up to 3 points of True Color.\nDuring combat, each time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> is cast, gain 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>. With 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> become available.\nExiting <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.",
        "param": [
          "40",
          "30"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Roller Skating Mode</color></size>\nAfter the <color=Highlight>Charging State</color>, Lynae enters <color=Highlight>Roller Skating Mode</color> and unlocks new moves.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color></size>\nDuring <color=Highlight>Roller Skating Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Jump and consume 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> to perform a leap attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Inflict <color=Highlight>Photochromic Flux</color> on targets hit. Can be cast up to 3 consecutive times.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Roller Skate Plunge Chain Attack</color></size>\nDuring <color=Highlight>Roller Skating Mode</color>, while in mid-air with max <color=Highlight>True Color</color>, if <color=Highlight>Enhanced Roller Skate Plunge Attack</color> is not on cooldown, cast <color=Highlight>Enhanced Roller Skate Plunge Attack</color>, otherwise cast <color=Highlight>Roller Skate Plunge Attack</color> instead. Inflict <color=Highlight>Photochromic Flux</color> on targets hit.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Roller Skate Plunge Attack</color> increases the Tune Break Boost for all nearby Resonators in the team.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Photochromic Flux</color> inflicts <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture - Shifting</color> or <color=Highlight>Tune Strain - Shifting</color> on targets based on the current <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Overflow</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Default State</color>, attacks recover <color=Highlight>Overflow</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Lumiflow</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Roller Skating Mode</color>, moving or attacking continuously restores <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>True Color</color></size>\nWhile in combat, each <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> grants 1 point of <color=Highlight>True Color</color>.",

        "name": "Spectral Analysis",
        "desc": "Lynae can inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on targets.\nLynae can respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.\n- Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>: When any Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG and inflicts the <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> state, Lynae casts <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis</color>.
