    "info": "The attending physician of Startorch Academy's Resonator Nursing Unit, renowned for his keen intellect and unshakable composure. Rumor has it nobody has ever seen him lose control.\n \nHe is a keen listener adept at dissecting the shadows in a person's heart. From the unhealing wound on his hand, golden blood seeps, a substance he can summon to become a blade of utmost precision.",
    "talent_name": "Phase Transition",
    "talent_doc": "[Filed from: <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>: <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te> Faculty Records]\n[Forte Examination Report RA2462-G]\n \nName: Luuk Herssen\n\nForte Overview: Examination confirms the subject's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located at the center of the right palm, marked by a chronic, unhealing wound. Physical signs and bloodwork indicate the presence of an anomalous energy fluid—an \"Ichor\"—circulating within the subject. This substance can rapidly alter its phase state under conscious will. Activation is accompanied by a burning sensation and transient high temperatures. Long-term use has resulted in color blindness. Currently, the subject perceives only the color gold, with all other hues rendered in grayscale.\n\nThe subject reports stable symptoms and declines further treatment.\n \n<i>\"Examination and reporting were conducted by the subject personally to ensure accuracy of records.\"</i>\n<i>\"Location: Startorch Academy - Resonator Nursing Unit. \nRecorder: Luuk Herssen.\"</i>",
    "talent_certification": "Analysis Performed: <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> Fluctuation Stability Test\n\nResult: Rabelle's Curve test sample exhibits an elongated elliptical waveform with considerable amplitude. However, a clear periodic rhythm is observed, and Resonant Criticality thresholds have not been approached.\n\nAssessment: The subject demonstrates stable control under high-load conditions, with data indicating exceptional self-regulation and mental focus. No indications of loss of control were observed.\n\nConclusion: Subject stability is excellent. No present risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te>. Psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary. Scheduled follow-up testing with continued monitoring of neural fatigue indices is recommended.\n\nThe subject has expressed willingness to cooperate with subsequent observation.\n \n <i>\"Dr. Luuk... is this wording all right? It feels a bit too official.\"</i>\n <i>\"It's perfectly acceptable. You did a good job.\"</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Ma Zhengyang",
    "cv_name_jp": "Tachibana Shinnosuke",
    "cv_name_ko": "Min Seung Woo",
    "cv_name_en": "Griffyn Bellah"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "\"Brother\"",
      "content": "The cold light glared deep into the night. Luuk sat beneath it and held out his hand without protest. The man known as his \"father\" gripped his palm, still unmistakably a child's, and watched as golden blood, \"Ichor,\" oozed from the wound like molten gold.\n \nLuuk knew the man wasn't looking at him, but through him, at another child. The real son who had died of a rare disease. Luuk was only a container to carry that obsession, a chance to fill the vacancy. But the change his father longed for never came. The Ichor flowed on in silence, and the feverish light in his father's eyes slowly dimmed into disappointment.\n \n \"...Why won't it change? You're one of the few who can tolerate the Ichor,\" his father murmured. The words shook the child's eardrums like thunder. \"It's the most promising cure we have for rare diseases... Even after everything we've invested in this... Why is there never any change?\"\n \nThat was when Rhein joined the \"family.\"\n \nLuuk watched his father speak, excitement making his voice unsteady, about how this child was just like him: afflicted by a rare disease, but able to endure the Ichor treatment. \"He's your brother now.\"\n \nLuuk looked at this \"brother,\" unrelated by blood. The boy was smaller than himself, his skin pallid from chronic illness, clearly too young to understand the world, let alone what this research into \"Golden Blood\" meant, and the hopes he now carried on his frail shoulders. Like any child his age, he was simply overjoyed by the candy his new \"father\" placed in his hand. \n \nA child who loved sweets. Luuk Herssen gazed at the soft curls on the boy's head and felt the urge to stroke them. He reached out, then stopped, remembering the wound on his palm that refused to heal.\n \nJust as his father expected, Rhein grew attached to Luuk almost immediately. Before he had learned many words, he was already chasing after him, calling out \"brother\" again and again.\n \nWhat his father did not expect was how quickly Rhein would reject the Ichor. Faster than Luuk ever had. The treatment ceased to work, and soon his body wasted away until he was barely able to leave his bed.\n \nThen came Rhein's birthday. Luuk carried him on his back, keeping to the shadows along the walls as they slipped through the long corridors and out of the house. He ran and ran, until fresh, earthy air filled his lungs, until a starry sky, dazzling almost to excess, pushed aside the cold ceiling lights of the treatment room.\n \nThey stopped at a forgotten garden at the edge of the estate.\n \nIt was littered with broken pots and dead leaves, hardly a beautiful sight. But the soil was soft, the air alive, and for Rhein, who had been confined to sickrooms for far too long, his eyes lit up all the same.\n \n\"Happy birthday, Rhein.\"\n \nBreathing hard, Luuk pulled something from inside his coat: a small, clumsily wrapped... thing. It was lopsided, its surface mottled with burnt brown and white cream. Piped on top was the shape of a little bear, the logo of Rhein's favorite brand of candy.\n \n\"I... I've never made one before. It might taste bad.\" Luuk said, voice tinged with embarrassment. To cover it up, he lit the candle in haste. The frail flame flickered in the night wind, reflecting in Rhein's wide, shining eyes.\n \n\"Make a wish, then blow it out,\" Luuk said, trying to sound cheerful. An older brother needed to be reassuring. \"That way, your wish will come true.\"\n \nRhein nodded hard, clasped his hands, puffed his cheeks, and blew.\n \nWhoosh. The flame went out.\n \nThe cold closed in again, tearing Luuk out of the long dream and back to the present. The room still echoed with the faint crackle of burning logs. He opened his eyes, his gaze settling on the fireplace, now nothing but ash, only then registering the chill coiled around him.\n \n...So many years had passed.\n \nHe let out a breath and pressed the memories back into the far reaches of sleep."
    },
    {
      "title": "Undercurrent",
      "content": "Luuk realized something was wrong years after his father's death.\n \nThough he bore the title of heir to Novialle Regenerative Group, the board's seasoned veterans saw him for what he appeared to be then: an underage figurehead. Naturally, they dismissed him as no threat. But...\n \nPage by page, Luuk sifted through seemingly unrelated financial discrepancies, lab procedures just shy of scrutiny, and itineraries of his father's final months that had been erased. Like puzzle pieces, they slowly assembled into a fractured, chilling image, one called the \"truth.\" His gaze hardened.\n \nIn fact, it was no different from surgery. Cut open a surface that looked intact. Inch a sharp blade deeper. Carve out the rot where it festered against the bone.\n \nHe had done it before, and he was good at it.\n \nTo the public, all they saw was a new executive far too young for the role. He carried himself with composure and steered the conglomerate with an iron will. The initial whispers of doubt soon fell silent in the face of results. Drug development accelerated, while labs once dedicated to researching \"Golden Blood\" were shuttered, one after another.\n \nAt night, alone, Luuk peeled off his gloves and watched the Ichor bleed from his palm. The golden blood spilled across his skin, coalescing into the hardened shape of a blade. Then, with a turn of his wrist, it dissolved back into a docile fluid.\n \nAfter all these years, the \"change\" his father had obsessed over had finally appeared. And it answered to Luuk.\n \n\"But I'm done sacrificing people for you,\" he said quietly, eyes fixed on the golden gleam. \"I'm going to... use you.\"\n\n \n\"Infiltrate the Fractsidus?\" The voice from the Terminal clearly wavered.\n \n\"Yes.\" Luuk stood at the edge of the rooftop, the wind whipping at his coat. \"Too many threads lead back to them. I suspect they're connected to my father's death.\"\n \n\"...Have you thought this through? Once you go in, there's no turning back.\"\n \nLuuk looked down at the lights scattered below. How many lives, sustained only by medication, flickering weakly like candles in the wind, waiting through an endless night for illusion to burn away and dawn to finally arrive?\n \n\"There's no turning back,\" he said as he leapt into the night, voice fading into the wind, \"That's why it's worth doing.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Dark Clouds",
      "content": "The air in this Fractsidus outpost was always thick with dust, mildew, and a metallic tang.\n \nLuuk Herssen walked down the dim corridor wearing thin, silver-rimmed glasses, an old medical case swinging at his side. His steps were light, deliberate, perfectly in character: a quiet, unassuming young doctor, skilled enough to be useful, timid enough to be ignored.\n \nThe door closed behind him. What greeted him next was the heavy stench of blood and the acrid bite of disinfectant.\n \nSeveral injured members of the Fractsidus were slumped against the walls or lying on cots. As he approached, someone clicked their tongue impatiently. \"Took you long enough.\"\n \nLuuk hunched his shoulders, kept his head down, and quickened his pace until he seemed to shrink into his medical coat.\n \nThe medical case opened with a soft snap. He carefully took out the forceps and antiseptic swabs and began to clean a gash on one member's arm. In the corner, a few of the less injured members spoke in hushed tones.\n \n\"Shhh!\" Someone cut in sharply, eyes darting warily toward Luuk as he worked.\n \nThe speaker froze for a moment, then scoffed. \"What's to worry about? Him?\" He raised his voice deliberately. \"Last time he treated my shoulder, he was so nervous he was practically panting. Look at him, timid as a mouse. He'll never amount to anything.\"\n \nRight on cue, Luuk pushed his glasses back up his nose. His gaze remained lowered, focused entirely on the bandage in his hands as if he had heard nothing.\n\n\"Still, better safe than sorry,\" someone muttered. \"All outposts are on high alert. Word is, a rat's slipped in...\"\n \nTheir voices faded into indistinct murmurs. Luuk maintained his unthreatening posture, but his hands never lost their precision. Disinfecting, medicating, bandaging, each step executed without flaw. Only occasionally did he let a hint of nervousness slip: the faint clink of forceps, a bottle cap fumbled once or twice.\n \nWhen the final bandage was tied, the injured men rose and began to leave. The loud one from earlier clapped him on the shoulder in passing. \"Thanks, Doc.\"\n \n\"...Just doing my job.\" His throat bobbed as he replied softly.\n \nFootsteps faded. The door closed. The treatment room fell quiet again, the smell of disinfectant hanging faintly in the air.\n \nLuuk Herssen slowly straightened. The air of timidity evaporated. He removed his glasses, wiping the lenses as he walked toward a pile of medical supplies in the corner. Freed of the disguise, his eyes, red as pigeon blood, lifted toward the top of a cabinet.\n \nHe reached into the clutter and retrieved a listening device no larger than a button.\n \nThe net was beginning to close.\n \nAfter confirming the transmission, Luuk moved to the window and parted the heavy curtain slightly. Outside lay the Fractsidus's grim compound, the last ray of twilight dissolving into night. He put his glasses back on. One by one, distant lights flickered on, reflected in the lenses like the eyes of beasts in the dark.\n \nHe stood at the border between light and shadow, letting his eyes curve with a faint satisfaction behind the lenses.\n \nThe show had only just begun."
    },
    {
      "title": "Storm",
      "content": "Winter was ending, but the cold refused to leave. When Luuk finally pulled himself away from the mountain of corporate matters and covert investigations, he pushed open the door to the special care ward, barely recognizing the emaciated figure on the bed.\n \nRhein lay against the pillows. The curls that had once been soft and voluminous now hung yellowed and brittle against his forehead. At the sound of the door, his eyes shifted slightly. No sound followed.\n \nLuuk suddenly recalled his father's words: \"You should feel lucky. The Ichor chose you.\"\n \nDespite the color blindness and the intermittent bouts of searing pain, Luuk remained the only person truly healed by the Ichor. Without exception, the others had all followed the same grim trajectory as Rhein.\n \nLuuk took the chair by the bed. The room was silent except for the rhythmic beeping of monitors. He tried to break the suffocating quiet.\n \n\"I studied psychology for a while,\" he said. \"I thought... it might help me understand things better. Help people better.\" After a pause, he added, \"I've also gotten much better at cooking. I don't burn cakes anymore. Is there anything you want to eat? I can make it.\"\n \nSilence. Luuk didn't give up. He changed the topic.\n \n\"I've... met someone recently. A friend. Clever, reliable. {Male=He's;Female=She's} challenged a lot of my old, stubborn ideas. I think maybe I should try to change...\"\n \n\"Do you really need to?\" Rhein's voice cut in, hoarse and brittle as an ice pick. \"Aren't you the one who's always been exceptional? Not like the rest of us ordinary people.\"\n \nLuuk's breath caught. The calm he had been holding together collapsed. He looked into Rhein's eyes, once bright and lively, now dulled to near emptiness. And beneath that still surface churned something unmistakable—hatred.\n \n...\n \n\"He refuses to speak to me again,\" Luuk said quietly.\n \nThe response from the Terminal was, as always, calm. \"What he hates isn't you. It's everything the name 'Herssen' stands for. You're just the only safe target for that hatred.\"\n \nLuuk was silent for a moment. \"...Thank you.\"\n \n\"Have you found anything?\"\n \n\"The dots are starting to connect,\" Luuk replied, looking out the window. Dark clouds coiled and thickened, promising a storm. \"Tonight... I'll confirm the truth.\"\n \nThat night, rain fell as if trying to hammer the entire world into the earth.  Luuk walked alone into a deserted cemetery. White lightning tore open the sky, illuminating the gravestone ahead. It was his father's.\n \nAnd then he saw it.\n \nThrough the curtain of rain, a figure stood silently before the grave, umbrella in hand, as if they had been waiting. Raindrops exploded against the fabric, flowing down its edges like a waterfall. Yet through the blur of gray and black, Luuk could see the eyes looking back at him with perfect clarity.\n \n...Gold. Like molten Ichor. Like the first ray of sunlight upon the frostlands.\n \nThe only vivid color in an ashen world.\n \n\"If you've truly uncovered something,\" {Male=he;Female=she} said, stepping through the pooled water toward him, \"then you'll need a witness.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "After the Thaw",
      "content": "Afternoon light filtered through the window glass, casting bands of light and shadow across the floor. Students fresh from training crowded around the treatment bed, watching as Luuk Herssen wrapped the ankle of their particularly unlucky friend.\n \n\"Dr. Luuk, how are you bandaging like that?\" the injured student grinned through clenched teeth. \"Can you teach me how to do that?!\"\n \nLuuk finished with a clean knot and tapped his shoulder. \"Sure. We'll bundle the lesson with your medical bill.\" At the boy's frozen expression, Luuk curved his lips. \"I'm joking. But remember to warm up next time. I'd hate to see you competing from a wheelchair.\"\n \nLaughter rippled through the room.\n \n\"Dr. Herssen, we're heading to the Royan Market later! Coming with us?\"\n \nLuuk glanced at the clock and shook his head with sincere regret. \"Not today. I've got other appointments coming up.\" He leaned in and lowered his voice. \"And I heard the cafeteria cakes are half price today. If you're late, there'll be nothing left.\"\n \nThe students smacked their foreheads and filed out in a burst of noise. The infirmary door shut behind them, cutting off the chatter. In the sudden quiet, the scent of disinfectant stood out somehow. Luuk turned to the window, recalling the last time he'd seen sunshine like this.\n \nThat was also the last time he saw Rhein.\n \nOr rather, it was hard to say whether the \"creature\" whose skin was veined with gold could still be called Rhein. The treatment plan that had consumed the conglomerate's lifetime of effort had failed to cure any rare disease patients except Luuk Herssen. In his final moments, Rhein didn't even die from his illness. The Ichor, once believed to be his salvation, had completely consumed him. Driven mad, he had injured several people and fled the ward, teetering on the edge of a total, violent breakdown. Luuk felt the Ichor in his palm grow searing hot, eager to become a blade. But…\n \nWas there truly no other way?\n \nLuuk stared into eyes that had once sparkled over a piece of candy and found no trace of the boy left. The Ichor burned, urging him on, but he hesitated, thinking of a way to stop Rhein without killing him.\n \nA blizzard of snow and mindless roars crashed over him, whiting out his vision.\n \n\"There's another way.\" He clenched his fist.\n \n\"Because I am like him. Because we... carry the same blood.\"\n \nIn that final instant, Luuk reversed the state of the Ichor in his palm. Using his own body as the anchor, he drove Rhein beneath the frozen earth. The solidifying gold bound them both. Frost spread from his feet as burning pain surged from his palm. Within him, the two forces met in a violent, silent standstill.\n \nAs his consciousness began to fade, he sensed someone rushing to his side. A soft voice asked if he could still see. He nodded. In a bleached world, he saw the sun rising over the distant frostlands, and much closer, eyes even brighter than that dawn.\n \n\"We'll make a promise.\" {Male=he;Female=she} had said. No matter how many winters it took, they'd see each other again. He'd open his eyes, and {Male=he'd;Female=she'd} be standing right here, just like today.\n \nHe thought, that must be…\n \nClick.\n \nLuuk turned. A flood of sunlight spilled into the room, outlining the figure in the doorway. A familiar warmth seeped into his monochrome world, shattering the grey expanse within him into a shower of golden light.\n \n...That must be when the sun rises once more.\n \nLuuk smiled and walked toward the light. Outside the window, a new leaf, loosened by a soft spring breeze, drifted down and came to rest on the sill.\n \nThe long winter had finally passed."
    }

      "title": "Aerial Attack: I",
      "content": "Return to silence!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_sp_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: II",
      "content": "Entombed in daybreak!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_sp_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: III",
      "content": "Blink, and agony ends.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_sp_03.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_sp_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Game over.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Time to incise.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Ha, got you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Imbalance ends here.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_sp_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Ash takes form.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_sp_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Rise anew!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_sp_03.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill01_sp_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VII",
      "content": "Rot resected!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VIII",
      "content": "Veins exposed.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Forte Circuit: I",
      "content": "Heh, as expected.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill03_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill03_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Forte Circuit: II",
      "content": "Accurate prediction.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill03_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_skill03_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "My scalpel... etches your epitaph.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "I deliver... merciful death.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "I bestow, eternal peace.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_luhesi_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Pain relief initiated.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_qte_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: II",
      "content": "Shh... Struggling only pains you more.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_qte_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_qte_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: III",
      "content": "Immediate procedure.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_qte_03.play_favor_word_luhesi_skill_qte_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "...A deep incision.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_behit_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_behit_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "...My past cuts deeper.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "...A bearable price.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Heh, finally, some blood.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Now... that's more like it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Once again... we part.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_die_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Such... a quiet end.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_die_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Back there... again?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_die_03.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Step forth, my partner.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform: I",
      "content": "Split in form.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hxchange_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hxchange_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform: II",
      "content": "I am the vessel.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hxchange_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_hxchange_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Right on schedule.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_engage.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider: I",
      "content": "Hmm, refreshing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider: II",
      "content": "A nice change of view.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_fly_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Hmm... A clear scan.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_scan.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "The path's clear.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Oh? What's hidden inside?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Hmm. Just a few scratches. Everything's functional.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Hope this helps.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luhesi_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_luhesi_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Non-Prescription Glasses",
      "content": "Used primarily as part of his cover while tracking the Fractsidus.\n \nOfficially, they're to keep a low profile. Unofficially, he finds the act itself entertaining, almost ritualistic.\n \nSomeone once joked that the glasses made him look like a hack scholar out to swindle people. In response, he adjusted the frame with studied restraint and replied, with complete sincerity, \"You're absolutely right.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure137_UI.T_Treasure137_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Medical Gloves",
      "content": "A pair of pristine white medical gloves. They conceal his <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> and the old, unhealing wound from which flows the golden blood he calls \"Ichor.\"\n \nTo him, this blood is a source of power. To others, it is a searing danger. So he keeps that gleam, and the history it represents, neatly contained beneath the spotless fabric.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure139_UI.T_Treasure139_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Faded Candy Wrapper Bookmark",
      "content": "Tucked between the pages of a book on his desk is a candy wrapper, its edges faintly curled. Printed on it is a \"Sunshine Bear\" design long since discontinued. Back when he was a child, his father would give him this candy as an occasional reward.\n \nNow, that man is gone. That home is gone. The candy, too, is no longer in production. He smooths the faded wrapper and uses it as a bookmark, compressing a childhood of conflict and pain into something fragile yet enduring enough to quietly slip between the pages of memory.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure136_UI.T_Treasure136_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Such is Light",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\nHurl out a whirling blade on Stage 3, which disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that can deal damage or leaves the field.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to jump into the air, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Stage 4 is a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> Stage {0} and 3 in mid-air.\nLuuk Herssen attacks with <color=Highlight>Scythe: Dissection</color> when the input is <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>.\nLuuk Herssen attacks with <color=Highlight>Scythe: Resection</color> when the input is <color=Highlight>Jump</color>. He also inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for {1}s and reduces DMG taken by {3} for {2}s.\nAs the active Resonator, while in mid-air, this skill's cycle will not be reset.\nWhile in mid-air, <color=Highlight>hold Normal Attack</color> to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> right after a successful Dodge on the ground to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> right after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to flash toward the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",
        "param": [
          "2",
          "25",
          "1",
          "15%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. \n<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> right after a successful Dodge to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Reunion of All the Fallen",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Golden Reflux</color></size>\nFlash toward the target and deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for 25s.\n<color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color> has 2 charges.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Aureole of Execution</color></size>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> replaces <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> with <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color>, which deals Basic Attack DMG and inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for 25s.\n<color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> has {0} forms, including <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Ring</color>, <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Breach</color>, and <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color>.\nCasting any form of <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> grants <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=151001>Endnotes on the Endgame</te></color> and switches <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> to the next form in sequence.\nSwitching to another Resonator resets the cycle of <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is reset to <color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Ring</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, and reset the <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle to Stage 1.\nThe next <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color> is no longer available if <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is cast in mid-air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Breach</color></size>\nSpin and dash forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to enemies along the path and resetting the <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle to Stage 1. Then, hurl out an <color=Highlight><te href=151004>Ichor Blade</te></color>.\nThe next <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color> is no longer available if <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is cast in air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color></size>\nHurl out Solid-State Ichor, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and forming an <color=Highlight>Ichor Deposit</color> on the ground.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color></size>\nFlash toward the target and deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ichor Deposit</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Ichor Deposit</color> detonates automatically after {3}s, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Endnotes on the Endgame</color></size>\nIncrease the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> by {4}, stacking up to {2} times. Casting <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> or switching to another Resonator removes all stacks.",
        "param": [
          "3",
          "1",
          "3",
          "5",
          "25%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight>Tune Strain - Shifting</color>. The skill has 2 charges.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> becomes available right after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color>, which deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> that's considered Basic Attack DMG, inflicts <color=Highlight>Tune Strain - Shifting</color>, and increases Luuk Herssen's <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> DMG, stacking up to 3 times.\n<color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> has 3 forms, which rotate in sequence each time <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> is cast.",
        "simple_param": [
          "1",
          "3"
        ],

        "desc": "When Resonators in the team directly damage and defeat targets, if the targets are affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>:\n- If Luuk Herssen has no Perpetuating Daytime, gain stacks of Perpetuating Daytime equal to the stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.\n- If Luuk Herssen already has Perpetuating Daytime, and the target's stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> exceed the current stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, increase Perpetuating Daytime's stacks to match the target's <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> stacks.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Perpetuating Daytime</color></size>\n- When Resonators in the team casts <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color>, if the target is affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color>,  Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, then apply equal stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target, up to the target's current <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> stack cap.       "skill": {
        "name": "Spark from the Frost",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color></size>\nWhen the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color> is hurled out, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color>.\nSlam down from the air to detonate the <color=Highlight><te href=151005>Ichor Deposit</te></color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG) and recovering all STA.\n<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> is no longer available when Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> is cast or Luuk Herssen is switched off the field.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Aureate Judge</color></size>\nWith full <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te>, enter the <color=Highlight>Aureate Judge</color> state. In this state, Luuk Herssen gains the following effects:\n- <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> does not restore. The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> increase by {15}.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> and <color=Highlight><te href=151005>Ichor Deposit</te></color> DMG by {15}.\n- {1} points of <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> is consumed each time Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> is cast.\n- <color=Highlight>Aureate Judge</color> ends when <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> depletes.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Golden Rule</color></size>\nWhen Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule. When Resonators with Golden Rule cast Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator is Luuk Herssen, remove all Golden Rules on Resonators in the team and grant Luuk Herssen {3} points of <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> and {4} points of Concerto Energy. Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule again after {2}s. This effect does not apply in Co-op Mode.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dawnlit Keep</color></size>\nLuuk Herssen gains <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over {5}s or casts Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Before Injection of Dawn</color>.\nDawnlit Keep is capped at {7} stack. When taking damage from enemies, consume <SapTag=9>{9}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=9} of Dawnlit Keep to reduce the DMG taken by {14} and gain immunity to interruptions for {10}s. This effect can be triggered once per second.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Radiant Reave</color></size>\nWhen Luuk Herssen performs Dodge in mid-air, he briefly stays airborne and hurls out an <color=Highlight><te href=151004>Ichor Blade</te></color>.\nLuuk Herssen consumes STA continuously while airborne.\nIf Luuk Herssen is launched into mid-air, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge</color> before landing to trigger this effect, up to 3 times. When he is on the ground or switched out for more than {12}s, the trigger count is reset.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ichor Blade</color></size>\nDeal fixed <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG that is not affected by any DMG Bonus.\nOnly one <color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> can exist at a time. It cannot trigger <color=Highlight>Counterattack</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> cannot be launched without a nearby target.\n<color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that deal damage or leaves the field.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ichor Flow</color></size>\nLuuk Herssen holds up to {0} points of Ichor Flow.\nNormal Attacks, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> restore Ichor Flow on hit.\nCasting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Before Injection of Dawn</color> restores {13} points of Ichor Flow.",
        "param": [
          "300",
          "100",
          "24",
          "200",
          "12",

          "1",

          "110%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill - Form III</color>, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to slam down, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Aureate Judge</color></size>\nCertain skills restore <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>. When <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> is full, the DMG Multipliers increase for all <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skills</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Golden Rule</color></size>\nWhen other Resonators in the team cast Outro Skill and Luuk Herssen is the incoming Resonator, he additionally restores <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> and Concerto Energy. This effect has a cooldown of {0}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dawnlit Keep</color></size>\nLuuk Herssen gains {2} stack of <color=Highlight>Dawnlit Keep</color> when he stays out of combat for over {1}s or casts Intro Skill, which reduces DMG taken and grants immunity to interruptions for a time.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Radiant Reave</color></size>\nHurl out a whirling blade to attack when Dodging in mid-air, dealing fixed <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Protocol Breach",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Payload</color></size>\nCast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> to charge forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Automatically cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload Stage {0}</color> upon hit, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, and trigger <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> which inflicts <color=Highlight><a href=骇破·偏移></a></color> on the target. If no target is hit during the charge, the skill's CD is reduced by {1}%. The CD reduction effect will not be triggered if the skill is not successfully cast or is interrupted in the action.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color></size>\nCast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> to cut through the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, before granting <color=Highlight>Digital Handshake</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Digital Handshake</color>: when not in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, gain <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color> every second. This effect is removed after entering <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> or casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {3}</color>.\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after this skill lands to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {4}</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color> reaches {5}% or Lucy is in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>.\nCast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflicting <color=Highlight><a href=骇破·偏移></a></color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {6}</color>.\nReset the CD of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>.",
        "param": [
          "2",
          "70",
          "10",
          "2",
          "2",
          "100",
          "2"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Payload</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Hitting a target triggers <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>. If this skill fails to hit, a certain amount of <color=Highlight>CD</color> will be reduced proportionally.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color></size>\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color></size>\nWhen the Forte Gauge <color=Highlight>TCP</color> is full, or while Lucy is in the <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> state, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>.\nDeal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Netrunner",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color></size>\nLucy deep dives into Cyberespace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for {0}s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to {1} different <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of RAM.\nWhile in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within her view. Marked targets will be applied with all <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects.\nWhile in the Protocol Interface, adjust the field of view to mark more targets.\nWhile in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Override</color> and deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects will not be applied when there are no marked targets. Wait until the end of the duration or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Override</color>, closing the Protocol Interface.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\n<size=10></size>\n<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Ping</color>\nRequires {3} RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all nearby targets without having to adjust the view, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction</color>\nRequires {4} RAM. Marked targets take {5}% increased damage for {6}s.\n<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol</color>\nRequires {7} RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by {8}% for {9}s.\n<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout</color>\nRequires {10} RAM. Deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all marked targets, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color>\nRequires {11} RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by {12}% for {13}s.\n<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch</color>\nRequires {14} RAM. Causes all Marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be nullified for {15}s.\n<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis</color>\nRequires {16} RAM. Convert all marked targets and reduce their Vibration Strength by a set proportion. Only effective against Common Class enemies.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> is cast, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>. Lucy gains all effects of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>, and the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Override</color> is greatly increased.\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, or when Lucy exits the <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Ghost Cyberware",
        "desc": "If Lucy takes no damage for {0}s while on the field, she gains <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>.       "skill": {
        "name": "Depths of Blackwall",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Cloud Portal</color></size>\nWhen not in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> upon hitting a target. At {0}% <color=Highlight>TCP</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> clears all <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Algorithm Compaction</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>, Lucy enters <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> and gains <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight>SQL</color>. Her <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Lucy's <color=Light>Spectro DMG Bonus</color> is increased by {2}% for {3}s.\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> will not grant <color=Highlight>SQL</color> again.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> upon hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Reaching {4}% <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> replaces <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color> with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>.\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy has <color=Highlight>SQL</color>, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by {5}% and remove <color=Highlight>SQL</color>.\nWhen casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy does not have <color=Highlight>SQL</color>, she loses {6}% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below {7}%, no HP is consumed.\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>.\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, or if no attacks are performed within {8}s after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, Lucy exits the <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> state and removes the additional <color=Light>Spectro DMG Bonus</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hack Response - Data Crash</color></size>\nLucy deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><a href=骇破·干涉></a></color> and applies the same target with <color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>, considered as Hack DMG.\n<color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>: Triggered upon the target performing an attack, Stagnating the target for {9}s.",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Prisoner's Dilemma",
      "content": "\"Did you hear? That new Director at the <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te>'s Defense Division doesn't let anything get past her!\" This rumor spread quickly through <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, soon becoming the city's hot topic.\n\nThe Ministry of Development ordered a batch of materials intended for the construction of a new defense line, but one container was filled with unlabeled, subpar goods. To complicate the matter even more, the batch had three different manufacturers, none willing to take responsibility for the defect.\n\n\"Director Taoqi, you have to help us sort this out. The Ministry of Development can't just accuse innocent people!\"\n\nThe three representatives said, their voices growing louder in an attempt to attract more attention.\n\nTaoqi calmly navigated through the commotion while softly putting off the noisy representatives. \"Alright, alright, I understand,\" even though she wasn't really paying attention to their complaints. She then crouched down to inspect the unlabeled container. After examining a few pieces of materials for a while, Taoqi seemed to have an idea. In a casual tone, she turned to the three representatives and said, \"But it seems one of you is lying. Or perhaps, all three of you are.\"\n\nAfter that, Taoqi and her junior, Xiaoyu, discreetly visited three manufacturing factories. They gathered clues about the machinery, transportation routes used that evening, and delivery schedules. With this information, Taoqi was able to solve the puzzle and ensure those who had been deceitful would face consequences.\n\nWithin days, rumors spread throughout the city. One of the three representatives was interrogated by Director Taoqi of the Ministry of Development. Then, news surfaced about another representative being caught, followed by the final one. Eventually, Jinzhou News broke a story revealing their collusion in supplying substandard materials. The public was left stunned, while only Taoqi and Xiaoyu knew the truth.\n\n\"I know! It-it's the typical prisoner's dilemma! You brought one of them in for a 'private talk' first, then you made sure the other two knew what happened. All of this was meant to put pressure on them so they'd betray and tell on each other, right? But how did you know they were all lying?\"\n\n\"People can lie, but machines can't. Each factory has its unique machine specifications. The answer was already clear when I examined those materials. Oh well... it did cost me several lunch breaks.\" Taoqi complained as she pulled her sleep mask down, determined to make up for those lost breaks."
    },
    {
      "title": "Taoqi's Tempo",
      "content": "\"Ugh... another workday.\"\n\nWith a reluctant sigh, Taoqi struggled to crawl out of her cozy cocoon of blankets, setting her eyes on the slowly rising sun over <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. For her, it marked the beginning of another ordinary day.\n\nThe streets were bustling with breakfast stalls and the working crowd was already queuing up. Some left money and snatched a bag of buns in a hurry to get to work. No need for stall owners to raise their voices, everyone was eager for a quick bite before heading off.\n\nJinzhou, after a good night's rest, sprang to life again.\n\nAmidst the bustling crowd, Taoqi emerged at a leisurely pace. Her sleep mask was still worn on her forehead, and she was yawning from time to time, looking as if she hadn't fully woken up yet.\n\n\"Hmm... which line should I join?\"\n\nRubbing her eyes, Taoqi sized up each stall and silently counted, \"Three, two, one...\"\n\nUpon completing her counting, the person at the front of the queue left with a bag of freshly baked buns in hand.\n\nTaoqi seemed to be counting the time needed to steam buns at each stall. After checking the time and the number of people in the queues, she made her decision.\n\n\"Hmm... Great. Bet I won't be late today.\"\n\nTaoqi gently tapped one hand against the other on a tempo to track the time. As the queue inched forward, she noticed that her tempo of \"three, two, one\" was slightly ahead of the queue's progress.\n\n\"Oh? Looks like I might not make it on time, after all.\"\n\nTaoqi was determined to clock in on time, but her counting didn't match the queue's progress. She checked her tapping speed and confirmed it was accurate. Was the stall owner slowing down? She cautiously observed them, their hands moving in a blur. Confused, she couldn't figure out the reason for the inconsistency. Time was ticking, and she really needed to get to work on time.\n\n\"I see. This must be the issue?\" \n\nAfter a while, her attention was drawn to a child's pinwheel and then back to the stove, where a large hole allowed the wind to spread the fire. But the vendor didn't seem to notice.\n\nTaoqi left the queue, grabbed a box, and shielded the fire from the wind.\n\n\"Excuse me, young lady, what are you doing?\"\n\n\"Just trying not to be late!\"\n\nTaoqi explained with a satisfied grin as she returned to her original place in the queue. However, it seemed she would have to queue up again.\n\n\"Oh my, I'm definitely going to be late now.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Taoqi's Time",
      "content": "Despite Taoqi's lazy appearance, as if she could nod off anytime, Taoqi is consistently flawless in all she does.\n\n\"Do you think Ms. Taoqi has fallen asleep again?\" New recruits at the Ministry of Development frequently share these doubts. In such situations, colleagues who are familiar with Taoqi always assure them that she is indeed a very dependable leader.\n\n\"Ms. Taoqi, I'm sorry to bother you, but I've been trying to optimize this construction plan for quite a while, yet I'm still stumped...\" In her spare time, Taoqi often finds herself caught by young colleagues seeking her advice.\n\n\"Hmm... it's getting late. Let's call it a day for now. Let's go for a walk. I heard there's a new restaurant with great food. Want to check it out?\"\n\n\"Uh, p-pardon please?\" Her Juniors often struggle to keep up with her abrupt topic changes.\n\nTaoqi rarely tells anyone what to do. She believes in letting people work it out themselves.\n\nShe brought her bewildered junior to a busy street market, the same one she helped improve for easier community access and better city planning. Taoqi urged him to observe everything on their stroll: the sights, sounds, and tastes of the street. She explained that by paying attention to the locals and their conversations, they could uncover hidden issues that really needs addressing. The junior thanked Taoqi with a grateful smile, having realized her intention. Taoqi smiled warmly in return.\n\nTaoqi is everyone's \"reliable big sister\", both in work and in everyday life. \n\n\"Ms. Taoqi, please...\"\n\nA certain storage space, once Taoqi's private nap haven, has been transformed into a comfortable \"chat room\" with a cozy sofa, perfect table, and delicious tea. Her junior colleagues now often come for her consultation during their free time. \n\nTaoqi lounged lazily on the sofa, listening patiently to her juniors as they opened up about their worries. \n\n\"You know what? The housing prices here have risen again!\"\n\n\"Indeed it has.\" \n\n\"Gotta work harder to repay the mortgage, but the thought of this stresses me out so much. I feel deflated...\" \n\n\"Same here...\"\n\n\"Sigh... Time flies by so fast. It's about time to go back to work...\" \n\nPerhaps this chatroom's popularity simply stems from it being a place for young people to spill their troubles and find solace in each other.\n\nAs for Taoqi, she only needs to be a patient listener, understanding their worries and offering advice when appropriate to gently lighten their burdens."
    },
    {
      "title": "Reunion with Friends",
      "content": "Taoqi endured unfounded ill will for her slowness as a child. But luckily, she met some friends who accepted and defended her.\n\nGrowing up, they were inseparable. But as adults, their paths diverged. The eldest joined the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> and is now stationed on the frontlines; the second became a teacher in a remote town, nurturing the next generation; the youngest became a travel writer who is constantly on the go. \n\nDespite their different careers, they always come back to their hometown. Taoqi, the second youngest of the group who stayed in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, is their go-to for meetups and farewells. \n\nAs they wait for her one more time, someone brings up her name and catches the attention of other diners. It seems she's quite well-known here.\n\n\"Oh really? Are you talking about Ms. Taoqi?\"\n\n\"I thought Ms. Taoqi had always been a laid-back person?\" \n\n\"Yeah, it's true. But she's changed a lot since she was little! Remember how she used to follow us around everywhere? Now, she seems so chill all the time. It's crazy. She used to get lost and cry about being left behind.\" \n\n\"She was even bullied...\" \n\n\"Really? I can't believe Ms. Taoqi went through that...\" \n\n\"Haha, bet you can't. And that's when we, her dear friends, stepped in. We kicked some serious butt for her!\" \n\n\"Wow... what did Ms. Taoqi do, then?\" \n\n\"Erm... She provided backup? Like, telling their parents, negotiating compensation and stuff.\" \n\n\"She had a sharp eye for gathering useful information... like she could quickly identify the weaknesses of the people we were up against.\" \n\n\"Oh well... She was like a little sister to me. I always tried to protect her, but one day I learned she had been quietly protecting us all along with her wisdom and sharp eye. It hit me right in the feels.\"\n\n\"She's grown a lot. Though she still does everything slowly, she seems more confident now.\" \n\n\"Wow, that's so Ms. Taoqi! I knew she was always trustworthy!\" \n\n\"Huh? Weren't we trying to tell you a different side of her?\"\n\nThe old friends all burst out in laughter.\n\n\"Whew, good afternoon, everyone. What were you all talking about? Having a good chat, I see.\"\n\n\"We've been waiting for you. Overslept your nap again, huh? You'll have to treat us for being late to this precious reunion!\"\n\n\"We were talking about you...\"\n\nTaoqi sat down, groggily rubbing her eyes,\"Is that something fun? Tell me all about it.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Work-life Balance",
      "content": "Work is work and life is life; maintaining a clear boundary between the two is essential for everything to function. \n\nTaoqi has always lived by this principle, and nothing in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> can stop her from leaving work on time. \n\nThe <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te> is a busy place, with people constantly coming and going, rushing through their tasks. In the midst of chaos, Taoqi's soft voice can always calm the storm. Amidst flipping papers, it brings peace and slows the pace.\n\n\"It's quitting time. Time to head home.\" \n\n\"Please wait a moment, Ms. Taoqi. We have a newly issued document that requires your attention.\"\n\n\"Well, let me take a look... Doesn't seem urgent. I'll deal with it tomorrow.\"\n\nAfter work, Taoqi has her unique way of \"relaxation\". For her, \"relaxation\" can come in various forms — from a good sleep to a casual stroll.\n\nAs Taoqi walks home, she enjoys strolling through the streets of Jinzhou and chatting with its residents. She loves hearing stories from elders about the city's history and having lighthearted conversations with children that remind her of the hope within Jinzhou. This way of relaxation helps her become better connected to the city she lives in and also contributes to her work. \n\nOnce in the past, the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> were always struggling to defend against surprise attacks from the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. With such extensive frontlines, it was nearly impossible to detect every breach and they were constantly vulnerable. So, they turned to Taoqi for help.\n\nFeeling stressed and overwhelmed, Taoqi took a break on a swing nearby. As she watched children playing in a sandpit, an idea came to her - just like how they filled the gaps in their sandcastles, they could also fill the gaps in the frontlines. She proposed building a sand wall at the frontline during Tacet Discord assaults. This would shorten the frontlines and limit the attack paths for the enemy. With fewer spots to defend, the Midnight Rangers would have more time to assess each attack and respond accordingly based on the varying frequencies caused by sand deformation. Thanks to Taoqi's clever thinking, they were able to better protect themselves against attacks and gain some much-needed breathing room on the frontlines.\n\nAccording to Taoqi, staring at a desk all day leads to monotony and disconnect from reality. So she seeks alternative methods for efficiency. It's in her free time that she stumbles upon unexpected guidance and inspiration through serendipitous encounters."
    }

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_behit_fly_02.play_favor_word_taoqi_behit_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: III",
      "content": "Ugh, stay calm.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_behit_fly_03.play_favor_word_taoqi_behit_fly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "No biggie, just a scratch.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_hp70.play_favor_word_taoqi_hp70"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Time to focus.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_hp50.play_favor_word_taoqi_hp50"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "It was my misstep...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_hp30.play_favor_word_taoqi_hp30"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "I couldn't... protect...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_die_01.play_favor_word_taoqi_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "I wasn't reliable enough...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_die_02.play_favor_word_taoqi_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Retreat to the bulwark.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_die_03.play_favor_word_taoqi_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Counting on you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_hx_summon.play_favor_word_taoqi_hx_summon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "How reliable.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_hx_change.play_favor_word_taoqi_hx_change"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "I got your back.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_qte.play_favor_word_taoqi_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Let's watch out.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_enter_battle.play_favor_word_taoqi_enter_battle"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Wind in my aid.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_fly.play_favor_word_taoqi_fly"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "Now I'm moving fast.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_hook.play_favor_word_taoqi_hook"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Hmm... Found something interesting.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_scan.play_favor_word_taoqi_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Let's take it slow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_dash.play_favor_word_taoqi_dash"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash",
      "content": "*Effort Sound*",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_fast_run.play_favor_word_taoqi_fast_run"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Excited for what's inside? Hehe, aren't you adorable.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_chest_01.play_favor_word_taoqi_chest_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "My luck seems good like always.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_chest_02.play_favor_word_taoqi_chest_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "The more the merrier.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_taoqi_chest_03.play_favor_word_taoqi_chest_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Guardian Wall Model",
      "content": "\"The weight of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is far beyond what a model can carry, but you can feel the weight of guarding Jinzhou up close by purchasing a Guardian Wall model.\" \nThe <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te> partnered with a toy company to create this model, rumored to be a limited first edition obtained personally by Taoqi from a revered toy mogul.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure1_UI.T_Treasure1_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Jinzhou Strategies",
      "content": "The data module for Terminal loading contains Taoqi's observations and thoughts on <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, from her childhood musings to her current decisions to protect the city. Every detail has been meticulously documented in this small but powerful device. Perhaps one day, it will alter the fate of Jinzhou.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure38_UI.T_Treasure38_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Peachy Turtle",
      "content": "Taoqi always longs to catch a nice, peaceful nap during her free time. The soft and plush Peachy Turtle becomes her haven, a paradise that washes away all fatigue accumulated from work.  \"If I could live a slow-paced life just like the Peachy Turtle, and still be a reliable support for everyone, that would be perfect.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure39_UI.T_Treasure39_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Concealed Edge",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume Stamina to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\nHold Basic Attack to enter <color=Highlight>Rocksteady Defense</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Rocksteady Defense</color></size>\n- Taoqi's damage taken is reduced by {0};\n- When Taoqi is attacked during <color=Highlight>Rocksteady Defense</color>, she will cast <color=Highlight>Strategic Parry</color>;\n- <color=Highlight>Strategic Parry</color> is automatically cast after <color=Highlight>Rocksteady Defense</color> lasts for {1}s;\nIf Taoqi is attacked when casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Fortified Defense</color>, <color=Highlight>Strategic Parry</color> is automatically cast.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Strategic Parry</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-Air Attack</color></size>\nConsume Stamina to perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",
        "param": [
          "35%",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Power Shift",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Timed Counters</color></size>\nWhen carrying \"Resolving Caliber\", use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Strategic Parry</color> or Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Defense Formation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Timed Counters</color>, performing up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.\n<color=Highlight>Timed Counters</color> consume {0} \"Resolving Caliber\" upon hitting an enemy to grant a shield.\nAfter casting the Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Defense Formation</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to directly cast <color=Highlight>Timed Counters</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resolving Caliber</color></size>\nTaoqi can hold up to {1} Resolving Caliber.\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color> will consume all of Taoqi's \"Rocksteady Shields\" to grant that many \"Resolving Caliber\".\nWhile <color=Highlight>Rocksteady Shield</color> exists, when the active character is attacked, {2} \"Rocksteady Shield\" will be consumed to recover \"Resolving Caliber\".\nAfter <color=Highlight>Rocksteady Shield</color> ends, all remaining \"Rocksteady Shield\" will be consumed to grant that many \"Resolving Caliber\".",
        "param": [
          "1",
          "3",
          "1"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Timed Counters</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly after Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Strategic Parry</color> or Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Defense Formation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Timed Counters</color>, performing up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\nUpon hitting a target, <color=Highlight>Timed Counters</color> grants a shield at the cost of {0} Resolving Caliber.\nAfter casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Defense Formation</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to directly cast <color=Highlight>Timed Counters</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resolving Caliber</color></size>\nTaoqi can store up to {1} Resolving Caliber.\nTaoqi gains Resolving Caliber whenever Rocksteady Shield is consumed or ends.\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color> will consume all of Taoqi's Rocksteady Shields.",
        "simple_param": [
          "1",
          "3",
          "1"
        ],

  "chara_info": {
