    "info": "With a vengeful blade of condensed blood in hand, Ranger Danjin hunts down thieves and bandits for retribution. \nShe journeys to distant lands in pursuit of justice.",
    "talent_name": "Scarlet Shade",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1856-G]\n\nThe exact time of Resonator Danjin's Awakening remains uncertain. Notably, during Resonator Danjin's Awakening event, she exhibited an uncontrollable state of emotional outburst. It is speculated that overwhelming emotions may have catalyzed her awakening.\n\nA <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on Danjin's upper left arm. Observations have revealed distinct alterations in her physical characteristics after her Awakening. A noteworthy alteration is the reddening of her pupils after exerting her Forte to a certain threshold.\n\nResonator Danjin's frequency fluctuations are stronger than usual, displaying uncommon instantaneous changes that may result in physical damage to her surroundings and any living beings therein when left unattended.\n\nEmpirical testing has revealed that Danjin's destructive potential surpasses normal people by 78.94%.\nResonance Spectrum Pattern of this Resonator matches that of the human blood. Tests reveal strong Syntony Responses, yet the cause of Danjin's Awakening remains unclear.\n\n\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a steep rise in its middle section. Therefore, Danjin is classified as a <te href=850069>Mutant Resonator</te>.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Danjin's waveform graph shows zigzag fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is irregular. Both the upper and lower peak values are high and manifest proximity to the Criticality level. The waveform displays segments of partial fuzziness and abnormal waveform can be seen.\n\nResonant Criticality: Low, with low stability. Risk of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> remains.\n\nResonator Danjin has no recorded history of Overclocking. However, during her first Awakening, she was on the verge of reaching her Resonant Criticality. This caused her blood to exhibit an explosive state and a highly sensitive Frequency Fluctuation reaction. Danjin lost control of her behavior, resulting in the spilling of part of her Frequency Energy. No casualties were reported, but the incident was classified as a Class 2 hazard (code EX61453).\n\nDiagnostic analysis reveals that her frequency fluctuation stemmed from a huge provocation in a short time. Noticeable aftereffect persists. As a result, there is still a small chance for Resonator Danjin to enter a state of fury during violent mood swings.\n\nFurther assessment reveals that the risk of Overclocking for Danjin is closely linked to her emotional state, posing a high risk. It is recommended to closely monitor her psychological and physical condition, and conduct routine counseling and examinations.",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Crimson Shade in the Wild",
      "content": "There are many dangerous areas near <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> — the Dim Forest cloaked in towering trees; the Whining Aix's Mire shrouded in unending fog; and the Wasted Metropolis, where shadows hide unknown dangers.\n\nGenerally speaking, people would always steer clear of such dangerous places. Even on those rare occasions when they have to pass through these places, they do so carefully and try their best to hide themselves.\n\nHowever, there was one girl who didn't follow this unspoken rule. The girl, clothed in vivid red, strolled through dangerous streets with an air of ease. The bright jade pendant she wore danced to the tune of her light footsteps.\n\nNaturally, this alluring appearance made her a prime target for predators.\n\nA bandit approached her under the guise of offering help, and asked why she was wandering alone in this desolate and treacherous place.\n\n\"I'm looking for someone,\" the girl answered.\n\n\"Wow, small world! I hardly see anyone around here. Funny enough, I actually saved someone recently and they're at my place. Maybe it's the person you're looking for? Want me to take you there?\" The bandit eagerly offered.\n\nThe girl studied him thoughtfully, pondering for a moment before finally giving a timid nod. \n\nPleased with this response, the bandit immediately led the girl to his camp.\n\nThey veered off the main roads and soon found themselves in a desolate place, shrouded in dense fog and overgrown with vegetation. Eerie cries echoed from the depths of the forest — was it a child's wail or a cat's scream? No one knew the answer. \n\nThe bandit, stealing a glance at the girl, worried that his prey may be scared off by the bloodcurdling ambiance.\n\nHowever, she still wore a calm expression with no trace of fear on her beautiful face.\n\n\"Stupid chick,\" the bandit snickered to himself.\n\nAs they approached an old iron door at the end of the path, intermittent whimpers could be heard from behind it. The girl pushed the door open and inside, they found a trembling and battered little girl.\n\n\"Is this the one you're looking for?\" asked several bandits with wicked grins, surrounding the girl.\n\n\"Exactly!\" replied the girl with a bright smile.\n\nAmidst deafening screams and agonized moans, crimson blood splattered everywhere... And so began a brutal slaughter that hushed even the evening glow."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Strange Customer",
      "content": "Uncle Wei the blacksmith had a strange customer one day.\n\nIt was a young girl, who looked puny and quiet. Her request, however, was rather unusual: she asked him to repair a broken sword.\n\n\"What happened to it?\" Uncle Wei furrowed his brow and inquired. He was no stranger to repairing all kinds of damaged weapons; still, he couldn't help but wonder what could have caused such significant wear on this blade.\n\nIn his mind's eye, Uncle Wei conjured up an image of a formidable big man wielding the sword with immense power, slashing through whatever stood in his way without mercy. By no means could he relate this image to a slender girl like her.\n\n\"Sorry, I may have hit them a bit too hard... I didn't mean it...\" the girl answered, her embarrassment evident. \"Is it difficult to repair?\"\n\nUncle Wei stared at her in disbelief. He examined the rolled edge with his callused finger and replied, \"...No worries. I'll give it a go.\"\n\nWith precision and skill, Uncle Wei heated the blade until it glowed and struck it forcefully with his hammer. Sparks flew, but the blade remained unyielding. Years of expertise guided him as he inspected and stroked the damaged metal, contemplating each blow. In a moment of clarity, he discovered the problem.\n\n\"The blade is exceptionally hard but lacks toughness. Its center of mass is off now, and it has a special frequency. It's difficult to repair and sharpen with traditional tools.\"\n\n\"If you wanna get it repaired,\" Uncle Wei continued, \"you'll need some really hard gray chalks with a good amount of Tacetite. But they're not easy to get, only found in a dangerous place, with a lot of rock cliffs! Don't get your hopes up, kid.\"\n\n\"You mean the Desorock Highland, right? Please give me some time. I'll be back soon.\"\n\nWith those words, the girl dashed out like the wind, leaving Uncle Wei confused and the rolled blade forgotten. \n\nShe returned shortly after, carrying a big piece of gray chalk with ease. \n\n\"Is this enough?\" she asked, surprising Uncle Wei with her quick return from the dangerous Desorock Highland. \n\n\"Absolutely!\" he stammered, amazed at her speed. How did she make it back so quickly?\n\nThe girl smiled, and cute dimples appeared on her face — a faint red spot could be vaguely seen on one of her dimples. Was it a mole? Or was it... <i>something else?</i>"
    },
    {
      "title": "Special Loong Whisker Crisps",
      "content": "Every food vendor in Jinzhou knows Danjin. After the rain, when the sun peeks through and the air is thick with humidity, they all set up their stalls. It's a symphony of clanging pots and sweet smelling syrup. That's when Danjin shows up, handing over a neat stack of <te href=850104>Shell Credits</te> for her favorite snack: two pieces of <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisp</te>. She always puts one in her pocket first, and then eagerly breaks apart the other, savoring each piece like it's a precious gem.\n\nA food vendor lady noticed Danjin always came alone and couldn't help but feel sorry for her: Even the cheapest snacks in Jinzhou, like Loong Whiskers Crisps, seemed so precious to this girl. Wanting to spread some kindness, the lady started giving Danjin extra snacks popular with girls her age — from pretty Rock Sugar to fluffy Dreamy Floss, and more. At first, Danjin would always refuse, because she felt uncomfortable accepting someone's generosity without a good reason, and because her wallet was running on empty from constantly repairing her weapons.\n\nHowever, the lady insisted it wouldn't be trouble to let Danjin have some more sweets for free, as she always prepared extra snacks for her sweets-loving younger sister back home, who was approximately Danjin's age. Touched by this genuine kindness, Danjin eventually nodded and accepted the extra snacks.\n\nFrom that day on, every time the vendor lady gave Danjin extra snacks, a mysterious gift appeared on her stall. Rock sugar brought a Pearl Leaf, while Dreamy Floss resulted in a Caltrop. These herbs were crucial in easing her younger sister's panic disorder, which she hadn't even told Danjin about.\n\nMaybe sooner or later, her younger sister would be able to leave the house by herself, and enjoy the freshly made Loong Whiskers Crisps with Danjin."
    },
    {
      "title": "Prey or the Hunter?",
      "content": "Danjin is indeed traveling in the wild to look for someone.\n\nShe is looking for revenge.\n\nOne vicious group of bandits was kidnapping children for sinister purposes. Years ago, they slaughtered Danjin's entire family. Her younger sister, a girl with a kind soul, opened the door for them out of sympathy, only to welcome the bloodthirsty blades that claimed her family's lives.\n\nThe culprits already met the wrath of Danjin's sword, but even after many years, similar tragedies continued to occur. The evil persisted. It seemed like an impenetrable barrier, preventing anyone from escaping their grasp. Day after day, month after month, new tragedies emerged as other evildoers continued their reign of terror. Danjin knew she had to find the root and eradicate it once and for all to stop the cycle of pain and suffering inflicted upon the innocent. She would not rest until justice was served and peace was restored.\n\nDanjin decided to make herself the bait. She travelled through treacherous terrain looking all innocent and defenseless, wiping out one hideout after another while hunting for more clues.\n\nHidden throughout the wilderness were these camps, blending into the natural surroundings. With precision and thoroughness, she scoured every inch of each campsite, uncovering vital details amidst the blood-stained haystacks and dilapidated structures. \n\nHer efforts paid off when she discovered that all the camp vehicles had passed through a specific location: where the bandits had been ambushing innocent victims.\n\nHiding in the tall weeds, Danjin nibbled on a <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisp</te>, her eyes glued to the foggy crossroad. \n\nFor seven days she had been waiting at this crossroad, stopping any suspicious vehicles that passed by. She refused to give up hope of catching those bandits, no matter what.\n\nFinally, eerie headlights and crunching wheels broke through the dense fog. The wheels' creaking almost drowned out a faint whimper, but it didn't escape Danjin's ears.\n\nEmerging from her hiding place, Danjin approached the vehicle. \n\nShe recited the lines she prepared with a perfectly practiced timid voice: \"Excuse me... I'm lost. Could you please give me a ride?\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Moonlit Determination",
      "content": "Eliminating all evil is a daunting task. That foggy crossroad had turned out to be merely a transit point, but Danjin wasn't discouraged. Small progress is still progress, and besides, she had rescued some kidnapped children along the way. After escorting the children to the Patrol Station, Danjin sighed in relief and decided to return to the city for some much-needed rest.\n\nShe strolled down the decorated street illuminated by vibrant festival lanterns and warm lights. The moon shone brightly above, adding to the enchanting atmosphere of the night.\n\nMany years ago, on a similar moonlit night, her family shared precious moments together. Her mother had prepared a table full of mouth-watering dishes, whereas Danjin's younger sister happily presented two pieces of <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisp</te>, one for herself, and one for Danjin.\n\n\"B-Big sister, this is for you...\"\n\nHer reminiscing was interrupted by a small voice. A younger girl held out a piece of Loong Whiskers Crisp, speaking to Danjin timidly. The treat was sprinkled with Dreamy Floss and colorful candies that fitted the festive vibe perfectly. The vendor lady, wearing a warm smile, gestured for Danjin to take it.\n\nDanjin's legs took her closer to the stall, and it seems there is a new face working at the stall today.\n\n\"Thanks to your herbs, Xinxin can leave our house now. Since it's been safer recently, I decided to take her out to get some fresh air.\"\n\n\"It's the first time she ever dared to talk to a stranger since her recovery. Maybe this is the blessing of fate?\"\n\nIndeed, Danjin thought to herself. This little girl named Xinxin was one of the children she had rescued during one of her raids. The girl seemed to recognize Danjin, too. She took off a lantern decorating the stall and shoved it into Danjin's hand.\n\n\"C-can we... set it off together?\"\n\nDanjin nodded, and the three of them set off the lantern into the night sky. The lantern soared, carrying their wishes along with it, joining the thousands of other floating lights in the velvety night."
    }

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Silky Reveries",
      "content": "Danjin has a sweet tooth. In her youth, during those rare and cherished family reunions, her mother would always buy two pieces of <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisp</te>, one for Danjin and the other for her younger sister. This delicate sweetness brought great happiness to her life.\nAs Danjin set out on a journey on her own, she always carries a few pieces of Loong Whiskers Crisp with her as this sugary delight provides a timely energy boost for her whenever fatigue sets in. Besides, the delicate sweetness also serves as a reminder. It reminds her of her goal to help more people live a happy life and pushes her to keep moving forward.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure3_UI.T_Treasure3_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Hand Mirror",
      "content": "Danjin's master had gifted her a hand mirror. For years, as she practiced her sword skills, Danjin would see her reflection drenched in scarlet and try to stay calm. With time, she mastered the technique and the scarlet blade became obedient. But sometimes, a faint blush of crimson would still stain her cheeks, and Danjin would gently wipe it away with her hand mirror. It was a reminder of her journey from a young girl to a skilled warrior, always striving for perfection.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure30_UI.T_Treasure30_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Jade Pendant",
      "content": "Danjin's jade pendant, a symbol of a pure world bestowed upon her by her father. As a child, she couldn't comprehend its significance. But after tragedy struck and her family was killed, she wears it constantly as she roams the wild. The precious jewel attracts unsavory individuals who seek to take it from her. However, they soon learn that those who covet the pendant will face severe consequences at her hands.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure24_UI.T_Treasure24_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Execution",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDanjin performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDanjin consumes STA to launch consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to launch an attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades</color></size>\nAfter a successful Dodge Counter, Danjin can use Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crimson Fragment</color> to perform Resonance Skill: <color=Highlight>Crimson Erosion</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades</color></size>\nAfter a successful Dodge Counter, Danjin can use Resonance Skill\n<color=Highlight>Crimson Fragment</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crimson Erosion</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Serene Vigil",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave</color></size>\nAfter accumulating {0} \"Ruby Blossom\", long press <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to consume all \"Ruby Blossom\" to cast <color=Highlight>Chaoscleave</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG, and healing Danjin.\nIf current \"Ruby Blossom\" reaches over {1}, {2} \"Ruby Blossom\" is consumed instead to increase the DMG multiplier of <color=Highlight>Chaoscleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Scatterbloom</color> performed this time.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Chaoscleave</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Scatterbloom</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Ruby Blossom</color></size>\nDanjin can hold up to {3} Ruby Blossom.\nDanjin obtains \"Ruby Blossom\" when using Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crimson Fragment</color>.",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "To the Days Ahead",
      "content": "She awoke from her dream.\n\nThe sun broke over the horizon, casting a warm glow across <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>. It was the dawn of another ordinary day. Camellya opened her eyes, stretching leisurely atop the treetops. Her movements were graceful, and a fall would be unthinkable. Even if she did slip, the vines would cradle her fall. She loved sleeping like this, away from any disturbance or people.\n\n\"What a beautiful morning,\" she mused. She felt stable, in mind and body, and the thought of needing the medical pod seemed distant. This was a good thing.\n\nShe knew {PlayerName} was to remain in the Black Shores, preparing for {Male=his;Female=her} journey to <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>. The prospect delighted her, for that meant more time to talk, laugh, and spend time together.\n\nShe gave {PlayerName} a gift, a bracelet designed to monitor frequencies, just like the one {Male=he;Female=she} had given her before.\n\nIt was the first gift she had ever prepared for someone.\n\n\"How peculiar!\" she mused. To wonder about someone's safety, or whether they even existed...  it was truly a novel feeling! Surely, it meant that she cared about their life. Such thoughts were foreign—she had never cared about her own life, or that of others. But after leaving the Stellar Matrix with {PlayerName} and discovering her identity as Lady Flora, she had begun to see things in a subtle new light. \n\nStill, she had no intention of following {PlayerName} to Rinascita. Their views on certain aspects of <te href=850079>Solaris</te>' history differed, and just as she did not intend to meddle in {Male=his;Female=hers} choices, she didn't feel the need to explain her own. In fact, to spare {PlayerName} from the added burden, she had kept some truths hidden from {Male=him;Female=her}. In the Stellar Matrix, she hadn't completely lost all memories of her past.\n\nYes, her past… Camellya squinted, a soft hum escaping her lips as she contemplated her next move. She wanted to investigate further on her own, biding her time until the moment felt right to share what she knew with {PlayerName}. She had little faith in the organization built on this shore, and even less in the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System. Aside from {PlayerName}, she had little trust in anyone else.\n\nOnce, as Lady Flora, she had shied away from entanglements, unwilling to watch {PlayerName} sacrifice {Male=himself;Female=herself} for the greater good. But now her perspective had shifted. She saw little resemblance to the Lady Flora of her past. \n\nShe had followed {PlayerName} travels from <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> till now. \n\nA singular force, always moving forward, gathering a diverse array of companions along the way. \n\nShe understood that this was still not her path, yet she no longer resisted observing it. Just as one pebble meets another, sending ripples across the water's surface, she embraced the idea of being a \"variable\" in this dance. Now, the joy she derived from their connection was profound. She felt no trace of the usual boredom creeping in, nor did she wish to erase thoughts of them. Instead, her thoughts often drifted to {Male=him;Female=her}, yearning to learn more about {Male=his;Female=her} adventures and share more delightful games. It was then Camellya realized that these thoughts had already left painful yet pleasing marks on her soul, long before she ever noticed.\n\nFeeling suddenly inspired, she activated her Terminal and drafted a brief message to {PlayerName}, set to send just before {Male=his;Female=her} departure. The bracelet allowed her to check on {Male=him;Female=her} anytime, so there was nothing to worry about. Though Solaris was vast, she believed that if they were threads in the same story, their paths would surely cross again.\n\nAt a time when {PlayerName} was none the wiser, that's when she would surprise {Male=him;Female=her}! \n\nAs she envisioned this delightful moment, a melody escaped her lips. Vines twisted around her arms, climbing upwards, as tiny buds began to bloom at their tips. \n\nSuddenly, a thought struck her.\n\n\"I will give {Male=him;Female=her} a flower.\"\n\nAs this idea took root in her mind, it consumed her completely. She had to find {PlayerName}—now! The flower, born from her very being, would neither wither nor decay unless she perished. She was stunned by her own eagerness and felt a flicker of sadness. As she reflected on it, a dull ache interrupted her thoughts.\n\nWith a sigh, she chose not to dwell on it. For… Yes! A smile graced her lips as she resolved to keep that flower blooming for {PlayerName}. She would do her utmost not to die too soon.\n\nCamellya leaped from the treetops, joyfully headed toward {PlayerName}, her cherished seed of fate."
    },
    {
      "title": "Labyrinth",
      "content": "She awoke from her dream.\n\nThe walls of the medical pod sank into darkness. Enveloped in heavy silence due to sound dampening, Camellya blinked and turned her dry gaze to the right. The indicators on the Terminal screen had returned to normal. The shackles around her wrists and ankles had loosened, yet she still felt weak, forcing her to remain lying in the narrow confines of the pod.\n\nShe tried to recall what had happened. She forced a precarious composure trying to remember, but the lost memories felt like a bottomless black hole—gazing into it revealed only darkness. Her memories had fractured once again.\n\nHaving been with <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> for only a year, Camellya had recently passed the test to become an official Bloom Bearer. She now enjoyed greater access to the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System's archives of information.\n\nBefore her arrival there, she had wandered across <te href=850079>Solaris</te> for a long time.\n\nThe cave where she first awoke showed no signs of other people, only twisted plants climbing the walls. Barefoot, Camellya waded through the water until she emerged into the open air, discovering a desolate village. Her foot struck something—a stone slab bearing the faded inscription, \"Petalfall Village.\"\n\nIt took her a long time to escape that abandoned place. When hunger struck, she hunted wild beasts for sustenance. When thirst overtook her, she drank from mountain springs. It took her several months to traverse the dense forests and finally arrive at a place bustling with people. Only later did she realize that the village had likely been forgotten for hundreds of years.\n\nEven after returning to civilization, Camellya's memories remained blank, unstimulated by her new surroundings. She felt like an untamed animal, living on pure instinct. The rules and regulations of the human world were foreign to her, but she wasn't frustrated—using her Forte was enough. To her, power was an instinctive weapon, and she wielded it freely, carving her own path through the <te href=850075>Lament</te>-scarred land.\n\nInitially, everything in Solaris fascinated her. However, as she gradually learned more, boredom set in quickly. Arriving at the Black Shores had been an accident, yet Camellya felt a strange familiarity with it. A year later, she found her name in the Tethys System and learned that she had once lived and worked there, known then as Lady Flora. It was odd how she had forgotten everything yet still remembered the name \"Camellya.\" \n\nDriven by curiosity, she began her investigation of the Black Shores, eager to uncover her past and the stories of Lady Flora. What had truly happened to her?\n\nAs those thoughts surfaced, a sharp pain pierced her head again, and the flower in her chest suddenly swelled, darkening to a deep purple. The sharp thorns of its veins threatened to tear through the medical pod. Fragments of memories flickered in her mind—Ah, Lady Flora had forbidden her from recalling the past. Camellya let out a muffled scream of pain as the restraints tightened once again around her limbs, and a loud alarm blared. Medical personnel would arrive soon.\n\nYet, she knew there was little they could do. They had already examined her carefully, concluding that her <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> symptoms were unique and untreatable, manageable only through restraint. Death could offer relief, but in her current condition, she couldn't even simply die.\n\nAll she could do was wait, wait for the grace of death. This passivity chafed at her spirit. If she couldn't decide the outcome, she at least wanted to control the process. \n\n\"I'll follow my instincts until death finds me.\"\n\n\"It hurts!\" she thought.\n\nDespite her agony, Camellya laughed loudly."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Fleeting Moment",
      "content": "She awoke from her dream.\n\nLady Flora opened her eyes, feeling the cold air brushing against her fingertips, making her hands and feet slightly numb. She dawdled in her seat for a moment, slowly sitting up to take in her surroundings.\n\nThe vehicle had come to a halt in a cave, a refuge from the snowstorm outside, where an endless silver expanse of snow stretched before her. Frost flowers drifted gently from the sky, landing delicately on the tip of her nose. Shivering, she huddled deeper into her thick clothing. \n\nShe was not the kind of plant that could withstand the cold.\n\n\"Where did the leader go?\" she asked after taking a few sips of water, turning to the Bloom Bearer in the front seat. \"I didn't see {Male=him;Female=her}.\"\n\n\"The leader? {Male=He;Female=She} went west. {Male=He;Female=She} said something interesting had turned up and wanted to take a look.\" \n\n\"Why didn't {Male=he;Female=she} take me? I am {Male=his;Female=her} guard, after all!\" she complained under her breath.\n\nHer fellow Bloom Bearer chuckled as he drove, barely glancing away from the steaming soup. \"You were asleep! You haven't been sleeping well on the journey, always shivering in the cold. {Male=He;Female=She} didn't want to wake you while you finally caught some rest.\"\n\nGrumbling quietly under her breath, Lady Flora pouted and swung the door open. \"Anyway, I'm off to find {Male=him;Female=her} now!\"\n\nThe Bloom Bearer waved her off, clearly used to the dynamic between Lady Flora and their leader.\n\nLeaving the warmth of the vehicle, Lady Flora dragged her feet across the snowy expanse, memories of their first encounter in Petalfall Village flooding back. She had known they would come to this snowy plain for the mission, and despite her dislike of the cold, she knew the time spent with the leader of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> would be worth it. Most of the time, she opted to accompany {PlayerName} on various errands, leaving her footprints across the tapestry of <te href=850079>Solaris</te>, from bustling towns to unknown alcoves, safe havens to treacherous lands. Lady Flora relished this existence, brimming with the thrill of the unknown, and {PlayerName} had an uncanny talent for transforming the ordinary into something extraordinary.\n\nShe didn't mind the threat of danger. In fact, she rather enjoyed it. To her, danger signified change, and change led to excitement. She did find, however, that with her leader by her side, she stifled her impulse to seek out trouble for fun.\n\nDanger...\n\nCamellya raised her hand, the delicate chain on her wrist catching the light. The bracelet monitoring her Rabelle indicators read as normal. She squeezed her wrist and exhaled softly. \"Good, everything is as it should be,\" she thought. \"If I start spiraling out of control, {Male=he;Female=she} would have to look after me. It would derail the entire mission.\"\n\nShe hated losing control.\n\nIn recent years, Lady Flora had been haunted by bizarre and fragmented dreams. They felt like memories of a life she had never lived. In these dreams, she was always searching for {PlayerName}, but the two never found each other. Each time she jolted awake, a disquiet settled over her, the mental turmoil seeping into her very being. She was often forced to report to the Black Shores medical facility. \n\nThe thought soured her mood. \n\nShe needed to find {Male=him;Female=her} as quickly as possible.\n\nShoving those tangled thoughts aside, she focused on pinpointing {PlayerName}'s frequencies. After crossing two hills and a frozen lake, she finally spotted a blurry figure in the distance.\n\n\"Camellya, how did you sleep?\" \n\n{Male=His;Female=Her} golden eyes sparkled with warmth, and she couldn't help but smile back.\n\n\"Hehe… With my leader by my side, of course I had the sweetest dreams.\" she heard herself reply."
    },
    {
      "title": "Eve",
      "content": "She awoke from her dream.\n\nThe interval between unconsciousness and consciousness became shorter with each passing day. Lady Flora was starting to find it hard to tell where her dreams ended and reality began. She couldn't even recall when this disorientation had started.\n\nMemories surged like turbulent waves, crashing into her mind and wreaking havoc on her senses. Pain ripped through her body, relentlessly and unforgivingly. She opened her mouth to scream, but <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> had turned her throat into a gnarled, coarse root, silencing her cries. \n\nAfter struggling to take just a few faltering steps, she collapsed onto a muddy riverbank, trembling, her fingertips spasming uncontrollably.\n\nHow many times had this happened? She stared blankly at the dark night sky above.\n\nA void of chaos swirled within her, yet there was one thing that stood out in sharp relief: {PlayerName}.\n\nShe remembered everything now.\n\nWho she was, who {PlayerName} is, the reason for her being, <te href=850079>Solaris</te>, and the <te href=850075>Lament</te>…\n\nBefore the madness of Overclocking engulfed her, those memories were always buried deep, locked in the depths of her being. Each time she awoke, she lost all recollection, left only with an aching void. As time passed and her body weakened under the strain of Overclocking, glimpses of her mission and roots would resurface, only to vanish again in an endless cycle.\n\nHow many times had it happened? Lady Flora had no answer.\n\nCivilizations crumbled into dust, only to rise anew; life faded, only to blossom once more. \n\nShe was witness to the ebb and flow of Solaris, yet remained forever a wanderer in her own mind.\n\n\"{PlayerName}…\" The name slipped from her lips like a prayer. \n\nThey had never truly met or exchanged words, and now, with her memories fading, she couldn't even tell if they were friends or foes. Yet somehow, the next time she awoke she knew her instincts would lead her to seek {Male=him;Female=her} out. It was not a tender yearning. It felt more like the weight of a heavy chain, one Lady Flora could not resist. \n\nYet she felt no hatred for this chain. \n\nThe rustle of leaves shattered her reverie. Wearily, she blinked, and the red camellia unfurled, its vines piercing through the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> lurking in the shadows. Yes, this was her instinct, her essence, the core of her being... Even as she teetered on the edge of forgetting everything, she could always rely on her instincts.\n\nIn truth, beyond her instincts, there was nothing left for her to hold onto. \n\n\"Next time, if only I could truly get to know {PlayerName} and share a conversation with {Male=him;Female=her}.\"\n\nLady Flora mused hazily. Perhaps the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System would lead {PlayerName} to her since she had already revealed herself in this mission.\n\nLady Flora closed her eyes and surrendered to the darkness as the pain peaked.\n\nThe lake's cool water swelled across her cheek, the camellia withering as its vines retreated into her body.\n\nThe autumn night breeze blew through the leaves, caressing her as she lay by the lake. To the north, the villagers of Petalfall Village would soon awaken from their dreams, calling to one another as they prepared to set out on a new day of fishing."
    },
    {
      "title": "Once Upon a Time",
      "content": "She awoke from her dream.\n\nThe wind howled fiercely at the rooftop's edge as she stretched, squinting down at the lively streets below. Vehicles crisscrossed the roads, their taillights forming a vibrant, fiery chain. Resting her chin on her hand, she began to hum.\n\nIt was a song she had learned from {PlayerName}.\n\nOf course, she hadn't heard it directly from {PlayerName} {Male=himself;Female=herself}, she had picked it up secretly. \n\nThey might not be enemies, but their relationship was far from friendly—at best, it was a one-sided acquaintance. {PlayerName}'s presence had caught the eye of various factions, including her own organization. Yet, that hardly concerned her, nor was it something she could afford to contemplate.\n\nShe was merely a \"chosen seed,\" a \"flower\" that bloomed for the sole purpose of hunting {PlayerName} down. Most days, the injections left her in a fog, drifting through a semi-conscious haze, with only her instinctual yearning for a certain person carved deep into her heart.\n\nThe substance she was administered had a sharp, acrid scent, dragging her reason into a mire, robbing her of clarity and self.\n\nHer thoughts whirled chaotically, like a bomb on the brink of detonation, forced to reset just before the countdown expired. \n\nBut she didn't care. \n\nOutside of {PlayerName}, little else piqued her interest. Sometimes, {Male=he;Female=she} felt like a mere silhouette against a blank canvas, an outline of a stranger. The portrait was drawn from fragments of information she had painstakingly gathered—they were so close yet had never truly met. She didn't know what {Male=he;Female=she} looked like.\n\nIt was said this distance was necessary to evade the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System's tracking. Contact was forbidden.\n\nBut how she longed to meet {PlayerName}!\n\nPerched dangerously on the edge of the building, she laughed at the fantasy. Vines entwined around her arms, climbing higher, their delicate buds slowly unfurling at their tips.\n\nSuddenly, a thought struck her.\n\n\"I'll give {Male=him;Female=her} a flower.\"\n\nThe moment the thought emerged, it consumed her entirely. She envisioned the moment she would find {PlayerName} and present this gift—a blossom sprouted from her very being. It would neither wither nor decay unless she perished. But just as quickly as it came, the thought vanished into the chaos of her mind, leaving no trace behind.\n\nLittle did she know, centuries later, the scene before her would vanish in the <te href=850075>Lament</te>. She would wander endlessly through a labyrinth of memories until one autumn morning, by a lake in Petalfall Village, where she would finally meet {PlayerName}, there to rescue the village from Tacet Discord attacks. From there, she would join <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> and share a few hundred years together before {Male=he;Female=she} would eventually leave her. She, too, would leave the Black Shores, only to be reunited decades later in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. All those futures had yet to unfold, just as possibilities slumbered within seeds, waiting for fate to blossom.\n\nShe leaped from the building, her vines weaving through the city's structures, searching for {Male=him;Female=her}."
    }

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "My mind has grown numb with monotony for the past decade or so. I handle exciting jobs sometimes, but the fun soon dries up, like tidal marks on the shoal. But you... you're the only one who keeps me on my toes. So of course I'd be paying attention to you.",

    {
      "type": 1,

      "content": "My stance? Ha! I didn't join <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> to save the world. Just needed a way to pass the time on this island.     {
      "type": 1,

      "content": "You know what? I dreamed of you while I was in the medical pod. In that dream… I couldn't get to know you. Your name echoed in my head endlessly as we roamed the same places, but I never saw your face, not even once... How odd...",

Secret!",

  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Wooden Doll",
      "content": "An intricately carved wooden doll, shaped in {PlayerName}'s likeness and crafted from the roots created by Camellya's Forte. It reflects her unique aesthetic.\nBefore their reunion in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, Camellya had made countless attempts to sculpt the doll's face, each attempt leading to frustration as she could never quite perfect the final stroke.\nNow, after all the vague attempts and disappointments, her vision has finally come to life.\nAs she gazes upon her creation, she can't help but chuckle.\n\"So, this is what it was meant to be like,\" she thought.\n\"Hehe, just as adorable as I imagined.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure75_UI.T_Treasure75_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Spectrum Bracelet",
      "content": "A frequency spectrum-monitoring bracelet designed by <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, created at Camellya's strong insistence.\nIts design resembles a cherished gift from a bygone era, equipped with similar tracking features to keep the wearer's location and safety known from afar.\nCamellya understands that she is no longer the Lady Flora of old, nor does she wish to be. Gone are the days of shadowing {PlayerName}, but so what? Both of them will do what makes them happy.\nFor her, this is the sole anchor in an endless sea of meaninglessness.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure76_UI.T_Treasure76_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "A Camellia",
      "content": "A flower dedicated to a certain person.\nWhether as a leader, a <te href=850111>Modulator</te>, or now as the Rover, the hero of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, a guide… Camellya has never cared about {Male=his;Female=her} title or accompanying responsibilities. However, she knows she cannot, and indeed will not, let her own perspective on life color {Male=his;Female=her} judgment.\nSo let this everlasting flower convey her feelings where mere words may fall short.\n\"It only blooms for you, forever and always.\"",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure78_UI.T_Treasure78_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Burgeoning",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\nAfter performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> or Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Pruning</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to continuously strike the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 5</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Pruning</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\nAfter performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color> or Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Pruning</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to continuously strike the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Pruning</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Valse of Bloom and Blight",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Crimson Blossom</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG), then enter <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color>.\nThis attack can be performed in mid-air.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Blossom Mode</color></size>\n- Unable to move while suspended on vines.\n- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Pruning</color> are replaced by Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color>: chain together 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n- When performing <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color> that deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> before automatically performing <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz Stage 4</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced by Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Atonement</color>. Tap <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n- Resonance Skill is replaced by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\n- Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> can be cast in mid-air.\n- <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color> ends after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color> ends after using the <color=Highlight>Levitator</color>.\n- Jump is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Ronde</color>. Use Jump to attack the target at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG). This ends the <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color>.\n- Using Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color> and Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color> in mid-air consumes STA.\n- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> doesn't restore STA.\n- Consume STA continuously to stay suspended on the vines.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Crimson Blossom</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Blossom Mode</color></size>\n- Unable to move while suspended on vines.\n- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Pruning</color> are replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- When performing <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> becomes Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Atonement</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- Resonance Skill becomes Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color> ends after casting <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color> ends after using the <color=Highlight>Levitator</color>.\n- Jump is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Ronde</color>. Use Jump to attack the target at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. This ends the <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color>.\n- Using Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color> and Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color> in mid-air consumes STA.\n- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> doesn't restore STA.\n- Consume STA continuously to stay suspended on the vines.",

Each bud lasts for {4}s, stacking up to {5} times.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Circuit: Ephemeral</color></size>\nWhen Concerto Energy is fully recovered, and <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color> is not on Cooldown, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color> consumes {6} Concerto Energy and deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> to the targets. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.\nCamellya enters <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color>.\nThis can be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Budding Mode</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Sweet Dream</color>: Increase the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Ronde</color>, Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Atonement</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crimson Blossom</color>, and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> by {8}.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color> consumes all Crimson Buds. Each Crimson Bud consumed additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Sweet Dream</color> by {9}, up to {10}. \n- When in <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color>, Camellya cannot gain Crimson Buds.\n- When in <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color>, the Energy Regen Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Ronde</color>, Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Atonement</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crimson Blossom</color>, and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> is reduced to {11}.\n- <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color> ends when Camellya is switched off the field.\n- <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color> ends when all Crimson Pistils are consumed.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Crimson Pistil</color></size>\nCamellya can hold up to {12} Crimson Pistils.\n- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Everblooming</color> recovers {13} Crimson Pistils.\n- Activating Forte Circuit's <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color> recovers {17} Crimson Pistils.",

        "simple_desc": "<color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> consume Crimson Pistils to gain additional Concerto Energy and <color=Highlight>Crimson Buds</color>.\nConsume Concerto Energy when Concerto Energy is full to activate Forte Circuit's <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color>, recovering Crimson Pistils while boosting Camellya's attacks.\n\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Circuit: Ephemeral</color></size>\nWhen Concerto Energy is full, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color> as long as <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color> is not on cooldown.\nConsume Concerto Energy to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Budding Mode</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Sweet Dream</color>: increase the DMG Multiplier of Normal Attacks and Resonance Skills, while reducing the Energy Regen Multiplier.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color> consumes all <color=Highlight>Crimson Buds</color>. Each Bud additionally increases the DMG Multiplier from <color=Highlight>Sweet Dream</color> by {9}, up to {10}. \n- While in <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color>, Camellya cannot gain Crimson Buds.\n- <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color> ends when Camellya is switched off the field.\n- <color=Highlight>Budding Mode</color> ends when all Crimson Pistils are consumed.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Crimson Pistil</color></size>\nCamellya can hold up to {12} Crimson Pistils.\nCamellya gains Crimson Pistil through <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> and Forte Circuit's <color=Highlight>Ephemeral</color>.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_01.play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Will there be new discoveries?",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_03.play_favor_word_nvzhu_join_team_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,

      "content": "A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Tuneslayer",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nRover-Havoc performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nRover-Havoc consumes STA to attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting Heavy Attack to cast Basic Attack 4.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nRover-Havoc consumes STA to cast a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Umbra Eclipse",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Devastation</color></size>\nWhen \"Umbra\" is full, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Devastation</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dark Surge</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Devastation</color>, Rover enters the <color=Highlight>Dark Surge</color> state. In this state:\n-<color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack</color>, which performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n-<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color>;\n-Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color> to cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thwackblade</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n-Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thwackblade</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack 3</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>;\n-Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Wingblade</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lifetaker</color>, transforming sounds into blades to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Umbra</color></size>\nRover can hold up to 100 points of Umbra.\nNormal Attack <color=Highlight>Tuneslayer</color> recovers Umbra on hit.\nResonance Skill <color=Highlight>Wingblade</color> recovers Umbra when cast.\nResonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lifetaker</color> recovers Umbra when cast.\nIntro Skill <color=Highlight>Instant of Annihilation</color> recovers Umbra when cast.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Devastation</color></size>\nWhen Umbra is full, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Devastation</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dark Surge</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Devastation</color>, Rover enters the <color=Highlight>Dark Surge</color> state. In this state:\n- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color>.\n- Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color> to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thwackblade</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thwackblade</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack 3</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Wingblade</color> becomes Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lifetaker</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Umbra</color></size>\nRover can hold up to 100 points of Umbra.\nRover gains Umbra through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [],

  "stories": [],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "(Hmm...)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "It is natural to feel dreadful of the unknown, yet... there are times when the unknown harbors hope, like how I can never know what else this power has to offer.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Will there be new discoveries?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_join_team_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup01.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup02.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup03.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup04.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup05.play_favor_word_nanzhu_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "The show begins.",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,

      "skill": {
        "name": "Tuneslayer",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nRover-Havoc performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nRover-Havoc consumes STA to attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting Heavy Attack to cast Basic Attack 4.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nRover-Havoc consumes STA to cast a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Umbra Eclipse",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Devastation</color></size>\nWhen \"Umbra\" is full, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Devastation</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dark Surge</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Devastation</color>, Rover enters the <color=Highlight>Dark Surge</color> state. In this state:\n-<color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack</color>, which performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n-<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color>;\n-Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color> to cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thwackblade</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.\n-Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thwackblade</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack 3</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>;\n-Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Wingblade</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lifetaker</color>, transforming sounds into blades to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Umbra</color></size>\nRover can hold up to 100 points of Umbra.\nNormal Attack <color=Highlight>Tuneslayer</color> recovers Umbra on hit.\nResonance Skill <color=Highlight>Wingblade</color> recovers Umbra when cast.\nResonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lifetaker</color> recovers Umbra when cast.\nIntro Skill <color=Highlight>Instant of Annihilation</color> recovers Umbra when cast.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Devastation</color></size>\nWhen Umbra is full, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Devastation</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dark Surge</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Devastation</color>, Rover enters the <color=Highlight>Dark Surge</color> state. In this state:\n- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color>.\n- Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color> to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thwackblade</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thwackblade</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack 3</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Wingblade</color> becomes Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lifetaker</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Umbra</color></size>\nRover can hold up to 100 points of Umbra.\nRover gains Umbra through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.",
        "simple_param": [],

  "desc": "Assistant, prop master, and improv comedian, Roccia is always there to make sure the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te> is at the ready.\n\nThe Magic Box she carries appears to hold the world, or perhaps she had recreated a world inside the box.",

    "talent_name": "Stage in the Box",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Golden Harpoon",
      "content": "Battier, the <te href=850108>Fool's Troupe</te>'s best fisherman, ran into trouble one day on what was supposed to be an ordinary fishing trip. With only his trusted harpoon, he fought against an aquatic <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te> so ferocious that it soon dragged him beneath the waves. Luckily, Roccia sensed something was off when Battier didn't return as expected and quickly rallied troupe members to form a small rescue team. They searched the nearby waters and finally pulled a drenched, beleaguered Battier ashore. However, his well-worn harpoon hadn't fared as well—it was wedged tight in the Tacet Discord's side, and both were swallowed by a whirlpool in the sea.\n\nWithout his harpoon, Battier felt like he'd lost part of his spirit. He'd spend hours baiting traps and coming up empty, as if the fish sensed his missing piece, too. Some days, he'd just lie in the black sand of the Strand, staring at the dim sky. Even the clouds seemed to taunt him, shaping themselves into fish that drifted further and further away.\n \n\"Aaaaah—!\" he shouted at the sky in helpless frustration.\n \nAs if to ease his mind, the clouds began to part, layer by layer, and beams of light spilled down, turning the sky into a shimmering sea. Right in the center, his lost harpoon appeared, descending like a divine gift from the heavens, gleaming in golden sunlight. It landed straight into his hand as if it had never left. In the meantime, fish swarmed to him once more, dancing through the air and across the water.\n \nHeartened by this wonder, Battier hauled in a full net to bring back to the troupe. Roccia and <te href=850122>Pero</te> used the catch to whip up a feast—roasted squid, creamy clam chowder, peppered fish steaks, and so on. The air was filled with the rich aroma of seafood as everyone gathered by the fire, laughing and eating together. Someone even wielded a fish skewer as a sword, putting on a little show that had people in stitches. Looking at the jolly crowd, Battier felt a warm feeling inside—it's the simple joy of being needed and the thrill of fishing for those who truly appreciated him.\n \nWhile the others were enjoying the feast, Roccia exchanged a quick smile with Pero before hiding the Cloudcaster they'd used earlier in a haystack. As a prop master, she knew how much meaning certain objects held for people. No matter how difficult, she'd always find a way to retrieve what was lost—whether from the sea or the sky. After giving them a good polish, she'd plan a heartwarming, dramatic reunion, just as she'd done with Battier's golden harpoon.\n \nFrom that day on, the troupe had a new show: Battier and the Golden Harpoon. The crew enjoyed re-enacting this enchanting story with grilled fish in hand and hearts full of laughter."
    },
    {
      "title": "Safe Voyage",
      "content": "To become the troupe's first mate, one must prove they can face down any storm the sea can throw at them. That's why every first mate must pass a trial—a perilous voyage led by the troupe's best helmsperson. For Roccia, her helmsperson was none other than Tina.\n\nEven with young Roccia onboard, Tina held firm, steering the ship straight into the heart of a brewing storm with steady hands, unflinching as she faced the dark, roiling waves.\n\nRoccia didn't seem fazed at first. She calmly pulled out one of <te href=850122>Pero</te>'s scripts, reading as if she were back under the troupe's tent instead of on a ship pitching wildly in the storm. She dabbed seawater from her face, reading plays prepared by Pero as though it were all a practiced routine. Years of crafting props and performing on stage had made her adaptable, and her time with Pero had taught her to understand and respond to the subtle frequencies of the Echo ship.\n \nBut as they reached the depths of the storm, faint, glowing eyes began to surface in the dark waters, and ominous whispers carried on the wind. Roccia's steady demeanor seemed to falter—her hand wavered as she tucked the script away and gripped the edge of the cabin. Eventually, even the hardened Tina noticed Roccia's trembling. At a loss on how to comfort her, Tina instead raised her voice in song, her voice strong and steady, resonating with the <te href=850082>Echo</te> ship. All she could do in this situation was to hold the ship steady through the rough waters, which required absolute focus.\n \nThen, a softer voice joined her. Tina looked back to see Roccia huddled near the cabin, singing along with a light quaver in her voice. Though fear glinted in her eyes, Roccia hadn't forgotten her duty. She took out her telescope, scanning the dark horizon for their course. Tina's voice rose stronger, blending with Roccia's softer notes, overpowering the ominous whispers around them. Catching the right current, the ship surged forward, breaking through the storm into the first light of dawn.\n\nBack on shore, Roccia's face was as calm and collected as ever. From that day on, First Mate Roccia guided every voyage with a steady hand, always bringing people safely home.\n\n\"Roccia?\" Tina, known for her blunt honesty, was asked later. She grinned, a glint of pride in her eyes. \"She's tough and dependable—a good girl who deserves love and care. As for her pitch… well, let's just say it may not be perfect, but it's got heart.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Old Ticket",
      "content": "Besides the twinkling star, little Luca's most cherished item is an old ticket.\n \nLuca remembers the day Roccia handed it to her after she'd been rescued from the Strand. Roccia was calm and steady, even though she couldn't have been much older than Luca herself. She could handle anything—helping lost pilgrims who drifted ashore, cooking meals for the troupe, recording funny moments, collecting seashells and Luceanites, even refilling the confetti pistol. And of course, cheering up homesick little newcomers like Luca was all part of her role.\n \nOne day, Luca looked up at Roccia with a sniffle, holding the ticket tightly in her little hand. \"I miss my Mama, Roccia… I want to go home and see her. But I only have a one-way ticket, and I lost it…\"\n\nThe ticket in his hand read, \"One-Way Ticket to Wonderland,\" written in beautiful handwriting with tiny flowers around the edges.\n\nRoccia knew right away what this was about. The Order, always busy banishing anyone who challenged them, would never be so kind as to make such a heartwarming ticket. She was sure Luca's mother had made it herself, hoping to give her a bit of comfort. Roccia wanted to reveal the truth to her. \"The Order didn't make these tickets, Luca. From the handwriting, it looks like a kind lady made it… someone who loves you.\" \"They were made by your mother, Luca. They can't really bring you home, so it doesn't matter if they're lost.\"\n\nBut she knew saying that might only make Luca cry more.\n\nRoccia thought for a moment, then left and returned with a new ticket—a \"Return Ticket,\" decorated with painted flowers, seashells, and a hand-drawn stamp that read, \"Arrived at Wonderland.\"\n\nLuca's face lit up as she took it, clutching it tightly with a huge smile.\n\nAs the troupe's prop master, Roccia could easily make something like that, but there was more to it than just crafting. She remembered when <te href=850122>Pero</te> had done the same for her when she first arrived on the island. Sometimes, a little piece of paper was all it took to hold a whole lot of hope."
    },
    {
      "title": "Peculiar Box",
      "content": "Little Roccia lay weak on the Strand, with the wreckage of her pilgrim ship battered to pieces by the waves behind her. Her fading eyes caught glimpses of <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> scattered across the water. So this would be the end of her \"pilgrimage\"... She closed her eyes, bracing herself for what she thought would be \"divine judgment.\"\n \nHowever, death didn't come as she expected. All she could hear was wind and faint cries in the air. When she opened her eyes, she found herself face-to-face with a peculiar box and a long arm reaching out to her—a hand offering her a second chance at life.\n \nAt first, Roccia felt lost after joining the troupe, for the little world she once knew had shattered. She soon realized she had been banished simply for singing songs from forbidden plays. The <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> she remembered—alive with plays, flowers, and freedom—had faded, leaving only the Order's lies and the hollow shell of her memories. The pilgrimage she once believed in was a ruse, wrapped in false promises, with a so-called \"return ticket\" meant only to fool children like her. Overnight, everything she held dear crumbled. Roccia began to question her love for theater—was it even worth anything anymore? But stranded on a desolate island, she found nothing else to rebuild her world.\n \n\"Pero! Pero!\" The odd box handed her a small, hand-drawn ticket with \"Return Trip\" written on it, decorated with painted seashells.\n \n\"Pero! Pero!\" It passed her a yellowed play script, filled with tales of Ragunna and lyrics of freedom.\n \n\"Pero! Pero!\" Out came a beautifully crafted mask, painted with intricate patterns and adorned with pearls and shells.\n \n\"Pero! Pero!\" The box reached out to her once more, inviting her to join the troupe's next performance. Tina's bright voice rang out, Bardolino flew in the air with balloons and tossed petals, Brant swung down on a rope holding a massive welcome banner, and <te href=850122>Pero</te> fired the confetti pistol, inviting her to the stage. This lively, chaotic welcome was Roccia's first taste of a different kind of play—a play filled with nothing but pure joy.\n\nFrom that moment on, Roccia began to rebuild her world through the plays held within Pero's box. She saw that Ragunna's grand stage had been a place of strict control, where only songs that conformed to the Order's tenets were permitted. But here, among her fellow \"Fools,\" she could finally express everything—joy, anger, and sorrow—freely. Together, they were all building a new home.\n\nNow, Roccia works confidently between the troupe's base and the Strand, calmly coordinating the rescue of new pilgrims and keeping this safe harbor running. Each task, no matter how small, is a piece of the home she's building—a place where she can finally belong, busy and content."
    },
    {
      "title": "New Stage",
      "content": "People came and went in the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>, each one inspiring Roccia's lively performances. Shows like \"Battier and the Golden Harpoon,\" \"Tina the Soprano Navigator,\" \"Brant the Maverick Captain,\" and \"<te href=850122>Pero</te> the Peculiar Box\" became legends of their own. By now, she and the crew had put on over two hundred performances, lighting up every corner of Penitent's End.\n\nThe troupe didn't have much, so as the prop master, Roccia became a master of turning everyday items into theater magic. Battier's golden harpoon, for instance, had played the part of a Primus's scepter, a wandering knight's sword, and even the La Guardia's dagger. The <te href=850082>Echo</te> ship had starred as everything from a lifeboat to a windmill giant's boot and even the eye of a sea monster.\n\nFor years, Roccia and Pero explored every inch of the Troupe's home base, every stretch of the island shore. They collected countless Luceanites from the Strand and watched thousands of sunrises. Like the others, they had been confined to this place for too long. The troupe was a warm haven for every member, but inevitably, some still dreamed of distant horizons while others longed for the homes they had left behind.\n\nWhen the long-awaited music of the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> drifted across the sea from <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, along with petals celebrating the crowned <te href=850103>Laureate</te>, the Troupe of Fools felt the undeniable pull of a homeward wind.\n\nChildhood memories were hazy for Roccia, but as she followed Brant and the crew into Ragunna's streets, the familiar smell of Trattoria Margherita's fresh-baked pizza and the songs spilling from the Odyssey Opera House stirred something deep within her, just like it did everyone else.\n\nUnder a golden sun in a clear sky, the city streets stretched out like a stage waiting for her. A soft breeze seemed to nudge open the box she had always hidden herself in, inviting her to step into a broader world. With open arms and a steady heart, Roccia took her first steps into Ragunna, welcoming a better tomorrow.\n\nNow, as the Troupe of Fools' reliable first mate, Roccia stands ready to fill Ragunna's streets with laughter and joy once more."
    }

  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "I'm always on the go, collecting treasures, helping my friends, making costumes, and repairing stage props... It's a busy routine, but seeing everyone smiling makes it all worth it.",

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "<te href=850122>Pero</te>'s box is more than just a treasure trove. It's my private lounge as well. It's bigger than you might think, and I've stashed all my nifty gadgets inside. Would you like a tour? Knock, knock—open up, Pero.",

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "Apparently, the mix of my over-the-top gestures and stoic face is hilarious to people. See? Just like that. Oh, did I actually get a chuckle out of you? Guess I'll keep this style going, then.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_toplayer03.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_toplayer03"

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "Our troupe never lets anyone feel left out. We accept everyone, chasing away their worries and inviting them to be a part of the performance. If you ever feel down or sad, come see us. I'd really like to see you smile.",

      "title": "Thoughts: V",

    {
      "type": 1,

      "content": "I like turning the things I collect into stage props. They might not look fancy at first, but each one has its own special story. On stage, the ordinary becomes extraordinary, and I think that's worth something.",

      "content": "Spaghetti Bolognese is great on its own, but it's even better when shared. Maybe... it's the company that makes it taste better?",

      "content": "Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean.",

      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "One day, the streets of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> will be alive with the spirit of freedom. Until then, I want it to grow within our troupe. We'll make the sad smile, help the hopeless dream again, give courage to the fearful, and remind everyone of who we really are.",

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "Luceanite pebbles, if not collected in time, will lose their glow and turn to dust. I used to be one of those lost pebbles, until the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te> came along and saved me. Now, I can help other lost souls with my own little light.",
