    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Brant",
      "content": "Brant is the greatest captain in all of Solaris. At least, that's what he insists I say. But it's true, having him around really does bring out the best in us. His passion is infectious, and his belief in freedom is like the mast that keeps us all steady.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_about_bulante.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_about_bulante"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Carlotta",
      "content": "Leading a large family is like steering a massive ship. It requires immense effort to keep it on course. I have firsthand experience in managing a vessel, and I admire her energy and bravery in navigating this journey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_about_kelaita.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_about_kelaita"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Zani",
      "content": "Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...",

    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Phoebe",
      "content": "She's from the <te href=850099>Order of the Deep</te>. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> to touch the box without getting bitten by <te href=850122>Pero</te>.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_about_feibi.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_about_feibi"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "There's a new show in the works, a little something we've been rehearsing. Come check it out if you have the time. Spoiler alert... It's kind of important you're there for the show to work. Why? Because you're the main character! Happy birthday!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "The show begins. \n\"Pero!\"",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_luokeke_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_luokeke_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_luokeke_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Hello, name's Roccia. Besides being the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>' first mate, I am also a stage mechanic and an improv performer. If you ever stumble upon something interesting, I'm a really good listener. <te href=850122>Pero</te> stores all that inspiration, and I'll spin it into a new improv act.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "All the world's a stage, and we are mere players.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "<te href=850122>Pero</te>'s tummy is rumbling. Inspiration, don't be shy!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Tornado makers, dimension-warping lamps... I've got all kinds of props if you're interested.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Time for a little laugh.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "<te href=850122>Pero</te> said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "<te href=850122>Pero</te> said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "<te href=850122>Pero</te> said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "<te href=850122>Pero</te> said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "<te href=850122>Pero</te> said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia. Those are the things I've been wanting to tell you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_luokeke_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack",
      "content": "PERO: Pero!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_atk04_01.play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_atk04_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack",
      "content": "Surprise!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_heavyatk_success_03.play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_heavyatk_success_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: I",
      "content": "Mamma mia!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_fallingatk02.play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_fallingatk02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: II",
      "content": "Avanti!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_fallingatk03.play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_fallingatk03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: III",
      "content": "Figurati!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_fallingatk04.play_favor_word_luokeke_atk_fallingatk04"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Tempest show.\nPERO: PEROOO!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Tornado maker.\nPERO: Whoosh—Whoosh—",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Up we go, <te href=850122>Pero</te>.\nPERO: Haah!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_skill01_03.play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_skill01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "All the world's a stage.\nPERO: Pero! Hmph!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_luokeke_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Time for some crowd work.\nPERO: Pero! Rawrrr!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_luokeke_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Improv performance.\nPERO: Pero! Pero!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_luokeke_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "Aerial stunt.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_qte.play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_qte"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "Can't lose the rhythm.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Every story needs drama.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Unexpected plot twist.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "A turn of events.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "Time for a comeback.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Better stay behind the scenes…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_die_01.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "The curtain's drawn.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_die_02.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "The spark fades...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_die_03.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "A supporting actor.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "I'll warm up the crowd.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_luokeke_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "We'll improvise.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_engage.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Looks like we've found something.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_scan.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "This should come in handy.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "No, <te href=850122>Pero</te>. That's not for you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Shiny stuff.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_luokeke_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_luokeke_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Portable Confetti Pistol",
      "content": "A confetti pistol crafted from recycled materials by Roccia. Despite her reserved nature, she never forgets to add a burst of confetti for those cheerful, dramatic moments in life—a little surprise, a quick-witted remark from a troupe member, and so on, each deserving its own small celebration.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure79_UI.T_Treasure79_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Pero's Peculiar Box",
      "content": "Ever since <te href=850122>Pero</te> saved Roccia, they've been close friends with a shared love for theater. Years of reading plays stored in Pero's box have shaped Roccia's taste for drama, just like how their time spent crafting props and performing together has deepened their bond. And for Pero, after a century of life, Roccia's presence has brought warmth to her world. They've given each other a second life, both becoming better versions of themselves.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure80_UI.T_Treasure80_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Luceanite Prop Set",
      "content": "A unique prop set crafted by Roccia, made from Luceanites that hold the emotions and memories of those long departed. When brought onto the stage, these lingering feelings glimmer within each line and monologue, casting a light that, as Roccia believes, allows their original keepers to shine once more.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure81_UI.T_Treasure81_UI"
    }
  ],
  "special_cook": {
    "id": 80001043,

    "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconCook/T_IconCook_066_UI.T_IconCook_066_UI",
    "rarity": 3
  },

      "skill": {
        "name": "Pero, Easy",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Hitting a target with at least {0} <te href=850015>Imagination</te> sends Roccia into mid-air and activates the <color=Highlight>Beyond Imagination</color> state. The longer you hold the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button, the more Imagination Roccia gains. In this state, Roccia can continue to charge the attack even when her STA depletes. Heavy Attack will be automatically cast when you release the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button while charging or when Imagination reaches the max limit.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nUse <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",
        "param": [
          "100"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Hitting a target with at least {0} Imagination sends Roccia into mid-air and activates <color=Highlight>Beyond Imagination</color>. The longer you hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, the more Imagination Roccia gains. Heavy Attack will be automatically cast when you release the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button while charging or when Imagination reaches the max limit.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",

        "name": "A Prop Master Prepares",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Beyond Imagination</color></size>\n- When Roccia is in <color=Highlight>Beyond Imagination</color> with at least {0} Imagination, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button to consume {0} Imagination to cast Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Real Fantasy</color>.\n- Roccia exits this state when she is not airborne or when switched off the field.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Real Fantasy</color></size>\n- Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When Roccia lands after Stage 1 and Stage 2 attacks with over {0} Imagination, she will launch into mid-air and activate <color=Highlight>Beyond Imagination</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Imagination</color></size>\nRoccia can hold up to {1} Imagination.\n- Dealing DMG with Normal Attacks restores Imagination.\n- Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to charge the next attack while restoring Imagination.\n- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Acrobatic Trick</color> restores {2} Imagination.\n- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Pero, Help</color> restores {3} Imagination.",

  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Round Table",
      "content": "The light filtered through the stained glass, casting a speckled pattern across the crimson sofa. \n\nDim lamps flickered softly in the misty purple room. Around the round table sat several indistinct figures. Some lounging in the light, others half-immersed in the shadows. The lady who arranged this gathering, or at least, by her position, that's what it seemed, spoke first. She had long, silky purple hair, and her indigo eyes, veiled in a soft mist, gave her an ethereal, dreamlike vibe. Lounging lazily on the sofa, she absentmindedly toyed with the sapphire pendant on her chest, a habit she indulged whenever lost in thought.\n\n\"I've gathered everyone today to discuss one thing: where should we stay? In the '<te href=850119>Illusory Dream</te>,' or in reality?\"\n\n\"Since we've been wandering the edge of dreams, should we remain here, in this illusion, where everything is familiar, light and delicate as bubbles? Or should we step forward, into reality, where we might face the unknown… but also see sights we've never known?\"\n\nA lazy but resolute voice cut through her words. \"How weak of you, Cantarella. You may be head of the family now, but from what I see, you're far from being capable.\"\n\nA figure emerged from the shadows, a woman with long hair cascading like a waterfall. She wore the same sapphire pendant and carried an air of grace similar to Cantarella's, but with the undeniable weight of experience and authority. Her deep purple eyes glinted with an unquestionable edge.\n\n\"This meeting is pointless. Just pour the '<te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>' into the waterfall behind the castle, and let all of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> fall into a dream under your control. That way, we will be queen wherever we go.\"\n\n\"Invalid answer. Or, if you insist, it will be counted as a vote for 'Illusory Dream.' Though it sounds a little wild and impractical, I'll still write it down for fairness. This is our discussion, after all.\" A young girl sitting beside them answered, opening a notebook full of strange doodles. She found a small space nearly buried under potion recipes and seriously drew a neat line.\n\n\"I abstain,\" she said casually. \"This discussion probably won't change anything. You already have your answer, don't you? For me, it doesn't matter where we stay.\" She closed the notebook with a soft snap and shook out her white shawl. The light caught her blue, hazy eyes.\n\n\"Why can't we just keep it simple and follow our hearts? Cantarella, you like watching the birds outside the window and long for a life of freedom, right? Then just do what feels right,\" said the youngest one, sprawled on the sofa, her hands lazily chasing the dust motes dancing in the light.\n\n\"This is an important decision and should be discussed seriously,\" Cantarella replied, her voice tinged with a hint of helplessness. \"Let's start with you then. Please explain your choice and the reasoning behind it.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Thorned Crown",
      "content": "The deep purple, venomous crown, when first placed upon the brow, brings a sharp sting. Yet, the blood that seeps from the forehead nourishes it, making it shine ever brighter. Soaked in the blood and tears of countless souls, this crown of toxic thorns rises from the depths of the sea,  symbolizing those who work silently against the chaos to support the weight of the Celestial Steed's tail feathers.\n\nSuch is the glory of the <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family, and its inescapable fate.\n\nBut what of each member of the family? In the dark, deep sea, they suffer the gnawing whispers, until the faintest glimmer of true faith in their hearts fades, lost to the abyss. The next in line to wear the crown will take up the duty, and so the cycle endures, unbroken, with no beginning or end.\n\nFragrant yet toxic blooms,\nColorless, flavorless tears of poisons,\nTwisted organs and venomous breaths,\nNeurotoxins,\nBiotoxins,\nMetallic toxins…\n\nThe poisons and toxins the Fisalias so pride themselves on and the abilities birthed from them will inevitably be undone by the whispers… In the end, they only come in handy when used to seek the end of life, either for the Fisalias themselves or their kin.\n\nThis had long been the norm until I developed the \"<te href=850119>Illusory Dream</te>.\" When the thorned crown burrowed into my flesh, the blood flew in strange, shimmering hues. Black tea steeped in mercury tasted like rich, honeyed nectar, while scones soaked in Jellyrose juice had a delicate sweetness. The heat in my throat was searing, as if hastily swallowing an entire cherry, and the suffocating sensation was like drifting in an endless sea… Slowly, the pain faded, and both body and mind became light as air. The bottles of poisons shattered on the floor, and our expressions turned relieved. The whispers were powerless in the world woven by the sea of dreams, for it gently dissolved all discord. Amidst the colorful waves, the once harsh thorned crown was softened… So soft that it formed delicate folds, resting lightly on my head. It became light and pure, like the tail feathers of the Celestial Steed.\n\nThat's why I cast my vote for \"Illusory Dream.\" After all, what harm is there in this illusion? Have we not all wandered here for so long? Pour the \"<te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>\" into the waterfall behind the castle, and let the whole of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> fall into a dream shaped by my hand… Rest assured, this is but a joke. I do not seek to control but only wish for all to live more peacefully.\n\nYou see, the \"Illusory Dream\" flows within our veins, and whether we like it or not, it's a permanent and inseparable part of us."
    },
    {
      "title": "Jellyfish Lamp",
      "content": "In the dimly lit room, heavy with a peculiar scent, a faint yellow light illuminated an old notebook and a strange cauldron. The young woman, wrapped in a white shawl, scribbled notes in the book while casually tossing ingredients into the cauldron. The smoke rising from it darkened her clothes, leaving patches of black and purple. Her once-clean apron was now speckled, but she wiped her face carelessly, unfazed by the mess.\n\nDistilled water, peppermint, castor bean, barnacle fish leaves, rosemary… The scent was fresh, the toxicity mild, with soothing and analgesic effects. It could treat the common Infantile Gray Matter syndrome seen recently… I'll write this recipe on a small note and leave it for Chloe later.\n\nHilo grass, sea okra, barnacle fish leaves, sea apple juice… The scent was unpleasant, and the toxicity potent, though it could counteract some nerve paralysis reactions. Hmm, but the side effects… Never mind, I'll keep it.\n\nSea okra mucilage, barnacle fish leaves dried and crushed, a splash of sea apple juice, a touch of Jellyrose juice… The toxicity of Jellyrose is too strong. Effective, but too risky.\n\nCrush the barnacle fish leaves, drizzle with Violacas juice, mix with sea okra mucilage, add a bit of sea apple juice, and let it ferment in a glass vial… Done. Once consumed, it soothes the spirit and neutralizes most poison reactions. I should distribute some to everyone to get through the trials in the coming days. And the name… okay, I'll call it <te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>.\n\nThe ingredients, processing method, sequence of preparation, and environmental temperature… Handle each step at the right moment, and I can brew the perfect elixir. I believe the same applies to life. At the right moment, with the right steps, most problems can be solved. No matter how illogical the rules or how brutal the situation is, there is always a way to find the right approach.\n\nTherefore, I stepped into the darkness with the lamp, facing my fears. The abyss mocked me—reclusive, weak, incapable of adapting. Its taunting howls echoed through the corridors, the twisted frequencies of past family heads surging forward, engulfing me. Serious, rigid, pale, gloomy, silent… They knew me too well, able to predict my every move and trap me effortlessly.\n\nBut still, I played my very first and last trick as I drank a large dose of Velvet Dream in advance. The moment the jellyfish's poisonous thorns pierced my skin, I pressed the Jellyrose Medusa to my head. The violent toxins clashed within my veins, nearly tearing me apart. My soul rolled between life and death, on the verge of spilling out through my burning throat. I couldn't tell if it was blood, tears, or sweat mixed with the remnants of the potion… It dripped onto the almost extinguished lamp.\n\nA small jellyfish wobbled out from the faint light. When I raised my eyes, the darkness lifted, and my blurred vision filled with colorful, vivid illusions.\n\nIt worked.\n\nSo, like I said, any situation can be solved with the right steps at the right time, even if you're just one part of the process. Since then, I've remained in a perpetual state between life and death, between dreams and reality. I often catch glimpses of lingering illusions, like the girl in the red hat. Who is she? Is it me? Or someone else? I can't figure it out.\n\nAnyway, I'll abstain from voting. It doesn't matter whether it's in a dream or reality. I've been used to it, and I can survive anywhere."
    },
    {
      "title": "Uncaged Bird",
      "content": "Since I could remember, I had always been in that big, empty house. I would walk from one end to the other, knowing every tile on the floor and every potion bottle on the shelves. The house was gray, dark, and quiet. The only time it ever felt alive was when a bird flew past the window. I would watch its white wings flutter up and down until it became nothing more than a tiny dot in the sky. Beyond that, the sky turned a clear blue, and the trees shone a bright green. It was such a beautiful sight.\n\nThat was when I would wonder… what was happening in that thick forest? Maybe a princess was having an adventure.\n\nI imagined a clever princess who knew how to spot a poisoned apple. When a snake chased her, a little bird would swoop in to save her, carrying her high into the sky. There, she would find a girl in red shoes who couldn't stop dancing and save her. Then, they would dive into the sea to rescue a siren who was on the verge of turning into foam. In the end, the bird would carry them all, flying as far as it could until it could fly no more, finally landing in a castle… But what was the castle like? I only hoped it wasn't like the manor I lived in—big and boring.\n\nSorry, that probably sounds all over the place, doesn't it? Well… Mother and Father always said that girls from the <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family didn't need to read silly fairytales or have strange ideas like that. We were supposed to read books—books like <i>The Complete Guide to Poison Recipes</i>, <i>The Fisalia Family's Secret Elixirs</i>, and <i>108 Poisons You Never Knew About</i>. They were interesting, but after reading them too many times, they became dull.\n\nStill, Mother and Father insisted that I memorize everything so that one day, I could save myself, or perhaps even become a Maiden or the family's leader. It sounded like a huge responsibility. I didn't really understand it yet, but I did what they told me.\n\nThey were always busy, always rushing around. Whenever they left, they locked the door extra tight and checked it over and over again. I never understood why they grew busier and thinner. And why did they drink so much \"water\" and mumble strange words?\n\nI had learned to say those words too: \"It's the glory and fate of the Fisalias.\"\n\nEventually, I grew older and had to move to a different house. When I left, Mother and Father looked proud, but their eyes were full of tears.\n\n\"Indeed, milord, our child has great talent, especially in brewing poisons.\"\n\"Yes, becoming a candidate for the trials is the glory and fate of the Fisalias.\"\n\nThat was the first time I ever left home. As I stepped outside, my footsteps startled the crows perched on the dead tree near the gate. They flapped their black wings and took off, flying toward a strange castle in the distance.\n\nOh, sorry, I went off track again. What I meant to say was... after spending so long flying through dreams, you start to miss the feeling of your feet on the ground. Sure, you might step into mud or get pricked by sharp stones, but there was something comforting about taking each step on solid earth.\n\nSo, when it came time to vote, I chose reality—<te href=850121>The Other Side of the Dream</te>, as the adults liked to call it. They always used fancy terms like that. But deep down, you already knew what your heart truly wanted, didn't you? Not just in dreams, but in reality, too. You could open the door, step outside, and go with everyone. Just fly alongside the white birds and chase after the happily-ever-after ending for everyone."
    },
    {
      "title": "Lucid Dream",
      "content": "In the misty purple room, voices blended together—the majestic and enchanting, the cold and resolute, and the genuine and innocent. They intertwined, forming a dreamlike symphony. The sapphire light shimmered with quiet authority, the pages of a book rustled softly, and the scent of freshly baked pastries mingled with the warmth of the room, creating a sweet, ethereal atmosphere.\n\nCantarella lifted the delicate teapot and poured the tea, a change from the usual. No longer the alluring purple hues, but a cup of tea with a refreshing clarity.\n\n\"Thank you for your invaluable opinions,\" she said, setting the teapot down. The fresh aroma filled the room. \"Now, I've made up my mind.\"\n\n\"I will continue to wear the crown of thorns, for the poison has already sunk deep into my bones, and the dream is a part of me I cannot remove.\"\n\n\"I will keep brewing potions, for they are needed not just by the <te href=850094>Fisalias</te>, but by all in struggle.\"\n\n\"I will step outside and follow the flight of birds, into the mountains and the streets. The whispers that once trapped us are gone, and now we are free.\"\n\n\"I am still within the dream, but I will strive to feel the ground beneath my feet… In that fleeting moment between dream and reality, I will hold on to what is real.\"\n\nCantarella took a deep breath, slowly opening her eyes. She had just woken from a brief afternoon nap, stepping out from a hazy yet lucid dream. The sunlight at three in the afternoon filtered through the glass window, casting a quiet glow over her lonely figure in the room. The only sounds left were the gentle bubbling of the tea and her steady breathing.\n\nShe picked up her cup and took a sip. The fresh aroma soothed the restless <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> in her mouth. It no longer draws power from illusion or pain. This was the tea she had bought earlier this morning in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, just ordinary tea. The faint sweetness and subtle fragrance reminded her of a breeze in the countryside, of dew drops hanging on fresh leaves…\n\nSo, this was the taste of peace and happiness after everything had settled.\n\nThe door creaked open. She poured another cup and offered it to the guest who had just arrived. The guest had black hair and golden eyes, a presence of calm and unwavering strength that grounded the room. This quiet, tranquil afternoon was a miracle granted by no other but {PlayerName}.\n\nThe soft sunlight brushed through the room, and the refreshing fragrance lingered between them, filling the space around the two teacups. She lifted her violet-blue eyes, the mist long faded, her gaze now like a calm sea, with just the ripple of gentle feelings."
    }

  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue. You must learn to relax. You can't help others if you don't take care of yourself, you know.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kanteleila_sys_toplayer01.play_favor_word_kanteleila_sys_toplayer01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "Aren't these jellyfish beautiful? Come, try touching one... a light caress. There, there, you needn't be afraid. I would never put you in harm's way. See, they only wish to wrap their soft tendrils around your finger and pull you into a sweet, sweet dream.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kanteleila_sys_toplayer02.play_favor_word_kanteleila_sys_toplayer02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "Some see in dreams the scars of a troubled past, others see bleak futures. For those confined in reality, dreams offer a sweet reprieve. Tell me, what do you see in yours, if not nothing at all? Look at you, hehe... so peacefully asleep.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kanteleila_sys_toplayer03.play_favor_word_kanteleila_sys_toplayer03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kanteleila_sys_toplayer04.play_favor_word_kanteleila_sys_toplayer04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,

    },
    {

    },
    {

    },

    {

      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "We desire, and so we find.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kanteleila_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_kanteleila_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "What we want has a way of appearing when least expected.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kanteleila_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_kanteleila_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Luck does seem to favor you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kanteleila_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_kanteleila_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Coral Parasol",
      "content": "The parasol carried by Cantarella.\n\nIts round canopy resembles a soft, plump jellyfish with long, graceful tentacles that seem to float effortlessly in the air. The ribs of the parasol are crafted from deep-sea coral, meticulously shaped into perfect curves that gleam with a subtle glow, both beautifully delicate and unyieldingly strong. At the handle, a sapphire is embedded, a symbol of the unshakable authority of the family head.\n\nViolence has never been Cantarella's first choice, but when forced to defend herself, she merely spins her parasol, and in an instant, the canopy radiates brilliant light. From it, a mesmerizing swarm of jellyfish unfurls, drifting into a phantasmal sea of illusion.\n\nDrawing her enemies into this enchanting yet perilous sea of dreams is the signature art of Cantarella. Like its owner, the parasol may appear soft and fluid, yet when the need arises, it is always indestructible.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure92_UI.T_Treasure92_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Cauldron of Sweet Dreams",
      "content": "The cauldron used by Cantarella, the Sea Witch, for potion brewing. The sapphire adorned on it marks Cantarella's authority as the head of the Fisalias.\n\nShe often allows her whims to guide her, carelessly tossing in unexpected ingredients, such as jellyfish tentacles, fish scales, tears from the heartbroken, and even the murmurs that linger in the air.\n\nWhatever she adds, the result is always a pot of sweet dreams that dissolves the bitterness of reality, gently soothing those lost in the abyss.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure91_UI.T_Treasure91_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Potion Vial",
      "content": "Cantarella always carries this potion vial, adorned with a sapphire as bright as the one she wears as a mark of her authority. Inside, she keeps a special brew, one she carefully prepares to ease weariness and calm nightmares.\n\nHowever, ever since you brought her away from the Sea of Ghosts, the nightmares have ceased.\n\nNow, this vial is imbued with her rare sincerity and tenderness, like a soft light piercing the abyss, reflecting the gentle murmurs hidden in the rolling waves. It is now a symbol of the trust Cantarella has placed in you, the one who has navigated the dark tides and reached the depths for her.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure93_UI.T_Treasure93_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Illusion Collapse",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Delusive Dive</color></size>\nWhen Cantarella has Trance, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Delusive Dive</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> to the target, and then Cantarella enters <color=Highlight><te href=850054>Mirage</te></color>. While in <color=Highlight>Mirage</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Delusive Dive</color> does not activate <color=Highlight>Mirage</color> again.\nCan be cast in water.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Delusive Dive</color></size>\nWith Trance, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Delusive Dive</color>. Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Mirage</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Dance with Shadows",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Graceful Step</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Flickering Reverie</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight><te href=850054>Mirage</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Flickering Reverie</color>, which is considered an <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color> when being cast. Attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, and send them into <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hazy Dream</color></size>\nReduce the target's movement speed for {0}s. When the target takes damage, <color=Highlight>Jolt</color> is triggered once, removing <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color> to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.\nAttacks by other Resonators in the team will not <color=Highlight>Jolt</color> a target influenced by <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color> and will remove the <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color>. \nCoordinated Attacks and damage from Utilities will not <color=Highlight>Jolt</color> a target.",
        "param": [
          "6.5"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Graceful Step</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Flickering Reverie</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Mirage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Flickering Reverie</color>. Casting this skill is also considered as casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and send the target into <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hazy Dream</color></size>\nReduce the target's movement speed. When the target takes damage, <color=Highlight>Jolt</color> is triggered once, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",

        "name": "Beneath the Sea",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Flowing Suffocation</color></size>\nAttack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG). Grant <color=Highlight>Diffusion</color> to all Resonators in the team. Casting this skill is also considered as casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Diffusion</color></size>\nWhen the Resonator on the field deals damage to a target, summon <color=Highlight>Dreamweavers</color> to perform Coordinated Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered as Basic Attack DMG).\n- Within {0}s after the Resonator deals damage, summon <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> <color=Highlight>{Cus:Sap,S=Dreamweaver P=Dreamweavers SapTag=1}</color> per second. This effect can be triggered once per second. Damage dealt by <color=Highlight>Dreamweavers</color> cannot trigger this effect.\n- Up to <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> <color=Highlight>{Cus:Sap,S=Dreamweaver P=Dreamweavers SapTag=2}</color> can be summoned each second, max {3} <color=Highlight>Dreamweavers</color> in total.\n- This effect lasts for {4}s or until reaching the maximum number of <color=Highlight>Dreamweavers</color>.",
        "param": [
          "3",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Between Illusion and Reality",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Mirage</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> becomes Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color>. Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Can be cast in mid-air. When cast mid-air, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color> consumes STA, and the combo does not reset when Cantarella is airborne.\n- Hitting the target with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color> consumes {0} point of Trance to obtain {1} point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.\n- The third stage of Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color> triggers 3 Coordinated Attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Abysmal Vortex</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> becomes Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Shadowy Sweep</color>. Attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting the skill to cast Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting Stage 2</color>.\n- When Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Abysmal Vortex</color> or Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Shadowy Sweep</color> hits a target, consume {0} point of Trance to obtain {1} point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.\n- Mirage lasts for {2}s.\n- <color=Highlight>Mirage</color> ends when Trance is depleted.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Forte Circuit - Perception Drain</color></size>\nIf Cantarella has {3} points of Shiver when in <color=Highlight>Mirage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Perception Drain</color>.\nConsume all Shiver to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG. Send the target into <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color> and heal all Resonators in the team.\nCasting this skill is also considered as casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Abyssal Rebirth</color></size>\nAfter casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, Cantarella enters <color=Highlight>Abyssal Rebirth</color>, which lasts for {5}s and can be activated once every 25s. In the duration, for up to 6 times, when Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>, Cantarella recovers {4} points of Concerto Energy. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.\nWhen in water, Cantarella's swimming speed increases and STA cost decreases.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Trance</color></size>\n- Cantarella can hold up to {6} points of Trance.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> recovers {7} point of Trance.\n- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> recovers {8} point of Trance.\n- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Graceful Step</color> recovers {9} point of Trance.\n- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Flowing Suffocation</color> recovers {10} points of Trance.\n- When in the water, recover {12} point of Trance every {11}s.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Shiver</color></size>\n- Cantarella can hold up to {13} points of Shiver.\n- Hitting the target with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color> recovers {14} point of Shiver.\n- When Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Abysmal Vortex</color> or Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Shadowy Sweep</color> hits a target, restore {15} point of Shiver.",

  "name": "Phrolova",

  "desc": "Phrolova, a Fractsidus Overseer walking the fine line between life and death, an uncanny, deadly conductor.\nA silent wave of her baton is enough to attune the very frequencies of being and conduct the symphonies of \"souls.\" The music of hers can sculpt a better world or, just as easily, summon a legion to wreak havoc.",
  "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconRoleHead256/T_IconRoleHead256_41_UI.T_IconRoleHead256_41_UI",

    "influence": "The Fractsidus",
    "info": "Phrolova, a Fractsidus Overseer walking the fine line between life and death, an uncanny, deadly conductor.\nA silent wave of her baton is enough to attune the very frequencies of being and conduct the symphonies of \"souls.\" The music of hers can sculpt a better world or, just as easily, summon a legion to wreak havoc.",
    "talent_name": "Symphony of Beyond",
    "talent_doc": "Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment RA-F2005-G]\nResonator Phrolova's Awakening occurred at the time of her death, granting her the ability to tune the frequencies of her target and alter their \"melodies\" based on the understanding of critical frequency structuring of matters. The strength of such tuning ability is proportional to her physical condition. Latest test data indicate that under extreme <te href=850073>Overclock</te> conditions, while maintaining consciousness, Phrolova's tuning can be extended to a maximum of 30 times the normal range, with the longest duration record of 46 seconds. Due to the complexity of its origin, the exact timing and cause of Phrolova's Awakening cannot be defined.\nPhrolova's <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> is located on her left arm. The Tacet Discord mutation following her Awakening prevents her body from aging, with the alteration in the color of her left iris being the sole physical change observed. Test results indicate that when Phrolova's body is within a healthy state, skin reconstruction and frequency reassembly take approximately 6 seconds, while internal organ restoration requires 15-18 minutes. No fatal weakness has been found as of the writing of this evaluation.\nExaminations reveal a large mass of chaotic frequencies housed within Phrolova's body, estimated to be around one thousand frequencies. The exact quantity remains undetermined. Further experiments confirm that these frequencies have no negative impact on her body or Resonance Ability. Such frequencies are deemed of zero significant value and are only related to Phrolova's mental fluctuations.\nAnalysis of test samples has revealed a consistent, flat <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> followed by a sharp ascent and stabilization. Therefore, Phrolova is identified as a <te href=850069>Mutant Resonator</te>. Through multiple experiments, it is confirmed that her method of Awakening cannot be artificially replicated upon any other individual.",
    "talent_certification": "Resonator Phrolova's waveform graph displays sawtooth and needle-like fluctuations. The Time Domain pattern frequently reveals intense and chaotic activity. During testing, the Time Domain data displayed significant distortion, and the peak value remains indeterminable.\nResonant Criticality: Extremely low.\nResonator Phrolova's frequency displays extremely low stability. It is noted that she has a documented history of Overclocking.\nHowever, she has consistently demonstrated control of her Overclocking, indicating a potential to explore methods of stabilizing and prolonging Overclock states of ordinary Resonators by leveraging this mental stability.",
    "cv_name_cn": "Zhang Qi",
    "cv_name_jp": "Fujita Saki",
    "cv_name_ko": "Choi Ha Ri",
    "cv_name_en": "Rae Lim"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Song of Red and Black",
      "content": "The audience drowned in the performance. Some sat frozen, others trembled, swaying like reeds in a storm. In the dark, countless eyes locked onto that lone, delicate yet powerful figure, their stares hypnotized by the rise and fall of her arms, like scattered notes lost in a feverish improvized elegy.\nThe presto's boiling melodies ignited the burning desires in their chests. Suppressed emotions flared. Uncontrolled. Uncontained. They choked on the music's maddening climax, dragged to the edge of their sanity alongside her. At the cliff's brink, above a yawning abyss, they hungered for the blossoms of destruction and rebirth.\nYet, just before that leap could be taken, the conductor stilled her arms under the spotlight. The music ceased with a sudden, almost cruel finality.\nShe stood there motionless, like a statue, chest heaving. The last tether of reason that pulled her back had snapped, dissolving into the sea of emotions where she drifted alone. Her gaze was set on the ceiling, never once lowering to meet the eyes of the audience below.\nWas that the end?\nSilent. Perturbed. Lost. The audience began leaving in a daze. But before they reached the door, the music returned like echoes from the past. It easily hissed back to life in an endless loop in their skulls, more captivating than when it was first heard, awakening and amplifying the madness within each one's heart. In an era of brightness, people would walk out with smiles on their faces, embracing a gilded tomorrow as they drank the crimson song. In an era of darkness, the blackened song would become the final straw, leading them to the windows above without hesitation.\nShe never seemed to care what color her music might paint for others. She only continued to sway her hands through the cycle of time. And those sitting in the music hall never pondered where the music would lead them. Time and time again the creator of those warm and sorrowful melodies stood on that stage, yet no one ever paused to wonder what kept her there—whether it was art, fury, or grief for a love long buried in dust."
    },
    {
      "title": "Hidden Lycoris",
      "content": "The scarlet hall was often empty, its only occupants the Overseers' flags fluttering in the cold wind. Among them, the flag bearing the Lycoris had long since discolored, yet it clung stubbornly to its place, never falling. As most Fractsidus members would recall, the Overseers come and go like shadows, very few would choose to linger here. But she was the most elusive of them all, with the flag being the sole mark of her existence. She had abandoned everything an Overseer might claim here—no belongings in her room, no unnecessary words. She did not belong here. The detached silence made her seemingly neglectable, yet whenever the thought that she might be dispensable to Fractsidus—or Fractsidus to her—the silent Lycoris would unexpectedly emerge from the darkness. Like a sharp bloom, she would pierce the heart of the enemy, fulfill her task, and vanish once more. Nothing here seemed to be of interest to her, and few knew why she had joined at all.\nThere was only one place in the Fractsidus that could tether her steps. At times, she would stand on the upper levels of the laboratory, quietly observing the developments of human integration with the flesh and limbs of <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, or the advancements of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> technology. She watched the burning desires in the eyes of those who actively sought evolution, their struggles toward rebirth. Screams of success, laments of failure. As if she were seeing more than just them.\nAt other times, she would appear like a phantom deep into the night, holding a lamp as she browsed the latest research results. Yet she never took a single page, as if everything ended in disappointment. Those who occasionally witnessed this scene would be left puzzled, wondering what exactly she was trying to accomplish."
    },
    {
      "title": "Treading Through Woes",
      "content": "When life becomes infinite, what path should one take in this world? She had no answer.\nThe unprecedented emptiness and vastness of existence left her at a loss. In response, she chose to close her eyes and let music speak for her—untamed notes spilling out her loneliness, her sorrow, her rage, careless of when or where they fell.\nThe crazed genius had gained renown, yet remained as willful as ever. She outlasted every praise and insult, watching the same events and hearing the same comments repeat endlessly. Time after time, she faced loneliness, until finally she understood that seeking dependence was ultimately futile. Precious moments were often fleeting, and only those forced to stay continued to bear the pain. Gradually, her mind cleared. Then it hardened. She shut out the world, numb to all feeling. She walked alone, ignoring the crowd beneath the stage, blind to the world beyond.\nShe did not change her name to disguise herself, caring little about people's speculations and questionings. Anyone could perceive her physical age, but few could guess the age of her soul.\nShe would have wandered like a ghost without purpose forever, but what happened at that single performance offered her purpose. At her moment of realization, the unbearable time passed in an instant, as if her entire life had contracted. She desperately sought anything she had yet to comprehend, searching for any talents that would shine in the flow of time. If people believed she was their greatest hope, she would gladly satisfy their curiosity. Across countless eras, she subjected herself to experiments, enduring her own decomposition and rebirth. Pain made her feel anchored to reality, yet she could only approach the past through the gaps of pain. None of her attempts were too hard to bear, for pain would ultimately be forgotten. But why then did she feel the walls closing in? Why did her infinite path now feel like a tightening noose? Was this not the way forward? She reached out her fingers between the narrowing gaps, desperately searching for a way out."
    },
    {
      "title": "The Perfect Gap",
      "content": "Ancient statues were especially valuable and difficult to procure due to the unique materials and exquisite craftsmanship that made them.\nYet, the more cherished a treasure, the more likely it was to meet destruction. What seemed accidental often carried a hint of inevitability, as if the self-destructive tendencies of their owners sealed their fate.\nThis statue fell from the top of the cabinet by accident someday, shattering into countless pieces that scattered across the floor. The era in which it was created had long passed, and now she was the only one who remembered its original form. Determined to restore it, she would set aside time to carefully glue the pieces back together. She started from the interior, reassembling tens of thousands of pieces based on the image of her memory. It was a task that required utmost concentration, and in those moments, her empty heart found calm and fulfillment. The world achieved perfect harmony as she worked. But when she slowed her pace, the world around her seemed to accelerate. Before she realized, she had restored most of the statue. It could now function and move as it used to. But this was far from enough. The beauty of its exterior was also an inseparable part of the statue. Every adjustment, every action had to follow her will to achieve perfection from the inside out.\nVictory seemed close yet distant at the same time. Every time she completed a section, another would fall under the weight of time.\nCracks would always exist.\nShe kept on working, putting each fallen piece back where it belonged time and again. The more anxious she became and yearned for the final result, the more the pieces seemed to scatter.\nFor too long she had stared at the statue, and the countless cracks on its surface began to resemble countless smiles, mocking her pursuit of perfection. They reminded her that the gap between fantasy and reality would forever exist, that she was only struggling with endless futility. For too long she had stared at the statue, that the cracks began to serve as a reminder that there was much to be done. This imperfection was already part of the statue. The cracks beyond perfection had, at some point, become the perfect gaps."
    },
    {
      "title": "Afterlife and Beyond",
      "content": "She looked up towards the sky. It was blue. But she remembered it being dark red.\nShe climbed over the fence on a search, as voices echoed around her, holding her back. \"You had a bad dream,\" they said.\nSo it was all just a dream... Like the fleeting clouds above, her white dress drifted across the grassland towards town. The sun rose as usual, and the town repeated the same chimney smokes and laughter day after day... Day after day, the ordinariness sank into her, and so did this feeling of stagnation. Her music no longer progressed, and people's thoughts no longer adapted to change. Day after day...\nHow long had it been since anyone ventured beyond the edges of town? Where did the food come from? How did they manage an endless supply of daily necessities? These were the questions she pondered as she walked further into the distance.\nComing up on the town's edge, she saw a red figure standing before the hazy mist. It had waited for a long time as if anticipating her arrival.\nHer intuition told her to stay away, but for some reason she reached out to place her hand in its palm, only to grasp a handful of blood.\nThe sky was indeed dark red.\nShe was but a dilapidated body with only one eye, covered in bright red flowers, unable to struggle or move. Why wasn't she dead? She gazed at the ashen sky, her hand involuntarily trying to grab the muddy red earth. Within her limited vision, her long-disappeared fingers slowly reappeared. The deaths of others cradled her rebirth, their residual Reverberations condensing in her right eye. It wasn't until she found the courage to leave the town and face reality that the \"<te href=851026>Beyond</te>\" enveloping her retreated deep into her heart. Red flowers trembled and fell, revealing new skin beneath. The echoes of laughter had not yet faded. She had indeed had a very long dream, a beautiful dream granted by the \"Beyond.\"\nBut who is it to say dreams cannot become reality?\nShe looked up. The sky was truly blue now.\nThe endless stagnation and the dream-shattering mist were no more. This was a new \"Beyond\" she had tirelessly recreated, identical to the one they had placed in her heart.\nPeople still called her name. And this time, she would surely embrace the real ones."
    }

      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "No need to rush off, the show isn't over just yet. The late hours of Tricktown belong to the revelry of bonfires, and the second act will begin at the stroke of midnight. Raise your arms, dance with abandon, and let us unveil the wild side of this city together.     {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "I know full well that the differences in that piece won't go unnoticed. The inspiration for such improvisation is a gift from the city of Peyero. The sound of the city's chiming fountain was pure and clear, with a hint of warmth. When it first reached my ears, it felt somewhat familiar. As I conducted, I couldn't help but think... it was like meeting an old friend I hadn't seen in a long time. Would you like to experience it? Consider it a unique epilogue to this performance.",

    {
      "type": 1,

      "content": "Would you care to know why the musical structure of this performance intrigues me so? The massive Ferris wheel I saw to the west side of Skob.     {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "Hecate has always stood at the crossroads of the <te href=851026>other world</te>, waiting, as if knowing that our paths would inevitably meet. The day I finally saw it clearly, I learned its name and understood the boundaries and choices it embodied.     {
      "type": 1,

      "content": "<te href=850073>Overclocking</te> is already common practice for the Fractsidus. I've seen countless people walk toward it, seize control, and exploit it.   "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Phrolova's Music Sheet",
      "content": "Her expression was calm, yet her hands waved with fervent, exaggerated motions, sweeping across one score after another. Reason teetered, then was torn, drowned beneath emotion's storm. Notes were shattered, then reborn, twisted into sound deformed.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure109_UI.T_Treasure109_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Phrolova's Violin",
      "content": "She was the one who received their gifts. She was the one who buried their remains.\nOne by one, the strings sang their exalted cries. Cycle after cycle, her bow played through repeated demises.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure108_UI.T_Treasure108_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Retained Concert Ticket",
      "content": "Once again, she stood before the music hall's entrance, with the ticket in her hand. She began to forget what exactly she was waiting for. The friend who understood her music? Or the path that shared a similar destination?\nThe crowds thinned. The doors closed behind the last of the audience. Yet, the ticket remained in her grasp.\nThen came the clarity: she had waited for neither. She was only waiting for a small thread to hang on to. A lifeline she dreamed of.\nShe would wait no longer.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure107_UI.T_Treasure107_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Movement of Life and Death",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\nWhen performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, enter <color=Highlight><te href=160805>Reincarnate</te></color> state.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Scarlet Coda</color></size>\nPhrolova enters the <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state every {1}s.\nWhen the following 3 conditions are met, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Scarlet Coda</color>.\n- Has 6 <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Notes</te></color>.\n- In the <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state.\n- Not in the <color=Highlight><te href=160802>Resolving Chord</te></color> state.\n<size=10></size>\n<color=Highlight>Scarlet Coda</color>: Consume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, Stagnating and pulling in nearby targets. This instance of damage is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.\nEach stack of <color=Highlight><te href=160803>Aftersound</te></color> additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of this instance of damage.\nCasting this skill is considered as casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.\nCasting this skill sends <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state into cooldown and activates the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.",
        "param": [
          "3",
          "25"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> is full, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color> becomes available, dealing massive <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>).\n<color=Highlight>Aftersound</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of this instance of damage.\nCasting this skill is considered as casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.\nThis skill cannot be cast repeatedly within an interval.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\nDeal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.",
        "simple_param": [

        ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Waltz of Forsaken Depths",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color></size>\nPhrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.\nWhen in the <color=Highlight><te href=160802>Resolving Chord</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> becomes available.\nCasting this skill ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, and Phrolova enters the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state for {0}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Maestro</color></size>\nGain {5} ATK increase.\nPhrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.\nDuring this period, Phrolova plays the <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Notes</te></color> in turn. Each <color=Highlight>Volatile Note</color> holds for {1}s.\nIf Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.\n- <color=Highlight>Cue - Basic Attack</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every {2} times Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>, the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Cue - Dodge</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.\n- <color=Highlight>Cue - Reset</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump to reset Hecate's position.\n- <color=Highlight>Cue - Curtain Call</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> and end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.\nWhen Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to {4} times in total during Phrolova's <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3}.\nSwitching back to Phrolova ends <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.\nEnding <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Hecate</color></size>\nPerform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color></size>\nWhen Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and Stagnating the targets (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color></size>\nWhen Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color></size>\nWhen Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Cadenza</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Curtain Call</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.\n- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.\n- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.\n- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.\n- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation.\n- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, hold Resonance Liberation.\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, casting <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> and ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state.",
        "param": [
          "24",

        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation</color></size>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack</color> unlocks <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> enters <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced State</color></size>\n- When Phrolova is the active Resonator, she can command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>. Every {2} times Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>, the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>.\n- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>. When Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight>Echo Skills</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>.\n- Switching back to Phrolova ends the <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Hecate</color></size>\n- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>: Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).\n- <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>: Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>). When Prolova is not the active Resonator, casting this skill grants <color=Highlight>Aftersound</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Rhapsody of a New World",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Movement of Fate and Finality</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Reincarnate</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Movement of Fate and Finality</color>, which Stagnates the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>) and ending <color=Highlight>Reincarnate</color> afterward.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Murmurs in a Haunting Dream</color></size>\nWhen in <color=Highlight>Reincarnate</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Murmurs in a Haunting Dream</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>) and ending <color=Highlight>Reincarnate</color> afterward.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Aftersound</color></size>\nPhrolova can hold up to {0} stacks of Aftersound.\nWhen Phrolova is not the active Resonator, casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color>, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color>, and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color> grants <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Aftersound.\nWhen Phrolova is out of combat, all stacks of Aftersound are removed every {2}s.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Volatile Note</color></size>\nPhrolova can hold up to 6 <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color>. When <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> reach the max number, gaining new <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> moves all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> one slot to the left, and the leftmost <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color> or <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color> will be removed.\nHitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Movement of Fate and Finality</color> grants 1 <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color>.\nHitting a target with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Whispers in a Fleeting Dream</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Murmurs in a Haunting Dream</color> grants 1 <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Inherent Skill - Accidental</color> is activated, casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, or Echo Skill grants 1 <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Cadenza</color>.\nPhrolova cannot obtain <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> during <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color>.",
        "param": [
          "24",
          "1",
          "30"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> can be chained into <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Enhanced Basic Attack</color> grants <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge - Red</color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color> grants <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge - Purple</color>.\nIn <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color>, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> gains different buffs based on the color of the current <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>.\n- <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge - Red</color>: <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> Stagnates the targets.\n- <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge - Purple</color>: <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> pulls the targets in.\n- <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge - Combined</color>: <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> Stagnates and pulls the targets in.",
        "simple_param": [
          "24",
          "1",
          "30"
        ],
