For Carlotta being a Montelli was her anchor—and the Montelli family was her everything.\n \n\"No, that's where you're mistaken,\" Grandfather said softly as if seeing exactly what Carlotta was thinking, \"A true Montelli does not live solely for the family. She does not exist to only follow rules, whether set by myself or by the family. She must feel the world and make her own rules.\"\n\n\"I want to see you shine because I believe you possess brilliance from within. Before you constrained yourself to the idea of what it meant to be a Montelli, you had just begun to define your own rules.\"\n\nThe sky outside began to lighten... In the end, Grandfather declined to let Carlotta keep the role of Executor. Instead, he asked her to write a letter inviting representatives from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> to Ragunna. Carlotta looked out the window. After the rain, Ragunna was enveloped in a dull gray mist. The city was a slumbering beast, waiting for the grand arrival of the Carnevale to awaken it.\n\nAt that moment, Carlotta was unaware that it was during this rainy night that Francesco Montelli made a decision that would shape the future of the Montellis. He would employ special means to return the power of choice to her hands. And she, like her original self, would pave the way for what was to come."
    },
    {
      "title": "In the Name of Carlotta",
      "content": "At dusk, the rain has finally stopped.\n\nThe soft glow of the setting sun gently washes over Carlotta as she sips coffee by the harbor. The tide rolls in and out, its golden ripples mirroring the endless cycle of Ragunna's days and nights. With no particular destination in mind, she wandered, pausing at random. This isn't her norm, but in the future, she might just make a habit of it, much like she has started making a habit of searching for parts of herself that belonged to Carlotta alone, separate from the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>.\n\nAfter celebrating the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> with the distinguished guest, and exposing Capollo's betrayal with {Male=his;Female=her} help, Carlotta finally understood what Grandfather had been unable to fully express on that rainy night.\n\nHe was concerned that she might do things for the family that went against her principles. Grandfather hadn't drawn a path for her based on his own past. He had only hoped that she would avoid being trapped by the established pattern.\n\nBut the truth is more complex than that.\n\nHer decision to remain as Executor was certainly made with the family's interest at heart. But every step that led to her decision was a choice she gladly made, and in the end, that was all there was to it. She was never one to be bound by rules. Not in the past. Not now. And not ever.\n\nNaturally, as a Montelli, she could not afford to think only of herself. She was drawn to extremes, to reckless solutions, unafraid of change or risk. But when it came time to act, when decisions had to be made, she tempered those inclinations. In a way, this was indeed a constraint imposed by her identity—a collar forged by blood and duty. But it was also a bond that anchored her. \n\nShe is Carlotta Montelli. She will always be needed. She will be cast aside again. Despite that single constraint, she has a freedom few could claim.\n\nA life devoted to creating a singular, defining masterpiece—Carlotta has seen many such lives.\n\nThe tapestry of her future is a subject far more enticing, and one she is more than willing to weave, thread by thread. To capture the essence of who she is, she will continue to cut, arrange, and layer... until she can call it a rich enough work of art.\n\nBut for now, she wants to permit herself a small sense of pride.\n\nCarlotta isn't ready to bear the parts of herself that exist only in the quiet spaces of her mind... But perhaps {PlayerName} would be the exception. Indeed, she still preferred to call {Male=him;Female=her} Cat's Eye. They had walked shoulder to shoulder for a time, but in the end, neither of them could have paused their journey for the other. {Male=He;Female=She} had been blunt about her \"excessive perfection,\" and so, in keeping with the promise she made to \"be less reserved,\" Carlotta will weave that Cat's Eye into the fabric of her story. She can't shake the feeling that fate is not done with them yet. As for when, or how, or what new adventures may unfold between them... she can scarcely wait.\n\nIn the distance, a Gondola cuts through still water as it glides back toward the dock. A chorus of calls between those aboard and onshore marks the fading echoes of the day's clamor. After the rain, no one can say what transpired in the dark of the night. For now, only the dying light brushes her skin, marking the end of the cycle of the day. \n\nShe takes one last sip from her cup, turns, and walks into the encroaching darkness.\n\nIn the stillness of the world, she will dance her own dance."
    }

      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Is that it?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "I'm still standing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "An eye... for an eye.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Glory to the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_die_01.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "Death… is not the end.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_die_02.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Red, a fading red…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_die_03.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Let's take them together.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_skill_hxsummon.play_favor_word_kelaita_skill_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Still recognize me?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_skill_hxchange.play_favor_word_kelaita_skill_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Quickly and swiftly.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_engage.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "Lighter than a dove.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Grapple",
      "content": "Gently does it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_hook_01.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_hook_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Ah… There you are.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_scan.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Can you keep up?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_dash_01.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_dash_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Wall Dash",
      "content": "A smooth journey.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_fastclimb_01.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_fastclimb_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Anything catch your eye?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "This craftsmanship... A wise investment.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Start small to build big.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_kelaita_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_kelaita_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Art's Return",
      "content": "This is no mere collage made of disparate materials but rather an interpretation of inspiration and a concept of constructivist ideals. Its creator started her career marked by striking innovation, yet she remained deeply underappreciated. Carlotta, however, recognized this \"hidden gem,\" describing her work as \"an impression of otherness with a hauntingly poetic touch.\" Now a celebrated installation artist in Ragunna, she crafted this fine piece as a unique token of gratitude for Carlotta's sponsorship and unwavering trust.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure82_UI.T_Treasure82_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Executor's Case",
      "content": "A delicate case decorated with intricately carved gemstones, ideal for any formal occasion. They say a lady's bag is where her secrets hide, which is certainly true for Carlotta. The perfume bottle, for instance, is a grenade in disguise, while the glasses are special instruments displaying real-time locations and query results. Beyond their ornamental charm, these items are Carlotta's most reliable allies in her missions.\nIn beauty, they adorn; in death, they unmake—perfectly suit their owner's needs.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure83_UI.T_Treasure83_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Family's Creed",
      "content": "A pair of black gloves, their lustrous sheen reminiscent of the night, adorned with gemstones bearing the same name as the wearer—Opal.\nWithin the family, there are many unspoken rules, subtle and unnecessary to voice aloud. One such rule is this: those who wear black gloves must quietly resolve any \"troubles\" to serve the family's needs.\nYet, this is not a matter of compromise, but rather Carlotta's own choice. The family has shown her the wider world, and now she will guide them into an even greater one—both in the name of the true <te href=850101>Montelli</te> and her own.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure84_UI.T_Treasure84_UI"
    }
  ],

  "skill_trees": {
    "1": {

      ],
      "skill": {
        "name": "Silent Execution",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>\nPerform up to 2 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Necessary Measures</color></size>\nWith <te href=850017>Moldable Crystals</te>, Carlotta's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Necessary Measures</color>.\nChain up to 3 strikes, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Each strike of <color=Highlight>Necessary Measures</color> consumes <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> Moldable {Cus:Sap,S=Crystal P=Crystals SapTag=1}.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>\nDeliver a charged attack at the target at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Containment Tactics</color></size>\nWhen Carlotta's <te href=850018>Substance</te> is full, her <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will be replaced with <color=Highlight>Containment Tactics</color>: consume all Substance to deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color> by {3}s.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>\nPerform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Using <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly after the landing will cast <color=Highlight>Customary Greetings</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Customary Greetings</color></size>\nFlip over the target and deliver a surprise shot, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to deliver a riposte shot, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.       "skill": {
        "name": "Era of New Wave",
        "desc": "Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> to all targets in an area (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and inflict <color=Highlight>Deconstruction</color> on targets hit, then activate <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air close to the ground.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Deconstruction</color></size>\nDealing DMG to targets inflicted with <color=Highlight>Deconstruction</color> ignores {1} of their DEF.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Twilight Tango</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>.\nEach <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color> grants <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> Meta {Cus:Sap,S=Vector P=Vectors SapTag=3}.\nWith {4} Meta Vectors, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Fatal Finale</color>. \n- All Substance is removed when activating and ending <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>. Cannot perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Necessary Measures</color>, Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Containment Tactics</color>, and Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Imminent Oblivion</color> while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Death Knell</color></size>\nCarlotta fires powerful shots with her musket and summons {5} crystal shards to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Skill DMG.\n- Carlotta moves in the direction of the movement input with each shot of <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Fatal Finale</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> to an area, considered Resonance Skill DMG.\n- <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> ends after casting <color=Highlight>Fatal Finale</color>.",
        "param": [

        ],
        "simple_desc": "Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight>Deconstruction</color>, then activate <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>. \nCan be cast in mid-air. \n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Deconstruction</color></size>\nDealing DMG to targets inflicted with <color=Highlight>Deconstruction</color> ignores {1} of their DEF.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Twilight Tango</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>.\nEach <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color> grants <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> Meta {Cus:Sap,S=Vector P=Vectors SapTag=3}.\nWith {4} Meta Vectors, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Fatal Finale</color>. \n- All Substance is removed when activating and ending <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>.       "skill": {
        "name": "Lethal Repertoire",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion</color></size>\nCarlotta activates <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> every {0}s.\nWhen Substance is full and <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> is activated, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to consume all Substance and cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Imminent Oblivion</color>, after which <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> enters cooldown. \nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG), and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color> by {1}s.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Final Bow</color></size>\nWhen Substance is full, enter the <color=Highlight>Final Bow</color> state.\nIncrease the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Era of New Wave</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fatal Finale</color> by {14}. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> or when <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> ends.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Substance</color></size>\nCarlotta can hold up to {2} points of Substance.\nCannot gain Substance while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> triggered by Resonance Liberation.\nRestore {3} points of Substance upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>.\nRestore {5} points of Substance for every {4} Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Chromatic Splendor</color>.\nRestore {5} points of Substance for every {4} Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Necessary Measures</color>.\nConsume {4} Moldable Crystal and restore {12} points of Substance upon casting <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Moldable Crystal</color></size>\nCarlotta can hold up to {6} Moldable Crystals.\nCannot gain Moldable Crystal while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> triggered by Resonance Liberation.\nRestore {7} Moldable Crystals upon casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.\nRestore {11} Moldable Crystals upon casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.\nRestore {8} Moldable Crystals upon casting Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Customary Greetings</color>.\nRestore {13} Moldable Crystals upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>.\nRestore {9} Moldable Crystals upon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color>.\nRestore {10} Moldable Crystals upon a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.",
        "param": [
          "22",
          "6",
          "120",
          "30",
          "1",
          "10",
          "6",
          "3",
          "3",
          "3",
          "3",
          "3",
          "10",
          "3",
          "80%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion</color></size>\nCarlotta activates <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> every {0}s.\nWhen Substance is full and <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> is activated, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to consume all Substance and cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Imminent Oblivion</color>, after which <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> enters cooldown.\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color> by {1}s.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Final Bow</color></size>\nWhen Substance is full, enter the <color=Highlight>Final Bow</color> state.\nIncrease the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Era of New Wave </color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fatal Finale</color> by {14}. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> or when <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> ends.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Substance</color></size>\nCarlotta can hold up to {2} points of Substance.\nCannot obtain Substance when in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>.\nSubstance can be obtained in the following ways: Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>, consuming Moldable Crystals via Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Chromatic Splendor</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Necessary Measures</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.\n<size=10> </size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Moldable Crystal</color></size>\nCarlotta can hold up to {6} Crystals.\nCannot gain Moldable Crystals while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>.\nMoldable Crystal can be obtained in the following ways: <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Customary Greetings</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color>, and a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.",
        "simple_param": [

    "info": "Hailing from Ashinohara, the Miko of Flaming Sakura now remains in Lahai-Roi as the last and only member of the Special Response Force.",
    "talent_name": "Futures' Tithe",
    "talent_doc": "[<te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>: Classified Archive]\n\nInterview Dossier: Hiyuki\n\nDue to multifaceted considerations, we have foregone a truly comprehensive evaluation of the representative from <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>—the Miko of Flaming Sakura.\nThe majority of the intelligence gathered herein is based on her personal testimony. In the recorder's professional estimation, corroborated through subsequent cross-referencing, she appears to harbor no intention of concealing any information regarding her background.\n<i>\"After all, information regarding the 'Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura' can be found in just about any Ashinohara elementary school textbook...\"</i>\n \nAccording to Hiyuki's own account, the source of her Forte is the \"Suzu,\" a Legacy Talisman worn on her right wrist.\nHiyuki describes the Suzu as follows: It grants the bearer the ability to perceive and utilize \"future possibilities\" of oneself, though it does not allow for direct communication with these \"shadows of future possibility.\"\nThe freezing power she often wields in combat also stems from the \"Suzu.\"\n<i>\"Verified via official Ashinohara reports: The Legacy Talismans are five relics left behind by the Sentinels, distributed among the internal factions of Ashinohara for safekeeping.\"</i>\n<i>\"Among them, the Suzu is described as granting its bearer the power to 'draw upon the future.'\"</i>\n \nConsequently, it is determined that the fundamental source of her exceptional combat prowess remains her own inherent skill.\nHowever, the \"futures\" available for her to draw upon are not infinite. Out of concern for her physiological lifespan, aggressive deployment of her abilities is strongly advised against.\n<i>\"Investigation confirms that every Miko of Flaming Sakura has shared a singular cause of death: vanishing from the battlefield without a trace following excessive use of the Suzu.\"</i>",
    "talent_certification": "The subject's Rabelle's Waveform diagram exhibits an elliptical oscillation pattern with a stable Time Domain representation. No abnormal fluctuations were observed. Examination results are determined to be within normal parameters. \n \nCurrent <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> threshold is exceptionally high, and subject stability remains robust. There is no risk of Overclocking, and the subject has no prior history of Overclocking. However, a course of psychological intervention is recommended.\n \n<i>\"This miko... How should I put this...\"</i>\n<i>\"<te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> textbooks never show her face, but they're clear about one thing. She is the strongest living warrior in all of Ashinohara.\"</i>\n<i>\"And yet, with all that combat, her readings stay perfectly stable. Something about that just doesn't sit right...\"</i>\n<i>\"I get your concern, but the data is clear. There's not a single irregularity.\"</i>\n<i>\"...Then what about those shadows? Like parallel-universe versions of herself from some movie?\"</i>\n<i>\"Hardly. It must be the Suzu's power. Just as the Ashinohara records describe, it allows her to 'draw upon the future' to a certain extent.\"</i>",
    "cv_name_cn": "Li Chanfei",
    "cv_name_jp": "Tomatsu Haruka",
    "cv_name_ko": "Jung Hye Won",
    "cv_name_en": "Mei Mac"
  },
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "Words Left Unsaid",
      "content": "The first time Hiyuki heard the truth of her own past, it spilled from Gyokuro's drunken lips. Hiyuki's mouth tightened. Without a word, she poured herself a glass of the bitter liquor.\n \n\"Hiyuki... My dear Hiyuki...\" \n\"You can't do this. You can't be the damn Miko of Flaming Sakura... Your life was never meant to be like this!\"\n \nHiyuki's eyes narrowed. If the people of <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> saw their usually dignified and poised Miko of Flaming Sakura acting like this behind closed doors... \n \nThe second hand ticked. The minute hand followed. At last, the hour hand lurched forward. By Ashinohara time, this very moment marked Hiyuki's transition into adulthood. She sighed and downed the drink in one burning gulp.\n \n\"You managed. You think I cannot?\"\n \nThe liquor scorched her throat and settled like lead in her slight frame. So this was what they called the \"drink of adulthood.\" Its taste, she decided, was hardly worth the wait. Hiyuki stood and draped a blanket over Gyokuro's muttering form. She lingered in the corner for a long moment. At last, she stepped forward, tucked the edges tight, and closed the door softly behind her.\n \nThe next morning, Gyokuro's fury toward the steward tasked with the Legacy Talisman's succession rang out loud enough to be heard two streets away.\n \nThe Suzu's power lay in \"drawing upon the future.\" In simple terms, it meant every use exacted a toll from the bearer's remaining lifespan. In the worst case, it meant a successor who inherited the bell today might vanish into nothingness in their very first battle against a Threnodian. Because the price was so high, successors were usually chosen early. Hiyuki had stayed at Gyokuro's side for more than a decade. Even if Gyokuro refused to name her... who else could possibly be chosen?\n \nThe steward, unable to handle Gyokuro's temper, could only offer a strained, placating smile. \"Even if not Hiyuki, surely you must name someone, Lady Miko.\"\n \nGyokuro fell silent for a few breaths. She sighed, cleared her throat, and prepared to resume her tirade.\n \nIt was Hiyuki who finally opened the door, ending the farce.\n \n\"For years, I have journeyed with you through Ashinohara. I know what each duty demands.\" \n\"I have mastered every art a miko must know. The weaving of charms, the ceremonial dances—all from teachers of your own choosing.\"\n\"Only I can ensure the name of the Flaming Sakura remains untarnished, Gyokuro... No. Lady Miko.\"\n \nGyokuro's brow furrowed. She waved a hand dismissively. \n\n\"You've learned it all, have you? Then don't you realize the Suzu will be the death of you?\"\n\"I was an orphan you took in. My family lies buried beneath the snow from that Threnodian attack. I have no attachments left.\"\n \nThe room fell suffocatingly quiet. The only sound was the raspy, obsessive scrape of Gyokuro's thumb as she rubbed the bell on her wrist. She tried to speak, but in the end, no words came."
    },
    {
      "title": "There Will Never Be Another...",
      "content": "The days following Hiyuki's succession were inevitably frantic. Where once she had simply walked in Gyokuro's shadow, she now found the weight of every duty resting on her own shoulders.\n \n<te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> had long suffered under the <te href=850074>Threnodian's</te> shadow, forcing the land to weave its very survival around the mikos. As the bearer of the Suzu, Hiyuki's status was as uniquely sacred as it was heavy, and her jurisdiction covered the entirety of Ashinohara. She became a nomad of necessity, racing between different places to assist the local mikos and turn the tides of battle.\n \nYet a miko was as much a living symbol as a blade. Wherever people would gather, a miko must appear to remind them why they fought. The Miko of Flaming Sakura was no exception. Hiyuki carried both burdens well. Perhaps it was because she had learned each duty at Gyokuro's side since childhood, combat and ceremony alike had long since become second nature. The only thing missing was Gyokuro's specific Flaming Sakura swordsmanship. Gyokuro had stubbornly refused to pass down the forms, even going so far as to distance herself from Hiyuki.\n \n\"Fine. If you will not teach me, I will learn in secret. One day, I will master it. One day.\"\n \nBut that day never came.\n\n\"The Suzu allows the bearer to draw upon the future, and a successor who inherits the Suzu today might vanish into nothingness during their very first battle with a Threnodian...\"\n \nHiyuki couldn't remember the words the steward whispered when placing the Suzu in her hands. She couldn't remember the clumsy way she tied it to her wrist, mimicking a gesture she had seen so many times. She couldn't recall the weather that day, or the face of the person who handed her the small wooden box containing Gyokuro's legacy.\n \nBy the time the world rushed back into focus, she was sitting alone in the hollowed halls of the seat of Flaming Sakura, clutching the wish slip that had been inside the box.\n \nBlood froze in her chest. A creeping frost left her fingertips numb. Inch by inch, Hiyuki dragged herself to that familiar corner of the room and curled up. She had crumpled the wish slip earlier. Now she smoothed it flat. \n \n\"...I see.\"\n\"...I accept your wish.\"\n\"...There will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura.\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Snowed In",
      "content": "\"Lady Hiyuki, you have served as the Miko of Flaming Sakura for a century now. If we are to renew the contract...\"\n\"It is of no consequence.\"\n\"Then, as per our previous arrangement... for how many years shall we set the renewal?\"\n\"Fill it as you wish.\"\n\"I did not expect you to be quite so like the previous Miko... Ahem. Very well. As you wish, Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura.\"\n \nThe steward bowed and withdrew, closing the door with practiced reverence. Hiyuki noted that the staff accompanying him had changed three times over the decades. She shook her head, eyes narrowing as they fell upon the envelope on her desk. After a pause, she reached instead for a teacup that had long since gone cold.\n \n\"Just like the previous Miko... am I?\"\n \nHow long had it actually been since she took up the title? \nLong enough that \"Hiyuki\" was now a fixed entry in <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>'s history books. \nWas it a long time? \nNot long enough.\n \nTrue to the fortune lot she had inherited that year, Hiyuki had used her own strength to prove a silent vow: There will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura. Gradually, the voices urging her to select a successor had faded. The Office of Legacy Talismans now treated its visits to the shrine as a mere formality. Even the steward, she suspected, believed a successor unnecessary. To them, Hiyuki had become the title itself.\n \nYet Hiyuki often heard a voice. It wasn't the grating, persistent lure of the Fractsidus. It was a peaceful murmur stating facts plainly in her ear.\n \n\"Hiyuki, you have held on for so long. But your enemy, the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>, has a far longer lifespan. It will wait until you die, until every miko, and every successor of every miko, has passed into memory.\"\n\"Does this path of resistance truly have an end?\"\n \nCold tea is always the most bitter. The over-steeped acridity clung to her tongue, making each breath feel heavy. Hiyuki tapped a finger against the envelope on the desk. Instantly, a layer of frost raced across its surface. With one more light touch, the unopened Fractsidus seal shattered into crystalline dust.\n \nHiyuki rose and called out to the child who had volunteered to help clean the shrine, reminding her to stay vigilant and watch for intruders while she was away. Her lips curled into a smile as she ruffled the girl's hair and pressed a protective charm into her small palm.\n \n\"Lady Miko, where are you going to help this time?\"\n\"Honami. I will be back soon. Keep this charm with you during this time, all right?\"\n \nHiyuki waved goodbye to the little girl. As she turned to leave, the bell on her wrist caught the light, shining as brilliantly as ever."
    },
    {
      "title": "Vanished Honami",
      "content": "The people of <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> had long grown accustomed to the distortions wrought by the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>. Survival was a matter of routine: seek shelter, wait for the local miko to deploy, and if the situation spiraled, wait for the recovery teams and the Miko of Flaming Sakura to arrive.\n \nTo Hiyuki, this felt like just another fight among thousands. She cut through the monsters with practiced efficiency, checking the integrity of the barrier as she always did. As the civilians emerged from the shelters, parents pointed her out to their children with reverent relief. \"Look, that's Lady Miko of Flaming Sakura.\"\n \nHiyuki offered a slight nod in response. She stepped over a fallen \"No Entry\" sign and turned back toward the barrier to finish her sweep.\n \nFocus. Strike. Sheathe... Hm?\n \nThe blade passed through the air as it always did. Yet something was different. Subtle, but unmistakable.\n \nHiyuki reexamined the entire barrier. Everything appeared intact, yet a lingering, visceral wrongness clung to her fingertips. She released her hilt. Flexed her wrist. Pressed her fingers together—\n \nA single drop of iridescent black mire welled from her skin. It pooled in the creases of her palm before dripping to the ground, spreading silently beneath her feet. \n\nHiyuki drew her blade. Frost snapped into existence around her. First, contain it. Evacuate the civilians. Then find a way to—\n \nShe turned, but the cry died in her throat. There was nothing before her. It was as if the air itself vanished. For one frozen moment, Hiyuki could not breathe.\n \nHonami was gone.\n\nAside from the shattered sign at her feet and a trace of mud creeping up the hem of her dress, there was nothing left.\n \nHiyuki reached out, but her hand recoiled on its own. She gasped for breath, but there was no oxygen. It was as if the atmosphere itself had been erased from existence. She raised her blade to strike, but found no enemy to sever. Only a faint, residual frequency remained, proof that the Threnodian had acted, for a fraction of a second, with power never before recorded.\n \nAccording to Ashinohara's records, Honami had been pulled into another dimension at that moment. Even after a desperate appeal to the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> for their most advanced tracking technology, not a single trace could be found.\n \nWhen the others finally led Hiyuki away, she was still mindlessly rubbing the bell on her wrist, her mind trapped in that moment of shock.\n\nWas this silent disaster her fault?\nOf course it was her fault. As the Miko of Flaming Sakura, she had failed to protect Honami.\nAnd of course, it was not her fault. Against the power of a Threnodian, a single person didn't matter—even one who could draw a million futures to safeguard the present.\n \nHiyuki returned to the Flaming Sakura. She took the protective charm from the child at the gate, forcing a ghost of a smile. Then she walked slowly to her room and pushed open the door. There, sitting quietly on her desk, was the envelope she had destroyed.\n \n\"Hiyuki, oh Hiyuki... Does this path truly have an end?\""
    },
    {
      "title": "Even Should the Path Have No End",
      "content": "Hiyuki didn't linger on the Fractsidus's many offers. No sane person would collaborate with those who viewed human lives as mere expendable fuel.\n \nInstead, she traveled across <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>, leaving behind white paper birds infused with her own frequency. She instructed the local mikos that her mind was linked to these messengers, and should any insurmountable incident occur, she would be there the moment they crushed the bird.\n \nThe path of resistance against the <te href=850074>Threnodians</te>... it had to have an end. It had to.\n \nIt was then that Hiyuki heard word that the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> was grappling with a critical lack of safety provisions for its expeditions. She saw an opportunity and proposed a \"trade.\" She would ensure the safety of their exploration efforts, and in exchange, the Collective would forge her a blade using the pinnacle of Solaris technology. A weapon sharp enough to cleave through a Threnodian.\n \nHiyuki joined the Spacetrek Collective as part of the Special Response Force. The unit had once been large, but casualties mounted as Aleph-1 grew more active. So Hiyuki submitted a request, proposing that henceforth, she alone would handle Threnodian containment and ensure the safety of those conducting surveys.\n \nWhen she first arrived here, the Collective was little more than a plot of foundation in the dirt. She watched as Lahai-Roi was built, step by step, and began to grasp the true measure of human potential. The facility's construction was a miracle, perhaps the greatest engineering feat in the history of <te href=850079>Solaris</te>. Yet it came not from gods, nor from any single hero. It was built, brick by brick, by people across all Solaris who dared to dream.\n \n\"Lucilla.\"\n\"Hmm?\"\n\nLucilla casually pulled a bottle of fine liquor from beneath the desk, a specialty from Ashinohara. A student hoping to pass their finals had left it at one of Hiyuki's frequent haunts, tucked under a neat note asking for the miko's blessing.\n \nHiyuki sighed, set out two glasses, and pushed one toward the restless Lucilla.\n \n\"The Spacetrek Collective... it was built to explore the stars beyond Solaris, was it not?\"\n\"That's the idea.\"\n\"How fares the progress?\"\n\"Ugh...\" Lucilla drained her drink in one go. \"Still a long way off. Research is hitting walls everywhere, and the higher-ups keep breathing down our necks with impossible demands.\"\n \nHiyuki rubbed the bell on her wrist, her eyes downcast. \n\n\"Have any of you ever wondered... where the end of this path is?\"\n \nLucilla toyed with her empty glass, then gently clinked it against Hiyuki's.\n \n\"There is no end, Hiyuki. Just like what you're trying to do... No end.\"\n\"But we have to keep moving forward anyway.\"\n\"Not to reach a finish line, but to take one more step alongside the people standing next to us.\"\n \nHiyuki remained silent for a long time. Finally, she gave a soft nod and raised her glass, drinking deeply. The liquor scorched her throat and settled like lead in her slight frame.\n \nThe bell on her wrist chimed—a solitary sound, but the Miko of Flaming Sakura would take her next step regardless."
    }
  ],
  "voices": [
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: I",
      "content": "Aleph-1 has been driven back, for now. But its shadow lingers. There are still complications in <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, matters unfit for researchers that require my hand. Once they are settled, I intend to return to <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> to see it for myself. Though it has already been... Well, perhaps we will meet again there.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer01.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: II",
      "content": "About the Fractsidus... You remember how I can draw upon my futures with the Suzu's power? Among them was one where I became a <te href=850074>Threnodian</te> Resonator. That possibility proved I could bear its power, and marked me as a threat in the eyes of many. That is why the Fractsidus sought me out, time and again. But you need not worry. I burned that future to ash before your eyes. The line is drawn.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer02.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: III",
      "content": "Tales of your exploits abound. Folk legends across countless regions, <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> reports, slander from the lips of your enemies...Yet those remain merely the evaluations of others. It was not until I met you that I understood why they depict you as they do. Had our paths crossed sooner... I wonder, might mine have taken a different turn?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer03.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: IV",
      "content": "There is something I wish... No, something I must confess to you. Even now, after our time together, a sour sentiment lingers within me. If I were to name it, I would call it \"jealousy.\" I find myself imagining your power as my own, wondering if I, too, could have... Forgive me. I simply needed to exhale this poison. If my words trouble you... then I will bear whatever judgment you deem fitting.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer04.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Thoughts: V",
      "content": "I once wielded my blade to see it shatter. Each strike was my prayer for spring, for the snow to thaw, and... for my own release. I believed solitude was a fate I could not escape. But when I looked at you, I realized that perhaps I may yet cling to something in this fate. I am not you, and I will never become you. Our paths may have crossed but briefly, yet knowing you walk the same path as well... I no longer feel alone.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer05.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_toplayer05"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Hiyuki's Hobby",
      "content": "I sculpt figurines in my leisure time. It is an intricate process, demanding one's complete focus. A state I find grounding. And no matter the medium or style, there is always a reference, a clear set of steps to follow. Adhere to them, and a repeatable result is assured. Such certainty is rare to find these days.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_taste.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_taste"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Hiyuki's Trouble",
      "content": "<te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> still occupies my thoughts... but I would not call it a burden. The past is settled. What remains is to handle what was left behind. Even if it is nowhere to be found on any map, the land still carries a legacy meant to endure.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_worry.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_worry"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Favorite Food",
      "content": "Gyokuro tea. It is <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>'s specialty. When I was young, I would steal sips from the adults' cups. All I tasted then was bitterness. But by the time I learned to appreciate the sweet aftertaste, I realized I had begun to miss that bitterness instead.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_foodlike.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_foodlike"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Disliked Food",
      "content": "Confections, I suppose... Not from any preference of palate. It is simply that sweetness, upon tasting, stirs memories of a bitter kind. The sweeter the past I once held, the more bitter the aftertaste that lingers.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_foodhate.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_foodhate"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ideals",
      "content": "My wish is... that there will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura. That no further fate need be bound to the <te href=850074>Threnodians</te>. Perhaps... all we have ever sought is a world where every soul is simply granted the right to live an ordinary life.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_dream.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_dream"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "The bell I wear on my wrist is what we call a \"Legacy Talisman\" in <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. For us Mikos of Flaming Sakura, it is a sacred relic passed down through generations—a vessel of Ashinohara's wishes. Through it, I gain the power to burn my futures, a power said to originate from Ashinohara's Sentinel. I know you share a close bond with the Sentinels. If you wish to see it, I can show it to you. Oh... the cord tied to the bell? Gyokuro braided it for me when I was a child. That alone is mine. The only thing that is.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_storyobj.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_storyobj"

    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "If you wish to know more about my past, you will find snippets of it in the records of <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. They tell a far more vivid tale than I ever could. After all, my only memory of the past is me striking that blade, again and again and again.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_storyexp.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_storyexp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Lynae",
      "content": "She is a bright spirit. I am aware of certain secrets she carries. In a sense, we are both bound by our pasts.     {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Chisa",
      "content": "Chisa is also from <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. I have made a point to avoid meeting her. After all, in our homeland, Mikos only appeared in the darkest of times.       "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_about_qianxiao.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_about_qianxiao"

    {
      "type": 1,

      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Lucilla",
      "content": "Though Lucilla insists our partnership is only contractual, I am well aware that without her discreet arrangements, I would have no place in the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>, much less have obtained that blade.     {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "A joyous birthday to you. The day of one's birth signifies the commencement of all things. It is a guidepost to your origin and an anchor should you ever drift. I first thought to prepare a traditional gift. Yet upon reflection, there is no offering more fitting than this single, blank paper. Please, write your wish here. Hold nothing back. Whatever it may be, I shall make it come true.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_feixue_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_feixue_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "(Effort sound)",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_feixue_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "I am Hiyuki, the last Miko of Flaming Sakura. Should you seek to slay the Threnodians, my blade and I stand at your service.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "...Ephemeral are the blooms.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "Entrust your wishes to me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Mm, I am here.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "Very well. As you wish.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "Hm, I feel it now. A sharper edge now rests within my grasp.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "With this strength, I shall safeguard more wishes.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_feixue_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: I",
      "content": "Be gone.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_atk03_sp_01.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_atk03_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: II",
      "content": "Dissipate.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_atk03_sp_02.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_atk03_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: III",
      "content": "Rest now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_atk05_sp_01.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_atk05_sp_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: IV",
      "content": "Time to end this.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_atk05_sp_02.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_atk05_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "Too late to escape.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk01_pro_01.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk01_pro_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "You should have run.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk01_pro_03.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk01_pro_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: III",
      "content": "Wait for the moment.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk02_start_03.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk02_start_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: IV",
      "content": "Is that the best you can do?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk02_pro_03.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk02_pro_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: V",
      "content": "Restless already?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk02_pro_01.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk02_pro_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: VI",
      "content": "Nuisance.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk02_pro_02.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk02_pro_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: VII",
      "content": "Follow my moves, if you can.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk03_01.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk03_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: VIII",
      "content": "Evanescent morning dew. Vanish!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk03_02.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk03_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: IX",
      "content": "You've prepared for this, have you not?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk03_03.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_heavyatk03_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Your days are numbered.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill01_01.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "No chance.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill01_02.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Drift with snowflakes.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill02_01.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Swirl.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill02_02.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Fall in my wake.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill03_01.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill03_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Down you go!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill03_03.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill03_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Forte Circuit: I",
      "content": "Brittle snow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill06_a.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill06_a"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Forte Circuit: II",
      "content": "Fading bloom.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill06_b.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill06_b"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Forte Circuit: III",
      "content": "Waning moon.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill06_c.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_skill06_c"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "...Let there be snow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "A life as fleeting as the first snow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Take your final dive, into Naraka.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: IV",
      "content": "May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst02_01.play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst02_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: V",
      "content": "Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst02_02.play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst02_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VI",
      "content": "For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst02_03.play_favor_word_feixue_burst_burst02_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill",
      "content": "You can trust me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_skill_qte_01.play_favor_word_feixue_skill_qte_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter: I",
      "content": "Futile.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_dodgeatk_02.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_dodgeatk_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dodge Counter: II",
      "content": "Too slow.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_atk_dodgeatk_03.play_favor_word_feixue_atk_dodgeatk_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit",
      "content": "Heh, it's been so long...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_behitfly_01.play_favor_word_feixue_com_behitfly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Worry not for me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_feixue_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",
      "content": "Be cautious. Stand back.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_hpdown02.play_favor_word_feixue_com_hpdown02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",
      "content": "I cannot fall now.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_hpdown03.play_favor_word_feixue_com_hpdown03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",
      "content": "Destined... to fade...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_die_01.play_favor_word_feixue_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "I've... seen this coming...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_die_02.play_favor_word_feixue_com_die_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "An ending, as it is...",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_die_03.play_favor_word_feixue_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Heed the summon.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_feixue_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Lend me your strength.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_feixue_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near",
      "content": "Careful. Get behind me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_engage.play_favor_word_feixue_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider",
      "content": "An intriguing device.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_feixue_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "There it is.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_scan.play_favor_word_feixue_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash",
      "content": "Let's get moving.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_feixue_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "You keep it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_feixue_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "Anything you might need?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_feixue_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Our rightful claim.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_feixue_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_feixue_com_openbox_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "Origami Familiar",
      "content": "Few would guess that the white birds soaring above the skies of <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, the very ones under the Miko of Flaming Sakura's command, could look so endearingly adorable up close.\n \nHiyuki's fingers are nimble, yet they seem to fail her whenever she attempts a \"professional\" origami bird. She even resorted to eavesdropping on origami lessons from outside a window, but the final result was always this same, harmlessly cute shape.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure143_UI.T_Treasure143_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Fortune Lot",
      "content": "A fortune lot from the Flaming Sakura. Its sakura motifs and divination text have been wholly obscured, buried beneath tiny white flowers gathered from somewhere unknown.\n\nHiyuki first drew this lot when she sought guidance, asking whether she would smoothly inherit the title of Miko of Flaming Sakura. Only days later, she discovered that someone had, in secret, stitched and reshaped her fortune into this form.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure144_UI.T_Treasure144_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Carving Kit Set",
      "content": "In her spare time, Hiyuki retreats to a secluded corner to carve. \n \nFigurines of people, animals, miniature landscapes, or scenes from art, she attempts to render them all with her carving knife. Recently, there is a rumor that her interest has shifted from the <te href=700022>Exoswarm</te> to the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>'s various mechanical constructs. Students have even reported glimpsing her in the frostlands, attempting to carve the likeness of the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te>.\n\nPerhaps one day, the carving knife in her hand will finally replace the blade sheathed at her waist.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure145_UI.T_Treasure145_UI"
    }
  ],
  "special_cook": {
    "id": 80001077,
    "name": "Packaged Red Bean Pudding",
    "desc": "Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 25%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.",
    "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconCook/T_IconCook_SP_26_UI.T_IconCook_SP_26_UI",
    "rarity": 3
  },

      "skill": {
        "name": "Flaming Sakura Blade Art",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Present Self</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> reaches 300 points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color> becomes available.\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.\nWhen the last arrow is shot, 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> is consumed and <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available. The arrow applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Present Self</color></size>\nConsume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Present Self</color></size>\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>.\nPerform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5</color> each applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nIn <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Hold Breath</color>, continuously consuming STA. When <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the <color=Highlight>Hold Breath</color> state and thrusts forward, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2</color>.\nIf Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4</color> instead.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>. \nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and consume STA and 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> to gain 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.\n<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.\nIf Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>.\nConsume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.\n<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3</color> apply <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.\nThe <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color> cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> within a short period.\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self</color>.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Dedication</color> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color> becomes available.\nHold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to consume STA and <color=Highlight>Dedication</color> to deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Hold Breath</color>. Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and block the incoming attack.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack -Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>.\nConsume STA and <color=Highlight>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color> to deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>",
        "simple_param": [],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Frostblight",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\nCasting this skill enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>, which now restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.\n{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.\n<size=10></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>:\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color></size>\nWhile on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, removing the targets' <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color>.\nThis skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Frostblight: Petalfall</color></size>\nWhile in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, removing the targets' <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color>.\nThis skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color></size>\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>:\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color></size>\nCan be cast on the ground. Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Frostblight: Petalfall</color></size>\nCan be cast in mid-air. Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.",

      "skill": {
        "name": "Foreclaiming",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, remove 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>. Then, enter <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> and restore 50 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.\n<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> applies 4 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> can be cast via the following ways:\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> and release to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. If Hiyuki has 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>. Otherwise, this cast does not consume <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.\n- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> periodically. Release <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. If no <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> is consumed when <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> will also be cast automatically when <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> depletes. \nHiyuki deals <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Each point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.\nCasting the skill consumes 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, and ends <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>.",
        "param": [],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color></size>\n<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color>.\nDeal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Upon casting, enter <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to enter a charging state by continuously consuming <color=Highlight>Snowforged Blade</color>. Release <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. The more <color=Highlight>Snowforged Blade</color> consumed while charging the attack, the higher the DMG dealt.\nAfter casting, exit <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>.",
