      "skill": {
        "name": "Everfrost Dominion",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Glacio Bite</color></size>\n- While Hiyuki is in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>. Every time a new stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is inflicted on a target, an instance of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is triggered based on that enemy's current <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stack limit. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> can be inflicted on <color=Highlight>frozen</color> targets. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te> DMG</color>.\n- When <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> hits a target, if the target has no fewer than {0} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, consume <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} and trigger <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color> once. \n- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> into <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, all enemies' <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stacks are cleared.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Present Self</color></size>\nHiyuki starts in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, casting certain skills restores <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nHiyuki enters <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> after casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> through certain attacks.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Iai Stance</color></size>\nIf Hiyuki has at least 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>:\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after casting any <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color>.\n- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> within a certain period after casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.\nWhile performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>.\nHiyuki may enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> while airborne. Upon entering the <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> ends if Hiyuki is switched out.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iai</color></size>\nWithin a certain period after entering <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and consume 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.\nIf <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> again.\nIf Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.\nEach time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> is cast, if Hiyuki has <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> to inflict 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit, and gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dedication</color></size>\nHiyuki holds up to  300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> may be restored via the following ways:\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.\n- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color> restores 200 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>, which now additionally restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Frostheart</color></size>\nHiyuki holds up to 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.\n<color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> is restored while casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> hits the target.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Frostharden Iai</color></size>\n<color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> has a maximum of 3 points.\nCasting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> grants 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color></size>\n<color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.\nEach time <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> is consumed through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Snowforged Blade</color></size>\n<color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.\nEach time <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> is cast, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.",
        "param": [
          "10",
          "10"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Glacio Bite</color></size>\nWhile Hiyuki is in the team, <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color> inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is replaced by <color=Highlight>Glacio Bite</color>.\nWhen <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> hits the target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of <color=Highlight>Glacio Bite</color>, remove 10 stacks and trigger <color=Highlight>Frostbind</color> once.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Present Self</color></size>\nHiyuki starts in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaimed Self</color></size>\nHiyuki enters <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>. While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, new skill forms are unlocked.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Iai Stance</color></size>\nHold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> while casting the certain attacks of <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> at the cost of STA.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iai</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and blocking incoming attacks. If Hiyuki has <color=Highlight>Frostharden Iai</color>, consume 1 stack of it to enhance this attack and gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> to continuously cast it.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dedication</color></size>\nA special resource used while in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>. Built up through certain attacks and consumed when casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Frostheart</color></size>\nA special resource used while in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>. Built up through certain attacks and consumed when casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Frostharden Iai</color></size>\nGained through <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>. Enhances <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color></size>\nGained when <color=Highlight>Frostharden Iai</color> is consumed through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>. When full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> becomes available.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Snowforged Blade</color></size>\nGained upon casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>. Enhances <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>.",

        "name": "Tune Break: Sword",
        "desc": "When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Hiyuki can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.\n<size=10></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3</color>.",

  "chains": {
    "1": {
      "name": "Springless",
      "desc": "The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self</color> are increased by {0}.\n<size=10></size>\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3</color> now has an increased range and pulls enemies within range toward the center. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions while casting  <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 & 5</color>.\n<size=10></size>\nCasting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 1 & 2</color>, which now inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.",
      "param": [
        "120%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_FeixueM1_UI.T_IconDevice_FeixueM1_UI"
    },
    "2": {
      "name": "To Burn Cold in Silence",
      "desc": "<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>'s DMG Multiplier is increased by {0}.\n<size=10></size>\nInherent Skill <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Realm</color>'s effect becomes the following one:\nOnce Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, restore <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\nOnce Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for {2}s, the following effects are triggered once:\n- While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, restore <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>.\n- Reset the Cooldown of <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=charge P=charges SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>.\n- Restore an additional {6} points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> for the next <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=cast P=casts SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.",
      "param": [
        "125%",
        "3",
        "4",
        "3",
        "2",
        "2",
        "50"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_FeixueM2_UI.T_IconDevice_FeixueM2_UI"
    },
    "3": {
      "name": "No Self, No Bound",
      "desc": "Inherent Skill <color=Highlight>Fine Snow</color> gains the following effect:\n{0}s after a Resonator joins the team or Hiyuki is revived, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>. Hiyuki can obtain up to 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color> in this way.\n<size=10></size>\nThe DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> are increased by {1}.\n<size=10></size>\nAt 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, while Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, the DMG Multiplier of the additionally applied Glacio Bite DMG each time she inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> is increased by {2}.",
      "param": [
        "2",
        "160%",
        "488%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_FeixueM3_UI.T_IconDevice_FeixueM3_UI"
    },
    "4": {
      "name": "Like Reeds on Tides",
      "desc": "Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color> increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by {0} for {1}s.\n<size=10></size>\nRestore {2} of Max HP while casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.",
      "param": [
        "20%",
        "30",
        "18%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_FeixueM4_UI.T_IconDevice_FeixueM4_UI"
    },
    "5": {
      "name": "Vessel of Thousand Wishes",
      "desc": "The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color> are increased by {0}.",
      "param": [
        "80%"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_FeixueM5_UI.T_IconDevice_FeixueM5_UI"
    },
    "6": {
      "name": "Into a Night Without End",
      "desc": "The Crit. DMG of <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> and <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> is increased by {0}.\n<size=10></size>\nAt 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, the effect \"While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier\" changes to \"While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time a Resonator in the team applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier.\"\nAt 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by {1}.\nAt 3 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, the total <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> taken by targets within a certain range of the active Resonator in the team is increased by {2}.",
      "param": [
        "500%",

      "sub_dec_name": "Hiyuki - Original Outfit",
      "bg_description": "A miko's robes from a distant land, worn by Hiyuki when she inherited the Suzu beneath the Flaming Sakura.   "forte_new": {
    "features": [
      "Deal substantial Resonance Liberation DMG.",
      "When certain attacks hit the target, consume <color=Highlight>Glacio Bite</color> on the target to inflict <color=Highlight>Frostbind</color>.",
      "Accumulate and consume <color=Highlight>Snowforged Blade</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. The more you consumed, the higher the DMG."
    ],
    "instructions": {
      "110801": {
        "name": "Forte Gauge",
        "desc": {
          "110807": {
            "desc": "While in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> restores Forte Gauge <color=Highlight>Dedication</color>. When <color=Highlight>Dedication</color> is full, Enhanced Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color> and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> become available. Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> sends Hiyuki into <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>.",
            "input_list": [],
            "image_list": [
              "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/T_RoleSkillTreeFeixue1.T_RoleSkillTreeFeixue1"
            ]
          },
          "110808": {
            "desc": "While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, Hiyuki restores Forte Gauge <color=Highlight>Frostheart</color> when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color> hits the target or casting Resonance Skill. With sufficient <color=Highlight>Frostheart</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge to enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> after Hiyuki performs certain attacks, during which <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> may be cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>.",

    "talent_name": "Bubbles of Nihility",
    "talent_doc": "[Filed by <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>: <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te> Student Records]\n\n[Forte Examination Report: RA2499-G]\n\nStudent Name: Denia\n\n<te href=700009>Synchronist</te> Qualification: Negative\n\nForte Overview:Tests reveal a <te href=850067>Rabelle's Curve</te> with a pronounced periodic waveform.   "stories": [
    {
      "title": "A Gift",
      "content": "To those who raised her, \"Denia\" was merely another asset of the Fractsidus, another pawn for the Grand Architect.\n\nAnd \"Denia,\" strictly speaking, isn't a real name at all.\n\nIn the region where she was born, people usually say \"Dasvidaniya\" when parting ways, meaning \"until we meet again.\"\n\nFor human beings, a name is a parent's first gift to their children, aside from life itself. From that moment on, the child steps into the world as someone new, growing day by day, slowly adding depth and meaning to that name.\n\nThe girl chose Denia as her name because it was the only gift her family had left for her.\n\nEven if that family only ever existed in some fleeting fever dream.\n\nShe had scoured her birth records. She even questioned if she was not something artificially constructed. But in the end, all she ever found was a blurred image of farewell in her memory.\nAnd it's so hard to tell anything from this little piece. Whenever she brought it up with the Grand Architect, the answer was always the same: \"Memories are unreliable. Let it go. It's best you don't know.\"\n\nMaybe the Grand Architect had a point.\n\nOnce she had a chat with Nastasha about her friends' names, and learned of the blessings and stories they carry. Some were hopes for peace or joy. Others were wishes or dreams. All of them, in one way or another, pointed toward happiness. Yet when she asked what \"Denia\" meant, she received no clear answer.\n\nIt was obvious Nastasha didn't want to talk about it, so Denia stopped asking. After a year of observing and imitating humans, she had long since mastered the arts of masking and deception.\nMaybe some things could never be found out.\n\nShe wasn't even sure if that hazy memory was really hers. Maybe it came from the biological original she was modeled after... Maybe it was nothing more than something the Fractsidus planted in her to keep her in line.\n\nShe had once overheard the Fractsidus researchers mention that while the human body replaces its cells and substances every few years, something always stays, to be refined time and again. That's what makes life so special.\n\nThat's especially true for those who never find their way back... Anything that manages to stick to the memories carves deep into their souls. Even just a scent. That is why some love to watch rainstorms, while others are obsessed with an unremarkable melody. Such is the human being. Always pretending to be rational, while venting all their emotions through irrational acts.\n\nMaybe there really was a girl named Denia, once. A girl who waved goodbye to her mother.\nBut was that girl truly her?"
    },
    {
      "title": "A Wasteland",
      "content": "Leaning against the solid, cold side of the Voidmatter Pod, bubbles and foul liquid forced their way into Denia's mouth and nose.\n\nDrip. Drip. Drip.\n\nHer senses dulled. Time seemed to stretch into forever.\n\nShe felt that everything that made her was being pulled apart. Her frequency splintered into countless threads. Her body dissolved into grot, swept away into the ocean. Then she rose again, a drift of mist moving across the world from one end to the other like the wind, brushing over colorless wastelands until she reached that familiar, decaying stretch of sky.\n\nAnd the silent world gazed down at her, as it always had, without a word.\n\nWhen the Grand Architect chose Denia as the \"vessel\" for Aleph-1's powers, the decision went beyond mere physical and frequency compatibility. Unlike other Resonators—people shaped by rich lives and deep emotions—Denia was empty. A hollow shell. And the one thing a hollow shell feels toward themselves and the world, more than anything, is \"nothingness.\" A quality that perfectly aligns with Aleph-1's logic of existence.\n\nAnd just as expected, Denia managed to embrace the power. For a split second in <te href=750040>Voidspace</te>, her eyes met Aleph-1's. A fleeting moment, but long enough for Voidmatter to flood her veins and organs. It granted her the power to manipulate Voidmatter particles and forged a link to Voidspace itself.\n\nAt the time, she felt only a familiar silence in the void, along with the peace that came with it.\n\nBut as the plan progressed, the Fractsidus noticed that the Resonance between Denia and the Voidborne Threnodian was rapidly declining.\n\nThe power itself remained unchanged. Something else went wrong. The vessel meant to remain hollow... wasn't. Undoubtedly, Denia failed to reach the perfection they desired.\n\nIn trying to imitate human behavior, in mimicking emotions she was never meant to feel, she had grown a fragile, aching heart.\n\nThe heart of the weak.\n\nAnd with a heart like that, she could never truly become the incarnation of Aleph-1. As a result, the Fractsidus needed to fill this vessel with something strong enough to command the \"void\" and complete the final step in forging Aleph-1's Resonator.\n\nDenia had always known this day would come.\n\nYet when that day arrived, how was she supposed to judge the life she had lived?\n\nA puppet. A twisted monster... Or simply a single drop in an ocean that no one will ever miss.\n\nSometimes she would think of the time she spent at Startorch Academy. The girl in the crowd with the unexpected smile. The girl whose gentle laughter lingered in the memories of others. The lazy girl who was sometimes flustered.\n\nWas that girl really her?\n\nBut then again, was she really not the girl?"
    },
    {
      "title": "A Bright Light",
      "content": "A smile is a convenient tool. A low-cost way to narrow the distance between you and others.\n\nDenia first met Sigrika during a group assignment. She sat in a corner of the classroom, idly twirling a strand of hair behind her ear while observing her classmates pair up.\n\nAn afternoon breeze drifted through the doorway, kneading the hums of vehicles from the parking lot with the clamor from the square. On the wall, a poster for a Fleet Snowfluff fan meeting rustled with a sharp, paper snap.\n\nA hesitant voice suddenly found her, pulling her out of the little moment of comfort.\n\n\"Would you like to work on the assignment with me, Denia?\"\n\nDenia turned her head and saw the orange-haired girl with her hands clasped behind her back. Habitually, she tilted her head slightly, just to be sure the question was really for her, then deepened the smile on her face.\n\n\"Sure, why not?\" she replied. \"But why me, Sigrika?\"\n\nSigrika explained that, while she knew Denia usually kept to herself, she noticed the joyful smile on Denia's face as she watched her classmates make a fuss.  That made Sigrika think she must be a gentle person. The kind she'd want to be friends with.\n\nGentle.\n\nDenia looked up the word later. After hearing the Grand Architect's explanation, she was certain that, when applied to her, the term carried a heavy sense of irony.\n\nIf given the choice again, Denia might have refused the invitation. A great deal of trouble could have been avoided had they never met.\n\nYet in that moment, she simply nodded, smiled, and told Sigrika, \"Okay.\"\n\nNastasha's words from a few days ago still echoed in her ears: \"The truth is, it's not that most people are not afraid of death... people simply try not to think about it.\"\n\nDon't think. Don't See. Don't hear. Don't wonder.\n\nDenia discovered that inside <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>, something stood between the students and the concept of death, shielding them from its weight.\n\nBy day, the campus was a hive of youthful energy, where something new waited to be discovered at every turn. At night, they gazed at the star charts, watching the dreams Professor Mornye painted across the sky. This sense of happiness shrouded their senses, blinding them to the harsh realities that \"it\" sees.\n\nBut all dreams eventually end. \"It\" will arrive one day.\n\nAt the time, Nastasha had ruffled her hair and told her, \"Most kids your age don't think about things like this. You're still young. You've got a whole future ahead of you. You should be more vocal and happy, like your peers, instead of curling up in the library all day, or sitting here with a librarian like me talking about such heavy things.\"\n\n\"Death is the ultimate question of life, Denia, but it's a bit too early for you to be solving it. First, you have to find your own path.\"\n\nDenia didn't really understand what Nastasha meant by those words. All she could do was visit the library less often afterwards.\n\nShe didn't want to make Nastasha sad."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Mob",
      "content": "Those close to the Grand Architect have all heard that tired story one time or another.\n\nOnce upon a time, there was a fool who became a great hero by sheer accident. To save those who were suffering, {Male=he;Female=she} bore an unimaginable price, a price that was never {Male=his;Female=hers} to bear...\n\nThe Overseers had their own takes on the story's hero. Some mocked {Male=him;Female=her}, some hated {Male=him;Female=her}, and some felt sorry for {Male=him;Female=her}. Others just laughed it off or barely paid attention.\n\nYet the name the Grand Architect kept bringing up, the name that often worked wonders, was nothing more than a distant, vague lie to Denia.\n\nShe didn't even know if she counted as one of \"those who were suffering.\" She only knew that whenever she mentioned that name, the Grand Architect would respond with mocking laughter—half aimed at Denia, half at themselves.\n\n\"You know, I also think {Male=he;Female=she} should be here,\" they'd say. \"But since {Male=he;Female=she}'s not, I guess {Male=he;Female=she} isn't as all-knowing or all-powerful as you'd hope.\"\n\n\"Such a shame, Denia. The god you needed most doesn't seem to need you.\"\n\nExcept Denia never thought of {Male=him;Female=her} as a god. If anything, she pitied {Male=him;Female=her}.\n\nIf everything the Grand Architect said was true, then the one they hailed as a savior was just another prisoner in a cage, left abandoned in this world. A person who bleeds. Who grieves. Who dies.\n\nAnd that was exactly why there was one thing neither the Grand Architect nor that person seemed to understand: she would have stood before the Keystone anyway. Even without the Grand Architect's order.\n\nBecause Denia couldn't find an answer.\n\nIf people who chase ideals always end up paying a heavier price, doesn't that mean the ideal itself is flawed?\n\nAfter all, in places that the person cannot see, there are always those who survive by more \"elegant\" rules. Exploitation. Betrayal. They enjoy the world {Male=he;Female=she} has sacrificed to protect, all while mocking the ones who throw themselves into the storm.\n\nWhy does the world always show its teeth to the kind souls? Why are those who put a price on everything the ones who endure?\n\nAnd if {Male=he;Female=she} could so easily let go of {Male=his;Female=her} own past, why would {Male=he;Female=she} ever give up the little happiness {Male=he;Female=she}'d fought to grasp, just to face something as absurd and horrible as Aleph-1 for everyone else's sake?\n\nTo protect them? But who would ever understand that? What would happen when that person fell?\n\nIf the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>'s plans could already save the majority... then what was that person struggling to achieve after all?\n\nMost of the time, the thoughts Denia kept buried under layers of masks were simple.\n\nShe just thought that between that person, this world, and herself, at least one of them had to be wrong."
    },
    {
      "title": "A Lie",
      "content": "Denia's consciousness kept falling, down through the endless dark.\n\nAbsorbing the final fragment of Aleph-1 into her <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> had pushed her physical form past its limit. The Voidmatter overwhelmed her once more, just as it had countless times before.\n\nHer senses dulled. Time seemed to stretch into forever.\n\nFunny how the ending mirrored the beginning. Everything fit nicely, enough to form a perfect circle.\n\nBut unlike the first time she'd found herself here, Denia realized she had somehow stopped trembling. Her breathing steadied, and the dread that once tightened her chest had vanished.\n\nWhen that gaze met hers again, she slowly reached out a hand toward the hollow eye. Then, the same hand reaching for something clenched into a fist. She raised her index and middle fingers, pointed them right at the center of that pupil, like she was taking aim.\n\nShe saw it now. How laughable Aleph-1 really was.\n\nA god born of a meaningless world naturally possesses nothing at all. Driven by the instincts of the void, it craved everything. Still, no matter how much it consumed, how much it destroyed, it remained as it was—alone in a world of eternal silence, forever thirsting, never satisfied, leaving nothing behind.\n\nAnd the solid ground for her mockery? A heart of her own. The very thing that set her apart from Aleph-1.\n\nEven if that heart was small, fragile, and nothing much in the grand stretch of time.\n\nYet this \"meaningless\" heart had allowed her to harbor expectations for tomorrow. Just like anyone else.\n\nThere would always be those willing to live for a lie. As a certain annoying friend once said: The heart defines who we are. And with it, one gains the right to choose. Much like how humans celebrate the day they were born, a day that marks their escape from the void with a fleeting memory and a transient shape. From that day on, they could feel the world. Feel joy. Reach out to others. And because of all that, they could create something the void could never.\n\nDenia closed her eyes. She pictured her friends across the lands of <te href=850079>Solaris</te>. Sigrika, chasing birds through a sunset field. Nastasha, bent over old books in the library. And the wanderer she'd once tricked, packing up again for another long journey, somewhere far, far away.\n\nThe thought almost made her smile. She wanted to borrow that person's tone for a second and say the words with the same serious face:\n\n\"I hope they're all happy. Joyful. Free. I hope every one of their wishes comes true.\"\n\nBut the words caught in her throat. Too dramatic, she thought.\n\nSo she let it go. Maybe this was enough.\n\nNot many things in this world had ever really belonged to Denia. But now, at least, she wasn't a vessel. Not a sample. Not a pawn. The void didn't own her anymore. Neither did the orders. Neither did the lies.\n\nShe just offered up the wish, quietly. From now on, she'd be right there beside them. Never leaving.\n\nDenia had found her own path.\n\n——\n\nBang.\n\nNow that could be the sound of a good joke being cracked. The endless dark actually had an end.\n\nSomewhere in the gloom, someone let out a soft sigh, as if they had been waiting for a long time."
    }
  ],

      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: I",
      "content": "People keep asking why I don't wear the uniform... Well, the whole point of the Academy uniform is its Voidmatter protection, right? But guess what the Academy has my Forte registered as? \"Capable of creating bubbles that can isolate Voidmatter and offer protection.\" Hehe, surprise, surprise.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_storyobj.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_storyobj"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Chat: II",
      "content": "It was just... a lot of time in a dim room. Surgeries. Performance tests. Over and over... Nothing but bad memories, really. But I did like that little garden outside my room. True, they were just plants that grew under the Voidmatter's influence, but they had these colors... Unique and beautiful.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_storyexp.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_storyexp"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Sigrika",
      "content": "I find myself wondering... how nice would it be if Sigrika were just an ordinary girl?\nWithout all that weight on her shoulders.  They say you eventually have to pay for being innocent, but what did the kind and pure ever do to deserve that? The world can be so cruel. It punishes the kindest people and calls it \"growth.\" Like that makes any sense.\nBut through it all, Siggy has never been afraid... She really is amazing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_xigelika.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_xigelika"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Hiyuki",
      "content": "That miko from <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> is so powerful. Like she's cheating, you know? Yeah, I'd heard the stories before. But facing that power myself was a whole different story.\nShe wasn't exactly what I pictured, though. Beyond all that strength and the gentleness you can tell right from her face, there's something else, almost... clinging to her. Something that won't wash away. Loneliness... or maybe regret?\nIf growing stronger really comes with a price, I wonder… what has she given up to get this power?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_feixue.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_feixue"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Phrolova",
      "content": "She was one of the few Overseers in the Fractsidus who would talk to me. When I was floating in the Voidmatter pod, she'd even play the violin for me. I really enjoyed her music. It's just... I never figured out how someone who could make such beautiful melodies... would ever want to help a maniac like the Grand Architect.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_fuluoluo.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_fuluoluo"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Mornye",
      "content": "Professor Mornye fits every idea I've ever had of a perfect teacher: She has a soft voice, a sweet heart, she knows her stuff inside and out, and her classes are seriously intense. And the best part? She never, ever calls on me to answer questions when I'm napping in her class! Although... it might also be that no one has ever dared to sleep in her class before.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_moning.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_moning"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "About Aemeath",
      "content": "She's the legendary Fleet Snowfluff, right? I totally recognized her back in <te href=750040>Voidspace</te>.\nThe Academy's former beloved star—even the toughest professors still talk about her after all these years. Plus, she still holds the top score on every single machine at the Mind Dive Arcade! Honestly, if you want your classmates to trust you, all you have to do is try to act like her... Her charm is seriously next level.\nSpeaking of which... you must be really proud of her, huh? Make sure you protect her well this time. Don't ever lose her again.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_aimisi.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_about_aimisi"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Birthday Wishes",
      "content": "Seriously? You picked me to celebrate your birthday with you? But your cake does look pretty good... Mind if I steal a bite?\nHaha, just kidding. This is your big day, huh? Happy birthday!\nI sincerely wish that, as you journey forward, your heart stays full of happiness, and that nothing—no matter how absurd or painful—ever truly defeats you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_birthcele.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_birthcele"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: I",
      "content": "Better start running. Oh? You actually got away. Hmph, lucky for you.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_idle_idle01.play_favor_word_daniya_idle_idle01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: II",
      "content": "One. Two. Three. Four… A bit off, maybe?\nFi-five! No!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_idle_idle02.play_favor_word_daniya_idle_idle02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Idle: III",
      "content": "Now, a volunteer from the audience...\nWant me put you down? Well, since you asked nicely… Hehe.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_idle_idle03.play_favor_word_daniya_idle_idle03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Self-Introduction",
      "content": "Surprised to see me? Haha, relax. I told you we'd meet again.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_introduction.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_introduction"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Greeting",
      "content": "Shh... Keep this between us, will you?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_gacha.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_gacha"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: I",
      "content": "Fine, fine... I'll help.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_jointeam_01.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_jointeam_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: II",
      "content": "Fighting alongside you? Okay, that's new.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_jointeam_02.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_jointeam_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Join Team: III",
      "content": "I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_jointeam_03.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_jointeam_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: I",
      "content": "It feels like I can control more Voidmatter now. Hmm... Getting stronger is always a good thing, right?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup01.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup01"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: II",
      "content": "So you just need more power? I see... But to borrow my power? That's far too risky.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup02.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup02"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: III",
      "content": "Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup03.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup03"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: IV",
      "content": "You knew the risks, and yet... you still came this far. You are just... impossible. Always. But thanks to you, I can stabilize Voidmatter now. It's a bit embarrassing to say, but... I think I want to use this power to protect everyone.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup04.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup04"
    },
    {
      "type": 1,
      "title": "Ascension: V",
      "content": "Existence is meaningless. Life is meaningless. We are meaningless. And thinking about this meaningless world is meaningless too—or so Aleph-1 says. But meaningless as I am, I can still hear my own heartbeat. I can still hear the laughter we shared... And now, I believe some things are real. Maybe that's how it's always been: I'm more afraid of being alone than I ever was of the void.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup05.play_favor_word_daniya_sys_rankup05"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: I",
      "content": "Piece by piece!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_black_01.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_black_01"
    },
    {

      "title": "Basic Attack: II",
      "content": "Bit by bit!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_black_02.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_black_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: III",
      "content": "Get lost.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_black_03.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_black_03"
    },
    {

      "title": "Basic Attack: IV",
      "content": "Burn!",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: V",
      "content": "Disintegrate!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_ex_black_02.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_ex_black_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: VI",
      "content": "Shut up.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_ex_black_03.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_ex_black_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Basic Attack: VII",
      "content": "Oh, please…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_03.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_atk04_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: I",
      "content": "Over here.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_heavyatk01_02.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_heavyatk01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: II",
      "content": "Surprise, surprise!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_heavyatk01_03.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_heavyatk01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: III",
      "content": "No hiding!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_heavyatk02_black_02.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_heavyatk02_black_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Heavy Attack: IV",
      "content": "So annoying!",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: I",
      "content": "Do we have to fight?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk01_end_01.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk01_end_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: II",
      "content": "Are we done yet?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk01_end_02.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk01_end_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: III",
      "content": "*Yawn* I'm beat.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk01_end_03.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk01_end_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: IV",
      "content": "Meaningless fight.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk02_end_black_01.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk02_end_black_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: V",
      "content": "I'm done being soft.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk02_end_black_02.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk02_end_black_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Aerial Attack: VI",
      "content": "Just give up.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk02_end_black_03.play_favor_word_daniya_atk_fallingatk02_end_black_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: I",
      "content": "Enough!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill01_sp_02.play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill01_sp_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: II",
      "content": "Stay down!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill01_sp_03.play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill01_sp_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: III",
      "content": "Wanna come in?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill02_black_03.play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill02_black_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: IV",
      "content": "Banish!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill02_sp_black_01.play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill02_sp_black_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: V",
      "content": "Devour.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill02_sp_black_02.play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill02_sp_black_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Skill: VI",
      "content": "Take a bite?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill02_sp_black_03.play_favor_word_daniya_skill_skill02_sp_black_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: I",
      "content": "Please don't… pity me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst01_01.play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst01_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: II",
      "content": "Please don't… look at me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst01_02.play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst01_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: III",
      "content": "Please don't… forgive me.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst01_03.play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst01_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: IV",
      "content": "Ashes to ashes!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst03_black_01.play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst03_black_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: V",
      "content": "Radiance no more!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst03_black_02.play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst03_black_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Resonance Liberation: VI",
      "content": "Darkness. End. Permanent.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst03_black_03.play_favor_word_daniya_burst_burst03_black_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Intro Skill: I",
      "content": "Is it my turn?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_skill_qte01.play_favor_word_daniya_skill_qte01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,

      "content": "Hah. Tired of running?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_skill_qte03_black.play_favor_word_daniya_skill_qte03_black"
    },
    {

    {

    },
    {

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: II",
      "content": "Right back at ya!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_parry_03.play_favor_word_daniya_com_parry_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: III",
      "content": "Anything else?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_parry_black_01.play_favor_word_daniya_com_parry_black_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Counterattack: IV",
      "content": "Mm-hmm?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_parry_black_02.play_favor_word_daniya_com_parry_black_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: I",
      "content": "You're getting on my nerves.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_behitfly_02.play_favor_word_daniya_com_behitfly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Hit: II",
      "content": "Wait. That's not fair!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_behitfly_03.play_favor_word_daniya_com_behitfly_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: I",
      "content": "Need to focus…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_hpdown01.play_favor_word_daniya_com_hpdown01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: II",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Injured: III",

    },
    {

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: I",

      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_die_01.play_favor_word_daniya_com_die_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: II",
      "content": "The void, and the darkness…",

    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Fallen: III",
      "content": "Someone's still… waiting for me…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_die_03.play_favor_word_daniya_com_die_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Summon",
      "content": "Now, do as I say.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_hxsummon.play_favor_word_daniya_com_hxsummon"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Echo Transform",
      "content": "Lend me your hand.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_hxchange.play_favor_word_daniya_com_hxchange"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near: I",
      "content": "Wait, again?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_engage.play_favor_word_daniya_com_engage"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Enemies Near: II",
      "content": "Don't push your luck.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_engage_black.play_favor_word_daniya_com_engage_black"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider: I",
      "content": "My body feels so light.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_fly_01.play_favor_word_daniya_com_fly_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Glider: II",
      "content": "It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_fly_02.play_favor_word_daniya_com_fly_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Sensor",
      "content": "Hiding something, are we?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_scan.play_favor_word_daniya_com_scan"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash: I",
      "content": "My feet hurt…",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_accelerate.play_favor_word_daniya_com_accelerate"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Dash: II",
      "content": "Make it quick.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_accelerate_black.play_favor_word_daniya_com_accelerate_black"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: I",
      "content": "Well, better than nothing.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_01.play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: II",
      "content": "A little pocket money.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_black_01.play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_black_01"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: III",
      "content": "Can I trade these for desserts?",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_02.play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: IV",
      "content": "They'd better be worth something.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_black_02.play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_black_02"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: V",
      "content": "Now they're mine!",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_03.play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_03"
    },
    {
      "type": 2,
      "title": "Supply Chest: VI",
      "content": "Make sure no one sees it.",
      "voice": "/Game/Aki/WwiseAudio/Events/play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_black_03.play_favor_word_daniya_com_openbox_black_03"
    }
  ],
  "goods": [
    {
      "title": "\"Trickster\"",
      "content": "A doll that Denia carries around. Far from the pretty thing you usually see, its worn body is now stitched all over with clumsy repairs, and the Voidmatter that once stuffed its shape has long since bled away.\n\n<i>\"A broken, stubborn vessel, once shaped by the world's gaze. Now, it whispers a plea, over and over: Please, give me a heart. Any heart will do.\"</i>",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure146_UI.T_Treasure146_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "Startorch Memory Album",
      "content": "An ornately decorated photo album, meticulously maintained. It is clear at a glance that its owner treasures it dearly.\nThe Photography Fan Club at <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te> gifted each member a personal album as a vessel for their cherished campus memories. Most of the pages are filled with group shots where Denia smiles quietly from the corner... It was simply her way to earn credits.\n\n<i>\"The wilderness has no word. Perhaps it sees nothing, hears nothing, and cares not what we say. It simply reaches out, stretching toward the infinite horizon.\"</i>",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure147_UI.T_Treasure147_UI"
    },
    {
      "title": "\"Dream Maker\"",
      "content": "A device that generates massive bubbles, nothing extraordinary except for its dreamy design.\nIt looks more like a toy than a weapon.\nDenia uses it to hide Voidmatter inside the bubbles. A small illusion of being able to protect others.\n\n<i>\"To be honest, Aleph-1 never harbored any hostility toward us. It's simply indifferent to all things. Life and hope are insignificant noises for it. Meaningless. That's exactly why it could never understand how the darkness of <te href=750040>Voidspace</te> is filled with color. Those are lights from a cosmic graveyard. Starlight that faded trillions of years ago. Proof that the stars were once there.\"</i>",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiRole/Image/Treasure/T_Treasure148_UI.T_Treasure148_UI"
    }
  ],

      "skill": {
        "name": "Bubbles and Baits",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form</color></size>\nPull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Beckon - Breakdown Form</color></size>\nPull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nThis skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Banish - Breakdown Form</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Banish - Breakdown Form</color></size>\nWhile holding a <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Core</te></color>, replace <color=Highlight>Beckon - Breakdown Form</color> with <color=Highlight>Banish - Breakdown Form</color>.\nCast <color=Highlight>Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 1</color> to pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after to cast <color=Highlight>Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2</color>.\n<color=Highlight>Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2</color> consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Cores</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. For each <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Core</te></color> consumed, the DMG Multiplier of the attack is increased by {0}.\nThe skill deals Resonance Liberation DMG.\nThis skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Beckon - Breakdown Form</color>.\nCan be cast in mid-air.",
        "param": [
          "150%"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Pink</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Violet</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Resonance Skill - Violet</color></size>\nWhen holding <color=Highlight>Energy Points</color>, consume all <color=Highlight>Energy Points</color> to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.       "skill": {
        "name": "Final Act",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Final Act - Stagecraft Form</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.\nAfter performing this skill, obtain <color=Highlight><te href=121103>Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form</te></color> for {0}s, then switch to <color=Highlight>Breakdown Form</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Final Act - Breakdown Form</color></size>\nWhen <color=Highlight><te href=121105>Conformal Charge</te></color> is full, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=121105>Conformal Charge</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color> to perform this skill.\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. \nAfter casting this skill, obtain <color=Highlight><te href=121104>Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form</te></color>, which lasts for {1}s, and then switch to <color=Highlight>Stagecraft Form</color>.\nCan be performed in mid-air.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form</color></size>\nIncreases ATK by {2}.\nObtaining this effect removes the <color=Highlight><te href=121104>Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form</te></color> effect.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form</color></size>\nGrants {3} point of <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color> per second.\nObtaining this effect removes the <color=Highlight><te href=121103>Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form</te></color> effect.",
        "param": [
          "12",
          "30",
          "30%",
          "1"
        ],
        "simple_desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Pink</color></size>\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Enter <color=Highlight>Enhanced State - Violet</color> and switch to <color=Highlight>Violet Form</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Violet</color></size>\nThis skill becomes available when <color=Highlight>Special Resonance Energy</color> is full.\nDeal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Enter <color=Highlight>Enhanced State - Pink</color> and switch to <color=Highlight>Pink Form</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced State - Violet</color></size>\nIncreases ATK and grants <color=Highlight>Energy Points</color> over time.\nObtaining this effect removes <color=Highlight>Enhanced State - Pink</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced State - Pink</color></size>\nRestores <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> and <color=Highlight>Energy Points</color> over time.\nObtaining this effect removes <color=Highlight>Enhanced State - Violet</color>.",

        "name": "\"Flawless\"",
        "desc": "<size=40><color=Title>Erosion Field</color></size>\nAfter casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Final Act - Breakdown Form</color>, generate an <color=Highlight>Erosion Field</color>, lasting for {0}s. Only one <color=Highlight>Erosion Field</color> generated by your own Resonator can exist at a time.\n<color=Highlight>Erosion Field</color> pulls in nearby targets once every {1}s, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Void Particle</color></size>\nWhen in the <color=Highlight>Breakdown Form</color> while holding <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> consumes <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color> on hit and grants the following effects:\n- The skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color> and the DMG Multiplier is increased by {2}.\n- <color=Highlight><te href=121105>Conformal Charge</te></color> regenerates {3} faster.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, Denia gains the following effects:\n- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every {5}s against the same target.\nIntro Skill <color=Highlight>It's Been A While!</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Knock Knock</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Final Act - Stagecraft Form</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Final Act - Breakdown Form</color>, and <color=Highlight>Erosion Field</color>.\n- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every {6}s against the same target.\n<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4</color>.\n- When Denia is in the team, if an enemy falls to <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te> DMG</color>, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color></size>\nWhile in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, Denia gains the following effects:\n- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target and reset the duration of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every {9}s against the same target.\nIntro Skill <color=Highlight>It's Been A While!</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Knock Knock</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Final Act - Stagecraft Form</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Final Act - Breakdown Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Erosion Field</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3</color> and <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4</color>.\n- When Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target, this target's Off-Tune Level is increased by {10} of the max. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every {11}s. \n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Dark Core</color></size>\n- Denia can hold up to {12} <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Cores</te></color>.\n- While in the <color=Highlight><te href=121106>Entropy Shift</te></color> states,  Denia obtains <SapTag=A>{14}</SapTag> <color=Highlight><te href=121101>{Cus:Sap,S=Dark Core P=Dark Cores SapTag=A}</te></color> every {13}s.\nDenia obtains <SapTag=B>{15}</SapTag> <color=Highlight><te href=121101>{Cus:Sap,S=Dark Core P=Dark Cores SapTag=B}</te></color> upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>It's Been A While!</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Knock Knock</color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Void Particle</color></size>\n- Denia can hold up to <SapTag=C>{16}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color>.\n- While in <color=Highlight>Stagecraft Form</color>, dealing damage through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> grants <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color>.\n- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>It's Been A While!</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Knock Knock</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form</color> grants <SapTag=D>{17}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color>.\n<size=10></size>\n<size=40><color=Title>Conformal Charge</color></size>\n- Denia can hold up to {18} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121105>Conformal Charge</te></color>.\n- While in <color=Highlight>Breakdown Form</color>, dealing damage through <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Beckon -   "skill_branches": {

      "name": "Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst",
      "desc": "When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, this Resonator inflicts <color=Highlight>Fusion Burst Effect</color> and boosts the damage output of Fusion Burst Effect teams.",

    "121102": {
      "name": "Resonance Mode - Tune Strain",
      "desc": "When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, Denia can inflict <color=Highlight>Tune Strain - Shifting</color>, reset <color=Highlight>Tune Strain - Interfered</color> duration, rapidly increase the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color>, and overall boost the damage dealt by the Tune Strain Response team.",
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Atlas/RoleLabel/SP_RoleLabelH2.SP_RoleLabelH2"
    }
  },
  "chains": {
    "1": {
      "name": "Silent Glows in a Dimlit Dream",
      "desc": "Crit. DMG is increased by {0}.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen performing Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form</color>, or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Banish - Breakdown Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4</color>,  Denia becomes immune to interruption.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen Denia enters combat in <color=Highlight>Stagecraft Form</color>, she obtains the <color=Highlight><te href=121104>Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form</te></color> effect for {1}s.\nWhen Denia enters combat in <color=Highlight>Breakdown Form</color>, she obtains the <color=Highlight><te href=121103>Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form</te></color> effect for {2}s.",
      "param": [
        "30%",
        "30",
        "12"
      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_DaniyaM1_UI.T_IconDevice_DaniyaM1_UI"
    },
    "2": {
      "name": "Tossed in the Tides of Reality",
      "desc": "When Denia is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, after a Resonator in the team inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target, they gain {0} Fusion DMG Bonus for {1}s. After <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> is triggered on enemies near the active Resonator in the team, Denia gains <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight>Degenerate Voidmatter</color> for {3}s, up to {4} stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight>Degenerate Voidmatter</color> causes Denia to ignore {5} of the target's Fusion RES.\nThis effect ends when Denia switches modes.\n<size=10></size>\nWhen Denia is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, her <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit</color> effect is enhanced: After a Resonator in the team inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target, their Tune Break Boost is increased by {6} for {7}s, and the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is increased by {8} of the max. This effect can only be triggered once per {9}s on the same target.\nThis effect ends when Denia switches forms.\n<size=10></size>\nThe DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Banish - Breakdown Form</color> is increased by {10}.",
      "param": [
        "50%",
        "15",

      ],
      "icon": "/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconDevice/T_IconDevice_DaniyaM2_UI.T_IconDevice_DaniyaM2_UI"
    },
    "3": {
      "name": "Through Dark and Wind, the Erlking Follows",
      "desc": "The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Final Act - Breakdown Form</color> is increased by {0}.\n<size=10></size>\nDenia now holds up to {1} <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Cores</te></color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=121106>Entropy Shift</te></color>,  the shortest interval at which she can obtain <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Core</te></color> is reduced to {2}s.\nThe <color=Highlight><te href=121104>Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form</te></color> effect is enhanced and now grants {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color> per second.\nThe <color=Highlight><te href=121103>Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form</te></color> effect is enhanced: Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Final Act - Breakdown Form</color> additionally restores {4} points of Concerto Energy.\n<size=10></size>\nDenia's Inherent Skill <color=Highlight>Vestiges of Falsehood</color> is enhanced:\nUpon entering combat, <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Core</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121102>Void Particle</te></color> are restored to the max. This effect can be triggered once every {5}s. \n<size=10></size>\nWhen the number of <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Cores</te></color> reaches the limit, casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form</color> consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=121101>Dark Cores</te></color> and increases the DMG Multiplier of this skill by {6}. The DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.",

    "6": {
      "name": "May You Find Your Sun in the Silence",
      "desc": "While in <color=Highlight><te href=121106>Entropy Shift</te></color> states, gain {0} ATK increase and {1} Fusion DMG Bonus.\n<size=10></size>\nWhile Denia is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>,  after <color=Highlight>Erosion Field</color> deals damage, trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target based on its max limit. The <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> DMG triggered gains a {2} DMG Multiplier increase against the main target and does not remove the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> stacks on the targets hit. The effect can be triggered on the same target up to <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3}. When the target is damaged by Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Final Act: Breakdown Form</color>, the effect's trigger count is reset. The trigger count can be reset for the same target once every {4}s.\n<size=10></size>\nWhile Denia is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, when Resonators in the team deal <color=Highlight>Tune Break DMG</color> to <color=Highlight>Mistuned</color> enemies in <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color>, they additionally inflict <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every {6}s.",
